# 2019: current events archive

**Source-preservation edition.**

This chronological reference preserves 3,841 Wikipedia event assertions across 365 dates, including topic hierarchy, original citations and pinned revisions. SQLite is authoritative; this UTF-8 Markdown is its readable companion.

Source selection and wording are Wikipedia’s, and are not certified exhaustive, impartial or factually correct. Publication does not imply independent checking of every assertion. Original wording, errors and dated reporting figures remain visible. Editorial accounts are separately labeled and cited.

Database: [2019.sqlite](2019.sqlite). Edition SHA-256: `fb7e557f4330c6e0a23df831c8cc292a5cc6a73e1c4d31f59281a356f1c5168d`. Publication: `preservation-release-1.0`. Extraction/Markdown profile: `annual-series-1.0`. Date: 2026-10-21.

Original entries without attached citations: 6. These have separate editorial evidence. Full-event reviews complete: 2; partial: 4; without a full-event review: 3,835. Partial reviews leave unsupported details explicit.

Exact original daily files, Wikipedia payloads/metadata and prior extraction candidates are embedded losslessly, with hashes, an exact retirement manifest and Git checkpoint. Wikipedia attribution and CC BY-SA obligations remain applicable. Publisher URLs identify evidence; full publisher articles and images are not reproduced.

Template display uses explicit original arguments without calculated conversions, live expansion or inferred links. Unsupported template markup and source reliability tags remain visible. Orphan topics and malformed/unbulleted material are preserved with the handling notes below; no missing child or event is invented.

Commented-out source assertions remain labeled non-event material in the database and handling notes; they are excluded from ordinary event totals.

## January

### 2019-01-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1095183764](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20January%201&oldid=1095183764>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-01-01-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban kills 27 members of the Afghan National Security Forces in a series of coordinated attacks in northern Afghanistan after refusing to discuss peace in the region with government officials.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/01/01/world/asia/afghanistan-attacks-taliban.html>).

<a id="event-2019-01-01-0-3"></a>

Context: War in North-West Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan gunmen attack a security base in the Loralai area of Pakistan, resulting in the deaths of four security guards and four terrorists, including a suicide bomber. Two guards were also injured in the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Channel NewsAsia](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/gunmen-attack-security-base-in-pakistan-s-balochistan-province-11078440>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-01-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least nine people are killed and 34 others are missing after a landslide strikes a village in Sukabumi, West Java, in Indonesia.

Source citations (as archived): [Sunday Times](<https://www.perthnow.com.au/news/asia/indonesian-landslide-leaves-nine-dead-in-west-java-ng-b881062909z?fbclid=IwAR3QTNzJ-Hbhh5L6gcOFS3PlIjdQKqdE2Nnd6fnjSQvNN_SMnXD9zp_XPDk>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-01-01-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Tokyo car attack.

**Archived source account.** A car plows into New Year's celebrators in Tokyo, Japan, injuring eight. A ninth person was assaulted by the driver after he got out of the vehicle. Police believe the incident to be intentional.

Source citations (as archived): [Global News](<https://globalnews.ca/news/4805677/tokyo-car-hits-pedestrians-new-years/>); [Channel NewsAsia](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/9-hurt-as-car-rams-into-crowd-at-famed-tokyo-street-on-new-year-11077634>).

<a id="event-2019-01-01-2-3"></a>

Context: Bottrop and Essen car attack.

**Archived source account.** Five people are injured after a man intentionally drives a car into multiple crowds of people in the cities of Bottrop and Essen, Germany. Police say the incident appears to be a xenophobic, far-right attack.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/germany-car-attack-far-right-crowd-injured-syrian-afgan-bottrop-a8706546.html>).

<a id="event-2019-01-01-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Armed men believed to be traditional hunters have killed at least 37 people in an attack on a village in central Mali.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-46732703>).

<a id="event-2019-01-01-2-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Thai man kills six members of his family before killing himself in a drunken shooting spree.

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<https://www.rt.com/newsline/447866-thailand-new-year-rampage/>); [BNO News](<https://bnonews.com/index.php/2018/12/7-dead-in-shooting-at-new-years-party-in-thailand/?fbclid=IwAR2Gv96f1E857p7KL_vqDSJ3ZrBcuHNCx7Jj1JQJS52CHKRO6xvrpuLe84I>).

<a id="event-2019-01-01-2-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Same-sex marriage becomes legal in Austria.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/austrian-women-celebrate-countrys-sex-marriage-60104054>).

<a id="event-2019-01-01-2-8"></a>

Context: Intersex rights in Germany.

**Archived source account.** A law recognising a third gender that can be administered for intersex people takes effect in Germany.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-46727611>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-01-01-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Jair Bolsonaro is inaugurated as the 38th president of Brazil, succeeding Michel Temer.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-46720899>).

<a id="event-2019-01-01-3-2"></a>

Context: 2018 Democratic Republic of the Congo general election.

**Archived source account.** U.S. and EU diplomats urge the Congolese government to restore internet connection to the country after it was shut down the previous day amid fears of election fraud.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/jan/01/drc-electoral-fears-rise-as-internet-shutdown-continues>).

<a id="event-2019-01-01-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump requests a bipartisan meeting with lawmakers to discuss the wall as a partial government shutdown enters its second week.

Source citations (as archived): [MPR News](<https://www.mprnews.org/story/2019/01/01/trump-invites-top-lawmakers-for-talks-as-shutdown-continues?fbclid=IwAR1YRs78X_IjfPg9M_ATRF9oVcF6YT3BbHk3cMCnDPXCTRsUcMDcXt-_j20>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-01-01-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 in spaceflight.

**Archived source account.** New Horizons makes a flyby of Kuiper belt object 2014 MU69, nicknamed Ultima Thule, at 05:33 UTC, becoming the farthest object in the Solar System visited by a spacecraft. It is a contact binary.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/12/31/science/new-horizons-ultima-thule.html>).

### 2019-01-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1362536202](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20January%202&oldid=1362536202>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-01-02-0-1"></a>

Context: China–United States trade war (2018–present).

**Archived source account.** American electronics maker Apple warns that iPhone sales are slowing significantly and the product is in weak demand, blaming trade tensions with China. The company says that it has lowered its expected fiscal earnings for the first quarter as a result, citing disappointing holiday sales figures, and that it could lose $9 billion due to the decline.

Source citations (as archived): [The Verge](<https://www.theverge.com/2019/1/2/18165804/apple-iphone-sales-weak-demand-tim-cook-letter-revised-q1-estimate>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-01-02-1-1"></a>

Context: Great Belt Bridge rail accident.

**Archived source account.** An express train crashes into an object dropped from a cargo train on the Great Belt Bridge between Funen and Zealand in Denmark, killing at least eight people and leaving several injured.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-46745652>).

<a id="event-2019-01-02-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six people are killed and 22 others injured after tractor trailer collided with twenty motorbikes in Long An province, Vietnam.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/asiapacific/2019-01/02/c_137715094_2.htm>).

<a id="event-2019-01-02-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Five people are killed after a Nigerian Air Force Mil Mi-35M crashes in Damasak, Borno State, Nigeria.

Source citations (as archived): [Aviation Safety Network](<https://aviation-safety.net/wikibase/220472>).

<a id="event-2019-01-02-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four skiers—three Finnish men and a Swedish woman—are killed in an avalanche near the Blåbærfjellet mountain in Troms, Norway.

Source citations (as archived): [Yle](<https://yle.fi/uutiset/osasto/news/norwegian_police_release_names_of_skiers_killed_by_avalanche/10585495>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-01-02-2-1"></a>

Context: United States federal government shutdown of 2018–2019.

**Archived source account.** On the last day of the 115th United States Congress, Democratic leaders Nancy Pelosi, Chuck Schumer, and others meet with President Donald Trump at the White House to discuss implementing a new budget agreement that may include funding for a new Mexico–United States barrier that could end the current federal government shutdown.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2019/01/02/pelosi-schumer-go-to-white-house-as-shutdown-over-trump-border-wall-persists.html>).

<a id="event-2019-01-02-2-2"></a>

Context: United States federal government shutdown of 2018–2019.

**Archived source account.** President Trump and congressional leaders fail to resolve their political differences over federal funding for the border barrier, with Pelosi stating that the president will receive "nothing for the wall" from her party.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.com/story/2019/01/02/trump-congress-meeting-shutdown-1077466>); [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/homenews/house/423596-pelosi-on-negotiations-with-trump-nothing-for-the-wall>).

<a id="event-2019-01-02-2-4"></a>

Context: Indigenous territories of Brazil.

**Archived source account.** President of Brazil Jair Bolsonaro issues a decree to place the responsibility for "identification, delimitation, demarcation and registration of lands traditionally occupied by indigenous people" on the Ministry of Agriculture, instead of the indigenous peoples affairs agency, FUNAI. The management of public forests also goes to the agriculture ministry. The move is seen as a big win for the industrial agribusiness lobby.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-politics-agriculture/brazil-farm-lobby-wins-as-bolsonaro-grabs-control-over-indigenous-lands-idUSKCN1OW0OS>).

### 2019-01-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1296294355](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20January%203&oldid=1296294355>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-01-03-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights and Syrian state media say that a U.S.-led coalition aerial attack killed 11 civilians in Deir ez-Zor Governorate.

Source citations (as archived): [EFE](<https://www.lavanguardia.com/internacional/20190103/453923983423/mueren-once-civiles-en-el-noreste-de-siria-por-un-bombardeo-de-la-coalicion.html>); [SANA](<https://sana.sy/en/?p=154758>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-01-03-1-1"></a>

Context: Corporate acquisitions and mergers.

**Archived source account.** Pharmaceutical company Bristol-Myers Squibb proposes the takeover of cancer drug company Celgene for US$95 billion, including debt, the biggest biopharma deal ever.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-celgene-m-a-bristol-myers/bristol-myers-to-buy-celgene-for-74-billion-in-largest-biopharma-deal-idUSKCN1OX0VM>).

<a id="event-2019-01-03-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Dow Jones Industrial Average drops 660 points following a warning from Apple on weak demand and trade relations between the United States and China.

Source citations (as archived): [TheStreet](<https://www.thestreet.com/amp/markets/dow-sinks-after-revenue-warning-from-apple-14823393?fbclid=IwAR3vgZzHuobuusvLAoQ6B5bMgs3i8ceipEUbC3Pn7f-IxtDQFgMtuU44uMg>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-01-03-2-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Magnitogorsk building collapse.

**Archived source account.** The death toll of an explosion caused by a gas leak that devastated a block of flats in Magnitogorsk, Russia, rises to 39. Rescuers end their search efforts at the collapse site as there are no more missing people.

Source citations (as archived): [The Moscow Times](<https://themoscowtimes.com/news/rescuers-end-search-at-magnitogorsk-building-collapse-site-final-death-toll-39-64033>).

<a id="event-2019-01-03-2-3"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** The mayor of Naples offers to berth a NGO-operated ship with 32 migrants who were rescued on 22 December in the Mediterranean Sea, off the coast of Libya.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-europe-migrants-ngo-italy/naples-mayor-offers-to-welcome-in-stranded-ngo-migrant-boat-idUSKCN1OX14L>).

<a id="event-2019-01-03-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Dutch Coast Guard says 270 containers fell off MSC Zoe in heavy seas near the German island of Borkum and floated towards the Netherlands. Treasure hunters revel on the West Frisian islands of Terschelling and Vlieland. Three containers containing hazardous materials are still missing and ships are warned for floating containers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/flat-screen-tvs-car-parts-wash-ashore-as-cargo-ship-containers-break-in-heavy-seas-1972284>); [World Maritime News](<https://worldmaritimenews.com/archives/267734/photos-over-200-containers-fall-from-msc-zoe-amid-heavy-weather/>).

<a id="event-2019-01-03-2-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Seven people are killed after a crash and diesel fuel spill sparked a massive fire on Interstate 75 in Gainesville, Florida, United States.

Source citations (as archived): [AOL News](<https://www.aol.com/article/news/2019/01/03/7-killed-after-fiery-crash-fuel-spill-on-florida-interstate/23633035/>).

<a id="event-2019-01-03-2-7"></a>

Context: 14th Street Tunnel shutdown.

**Archived source account.** New York Governor Andrew Cuomo announces that a complete shutdown of the 14th Street Tunnel in New York City, proposed to allow for subway repairs caused by damage from Hurricane Sandy, has been halted. Cuomo says that engineers will use a new technology from Europe to make critical repairs to the tunnel without having to close it entirely. The complete shutdown would have closed the tunnel, which is used by nearly 225,000 people each weekday, for an expected 15 months.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/01/03/nyregion/l-train-shutdown.html?fbclid=IwAR0sFInoa9FRuxSVXuch7Hqzr5p601_GoKYCN9p3Jo9kWd_1BQorjfAIf9s>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-01-03-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Somalia expels Nicholas Haysom, the most senior United Nations diplomat in the country, after accusing him of "acting like the country's ruler".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-46734994>).

<a id="event-2019-01-03-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Afghan President Ashraf Ghani demands clarification after U.S. President Donald Trump said yesterday that the Soviet Union was "right to be there", referring to the 1979–1989 Soviet–Afghan War.

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-01-15-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The correction of the North Magnetic Pole model, one year ahead of the regular five-year update, scheduled to be released this week is delayed until the end of January because of the U.S. federal government shutdown. The model is used in navigation and by the GPS systems in smartphones. The pole has been wandering, much faster than expected, away from the Canadian Arctic toward Siberia.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<https://www.upi.com/Science_News/2019/01/14/Magnetic-Norths-erratic-behavior-forces-update-to-global-navigation-system/1611547434485/>); [M.I.T. Technology Review](<https://www.technologyreview.com/the-download/612758/the-magnetic-north-pole-is-messing-with-your-smartphones-mapping-apps/>); [The Maritime Executive](<https://maritime-executive.com/article/magnetic-north-pole-shifting-rapidly-and-unpredicatably>).

### 2019-01-16

Context: Manbij bombing.

This is the first time that United States Armed Forces servicemembers have not been paid during a shutdown or other lapse in government appropriation.

The NFC Championship game is best known for an unpenalized pass interference committed by cornerback Nickell Robey-Coleman on wide receiver Tommylee Lewis, which is nicknamed as the NOLA No-Call.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS Sports](<https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/officials-miss-blatant-pass-interference-penalty-leading-to-rams-come-from-behind-win-over-saints/>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/01/22/us/new-orleans-saints-super-bowl-play-reaction-trnd/index.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-01-21-5-1"></a>

Context: Lulu and Nana controversy.

**Archived source account.** China confirms the 2018 birth of the world's first genetically edited babies, Lulu and Nana, saying He Jiankui forged ethical review papers and organised a project team with foreign staff, which intentionally avoided surveillance, and that He and his staff will be punished according to laws and regulations. The Guangdong government will keep the twins under medical observation with the support of the national departments.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<https://www.scmp.com/news/china/science/article/2182964/china-confirms-gene-edited-babies-blames-scientist-he-jiankui>).

<a id="event-2019-01-21-5-3"></a>

Context: January 2019 lunar eclipse.

**Archived source account.** A total lunar eclipse occurs, popularly dubbed a Super Blood Wolf Moon, due to the timing and orbital perigee, and a meteor impact is observed during the event.

Source citations (as archived): [Space.com](<https://www.space.com/43075-blood-moon-2019-meteor-impact-video.html>).

### 2019-01-22

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

The Israel Defense Forces action is retaliation for a shooting which lightly injured an officer, and for the brief incursion of two Palestinians into Israel.

<a id="event-2019-01-22-0-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuelan protests.

<a id="event-2019-01-22-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bus catches fire after crashing with a truck in Lasbela, Pakistan, killing 27 people and injuring others.

Context: Kuril Islands dispute, Japan–Russia relations.

<a id="event-2019-01-22-4-2"></a>

Context: Transgender personnel in the United States military.

Context: 2018 North Carolina's 9th congressional district election.

<a id="event-2019-01-22-6-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Baseball Hall of Fame balloting.

**Archived source account.** The National Baseball Hall of Fame announces the results of voting by the Baseball Writers' Association of America (BBWAA) to determine players to be formally inducted in July 2019. Roy Halladay, Edgar Martínez, Mike Mussina, and Mariano Rivera are elected and will join Harold Baines and Lee Smith, elected by a Hall committee in December 2018, at the induction ceremonies in Cooperstown, New York. Rivera is the first player ever to be elected unanimously by the BBWAA.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://www.espn.com/mlb/story/_/id/25826814/mariano-rivera-edgar-martinez-roy-halladay-mike-mussina-elected-baseball-hall-fame>).

<a id="event-2019-02-01-3-1"></a>

Context: Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces Treaty, Cold War II, Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo announces that the United States is suspending its role in the Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces Treaty, an agreement made in 1987 with the USSR (and, by extension, its successor state Russia) banning both countries from possessing or testing nuclear and conventional intermediate-range missiles, as well as their launchers, citing Russian non-compliance with the treaty.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/02/01/politics/us-russia-nuclear-arms-treaty-pompeo/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-02-01-4-1"></a>

Context: 2020 United States presidential election, 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Democratic New Jersey Senator Cory Booker announces that he is running for the office of the presidency in the 2020 presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/02/01/politics/cory-booker-announces-presidential-run-2020/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-02-01-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Republican and Democratic leaders call for the resignation of Governor Ralph Northam after a 1984 yearbook photograph apparently featuring Northam surfaces showing one person wearing blackface and another person wearing Ku Klux Klan attire.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/homenews/state-watch/428146-top-dem-super-pac-chief-activist-group-call-on-northam-to-resign?fbclid=IwAR1vnwJsTd9-zNjzXv-eFDCecFxfpLid_TZ4Lo9QUXVfb1FUByRK6Q_Agys>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-02-01-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A meteorite strikes near the Cuban town of Viñales, in the western province of Pinar del Río, after sightings of a fireball over the Florida Keys. The last confirmed meteorite to hit Cuba was in 1994.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/cuba-reports-meteorite-strike-with-fragments-falling-on-pinar-del-rio/a-47332892>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-02-01-6-1"></a>

Context: 2019 AFC Asian Cup.

**Archived source account.** Qatar defeats Japan 3-1 to win the 2019 AFC Asian Cup, earning them their first continental championship title.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/football/2019/feb/01/qatar-stun-japan-with-3-1-win-to-be-crowned-asian-cup-champions>).

<a id="event-2019-02-01-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** American Olympic alpine skier Lindsey Vonn announces she will retire after the 53rd Alpine Ski World Cup in Sweden, which is currently taking place and will conclude in March.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<http://time.com/5518558/lindsey-vonn-announces-retirement/>).

<a id="event-2019-02-02-4-1"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations, Cold War II.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-47101429>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-02-02-5-1"></a>

Context: Crisis in Venezuela, 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** Venezuela's Nicolás Maduro supports a proposal by the 2017 Constituent National Assembly to hold early legislative elections, which is seen as an attempt to eliminate the threat posed by the opposition-controlled National Assembly. U.S. Vice President Mike Pence tells a Florida rally that the time for dialogue "had ended" and "all options were on the table."

Source citations (as archived): [RTE](<https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2019/0202/1027078-venezuela/>).

<a id="event-2019-02-02-5-2"></a>

Context: Crisis in Venezuela, 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** Venezuelan Air Force general Francisco Yáñez becomes the first high-ranking general to publicly support Juan Guaidó after he denounced the "dictatorship" of Maduro and recognized Guaidó's claim as the nation's legitimate leader.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<https://www.foxnews.com/world/top-venezuela-general-rejects-maduros-legitimacy-throws-support-behind-interim-president>).

<a id="event-2019-02-02-5-3"></a>

Context: Crisis in Venezuela, 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of thousands of Venezuelan people take to the streets to protest socio-economic and political situation of the country and to demand a better economic situation. Large competing anti-Maduro and anti-Guaidó rallies are held in Caracas.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/the_americas/venezuela-protests-guaido-vs-maduro/2019/02/02/ef043b00-2660-11e9-b5b4-1d18dfb7b084_story.html?utm_term=.887de157eb3d>).

<a id="event-2019-02-02-5-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Virginia political crisis.

**Archived source account.** Governor of the U.S. state of Virginia Ralph Northam says he will not resign from office because he does not believe that he appears in a controversial photograph from his 1984 medical school yearbook showing one person wearing blackface and another person wearing Ku Klux Klan attire. However, Northam later admits to wearing blackface during the same time period for a dance contest, in order to imitate musician Michael Jackson.

Source citations (as archived): [Post and Courier](<https://www.postandcourier.com/politics/va-gov-ralph-northam-says-he-won-t-resign-denying/article_70e61994-2725-11e9-aed6-87235b6577f8.html?fbclid=IwAR3Gfo3KxT0burB3DzaqDJhJFKjb8hAaZZSG-hsPpWcQeAmTXrQKROPbKXM>); [The Washington Examiner](<https://www.washingtonexaminer.com/news/northam-says-he-did-wear-blackface-but-not-in-racist-yearbook-photo?fbclid=IwAR3zb8shDREXRWQjnoZPcZshTuEw6srfofae2QZ64DyR51OYevarIEfZvec>).

Source citations (as archived): [NOAA](<https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/news/world-magnetic-model-out-cycle-release>).

<a id="event-2019-02-07-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Amazon CEO Jeff Bezos publishes an online essay accusing American Media, Inc. owner David Pecker of "extortion and blackmail."

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/02/07/technology/jeff-bezos-national-enquirer-blackmail.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-02-07-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six people are killed by a gas explosion in an abandoned coal mine in Middelburg, South Africa.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-47158887>).

<a id="event-2019-02-07-1-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Piper PA-46 Malibu crash.

**Archived source account.** The lone body found in the Piper PA-46 Malibu that disappeared two weeks ago is confirmed to be that of missing footballer Emiliano Sala. The pilot remains missing, presumed dead.

Source citations (as archived): [Mirror](<https://www.mirror.co.uk/sport/football/news/breaking-emiliano-sala-confirmed-dead-13890793>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-02-07-2-1"></a>

Context: France–Italy relations.

**Archived source account.** France withdraws its ambassador to Italy, for the first time since the Second World War, amid an ongoing verbal row and Deputy Prime Minister Luigi Di Maio’s decision to meet with members of the French yellow vest movement.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-france-italy/france-tells-italy-basta-withdraws-envoy-after-war-of-words-idUSKCN1PW1GJ>).

<a id="event-2019-02-07-2-3"></a>

Context: Me Too movement / 2019 Virginia political crisis.

**Archived source account.** Californian professor Vanessa Tyson accuses Lieutenant Governor of Virginia Justin Fairfax of having sexually assaulted her in 2004.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2019/02/06/accuser-of-virginias-justin-fairfax-details-alleged-sexual-assault-.html>).

#### Science and research

<a id="event-2019-02-07-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** NASA scientists report the MarCO satellites, two CubeSats in deep space, have lost contact with Planet Earth.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/02/07/world/nasa-mars-insight-marco-satellites/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-02-08-1-1"></a>

Context: 2010–2017 Toronto serial homicides.

<a id="event-2019-02-08-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis, Crisis in Venezuela, United States–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** A senior White House official, speaking on condition of anonymity, reveals that the United States government is holding direct communications with members of Venezuela's military urging them to abandon Nicolás Maduro.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics-military-exclusive/exclusive-u-s-in-direct-contact-with-venezuelan-military-urging-defections-source-idUSKCN1PX22L>).

<a id="event-2019-02-08-2-5"></a>

Context: Spanish constitutional crisis.

<a id="event-2019-02-08-2-7"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Bangkok Post](<https://www.bangkokpost.com/news/general/1626498/princess-ubolratana-says-thanks-to-thais>).

### 2019-02-10

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1101250397](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20February%2010&oldid=1101250397>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-02-10-0-1"></a>

Context: Sexual abuse scandal in Southern Baptist churches, Religious abuse, Baptists in the United States.

**Archived source account.** An investigation by Houston Chronicle and the San Antonio Express-News found that since 1998, about 380 Southern Baptist church clerics, laypersons, and volunteers have faced credible accusations of sexual abuse and that of those, roughly 220 were convicted of sex crimes or received plea deals, in cases involving more than 700 victims. Many accusers were young men and women, who allegedly experienced everything from molestation to rape and impregnation at the hands of church members.

Source citations (as archived): [Houston Chronicle](<https://www.houstonchronicle.com/news/investigations/article/Southern-Baptist-sexual-abuse-spreads-as-leaders-13588038.php>); [Houston Chronicle2](<https://projects.houstonchronicle.com/2019/southern-baptist-abuse/>); [San Antonio Express-News](<https://www.expressnews.com/news/investigations/article/Southern-Baptist-sexual-abuse-spreads-as-leaders-13588038.php>).

<a id="event-2019-02-10-0-2"></a>

Context: Sexual abuse scandal in Southern Baptist churches, Religious abuse, Baptists in the United States.

**Archived source account.** President of the Southern Baptist Convention J. D. Greear condemns the sexual abuse committed by the clergy, laypersons, and volunteers and calls it "pure evil".

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/religion/2019/02/10/pure-evil-southern-baptist-leaders-condemn-decades-sexual-abuse-revealed-investigation/?noredirect=on&amp;utm_term=.b7a520318d0e>).

<a id="event-2019-02-10-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed in Gandhinagar, India, by a serial killer. The alleged killer, who is later identified as a eunuch, remains at large.

Source citations (as archived): [Ahmedabad Mirror](<https://ahmedabadmirror.indiatimes.com/ahmedabad/others/gnagar-terrorised-by-serial-killer-on-prowl/articleshow/67920922.cms>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-02-10-1-2"></a>

Context: 2020 United States presidential election, 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries / Amy Klobuchar 2020 presidential campaign.

**Archived source account.** United States Senator Amy Klobuchar announces her intention to run for President of the United States in the 2020 United States presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2020-election/democratic-sen-amy-klobuchar-announces-run-president-n969796>).

<a id="event-2019-02-10-1-4"></a>

Context: Demographics of Hungary, Opposition to immigration.

**Archived source account.** Hungary's Prime Minister Viktor Orbán announces new tax and loan benefits for families as part of his government’s efforts to increase the birth rate in Hungary. The new measures include the expansion of a loan program for families with at least two children and waiving personal income tax for women raising at least four children. Orbán is one of the most outspoken critics of immigration to Europe from the Middle East and Asia.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20190210-hungarys-orban-vows-defence-christian-europe>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hungary-orban-benefits/orban-offers-financial-incentives-to-boost-hungarys-birth-rate-idUSKCN1PZ0I0>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-02-10-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Caribbean Series.

**Archived source account.** In baseball, the Toros de Herrera become the first Panamanian team since 1950 to win the Caribbean Series as they defeat the Leñadores de Las Tunas of Cuba 3-1 in the final.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<http://www.espn.com/mlb/story/_/id/25969317/panama-team-wins-country-first-caribbean-series-1950>).

The oilfield, which was formerly under the control of Tripoli-based Government of National Accord, was taken over by local tribesmen in December 2018.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-libya-security-oil/east-libyan-forces-say-they-have-full-control-of-el-sharara-oilfield-idUSKCN1Q026C>).

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/technology/mars-one-bankrupt-1.5014522>).

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.apnews.com/445a98d16498435f8d5a5765c683113a>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/weather/2019/02/11/historic-storm-hurls-huge-waves-mph-winds-hawaii-rare-snow-hits-maui/?utm_term=.5321533da927>).

### 2019-02-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1127423917](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20February%2013&oldid=1127423917>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-02-13-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Khash-Zahedan suicide bombing.

**Archived source account.** At least 27 Iranian Revolutionary Guards are killed after a suicide bombing attack in southeastern Iran. The attack is claimed by Jaish ul-Adl militants.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/02/13/world/middleeast/iran-bombing.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-guards-attack-claim/jaish-al-adl-militant-group-claims-responsibility-for-attack-against-irans-revolutionary-guards-fars-news-idUSKCN1Q225B>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-02-13-1-1"></a>

Context: Israel–Venezuela relations, 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** Venezuelan disputed interim President Juan Guaidó states that he is working to restore ties with Israel, which were broken by Hugo Chávez's anti-Israeli policy, while also weighing whether to relocate the nation's embassy into Jerusalem.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/02/venezuela-guaido-working-restore-ties-israel-190213060829530.html>).

<a id="event-2019-02-13-1-3"></a>

Context: Foreign involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Kremlin announces that Russia, Iran and Turkey will hold their fourth round of talks in Sochi on Thursday with regards to their roles in the Syrian Civil War.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/02/russia-iran-turkey-hold-fourth-syria-talks-sochi-190213135429737.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-02-13-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Public Prosecutor General of Germany announces the arrest of two members of the Syrian military intelligence service on charges of crimes against humanity. The arrests happened the day before in the states of Berlin and Rhineland-Palatinate.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/germany-arrests-two-syrians-for-alleged-crimes-against-humanity/a-47496784>).

<a id="event-2019-02-13-2-2"></a>

Context: Special Counsel investigation.

**Archived source account.** U.S. District Court Judge Amy Berman Jackson rules that political consultant and former Trump campaign chairman Paul Manafort breached his plea deal with special counsel Robert Mueller by intentionally lying, about three of five matters, to investigators and the federal grand jury.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-47234491>); [Daily Mail](<https://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-6702605/Judge-finds-Manafort-lied-investigators-Russia-probe.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-02-13-4-1"></a>

Context: Exploration of Mars.

**Archived source account.** The mission of NASA's Opportunity rover on Mars comes to an end. The rover stopped communicating in June 2018 after a Martian dust storm, and attempts to reestablish communications have not been successful.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/money/2019/02/19/payless-shoesource-chapter-11-bankruptcy/2913106002/>).

<a id="event-2019-02-19-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ford Motor Company will stop selling commercial trucks in South America.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2019/02/19/ford-will-stop-selling-commercial-trucks-in-south-america.html>).

<a id="event-2019-02-19-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Honda confirms that it will be closing its car plant in Swindon, South West England, because of decreased demand for diesel cars and tougher emissions regulations. The closure in 2021 will result in the loss of about 3,500 jobs.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-47287386>).

<a id="event-2019-02-19-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Teva Pharmaceutical settles outstanding cases with the U.S. Federal Trade Commission involving payments from brand-name drugmakers to delay releasing a cheaper version of its product, so-called "pay-for-delay" agreements.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ftc-teva-settlement/us-settles-with-teva-over-keeping-generic-drugs-off-market-idUSKCN1Q82U0>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-02-19-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An avalanche at the Crans-Montana ski resort in Switzerland injures four, one seriously, with fears that up to a dozen skiers may have been hit according to witnesses. 240 rescuers including police and army search the affected piste area. No further victims are immediately found, or missing persons reported.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<https://www.foxnews.com/world/at-least-a-dozen-skiers-may-be-buried-after-avalanche-hits-popular-swiss-alps-resort>); [SwissInfo](<https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/mountain-accident_crans-montana-avalanche-buries-skiers/44769096>).

<a id="event-2019-02-19-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A house fire in Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada, kills seven children from a Syrian family.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-47299551>).

<a id="event-2019-02-19-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A father, his son, and a gas station employee are all killed in Wayne, New Jersey when a driver under the influence swerves his car and hits the father and son’s Chevrolet Camaro.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC New York](<https://www.nbcnewyork.com/news/local/fatal-crash-impaired-driver-wayne-nj/42957/%3famp>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-02-19-3-2"></a>

Context: 2020 United States presidential election, 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries / Bernie Sanders 2020 presidential campaign.

**Archived source account.** Vermont Senator and 2016 presidential candidate Bernie Sanders announces on Vermont Public Radio that he is running for President of the United States as a Democrat in 2020.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/02/19/676923000/bernie-sanders-enters-2020-presidential-campaign-no-longer-an-underdog?t=1550576496363>).

<a id="event-2019-02-19-3-4"></a>

Context: Politics of Spain.

**Archived source account.** Francisco José Alcaraz, from Vox, becomes the first far-right politician to become a Senator since the restoration of democracy.

Source citations (as archived): [El Mundo](<https://www.elmundo.es/andalucia/2019/01/31/5c52df2ffc6c839b798b4652.html>).

<a id="event-2019-02-19-3-6"></a>

Context: History of the UK Labour Party, Antisemitism in the UK Labour Party.

**Archived source account.** Joan Ryan becomes the eighth MP to quit the Labour Party and join The Independent Group, citing a "culture of anti-Jewish racism" within the party as the reason for her departure.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-47300832>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-02-19-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The opening round of the Aeroflot Open, an international open chess tournament, is postponed a day after 45 minutes of play as a bomb threat locks down the Moscow hotel hosting the event. Similar threats also shut down cinemas, shopping centres, and theatres; thousands are evacuated.

Source citations (as archived): [Chess.com](<https://www.chess.com/news/view/aeroflot-open-round-1-called-off-after-bomb-threat>); [Chessbase](<https://en.chessbase.com/post/bomb-threats-in-moscow-round-1-of-the-aeroflot-open-was-aborted>).

### 2019-02-20

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 896335534](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20February%2020&oldid=896335534>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-02-20-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Southern Poverty Law Center reports a 30 percent increase in U.S. hate groups over the past four years with a 7% increase in 2018 alone.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/02/20/696217158/u-s-hate-groups-rose-sharply-in-recent-years-watchdog-group-reports>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-02-20-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis, 2019 shipping of humanitarian aid to Venezuela.

**Archived source account.** The Venezuelan Navy closes its maritime borders with the Dutch Caribbean islands of Aruba, Curaçao and Bonaire ahead of the planned entry of international humanitarian aid into Venezuela on February 23, which Nicolás Maduro considers a precursor to invasion.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/02/20/americas/venezuela-closes-border-intl/index.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-02-20-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Dhaka fire.

**Archived source account.** A fast-moving fire has swept through a historic district of Bangladesh's capital Dhaka, killing at least 80 and wounding 50 others.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition-m.cnn.com/2019/02/20/asia/dhaka-apartment-fire-intl/index.html?r=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.google.com%2F>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-02-20-3-1"></a>

Context: Timbs v. Indiana.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Supreme Court, in a unanimous 9–0 decision, rules the 8th Amendment's prohibition on excessive fines applies to state and local governments, as well as the federal government.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/courts_law/supreme-court-says-constitutional-protection-against-excessive-fines-applies-to-state-actions/2019/02/20/204ce0d4-3522-11e9-af5b-b51b7ff322e9_story.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-02-20-4-1"></a>

Context: History of the UK Conservative Party.

**Archived source account.** Three British MPs – Anna Soubry, Sarah Wollaston and Heidi Allen – defect from the Conservative Party to The Independent Group, citing their opposition to Brexit and the party's adoption of UKIP policies. This brings the total number of The Independent Group MPs to eleven following recent defections from Labour.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2019/feb/20/tory-mps-defect-independent-group-soubry-allen-wollaston>).

<a id="event-2019-02-20-4-3"></a>

Context: 2019 North Korea–United States Hanoi Summit.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Security Council Sanctions Committee permits those North Koreans on its global travel ban list to travel to Hanoi, Vietnam, for the second summit meeting with U.S. President Donald Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-usa-un/u-n-permits-north-koreans-to-travel-to-vietnam-for-trump-summit-idUSKCN1Q92KF>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-02-20-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** One surviving female specimen of the Fernandina Galápagos tortoise species, which was thought to be extinct for more than 100 years, is found.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2019/02/20/galapagos-rare-tortoise-species-considered-extinct-until-now/2930134002/>).

### 2019-02-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1084451188](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20February%2021&oldid=1084451188>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-02-21-0-1"></a>

Context: American-led intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The United States' allies France and the United Kingdom say they won't keep their troops in Syria after the United States pulls out.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/allies-say-they-wont-remain-in-syria-after-us-troops-withdraw/2019/02/20/62e503b2-3532-11e9-a400-e481bf264fdc_story.html?utm_term=.621503c2a1ec>).

<a id="event-2019-02-21-0-3"></a>

Context: Libyan Crisis (2011–present).

**Archived source account.** The Tobruk-based Libyan National Army says it has taken control of the El Feel oilfield in Libya's southern Murzuq District.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-libya-oil/eastern-libyan-military-forces-claim-control-of-el-feel-oilfield-idUSKCN1QA2AX>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-02-21-1-1"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Russian President Vladimir Putin states that Russia is militarily ready for "a Cuban Missile-style crisis" if the United States wants one, in relation to new U.S. missile deployments in Europe.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-putin/putin-to-u-s-im-ready-for-another-cuban-missile-crisis-if-you-want-one-idUSKCN1QA1A3>).

<a id="event-2019-02-21-1-3"></a>

Context: 2019 North Korea–United States Hanoi Summit.

**Archived source account.** Vietnam tightens security at its rail station on the Chinese border ahead of North Korean leader Kim Jong-un's visit to Hanoi for his summit with U.S. President Donald Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-usa-vietnam-border/vietnam-tightens-security-at-border-station-ahead-of-kim-jong-un-visit-idUSKCN1QA1EI>).

<a id="event-2019-02-21-1-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis, 2019 shipping of humanitarian aid to Venezuela.

**Archived source account.** Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro orders the closing of his country's border with Brazil. International humanitarian aid is currently scheduled to enter Venezuela on February 23, under foreign military protection.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-47325201>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-02-21-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** American actor Jussie Smollett is arrested for filing a false police report about an alleged hate crime.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<https://www.foxnews.com/entertainment/jussie-smollett-is-under-arrest-in-custody-of-chicago-police>).

<a id="event-2019-02-21-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hoda Muthana, an Alabama woman who joined the Islamic State, is banned from entering the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://amp.usatoday.com/amp/2914244002>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/amp/world-us-canada-47313657>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-02-21-3-1"></a>

Context: Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Separatists in Catalonia launch a general strike in protest of the trial of Catalonia independence leaders, with major participation of the educational community. Demonstrators block major roads, highways, train tracks and the entrance to the port of Tarragona.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<http://time.com/5534324/catalan-secessionists-block-highways-strike/>); [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/wireStory/catalan-secessionists-block-highways-train-tracks-strike-61205982>); [Cope](<https://www.cope.es/actualidad/economia/noticias/cerca-200-manifestantes-cortan-entrada-del-puerto-tarragona-20190221_357990>).

<a id="event-2019-02-21-3-2"></a>

Context: Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Clashes between demonstrators and Catalan regional police leave three arrested and 20 injured.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/catalan-secessionists-block-highways-train-tracks-in-strike/2019/02/21/dbe49b52-35ae-11e9-8375-e3dcf6b68558_story.html>).

<a id="event-2019-02-21-3-4"></a>

Context: 2018 North Carolina's 9th congressional district election.

**Archived source account.** North Carolina election authorities unanimously order a new election to choose the district's representative to the United States House of Representatives after their investigation determined the Republican candidate's campaign illegally handled absentee ballots, and the candidate, Mark Harris, reverses his position and calls for a new election.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/02/21/us/mark-harris-nc-voter-fraud.html>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/02/21/696561080/email-shows-n-c-gop-candidate-sought-out-operative-accused-of-illegal-ballot-sch>).

<a id="event-2019-02-21-3-6"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** United Socialist Party of Venezuela congressman and former head of the Directorate General of Military Counterintelligence Hugo Carvajal defects to the opposition, urging the military to abandon Nicolás Maduro. Carvajal says drug trafficking and corruption are commonplace in the government.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/02/21/world/americas/hugo-carvajal-maduro-venezuela.html>).

<a id="event-2019-02-21-3-8"></a>

Context: 2019 Israeli legislative election.

**Archived source account.** Retired IDF Chief Benny Gantz and Yesh Atid chairman Yair Lapid agree to combine their prime ministerial campaigns in the April 9 Knesset election against incumbent Benjamin Netanyahu.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-47316511>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-02-21-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A fossil from a new species of tyrannosaur named Moros intrepidus is discovered in the U.S. state of Utah. Scientists are using the find to better understand how Tyrannosaurus rex evolved during the Cretaceous period.

Source citations (as archived): [National Geographic](<https://www.nationalgeographic.com/science/2019/02/new-tiny-t-rex-relative-moros-fills-north-american-fossil-gap/>).

<a id="event-2019-02-21-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Scientists announce that the Megachile pluto (Wallace's giant bee), the world's largest bee, has been rediscovered in North Maluku, Indonesia, after no confirmed sightings since 1981. The first ever pictures and videos are taken of the rare species.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-47311186>).

<a id="event-2019-02-21-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** JAXA's Hayabusa2 space probe successfully lands on Apollo asteroid 162173 Ryugu.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/science/2019/feb/22/japans-hayabusa-2-successfully-touches-down-on-ryugu-asteroid>).

### 2019-02-22

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

<a id="event-2019-02-22-0-3"></a>

Context: American-led intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump agrees to keep about 400 U.S. troops in Syria.

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-02-22-1-1"></a>

Context: Crisis in Venezuela.

**Archived source account.** The Venezuela Aid Live benefit concert takes place on the Colombia–Venezuela border. The all-day event on the Colombian side of the Tienditas Bridge is expected to attract up to 250,000 people.

<a id="event-2019-02-22-1-2"></a>

<a id="event-2019-02-22-1-3"></a>

Context: Crisis in Venezuela.

**Archived source account.** Venezuelan interim President Juan Guaidó arrives at the Venezuela Aid Live concert in Cúcuta, Colombia, defying a travel ban placed on him by the Maduro regime.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-02-22/guaido-arrives-at-colombia-benefit-gig-defying-maduro-travel-ban>).

Context: List of earthquakes in 2019.

<a id="event-2019-02-22-2-2"></a>

Context: History of the UK Labour Party, Antisemitism in the UK Labour Party.

**Archived source account.** British MP Ian Austin quits Labour over a "culture of extremism, anti-semitism and intolerance" within the party under Jeremy Corbyn, becoming the ninth Labour MP to quit this week. However, unlike the others, he will not be joining The Independent Group.

Context: 2019 North Korea–United States Hanoi Summit.

**Archived source account.** The Trump administration weighs softening demands ahead of the second summit meeting with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un in Hanoi.
