<a id="event-2019-02-23-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Nigerian general election.

**Archived source account.** After having been postponed by a week, Nigeria's general election takes place nationwide.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/vote-counting-begins-in-nigerias-delayed-presidential-election/a-47634708>).

### 2019-02-24

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1084452257](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20February%2024&oldid=1084452257>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-02-24-0-1"></a>

Context: 91st Academy Awards.

**Archived source account.** The 91st Academy Awards are presented in Hollywood. Bohemian Rhapsody wins a leading four awards, followed by Black Panther, Green Book, which won Best Picture, and Roma, with three awards each.,

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/film/live/2019/feb/24/oscars-2019-live-latest-red-carpet-ceremony-winners-aftermath>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/02/24/movies/oscar-winners.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-02-24-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** During a training exercise, a twin-engine aircraft crashes through the roof of a home in Winter Haven, Florida, shortly after takeoff. The pilot was killed. A trainee pilot and eight people in the house suffered minor injuries. The Federal Aviation Administration and National Transportation Safety Board will be investigating.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/pilot-dies-family-avoids-disaster-as-plane-crashes-into-home/ar-BBTZwCI>).

<a id="event-2019-02-24-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A state of emergency is declared in Tennessee amid flooding that has caused landslides and one death.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/02/24/us/tennessee-flooding-wxc/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-02-24-2-1"></a>

Context: Biman Bangladesh Airlines Flight 147.

**Archived source account.** Bangladeshi special forces shoot and kill an armed man after he attempted to hijack a Biman Bangladesh Airlines flight heading to Dubai International Airport. All 148 passengers and crew members disembarked safely.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-47350138>).

<a id="event-2019-02-24-2-3"></a>

Context: National Coalition for Men v. Selective Service System.

**Archived source account.** A federal judge rules that the exclusion of women from the Selective Service System is unconstitutional.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/02/24/us/military-draft-men-unconstitutional.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-02-24-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Moldovan parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Moldova go to the polls to elect the new members of Parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20190224-moldova-vote-divisive-parliamentary-election>).

<a id="event-2019-02-24-3-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Senegalese presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Senegal assemble to vote for the country's next president.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/senegal-votes-for-new-president/a-47662841>).

<a id="event-2019-02-24-3-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Cuban constitutional referendum.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Cuba are asked whether they approve of a new constitution that gives criminal defendants the presumption of innocence, recognizes private property, bans some forms of discrimination, creates a term limit for the president, and restores the position of Prime Minister.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/02/cuba-constitutional-referendum-190222174420643.html>).

<a id="event-2019-02-24-3-7"></a>

Context: Brexit.

**Archived source account.** British MPs will vote on the latest Brexit deal by March 12, according to Prime Minister Theresa May.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-47348610>).

<a id="event-2019-02-24-3-9"></a>

Context: 2019 Okinawan referendum.

**Archived source account.** Voters in the Japanese prefecture of Okinawa go to the polls in a referendum on the central government's plan to move the Futenma airbase to Henoko in northern Okinawa Island. 72% of voters oppose the plan.

Source citations (as archived): [Asahi Shimbun English](<http://www.asahi.com/ajw/articles/AJ201902250016.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-02-24-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 English Football League Cup Final, 2018–19 English Football League Cup.

**Archived source account.** Manchester City F.C. defeat Chelsea F.C. in the English Football League Cup Final in the penalties after 120 minutes of goalless draw for their 6th EFL title. Post-match discussion is dominated by Chelsea goalkeeper Kepa Arrizabalaga's controversial refusal to leave the pitch when head coach Maurizio Sarri attempted to substitute him.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/football/live/2019/feb/24/chelsea-v-manchester-city-carabao-cup-final-live>).

### 2019-02-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1084452422](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20February%2025&oldid=1084452422>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-02-25-0-1"></a>

Context: American military intervention in Somalia (2007–present).

**Archived source account.** United States Africa Command says a U.S. airstrike has killed 35 al-Shabaab militants in Somalia's central Hiran administrative region.

Source citations (as archived): [FRANCE 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20190225-us-strike-somalia-kills-35-terrorists-pentagon>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-02-25-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Piper PA-46 Malibu crash.

**Archived source account.** The Air Accidents Investigation Branch of the United Kingdom issues an interim report revealing the pilot, David Ibbotson, held only a private pilots licence and could not transport paying passengers within the European Union. Ibbotson and Argentinian footballer Emiliano Sala both died in the accident. Cardiff City FC announce "grave concerns" over Ibbotson's licence.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-wales-47358572>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-02-25-2-1"></a>

Context: Chagos Archipelago sovereignty dispute.

**Archived source account.** The International Court of Justice (ICJ), the highest court of the United Nations, rules that the United Kingdom should end its control of the Chagos Archipelago "as rapidly as possible". Mauritius claims the archipelago was unlawfully separated from the island nation in 1965.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-47358602>).

<a id="event-2019-02-25-2-3"></a>

Context: Brexit.

**Archived source account.** The Labour Party announces it will support a second referendum on the end of the United Kingdom's membership of the European Union unless Wednesday sees Labour's proposed Brexit deal supported by Parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-47363307>).

<a id="event-2019-02-25-2-5"></a>

Context: Negotiations between the Taliban and the United States.

**Archived source account.** Peace talks begin in Qatar between the United States and the Taliban.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-47351369>).

<a id="event-2019-02-25-2-7"></a>

Context: 2019 North Korea–United States Hanoi Summit.

**Archived source account.** North Korean leader Kim Jong-un arrives in Vietnam, ahead of his two-day summit with U.S. President Donald Trump in the capital Hanoi.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/02/25/asia/kim-jong-un-vietnam-arrive-train-intl/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-02-25-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** UK Home Secretary Sajid Javid announces plans to ban the political wing of the Lebanese Islamist movement Hezbollah under counterterrorism legislation.

Source citations (as archived): [Herald Scotland](<https://www.heraldscotland.com/news/17457501.hezbollah-to-be-completely-banned-in-britain-under-anti-terror-laws/>).

<a id="event-2019-02-25-3-2"></a>

Context: Iran and state-sponsored terrorism.

**Archived source account.** Police in Kenya ask a court to allow them to detain three men for 30 days on suspicion of conspiring to aid two Iranian terror suspects to escape.

Source citations (as archived): [KBC](<http://www.kbc.co.ke/police-probe-plot-terror-suspects-escape/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-02-25-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Okinawan referendum.

**Archived source account.** Japanese Prime Minister Shinzō Abe says the relocation of Marine Corps Air Station Futenma, in the Okinawa Prefecture, will still go ahead despite 72% of Okinawan voters rejecting the construction of a new base in a non-binding referendum.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-47353504>).

<a id="event-2019-02-25-4-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** Jorge Ramos and five other Univision staff are detained at Miraflores Palace in Caracas shortly after interviewing Nicolás Maduro.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/02/25/media/univision-venezuela-jorge-ramos/index.html>); [Miami Herald](<https://www.miamiherald.com/news/nation-world/world/americas/venezuela/article226785924.html>).

<a id="event-2019-02-25-4-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Cuban constitutional referendum.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Cuba approve a new constitution which recognizes private and cooperative businesses, sets term limits for the president, creates the post of prime minister, introduces the presumption of innocence and habeas corpus to the justice system, and affirms an "irrevocable" socialist government.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/02/cubans-approve-constitution-affirming-role-socialism-190226002347961.html>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/feb/25/cuba-approves-new-socialist-constitution>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-02-25-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** New England Patriots owner Robert Kraft is charged with two counts of first-degree solicitation in Florida.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/26078163/patriots-owner-robert-kraft-officially-charged-first-degree-solicitation-prostitute>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/02/25/697782148/robert-kraft-is-formally-charged-with-solicitation-over-visits-to-florida-day-sp>); [Fox News](<https://www.foxnews.com/sports/patriots-robert-kraft-allegedly-visited-florida-spa-for-sex-acts-on-day-of-afc-championship-game>).

### 2019-02-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256031842](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20February%2026&oldid=1256031842>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-02-26-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Balakot airstrike.

**Archived source account.** Pakistan reports that Indian military aircraft violated their airspace near Muzaffarabad and were intercepted by Pakistan Air Force (PAF) military aircraft. Indian Air Force aircraft in a haste dropped their payload which fell near balakot. India claims that the incident was an airstrike on an alleged Jaish-e-Mohammed camp in Balakot in retaliation to the Pulwama attack days earlier.,

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-india-kashmir-pakistan/pakistan-says-indian-aircraft-released-a-payload-after-crossing-frontier-no-casualties-idUSKCN1QF07B>); [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/03/02/opinion/sunday/kashmir-india-pakistan.html>).

<a id="event-2019-02-26-0-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Balakot airstrike.

**Archived source account.** The attack is the first time since Indo-Pakistani War of 1971 that the Indian Air Force has crossed and attacked Pakistan beyond the line of control. As well as the first time since both countries have acquired nuclear weapons.

Source citations (as archived): [India Today](<https://www.indiatoday.in/india/story/india-airstrike-in-pakistan-iaf-crosses-loc-first-time-since-1971-war-1465178-2019-02-26>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-02-26-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two Long Island Rail Road trains collide into a car in Westbury, New York, United States, killing all three occupants in the car.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/02/26/nyregion/lirr-train-collision-accident.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-02-26-2-1"></a>

Context: Nuclear warfare, Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Following Vladimir Putin's warning that Russia would deploy nuclear missiles in Europe if the United States deploys intermediate-range nuclear missiles in Europe, Putin's ally Dmitry Kiselyov lists what he claims are the targets in the United States, which includes The Pentagon, Camp David, Fort Ritchie, McClellan Air Force Base, and Jim Creek Naval Radio Station. Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov denies the existence of the target list.,

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-nuclear-russia/after-putins-warning-russian-tv-lists-nuclear-targets-in-u-s-idUSKCN1QE1DM>); [TASS](<http://tass.com/politics/1046259>).

<a id="event-2019-02-26-2-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis, United States–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** Two United States military officials tell CNN that the U.S. military has flown reconnaissance flights in international airspace off the coast of Venezuela during the last several days to gather classified intelligence about President Nicolás Maduro.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/02/25/americas/venezuela-developments/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-02-26-2-4"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis, United States–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States Department of the Treasury imposes sanctions on governors of four states of Venezuela, all of them members of the ruling United Socialist Party.

Source citations (as archived): [United States Department of the Treasury](<https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/sm616>).

<a id="event-2019-02-26-2-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis, United States–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** Colombia's Immigration Agency says 274 military personnel from different branches of the Venezuela's Armed Forces, Venezuela's National Police, and Venezuela's National Guard have defected to Colombia.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/02/25/americas/venezuela-developments/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-02-26-2-7"></a>

Context: 2019 North Korea–United States Hanoi Summit.

**Archived source account.** North Korean leader Kim Jong-un visits his country's embassy in Hanoi on Tuesday in preparation for the summit.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-usa-kim-outing/north-koreas-kim-begins-hanoi-trip-by-visiting-embassy-idUSKCN1QF15U>).

<a id="event-2019-02-26-2-8"></a>

Context: 2019 North Korea–United States Hanoi Summit.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump lands in Vietnam's capital for the summit.

Source citations (as archived): [The Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/trump-arrives-in-vietnam-for-second-summit-with-north-korean-leader-11551190215>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-02-26-3-1"></a>

Context: Catholic Church sexual abuse cases in Australia, Pope Francis's response to sexual abuse in the Catholic Church.

**Archived source account.** Australian cardinal George Pell is convicted of sexually assaulting two 13-year-old choirboys at Melbourne’s St Patrick’s Cathedral. The verdict has been suppressed by a gag order until now. He is the Catholic Church's most senior official to be convicted of a sexual crime in history.

Source citations (as archived): [The Age](<https://www.theage.com.au/national/victoria/cardinal-george-pell-found-guilty-of-child-sex-abuse-20181214-p50m86.html>); [The Age2](<https://www.theage.com.au/national/victoria/george-pell-guilty-verdict-fallout-live-20190226-p510ao.html>).

<a id="event-2019-02-26-3-3"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Israel.

**Archived source account.** A Jewish Israeli teen is convicted of membership of a terror organisation, arson, and racially aggravated assault. He is the second Jewish person convicted of terror group membership ever in Israel in connection to crimes against Palestinians. His conviction was announced today, but occurred last week in secrecy.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/settler-teen-convicted-of-terror-offenses-for-attacks-on-palestinians/>).

<a id="event-2019-02-26-3-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Morrisville killings.

**Archived source account.** Five were killed by a mother and daughter duo believed to have strangled them including three children.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/02/26/us/pa-five-dead-apartment/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-02-26-4-1"></a>

Context: Trump administration family separation policy.

**Archived source account.** An oversight committee is expected to vote on whether to subpoena Trump administration officials over family separations at the southern border.

Source citations (as archived): [AP News](<https://www.apnews.com/0b012aaaa6454a10a585eb4a848c8541>).

<a id="event-2019-02-26-4-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Nigerian general election.

**Archived source account.** Nigeria reelects President Muhammadu Buhari.

Source citations (as archived): [Africa News](<http://www.africanews.com/2019/02/27/buhari-beats-atiku-to-secure-re-election-as-nigeria-president/>).

### 2019-02-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1215217460](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20February%2027&oldid=1215217460>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-02-27-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019 India–Pakistan standoff.

**Archived source account.** The Pakistani Air Force claims it has carried out six airstrikes in Indian-administered Jammu and Kashmir, shooting down one Indian aircraft and capturing one pilot following a dogfight. Pakistani officials claimed that they have shot down two Indian Air Force (IAF) jets. Wreckage of one aircraft fell in Azad Kashmir while the other fell in Indian-administered Kashmir. Indian officials initially rejected that any of their aircraft was shot down and claimed that all of IAF pilots were accounted for. However, later on they acknowledge that one IAF Mig-21 has been shot down and its pilot was captured by the Pakistan Army. India officials also claimed to have shot down one Pakistani Air Force (PAF) jet that violated its airspace. However, Indian officials claim were rejected by Pakistani officials.

Source citations (as archived): [The Week (India)](<https://www.theweek.in/news/india/2019/02/27/pakistan-jets-violate-indian-air-space-kashmir-nowshera-drop-bombs.html>); [NDTV](<https://mobile.twitter.com/ndtv/status/1100656090805686272>); [The Hindu Business Line](<https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/news/pakistan-violates-indian-air-space-in-nowshera/article26383265.ece>); [Dawn News](<https://www.dawn.com/news/1466413>).

<a id="event-2019-02-27-0-2"></a>

Context: 2019 India–Pakistan standoff.

**Archived source account.** An Indian Air Force Mi-17 transport helicopter crashes in the Budgam district of Jammu and Kashmir, killing all six IAF personnel onboard and a civilian on the ground.

Source citations (as archived): [Hindustan Times](<https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/military-aircraft-crashes-in-jammu-and-kashmir-s-budgam-district/story-6SPgXbpkV7oc39JHSdM6lM.html>).

<a id="event-2019-02-27-0-4"></a>

Context: Israeli involvement in the Syrian Civil War, Israel–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu tells Russian President Vladimir Putin that Israel will "continue to take action against Iran in Syria".

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/netanyahu-tells-putin-israel-will-continue-to-take-action-against-iran-in-syria/>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-02-27-1-1"></a>

Context: Ukraine in the Eurovision Song Contest 2019.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine withdraws from this year's Eurovision Song Contest in Tel Aviv, Israel, after Ukrainian entrant Maruv said she refused to be used as a "political tool" after being asked to sign a contract saying she wouldn't hold any concerts in Russia in the lead up to the event.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/entertainment-arts-47394371>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-02-27-2-1"></a>

Context: Ramses Station train collision.

**Archived source account.** A train crash and subsequent fire kills at least 25 people at Ramses Station in Cairo, Egypt.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-47384443>).

<a id="event-2019-02-27-2-2"></a>

Context: Ramses Station train collision.

**Archived source account.** Egyptian Transport Minister Hisham Arafat consequently resigns. Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly accepts the resignation.

Source citations (as archived): [Africa News](<http://www.africanews.com/2019/02/27/egypt-at-least-25-killed-as-train-crashes-at-cairo-station/>).

<a id="event-2019-02-27-2-4"></a>

Context: 2019 Taplejung helicopter crash.

**Archived source account.** A helicopter crashes in Taplejung, Nepal, killing 7 people, including Nepal's culture and tourism minister Rabindra Prasad Adhikari.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/02/27/world/asia/nepal-helicopter-crash-tourism-minister.html>).

<a id="event-2019-02-27-2-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A suspected gas explosion in Taraz, Kazakhstan, kills three people in an apartment block.

Source citations (as archived): [RFERL](<https://www.rferl.org/a/explosion-kills-three-partially-destroys-residential-building-in-kazakhstan/29793630.html>).

<a id="event-2019-02-27-2-7"></a>

Context: Disasters in Indonesia.

**Archived source account.** A landslide hits an illegal gold mine in North Sulawesi, Sulawesi, Indonesia. An estimated 60 people are trapped underground as shafts give way, while three others are found dead.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/at-least-three-dead-and-dozens-buried-alive-in-indonesia-gold-mine-collapse-11649457>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-02-27-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 North Korea–United States Hanoi Summit.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong-un meet face-to-face for the first time since their summit last year.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2019/02/27/trump-and-kim-meet-face-to-face-in-vietnam-as-second-summit-kicks-off.html>).

<a id="event-2019-02-27-3-3"></a>

Context: Brexit negotiations.

**Archived source account.** MPs in the House of Commons meet to discuss UK Prime Minister Theresa May's latest proposed deal for the state's departure from the European Union. May says if this proposal and a 'no deal' scenario are both rejected by MPs they will be granted a vote on extending the departure deadline beyond the current one of March 29.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-47380314>).

<a id="event-2019-02-27-3-4"></a>

Context: Brexit negotiations.

**Archived source account.** Conservative MP Alberto Costa tables an amendment to secure the rights of EU citizens within the UK and UK citizens abroad. Theresa May tells Commons she opposes the amendment; Home Secretary Sajid Javid subsequently supports it, apparently unaware of May's opposition. Costa resigns as parliamentary private secretary to Scottish Secretary David Mundell, who supports the amendment. The government subsequently announces it will support the amendment.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2019/feb/27/confusion-reigns-over-brexit-amendment-as-tory-mp-alberto-costa-sacked>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-02-27-4-1"></a>

Context: Timeline of investigations into Donald Trump and Russia (2019).

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump's former attorney, Michael Cohen, is prepared to testify that Trump was aware of longtime adviser Roger Stone's efforts to make contact with WikiLeaks in advance of its release of damaging information about Hillary Clinton's 2016 presidential campaign, according to a copy of his public testimony submitted to Congress and obtained by CNN.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/02/27/politics/michael-cohen-testimony/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-02-27-4-3"></a>

Context: Child sexual abuse in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Nine men receive prison terms for raping two vulnerable teenage girls in Bradford over a period of years. A tenth is cleared. The abuse began when the victims were fourteen. The girls were from a children's home.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-leeds-47388060>).

<a id="event-2019-02-27-4-5"></a>

Context: Human rights in Israel, Terrorism in Israel.

**Archived source account.** Shin Bet arrest lawyer Tarek Barghout, an attorney who has represented "terror" suspects, and a Palestinian man named Zakaria Zubeidi for what it calls "their involvement in serious and current terrorist activities."

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/israel-arrests-former-terrorist-leader-citing-serious-current-activities/>).

<a id="event-2019-02-27-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Steven Avery, a high-profile miscarriage of justice victim subsequently convicted of murder after his release in 2003, is granted a fresh appeal in Wisconsin. Avery, who was suing Manitowoc County officials over his original wrongful conviction when he was arrested for murder, gained international attention as the subject of the documentary Making a Murderer.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/making-a-murderers-steven-avery-is-granted-an-appeal-against-murder-conviction-11649607>).

<a id="event-2019-02-27-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** The family of Pat Finucane, murdered during The Troubles in Northern Ireland, win a declaration from the Supreme Court of the United Kingdom that the investigation into his killing was sufficiently ineffective to amount to a failure of the state's obligations under the European Convention on Human Rights. The Supreme Court stops short of mandating a public inquiry as requested by the family. Members of the security services are accepted to have colluded with Finucane's murderers, but the scale and nature of collusion is unclear.

<a id="event-2019-03-05-2-1"></a>

Context: Management of HIV/AIDS.

**Archived source account.** An HIV-positive man, identified as "the London patient", is the second known adult worldwide cleared of the HIV virus after a bone marrow transplant from an HIV-resistant donor. He has been in remission from HIV for 18 months and is no longer taking HIV drugs.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/health-47421855>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/health/2019/03/05/decade-after-first-person-was-cured-hiv-second-patient-is-long-term-remission/?utm_term=.c5399ea1ddf8>); [The Irish Times](<https://www.irishtimes.com/news/health/hiv-patient-in-uk-cleared-of-aids-virus-1.3814967>); [Nature](<https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-019-00798-3>).

<a id="event-2019-03-05-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The US Food and Drug Administration approves Janssen Pharmaceutica's esketamine for treatment-resistant depression. The drug is the chemical cousin of ketamine, a powerful anesthetic and recreational drug, and the first major new depression treatment to be approved by the FDA in more than 30 years.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/03/05/health/esketamine-depression-nasal-spray-fda-bn/index.html>); [TechCrunch](<https://techcrunch.com/2019/03/05/fda-approves-esketamine-nasal-spray-the-first-new-major-depression-drug-in-more-than-30-years/>).

#### Politics and elections

**Archived source account.** United States' Food and Drug Administration commissioner Scott Gottlieb announces his resignation "in the next month".

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/03/05/politics/gottlieb-resigning-fda-health-bn/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-03-05-3-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Guatemalan general election.

**Archived source account.** Semilla announces Jonathan Menkos Zeissig as running mate of Thelma Aldana. Aldana will be proclaimed presidential candidate on March 10.

Source citations (as archived): [La Hora](<https://lahora.gt/thelma-aldana-y-jonathan-menkos-son-el-binomio-de-semilla/>).

Context: 2018–19 UEFA Champions League.

**Archived source account.** Underdog AFC Ajax defeats defending champions Real Madrid 4–1, and advances to quarter-finals on aggregate 5–3, marking the end of Real Madrid's European dominance.

Source citations (as archived): [Goal.com](<https://www.goal.com/en-us/news/historic-humiliation-madrid-horror-show-sees-ajax-dump-out/8mihx3iuohib1dthqpcvg6iyy>).

Venezuelan National Assembly-declared Acting President Juan Guaidó stated that "state corruption and mismanagement (...) have left the electrical grid in shambles".

<a id="event-2019-03-08-2-1"></a>

Context: Politics of Finland.

**Archived source account.** The entire coalition government of Finland resigns after a failure to deliver on healthcare reform, a month ahead of the country's general election. The coalition, made up of Prime Minister Juha Sipilä's Centre Party, the conservative National Coalition Party and the Eurosceptic Blue Reform Party, were unable to agree on a package that would have slowed healthcare spending over the next decade. The government will be interim until April elections.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-finland-government/finlands-cabinet-quits-over-failure-to-deliver-healthcare-reform-idUSKCN1QP0R6>).

<a id="event-2019-03-12-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The sinking of the Grande America causes a 2200 t oil spill in the Bay of Biscay, France.

Source citations (as archived): [FreightWaves](<https://www.freightwaves.com/news/maritime/grimaldi-confirms-grande-america-fire-started-in-cargo-container-ezkx7-g33nr-gn3cf>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/royal-navy-rescue-container-ship-fire-hms-argyll-a8818536.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-03-12-1-1"></a>

Context: United States–Venezuela relations, Crisis in Venezuela.

**Archived source account.** The United States Secretary of State Mike Pompeo announces that the U.S. will be withdrawing all remaining diplomatic staff from Venezuela. The withdrawal follows televised remarks from Nicolás Maduro calling colectivos (paramilitary groups) to active resistance, and alleging that U.S. President Donald Trump masterminded the ongoing nationwide power blackout as part of a "demonic plot" to oust him, by crippling the country's electricity sector with an "electromagnetic attack".

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/mar/12/nicolas-maduro-blames-demonic-trump-plot-for-blackout-crippling-venezuela>); [Infobae](<https://www.infobae.com/america/venezuela/2019/03/12/en-medio-del-masivo-apagon-en-venezuela-nicolas-maduro-llamo-a-los-colectivos-chavistas-a-la-resistencia-activa/>).

<a id="event-2019-03-12-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** In an annual report, the Estonian Foreign Intelligence Service warns that Russia will "very likely" try to intervene in European parliamentary elections this May to undermine unity within the European Union "by sowing disorder and disbelief" within and between the 28 European Union member states.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/russia-very-likely-to-meddle-in-european-parliament-elections-warns-estonia-spy-chief-11663051>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-03-12-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 college admissions bribery scandal.

**Archived source account.** A college admission scheme across the United States results in the indictment of over 50 people including athletic coaches, CEOs, and two Hollywood actresses, accused of using bribery and fraud in order to cheat their children into universities such as Yale and Stanford.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/03/12/us/indictment-college-admissions-scheme/index.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-education-cheating/hollywoods-huffman-loughlin-snared-in-25-million-u-s-college-fraud-scheme-idUSKBN1QT1WJ>).

<a id="event-2019-03-12-2-3"></a>

Context: Catholic Church sexual abuse cases.

**Archived source account.** Cardinal George Pell, the most senior official of the Catholic Church to be convicted of sexual abuse to date, is sentenced to six years in prison for the sexual assault of two children in the late 1990s.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/03/12/australia/cardinal-george-pell-sentencing-intl/index.html?no-st=1552451368>).

<a id="event-2019-03-12-2-5"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in California.

**Archived source account.** It is reported that California Governor Gavin Newsom will sign an executive order placing a moratorium on the death penalty for all 737 inmates on California's death row, ensuring that no executions will take place while he is governor.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Daily News](<https://www.dailynews.com/2019/03/12/gov-gavin-newsom-to-halt-death-penalty-despite-voter-efforts-to-hasten-executions/?utm_content=fb-ladailynews&amp;utm_source=facebook.com&amp;utm_medium=social&amp;utm_campaign=socialflow>).

<a id="event-2019-03-12-2-7"></a>

Context: Crisis in Venezuela, Censorship in Venezuela.

**Archived source account.** Prominent Venezuelan journalist Luis Carlos Díaz is released after being taken by SEBIN, the national intelligence service, on Monday; he has been ordered not to speak of his time in detention or publish anything.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/mar/12/venezuela-luis-carlos-diaz-journalist-taken-sebin>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-03-12-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Micronesian parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** President Peter M. Christian is defeated for re-election to his at-large seat in Congress by David Panuelo.

Source citations (as archived): [Pacific Islands Times](<https://www.pacificislandtimes.com/single-post/2019/03/12/FSM-elections-certified-Peter-Christian-loses-seat-to-Panuelo>).

<a id="event-2019-03-12-3-3"></a>

Context: Brexit negotiations.

**Archived source account.** The UK's parliament rejects Prime Minister Theresa May's Brexit deal by 149 votes. A vote for leaving the European Union without a deal is scheduled for the thirteenth of March. If Parliament rejects the decision to leave with no deal, the UK could request its withdrawal from the EU be postponed with the unanimous consent of the other 27 member states.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/03/12/world/europe/brexit-vote.html>).

### 2019-03-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087386252](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20March%2013&oldid=1087386252>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-03-13-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The SOHR reports that Syrian government shelling and Russian air strikes occur in several areas in Idlib province, in the first such raids since a September truce deal, killing at least 15 civilians including eight children and wounding around 60.

Source citations (as archived): [TRT World](<https://www.trtworld.com/middle-east/regime-shelling-and-russian-air-raids-kill-15-civilians-in-syria-24939?utm_source=GoogleNews&amp;utm_medium=rss>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/03/civilians-killed-government-air-strikes-hit-syria-idlib-190314145321261.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-03-13-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Lagos school collapse.

**Archived source account.** A building in Lagos, Nigeria, collapses, killing ten people and leaving more than 100 others trapped under the rubble.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-47555373>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nigeria-school/100-children-many-others-feared-trapped-in-collapse-of-nigeria-building-that-housed-school-idUSKBN1QU1G7>).

<a id="event-2019-03-13-1-3"></a>

Context: Boeing 737 MAX groundings.

**Archived source account.** Canada and the United States ground all Boeing 737 Max 8 and Max 9 aircraft and ban the jet from their airspace until further notice. It is now effectively grounded worldwide, with no operators remaining unaffected by grounding orders.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/garneau-boeing-ethiopia-crash-1.5054234>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-47562727>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/world/live-news/boeing-737-max-8-ethiopia-airlines-crash/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-03-13-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** An avalanche on Ben Nevis kills two French nationals and a Swiss national. A fourth climber is injured and is receiving treatment at a hospital in Glasgow.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-highlands-islands-47553208>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-03-13-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 111 schools in Malaysia are shut down following the treatment of 200 children, staff, and others being poisoned. Authorities suspect that a chemical dump in the southern state of Johor is responsible for the sudden illnesses.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-malaysia-poisoning/malaysia-shuts-111-schools-as-poisonings-become-more-critical-idUSKBN1QU0YV>); [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2019/03/14/malaysia-shuts-111-schools-as-poisonings-become-more-critical.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-03-13-3-1"></a>

Context: Killing of Susanna Feldmann.

**Archived source account.** Ali Bashar confesses in court in Germany to killing teenager Susanna Feldmann. Bashar is a failed asylum seeker from Iraq. The case prompted national debate and a pledge by Angela Merkel to call for improvements to the deportation system in Germany. Counterterror police traveled to Iraq in order to return him to Germany, as he had already been deported when he was identified in connection to the murder; Iraq has no extradition treaty with Germany.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-47536431>).

<a id="event-2019-03-13-3-3"></a>

Context: Assassination of Marielle Franco.

**Archived source account.** Two former military police officers are arrested in Brazil for the murders of Marielle Franco and her driver Anderson Gomes. One of the suspects was arrested at home, in a Rio de Janeiro gated community where President Jair Bolsonaro also resides. Franco was born in a Rio favela and became a politician and activist against violence in the slums, which are often controlled by paramilitary groups. Her assassination prompted widespread protests.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/mar/12/police-officers-arrested-murder-brazilian-politician-marielle-franco>).

<a id="event-2019-03-13-3-5"></a>

Context: Suzano school shooting.

**Archived source account.** Two men, aged 17 and 25 years, attack a school in the Brazilian city of Suzano, São Paulo, with a revolver and a knife, killing eight and wounding 23 people, among students and staff. The two shooters committed suicide after the attack. Police have found a crossbow, Molotov cocktails and a "suitcase with wires" at the scene.

Source citations (as archived): [G1](<https://g1.globo.com/sp/mogi-das-cruzes-suzano/noticia/2019/03/13/tiros-deixam-feridos-em-escola-de-suzano.ghtml>).

<a id="event-2019-03-13-3-7"></a>

Context: Trials of Paul Manafort.

**Archived source account.** Former Trump campaign manager Paul Manafort is sentenced to 3½ years for money-laundering and obstruction of justice.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/03/13/us/politics/paul-manafort-sentencing.html>).

<a id="event-2019-03-13-3-8"></a>

Context: Trials of Paul Manafort.

**Archived source account.** Minutes after Manafort is sentenced in federal court, New York state prosecutors announce 16 criminal charges against him related to mortgage fraud, conspiracy and falsifying business records.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2019/03/13/paul-manafort-indicted-by-ny-prosecutors-after-federal-sentencing.html>).

<a id="event-2019-03-13-3-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iranian human rights activist and lawyer Nasrin Sotoudeh, who won the Sakharov Prize in 2012, is sentenced to 38 years in prison for her defence of women who had been arrested after removing their hijabs.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/03/13/world/middleeast/nasrin-sotoudeh-iran-lawyer-lashes.amp.html>).

<a id="event-2019-03-13-3-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Frank Cali, the reputed head of the Gambino crime family, is shot dead by an unknown assailant outside his home in Todt Hill, Staten Island, New York City. It is the first targeted killing of a mob boss in New York City since Paul Castellano was assassinated in 1985.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-47566382>).

<a id="event-2019-03-13-3-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mexican authorities announce a national search operation is underway after revealing masked gunmen with a list of names stormed a bus on March 7 as it was traveling along a highway that connects the town of San Fernando with the city of Reynosa. The perpetrators kidnapped 19 people and they have not been seen since.

Source citations (as archived): [KTLA](<https://ktla.com/2019/03/16/investigators-scrambling-to-solve-mystery-just-miles-from-u-s-mexico-border-after-gunmen-take-19-people/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-03-13-4-1"></a>

Context: Brexit negotiations.

**Archived source account.** The UK's parliament votes against a no-deal Brexit. This greatly increases the chance of a delayed Brexit, to be voted on Thursday, as well as opening the door to the possibility of a second referendum.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/brexit-no-deal-vote-1.5054219>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-03-13-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A team of physicists at the Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology, assisted by colleagues in Switzerland and the United States, successfully returns the state of a quantum computer a fraction of a second into the past.

Source citations (as archived): [Phys.org](<https://phys.org/news/2019-03-physicists-reverse-quantum.html>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/life-style/gadgets-and-tech/news/time-reverse-quantum-computer-science-study-moscow-a8820516.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-03-13-6-1"></a>

Context: Iditarod Trail Sled Dog Race.

**Archived source account.** Peter Kaiser wins the 2019, 1000-mile Iditarod, arriving in Nome in 9 days, 12 hours and 39 minutes.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-alaska-iditarod/alaskan-musher-wins-his-first-iditarod-crossing-finish-line-in-nome-idUSKBN1QU1OC>).

### 2019-03-14

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087754332](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20March%2014&oldid=1087754332>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-03-14-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Tel Aviv rocket strike.

**Archived source account.** Two rockets are fired from the Gaza Strip at Tel Aviv, Israel; neither rocket was intercepted by the IDF's Iron Dome system.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/03/14/world/israel-reports-rocket-attack-on-tel-aviv.html>); [IDF Spokesperson](<https://twitter.com/AmichaiStein1/status/1106287055108218880>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-03-14-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** USS Devastator is damaged by fire while at a Bahrain dock.

Source citations (as archived): [Task &amp; Purpose](<https://taskandpurpose.com/navy-ship-fire>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-03-14-2-1"></a>

Context: Bloody Sunday.

**Archived source account.** Prosecutors in Northern Ireland charge a former British Army soldier with murdering two people during the mass shooting in Derry during the Troubles in 1972, following a contemporary police investigation. The man, known only as Soldier F, is also charged with three attempted murders. It is also announced that no other charges against either soldiers or civilians will be brought due to insufficient evidence. Soldiers shot 28 unarmed protestors, killing 13.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-northern-ireland-47540271>).

<a id="event-2019-03-14-2-3"></a>

Context: 2019 college admissions bribery scandal.

**Archived source account.** Eight universities are sued by two Stanford University students in regards to the college admissions bribery scandal.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/US/elite-schools-hit-lawsuit-massive-college-admissions-bribery/story?id=61679252>).

<a id="event-2019-03-14-2-5"></a>

Context: Caracas drone attack.

**Archived source account.** A CNN reporter alleges an unnamed source has provided new video details about the August 2018 drone explosion in Caracas, claiming that it was part of a plot to kill Nicolás Maduro.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/03/14/americas/venezuela-drone-maduro-intl/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-03-14-3-2"></a>

Context: 2020 United States presidential election, 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries / Beto O'Rourke 2020 presidential campaign.

**Archived source account.** Former U.S. Representative Beto O'Rourke from Texas announces he is running for the Democratic Party's nomination for President of the United States in the 2020 election.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-47564276>).

<a id="event-2019-03-14-3-4"></a>

Context: Brexit negotiations.

**Archived source account.** The House of Commons of the United Kingdom votes 412 to 202 to seek a delay to Brexit of three months if UK Prime Minister Theresa May's deal can be passed at a third attempt next week, else significantly longer. The delay, which means the UK will no longer leave the European Union on March 29, will have to be unanimously approved by all other 27 EU member states.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-47576813>).

<a id="event-2019-03-14-3-6"></a>

Context: National Emergency Concerning the Southern Border of the United States.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Senate votes 59–41 to cancel President Donald Trump's emergency declaration to fund the wall along the Mexico–United States border. Trump plans to veto the decision.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/03/14/us/politics/senate-vote-trump-national-emergency.html>).

### 2019-03-15

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087754474](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20March%2015&oldid=1087754474>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-03-15-0-1"></a>

Context: Christchurch mosque shootings, Terrorism in New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** At least 50 people are killed and dozens others are injured during two attacks on mosques in Christchurch, New Zealand.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/new-zealand-shooting-death-toll-rises-50-attack-mosque-n984066>).

<a id="event-2019-03-15-0-2"></a>

Context: Christchurch mosque shootings, Terrorism in New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** Four people—three men and one woman—are arrested in connection to the shootings, according to New Zealand Police Commissioner Mike Bush. It is later learned that one of them was an armed citizen trying to help police and was released.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/live-significant-number-killed-in-shootings-at-new-zealand-mosques-11665829>).

<a id="event-2019-03-15-0-3"></a>

Context: Christchurch mosque shootings, Terrorism in New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** A gunman involved in the shootings of at least one of the two mosques is identified as Brenton Tarrant, a 28-year-old Australian man.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<https://apnews.com/1e19fefcb2e948a1bf7ce63429bc186e>).

<a id="event-2019-03-15-0-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Tel Aviv rocket strike.

**Archived source account.** In response to a possible accidental launching of two rockets from the Gaza Strip towards Tel Aviv the day before, Israel launches hundreds of counter strikes directed at the town of Khan Yunis.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/03/14/world/israel-reports-rocket-attack-on-tel-aviv.html>); [Associated Press](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/israeli-military-announces-strikes-gaza-sites-after-rocket-attack-tel-n983551>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-03-15-1-1"></a>

Context: School strike for climate.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of thousands of students protest worldwide for climate change mitigation.

Source citations (as archived): [ANSA](<http://www.ansa.it/english/news/general_news/2019/03/15/italian-climate-protesters-demand-action_dc295006-6a6a-4062-ac72-29f15a28c9d7.html>); [Archynewsy.com](<https://www.archynewsy.com/climate-events-all-over-the-world-students-invade-the-squares-in-italy-we-are-one-million/>); [The Sydney Morning Herald](<https://www.smh.com.au/education/don-t-want-the-earth-to-get-hurt-150-000-students-strike-20190315-p514ky.html>).

<a id="event-2019-03-15-1-3"></a>

Context: Keystone pipeline expansion.

**Archived source account.** A U.S. appeals court denies TransCanada's request to lift an injunction preventing pre-construction work on the Keystone XL expansion from beginning. The company claims this will delay the project by a year.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/business/transcanada-keystone-pipeline-1.5058988>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-03-15-2-1"></a>

Context: United States and the International Criminal Court, United States war crimes, War crimes in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** United States Secretary of State Mike Pompeo bars the entry of International Criminal Court investigators into the United States as part of the ICC's investigation into possible war crimes committed by the United States military in Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<https://www.apnews.com/08e538e370914f6e8243e237dbde50b5>).

<a id="event-2019-03-15-2-3"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction, North Korea–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** North Korea has reportedly threatened to suspend negotiations with the United States regarding nuclear weaponry, as well as resume related missile testing.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/03/15/world/asia/north-korea-kim-jong-un-nuclear.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-03-15-3-1"></a>

Context: Volkswagen emissions scandal.

**Archived source account.** The Securities and Exchange Commission alleges in a court filing that Volkswagen has "perpetrated a massive fraud" and repeatedly lied to U.S. investors in connection with diesel emissions.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2019/03/15/dieselgate-sec-says-volkswagen-perpetrated-fraud-lied-to-investors.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-03-15-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Algerian protests.

**Archived source account.** The 2019 Algerian protests, the largest protests since the Algerian Civil War, have led the government to cancel the Presidential elections, to replace the Prime Minister, and to promise Abdelaziz Bouteflika would not run for re-election.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/why-algeria-is-still-protesting-after-ruler-relents/2019/03/13/e5353bb2-455d-11e9-94ab-d2dda3c0df52_story.html>).

<a id="event-2019-03-15-4-3"></a>

Context: National Emergency Concerning the Southern Border of the United States.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump issues his first ever veto after Congress attempts to block his emergency declaration to fund construction of the wall along the Mexico–United States border.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/03/15/us/politics/trump-veto-national-emergency.html>).

<a id="event-2019-03-15-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Lawmakers in Mexico's lower chamber of Congress approve a constitutional reform that would allow for recall referendums to cut short the six-year presidential term limit; the measure still needs the approval of the Senate and the state legislatures.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mexico-politics/mexicos-lower-house-passes-measure-to-cut-short-presidential-term-idUSKCN1QW0FC>).

### 2019-03-16

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087754547](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20March%2016&oldid=1087754547>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-03-16-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A fire at a refugee camp in Nigeria kills eight and leaves 15,000 homeless. The residents are people displaced by ongoing conflict with Boko Haram.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-nigeria-security-insurgency/fire-kills-at-least-eight-destroys-homes-in-northeast-nigeria-camp-idUKKCN1QX0EA>).

<a id="event-2019-03-16-0-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Midwestern U.S. floods.

**Archived source account.** Flooding over large portions of Nebraska leave one dead and two missing with over 900 people using emergency shelters. Many roads and highways in the state are also closed.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2019/03/16/nebraska-flooding-worst-50-years-following-bomb-cyclone-storm/3184806002/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-03-16-1-1"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Ireland, Terrorism in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** The village of Derrylin, close to the border between Northern Ireland and the Republic of Ireland, is sealed off after a suspicious object is found. The object is later determined to be “nothing untoward”.

Source citations (as archived): [Irish Times](<https://www.irishtimes.com/news/ireland/irish-news/border-village-sealed-off-after-reports-of-suspicious-object-1.3828864>).

<a id="event-2019-03-16-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Colombia's migration authority detains and expels an alleged spy working for Cuba's Intelligence Directorate.

Source citations (as archived): [El Tiempo](<https://www.eltiempo.com/colombia/otras-ciudades/expulsan-a-espia-cubano-que-rondaba-la-base-militar-de-palanquero-338340>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-03-16-2-1"></a>

Context: Yellow vests movement.

**Archived source account.** Protests against French President Emmanuel Macron enter a fourth month in Paris. Tear gas is fired at protestors throwing stones at riot police in front of the Arc de Triomphe, news stands are torched at the Champs-Élysées, and a branch of Banque Tarneaud is burned. More than 80 arrests are made. Businesses around the Champs-Élysées are looted.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-france-protests/fresh-clashes-as-frances-yellow-vests-seek-new-momentum-idUKKCN1QX0AX>).

<a id="event-2019-03-16-2-3"></a>

Context: Trial of Catalonia independence leaders, Catalan independentism.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of demonstrators protest in Madrid against the trial of Catalan independence leaders and the ongoing detention of some of them. Local police say around 18,000 protestors were involved; organisers claim almost 120,000.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-47597473>).

### 2019-03-17

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087754624](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20March%2017&oldid=1087754624>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-03-17-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Jayapura flood and landslide.

**Archived source account.** At least 73 people have been killed in flash floods in the province of Papua, Indonesia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-47602836>).

<a id="event-2019-03-17-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** President of Mozambique Filipe Nyusi suggests the death toll of Cyclone Idai could reach over one thousand. The current official toll stands at 84.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-47609676>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-03-17-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Slovak presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Progressive Slovakia candidate Zuzana Čaputová, who ran on an anti-corruption campaign against the backdrop of Ján Kuciak's murder, wins the first round of Slovakia's presidential election with 40.5% of the vote while the ruling Direction – Social Democracy Party's candidate Maroš Šefčovič receives 18.6% of the vote. As no candidate reached 50%+1 votes in the first round, Čaputová and Šefčovič will take part in a second round on March 30, 2019. The ruling Direction – Social Democracy Party suffers its worst result since its founding in 1999.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-slovakia-election-president/anti-graft-campaigner-wins-first-round-of-slovak-presidential-vote-idUSKCN1QW2Z3>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/mar/17/slovakia-pro-eu-zuzana-caputova-wins-first-round-of-presidential-election>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-47599946>); [Slovakia's Election Commission](<http://www.volbysr.sk/en/data01.html>).

<a id="event-2019-03-17-1-4"></a>

Context: 2020 United States presidential election, 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries / Kirsten Gillibrand 2020 presidential campaign.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Senator Kirsten Gillibrand of New York formally announces she is officially running for the Democratic Party's nomination for President of the United States in the 2020 election.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/03/17/us/politics/gillibrand-2020-announce.html>).

### 2019-03-18

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087754730](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20March%2018&oldid=1087754730>).

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2019-03-18-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Utrecht shooting.

**Archived source account.** A man opens fire in a tram in the city of Utrecht, Netherlands, killing three people and wounding nine others, before fleeing. Terrorism is suspected by authorities. A 37-year-old Turkish man is arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<https://www.foxnews.com/world/the-latest-no-indication-utrecht-shooter-knew-victims>).

<a id="event-2019-03-18-0-3"></a>

Context: Christchurch mosque shootings, Internet censorship in Australia.

**Archived source account.** Telstra blocks access to several websites in Australia for hosting footage of the recent mass shootings in Christchurch, New Zealand, which were livestreamed on Facebook, including LiveLeak, 4chan, 8chan, Voat and the blog Zero Hedge. Optus and Vodafone took similar actions but did not list which sites had been blocked.

Source citations (as archived): [9news](<https://www.9news.com.au/2019/03/19/16/47/telcos-block-access-to-4chan-liveleak>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-03-18-1-1"></a>

Context: Kamchatka superbolide.

**Archived source account.** NASA reports that it has detected a huge meteor explosion in Earth's atmosphere on December 18, 2018, above Russia's Kamchatka Peninsula. The explosion went largely unnoticed due to its location. The explosion, which was ten times more powerful than the atomic bomb dropped on Hiroshima, was the second largest of its kind in 30 years.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-47607696>).

### 2019-03-19

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1278974679](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20March%2019&oldid=1278974679>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-03-19-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, International military intervention against ISIL, Battle of Baghuz Fawqani.

**Archived source account.** Syrian Democratic Forces declares progress in Syria after an ISIL camp on the outskirts of Baghuz is captured.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/03/19/704730563/isis-camp-in-baghouz-is-captured-as-u-s-allies-celebrate-progress-in-syria>); [Fox News](<https://www.foxnews.com/world/isis-fighters-tied-to-killing-4-americans-in-syria-captured-by-us-backed-fighters-us-official-says>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-03-19-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Food and Drug Administration approves Sage Therapeutics' Zulresso, also known as allopregnanolone or brexanolone, for treatment of postpartum depression. It is the first drug approved to specifically target the disease, which is the most common complication of childbirth.

Source citations (as archived): [STAT News](<https://www.statnews.com/2019/03/19/fda-sage-postpartum-depression-drug/>); [US FDA](<https://www.fda.gov/NewsEvents/Newsroom/PressAnnouncements/ucm633919.htm>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-03-19-2-1"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** North Korea and South Korea express interest in jointly hosting the 2023 FIFA Women's World Cup.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters UK](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-soccer-women-worldcup-2023/south-and-north-korea-seek-womens-world-cup-in-latest-detente-idUKKCN1R01C3>); [Yonhap News Agency](<https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20190319009900315?section=sports/sports>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-03-19-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The President of Kazakhstan, Nursultan Nazarbayev, announces his resignation after 29 years in office.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-kazakhstan-president/president-of-kazakhstan-nursultan-nazarbayev-resigns-idUSKCN1R01N1>).

<a id="event-2019-03-19-3-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Guatemalan general election.

**Archived source account.** A judge issues an arrest warrant against presidential candidate Thelma Aldana; however, as the Supreme Electoral Tribunal registered Aldana as a presidential candidate, she enjoys immunity and can not be arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [Arab News](<http://www.arabnews.com/node/1469446/world>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-03-19-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters awards this year's Abel Prize to Karen Uhlenbeck for "her pioneering achievements in geometric partial differential equations, gauge theory and integrable systems." Uhlenbeck is the first woman to win this prize.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/karen-uhlenbeck-is-first-woman-to-receive-abel-prize-in-mathematics/ar-BBUXk35>).

### 2019-03-20

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087754935](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20March%2020&oldid=1087754935>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-03-20-0-1"></a>

Context: Acquisition of 21st Century Fox by Disney.

**Archived source account.** The Walt Disney Company completes its $71.3 billion acquisition of 21st Century Fox's film and TV assets (with the exception of the business, broadcasting network, news, and sports assets owned by the newly-formed Fox Corporation).

Source citations (as archived): [The Hollywood Reporter](<https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/disney-closes-fox-deal-creating-global-content-powerhouse-1174498>).

<a id="event-2019-03-20-0-3"></a>

Context: European Union competition law.

**Archived source account.** European Union regulators fine Google €1.49 billion for bundling Google Custom Search with its AdSense program which the regulators find as illegal under EU antitrust rules.

Source citations (as archived): [Ars Technica](<https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2019/03/google-fined-1-69-billion-by-the-eu-for-anti-competitive-advertising-practices/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-03-20-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The European People's Party votes to suspend Hungary's ruling Fidesz party citing its anti-immigration stance, and personal attacks on Jean-Claude Juncker and George Soros. Hungarian Prime Minister and Fidesz leader Viktor Orbán had threatened to pull out of the EPP if it was suspended.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-47622921>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-03-20-2-1"></a>

Context: Politics of Kazakhstan.

**Archived source account.** The second President of Kazakhstan, Kassym-Jomart Tokayev, is sworn into office, after the resignation of Nursultan Nazarbayev.

Source citations (as archived): [The National](<https://www.thenational.ae/world/asia/kazakhstan-new-president-sworn-in-renames-capital-city-after-former-leader-1.839522>).

<a id="event-2019-03-20-2-2"></a>

Context: Politics of Kazakhstan.

**Archived source account.** Astana, the capital of Kazakhstan, is renamed Nursultan, after the former President.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-47638619>).

<a id="event-2019-03-20-2-4"></a>

Context: Brexit negotiations.

**Archived source account.** UK Prime Minister Theresa May formally writes a letter to European Council President Donald Tusk requesting for a delay of Brexit until June 30.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2019/mar/20/theresa-may-asks-eu-for-brexit-delay-until-30-june>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-03-20-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mike Trout and the Los Angeles Angels finalize a record-breaking 12-year, $430 million contract, the largest in the history of Major League Baseball.

Source citations (as archived): [Sporting News](<http://www.sportingnews.com/us/mlb/news/mike-trout-angels-discussing-12-year-430-million-extension-mlb/wvpbd87bdg1b132f9ned1j72u>).

### 2019-03-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087755009](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20March%2021&oldid=1087755009>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-03-21-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** Six people are killed and 23 others injured in three bomb explosions during Nowruz celebration in Kabul, Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-47651752/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-03-21-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Mosul ferry sinking.

**Archived source account.** At least 103 people are killed when a Tigris River ferry, carrying families celebrating the Nowruz new year holiday, sinks near the Iraqi city of Mosul.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/03/families-demand-justice-toll-mosul-boat-disaster-hits-103-190322140900440.html>).

<a id="event-2019-03-21-1-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Yancheng chemical plant explosion.

**Archived source account.** A fire and explosion at a chemical plant that makes fertilizer in Yancheng, Jiangsu province, China, kills 47 people and injures 640 others.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-47663023>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-03-21-2-1"></a>

Context: Israel–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump announces his intentions to recognize Israeli sovereignty over the disputed Golan Heights, a move welcomed by Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/03/21/politics/trump-golan-heights-tweet/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-03-21-2-2"></a>

Context: Israel–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Syria has not publicly responded to President Trump's decision. Ahmed Aboul Gheit, Secretary-General of the Arab League, declares this action irrelevant and illegal.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/syria-silent-amid-muted-international-criticism-of-trump-golan-recognition/>); [Ynet](<https://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-5482654,00.html>).

<a id="event-2019-03-21-2-4"></a>

Context: North Korea–United States relations, China–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States sanctions two Chinese shipping companies suspected of helping North Korea evade sanctions. These are the first actions targeting Pyongyang since last month's Hanoi Summit ended without agreement.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<http://time.com/5556515/china-shipping-firms-sanctioned-north-korea-trade/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-03-21-3-1"></a>

Context: Operation Car Wash.

**Archived source account.** Former President of Brazil Michel Temer is arrested as part of an investigation into corruption. Former Governor of Rio de Janeiro Moreira Franco is also arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-47657159>).

<a id="event-2019-03-21-3-3"></a>

Context: October 2018 United States mail bombing attempts.

**Archived source account.** Cesar Sayoc pleads guilty to 65 felony counts, including using weapons of mass destruction, in last year's attempted mail bomb domestic terrorist attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/03/21/us/cesar-sayoc-guilty-plea/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-03-21-3-5"></a>

Context: Burning Sun scandal.

**Archived source account.** Korean pop star Jung Joon-young is arrested over allegations that he shared sexually explicit videos of women filmed without their knowledge or consent.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/03/21/asia/jung-joon-young-k-pop-star-arrested-south-korea-scli-intl/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-03-21-4-1"></a>

Context: Brexit negotiations.

**Archived source account.** The European Union confirms that UK Prime Minister Theresa May's requested short extension date of 30 June is too late due to pending EU elections. After lengthy discussions, EU leaders agree that if the Prime Minister's deal is passed next week a short extension until 22 May is available to pass the necessary legislation. If that deal is not passed, the UK is given until 12 April to define whether it will participate in EU elections.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2019/mar/21/brexit-eu-rejects-theresa-may-request-delay-control>); [The Guardian2](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2019/mar/21/mays-appeal-falls-flat-as-eu-seizes-control-of-brexit-date>).

<a id="event-2019-03-21-4-3"></a>

Context: Gun laws in New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** New Zealand Prime Minister Jacinda Ardern announces a ban of all military-style semi-automatic weapons, assault rifles and high-capacity magazines following the Christchurch mosque shootings. An amnesty is in effect for people who return their guns.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/03/20/asia/new-zealand-christchurch-gun-ban-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-03-21-4-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** Venezuela's intelligence unit, the Bolivarian Intelligence Service (SEBIN), detains attorney Roberto Marrero, Juan Guaidó's chief of staff. U.S. Senator Marco Rubio says this is "a significant escalation of repression and could signal the beginning of efforts to arrest Guaidó himself".,

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<https://www.haaretz.com/world-news/venezuela-detains-top-aide-to-guaido-in-test-of-trump-s-red-line-1.7044395>); [Infobae](<https://www.infobae.com/america/venezuela/2019/03/21/el-regimen-de-nicolas-maduro-detuvo-al-abogado-roberto-marrero-jefe-del-despacho-de-juan-guaido/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-03-21-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ichiro Suzuki retires from baseball after 28 years following the Seattle Mariners/Oakland Athletics game in the Tokyo Dome.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://www.espn.com/mlb/story/_/id/26321505/in-japan-ichiro-retires-where-career-began>).

### 2019-03-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1127423890](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20March%2022&oldid=1127423890>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-03-22-0-1"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** In the town of Dangdala, Chad, 23 National Army soldiers are killed in an overnight attack by Boko Haram militants.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://af.reuters.com/article/chadNews/idAFL8N2192A4>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-03-22-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Global investment management company BlackRock says that it is buying eFront, the leading provider of management software for alternative investments, for $1.3 billion in cash.

Source citations (as archived): [MarketWatch](<https://www.marketwatch.com/story/blackrock-to-acquire-efront-for-13-billion-in-cash-2019-03-22?mod=newsviewer_click>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-03-22-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two buses collide head-on in a village near Kintampo, Ghana, killing at least 50 people. Almost all casualties are a result of a fire on one of the buses.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-47668146>); [GhanaWeb](<https://www.ghanaweb.com/GhanaHomePage/NewsArchive/Accident-claims-close-to-60-lives-at-Amoma-Nkwanta-near-Kintampo-732366#>).

<a id="event-2019-03-22-2-2"></a>

Context: 2018–19 Australian region cyclone season.

**Archived source account.** Thousands have been forced to evacuate their homes as two potentially devastating cyclones are expected to hit the country this weekend. Cyclone Trevor will make landfall in the north near Numbulwar and Borroloola, while Cyclone Veronica, a Category 4 storm, will strike Pilbara on Australia's west coast.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-47671306>).

<a id="event-2019-03-22-2-4"></a>

Context: 2019 Yancheng chemical plant explosion.

**Archived source account.** Officials report the death toll is now 62 from Thursday's chemical plant explosion in Chenjiagang Industrial Park in northeastern Jiangsu Province, with 94 others seriously injured and 28 people still missing.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-47663023>); [The Straits Times](<https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/death-toll-from-east-china-factory-blast-jumps-to-44-state-media>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-03-22-3-1"></a>

Context: North Korea–United States relations, China–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump removes sanctions targeting North Korea that were imposed Thursday by the Treasury Department on two Chinese companies.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<https://www.foxnews.com/politics/trump-surprises-by-revoking-north-korea-sanctions-immediately-after-treasury-imposes-them>).

<a id="event-2019-03-22-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Inter-American Development Bank, Latin America’s largest development lender, cancels its scheduled annual 48-country meeting next week following China's refusal to allow a representative of Venezuelan opposition leader Juan Guaidó to attend what would have been the first IADB meeting held in China.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics-china-iadb-exclusi/exclusive-iadb-cancels-china-meeting-after-beijing-bars-venezuela-representative-idUSKCN1R32NU?il=0>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-03-22-4-1"></a>

Context: Zaoyang car attack.

**Archived source account.** A man is shot dead in the city of Zaoyang, China, after ramming his vehicle into a crowd of pedestrians, killing at least six and injuring seven others.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/car-plows-into-crowd-in-china-six-killed-police-shoot-driver/ar-BBV4XBY?li=BBnb7Kz>).

<a id="event-2019-03-22-4-3"></a>

Context: Special Counsel investigation, Links between Trump associates and Russian officials.

**Archived source account.** Special Counsel Robert Mueller delivers a report on his inquiry into Russian interference in the 2016 elections to Attorney General William Barr, who is expected to summarize the findings for congressional lawmakers in the coming days.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/live-news/mueller-report-released-russia-investigation-trump-campaign-election-live-updates-today/>); [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/special-counsel-robert-muellers-highly-anticipated-report-handed/story?id=61147281&amp;cid=clicksource_4380645_null_headlines>); [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/justice-department/mueller-sends-report-trump-investigation-ag-barr-n974006>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/politics/live-news/mueller-submits-russia-report/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-03-22-5-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.
