**Archived source account.** More than 24 hours after the Bolivarian Intelligence Service (SEBIN) detain attorney Roberto Marrero—Juan Guaidó's chief of staff—there has been no contact with him and lawmakers are denied access to him at El Helicoide.

Source citations (as archived): [Tal Cual Digital](<http://talcualdigital.com/index.php/2019/03/22/advierten-que-a-marrero-le-podrian-aplicar-sustancias-para-dar-falso-testimonio/>).

<a id="event-2019-03-22-5-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** Just hours after Marrero's detention, the United States Department of the Treasury responds by placing sanctions on BANDES, the Venezuelan Economic and Social Development Bank and four of its subsidiaries. )

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20190322-us-slaps-sanctions-venezuelan-bank>).

<a id="event-2019-03-22-5-4"></a>

Context: 2019 Algerian protests.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of thousands of Algerians again rally, this week in heavy rain and cold weather, against President Abdelaziz Bouteflika demanding his immediate resignation. Bouteflika is fighting for his political survival in the face of unrelenting protests and the desertion of long-time allies.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-algeria-protests/hundreds-of-thousands-of-algerians-rally-against-bouteflika-idUSKCN1R31B3?il=0>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-03-22-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The English Football League is to deduct Birmingham City F.C. nine points for breaching profitability and sustainability rules. Birmingham City are the first club to be deducted points since the EFL introduced its new profitability and sustainability regulations in 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC Sport](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/47667742>).

### 2019-03-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087755182](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20March%2023&oldid=1087755182>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-03-23-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / Battle of Baghuz Fawqani.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Democratic Forces announce the capture of the last territory held by ISIL in Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/islamic-state-defeated-in-syria-us-backed-syrian-forces/a-48036014>).

<a id="event-2019-03-23-0-5"></a>

Context: Northern Mali conflict / March 2019 attacks against Fulani herders.

**Archived source account.** At least 160 Fulani herdsmen are killed in an attack on the villages of Ogossagou and Welingara by Dogon militia in Mali.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mali-security/at-least-134-fulani-herders-killed-in-central-malis-worst-violence-yet-idUSKCN1R40K9>).

<a id="event-2019-03-23-0-7"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War.

**Archived source account.** In Mogadishu, Somalia, at least five militants set off a car bomb and raid a government building, killing at least five people. Al-Shabaab claim responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/03/23/world/africa/somalia-bombing-gunfight-shabab.html>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/africa/explosion-heard-in-somali-capital-mogadishu/2019/03/23/16cc00dc-4d49-11e9-8cfc-2c5d0999c21e_story.html?utm_term=.da9c4b1c0e9b>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-03-23-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Wall Street Journal reports that former Enron CEO Jeffrey Skilling, released from prison in February after serving 12 years for fraud and insider trading following Enron's 2001 collapse, is planning a return to the energy business, helming a "digital platform connecting investors to oil and gas projects"..

Source citations (as archived): [The Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/ex-enron-ceo-skilling-plots-second-act-11553282732>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-03-23-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Rescuers scramble to rescue about 1,300 passengers and crew from the cruise ship Viking Sky adrift off the coast of Norway.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/03/23/europe/norway-cruise-ship-evacuation/index.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-03-23-3-1"></a>

Context: China–Italy relations.

**Archived source account.** Italy signs $2.8 billion in deals with the Belt and Road Initiative.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-italy-china-deals-factbox/italy-signs-deals-worth-2-5-billion-euros-with-china-idUSKCN1R40KN>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-03-23-4-1"></a>

Context: Opposition to Brexit in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Approximately one million Britons assemble for the People's Vote March in London, United Kingdom advocating for an additional referendum on Brexit.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-47678763>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/live/2019/mar/23/brexit-hundreds-of-thousands-expected-to-march-for-peoples-vote-london-live-updates>).

### 2019-03-24

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1127423883](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20March%2024&oldid=1127423883>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-03-24-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** A United States airstrike in Afghanistan early Saturday kills 10 children and 3 adults. The family was displaced because of the conflict according to early findings by the United Nations Assistance Mission in Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-casualties/ten-children-killed-by-u-s-air-strike-in-afghanistan-u-n-idUSKCN1R60V0>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-03-24-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The 2019 Global Teacher Prize and its $1 million (£760,000) purse is awarded to Brother Peter Tabichi, a Franciscan science teacher from rural Kenya. Tabichi gives away 80 percent of his salary to support poorer pupils at the Keriko Mixed Day Secondary School in Pwani Village, Nakuru.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-47658803>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-03-24-2-1"></a>

Context: Stoneman Douglas High School massacre aftermath.

**Archived source account.** More than 60 school, county, city, child services and law enforcement officials, as well as mental health specialists, teachers and parents, hold an emergency meeting after the suicide of a second Stoneman Douglas survivor. Florida's emergency chief is requesting the state Legislature provide more mental health resources for the community. Coral Springs, Florida, police reported that, Saturday night, a current sophomore killed himself. Last week, Sydney Aiello, a 19-year-old graduate who had recently been diagnosed with post-traumatic stress disorder, took her own life.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2019/mar/24/parkland-student-second-death>); [Miami Herald](<https://www.miamiherald.com/news/local/community/broward/article228350134.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-03-24-3-1"></a>

Context: Russia–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** Two Russian military planes, an Ilyushin Il-62 and an Antonov An-124, land at Simón Bolívar International Airport near Caracas, Venezuela, carrying senior Defence Ministry official Vasily Tonkoshkurov, a large amount of equipment and about 100 troops. Russia, which three months earlier held joint military exercises on Venezuelan soil, condemned other countries for backing Venezuelan opposition leader Juan Guaidó against embattled President Nicolás Maduro.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics/russian-air-force-planes-land-in-venezuela-carrying-troops-reports-idUSKCN1R50NB>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-46989279>).

<a id="event-2019-03-24-3-3"></a>

Context: Status of Jerusalem.

**Archived source account.** In Washington, D.C., the leaders of Romania and Honduras announce they will recognize Jerusalem as Israel's capital, following the lead of the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<https://www.foxnews.com/world/romania-honduras-recognize-jerusalem-as-israels-capital>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-03-24-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Thai general election.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Thailand head to the polls to elect all 500 members of the House of Representatives. This is the first parliamentary election held in the country since the invalidation of the 2014 Thai general election and the ensuing 2014 Thai coup d'état.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-thailand-election/thai-voters-go-to-polls-as-coup-leader-democratic-front-face-off-idUSKCN1R5027>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/thailands-military-junta-allows-first-elections-in-8-years-but-the-rules-appear-to-tip-in-its-favor/2019/03/23/b29f36fa-4bd2-11e9-8cfc-2c5d0999c21e_story.html?noredirect=on&amp;utm_term=.6713bae9e993>).

<a id="event-2019-03-24-4-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Comorian presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Voters in the Comoros head to the polls to elect a new President.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-47685991>).

<a id="event-2019-03-24-4-5"></a>

Context: Mueller special counsel investigation.

**Archived source account.** Special Counsel Robert Mueller's report on Russian interference in the 2016 United States elections does not find that any US officials or Trump campaign members knowingly conspired with the government of Russia. Mueller drew no conclusions about whether Trump illegally obstructed justice.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-russia-barr/mueller-does-not-find-trump-campaign-knowingly-conspired-with-russia-idUSKCN1R50RG>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/03/24/us/politics/mueller-report-summary.html>).

<a id="event-2019-03-24-4-6"></a>

Context: Mueller special counsel investigation.

**Archived source account.** Attorney General William Barr releases the "principal conclusions" of Mueller's investigation in a four-page public letter to the Congress's Judiciary Committee leadership.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<https://www.foxnews.com/politics/barr-releases-letter-summarizing-muellers-key-findings-after-long-running-russia-probe>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2019/03/24/takeaways-mueller-reports-principal-conclusions/?utm_term=.cabfa868c97a>); [William Barr letter to congress](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/context/read-attorney-general-barr-s-principal-conclusions-of-the-mueller-report/?noteId=9048a12b-2332-4645-a1be-d645db216eb5&amp;questionId=218b8095-c5e3-4eab-9135-4170f5b3e87f&amp;utm_term=.1cc3924e144f>).

<a id="event-2019-03-24-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thousands of teachers gather in the capital of Rabat, Morocco to protest working conditions and wages.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-47684913>); [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20190324-thousands-moroccan-teachers-protest-over-pay-rabat-education>).

### 2019-03-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087755369](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20March%2025&oldid=1087755369>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-03-25-0-1"></a>

Context: Gaza–Israel conflict.

**Archived source account.** Seven people are moderately injured after a rocket attack destroys a home in Mishmeret, Israel. The Israel Defense Forces claim that Hamas is responsible for any attack from Gaza.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-47689684>).

<a id="event-2019-03-25-0-2"></a>

Context: Gaza–Israel conflict.

**Archived source account.** As a result, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu cuts his four-day trip to the United States short after meeting with U.S. President Donald Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians-violence/netanyahu-cuts-short-u-s-trip-after-rocket-attack-from-gaza-idUSKCN1R60M3>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/gaza-rocket-hits-israeli-home-injuring-7-netanyahu-cuts-short-washington-trip/2019/03/25/7eb5f062-4ed0-11e9-a3f7-78b7525a8d5f_story.html>).

<a id="event-2019-03-25-0-3"></a>

Context: Gaza–Israel conflict.

**Archived source account.** In retaliation Israeli Air Force jets strike multiple targets in the Gaza Strip, including the office of senior Hamas official Ismail Haniyeh, and Hamas' military intelligence headquarters in Gaza City.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palsetinians-violence-haniyeh/israel-air-strike-targets-office-of-hamas-leader-in-gaza-hamas-radio-idUSKCN1R62BJ>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/03/israeli-military-begins-striking-hamas-targets-gaza-190325152429228.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-03-25-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Iran floods.

**Archived source account.** Flash flooding in the southern provinces of Iran kills at least 19 people and injures more than 100. The majority of the deaths occurred in the city of Shiraz.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-47694423>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-03-25-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Bayer and Johnson &amp; Johnson announce that they have reached a $775 million agreement to settle approximately 25,000 outstanding litigation cases, which claim that their drug Xarelto caused severe and sometimes fatal bleeding episodes. Bayer and Johnson &amp; Johnson had successfully defended the safety of the drug in all six prior cases that went to trial.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/03/25/health/xarelto-blood-thinner-lawsuit-settlement.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-03-25-3-1"></a>

Context: United States recognition of the Golan Heights as part of Israel, Israel–United States relations, Syria–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump signs a proclamation formally recognising the disputed Golan Heights as sovereign Israeli territory.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/03/trump-formally-recognises-israeli-sovereignty-golan-heights-190325153937336.html>).

<a id="event-2019-03-25-3-2"></a>

Context: United States recognition of the Golan Heights as part of Israel, Israel–United States relations, Syria–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Syria's Foreign Affairs Ministry condemns Trump's move as a "flagrant violation of the sovereignty of Syria".

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhuanet](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-03/26/c_137923014.htm>).

<a id="event-2019-03-25-3-4"></a>

Context: Greek–Turkish relations.

**Archived source account.** Greek prime minister Alexis Tsipras says Turkish fighter jets threatened his helicopter, in Greek airspace, heading to the Aegean island of Agathonisi, near Turkey's coastline, for Greek Independence Day which celebrates the country's 1821 uprising against the Ottoman Empire. Turkish security forces rejected the accusation, insisting the jets were carrying out a routine mission.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-47692529>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-03-25-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A judge rules that former Guantanamo Bay prisoner Omar Khadr has completed his prison sentence.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/amp/1.5068610>); [Vancouver Courier](<https://www.vancourier.com/edmonton-judge-rules-omar-khadr-s-sentence-has-expired-1.23769542>).

<a id="event-2019-03-25-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Attorney Michael Avenatti is arrested and charged with extortion, embezzlement and bank fraud.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2019/03/25/michael-avenatti-to-be-charged-with-wire-and-bank-fraud.html>).

### 2019-03-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087755566](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20March%2026&oldid=1087755566>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-03-26-0-1"></a>

Context: Iran–Israel proxy conflict, Gaza–Israel conflict, Iran and state-sponsored terrorism.

**Archived source account.** According to Israel Today, a senior Hamas official, speaking on condition of anonymity, claimed that Iran's rulers ordered the rocket attack on Mishmeret in central Israel on March 25, 2019, which injured seven Israelis. The rocket attack was carried out by Islamic Jihad Movement in Palestine, which is heavily financed by Iran. The Hamas official said that Hamas's goal was to hurt Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's chances of getting reelected in the April 9 elections.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/Arab-Israeli-Conflict/Hamas-official-Iran-ordered-rocket-attack-on-central-Israel-584712>); [Israel National News](<http://www.israelnationalnews.com/News/News.aspx/260933>).

<a id="event-2019-03-26-0-3"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War.

**Archived source account.** An airstrike carried out in north-west Yemen kills seven and injures eight others at a hospital. The airstrike occurred early when patients and staff members were arriving.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-47711413>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/save-the-children-7-killed-in-airstrike-on-yemen-hospital/2019/03/26/7192c590-5029-11e9-bdb7-44f948cc0605_story.html?utm_term=.4040c24990f4>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-03-26-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The all-female board of Women Church World, a monthly supplement in the L'Osservatore Romano (the Vatican City daily newspaper), resign citing a campaign to discredit them and put them "under the direct control of men".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-47704995>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-03-26-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S.-owned company Uber buys Dubai-based ride-sharing company Careem for $3.1 billion in order to further solidify its Middle Eastern presence.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2019/03/26/uber-to-buy-middle-east-ride-sharing-rival-careem-for-3point1-billion.html>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/03/26/tech/uber-careem-acquisition/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-03-26-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission tells a judge in New York that she has the power to decide whether the CEO of Tesla, Elon Musk, violated the terms of his settlement with the SEC without holding a hearing, because there are no open issues of material fact.

Source citations (as archived): [SEC](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-03-25/sec-tells-court-no-need-for-hearing-to-find-musk-in-contempt?srnd=premium>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-03-26-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Jayapura flood and landslide.

**Archived source account.** The death toll of the floods and landslide in Jayapura, Indonesia, rise to 113. At least 94 others are still missing.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition-m.cnn.com/2019/03/26/asia/indonesia-floods-papua-intl/index.html?r=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.google.com%2F>).

<a id="event-2019-03-26-3-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Iran floods.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from a flash flood in Iran rises to 21.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/iran-flooding-death-toll-climbs-today-unprecedented-floods-climate-change-03-26-2019/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-03-26-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Health officials in Rockland County, New York, declare a state of emergency due to an ongoing measles outbreak. The county is prohibiting unvaccinated children under the age of 18 from public areas for 30 days.

Source citations (as archived): [Ars Technica](<https://arstechnica.com/science/2019/03/emergency-declared-in-ny-over-measles-unvaccinated-barred-from-public-spaces/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-03-26-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Lima Group condemns the presence of Russian military planes in Venezuela as a "provocation threatening peace and security in the region."

Source citations (as archived): [France24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20190326-lima-group-concerned-over-russian-provocation-venezuela>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-03-26-6-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of North Korea.

**Archived source account.** The Spanish Audiencia Nacional reveals that an attack on the North Korean embassy in Madrid on February 22 was led by a Mexican citizen residing in the United States who later offered the FBI data stolen during the incident.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<https://apnews.com/d4d3b2276f1b478fa0955c1000003217>); [Euro news](<https://www.euronews.com/2019/03/26/mexican-national-stole-files-from-north-korean-embassy-in-spain-for-the-fbi-spanish-court>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2019/03/26/world/europe/ap-eu-spain-nkorea-embassy-attack.html>).

<a id="event-2019-03-26-6-3"></a>

Context: Directive on Copyright in the Digital Single Market.

**Archived source account.** The European Parliament approves two revisions to the controversial Directive on Copyright in the Digital Single Market. One resolution includes new requirements aimed at making companies pay licensing fees to publications such as newspapers whose work gets aggregated by online services. The second revision makes online platforms such as Google, Facebook and YouTube liable for the content posted on their services, meaning that all content providers must get permission from rights holders before uploading copyrighted material of any kind.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/media/2019/mar/26/meps-approve-sweeping-changes-to-copyright-law-european-copyright-directive>).

<a id="event-2019-03-26-6-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** All charges against American actor Jussie Smollett for allegedly filing a false police report are dropped.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/03/26/entertainment/jussie-smollett-charges-dropped/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-03-26-6-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Purdue Pharma reaches a $270 million settlement in a lawsuit filed by the U.S. state of Oklahoma that claimed the pharmaceutical company's opioids contributed to the deaths of thousands of people as part of the opioid epidemic.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/health-science/purdue-pharma-state-of-oklahoma-reach-settlement-in-landmark-opioid-lawsuit/2019/03/26/69aa5cda-4f11-11e9-a3f7-78b7525a8d5f_story.html?utm_term=.4d79fe0fc79e>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-03-26-7-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Algerian protests.

**Archived source account.** Algeria's Chief of Staff of the People's National Army Ahmed Gaid Salah, the highest-ranked military official in the country, gives a televised address, calling on President Abdelaziz Bouteflika to resign or be declared "unfit to serve" by the People's National Assembly.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-47710945>).

<a id="event-2019-03-26-7-3"></a>

Context: Green New Deal.

**Archived source account.** The United States Senate blocks the Green New Deal, a progressive climate change resolution aiming to achieve net-zero greenhouse gas emissions in the United States. It has faced criticism from conservatives, as well as some Democrats, who found the resolution too broad and unspecific.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/homenews/senate/435899-senate-blocks-green-new-deal>).

<a id="event-2019-03-26-7-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. Secretary of Education Betsy DeVos testifies before a House appropriations subcommittee about this year's DoED budget request. The committee heavily criticized Secretary DeVos for the proposed budget cuts.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News](<https://news.yahoo.com/betsy-de-vos-under-fire-over-special-olympics-budget-cuts-210604137.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-03-26-8-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mixed martial artist Conor McGregor announces his retirement from the sport on Twitter. The New York Times reports that McGregor was arrested in January for allegedly sexually assaulting a woman in Ireland. According to the New York Times, he was released and is under investigation by authorities.

Source citations (as archived): [MMA Fighting](<https://www.mmafighting.com/2019/3/26/18281973/conor-mcgregor-tweets-hes-decided-to-retire-from-mma>); [New York Post](<https://nypost.com/2019/03/26/conor-mcgregor-facing-sexual-assault-accusation-in-ireland/>).

### 2019-03-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087755705](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20March%2027&oldid=1087755705>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-03-27-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Cathay Pacific announces the acquisition of low-cost carrier HK Express for US$628 million (HK$4.93 billion).

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-47715426>); [South China Morning Post](<https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/transport/article/3003412/hong-kongs-cathay-pacific-airways-pay-hk493-billion-buy>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-03-27-1-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** The European Union says it is suspending Operation Sophia ship patrols. Instead, the operation will rely on air missions and close coordination with Libya. The EU also announces the mandate for Operation Sophia, which was scheduled to expire March 31, 2019, will be extended for six months.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/eu-suspends-naval-patrols-libya-migrant-operation-150040225.html>).

<a id="event-2019-03-27-1-2"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** More than 100 migrants hijack a merchant vessel that rescued them off Libya's coast, ordering the crew to head towards Malta. Malta's military said the ship would not be allowed into its waters.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-47725242>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-03-27-2-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Charlottesville car attack.

**Archived source account.** James Alex Fields, who drove his car into a crowd of protestors at the Unite the Right rally in Charlottesville, Virginia, in 2017, killing one person and injuring 28 others, pleads guilty to 29 federal hate crimes. He will be sentenced on July 3, 2019.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/driver-deadly-car-attack-charlottesville-white-nationalist-rally-pleads-guilty-n987961>).

<a id="event-2019-03-27-2-3"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the kidnapping of Jayme Closs.

**Archived source account.** Jake Patterson pleads guilty to the kidnapping of teenager Jayme Closs and the murder of her parents last year.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Post](<https://nypost.com/2019/03/27/jake-patterson-pleads-guilty-to-kidnapping-jayme-closs-killing-her-parents/>).

<a id="event-2019-03-27-2-5"></a>

Context: Medicaid expansion.

**Archived source account.** Judge James Boasberg of the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia blocks Kentucky from implementing Medicaid work requirements and Arkansas from continuing its program, stating the program's approval by the Department of Health and Human Services "... is arbitrary and capricious because it did not address... how the project would implicate the 'core' objective of Medicaid, the provision of medical coverage to the needy".

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/health-shots/2019/03/27/707401647/federal-judge-again-blocks-states-work-requirements-for-medicaid>).

<a id="event-2019-03-27-2-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Argentine President Carlos Menem is sentenced to 3 years and 9 months in prison for the sale of a government ground. His government's Minister of Economy Domingo Cavallo was also sentenced to 3 years and 6 months. In addition, both were disqualified from holding public office for life. As Menem is currently a National Senator and has immunity, he will not comply with his sentence yet.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN in Spanish](<https://cnnespanol.cnn.com/2019/03/27/argentina-condenan-al-expresidente-carlos-menem-a-3-anos-9-meses-de-prision/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-03-27-3-1"></a>

Context: Brexit negotiations.

**Archived source account.** The UK parliament holds "indicative votes" on eight options regarding Brexit in an attempt to find an approach which can command a majority. None of the options are passed at this stage; however, a further round of voting is planned for Monday.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/theresa-may-job-brexit-alternatives-vote-1.5073190>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2019/mar/27/alternative-brexit-options-what-will-john-bercow-select-for-indicative-votes>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2019/mar/27/mps-reject-all-alternative-brexit-options>).

<a id="event-2019-03-27-3-2"></a>

Context: Brexit negotiations.

**Archived source account.** UK Prime Minister Theresa May announces that she will resign before the next phase of Brexit negotiations, if her deal were to be passed.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2019/mar/27/theresa-may-to-resign-before-next-phase-of-brexit>).

<a id="event-2019-03-27-3-4"></a>

Context: 2019 Guatemalan general election.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Electoral Tribunal dismisses six nullity proceedings against the presidential candidacy of Thelma Aldana. However, it accepts two processes and requests the Supreme Court of Justice, the Public Prosecutor's Office and the Comptroller General of Accounts to present a report on their legal situation. It was also reported that after resolving these processes this week, it will proceed to issue the credential that grants immunity to the candidate.

Source citations (as archived): [Prensa Libre](<https://www.prensalibre.com/guatemala/politica/tse-pide-informacion-a-mp-contraloria-y-oj-sobre-thelma-aldana/>).

<a id="event-2019-03-27-3-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Guatemalan general election.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Electoral Tribunal acts legally before the Constitutional Court to appeal the permission granted to the presidential candidate Zury Ríos to participate in the elections despite having constitutional impediment.

Source citations (as archived): [Prensa Libre](<https://www.prensalibre.com/guatemala/politica/los-argumentos-del-tse-para-apelar-la-candidatura-de-zury-rios/>).

<a id="event-2019-03-27-3-6"></a>

Context: 2019 Guatemalan general election.

**Archived source account.** Director of the Registry of Citizens of the Supreme Electoral Tribunal Leopoldo Guerra denounces pressures and threats by far-right groups not to register Thelma Aldana as a presidential candidate and request precautionary measures from the Inter-American Commission on Human Rights.

Source citations (as archived): [Prensa Libre](<https://www.prensalibre.com/guatemala/politica/leopoldo-guerra-pide-medidas-cautelares-a-la-cidh-por-amenazas/>).

### 2019-03-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087755773](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20March%2028&oldid=1087755773>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-03-28-0-1"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War.

**Archived source account.** At least 11 people are killed following an explosion in Mogadishu, Somalia.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/03/8-killed-car-bomb-mogadishu-190328110849696.html>).

<a id="event-2019-03-28-0-3"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Maltese Navy seizes control of commercial tanker Elhiblu 1, which was hijacked by migrants off the coast of Libya yesterday. The tanker is now docked in the Maltese capital, Valletta.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-47730693>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-03-28-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** WOW air, an Icelandic low-cost airline, ceases operations.

Source citations (as archived): [Icelandic Transport Authority](<https://www.icetra.is/about/press-room/news/end-of-operation-of-wow-air>); [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/icelandic-budget-airline-wow-air-ceases-operations-1.5074662>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-03-28-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 18 people have died after a truck struck a crowd gathered at a road accident in western Guatemala. The group had apparently gathered on the road to inspect a person who had been killed in a separate crash when the vehicle ploughed into them. The estimates of those dead were later revised by officials.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/30-dead-after-truck-hits-crowd-in-guatemala-11676960>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-guatemala-crash/at-least-32-killed-in-guatemala-as-truck-plows-into-crowd-idUSKCN1R90CB>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-47738483>).

<a id="event-2019-03-28-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A fire breaks out in Dhaka, Bangladesh, at a 22-story tower, killing at least 25 people and injuring more than 70 others.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-47751005>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-03-28-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of the United States rejects a request by gun rights activists to grant a temporary stay on the Trump administration's ban on bump stock attachments that allow semi-automatic firearms to be fired rapidly. The policy took effect Tuesday after a similar bid to delay implementation was rejected.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-court-guns/us-supreme-court-refuses-to-block-trumps-gun-bump-stock-ban-idUSKCN1R9230>).

<a id="event-2019-03-28-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Judge John D. Bates of the Federal District Court for the District of Columbia, in a case filed by 11 states, strikes down the Trump administration rule broadly re-defining an Association Health Plan employer to include self-employed individuals with no employees because it violates the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 and the Affordable Care Act of 2010.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/court-deals-trump-second-blow-this-week-on-health-care/ar-BBVmQqV>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-03-28-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** Venezuelan state comptroller Elvis Amoroso announces that opposition leader Juan Guaidó is barred from holding public office for 15 years because of irregularities in his financial records. Guaidó, the National Assembly President, says he will continue his campaign to oust President Nicolás Maduro.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/juan-guaido-venezuelan-opposition-leader-barred-from-holding-office-for-15-years-live-updates-2019-03-28/>).

### 2019-03-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087755844](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20March%2029&oldid=1087755844>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-03-29-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the aftermath of Cyclone Idai, those infected by cholera jump to 139 confirmed cases in Mozambique.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/africa/mozambique-cholera-cases-jump-to-139-a-day-after-outbreak/2019/03/29/ad9b3f88-51f3-11e9-bdb7-44f948cc0605_story.html?noredirect=on&amp;utm_term=.ae94c14a8c3f>); [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/cyclone-mozambique-cholera-outbreak-water-disease-red-cross-ticking-time-bomb/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-03-29-1-1"></a>

Context: Same-sex marriage in the Cayman Islands.

**Archived source account.** Cayman Islands legalises same-sex marriage after a judge rules that a law defining marriage as a relationship between a man and woman is unconstitutional.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/cayman-islands-gay-marriage-same-sex-lgbt-british-territory-a8846431.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-03-29-2-1"></a>

Context: Brexit negotiations.

**Archived source account.** UK Prime Minister Theresa May suffers another defeat of 286–344 on her Withdrawal Agreement. European Council President Donald Tusk schedules an emergency summit on April 10, two days before Brexit is scheduled to happen.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/uk/live-news/brexit-withdrawal-deal-vote-gbr-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-03-29-2-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Algerian protests.

**Archived source account.** Algerians protest in the capital of Algiers against President Abdelaziz Bouteflika in an effort to make him resign. It is estimated that tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands attended.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/03/29/world/africa/algeria-antigovernment-protests.html>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-47746938>); [Channel NewsAsia](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/huge-rallies-in-algiers-despite-loyalist-calls-for-president-to-11393902>).

### 2019-03-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087755925](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20March%2030&oldid=1087755925>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-03-30-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** First Vice President of Afghanistan Abdul Rashid Dostum survives an assassination attempt on his convoy while traveling to the Jowzjan Province in Afghanistan. The attack killed one bodyguard and injured two others.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-dostum/afghan-vice-president-narrowly-escapes-death-for-a-second-time-idUSKCN1RB0HO>); [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/Breaking-News/Afghan-vice-president-narrowly-escapes-death-for-a-second-time-585253>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-03-30-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis and Moroccan King Mohammed VI call for the protection of Jerusalem's multi-religious character, saying the city's sacred sites must be accessible to worshipers of all faiths.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pope-morocco-jerusalem/pope-moroccos-king-say-jerusalem-must-be-open-to-all-faiths-idUSKCN1RB0IK?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-03-30-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Brunei defends its decision, despite global criticism, to implement laws that can punish homosexuality, adultery and rape with the death penalty, including by stoning, and theft with amputation, as of Wednesday, April 3, 2019.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brunei-islamiclaws/brunei-defends-tough-new-islamic-laws-against-growing-backlash-idUSKCN1RB0E1?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-03-30-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis says the plight of migrants was "a wound that cries out to heaven". He added, "The issue of migration will never be resolved by raising barriers, fomenting fear of others or denying assistance to those who legitimately aspire to a better life for themselves and their families".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pope-morocco/wound-of-migration-not-solved-by-physical-barriers-pope-says-idUSKCN1RB0GK>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-03-30-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Flash floods kill at least 32 people in western Afghanistan, destroying homes and sweeping through makeshift shelters that housed displaced families.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-floods/afghanistan-floods-kill-32-worsen-already-desperate-situation-idUSKCN1RB068>).

<a id="event-2019-03-30-2-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Midwestern U.S. floods.

**Archived source account.** This month, at least 400,000 hectares (1 million acres) of U.S. farmland were flooded from the early March blizzard storm that affected nine major grain-producing states, according to Israel Cleantech Ventures' Gro Intelligence.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-weather-floods-exclusive/exclusive-more-than-1-million-acres-of-u-s-cropland-ravaged-by-floods-idUSKCN1RA2AW>).

<a id="event-2019-03-30-2-4"></a>

Context: Earthquakes in 2019.

**Archived source account.** A 5.3 magnitude earthquake strikes northwest of Athens, Greece, near the seaside town of Itea at 1046 GMT.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/53-magnitude-earthquake-strikes-central-greece/2019/03/30/feff87a6-52e0-11e9-bdb7-44f948cc0605_story.html?utm_term=.df45ef20191e>).

<a id="event-2019-03-30-2-5"></a>

Context: Earthquakes in 2019.

**Archived source account.** A 6.4 magnitude earthquake hits Papua New Guinea's New Britain island, east of Kandrian at 1120 GMT.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-papua-quake/magnitude-6-1-earthquake-hits-papua-new-guinea-usgs-idUSKCN1RB0BJ?il=0>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-03-30-3-1"></a>

Context: Northern Triangle of Central America.

**Archived source account.** President Donald Trump directs the United States Department of State to cease aid for El Salvador, Honduras, and Guatemala. This apparently reverses the regional compact agreement Homeland Security Secretary Kirstjen Nielsen signed on Wednesday with these countries and Secretary of State Mike Pompeo's congressional testimony of the same day.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/latino/436579-us-halting-aid-to-el-salvador-guatemala-and-honduras>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-immigration-aid/u-s-ending-aid-to-el-salvador-guatemala-honduras-over-migrants-idUSKCN1RB0OR>); [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/trump-cuts-direct-assistance-honduras-el-salvador-guatemala/story?id=62051082>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/03/30/politics/state-department-aid-el-slavador-guatemala-honduras/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-03-30-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tunisian authorities acknowledge they are detaining Tunisian national Moncef Kartas, a UN Libyan arms embargo monitor who has diplomatic immunity. Tunisia says Mr. Kartas had traveled in a private capacity on his Tunisian passport. The United Nations has called for his release and for Tunisia to clarify the reason for his arrest.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-tunisia-libya/tunisia-says-u-n-official-arrested-in-anti-terrorism-probe-agency-idUSKCN1RB0LG?il=0>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/03/tells-tunisia-free-libya-sanctions-expert-190329182201842.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-03-30-4-1"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Egypt.

**Archived source account.** Thirty men are sentenced in Egypt for planning an attack on a church in Alexandria, with eighteen men receiving life sentences and twelve men receiving between ten to fifteen years in prison.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/03/30/world/middleeast/egypt-isis-terror-plot-church.html>).

<a id="event-2019-03-30-4-3"></a>

Context: Offshore oil and gas in the United States, Arctic Refuge drilling controversy.

**Archived source account.** Federal Judge Sharon L. Gleason for the District of Alaska rules that President Donald Trump's 2017 executive order allowing oil and gas drilling in the Arctic Ocean and parts of the North Atlantic coast exceeds presidential power because it requires congressional action.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-47762089>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/03/30/climate/trump-oil-drilling-arctic.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-03-30-5-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Slovak presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Slovak citizens vote for a new president, with front runner Zuzana Čaputová facing Maroš Šefčovič.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-47756368>).

<a id="event-2019-03-30-5-3"></a>

Context: 2018 Gaza border protests, Gaza–Israel conflict.

**Archived source account.** On the one year anniversary of the Gaza border protests, tens of thousands of Palestinians gather on the border to commemorate the weekly gatherings. Four Palestinian protesters have been killed and more than 300 injured according to Palestinian health officials.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-47758369>); [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/three-palestinians-dead-in-protests-gazas-health-ministry-says-11679341>).

<a id="event-2019-03-30-5-5"></a>

Context: Algerian protests.

**Archived source account.** Algerian Army Chief of Staff Ahmed Gaid Salah renews his call for President Abdelaziz Bouteflika, who has rarely been seen in public since suffering a stroke in 2013, be declared unfit for office. He also told opponents not to seek to undermine the military.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-algiers-protests/algerian-army-repeats-call-to-declare-president-unfit-for-office-idUSKCN1RB0N7?il=0>).

### 2019-03-31

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087758700](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20March%2031&oldid=1087758700>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-03-31-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A plant explosion in the Jiangsu province of China kills seven and injures five others. The explosion is the second deadliest in the month after the 2019 Xiangshui chemical plant explosion.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-blast/seven-killed-in-china-plant-explosion-second-deadly-blast-this-month-idUSKCN1RC0AC>).

<a id="event-2019-03-31-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Severe thunderstorms in Nepal leave at least 25 people dead while more than 400 others are injured.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/officials-20-killed-hundreds-injured-rainstorm-southern-nepal-62073305>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/mar/31/nepal-thunderstorm-severe-25-dead-hundreds-injured>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-03-31-1-1"></a>

Context: Cross-Strait relations.

**Archived source account.** Taiwan condemns China after two PLAAF fighter jets pass the maritime line on the Taiwan Strait. Though there was no immediate response from China, the move comes after a week when the United States Navy and United States Coast Guard sent ships through the Strait.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-taiwan-china/taiwan-condemns-china-after-chinese-jets-flew-past-a-maritime-line-idUSKCN1RC0ID>); [Channel NewsAsia](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/taiwan-condemns-china-after-chinese-jets-flew-past-a-maritime-line-11397794>); [The Japan Times](<https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2019/03/31/asia-pacific/taipei-blasts-provocative-flight-chinese-fighters-taiwan-strait/#.XKDRt5hKhPY>).

<a id="event-2019-03-31-1-3"></a>

Context: United States recognition of the Golan Heights as part of Israel.

**Archived source account.** During the 30th Arab League summit held in Tunisia, leaders condemn the United States' claim that the Golan Heights belong to Israel, and stated the establishment of a Palestinian state is essential for stability.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-tunisia-arabs-summit/arab-leaders-grappling-regional-rifts-condemn-u-s-decision-on-golan-idUSKCN1RC060>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/03/arab-leaders-call-palestinian-state-condemn-golan-move-190331122623860.html>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/africa/arab-leaders-meet-in-tunisia-with-eye-on-trumps-golan-move/2019/03/31/c3b66466-5390-11e9-aa83-504f086bf5d6_story.html?utm_term=.25ca29cf269c>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-03-31-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Fourteen suspected communist rebels are killed in the Philippines. However, human rights groups dispute the claims by police forces stating those killed were farmers.

Source citations (as archived): [The Bangkok Post](<https://www.bangkokpost.com/news/asean/1654224/philippine-police-kill-14-men-rights-groups-say-were-farmers>); [Channel NewsAsia](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/14-farmers-killed-in-philippine-police-massacre-activists-11397608>).

<a id="event-2019-03-31-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three teenage migrants who partook in the hijacking of Elhiblu 1 are charged in Malta.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/03/31/world/europe/migrants-hijacking-ship-malta.html>).

<a id="event-2019-03-31-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** American rapper Nipsey Hussle is shot and killed outside a Los Angeles clothing store. Two other people with him were also shot and wounded.

Source citations (as archived): [Global News](<https://globalnews.ca/news/5116559/rapper-nipsey-hussle-shot-dead/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-03-31-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Ukrainian presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Ukraine go to the polls today in the first round of the presidential election. President Petro Poroshenko is seeking re-election, with comedian Volodymyr Zelensky and former Prime Minister Yulia Tymoshenko the primary challengers. All three have expressed largely pro-European views. Former Vice Prime Minister Yuriy Boyko is the front-runner among the pro-Russian candidates. A total of 39 candidates are on the ballot, increasing the probability no candidate will win more than 50 percent of the votes. If so, the top two will meet in a second round on 21 April.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-47763176>).

<a id="event-2019-03-31-3-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Slovak presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Anti-corruption candidate Zuzana Čaputová of the Progressive Slovakia party wins the second round of Slovakia's presidential election, defeating the governing party candidate Maroš Šefčovič, 58 percent versus 42%. She will be the country's first female head of state.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-47756368>).

<a id="event-2019-03-31-3-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Turkish local elections.

**Archived source account.** Voters head to the polls in Turkey to vote on metropolitan and district municipal mayors along with provincial and municipal councillors. The election is believed to be contested on challenging the current President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-47764393>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/03/economy-security-spotlight-turks-set-local-polls-190330150248508.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-03-31-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Elvis Luciano of the Toronto Blue Jays becomes the first person born in the 2000s to play in a Major League Baseball game.

Source citations (as archived): [MLB.com](<https://www.mlb.com/news/elvis-luciano-first-mlb-player-born-in-2000s>).


## April

### 2019-04-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087758981](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20April%201&oldid=1087758981>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-04-01-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Iran floods.

**Archived source account.** The Iranian government announces an emergency in southwestern provinces threatened by flooding and worked to evacuate dozens of villages as forecasters predicted more of the heavy rains that have killed at least 45 people last week.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-floods/iran-calls-emergency-in-flood-threatened-southwest-province-idUSKCN1RB0F3>).

<a id="event-2019-04-01-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The death toll from thunderstorms in southern Nepal rises to 30. Several houses are ruptured, trees uprooted and vehicles overturned in Bara district and Parsa district.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-47772482>).

<a id="event-2019-04-01-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thirty firefighters die in southwestern China after a forest fire trapped them due to a sudden shift in winds.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/04/01/world/asia/china-fire-sichuan.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-47772483>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-04-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** China announces that it will add fentanyl to a list of regulated narcotic drugs on May 1, 2019, in an effort to curtail its manufacturing.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-47772484>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/04/01/asia/china-us-fentanyl-trump-intl/index.html>); [Time](<http://time.com/5561887/china-regulate-fentanyl-drugs/>).

<a id="event-2019-04-01-1-2"></a>

Context: Aftermath of Cyclone Idai.

**Archived source account.** The first death due to cholera is confirmed in Mozambique, with confirmed cases rising to 517.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/cholera-outbreak-cyclone-mozambique-first-death-disease-spreads-fast/>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa/cyclone-idai-mozambique-cholera-death-beira-a8848971.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-04-01-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Turkish local elections, Erdoğanism.

**Archived source account.** In an election marred by electoral fraud, Turkey's ruling Justice and Development Party wins with 44% of the vote while Republican People's Party comes in second with 30% of the vote. Overall, People's Alliance gets 51% of the vote while Nation Alliance receives 37% of the vote. Voter turnout was 84%.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<http://secim.aa.com.tr/#en>).

<a id="event-2019-04-01-2-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Japanese imperial transition.

**Archived source account.** \{\{Nihongo\|\[\[Reiwa period\|Reiwa\]\]\|令和\}\} is revealed as the new Japanese Era name set to start on May 1 upon Crown Prince Naruhito's accession to the Chrysanthemum Throne as the 126th Emperor of Japan.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2019/04/01/national/politics-diplomacy/japan-readies-announce-name-new-era/>).

<a id="event-2019-04-01-2-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Guatemalan general election.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Electoral Tribunal accepts the nullity recourses against the candidacy of Thelma Aldana and temporarily leaves her out of the general elections. However, an appeal will be filed before the Supreme Court of Justice and ultimately, the Constitutional Court. All three top candidates face serious legal challenges that may prevent them from running.

Source citations (as archived): [Prensa Libre](<https://www.prensalibre.com/guatemala/politica/tse-rechaza-inscripcion-de-thelma-aldana/>); [Fox News](<https://www.foxnews.com/world/guatemala-election-court-puts-former-prosecutor-out-of-race>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/amp/news/2019/04/guatemala-top-presidential-contenders-face-expulsion-race-190402151350957.html>).

<a id="event-2019-04-01-2-7"></a>

Context: 2019 Algerian protests.

**Archived source account.** Algerian President Abdelaziz Bouteflika announces that he will resign by April 28, following intense pressure from the military and the ruling party to step down amid anti-government protests, bringing an end to his 20-year rule.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-algeria-protests-businessmen/algerias-bouteflika-to-resign-before-mandate-ends-april-28-state-media-idUSKCN1RD217>).

<a id="event-2019-04-01-2-9"></a>

Context: Brexit negotiations.

**Archived source account.** The British parliament votes against four alternative Brexit plans.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/brexit-monday-indicative-votes-1.5079353>).

<a id="event-2019-04-01-2-10"></a>

Context: Brexit negotiations.

**Archived source account.** Protesters strip naked in the public galleries of the House of Commons, pressing their buttocks against the window facing Ministers.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OVdl6lKxG-Q>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/apr/01/semi-naked-climate-protesters-disrupt-brexit-debate>).

<a id="event-2019-04-01-2-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** Michele Muratori and Nicola Selva are sworn in as Captains Regent of San Marino.

Source citations (as archived): [Corriere Romagna](<https://www.corriereromagna.it/news/san-marino/34819/ambiente-sociale-economia-e-turismo-il-programma-dei-capitani-reggenti-a-san-marino.html>).

### 2019-04-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087759262](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20April%202&oldid=1087759262>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-04-02-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Google starts deleting consumer accounts from its social network Google+ due to low user engagement and the discovery of security vulnerabilities which potentially exposed user data to developers.

Source citations (as archived): [The Verge](<https://www.theverge.com/2019/4/2/18290637/google-plus-shutdown-consumer-personal-account-delete>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-04-02-1-1"></a>

Context: Boeing 737 MAX groundings.

**Archived source account.** Boeing delays the availability of the software update for its 737 Max airliners. The Federal Aviation Administration anticipates the update to be rolled out "in the coming weeks."

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/business/boeing-faa-more-time-needed-737-max-fixes-1.5080823>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-04-02-2-1"></a>

Context: Russia–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** Russia opens a helicopter training facility in Venezuela. Under the plans, Russian state-owned Rostec will train Venezuelan pilots to operate Mi-35M gunships and transport helicopters. The move comes after the White House warned Moscow against sending troops or military equipment to the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics-russia/russia-says-it-has-opened-helicopter-training-center-in-venezuela-idUSKCN1RE1G3>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-04-02-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** According to a criminal complaint filed in a U.S. District Court, a Chinese woman is arrested and charged with making a false statement to the United States Secret Service after illegally entering U.S. President Donald Trump's Mar-a-Lago resort in Florida on 30 March 2019 while carrying multiple passports, four mobile phones and a thumb drive containing malware.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-47795513>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-intruder-idUSKCN1RE2HW>).

<a id="event-2019-04-02-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eric Holder (not to be confused with the former U.S. Attorney General of the same name) is arrested and charged with the murder of rapper Nipsey Hussle.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/nation/2019/04/02/police-name-nipsey-hussle-murder-suspect-after-stampede-breaks-out-memorial/?utm_term=.7865bd46c335>).

<a id="event-2019-04-02-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Peruvian authorities investigate the death of British De La Salle Brother Paul McAuley, age 71. According to the report he is burned to death in a home he founded for indigenous students in Iquitos, in the northeastern Amazonian region.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/a93ff0b209cd4d3285c753fbcdb6a653>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-04-02-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Algerian protests.

**Archived source account.** President Abdelaziz Bouteflika resigns amid pressure from the public and the military, having ruled the country since 1999.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-47795108>).

<a id="event-2019-04-02-4-3"></a>

Context: Brexit negotiations.

**Archived source account.** UK Prime Minister Theresa May gives a speech after seven hours of continuous meetings, saying that a further extension to the withdrawal from the European Union is needed, and asking for talks with Jeremy Corbyn.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-47794235>).

<a id="event-2019-04-02-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The chairman for the Republican Party in North Carolina, Robin Hayes, is charged with bribery and other corruption charges, along with Republican donor Greg Lindberg.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\!](<https://ca.news.yahoo.com/north-carolina-gop-chair-major-162449942.html>).

<a id="event-2019-04-02-4-6"></a>

Context: SNC-Lavalin affair.

**Archived source account.** Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau expels former ministers Jody Wilson-Raybould and Jane Philpott from the Liberal Party of Canada.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-47754193>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-canada-politics-expulsion/canadas-trudeau-expels-two-ex-ministers-from-ruling-party-in-bid-to-end-scandal-idUSKCN1RE2IY>).

<a id="event-2019-04-02-4-8"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Nicolás Maduro-aligned Constituent National Assembly formally strips opposition leader and National Assembly President Juan Guaidó of his immunity from prosecution, potentially paving the way for his arrest.

Source citations (as archived): [Brisbane Times](<https://www.brisbanetimes.com.au/world/south-america/venezuela-s-guaido-stripped-of-immunity-20190403-p51aap.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-04-02-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In American football, Tom Dundon, principal owner of the Alliance of American Football, announces that the league has suspended operations effective immediately, before the end of its first season.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://www.espn.com/espn/story/_/id/26423928/aaf-suspends-operations-polian-disappointed>).

### 2019-04-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1131728457](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20April%203&oldid=1131728457>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-04-03-0-1"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War, 2019 Western Libya Offensive.

**Archived source account.** The Libyan National Army (LNA) launches a surprise offensive in western Libya, moving units towards the Government of National Accord-held capital Tripoli, with reports of clashes in the city of Gharyan. The LNA say their operation, ordered by General Khalifa Haftar, is aimed at "cleansing the western zone from terrorist groups".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-libya-security/eastern-libya-forces-move-west-triggering-alert-in-tripoli-idUSKCN1RF1LQ?il=0>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/04/libyan-strongman-khalifa-haftar-orders-forces-advance-west-190403155045917.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-04-03-1-1"></a>

Context: Mueller special counsel investigation, Russian interference in the 2016 United States elections.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. House Committee on the Judiciary approves a subpoena to obtain, in its full and unredacted form, the final report written as part of special counsel Robert Mueller's recently concluded investigation into Russian meddling in the 2016 presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Post](<https://nypost.com/2019/04/03/house-panel-authorizes-subpoena-to-get-unredacted-mueller-report/?fbclid=IwAR36cSsP6Qn2SUPCmX-r_NBQpSVX0sbnAHWo66wCMj3Nt86YtlZdOWIDKlI>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-04-03-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Ukrainian presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Volodymyr Zelensky wins the first round of Ukraine's presidential election with 30 percent of the vote, with President Petro Poroshenko coming in second with 15 percent of the vote. Since no candidate reached the required number of votes to achieve the office of the presidency, a runoff election between the two candidates will be held on April 21. Voter turnout was 63 percent.

Source citations (as archived): [Ukrinform](<https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-elections/2673673-cec-counts-9999-of-ballots.html>); [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/Diaspora/Jewish-comedian-most-voted-in-first-Ukraine-presidential-election-round-585406?fbclid=IwAR3qZ0K33c_faad62-zYmtUyHYvR0V1PdMRZTNQNCjUwKbokdeNuFoZSYdA>).

<a id="event-2019-04-03-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** In an effort led by U.S. Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell, Senate Republicans vote 51-48 to approve new Senate rules to limit the in-session debate time for most of President Donald Trump's appointed political nominees to two hours instead of the previously required 30 hours. Senate Republicans invoke the so-called "nuclear option" to approve the new rules, a procedure that allows the Senate to amend rules with a simple majority of 51 votes, rather than the two-thirds supermajority normally required to do so.

Source citations (as archived): [Axios](<https://www.axios.com/senate-gop-nuclear-option-mcconnell-trump-nominees-b4ba06fb-0c23-434e-abc9-8597041b0df4.html>).

<a id="event-2019-04-03-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. House Committee on Ways and Means formally requests six years of President Donald Trump's personal and business tax returns from the Internal Revenue Service.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/house-democrats-treasury-trumps-tax-returns/story?id=62150855>).

<a id="event-2019-04-03-2-5"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. House of Representatives approves a resolution to end U.S. support for the Saudi Arabia-led coalition in the war in Yemen.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.com/story/2019/04/04/house-rebukes-trump-with-vote-ending-us-support-for-yemen-war-1255866>).

<a id="event-2019-04-03-2-7"></a>

Context: Brexit negotiations.

**Archived source account.** An indicative vote on holding more indicative votes for Brexit possibilities in the House of Commons achieves a vote of 310 Aye and 310 No, becoming the first British parliamentary vote to result in a draw in the 21st century; Speaker John Bercow breaks the tie by voting No.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/av/uk-politics-47802664/speaker-casts-deciding-vote-after-dead-heat>).

### 2019-04-04

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1131728494](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20April%204&oldid=1131728494>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-04-04-0-1"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War, 2019 Western Libya Offensive.

**Archived source account.** Libyan National Army forces continue to advance on the Libyan capital Tripoli, capturing the city of Gharyan, with only light resistance reported. General Khalifa Haftar has ordered the LNA to seize control of Tripoli, prompting the Tripoli-based Presidential Council to declare a general mobilization.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/apr/04/un-chief-urges-restraint-as-libyan-army-leader-plans-tripoli-assault>); [Middle East Monitor](<https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20190404-libya-declares-mobilization-to-face-haftars-forces/>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-04-04-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Belarusian authorities begin demolishing crosses with bulldozers at the Byelorussian Soviet Socialist Republic-era mass grave site Kurapaty on the outskirts of Minsk, where at least 30,000 people were executed by the NKVD's secret police in the 1930s and 1940s. The bulldozing is widely condemned in Belarus.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-47816897>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-04-04-2-1"></a>

Context: Boeing 737 MAX groundings, Ethiopian Airlines Flight 302.

**Archived source account.** The Ethiopian government releases a preliminary report on the investigation into the crash of Ethiopian Airlines Flight 302.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cbsnews.com/live-news/ethiopian-airlines-flight-302-crash-preliminary-report-today-live-updates-04-04-2019/>).

<a id="event-2019-04-04-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A rapidly spreading wildfire in Gangwon Province, South Korea, kills two people, injures 11 others, and forces the evacuation of thousands of civilians.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/south-korean-coastal-fire-kills-one-injures-11/2019/04/04/8538804c-56f7-11e9-aa83-504f086bf5d6_story.html?noredirect=on&amp;utm_term=.032a40dcb12b>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-04-04-3-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Christchurch mosque shootings, Internet censorship in Australia.

**Archived source account.** The Australian Parliament passes a law which makes it illegal for Internet platforms and service providers to host videos of "abhorrent violent conduct" without "expeditiously" removing them.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/media/2019/apr/04/australia-passes-social-media-law-penalising-platforms-for-violent-content>).

<a id="event-2019-04-04-3-3"></a>

Context: Cannabis in Guam.

**Archived source account.** Governor Lou Leon Guerrero signs a bill into law, legalizing the recreational use of cannabis.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/policy/healthcare/437440-guam-legalizes-marijuana>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-04-04-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** George Vella is sworn in as the new President of Malta succeeding Marie-Louise Coleiro Preca.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Malta](<https://www.timesofmalta.com/articles/view/20190404/local/george-vella-to-be-sworn-in-as-maltas-president-today.706420>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-04-05-0-1"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War, 2019 Western Libya Offensive.

**Archived source account.** Libyan National Army troops reach the outskirts of the Libyan capital Tripoli, securing a key military checkpoint known as "Bridge 27".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-libya-security-advance-idUSKCN1RH24V>); [The Economist](<https://www.economist.com/middle-east-and-africa/2019/04/05/khalifa-haftar-libyas-strongest-warlord-makes-a-push-for-tripoli>).

<a id="event-2019-04-05-0-3"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War, 2019 Western Libya Offensive.

**Archived source account.** LNA forces say they have seized control of Tripoli International Airport.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-libya-security/east-libyan-troops-close-on-tripoli-alarming-u-n-idUKKCN1RH0SK>).

<a id="event-2019-04-05-0-4"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War, 2019 Western Libya Offensive.

**Archived source account.** The United States, United Kingdom, France, and Italy issue a joint statement calling on Field Marshal Khalifa Haftar to end the offensive.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/2019/04/04/tensions-flare-in-libya-as-eastern-libyan-commander-orders-forces-to-move-on-tripoli>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-04-05-1-1"></a>

Context: Boeing 737 MAX groundings, Ethiopian Airlines Flight 302.

**Archived source account.** The CEO for Boeing, Dennis Muilenburg, apologizes for the loss of lives in the two 737 MAX accidents, recognizing the role that the MCAS system played in the disasters.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/2019/04/04/boeing-ceo-dennis-muilenburg-apologizes-lives-lost-ethiopian-indonesian-plane-crashes/>).

<a id="event-2019-04-05-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nineteen people are killed after a vehicle lost control, skidded and then overturned in Faskari, Katsina State, Nigeria.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-04/06/c_137955086.htm>).

<a id="event-2019-04-05-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thirteen people are killed and four others are injured after a freight vehicle overturned in Sidama Region, Ethiopia.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-04/06/c_137955515.htm>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-04-05-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reports the source of E. coli O103, that has infected 72 people in five states, has not been identified. Bill Marler, a food safety lawyer in Seattle, notes this O103 outbreak is by far the largest in recent memory.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/health/health-news/dozens-have-fallen-ill-during-a-five-state-e-coli-outbreak-and-nobody-knows-where-its-coming-from/ar-BBVFhpN?ocid=spartanntp>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-04-05-3-1"></a>

Context: Julian Assange's asylum at the Ecuadorian embassy, INA Papers.

**Archived source account.** WikiLeaks says that a high-level source within the government of Ecuador has informed them that Julian Assange will be expelled within "hours to days" and that Ecuador's government already has an agreement with the UK for his arrest. On April 2, 2019, Ecuadorian President Lenín Moreno accused WikiLeaks of leaking the INA Papers, a set of documents published in February 2019 which uncover the operations of INA Investment Corp, an offshore tax haven created by the brother of President Moreno and allegedly reveal government corruption.

Source citations (as archived): [WikiLeaks](<https://defend.wikileaks.org/2019/04/03/ecuador-twists-embarrassing-ina-papers-into-pretext-to-oust-assange/>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/04/wikileaks-founder-assange-expelled-ecuador-embassy-190405030521011.html>).

<a id="event-2019-04-05-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 29-year-old man is charged with five counts of attempted murder after stabbing five people in "random attacks", including four people in a 10-hour period on March 30, in Edmonton, London.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-london-47823157>).

<a id="event-2019-04-05-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** An inquest finds that Jennifer and Sarah Hart intentionally killed themselves. In 2018, a vehicle with the couple and their six adopted children drove off a cliff in California, killing all of them.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN.com](<https://www.msn.com/en-ca/news/world/inquest-finds-the-hart-parents-intentionally-killed-their-6-adopted-kids-and-themselves/ar-BBVEzk4?ocid=spartanntp>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-04-05-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A small 5-200 kilometer planetesimal, with a similar mineral composition to Earth, is found orbiting in the debris disk of a white dwarf star. This discovery is among the first of its kind and expected to provide insight into the future of our own planetary system.

Source citations (as archived): [Astronomy.com](<http://www.astronomy.com/news/2019/04/astronomers-discover-a-chunk-of-a-planets-core-around-dead-star>).

<a id="event-2019-04-05-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** JAXA space probe Hayabusa2 successfully fires a bullet at Apollo asteroid 162173 Ryugu, forming a crater which will be used to collect underground samples.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/2dd46c807e13486c9f658ec74776ce52>).

### 2019-04-07

Context: Second Libyan Civil War, 2019 Western Libya offensive.

<a id="event-2019-04-07-0-3"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War, 2019 Western Libya offensive.

**Archived source account.** Libyan Air Force jets loyal to Khalifa Haftar strike GNA positions in Tripoli for first time since the offensive began, including four airstrikes near the Bab al-Azizia military barracks.

<a id="event-2019-04-07-0-4"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War, 2019 Western Libya offensive.

**Archived source account.** Russia blocks a United Nations Security Council statement calling on Libyan Field Marshal Khalifa Haftar to immediately halt the Libyan National Army's offensive on Tripoli, because it wants the UN statement to also apply to pro-GNA forces, including Islamist militias from Misrata.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<https://www.scmp.com/news/world/middle-east/article/3005069/air-strikes-bombard-tripoli-eastern-libyan-forces-attempt>).

<a id="event-2019-04-07-0-5"></a>

<a id="event-2019-04-07-1-1"></a>

<a id="event-2019-04-07-2-1"></a>

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Second Libyan Civil War, 2019 Western Libya offensive.

<a id="event-2019-04-08-0-2"></a>
