<a id="event-2019-04-08-0-3"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War, 2019 Western Libya offensive.

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-04-08-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Nation\{\{'s\}\} editor Katrina vanden Heuvel announces that she will step down as editor after 24 years, on June 15, 2019.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/04/08/business/media/katrina-vanden-heuvel-the-nation.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-04-08-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nationwide protests against animal cruelty take place in Australia. In the city of Melbourne, protesters blocked a major intersection for four hours before it was dispatched by police; several people were arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [News.com.au](<https://www.news.com.au/lifestyle/food/animal-activists-hold-protests-around-the-country-on-one-year-anniversary-of-confronting-documentary/news-story/4bce0ca02fa6c71f000638f5bf0379c9>).

<a id="event-2019-04-08-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Department for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport in the United Kingdom releases a white paper proposing to set up an independent regulatory body which would require Internet companies to remove content and block websites considered harmful.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-47826946>).

<a id="event-2019-04-08-2-3"></a>

Context: 2019 college admissions bribery scandal.

**Archived source account.** American actress Felicity Huffman and 13 other defendants involved in a conspiracy regarding admission to prestigious colleges have agreed to plead guilty in the matter, prosecutors say. The 14 individuals are among 50 people accused of engaging in schemes that involved cheating on college entrance exams and paying $25 million in bribes to secure their children admission to well-known colleges.

Source citations (as archived): [WKZO](<https://wkzo.com/news/articles/2019/apr/08/felicity-huffman-others-to-plead-guilty-in-us-college-admissions-scandal-prosecutors/>).

<a id="event-2019-04-08-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. district judge Richard Seeborg halts the Trump administration’s policy of sending some asylum seekers to Mexico while their cases are pending in the United States. The national injunction will take effect Friday.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-immigration-asylum/u-s-judge-halts-trump-policy-of-returning-asylum-seekers-to-mexico-idUSKCN1RK2E6>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-04-08-3-2"></a>

Context: 2020 United States presidential election, 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries / Eric Swalwell 2020 presidential campaign.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Representative Eric Swalwell from California announces he is running for the Democratic Party's nomination to be President of the United States in the 2020 presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<https://www.foxnews.com/politics/rep-eric-swalwell-announces-2020-run-on-colberts-late-show>).

<a id="event-2019-04-08-3-4"></a>

Context: Trump administration dismissals and resignations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump terminates the employment of Randolph Alles, the Director of the United States Secret Service.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://amp.cnn.com/cnn/2019/04/08/politics/randolph-tex-alles-secret-service-director/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-04-08-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** United States Secretary of State Mike Pompeo announces the designation of the entirety of Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps as a Foreign Terrorist Organization (FTO), effective April 15. This will be the first time the United States has designated a part of another government as a terrorist organization.

Source citations (as archived): [United States Department of State](<https://www.state.gov/secretary/remarks/2019/04/290966.htm>); [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/trump-designates-irans-islamic-revolutionary-guard-corps-as-a-terrorist-organization/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-04-08-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** David Saint-Jacques becomes the fourth Canadian astronaut to take part in a spacewalk and the first in 12 years as he begins a roughly seven-hour mission.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hamilton Spectator](<https://www.thespec.com/news-story/9272303-astronaut-david-saint-jacques-first-canadian-to-perform-spacewalk-in-12-years/>); [CBC.ca](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/technology/david-saint-jacques-first-spacewalk-1.5088545>).

<a id="event-2019-04-08-4-2"></a>

Context: Gravitational wave observations.

Source citations (as archived): [New Scientist](<https://www.newscientist.com/article/2199107-ligo-has-spotted-another-gravitational-wave-just-after-turning-back-on/>).

Context: 2019 NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Tournament.

**Archived source account.** In basketball, the Virginia Cavaliers defeat the Texas Tech Red Raiders, 85–77 in overtime, to win their first national title.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-04-10-1-1"></a>

Context: Brexit negotiations.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom and European Union agree to delay Brexit until October 31, 2019. This means that the UK will participate in next month's European Parliament election.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-04-10-2-0"></a>

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-04-11-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Australian federal election.

<a id="event-2019-04-11-2-1"></a>

Context: Abortion in South Korea.

<a id="event-2019-04-11-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** WikiLeaks founder Julian Assange is arrested in London after Ecuador withdraws asylum. He is later found guilty of breaching bail in 2012 by a British court, however he faces likely extradition to the United States over allegations he conspired with former US military analyst Chelsea Manning to acquire classified U.S. government files.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/media/live/2019/apr/11/wikileaks-founder-julian-assange-arrested-at-the-ecuadorean-embassy-live-updates>).

<a id="event-2019-04-11-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police in Louisiana arrest Holden Matthews, a suspect in arson at three historically African-American churches in the past weeks which the NAACP flagged as hate crimes. Matthews is the son of a local deputy sheriff. He has ties to black metal music and commented on memes about musician Varg Vikernes, a neo-Nazi who boasted about burning churches in Norway and was imprisoned for arson and murder, but researchers are unsure if they prove hate was his motive.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/black-church-fires-louisiana-suspect-holden-matthews-charged/>); [Rolling Stone](<https://www.rollingstone.com/culture/culture-features/holden-matthews-varg-wikernes-norwegian-black-metal-lords-of-chaos-820995/>); [Daily Beast](<https://www.thedailybeast.com/holden-matthews-arrested-in-string-of-louisiana-church-fires>).

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2019-04-21-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Sri Lanka Easter bombings.

**Archived source account.** A series of explosions at churches and hotels in four cities in Sri Lanka, including the nation's commercial capital and largest city Colombo, kills at least 359 people and wounds around 500 others. ISIL has since claimed responsibility for the attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-48008073>).

<a id="event-2019-04-21-0-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Sri Lanka Easter bombings.

**Archived source account.** The Sri Lankan government temporarily blocks access to all social media platforms to stop the spread of "false media reports" about the attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2019/04/21/sri-lankan-government-blocks-social-media-imposes-curfew-following-deadly-blasts/>).

<a id="event-2019-04-21-0-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Sri Lanka Easter bombings.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo has stated that several United States citizens were killed in the attacks and Sri Lanka's Foreign Ministry officials have stated that at least five of the victims were of British nationality.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/asia/live-news/sri-lanka-easter-sunday-explosions-dle-intl/h_7cf075d83c893b55b334e94892ffb15c>).

<a id="event-2019-04-21-0-4"></a>

Context: 2019 Sri Lanka Easter bombings.

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis speaks words of solidarity to the Christian community of Sri Lanka, lamenting that the attacks have wrought grief and sorrow.

Source citations (as archived): [Vatican News](<https://www.vaticannews.va/en/pope/news/2019-04/pope-francis-laments-sri-lanka-attacks-on-easter.html>).

<a id="event-2019-04-21-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four attackers are killed in a failed attack on a police station in Zulfi, Saudi Arabia. The attackers had machine guns, bombs, and petrol bombs.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/04/killed-foiled-attack-saudi-police-station-reports-190421101113605.html>).

<a id="event-2019-04-21-0-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Suspected jihadist militants attack a Malian military base in the town of Guiré, Koulikoro Region, killing ten soldiers.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/mali-soldiers-killed-in-suspected-jihadist-attack/a-48422811>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-04-21-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** 28 people are killed and two others are missing after a landslide in the municipality of Rosas, in southwestern Colombia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-48021710>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-04-21-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Ukrainian presidential election.

**Archived source account.** According to exit polls, comedian Volodymyr Zelensky wins Ukraine's presidential run-off election over incumbent President Petro Poroshenko with more than 70 percent of the votes. Poroshenko concedes defeat.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ukraine-election/comedian-zelenskiy-wins-ukrainian-presidential-race-by-landslide-exit-poll-idUSKCN1RX01N>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48007487>); [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/ukraine-presidential-election-second-round-1.5105896>).

<a id="event-2019-04-21-2-3"></a>

Context: 2019 North Macedonian presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Macedonians go to the polls to elect the next President of North Macedonia in an election dominated by divisions over the Prespa agreement, which resolved the naming dispute between North Macedonia and Greece.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-north-macedonia-election/macedonians-vote-in-election-dominated-by-splits-over-name-change-idUSKCN1RX008>).

### 2019-04-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087766708](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20April%2022&oldid=1087766708>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-04-22-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Luzon earthquake.

**Archived source account.** Sixteen people are killed when a magnitude 6.1 earthquake strikes the municipalities of Porac and Lubao, Pampanga province, Philippines at 17:11 Philippine Standard Time.

Source citations (as archived): [The Manila Times](<https://www.manilatimes.net/16-dead-in-luzon-quake-ndrrmc/544291/>).

<a id="event-2019-04-22-0-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Luzon earthquake.

**Archived source account.** According to PHIVOLCS, the epicenter of the earthquake is located 18 km northeast of Castillejos, Zambales. PHIVOLCS originally records the earthquake, which is tectonic in origin, at magnitude 5.7, but later upgrades it to 6.1.

Source citations (as archived): [GMA News](<https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/scitech/weather/692003/magnitude-5-7-earthquake-jolts-zambales/story/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-04-22-1-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Representative for Massachusetts Seth Moulton announces he is running for the Democratic Party's nomination in the 2020 US presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/04/22/politics/seth-moulton-2020-campaign-announcement/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-04-22-1-3"></a>

Context: United States sanctions against Iran.

**Archived source account.** The United States demands that all countries cease purchasing oil from Iran by May 1 or face sanctions, in a move aimed at reducing Iran's income.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-iran-oil/u-s-to-end-all-waivers-on-imports-of-iranian-oil-crude-price-jumps-idUSKCN1RX0R1>).

### 2019-04-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087766808](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20April%2023&oldid=1087766808>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-04-23-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Sri Lanka Easter bombings.

**Archived source account.** ISIL claims responsibility for the bombings in Sri Lanka that took place on Easter Sunday.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/04/23/world/asia/sri-lanka-bombing.html>).

<a id="event-2019-04-23-0-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Sri Lanka Easter bombings.

**Archived source account.** Sri Lankan investigators believe that the bombings were revenge for attacks on New Zealand mosques in March.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-sri-lanka-blasts/sri-lanka-bomb-attacks-were-revenge-for-new-zealand-mosque-killings-minister-idUSKCN1RZ06M>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-04-23-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) certifies Alphabet Inc.-owned delivery drone service Wing to operate as an airline in the United States. Wing is the first delivery drone company to receive FAA air carrier certification.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://reuters.com/article/uk-usa-drone-alphabet/faa-paves-way-for-alphabet-unit-to-make-first-u-s-drone-deliveries-idUKKCN1RZ25R>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/04/23/716360818/faa-certifies-googles-wing-drone-delivery-company-to-operate-as-an-airline>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-04-23-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Visayas earthquake.

**Archived source account.** A magnitude 6.5 earthquake strikes the islands of Visayas in the Philippines at 13:37 Philippine Standard Time.

Source citations (as archived): [ABS-CBN News](<https://news.abs-cbn.com/news/04/23/19/62-magnitude-quake-hits-eastern-samar>).

<a id="event-2019-04-23-2-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Visayas earthquake.

**Archived source account.** According to PHIVOLCS, the epicenter of the earthquake is located 9 km northwest of San Julian, Eastern Samar. PHIVOLCS originally records the earthquake, which is tectonic in origin, at magnitude 6.2, but later upgrades it to 6.5.

Source citations (as archived): [The Philippine Star](<https://www.philstar.com/headlines/2019/04/23/1911918/phivolcs-upgrades-magnitude-65-quake-jolted-eastern-samar-town>).

<a id="event-2019-04-23-2-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Visayas earthquake.

**Archived source account.** The earthquake happened less than 24 hours after the 6.1 magnitude earthquake that struck Luzon.

Source citations (as archived): [ABS-CBN News](<https://news.abs-cbn.com/news/04/23/19/62-magnitude-quake-hits-eastern-samar>).

<a id="event-2019-04-23-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A mudslide at a jade mine in Hpakant, Kachin State, northern Myanmar caused by the collapse of a nearby lake kills three miners and leaves 51 missing.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/04/23/asia/myanmar-jade-mine-accident-intl/index.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-04-23-3-1"></a>

Context: North Korea–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Korean Central News Agency confirms North Korean leader Kim Jong-un will soon visit Russia for a summit with Russian President Vladimir Putin.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-russia/north-korea-confirms-leader-kim-jong-un-to-visit-russia-for-summit-with-putin-idUSKCN1RY1KT>).

<a id="event-2019-04-23-3-3"></a>

Context: Canada–Philippines relations.

**Archived source account.** Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte insists Canada remove tons of mislabeled, misdirected trash from Manila that arrived in 2013 and 2014. Duterte threatens to retaliate, up to declaring war, if the trash is not removed.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/04/24/716692612/philippines-duterte-talks-trash-literally-to-canada-threatening-war-over-garbage>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-04-23-4-1"></a>

Context: Murder of Karina Vetrano.

**Archived source account.** In the United States, Chanel Lewis is sentenced to life in prison without the possibility of parole for the 2016 murder of Karina Vetrano while she was running in Queens, New York City. The judge had earlier declined the defense's motion of a re-trial due to what they alleged to be police and juror misconduct.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC](<https://abcnews.go.com/US/queens-jogger-sentenced-life-prison/story?id=62573087>).

<a id="event-2019-04-23-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eight pedestrians in Sunnyvale, California, are injured when a car is intentionally driven into them. The driver is arrested after crashing into a tree. The FBI is assisting in the investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/eight-pedestrians-struck-car-suspected-intentional-crash-n997911>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-04-23-5-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Prince Edward Island general election and electoral reform referendum.

**Archived source account.** The Progressive Conservative Party of Prince Edward Island wins its first minority government since the Island's 1890 general election; while the Green Party of Prince Edward Island has beaten the Prince Edward Island Liberal Party by taking most of all their seats and becoming the province's new Official Opposition party, a first for any Green Party in North America. Voters also reject adopting mixed-member proportional representation as the province's election system in a referendum held simultaneously with the election.

Source citations (as archived): [The Epoch Times](<https://www.theepochtimes.com/voters-in-prince-edward-island-elect-tory-minority-amid-green-surge_2892527.html>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/apr/24/prince-edward-island-elevates-green-party-to-opposition-in-canadian-first>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.pe.ca/news/pei-election/no-side-pleased-with-status-quo-after-pei-electoral-reform-referendum-305151/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-04-23-6-1"></a>

Context: Exploration of Mars.

**Archived source account.** NASA reports the first detection of a likely Marsquake by the InSight Mars lander.

Source citations (as archived): [News18](<https://www.news18.com/news/buzz/marsquake-nasas-insight-lander-detects-first-seismic-event-on-the-red-planet-2114905.html>); [NASA](<https://www.nasa.gov/press-release/nasa-s-insight-lander-captures-audio-of-first-likely-quake-on-mars>).

### 2019-04-24

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087766921](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20April%2024&oldid=1087766921>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-04-24-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Floods and mudslides in the South African city of Durban and the wider KwaZulu-Natal province have killed at least 60 people.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-48036252>).

<a id="event-2019-04-24-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police evacuate 148 homes in Sokndal, Norway. Wildfires have burned through about 7.5 square kilometers (2.9 sq. miles) of land in the area. A spokesperson for the European Union Forest Fire Information System says wildfires in northern Europe "are way above the average" for this time of year.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48035682>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-04-24-1-1"></a>

Context: North Korea–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** North Korean leader Kim Jong-un arrives by train in Vladivostok, Russia, for his first talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin, expected to start Thursday.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-48032592>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-04-24-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Guatemalan general election.

**Archived source account.** A judge in Miami orders the arrest of Guatemalan presidential candidate Roberto Arzú. Arzú is the second presidential candidate who has had legal problems with the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Prensa Libre](<https://www.prensalibre.com/guatemala/justicia/roberto-arzu-tiene-orden-de-captura-en-miami/>).

<a id="event-2019-04-24-2-3"></a>

Context: Murder of James Byrd Jr..

**Archived source account.** John William King is executed by lethal injection by the state of Texas, 21 years after the murder of James Byrd Jr., for which he was sentenced.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-texas-execution/white-supremacist-executed-in-texas-for-dragging-death-of-black-man-idUSKCN1S01BY>).

<a id="event-2019-04-24-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Illinois Governor J. B. Pritzker is investigated federally for a property tax break that netted him $331,000 in tax relief by taking toilets out of a Chicago mansion he owns. Pritzker stated he has "no concerns" about the report.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/illinois-governor-no-concerns-about-report-of-fed-probe/2019/04/24/8930e834-66c8-11e9-a698-2a8f808c9cfb_story.html>); [Governing](<https://www.governing.com/topics/politics/tns-illinois-governor-tax-investigation.html>); [Washington Times](<https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2019/apr/24/jb-pritzker-faces-toilet-removal-tax-break-probe/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-04-24-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Asia Press reports that North Korean leader Kim Jong-un ordered the execution by firing squad of four foreign ministry officials following the failure of his February Hanoi summit with U.S. President Donald Trump, after accusing them of "selling information to the U.S." before the summit.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News](<https://news.yahoo.com/north-korea-executes-four-officials-failed-us-summit-report-claims-140135012.html>).

### 2019-04-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1104626599](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20April%2025&oldid=1104626599>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-04-25-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The parliament of Ukraine passes a language law in a vote of 278 to 38 that will secure the use of Ukrainian as the country's only official language.

Source citations (as archived): [RFE/RL](<https://www.rferl.org/a/parliament-in-kyiv-oks-bill-making-ukrainian-the-official-state-language/29903054.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-04-25-1-1"></a>

Context: Tornadoes of 2019.

**Archived source account.** Tornadoes spawned by severe weather in Texas and Louisiana cause at least five deaths and over 17,000 power outages.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2019/04/25/tornadoes-killer-storms-leave-death-destruction-texas-louisiana/3573446002/>); [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/severe-weather-texas-mississippi-louisiana-tornadoes-flooding-thunderstorms-2019-04-25/>).

<a id="event-2019-04-25-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** An ammonia leak in a Chicago suburb hospitalizes 37 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<http://time.com/5577991/chicago-ammonia-chemical-spill/>).

<a id="event-2019-04-25-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Texas semi truck driver with no criminal record is arrested and faces 4 counts of vehicular homicide after he told police his brakes were failing on I-70 as it descended from the mountains in Colorado and caused a 28 vehicle crash.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS Denver](<https://denver.cbslocal.com/2019/05/05/prosecutor-rogel-aguilera-mederos-showed-extreme-indifference-to-human-life/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-04-25-2-1"></a>

Context: War in Donbass, Russian military intervention in Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Russia announces it will fast-track citizenship applications from people living in conflict areas in eastern Ukraine. The European Union calls the move an attack on Ukraine's sovereignty that would undermine any peace agreement.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ukraine-crisis-russia-passports-putin/putin-nothing-wrong-with-us-giving-passports-to-east-ukraine-residents-idUSKCN1S112D>).

<a id="event-2019-04-25-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Washington Post reports that in June 2017 President Donald Trump secured the release of Otto Warmbier, a dying prisoner of North Korea, by agreeing to pay the regime in that country $2 million, described as a payment for hospital bills.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/report-north-korea-sought-2m-from-us-for-captured-american/2019/04/25/16fe5948-6792-11e9-a698-2a8f808c9cfb_story.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-04-25-3-1"></a>

Context: Abortion in the United States by state.

**Archived source account.** A federal district court in Washington State issues a preliminary injunction against enforcement of an initiative by the Donald Trump administration ("gag order") that would have restricted doctor-patient communications about abortion in family planning clinics that receive U.S. taxpayer funding.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-abortion/u-s-judge-blocks-new-trump-abortion-rule-for-health-clinics-idUSKCN1S12SC>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-04-25-4-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries.

**Archived source account.** Former Senator and Vice President Joe Biden announces he is running for the Democratic Party's nomination in the 2020 U.S. presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/04/25/us/politics/joe-biden-2020-announcement.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-04-25-5-1"></a>

Context: List of gravitational wave observations.

**Archived source account.** LIGO detects a second neutron star merger using its gravitational wave signal after the first such detection in August 2017.

Source citations (as archived): [Syracuse University](<https://news.syr.edu/blog/2019/04/25/ligo-livingston-detector-catches-binary-neuron-star-merger-says-physics-professor/>).

### 2019-04-26

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-04-26-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis meets with Milorad Dodik, head of the joint presidency of Bosnia-Herzegovina. They discuss bilateral relations, the presence of the Catholic community, coexistence and reconciliation, and the economic and social challenges facing Bosnia and Herzegovina.

**Archived source account.** A large methane explosion at a coal mine in the self-proclaimed Luhansk People's Republic in eastern Ukraine leaves 17 miners dead.

Source citations (as archived): [UrduPoint](<https://www.urdupoint.com/en/world/all-17-victims-recovered-from-collapsed-mine-607564.html>).

<a id="event-2019-04-26-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Miami native Todd Leininger is released from a Venezuelan prison after being detained for five years for allegedly aiding the opposition.

<a id="event-2019-04-26-3-0"></a>

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-04-26-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 NFL season.

**Archived source account.** The Kansas City Chiefs suspend wide receiver and return specialist Tyreek Hill from team activities for an alleged child abuse case.

Source citations (as archived): [Sporting News](<https://www.sportingnews.com/us/amp/nfl/news/chiefs-tyreek-hill-discusses-child-abuse-case-in-audio-recording/gdlw9e5zy7af1hxor0rbnhx3c>); [Houston Chronicle](<https://www.chron.com/sports/texans/amp/Chiefs-Tyreek-Hill-suspended-audio-child-abuse-13797839.php>).

### 2019-04-27

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-04-27-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The official video for Taylor Swift's "Me\!", which premiered Thursday night, breaks Vevo's record for the biggest debut of all time, with at least 56.9 million views in 24 hours.

Context: Seattle crane collapse.

**Archived source account.** A construction crane in the South Lake Union of Seattle collapses onto Mercer Street, killing four people.

Source citations (as archived): [The Seattle Times](<https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/fallen-crane-kills-four-in-south-lake-union-it-was-terrifying/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-04-27-2-1"></a>

Context: Poway synagogue shooting.

**Archived source account.** One person is killed and multiple people are wounded in a shooting that occurred at a synagogue in Poway, California.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/04/27/us/san-diego-synagogue/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-04-27-2-2"></a>

Context: Poway synagogue shooting.

**Archived source account.** John Earnest, a 19-year-old student at California State University, San Marcos, is arrested after Poway synagogue shooting.

Source citations (as archived): [VOA News](<https://www.voanews.com/a/us-college-student-arrested-california-synagogue/4894719.html>).

<a id="event-2019-04-27-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Oliver North steps down as president of the National Rifle Association as New York attorney general Letitia James opens an investigation against the NRA.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Insider](<https://www.businessinsider.com/oliver-north-resigned-nra-president-2019-4>); [Vox](<https://www.vox.com/policy-and-politics/2019/4/27/18519685/nra-ceo-accuses-president-extortion-wayne-lapierre-oliver-north>).

### 2019-04-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087768329](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20April%2028&oldid=1087768329>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-04-28-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six people are killed when terrorists storm a church in the Soum Province, Burkina Faso. The victims are the pastor, two of his sons and three other worshippers.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-48094789>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-04-28-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** 272 election workers in Indonesia die, mostly of fatigue-related illnesses, caused by long hours of work counting millions of ballot papers by hand. 1,878 other staff fall ill.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-48083051>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-04-28-2-1"></a>

Context: Crime in Tennessee.

**Archived source account.** Seven people are found dead in Sumner County, Tennessee. The suspect, Michael Cummins, is in police custody.

Source citations (as archived): [WFTS](<https://www.abcactionnews.com/news/national/6-people-found-dead-tennessee-suspect-in-custody>).

<a id="event-2019-04-28-2-3"></a>

Context: Crime in Ohio.

**Archived source account.** Four family members, three women and one man, were found shot to death in an apartment in West Chester Township, Ohio. The suspect remains at large.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/four-family-members-killed-ohio-apartment-n999621>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-04-28-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Spanish general election.

**Archived source account.** Spaniards go to the polls to elect all 350 members of the Congress of Deputies and 208 (of 266) seats in the Senate.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/04/27/europe/spain-elections-fragmentation-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-04-28-3-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Spanish general election.

**Archived source account.** The governing social democrat Spanish Socialist Workers' Party (PSOE) wins, but short of an absolute majority. The far-right Vox party finished fifth with 10% of the votes.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/spain-election-1.5114641>); [El País](<https://elpais.com/elpais/2019/04/28/inenglish/1556480286_209551.html>).

<a id="event-2019-04-28-3-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Spanish general election.

**Archived source account.** The Valencian regional election is held concurrently. The ruling left-wing alliance led by PSPV-PSOE wins a majority.

Source citations (as archived): [El Pais](<https://elpais.com/elpais/2019/04/30/inenglish/1556617031_230993.html>).

### 2019-04-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087768435](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20April%2029&oldid=1087768435>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-04-29-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A propaganda video featuring Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant leader Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi is released, in which he references the 2019 Sri Lanka Easter bombings, indicating that he is still alive and that the video was shot very recently. It is the first time he's been seen on video since July 2014, when he addressed a crowd at the now destroyed Great Mosque of al-Nuri in Mosul.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/asia/2019/04/isil-chief-abu-bakr-al-baghdadi-appears-propaganda-video-190429163448332.html>).

<a id="event-2019-04-29-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Hayat Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) militants assault several Syrian Army positions in the northern Aleppo Governorate, killing 17 soldiers and wounding 30 others. HTS say the attacks were in response to recent Syrian government and Russian airstrikes on rebel-held areas.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/04/17-syria-pro-regime-fighters-killed-rebel-attacks-190427160246489.html>).

<a id="event-2019-04-29-0-4"></a>

Context: Terrorism in the United States.

**Archived source account.** A US Army veteran was planning to bomb a white nationalist rally in retribution for the shooting in New Zealand. He was also planning attacks on Jews.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-48100431>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/04/29/politics/terror-plot-thwarted-la/index.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-04-29-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Avengers: Endgame breaks numerous box office records, including the biggest opening weekend in cinematic history, grossing over $1 billion worldwide.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/film/2019/apr/28/avengers-endgame-breaks-global-box-office-record-in-opening-weekend>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-04-29-2-1"></a>

Context: Cyclone Kenneth.

**Archived source account.** The death toll in cyclone-hit northern Mozambique has risen to 38, as aid workers struggle to reach the worst-affected areas. Seven people were also killed by the cyclone in Comoros.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-48096148>); [ReliefWeb](<https://reliefweb.int/report/comoros/comoros-humanitarian-situation-report-no-2-cyclone-kenneth>).

<a id="event-2019-04-29-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Floods sparked by torrential rains have killed 31 people in Indonesia while 13 others are missing.

Source citations (as archived): [Bangkok Post](<https://www.bangkokpost.com/news/asean/1669084/floods-in-indonesia-kill-31-dozen-missing>).

<a id="event-2019-04-29-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** North Carolina authorities have ordered evacuations covering a half-mile radius because of air quality, possibly including harmful sulfuric acid, from a massive fire at a metal recycling plant in Mooresboro. Officials say the blaze has been extinguished, as of 7:15 a.m.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-48095758>).

<a id="event-2019-04-29-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A minibus carrying Turkish Süper Lig Alanyaspor football players crashes near Alanya, Turkey, resulting in the death of Czech Republic national football team international Josef Šural, while several other players are seriously injured.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/football/2019/apr/29/josef-sural-czech-republic-killed-minibus-accident-alanyaspor-caulker-cisse>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-04-29-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Indonesian President Joko Widodo has decided to relocate the nation's capital from Jakarta, on the northwest coast of Java island. The new location and timing are not yet known. Jakarta, home to over 10 million people, is sinking at one of the fastest rates in the world; almost half of its area is below sea level.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-48093431>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/04/29/718234878/indonesia-plans-to-move-its-capital-out-of-jakarta-a-city-thats-sinking>).

<a id="event-2019-04-29-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. Deputy Attorney General Rod Rosenstein announces he will resign, effective May 11.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/rod-rosenstein-to-resign-effective-may-11/2019/04/29/1092851c-6ac5-11e9-8f44-e8d8bb1df986_story.html?utm_term=.d3cd6724a20b>).

### 2019-04-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1161110824](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20April%2030&oldid=1161110824>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-04-30-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Japanese imperial transition.

**Archived source account.** Emperor Akihito abdicates the Chrysanthemum Throne in favor of his elder son, Crown Prince Naruhito. He is the first Emperor to abdicate in over two hundred years, since Emperor Kōkaku in 1817.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2019/04/29/national/history/defining-heisei-era-just-peaceful-past-30-years/#.XMezhDjsaM8>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/04/29/world/asia/japan-emperor-women.html>).

<a id="event-2019-04-30-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Canadian ten-dollar note, featuring Canadian civil rights activist Viola Desmond, wins the International Bank Note Society award.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-48071926>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-04-30-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Blackstone Group, a multinational private equity and asset management firm, has agreed to buy Geo-Young, a wholesale drug distributor in South Korea, in a deal that will retain Geo-Young's CEO, Cho Sun-hae, in her leadership role.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-geoyoung-m-a-blackstone-group/blackstone-acquires-south-korean-pharma-wholesaler-geo-young-with-cos-founder-idUSKCN1S606Z>).

<a id="event-2019-04-30-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. Attorney General William Barr has decided to recuse himself from deliberations about whether the Antitrust Division of the U.S. Justice Department ought to challenge the planned merger of T-Mobile and Sprint, says a Reuters source "familiar with the decision". Barr is invested in both of the firms involved.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-sprint-corp-m-a-t-mobile-us/u-s-attorney-general-recuses-self-from-t-mobile-sprint-merger-probe-idUSKCN1S62EF>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-04-30-2-1"></a>

Context: Canada–China relations.

**Archived source account.** Fan Wei, a Canadian citizen in China, is sentenced to death following his conviction for producing and trafficking methamphetamine. Canada has requested clemency for Fan, who is the second Canadian citizen sentenced to death this year. The application of the death penalty was condemned by Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau. Foreign Minister Chrystia Freeland added, "Canada stands firmly opposed to the death penalty everywhere around the world."

Source citations (as archived): [National Post](<https://nationalpost.com/news/world/second-canadian-sentenced-to-death-in-china-for-drugs-offences>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-48104607>); [Toronto Star](<https://www.thestar.com/news/world/asia/2019/04/30/china-sentences-6-foreigners-for-drugs-canadian-gets-death.html>).

<a id="event-2019-04-30-2-3"></a>

Context: 2019 University of North Carolina at Charlotte shooting.

**Archived source account.** Six people are shot, two fatally, on the last day of classes at the University of North Carolina at Charlotte. The gunman was taken into custody after he ran out of ammunition.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/04/30/us/university-of-north-carolina-charlotte-shooting/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-04-30-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuela uprising, 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** Juan Guaidó, accompanied by members of the Venezuelan armed forces, speaks in front of La Carlota Air Base in Caracas, stating that Leopoldo López, a political prisoner since 2014, is freed by defecting soldiers who have renounced their loyalty to Nicolás Maduro, prompting people to take to the streets.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2019/apr/30/venezuela-opposition-leader-juan-guaido-claims-coup-underway-live-news>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/americas/live-news/juan-guaido-venezuela-operation-freedom-live-updates/index.html>); [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/live-news/venezuela-latest-juan-guaido-military-uprising-called-coup-attempt-by-president-nicolas-maduro/>).

<a id="event-2019-04-30-3-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuela uprising, 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** An armored car runs over supporters of Guaidó, escalating violence. At least 71 injured people, including two with gunshot wounds, were taken to Salud Chacao Medical Center in Caracas, according to the president of the center.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Daily News](<https://www.nydailynews.com/news/world/ny-juan-guaido-urges-military-to-overthrow-maduro-20190430-p5cushdl5remdoqwyouoouzrtu-story.html>); [Associated Press](<https://apnews.com/0153cace08c84c8fbf34f9c6a7bdd4dd>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics/venezuelas-guaido-says-troops-join-him-for-coup-government-says-it-is-firmly-in-control-idUSKCN1S60ZQ>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/americas/live-news/juan-guaido-venezuela-operation-freedom-live-updates/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-04-30-3-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuela uprising, 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** The European Union calls for "free and fair" elections in Venezuela to end the standoff.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2019/04/30/european-union-says-free-fair-elections-solution-venezuela-antonio-tajani-maduro-guaido/3631688002/>).

<a id="event-2019-04-30-3-4"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuela uprising, 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** Lopez and his family later seek refuge in Chile's diplomatic residence.

Source citations (as archived): [La Patilla](<http://www.lapatilla.com/2019/04/30/guaido-le-habla-a-venezuela-desde-la-base-aerea-la-carlota-video/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics/venezuelas-guaido-calls-for-uprising-but-military-remains-loyal-to-maduro-for-now-idUSKCN1S60ZQ?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-04-30-3-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuela uprising, 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** Reuters reports that an uneasy peace returned by the afternoon. There do not appear to be any immediate attempts by the opposition to take power through force, and there are no reports of defections from the armed forces leadership.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics/venezuelas-guaido-calls-for-uprising-but-military-remains-loyal-to-maduro-for-now-idUSKCN1S60ZQ?il=0>).


## May

### 2019-05-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1157929045](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20May%201&oldid=1157929045>).

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2019-05-01-0-1"></a>

Context: Naxalite–Maoist insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Sixteen soldiers, including a driver, are killed in a landmine explosion in the Gadchiroli district of Maharashtra, India. Maoist insurgents are currently active in the area, leading officials to believe them to be responsible.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/05/01/india/india-attack-maharashtra-intl/index.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-05-01-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Japanese imperial transition.

**Archived source account.** The Japanese Era \{\{Nihongo\|\[\[Reiwa\]\]\|令和\}\} begins as Emperor Naruhito accedes to the Chrysanthemum Throne as the 126th Emperor of Japan. The Emperor inherits two of the Three Sacred Treasures of Japan during a symbolic ceremony, which formalises his ascension.

Source citations (as archived): [The Mainichi](<https://mainichi.jp/english/articles/20190430/p2a/00m/0na/023000c>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-48101637>).

<a id="event-2019-05-01-1-3"></a>

Context: Monarchy of Thailand.

**Archived source account.** Vajiralongkorn, King of Thailand, marries his head of security and mistress, General Suthida Tidjai, days before his coronation.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-thailand-king/thai-king-names-his-consort-queen-days-before-coronation-idUSKCN1S73TQ>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-05-01-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** WikiLeaks founder Julian Assange is sentenced to 50 weeks in prison by a judge in the United Kingdom for breaching bail in 2012. Assange still faces possible extradition to the United States on charges of conspiracy to commit computer intrusion.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/05/01/718945707/british-judge-sentences-julian-assange-to-50-weeks-in-prison>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/media/2019/may/01/julian-assange-jailed-for-50-weeks-for-breaching-bail-in-2012>).

<a id="event-2019-05-01-2-2"></a>

Context: Internet censorship in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russian President Vladimir Putin signs the Internet Sovereignty Bill into law. The bill has drawn fierce criticism from civil society groups over fears that it would lead Russia to establish an isolated internet landscape.

Source citations (as archived): [The Moscow Times](<https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2019/05/01/putin-signs-internet-isolation-bill-into-law-a65461>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-05-01-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Fiona Onasanya, the member of the UK Parliament for Peterborough, is removed from her position following a successful recall petition in the wake of her conviction for perverting the course of justice, becoming the first MP in the country's history to lose their seat in this manner. A by-election will be called to elect a replacement MP.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-cambridgeshire-48123355>).

<a id="event-2019-05-01-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** British Prime Minister Theresa May fires Gavin Williamson as Secretary of State for Defence, following the leaking of information relating to a National Security Council meeting, regarding the security risk posed by Chinese multinational telecommunications company Huawei. Secretary of State for International Development Penny Mordaunt is appointed the first-ever female British Defence Secretary.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2019/may/01/gavin-williamson-sacked-as-defence-secretary-over-huawei-leak>); [Evening Standard](<https://www.standard.co.uk/news/politics/penny-mordaunt-appointed-as-first-ever-female-defence-secretary-after-gavin-williamson-sacked-from-a4131876.html>).

<a id="event-2019-05-01-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The UK Parliament declares "an environment and climate emergency."

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://amp.cnn.com/cnn/2019/05/01/europe/uk-climate-emergency-scn-intl/index.html>).

### 2019-05-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087781826](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20May%202&oldid=1087781826>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-05-02-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019 North Indian Ocean cyclone season.

**Archived source account.** Evacuation of approximately 800,000 people is underway as Extremely Severe Cyclonic Storm Fani heads toward the Indian state of Odisha (formerly Orissa) and is expected to make landfall Friday with wind speeds in excess of 200 km/h (127 mph).

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-48121606>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-05-02-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019 measles outbreak.

**Archived source account.** The Freewinds cruise ship is quarantined in Saint Lucia over concerns of a measles epidemic after it is reported that one of the passengers has the disease. The cruise ship is reportedly owned by the Church of Scientology, a religious organization that opposes vaccinations against diseases such as measles.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/05/02/health/st-lucia-measles-cruise-ship-quarantine/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-05-02-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Insys Therapeutics founder John Kapoor is found guilty of racketeering in an opioid-related bribery scheme.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-48143094>).

<a id="event-2019-05-02-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Myanmar security forces fire into a crowd of 275 Rakhine people detained during a search for Arakan Army members, killing six and wounding eight. The military claim that they were forced to shoot after some of the detainees attempted to seize their weapons, despite warning shots and verbal warnings.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-rakhine/myanmar-troops-kill-six-detain-scores-in-rakhine-over-suspected-rebel-links-military-spokesman-idUSKCN1S80R2>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-05-02-3-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Senator Michael Bennet from Colorado announces he is running for the Democratic Party's nomination to be President of the United States in the 2020 presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/05/02/us/michael-bennet-president-2020.html>).

<a id="event-2019-05-02-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Catherine Pugh, Mayor of Baltimore, resigns under investigation for alleged financial improprieties. Baltimore City Council president Jack Young has been serving as acting mayor since April 2.

Source citations (as archived): [Baltimore Sun](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/baltimore-mayor-pugh-resigns-after-month-on-leave-amid-investigation-into-her-business-deals/ar-AAANQQV>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/05/02/717660592/baltimore-mayor-catherine-pugh-resigns-in-wake-of-childrens-book-scandal>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-05-02-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Facebook and Instagram ban political figures Alex Jones, Nation of Islam leader Louis Farrakhan, Milo Yiannopoulos, Paul Joseph Watson, Paul Nehlen, David Duke and Laura Loomer, from their platforms and remove their pages for allegedly engaging in "violence and hate".

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/05/02/tech/facebook-ban-louis-farrakhan-infowars-alex-jones-milo-laura-loomer/index.html>); [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/tech/tech-news/facebook-bans-alex-jones-louis-farrakhan-others-facebook-instagram-n1001311>); [JTA](<https://www.jta.org/quick-reads/facebook-is-finally-banning-anti-semites-like-david-duke-louis-farrakhan-and-alex-jones>).

### 2019-05-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087781917](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20May%203&oldid=1087781917>).

#### Business and finance

<a id="event-2019-05-03-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sinclair Broadcast Group buys Fox Sports Networks (FSN) from The Walt Disney Company for $10.6 billion. Disney was ordered by the U.S. Justice Department to sell FSN as part of its purchase of 21st Century Fox last year due antitrust concerns over its ownership of ESPN Inc.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/05/03/business/media/sinclair-disney-regional-sports-networks.html>).

<a id="event-2019-05-03-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Documents filed in a United States bankruptcy court indicate that the bankrupt utility company Pacific Gas &amp; Electric has not been able to reach a settlement with its creditors over billions of dollars it owes under power purchase contracts. PG&amp;E wants the issue settled by the bankruptcy court rather than by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pg-e-us-renewables/pge-unable-to-strike-deal-over-renewable-power-contracts-court-documents-idUSKCN1S91W6>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-05-03-1-1"></a>

Context: Mississippi River floods.

**Archived source account.** Alton, Illinois, builds a barrier wall as the Mississippi River rises to levels not seen since the historic 1993 floods.

Source citations (as archived): [Chicago Tribune](<https://www.chicagotribune.com/news/nationworld/midwest/ct-spring-flooding-illinois-mississippi-river-20190503-story.html>).

<a id="event-2019-05-03-1-2"></a>

Context: Mississippi River floods.

**Archived source account.** The Mississippi River rises to its highest level since the 1993 floods at the Quad Cities in Illinois and Iowa.

Source citations (as archived): [Chicago Tribune](<https://www.chicagotribune.com/news/nationworld/midwest/ct-spring-flooding-mississippi-river-1993-levels-20190502-story.html>).

<a id="event-2019-05-03-1-3"></a>

Context: Mississippi River floods.

**Archived source account.** Flooding from Michigan to the south damages homes and sends the Mississippi River to a 157-year high in Davenport, Iowa.

Source citations (as archived): [Weather Channel](<https://weather.com/news/news/2019-05-03-flooding-mississippi-river-michigan-mississippi-davenport>).

<a id="event-2019-05-03-1-5"></a>

Context: 2019 North Indian Ocean cyclone season.

**Archived source account.** Cyclone Fani, an extremely severe category 4 storm and one of the strongest in recent years, makes landfall at the coastal town of Puri in the Indian state of Odisha. Eight people have been killed in India, according to the Press Trust of India, and hundreds more injured. Severe damage and flooding has been reported. One million Indians and 2.1 million Bangladeshis have been evacuated. A storm surge possibly up to 1.5m (5ft) is expected. The storm, weakening as it travels northeast through India, is expected to reach Chittagong in Bangladesh Saturday.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-india-cyclone/cyclone-slams-into-indian-temple-town-bangladesh-braces-with-evacuation-order-idUSKCN1S905P>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-48153413>).

<a id="event-2019-05-03-1-7"></a>

Context: Miami Air Flight 293.

**Archived source account.** A Boeing 737 arriving at Naval Air Station Jacksonville in Florida slides off the runway into the St. Johns River. All on board survive.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/05/03/us/jacksonville-commercial-plane-river/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-05-03-2-1"></a>

Context: Tax returns of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The California Senate passes a bill that would keep Donald Trump out of the 2020 presidential primaries until he releases his tax returns.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/homenews/state-watch/441908-california-senate-passes-bill-that-would-keep-trump-off-2020-ballot>); [Associated Press](<https://www.apnews.com/880e9ce35f884f059eecb2b68c8997a0>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-05-03-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 NBA playoffs.

**Archived source account.** The Portland Trail Blazers defeat the Denver Nuggets 140-137 in quadruple overtime, making the game the first quadruple overtime game in the playoffs since 1953.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://amp.theguardian.com/sport/2019/may/03/portland-denver-four-overtimes-nba-playoffs>); [Vladtv](<https://www.vladtv.com/article/254551/blazers-beat-the-nuggets-in-quadruple-overtime-1st-4ot-game-since-1953>).

### 2019-05-04

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087782006](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20May%204&oldid=1087782006>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-05-04-0-1"></a>

Context: Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant in Libya during the Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** An attack on forces loyal to Field Marshal Khalifa Haftar in Sabha, Libya, kills at least nine people. ISIL claims responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/nine-dead-in-is-attack-on-haftar-forces-in-south-libya/articleshow/69178531.cms>).

<a id="event-2019-05-04-0-3"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** North Korea fires several short-range projectiles from the east coast city of Wonsan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters/AP](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2019-05-04/north-korea-fires-short-range-missile/11080184>).

<a id="event-2019-05-04-0-5"></a>

Context: Gaza–Israel clashes (May 2019).

**Archived source account.** The Israeli Air Force carries out dozens of airstrikes on the Gaza Strip in response to a barrage of rockets fired by Hamas militants. The Turkish state-owned Anadolu Agency's media office in Gaza was among those hit by Israeli missiles, prompting outrage from Turkish officials.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/israel-hits-offices-of-turkish-state-news-agency-in-gaza/a-48604155>).

<a id="event-2019-05-04-0-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four Turkish soldiers were killed in an attack on their base in Iraq by Kurdish forces. Twenty PKK members were also killed in the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-security-soldiers/four-turkish-soldiers-killed-in-clashes-with-pkk-ministry-idUSKCN1RW07B>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-05-04-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Vajiralongkorn, King of Thailand since 2016, is officially crowned sovereign. His wife Suthida Tidjai, who he had married only three days prior, is declared Queen consort.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://washingtonpost.com/world/2019/05/05/dressed-gold-new-thai-king-has-procession-through-bangkok-second-day-coronation-ceremonies/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-05-04-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 North Indian Ocean cyclone season.

**Archived source account.** Cyclone Fani starts affecting Bangladesh, where over a million people have been evacuated from the storm's path. Authorities say the cyclone has killed at least five people in Bangladesh and damaged over a thousand homes. At least twelve people have been killed in total by the cyclone.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-india-cyclone/cyclone-hits-bangladesh-after-battering-india-mass-evacuations-save-lives-idUSKCN1SA05Y>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-05-04-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Interstellar Technologies successfully launches uncrewed rocket MOMO-3 from its launch facility in Taiki, Hokkaido, becoming the first commercially developed Japanese rocket to reach the Kármán line.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/japanese-private-firm-sends-first-rocket-into-space/a-48600093>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2019-05-04-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Kentucky Derby.

**Archived source account.** In horse racing, Country House wins the 145th Kentucky Derby after Maximum Security is disqualified. The latter horse is the first Kentucky Derby winner ever to have been disqualified for interference.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS Sports](<https://www.cbssports.com/general/news/kentucky-derby-2019-results-live-updates-as-maximum-security-wins-the-145th-run-for-the-roses/>).

### 2019-05-05

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2019-05-05-0-1"></a>

Context: Gaza–Israel clashes (May 2019), Iran–Israel proxy conflict.

**Archived source account.** Hamas and other militant groups in the Gaza Strip fire hundreds of rockets at Israel, killing two Israeli civilians in Ashkelon and one in Ashdod. Retaliatory Israeli strikes on Gaza kill at least 23 Palestinians, including a senior Hamas commander.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/05/05/middleeast/israel-airstrikes-gaza-rockets-intl/index.html>); [Haartez](<https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/430-gaza-rockets-fired-at-israel-one-israeli-dead-six-palestinians-said-killed-1.7199036>).

<a id="event-2019-05-05-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Taliban insurgents kill 13 and injure 55 people in an attack on a police headquarters in Puli Khumri, Afghanistan, using guns and suicide vests. The Taliban's high command recently rejected a ceasefire offer from the Afghan government.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-48169104>).

<a id="event-2019-05-05-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States deploys a carrier strike group and a bomber task force to the Middle East to respond to threats from Iran. A U.S. official told CNN, "... the threats were against both U.S. maritime and land-based forces in the region."

<a id="event-2019-05-05-1-1"></a>

Context: Aeroflot Flight 1492.

**Archived source account.** At least 41 passengers are killed after Sukhoi Superjet 100 (flight SU1492), which suffered an inflight fire, is engulfed by fire after an emergency crash landing at Sheremetyevo International Airport, Moscow, Russia. A five-person crew and 73 passengers were on board.

Source citations (as archived): [Aviation 24](<https://www.aviation24.be/airlines/aeroflot/sukhoi-superjet-makes-emergency-landing-at-moscow-sheremetyevo-after-a-fire-on-board/>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48171392>).

<a id="event-2019-05-05-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Seven Venezuelan military officers are killed in a helicopter crash.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.apnews.com/056d93e06fc146048be64fa0272bb5aa>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-05-05-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis, United States–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** The President of the National Assembly of Venezuela Juan Guaidó tells the BBC he is considering formally requesting the United States to launch a military intervention to topple President Nicolás Maduro. Guaidó led a failed uprising against Maduro last month.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-48172520?ocid=socialflow_twitter>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-05-05-3-1"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Brunei.

**Archived source account.** Brunei's Sultan Hassanal Bolkiah announces, via a television broadcast, that he has extended the moratorium on capital punishment for gay sex convictions. No executions have been carried out in Brunei since 1957. There has been overwhelming international backlash against a number of the changes affected by the stricter interpretation of Islamic law published on 3 April 2019. The Sultan also said Brunei will ratify the United Nations Convention against Torture.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-48171165>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/05/05/asia/brunei-lgbt-death-penalty-intl/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-05-05-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 North Macedonian presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Voters in North Macedonia head to the polls for the second round of the 2019 presidential election. Stevo Pendarovski of the Social Democratic Union of Macedonia wins over his opponent Gordana Siljanovska-Davkova.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-north-macedonia-election/north-macedonias-pro-western-candidate-wins-presidential-vote-idUSKCN1SA0SO>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/05/05/world/europe/north-macedonia-election.html>).

<a id="event-2019-05-05-4-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Panamanian general election.

**Archived source account.** Laurentino Cortizo of the center-left Democratic Revolutionary Party defeats Rómulo Roux of the center-right Democratic Change party in a narrow election to become the next president of Panama. Cortizo receives 33% of the vote to Roux's 31%, marking the return of the Democratic Revolutionary Party after 10 years out of the presidency.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-48174497>).

The current negotiations for a new deal between the two countries, originally planned for Wednesday, are now in question. U.S. stock futures fell sharply as well.
