Context: North Korea–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** For the first time the United States seizes a North Korean merchant ship loaded with coal in the East China Sea sailing toward Indonesia. The ship is suspected of violating sanctions.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/wireStory/us-seizes-large-north-korean-ship-transport-coal-62936387>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/05/09/politics/us-north-korean-cargo-ship-sanctions/index.html>); [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/justice-department/u-s-seeks-seize-north-korean-ship-suspected-violating-u-n1003811>).

<a id="event-2019-05-09-0-5"></a>

Context: International military intervention against ISIL.

**Archived source account.** A blast hits Baghdad's northeastern Sadr City district. ISIL claims responsibility. No verified report on casualties is presently available.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-security-blast/blast-rocks-baghdad-marketplace-differing-accounts-on-casualties-idUSKCN1SF2AK?il=0>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-05-09-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Reserve Bank of Australia confirms it issued approximately 46 million new Australian $50 notes in late 2018 with a typo in the background fine print: "responsibility" is misspelled as "responsibilty", the third "i" is missing. The mistake appears three times on the note and is extremely small requiring magnification to see. Part of the rollout of Australia's redesigned currency, the A$50 notes feature the first female member of an Australian parliament, social reformer Edith Cowan.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-48210733>); [The Age](<https://www.theage.com.au/business/the-economy/oops-typo-for-the-ages-printed-on-46-million-new-50-notes-20190509-p51ljw.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-05-09-2-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations states that at least 65 people are dead after a boat sinks off the coast of Tunisia while carrying migrants from Libya to Europe.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters/ABC News Australia](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2019-05-11/dozens-of-migrants-drown-off-tunisia-coast-after-leaving-libya/11103846>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-05-09-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Argentine congressman Héctor Enrique Olivares of the UCR party is shot by two assailants and is in critical condition. One of his advisers dies as a result of the gunshots.

Source citations (as archived): [Infobae](<https://www.infobae.com/sociedad/policiales/2019/05/09/olivares-fue-baleado-desde-un-auto-gris-y-no-le-robaron-nada-revelan-las-camaras-de-seguridad/>); [Buenos Aires Times](<http://www.batimes.com.ar/news/argentina/gunmen-shoot-hector-olivares-outside-congress-building-kills-another-man.phtml>).

<a id="event-2019-05-09-3-2"></a>

Context: Operation Car Wash.

**Archived source account.** Former Brazilian President Michel Temer surrenders to the federal police in response to Wednesday's arrest warrant regarding an investigation into an alleged corruption scheme involving an Eletrobras nuclear power plant. Temer's lawyer's appeal will be heard on Tuesday.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-corruption-temer/former-brazil-president-temer-surrenders-following-new-arrest-warrant-idUSKCN1SF298?il=0>); [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20190509-brazil-court-orders-ex-president-temer-back-jail-corruption>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-05-09-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States House of Representatives votes to overturn President Donald Trump’s move on the Affordable Care Act.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/homenews/house/443036-house-votes-to-overturn-trump-obamacare-move>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-05-09-5-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** SEBIN agents detain Juan Guaidó's deputy Edgar Zambrano, the Vice President of the opposition-held National Assembly, and are reported to have taken him to El Helicoide prison. He is the most high profile opposition politician arrested since the presidential crisis began in January.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-48210625>); [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/vice-president-of-venezuelan-congress-detained/a-48667988>).

<a id="event-2019-05-09-5-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** Colleague Richard Blanco of the Brave Peoples’ Alliance party seeks refuge in Argentina's embassy in Caracas, Venezuela, following Zambrano's arrest.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics/venezuela-lawmaker-seeks-refuge-in-argentine-embassy-after-colleagues-arrest-idUSKCN1SF1YK>).

<a id="event-2019-05-09-5-4"></a>

Context: Montenegrin coup plot.

**Archived source account.** Russian officials are sentenced for a 2016 coup attempt in Montenegro.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/may/09/montenegro-convicts-pro-russia-politicians-of-coup-plot>).

### 2019-05-10

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1127423864](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20May%2010&oldid=1127423864>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-05-10-0-1"></a>

Context: Insurgency in the Maghreb (2002–present).

**Archived source account.** Four hostages, who were being held in northern Burkina Faso, are rescued by French naval commandos, with two French commandos killed during the rescue operation. Those freed include two Frenchmen who had been kidnapped in Benin on May 1 and a pair of women, one an American and the other a South Korean.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-48228353>).

<a id="event-2019-05-10-0-3"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** About 900 children are released from the Civilian Joint Task Force, a militia formed in Nigeria to counter Boko Haram.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/05/10/africa/boko-haram-children-freed-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-05-10-0-5"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Balochistan.

**Archived source account.** Suspected Baloch nationalist gunmen storm a coal mine in Islamabad, Pakistan, killing at least five people.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/05/pakistan-dead-baloch-separatist-gunmen-attack-coal-190510073131883.html>).

<a id="event-2019-05-10-0-7"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** One day after peace talks between the Taliban and the United States ended with no resolution, Taliban militants attack government outposts in northwestern Afghanistan, killing at least twelve Afghan soldiers.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/05/10/world/asia/afghanistan-taliban-attack.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-05-10-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Uber makes its initial public offering on the New York Stock Exchange, starting by selling stocks at $42 and closing at $41.60. Uber's market cap drops from over $80 billion to about $72 billion.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! Finance](<https://finance.yahoo.com/news/uber-ipo-to-begin-trading-on-nyse-135445721.html>); [BuzzFeed News](<https://www.buzzfeednews.com/article/alexkantrowitz/uber-goes-public-ipo>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-05-10-2-1"></a>

Context: China–United States trade war, China–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States increases tariffs from 10% to 25% on $200 billion worth of imports from China after no deal materialized prior to the midnight deadline.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2019/05/10/china-trade-us-tariffs-jump-but-trade-war-talks-to-continue.html>); [The Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/u-s-to-move-forward-with-china-tariffs-trump-says-11557424081>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-48210313>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-05-10-3-1"></a>

Context: Mueller special counsel investigation, Crossfire Hurricane (FBI investigation).

**Archived source account.** Republicans Senate Homeland Security Committee Chairman Ron Johnson and Senate Finance Committee Chairman Chuck Grassley request documents related to Christopher Steele, author of the Trump–Russia dossier, in a letter to United States Secretary of State Mike Pompeo and the FBI Director Christopher Wray.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/senators-request-documents-related-to-christopher-steele-author-of-trump-dossier/>).

<a id="event-2019-05-10-3-3"></a>

Context: Tax returns of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The United States House Committee on Ways and Means subpoenas United States Secretary of the Treasury Steven Mnuchin and Commissioner of Internal Revenue Charles Rettig to provide President Donald Trump's federal tax returns for the last six years.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/05/10/us/politics/trump-tax-returns-subpoena.html>).

### 2019-05-11

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1213669879](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20May%2011&oldid=1213669879>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-05-11-0-1"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** Houthi forces begin to withdraw from several Yemeni ports, including Al Hudaydah, As-Salif and Ras Isa. The withdrawal is part of a UN-brokered ceasefire deal that aims to end the blockade of Yemen.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/yemens-houthis-withdraw-from-hodeida-and-other-ports/a-48694915>).

<a id="event-2019-05-11-0-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Pearl Continental Hotel attack.

**Archived source account.** In Gwadar, three insurgents attack a luxury hotel, as a result of the attack, four hotel employees, a soldier and all three attackers have been killed. The Baloch Liberation Army, an ethnic Baloch separatist group fighting for independence for Balochistan province, claimed responsibility for the attack saying that four fighters were involved.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-48245353>).

<a id="event-2019-05-11-0-5"></a>

Context: North Korea–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** A North Korean merchant ship loaded with coal, seized by the United States in the East China Sea for suspected sanctions violation, arrives in Pago Pago, American Samoa.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<https://www.apnews.com/04b6e91f993f43afb48ac1634b593830>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-05-11-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Efforts begin in Solomon Islands to refloat a ship after an oil spill in what the government says will be a "very difficult operation."

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand](<https://www.radionz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/388941/solomon-islands-to-refloat-ship-after-oil-spill>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-05-11-2-1"></a>

Context: Harvey Weinstein sexual abuse allegations.

**Archived source account.** Harvard announces that they will not renew law professor Ronald S. Sullivan Jr.'s appointment as dean of Winthrop House after he joined the defense of Harvey Weinstein. He remains a regular professor.

Source citations (as archived): [Boston CBS](<https://boston.cbslocal.com/2019/05/11/harvard-weinstein-lawyer-ronald-sullivanstudent-house-dean/amp/>); [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2019/05/11/us/11reuters-usa-harvard-weinstein.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-05-11-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** David W. Panuelo is sworn in as President of the Federated States of Micronesia, succeeding Peter M. Christian, after being elected by the Congress.

Source citations (as archived): [Fiji Times](<https://www.fijitimes.com/fsm-congress-elects-h-e-david-w-panuelo-president-of-the-federated-states-of-micronesia/>).

### 2019-05-12

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087785287](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20May%2012&oldid=1087785287>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-05-12-0-1"></a>

Context: Insurgency in the Maghreb (2002–present).

**Archived source account.** Gunmen burn down a Catholic church during mass and kill six people, including a priest, in Dablo, Burkina Faso.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-48246715>).

<a id="event-2019-05-12-0-3"></a>

Context: Gulf of Oman incident, Iran–United States relations, Iran–Saudi Arabia relations.

**Archived source account.** The United Arab Emirates reports four commercial vessels were subject to "sabotage operations" just outside its territorial waters in the Gulf of Oman and two of the vessels suffer "significant damage" to their structure off the coast of Fujairah. One of the vessels was en route to the United Arab Emirates to be loaded with Saudi Arabia crude oil and sent to the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-emirates-fujairah-port-shipping/uae-says-four-vessels-subjected-to-sabotage-near-fujairah-port-idUSKCN1SI0EG>); [Associated Press](<https://www.apnews.com/b571ec62b9f64e65ad33eda04e390aa9>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/05/12/middleeast/uae-cargo-ship-sabotage-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-05-12-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Memos sent to Syria's head of military intelligence, and obtained by the New York Times, report that President Bashar al-Assad's government has been running a network of secret torture facilities across Syria, crushing opposition via routine torture in secret prisons.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/05/syria-assad-silenced-dissent-secret-torture-prisons-report-190512112521443.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-05-12-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Argentine lawmaker Héctor Enrique Olivares, who was seriously injured in a shooting attack near the Congress on May 9, dies in hospital as result of the gunshot injuries.

Source citations (as archived): [TN.com.ar](<https://tn.com.ar/politica/murio-el-diputado-hector-olivares-baleado-metros-del-congreso_961845>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-argentina-attack-lawmaker/argentine-lawmaker-olivares-dies-from-injuries-after-mafia-style-shooting-idUSKCN1SI0RG>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-05-12-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Lithuanian presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Lithuanians are called to the polls to elect the new President. Ingrida Šimonytė wins the first round and will dispute the second round with Gitanas Nausėda. Prime Minister and presidential candidate, Saulius Skvernelis is about to resign after the bad results of his candidature.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/polls-close-in-lithuania-presidential-election/a-48704538>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48249482>).

<a id="event-2019-05-12-2-3"></a>

Context: 2019 North Macedonian presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Stevo Pendarovski is sworn in as the President of North Macedonia after winning the election, the first after the Prespa agreement.

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-05-12-3-1"></a>

Context: England's 2018–19 Premier League.

**Archived source account.** Manchester City F.C. win England's 2018–19 Premier League for the second year in a row with 98 points, while Liverpool F.C. come in second with 97 points, continuing their 29-year title drought.

Source citations (as archived): [English Premier League](<https://www.premierleague.com/matchweek/3297/blog>).

### 2019-05-13

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-05-13-0-1"></a>

Context: Gulf of Oman incident, Iran–United States relations, United Arab Emirates - Iran relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States Maritime Administration (MARAD) issues a new alert to all ships passing Fujairah, off the coast of the United Arab Emirates on the Gulf of Oman over "acts of sabotage" amid heightened regional tensions between the United States and Iran.

<a id="event-2019-05-13-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four people are killed when two sightseeing planes, with a total of 14 Royal Princess ship tourists, collide near Ketchikan, Alaska. Multiple people were rescued though two others are missing.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/alaska-plane-crash-2-sightseeing-planes-carrying-cruise-ship-tourists-collide-midair-near-ketchikan-alaska-2019-05-14/>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/05/14/us/ketchikan-plane-crash-alaska.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-05-13-2-1"></a>

Context: Iran–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** An Iranian woman is sentenced to 10 years in prison for suspected spying for the United Kingdom. A judiciary spokesman alleged that she was recruited by the British Council's Iran desk.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-uk-spy/iran-says-it-has-sentenced-iranian-woman-to-10-years-for-spying-for-uk-idUSKCN1SJ0NH>).

<a id="event-2019-05-13-2-3"></a>

Context: China–United States trade war, China–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** China announces its intent to increase tariffs from 10% to 25% on $60 billion worth of imports from the United States effective June 1, 2019.

Context: 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis, United States–Venezuela relations.

<a id="event-2019-05-13-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Prosecutors in Sweden reopen the rape allegation investigation against WikiLeaks founder Julian Assange. Swedish prosecutors mention their intent to seek extradition of Assange from the United Kingdom after he has served his 50-week prison sentence for skipping bail.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48253343>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/05/13/world/europe/assange-sweden-investigation.html>); [Associated Press](<https://www.apnews.com/a3053bfbb08b45f68bdd22fbc2404a8f>).

<a id="event-2019-05-13-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 36-year-old man is arrested just outside Casa Rosada in Argentina, armed with a handgun, after requesting to hold an interview with President Mauricio Macri.

Source citations (as archived): [Perfil](<https://www.perfil.com/noticias/policia/casa-rosada-detuvieron-hombre-armado-que-queria-ver-presidente-mauricio-macri%20.phtml>).

<a id="event-2019-05-13-3-3"></a>

Context: 2019 college admissions bribery scandal.

**Archived source account.** Actress Felicity Huffman pleads guilty to conspiracy to commit mail fraud and honest services mail fraud and admits to paying $15,000 for a proctor to change her daughter's SAT answers.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/felicity-huffman-pleads-guilty-college-admissions-scandal-n1005056>).

<a id="event-2019-05-13-3-5"></a>

Context: Russian interference in the 2016 United States elections.

**Archived source account.** Trump's U.S. Attorney General William Barr appoints Republican U.S. Attorney for the District of Connecticut John Durham to investigate the origins of the Crossfire Hurricane and Special Counsel investigations, and any criminality that may have occurred.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/u-s-attorney-to-review-russia-probe/>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/05/13/politics/john-durham-russia-probe/>).

<a id="event-2019-05-13-3-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of the United States (SCOTUS) rules in Franchise Tax Board of California v. Hyatt, that a state cannot be sued in another state's court, overturning a 40-year-old precedent. The 5-4 decision overrules the stare decisis set in 1979 which allowed private suits from one state to be brought in another state's court.

Source citations (as archived): [PBS](<https://www.pbs.org/newshour/nation/supreme-court-rules-a-state-cant-be-sued-in-another-states-courts>); [SCOTUS Blog](<https://www.scotusblog.com/case-files/cases/franchise-tax-board-of-california-v-hyatt-2/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-05-13-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Philippine general election.

**Archived source account.** Voters in the Philippines go to the polls to elect new members of the Senate of the Philippines and House of Representatives of the Philippines, as well as various other local positions.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/05/12/world/asia/philippines-election-senate-duterte.html>).

<a id="event-2019-05-13-4-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Guatemalan general election.

**Archived source account.** The Constitutional Court determines that Zury Ríos has a constitutional impediment to be a presidential candidate and leaves her out of the electoral contest. Her constitutional impediment is for being the daughter of former dictator Efraín Ríos Montt.

Source citations (as archived): [Prensa Libre](<https://www.prensalibre.com/guatemala/politica/zury-rios-queda-fuera-de-la-contienda/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-05-13-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** American undersea explorer Victor Vescovo sets a new world record for the deepest ever sea dive at 10,972 m in the Pacific Ocean's Mariana Trench. Several unusual things are discovered at the bottom, including four new species of prawn-like crustaceans, a new species of snailfish, strange brightly coloured rocky outcrops and a plastic bag.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-48230157>).

A tsunami alert is issued by the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center. The tsunami threat has now largely passed.

**Archived source account.** French anaesthesiologist Frédéric Péchier, previously investigated in the poisoning of seven patients at private clinics in Besançon, France, is being held over suspicions that he poisoned a further 17 - 50. Mr. Péchier has denied all charges, and is scheduled for a hearing later this week.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/french-anaesthesiologist-suspected-in-17-more-poisoning-cases-11541220>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48303733>); [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2019/05/14/french-anaesthologist-quizzed-suspected-poisoning-50-patients/>).

<a id="event-2019-05-14-3-3"></a>

Context: Russian interference in the 2016 United States elections.

**Archived source account.** Florida Governor Ron DeSantis announces that Russian hackers accessed voter databases in two Florida counties prior to the 2016 presidential election. No data or vote tallies were affected.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/05/14/723215498/florida-governor-says-russian-hackers-breached-two-florida-counties-in-2016>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-05-14-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** Venezuelan security forces surround the Palacio Federal Legislativo in Caracas, preventing opposition National Assembly lawmakers from entering the building to discuss a response to the recent arrest of National Assembly Vice President Edgar Zambrano.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/2019/05/14/venezuela-security-forces-block-opposition-lawmakers-from-entering-parliament>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-05-14-5-1"></a>

Context: Microarchitectural Data Sampling.

**Archived source account.** Security researchers from Graz University of Technology and Catholic University of Leuven discover a major new class of Microarchitectural Data Sampling vulnerabilities called ZombieLoad in Intel processors, which, if exploited, can be used to steal sensitive information directly from the processor. Almost every computer with an Intel chip dating back to 2011 is affected by these vulnerabilities.

Source citations (as archived): [ZombieLoad disclosure website](<https://zombieloadattack.com/>); [TechCrunch](<https://techcrunch.com/2019/05/14/zombieload-flaw-intel-processors/>).

<a id="event-2019-05-14-5-2"></a>

Context: Microarchitectural Data Sampling.

**Archived source account.** Linux kernel developers, Apple, Google and Microsoft release emergency patches for their products to mitigate ZombieLoad.

Source citations (as archived): [TechCrunch](<https://techcrunch.com/2019/05/14/intel-chip-flaws-patches-released/>); [Phoronix](<https://www.phoronix.com/scan.php?page=news_item&amp;px=MDS-Kernel-Fixes>).

<a id="event-2019-05-14-5-4"></a>

Context: Mass surveillance industry.

**Archived source account.** WhatsApp confirms a major security bug in the app let hackers remotely install surveillance software on its users' devices. All 1.5 billion users are urged to update WhatsApp as a precaution. The technology used in the cyberattack appears to have originated from NSO Group, a technology company operating out of Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-48262681>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/life-style/gadgets-and-tech/news/whatsapp-update-how-to-iphone-android-bug-hack-attack-security-a8912591.html>).

### 2019-05-15

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1249095519](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20May%2015&oldid=1249095519>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-05-15-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Militants kill at least 17 Niger Armed Forces troops in an ambush near the Malian border. Another 11 soldiers are missing; six others have been evacuated to a hospital. No group has claimed responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-48286975>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-niger-security/at-least-17-niger-soldiers-killed-in-ambush-government-spokesman-idUSKCN1SL1T8>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-05-15-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Jeremy Kyle Show, one of the United Kingdom's most watched reality television programmes, is cancelled by ITV Studios following the suicide of a male guest shortly after taking part in the programme. The show has long been criticised for its style, with many describing it as poverty porn.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/entertainment-arts-48279613>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-05-15-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A helicopter with only the pilot onboard crashes into the Hudson River shortly after taking off from the West 30th Street Heliport in New York City injuring the pilot and the dockworker on the ground.

Source citations (as archived): [Source](<https://newyork.cbslocal.com/2019/05/15/helicopter-in-hudson-river-new-york/>).

<a id="event-2019-05-15-2-2"></a>

Context: Pacific Islands Forum.

**Archived source account.** United Nations Secretary General António Guterres says Pacific island nations are "running out of time" in regards to climate change and global warming effects.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/389305/guterres-told-pacific-running-out-of-time-for-climate-action>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-05-15-3-1"></a>

Context: Iraq–United States relations, Iran–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States Department of State orders all non-emergency, non-essential government employees at the U.S. Embassy in Baghdad and Erbil consulate office to leave Iraq amid heightened tensions in the Persian Gulf between the United States and Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-iran-iraq-embassy/u-s-pulls-some-government-employees-from-iraq-idUSKCN1SL0SX>); [Associated Press](<https://www.apnews.com/c61546f081e842f6b5d944ed20a204bc>).

<a id="event-2019-05-15-3-3"></a>

Context: Germany–Iraq relations, NATO Training Mission – Iraq, Germany–Iran relations, Iraq–European Union relations.

**Archived source account.** Germany and the Netherlands suspend military training mission in Iraq citing escalating tensions in the region with Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/germany-suspends-iraq-training-mission-as-us-pulls-out-diplomatic-staff/a-48745596>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-netherlands-iraq-security/netherlands-suspends-government-mission-in-iraq-over-security-threat-anp-agency-idUSKCN1SL1LR>).

<a id="event-2019-05-15-3-5"></a>

Context: Christchurch Call summit.

**Archived source account.** Representatives from 17 world governments and various U.S. technology companies meet in Paris to support a set of anti-terrorism guidelines called the "Christchurch Call to Action" drafted by the governments of France and New Zealand. The White House expressed support for the "overall goals reflected" in this pledge, but refused to back it, citing freedom of speech concerns.

Source citations (as archived): [SBS](<https://www.sbs.com.au/news/leaders-and-tech-giants-sign-christchurch-call-to-curb-online-extremism-but-us-declines>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-05-15-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** San Francisco becomes the first U.S. city to ban the use of facial recognition systems by law enforcement.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-48276660>).

<a id="event-2019-05-15-4-2"></a>

Context: Abortion in the United States by state, Fetal heartbeat bill.

**Archived source account.** The Governor of Alabama Kay Ivey signs the Human Life Protection Act into law, effective six months after signing, bans all abortions in the state of Alabama, except when "abortion is necessary in order to prevent a serious health risk" to the woman according to the bill's text. The law reclassifies abortion as a Class A felony and attempted abortion as a Class C felony.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/alabama-abortion-law-governor-kay-ivey-signs-near-total-ban-today-live-updates-2019-05-15/>); [WBRC Birmingham, AL](<https://www.wbrc.com/2019/05/15/alabama-governor-signs-near-total-abortion-ban-into-law/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-05-15-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Fijian Prime Minister Frank Bainimarama asks developed nations, especially the United States, to help fight climate change to "prevent the current crisis from escalating into total chaos."

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/389108/total-chaos-climate-warning-from-bainimarama>).

<a id="event-2019-05-15-5-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Andorran parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** Xavier Espot Zamora is elected the new Prime Minister by the General Council, succeeding Antoni Martí.

Source citations (as archived): [Diari d'Andorra](<https://www.diariandorra.ad/noticies/nacional/2019/05/15/xavier_espot_elegit_cap_govern_145832_1125.html>).

<a id="event-2019-05-15-5-4"></a>

Context: Presidency of Jair Bolsonaro.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of thousands of students, schoolteachers, and university professors hold demonstrations across Brazil's biggest cities in opposition to large cuts in the education budget. From Dallas, Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro calls demonstrators "stupid."

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/amp/news/2019/05/brazil-teachers-students-protest-scandalous-cuts-education-190515222229220.html>).

<a id="event-2019-05-15-5-5"></a>

Context: Presidency of Jair Bolsonaro.

**Archived source account.** President Bolsonaro expresses support for comedian Danilo Gentili who was sentenced to six months in prison for a sexually graphic rant against a congresswoman, saying that she was a transexual or a prostitute.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/the_americas/right-wing-comedians-prison-sentence-sparks-free-speech-debate-in-bolsonaros-brazil/2019/05/14/8b47b402-74fd-11e9-a7bf-c8a43b84ee31_story.html>).

<a id="event-2019-05-15-5-7"></a>

Context: 2019 Guatemalan general election.

**Archived source account.** The Constitutional Court ruled that former Attorney General Thelma Aldana can not participate as a presidential candidate and leaves her out of the elections. Aldana was one of the favorites to succeed the current President Jimmy Morales.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/the_americas/guatemala-awaits-ruling-can-popular-anti-corruption-crusader-run-for-president/2019/05/14/8ec59356-7516-11e9-a7bf-c8a43b84ee31_story.html>).

### 2019-05-16

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1273651885](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20May%2016&oldid=1273651885>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-05-16-0-1"></a>

Context: Sinai insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Forty-seven insurgents and five Egyptian soldiers are killed in a gunfight in the Sinai Peninsula.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/middleeast/2019/05/egypt-sinai-47-fighters-5-troops-killed-battle-190516133026261.html>).

<a id="event-2019-05-16-0-3"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir.

**Archived source account.** Multiple people are killed, including three militants, two Mujahideen, two civilians and two Indian soldiers, in Kashmir after a shootout.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://af.reuters.com/article/worldNews/idAFKCN1SM0ZC>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-05-16-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Government under the Trump administration cancels $929 million federal grant for California High-Speed Rail project.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<https://www.latimes.com/local/california/la-me-high-speed-rail-loses-federal-funding-20190516-story.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-05-16-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three Britons and a South African die when their light aircraft crashes on approach to Dubai International Airport, closing the world's busiest airport for 45 minutes.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/three-britons-killed-as-small-plane-crashes-in-dubai-11721737>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-05-16-3-1"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Field Marshal Khalifa Haftar of the Tobruk-based House of Representatives meets with Italian Prime Minister Giuseppe Conte and has scheduled a meeting with French President Emmanuel Macron for next week.

Source citations (as archived): [Libya Observer](<https://www.libyaobserver.ly/news/italian-prime-minister-meets-haftar-rome-calls-ceasefire>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-libya-security-france/frances-macron-to-meet-libyas-eastern-commander-haftar-next-week-presidency-idUSKCN1SM204>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-05-16-4-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries.

**Archived source account.** Mayor of New York City Bill de Blasio announces he is running for the Democratic Party's nomination to be President of the United States in the 2020 presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2019/may/16/bill-de-blasio-2020-presidential-campaign>).

<a id="event-2019-05-16-4-3"></a>

Context: Immigration policy of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump proposes a new immigration plan based on merits such as college degrees and skilled trades and less on family ties.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/05/15/us/politics/trump-immigration-kushner.html>).

<a id="event-2019-05-16-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. federal agents raid the Venezuelan embassy to evict Code Pink protesters, at the request of National Assembly leader Juan Guaidó. They had been staying at the embassy at the invitation of Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro, who is locked in a dispute over the presidency with Guaidó. Maduro's government considers the raid to be a violation of the Vienna convention.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics-washingtondc/u-s-federal-agents-arrest-protesters-occupying-venezuelan-embassy-idUSKCN1SM21T>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/us-police-venezuela-embassy-vienna-convention-maduro-guaido-a8917361.html>).

<a id="event-2019-05-16-4-6"></a>

Context: Brexit negotiations in 2019, Premiership of Theresa May.

**Archived source account.** UK Prime Minister Theresa May says that she will detail the timetable for her resignation after the Brexit vote in June.

Source citations (as archived): [FT](<https://www.ft.com/content/f6be9a3c-77de-11e9-bbad-7c18c0ea0201>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/05/16/world/europe/uk-theresa-may.html>); [Time](<http://time.com/5590944/uk-prime-minister-theresa-may-june-timetable-resign/>).

### 2019-05-17

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1295799347](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20May%2017&oldid=1295799347>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-05-17-0-1"></a>

Context: Canada–United States relations, Mexico–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States lifts tariffs on steel and aluminum from Canada and Mexico.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/05/17/724357441/u-s-to-lift-tariffs-on-canadas-and-mexico-s-steel-and-aluminum>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-05-17-1-1"></a>

Context: China–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** A former CIA officer, Kevin Mallory, is sentenced to 20 years in prison by a federal judge in the Eastern District of Virginia for spying for China.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/05/17/us/politics/cia-spying-china.html>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-48319058>).

<a id="event-2019-05-17-1-3"></a>

Context: LGBTQ rights in Taiwan.

**Archived source account.** Taiwan's Legislative Yuan passes legislation legalizing same-sex marriage and limited joint-custody rights, making Taiwan the first country in Asia to do so. President Tsai Ing-wen and her cabinet helped draft the bill, and she will sign it into law on or before May 24.

Source citations (as archived): [Taiwan News](<https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/en/news/3704386>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-taiwan-lgbt/in-first-for-asia-taiwan-parliament-endorses-same-sex-marriage-idUSKCN1SN0A6>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/05/taiwan-parliament-vote-sex-marriage-legislation-190517041658310.html>).

<a id="event-2019-05-17-1-5"></a>

Context: LGBTQ rights in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. House of Representatives passes the Equality Act, which prohibits discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Insider](<https://www.businessinsider.com/house-passes-equality-act-major-new-lgbtq-protections-2019-5>).

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087786354](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20May%2018&oldid=1087786354>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-05-18-0-1"></a>

Context: Eurovision Song Contest 2019.

**Archived source account.** Duncan Laurence, representing the Netherlands, wins the 2019 edition of the Eurovision Song Contest with the song "Arcade". It is the country's first win since \{\{escyr\|1975\}\}.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Scott Morrison declares victory. It remains unclear whether his Liberal-National Coalition has won a majority of seats, or whether it will form a minority government.

**Archived source account.** Despite opinion polls predicting a Labor victory, the Labor Party loses several seats, with support in the key state of Queensland far lower than expected. Opposition Leader Bill Shorten concedes defeat and steps down as party leader.

**Archived source account.** Justin Amash from Michigan's 3rd congressional district becomes the first Republican U.S. Representative to support the impeachment of President Donald Trump.

Context: 2019 FA Cup Final, 2018–19 Manchester City F.C. season.

**Archived source account.** Manchester City F.C. win England's 2018–19 FA Cup by defeating Watford F.C. 6-0 in the final, marking the first time that an English club has won all three domestic titles in one season.

### 2019-05-19

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087786465](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20May%2019&oldid=1087786465>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-05-19-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An explosion hits a tourist bus carrying South African nationals near the Grand Egyptian Museum in Giza, Egypt, injuring at least 14 people.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/05/19/africa/egypt-museum-blast-tourists-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-05-19-0-2"></a>

Context: Iraq–United States relations, Iran–United States relations.

<a id="event-2019-05-19-1-1"></a>

Context: China–United States trade war.

<a id="event-2019-05-19-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Martin Tower, the tallest building in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania, is destroyed in a controlled demolition by the Controlled Demolition, Inc. firm. The 21-story building, which was listed on National Register of Historic Places, had been vacant since 2007.

<a id="event-2019-05-19-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The White House is expected to announce the first part of their Middle East peace proposal in what officials are calling an economic "workshop" to encourage investing capital in the West Bank, Gaza, and the region. The workshop is expected to happen on June 25 and 26 in Manama, Bahrain.

Context: Iran–Saudi Arabia relations.

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabian Minister of Foreign Affairs Adel al-Jubeir says his country "seeks to avert war, ready to respond with force and determination" to a would-be attack by Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/05/saudi-arabia-seeks-avert-war-ready-respond-force-190519055552084.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-05-19-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Several gunmen open fire inside a bar in Belém, Brazil, killing at least eleven people.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-05-19/urgent-brazil-officials-report-massacre-media-say-11-dead-at-bar>).

### 2019-05-20

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087786617](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20May%2020&oldid=1087786617>).

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2019-05-20-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thirty-two people are killed when Islamic State members started a prison riot and a fire in a prison located in Vahdat, Tajikistan.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-48332969>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/05/isil-inmates-spark-deadly-riot-tajik-prison-190520060419825.html>); [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/459783-isis-riot-tajikistan-prison/>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-05-20-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Whole Foods Market announces it will eliminate disposable plastic straws in July from its stores in the United States, Canada and the United Kingdom.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/money/2019/05/20/whole-foods-drop-plastic-straws-us-stores-july/3739491002/>).

#### Business and finance

<a id="event-2019-05-20-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ascena Retail Group announces it will close all 650 Dressbarn stores by the end of the year.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/money/2019/05/20/dressbarn-closing-all-stores/3747205002/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-05-20-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed, the pilot and the passenger, when a floatplane crashes into Metlakatla harbor near Ketchikan, Alaska. The pilot and passenger were the only people on board.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/alaska-small-plane-crash-kills-2-a-week-after-a-deadly-mid-air-collision-involving-the-same-carrier/>); [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/two-dead-after-float-plane-crashes-alaska-n1008131>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-05-20-4-1"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations, Droughts in Korea.

**Archived source account.** South Korea vows to send humanitarian aid to North Korea through international organizations as it suffers droughts.

Source citations (as archived): [Star Tribune](<http://www.startribune.com/south-korea-vows-to-send-aid-to-north-quickly-may-send-food/510152332/>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2019/05/20/world/asia/ap-as-koreas-diplomacy-.html>).

<a id="event-2019-05-20-4-3"></a>

Context: Iran–Saudi Arabia relations, Iran–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Iranian Minister of Foreign Affairs Mohammad Javad Zarif states that the "genocidal taunts" of U.S. President Donald Trump "won't end Iran", in response to President Trump's comments that if Iran attacked U.S. interests, "that will be the official end of Iran." He also blasted Saudi Arabian Minister of Foreign Affairs Adel al-Jubeir for his previous May 19 remarks regarding Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [Brecorder](<https://www.brecorder.com/2019/05/20/498069/tehran-says-trumps-genocidal-taunts-wont-end-iran/>).

<a id="event-2019-05-20-4-5"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. F-22 stealth jets intercept four Russian Tupolev Tu-95 strategic bombers and two Russian Su-35 jets entering the Alaskan Air Defense Identification Zone off the coast of Alaska. The Russian jets and bombers did not enter the U.S. nor Canadian airspace according to the North American Aerospace Defense Command.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/russian-jets-bombers-intercepted-by-us-near-alaska-coast-norad-says-today-2019-05-21/>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/05/21/politics/russian-bombers-alaska-intercept/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-05-20-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Swedish prosecutor files an arrest warrant against WikiLeaks founder Julian Assange over a rape allegation. Assange is serving a 50-week prison sentence in the United Kingdom for skipping bail.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-wikileaks-assange-sweden-detention/swedish-prosecutor-files-request-for-assanges-arrest-over-rape-allegation-idUSKCN1SQ0ID>).

<a id="event-2019-05-20-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Supreme Court in Herrera v. Wyoming rules in favor of a Native American elk hunter from Montana who was convicted for hunting off-season in Bighorn National Forest, deciding that the 1868 federal treaty between the Crow Nation and the U.S. Government is still in force even after Wyoming became a state in 1890. The treaty gave tribe members hunting rights on "unoccupied" lands.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-court-hunter/us-supreme-court-sides-with-native-american-elk-hunter-idUSKCN1SQ1RN>); [SCOTUS Blog](<https://www.scotusblog.com/case-files/cases/herrera-v-wyoming/>).

<a id="event-2019-05-20-5-3"></a>

Context: Tax returns of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** Judge Amit Mehta of the United States District Court for the District of Columbia rules that accounting firm Mazars must comply with a subpoena issued by the United States House Committee on Oversight and Reform to turn over U.S. President Donald Trump's financial records.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/05/20/us/politics/trump-financial-records.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-05-20-6-1"></a>

Context: Ukrainian presidential inauguration.

**Archived source account.** Former comedian and reality television actor Volodymyr Zelensky is sworn in as the 6th President of Ukraine by the Verkhovna Rada. Zelensky announces the dissolution of parliament and calls a snap parliamentary election.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/cda/en/ukraine-president-zelenskiy-disbands-parliament-on-inauguration-day/a-48800069>).

<a id="event-2019-05-20-6-2"></a>

Context: Ukrainian presidential inauguration.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian Prime Minister Volodymyr Groysman announces he will resign Wednesday in response to the new president's disbanding of parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/05/ukraine-prime-minister-resigns-protest-190520155817398.html>).

<a id="event-2019-05-20-6-4"></a>

Context: Ibiza affair.

**Archived source account.** All ministers from the far-right Freedom Party of Austria, who make up close to half of Austria's cabinet, are resigning in response to their party leader, Heinz-Christian Strache being forced to resign as Vice-Chancellor after a video was published Friday showing Strache's participation in a compromising video.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48335316>).

<a id="event-2019-05-20-6-6"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro proposes early elections for Venezuela's National Assembly. Opposition leader and National Assembly President Juan Guaidó has stated a rejection of the proposal.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-48345335>).

<a id="event-2019-05-20-6-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** After several months of negotiations, President Félix Tshisekedi names Sylvestre Ilunga Ilukamba as the new Prime Minister of the Democratic Republic of the Congo in an agreement with former president Joseph Kabila. He had not appointed a prime minister since being elected in December 2018.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News](<https://www.yahoo.com/news/dr-congo-political-heavyweight-moise-katumbi-returns-home-135221830.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-05-20-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The redefinition of the SI system of measurement adopted by the majority of countries in the world takes effect.

Source citations (as archived): [BIPM](<https://www.bipm.org/en/measurement-units/>).

### 2019-05-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256031898](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20May%2021&oldid=1256031898>).

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2019-05-21-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eleven people were killed in an ambush at 12th mile in Khonsa-Deomali road in Tirap District in Arunachal Pradesh.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-india-violence-arunachal/politician-family-members-among-11-killed-in-india-ambush-idUSKCN1SR188>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-05-21-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pharmaceutical giant Merck &amp; Co. announces that it will purchase Peloton Therapeutics Inc. for $1.05 billion in cash. The catalyst for the deal is Peloton's recent progress in the development of a kidney cancer treatment.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-merck-co-deals/merck-buys-peloton-to-expand-its-kidney-cancer-treatment-portfolio-idUSKCN1SR136>).

<a id="event-2019-05-21-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Jamie Oliver Restaurant Group, owned by British restaurateur Jamie Oliver, collapses into administration, resulting in 1,000 job losses.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-48352026>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-05-21-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis, Italy–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** Venezuela's Ambassador to Italy, Isaías Rodríguez, resigns, citing the government's lack of finances amid international sanctions on the Nicolás Maduro government. Rodríguez says, due to the sanctions, he has been unable to pay his staff or the rent for his office in Rome.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/may/21/venezuelas-ambassador-to-italy-resigns>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-05-21-3-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Christchurch mosque shootings.

**Archived source account.** Brenton Tarrant, accused of killing 51 people and wounding 49 others in two New Zealand mosques, is also charged with committing terrorist acts.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Post](<https://nypost.com/2019/05/21/alleged-christchurch-shooter-brenton-tarrant-charged-with-terrorism/>); [Mid Day](<https://www.mid-day.com/articles/police-christchurch-attacker-brenton-tarrant-charged-with-terrorism/20989185>).

<a id="event-2019-05-21-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Washington becomes the first U.S. state to legalize human composting, the right to allow people to have their body turned into soil after death. The process is seen as an alternative to traditional cremations and burials.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-48359571>).

<a id="event-2019-05-21-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The California High-Speed Rail Authority sues the U.S. Transportation Department to block the cancelling of $929 million federal grant for the California High-Speed Rail project. The suit comes after the Trump administration canceled the federal grant for California's bullet train on May 16, 2019.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<https://www.latimes.com/politics/la-pol-ca-california-high-speed-rail-lawsuit-trump-administration-20190521-story.html>).

<a id="event-2019-05-21-3-5"></a>

Context: 2015–19 Irish gangland feud.

**Archived source account.** A man is shot dead and his car set alight in Walshestown near Balbriggan, Dublin. It is believed the shooting is linked to the 2015–19 Irish gangland feud.

Source citations (as archived): [RTÉ](<https://www.rte.ie/news>).

<a id="event-2019-05-21-3-7"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Mueller special counsel investigation.

**Archived source account.** The United States House Committee on the Judiciary subpoenas former White House Communications Director Hope Hicks and former Deputy White House Counsel Annie Donaldson in regards to their actions during the special counsel investigation into Russian interference in the 2016 United States elections.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/house-panel-subpoenas-trumps-former-top-staffer-aide-to-mcgahn/2019/05/21/58182038-7801-11e9-ac17-284a66782c41_story.html?utm_term=.d5593a10e4cf>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-05-21-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Indonesian general election.

**Archived source account.** Indonesia's General Elections Commission announces that incumbent President Joko Widodo has won last month's presidential election, with 55.5% of the vote. His rival Prabowo Subianto's team, however, refuses to sign and validate the results.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/may/21/indonesia-election-official-count-hands-victory-to-joko-widodo-as-rival-cries-foul>).

**Archived source account.** Voters head to the polls to elect the next President of Malawi, Parliament and local government councillors.

<a id="event-2019-05-21-4-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Pennsylvania's 12th congressional district special election.

**Archived source account.** Voters head to the polls in a special election to elect a new U.S. House Representative to finish the term for Pennsylvania's 12th congressional district after Republican Tom Marino resigned on January 23, 2019.

<a id="event-2019-05-21-4-6"></a>

Context: 2019 Pennsylvania's 12th congressional district special election.

**Archived source account.** Republican Fred Keller wins the special election against his Democratic opponent Marc Friedenberg.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/homenews/campaign/444876-republican-wins-special-house-election-in-pennsylvania>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/interactive/2019/05/21/us/elections/results-pennsylvania-elections.html>).

<a id="event-2019-05-21-4-8"></a>

Context: Trial of Catalonia independence leaders.

**Archived source account.** The Catalan leaders who are imprisoned accused of rebellion, Oriol Junqueras, Jordi Turull, Jordi Sànchez and Josep Rull, are sworn in as members of the Congress of Deputies after being elected in the 28th April general election by an authorization of the Supreme Court.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<https://www.foxnews.com/world/jailed-deputies-allowed-to-attend-spanish-parliament-session>).

<a id="event-2019-05-21-4-9"></a>

Context: Trial of Catalonia independence leaders.

**Archived source account.** Catalan leader Raül Romeva is sworn in as Senator.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/congress/jailed-deputies-allowed-to-attend-spanish-parliament-session/2019/05/21/25705e28-7ba0-11e9-b1f3-b233fe5811ef_story.html?utm_term=.9903185136ea>).

<a id="event-2019-05-21-4-11"></a>

Context: 2019 Kentucky elections.

**Archived source account.** Incumbent Governor Matt Bevin wins the Republican nomination and Andy Beshear wins the Democratic nomination primaries ahead of the November 5 gubernatorial election.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/05/21/us/politics/kentucky-primary-elections.html>); [Lexington Herald-Leader](<https://www.kentucky.com/news/politics-government/election/article230615424.html>).

<a id="event-2019-05-21-4-12"></a>

**Archived source account.** Dutch Minister of Justice and Security Mark Harbers resigns amid a scandal over a government report which played down crimes committed by asylum seekers in the country, including rapes and murders, which were placed under a category called "other". The omission was first highlighted by Dutch newspaper De Telegraaf.

Source citations (as archived): [FRANCE 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20190521-dutch-migration-minister-resigns-over-asylum-seeker-crime-report>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-05-21-5-1"></a>

Context: 2019 NBA playoffs.

**Archived source account.** The Golden State Warriors qualify for the NBA Finals for the fifth year in a row by defeating the Portland Trail Blazers, 119–117, in overtime in Game 4 of the Western Conference Finals.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/nba/warriors/2019/05/20/golden-state-warriors-reach-nba-finals/3748577002/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: War in Donbass.

**Archived source account.** The Ukrainian military reports that eight Ukrainian soldiers have been captured by pro-Russian fighters near the village of Novotroyitske.

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-05-22-1-1"></a>

Context: Economy of the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** British Steel Limited goes into compulsory liquidation after rescue talks between the British government and the company's owners, Greybull Capital, fail. Around 5,000 workers are employed by the company, 3,800 of whom are based in the UK.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-48365241>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-05-22-2-1"></a>

Context: Tornadoes of 2019.

**Archived source account.** A powerful tornado hits Jefferson City, Missouri, leaving people trapped or injured and structural damage according to city and state officials. At least three people are killed in southwestern Missouri when a storm system sweeps across the state causing extensive damage.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-05-22-3-1"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** United States F-22 Raptors intercept four Russian Tu-95 bombers and two Su-35 fighter jets off the coast of Alaska on Tuesday and Wednesday, according to a statement from the North American Aerospace Defense Command.

<a id="event-2019-05-22-4-1"></a>

Context: Timeline of investigations into Donald Trump and Russia (2019).

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Justice Department agrees to provide the House Intelligence Committee with intelligence files from special counsel Robert Mueller's investigation of Russian interference in the 2016 election.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/politics/in-compromise-justice-department-will-reveal-intelligence-files-from-mueller-probe-to-house-committee/ar-AABJZki?ocid=spartandhp>).

Context: Tax returns of Donald Trump.

<a id="event-2019-05-22-4-5"></a>

Context: Tax returns of Donald Trump.

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-05-22-5-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Indonesian general election.

**Archived source account.** Six people die and more than 200 are injured in the Indonesian capital, Jakarta, after protesters of the announced results of the presidential election clash with security forces and set fire to a police dormitory and vehicles.

### 2019-05-23

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-05-23-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Northwestern Syria offensive (April 2019–present).

<a id="event-2019-05-23-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Panasonic suspends shipments of certain hardware components to Huawei Technologies Co. Ltd. to comply with U.S. restrictions on the company.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-huawei-panasonic/panasonic-suspends-some-component-shipments-to-huawei-amid-u-s-blacklist-idUSKCN1SS32U>).

<a id="event-2019-05-23-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump announces a second aid package worth $16 billion for farmers impacted by the China–United States trade war.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2019/05/23/trump-to-give-16-billion-to-farmers-hurt-by-trade-war-sonny-perdue.html>); [Fox Business](<https://www.foxbusiness.com/markets/trump-second-round-farmer-aid-us-china-trade>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-05-23-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** John Walker Lindh, the first person to be convicted of a crime in the War on Terror, is released on probation from a U.S. federal prison after serving 17 years of a 20-year sentence. Lindh has refused to renounce Islamist extremism and will be on probation for three years. U.S. President Donald Trump condemns the early release.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/05/22/politics/john-walker-lindh-american-taliban/index.html>); [()](<https://www.apnews.com/24e30be3a75949b7aa3b30946703140d>).

<a id="event-2019-05-23-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. city of Baltimore, Maryland, has been battling a ransomware attack that has blocked government email accounts and disabled online payments to city departments. The hackers breached the city's servers on May 7 and demanded $100,000 (£79,000) worth of Bitcoin.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-48371476>).

<a id="event-2019-05-23-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Interpol's Operation Blackwrist arrests nine people in Australia, Thailand and the United States, and rescues 50 children in connection with a 63,000-member online pedophilia ring. More arrests are expected. Investigators from nearly 60 countries participated in this operation.

Source citations (as archived): [ChannelNewsAsia](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/interpol-child-sex-abuse-network-thailand-australia-blackwrist-11558670>); [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/pedophilia-ring-dark-web-interpol-operation-blackwrist-thailand-us-australia-children-rescued/>).

<a id="event-2019-05-23-2-4"></a>

Context: Indictment and arrest of Julian Assange.

**Archived source account.** The United States Department of Justice charges WikiLeaks founder Julian Assange with 17 counts of violating the Espionage Act, including provisions that prohibit a conspiracy to obtain, receive and disclose national defense information, attempting to crack computer passwords, and unlawful receipt of sensitive information such as State Department communications and Defense Department logs.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/05/23/726282766/u-s-brings-new-charges-against-julian-assange-in-war-logs-state-cables-case>).

<a id="event-2019-05-23-2-6"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Mueller special counsel investigation and Crossfire Hurricane (FBI investigation).

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump, in a directive, orders the Intelligence Community to cooperate with U.S. Attorney General William Barr's review of the origins of the Special Counsel investigation. The order allows Attorney General Barr to declassify information he sees fit for the review process.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-russia-barr/trump-orders-intelligence-community-to-cooperate-with-review-on-russia-probe-origins-idUSKCN1SU00T>); [Fox News](<https://www.foxnews.com/politics/trump-gives-ag-barr-authority-to-declassify-documents-related-to-2016-campaign-surveillance>).

<a id="event-2019-05-23-2-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** American serial killer Bobby Joe Long who murdered 10 women in the Tampa Bay Area during an eight month period in 1984 is executed by lethal injection.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/bobby-joe-long-execution-serial-killer-executed-today-for-murdering-10-women-survivor-witnessed-execution/>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://af.reuters.com/article/topNews/idAFKCN1ST1A0-OZATP>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-05-24-2-1"></a>

Context: Shiregreen child deaths.

**Archived source account.** During a police raid, six children are found unconscious inside a residential property in the Shiregreen suburb of Sheffield, England. The eldest two children, aged 13 and 14, subsequently died at Sheffield Children's Hospital; the other four children remain hospitalised.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-south-yorkshire-48397021>).

<a id="event-2019-05-24-2-2"></a>

Context: Shiregreen child deaths.

**Archived source account.** Two people – a 37-year-old man and a 34-year-old woman – have been arrested under suspicion of murder at the property in Sheffield where six children were found. They remain in police custody. A murder investigation has been opened.

Source citations (as archived): [Evening Standard](<https://www.standard.co.uk/news/uk/six-children-taken-to-hospital-after-serious-incident-in-sheffield-a4150646.html>).

<a id="event-2019-05-24-2-4"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Taiwan, Legal status of same-sex marriage.

**Archived source account.** Same-sex marriage becomes legal in Taiwan, making Taiwan the first nation in Asia to recognize same-sex marriage.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://web.archive.org/web/20190517081651/https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2019/05/17/taiwan-becomes-first-country-asia-legalise-same-sex-marriage/>).

<a id="event-2019-05-24-2-6"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Kenya.

**Archived source account.** The High Court of Kenya rules against a bid to strike down Section 162 and 165 of the Kenyan Penal Code, a sodomy law. The plaintiffs plan to appeal to the Court of Appeal.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Nation](<https://www.nation.co.ke/news/Court-declines-scrap-anti-gay-sex-law/1056-5130052-jqxp7t/>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/may/24/kenya-court-upholds-ban-on-gay-sex-in-major-setback-for-campaigners>).

<a id="event-2019-05-24-2-8"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the kidnapping of Jayme Closs.

**Archived source account.** In the U.S. state of Wisconsin, Jake Thomas Patterson is sentenced to life in prison for the kidnapping of Jayme Closs and the murders of her parents.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/05/24/726803919/wisconsin-man-sentenced-to-2-life-terms-for-kidnapping-teen-murdering-her-parent>).

<a id="event-2019-05-24-2-10"></a>

Context: Human Life Protection Act.

**Archived source account.** A federal lawsuit is filed to block Alabama’s abortion ban.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/federal-lawsuit-filed-block-alabamas-abortion-ban-63253763>).

<a id="event-2019-05-24-2-12"></a>

Context: Abortion in the United States by state, Heartbeat bill.

**Archived source account.** The Governor of Missouri Mike Parson signs House Bill 126 into law, effective on August 28, 2019, bans all abortions in the state of Missouri at or beyond 8 weeks of pregnancy, except in cases of medical emergencies. Persons who perform abortion in the state after 8 weeks of pregnancy face 5 to 15 years in prison.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/live-news/missouri-abortion-law-mike-parson-signs-bill-banning-abortions-8-weeks-today-2019-05-24-live-updates/>); [The Kansas City Star](<https://www.kansascity.com/news/politics-government/article230790159.html>).

<a id="event-2019-05-24-2-14"></a>

Context: Trial of Catalonia independence leaders.

**Archived source account.** The Board of the Congress of Deputies suspends Jordi Turull, Josep Rull, Oriol Junqueras and Jordi Sànchez Catalan leaders elected lawmakers due to they judicial situation.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-spain-politics/spanish-parliament-suspends-jailed-catalan-leaders-rights-as-lawmakers-idUSKCN1SU1BP>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-court-gerrymandering/us-supreme-court-blocks-redrawing-of-ohio-michigan-electoral-maps-idUSKCN1SU292>); [Los Angeles Times](<https://www.latimes.com/politics/la-na-pol-supreme-court-gerrymander-republicans-20190524-story.html>).

<a id="event-2019-05-25-4-0"></a>

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-05-30-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A study, published in the journal Science, finds a genetically enhanced fungus that produces spider toxin can rapidly kill huge numbers of the mosquitoes that spread malaria. Trials held in Burkina Faso showed mosquito populations collapsed by 99% within 45 days. The fungus did not affect other insects, such as bees.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/health-48464510>); [Science](<https://science.sciencemag.org/content/364/6443/894>).

<a id="event-2019-05-30-2-2"></a>

Context: Measles resurgence in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Sixty new cases in the past week are reported, bringing this year's total to 971 cases in 26 U.S. states – the highest since 1994. The CDC warns, "If these outbreaks continue through summer and fall, the United States may lose its measles elimination status."

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-48468801>).

<a id="event-2019-05-30-3-1"></a>

Context: Mexico–United States relations.

<a id="event-2019-05-30-3-2"></a>

Context: Mexico–United States relations.

He also ordered his foreign minister to travel to Washington on Friday.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trade-mexico-president/america-first-is-a-fallacy-mexicos-president-responds-to-trump-tariff-idUSKCN1T109N?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-06-01-5-2"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-summit-oic-golan/oic-refuses-to-accept-any-decision-to-change-legal-status-of-syrias-golan-heights-idUSKCN1T22VE?il=0>); [Reuters²](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-summit-palestinians-oic/oic-summit-condemns-any-decision-to-recognize-jerusalem-as-israels-capital-idUSKCN1T22UY?il=0>); [Reuters³](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-summit-oic-rohingya/oic-condemns-inhumane-situation-of-myanmars-rohingya-idUSKCN1T22VG?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-06-01-5-4"></a>

Context: China–United States trade war.

**Archived source account.** The United States begins collecting the higher, 25 percent tariffs on many Chinese goods arriving in U.S. seaports.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trade-china-tariffs/u-s-begins-collecting-higher-tariffs-on-chinese-goods-arriving-by-sea-idUKKCN1T22W7>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-06-01-6-1"></a>

Context: Indictment and arrest of Julian Assange.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations special rapporteur on torture, Nils Melzer, accuses the United States, the United Kingdom and Sweden of "ganging up" on Julian Assange and subjecting him to "psychological torture" and "collective persecution" after spending seven years living inside London's Ecuadorian Embassy.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/05/31/world/europe/julian-assange-torture-un.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-06-01-7-1"></a>

Context: 2020 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Maryland Governor Larry Hogan says he won't challenge U.S. President Donald Trump for the Republican Party's nomination for President in the 2020 presidential election, leaving Bill Weld as the only other major candidate for the nomination.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2019/06/01/maryland-gov-larry-hogan-wont-challenge-trump-for-2020-gop-presidential-nomination.html>).

<a id="event-2019-06-01-7-3"></a>

Context: Sudanese protests.

**Archived source account.** Shots fired by "regular forces" near the site of a sit-in protest in Khartoum kill one person and wound 10 others, according to the Central Committee of Sudanese Doctors. The gunfire lasted about four hours. This week at least three protesters have been shot dead and eight others injured during protests calling for the generals who replaced deposed President Omar al-Bashir to hand power to a civilian-led administration.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-sudan-politics/eleven-wounded-in-sudan-by-gunfire-near-sit-in-opposition-committee-idUSKCN1T23GJ?il=0>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/06/sudan-forces-fired-gunshots-disperse-sit-witnesses-190601172719030.html>).

<a id="event-2019-06-01-7-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** El Salvador's new President Nayib Bukele takes office.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-elsalvador-politics/new-president-pledges-to-cure-sick-child-el-salvador-idUSKCN1T23FH?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-06-01-7-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The website The Daily Beast identifies the man who posted a video of U.S. House Speaker Nancy Pelosi in order to create the misleading impression of drunkenly slurred speech. It was "an occasional sports blogger from the Bronx.".

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Beast](<https://www.thedailybeast.com/we-found-shawn-brooks-the-guy-behind-the-viral-drunk-pelosi-video>).

Source citations (as archived): [CBS Sports](<https://www.cbssports.com/soccer/news/liverpool-vs-tottenham-champions-league-final-score-salah-delivers-after-controversial-penalty-as-reds-win-ucl/>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2019-06-04-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** British-American cruise operator Carnival Corporation &amp; PLC is fined $20 million for environmental violations.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-06-04-1-1"></a>

Context: Cuba–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States announces new restrictions on American travel to Cuba. Effective Wednesday, travel via cruise ships or other conveyances, including private yachts or airplanes, is prohibited. Group travel under the previous "people-to-people educational" provision is also not allowed.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-48503821>); [AP](<https://www.wkyt.com/content/news/Trump-administration-imposes-new-restrictions-on-US-travel-to-Cuba-510806781.html>).

Context: China–United States relations, China–United States trade war.

**Archived source account.** China expands its warnings about travel to the U.S. issued for students and academics yesterday, to now cover tourists and businesses because, "in recent days, there have been incidents of gun violence, robberies and thefts in the United States".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-48522488>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trade-china/china-warns-its-companies-on-us-travel-rebuffs-trade-criticism-idUSKCN1T50ZK>).

Former president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva had opened more than 65 embassies in countries throughout the Global South in a bid to enhance political and economic ties with Brazil.

<a id="event-2019-06-04-3-1"></a>

Context: Gun laws in Virginia.

**Archived source account.** Tens of thousands of people gather in Hong Kong to mark the 30th anniversary of the crackdown on protests in Beijing's Tiananmen Square. Hong Kong is one of the two places in China where people can openly commemorate the event, the other being Macau, to a lesser extent; elsewhere in China, the authorities have banned and blocked any reference to the crackdown.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2019/jun/04/change-uk-poised-to-lose-at-least-half-its-mps-heidi-allen-chuka-umunna-lib-dems>).
