Context: Taiwan–United States relations, China–United States relations, Cross-Strait relations.

**Archived source account.** The Trump administration informs Congress of a potential $2 billion arms deal with Taiwan that includes the M1A2, the U.S.'s latest main battle tank, and a resupply of anti-air and anti-armor weapons. China's foreign ministry says it is "severely concerned with" and "firmly against" the plan.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-06-05/trump-administration-readies-a-2-billion-taiwan-arms-package>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-06-05-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Australian federal police raid the headquarters of the country's public broadcaster, Australian Broadcasting Corporation, regarding the alleged publication of classified material in a 2017 report on allegations that Australian Special forces engaged in unlawful killings and gross misconduct in Afghanistan. The day before, police raided Herald Sun journalist Annika Smethurst's home regarding an alleged leak of national security information.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-48522729>); [Business Insider](<https://www.businessinsider.com/australia-federal-police-raid-offices-australia-broadcasting-network-2019-6>).

<a id="event-2019-06-05-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Detroit Police Chief James Craig announces the department is looking for a possible serial killer in three unsolved murders of sex workers in the city dating back to March.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<https://time.com/5602219/detroit-serial-killer-women/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-06-05-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Danish general election.

**Archived source account.** The center-left Social Democrats win 48 of the 179 seats in the Folketing (parliament). Current Liberal Prime Minister Lars Løkke Rasmussen concedes defeat, paving the way for Social Democrat leader Mette Frederiksen, who at 41 is set to be the country's youngest prime minister.

Source citations (as archived): [The Local](<https://www.thelocal.dk/20190605/denmark-goes-to-the-polls-in-crucial-general-election-with-voters-seeking-change>); [EUobserver](<https://euobserver.com/political/145099>).

<a id="event-2019-06-05-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** President of Peru Martín Vizcarra wins a motion of confidence in the Congress of the Republic.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-peru-politics/with-confidence-vote-peru-revives-debate-over-anti-graft-reforms-idUKKCN1T61WN>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-06-06-2-0"></a>

<a id="event-2019-06-06-2-1"></a>

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-06-06-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Peterborough by-election.

**Archived source account.** The Labour Party holds the Peterborough seat in the by-election, defying predictions that they would lose the seat to the Brexit Party. The seat was vacated after a successful recall petition against its previous MP Fiona Onasanya.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2019/jun/07/peterborough-byelection-result-labour-sees-off-brexit-party-threat-to-hold-seat>).

<a id="event-2019-06-06-3-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Danish general election.

**Archived source account.** After the defeating of his party in the general election, Prime Minister Lars Løkke Rasmussen resigns, but will remain as acting in the office until his succession.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/denmark-election-fallout-1.5164534>).

<a id="event-2019-06-06-3-5"></a>

Context: Bolivarian diaspora.

**Archived source account.** In Peru, the president Martín Vizcarra's government decides to impose humanitarian visa and passport requirements on Venezuelan immigrants who wish to enter Peru, who flee the economic, social and political crisis in their country. This happens after the expulsion of 140 Venezuelan citizens with police records and amid a growing rejection of immigrants from the Peruvian population. He said that his goal is "to ensure an orderly and safe migration we are achieving it through eliminating the bad elements.".

Source citations (as archived): [Perú.21](<https://peru21.pe/peru/15-junio-venezolanos-entraran-peru-pasaporte-visa-anuncio-martin-vizcarra-expulsados-migraciones-482899>); [Gestión](<https://gestion.pe/economia/mercedes-araoz-migracion-venezolana-carga-duplica-nuestra-capacidad-ofrecer-empleos-servicios-269925>); [El Comercio](<https://elcomercio.pe/peru/55-limenos-acuerdo-llegada-migrantes-venezolanos-noticia-561949>).

Context: Syrian Civil War.

<a id="event-2019-06-07-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Authorities arrested Ashiqul Alam who allegedly planned to attack Times Square in New York City with grenades, guns and a suicide vest.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/06/07/nyregion/times-square-plot-attack.html>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/06/07/opinions/terrorist-plots-new-york-los-angeles-isis-campbell/index.html>).

#### Art and culture

<a id="event-2019-06-07-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** France returns three archaeological pieces to Peru that were seized by French customs in 2007. The artifacts, which date from between 1100 and 1450, are two clay statuettes and a wooden spear that belong to the Chancay and Chimú pre-Columbian cultures respectively.

Source citations (as archived): [Perú.21](<https://peru21.pe/peru/francia-devuelve-piezas-precolombinas-confiscadas-2007-482827>); [El Comercio](<https://elcomercio.pe/peru/francia-devuelve-peru-tres-piezas-prehispanicas-confiscadas-culturas-chancay-chimu-fotos-noticia-nndc-642424>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-06-07-2-1"></a>

Context: Boeing 737 MAX groundings.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Representatives Peter DeFazio and Rick Larsen of the House Transportation committee report Boeing discovered the 737 Max AOA Disagree alert problem in 2017 but decided to defer fixing it until 2020, and sped up the process only after the Lion Air Flight 610 crash.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-boeing-737/boeing-delayed-fix-of-defective-737-max-warning-light-for-three-years-u-s-lawmakers-idUSKCN1T8284?il=0>); [The Seattle Times](<https://www.seattletimes.com/business/boeing-aerospace/boeing-didnt-plan-to-fix-737-max-warning-light-until-2020/>).

<a id="event-2019-06-07-2-3"></a>

Context: Concerns over Chinese involvement in 5G wireless networks, Brazil-China relations.

**Archived source account.** Brazilian Vice President Hamilton Mourão says the government will not exclude Chinese telecom company Huawei Technologies Co. from operating a fifth-generation (5G) mobile telecom network.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-huawei-tech-brazil/brazil-will-not-bar-huawei-from-5g-network-vice-president-idUSKCN1T82BJ?il=0>).

**Archived source account.** Colombia’s top administrative court begins hearings on proposals to drill for oil using the technique known as fracking.

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-06-07-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Oman-registered bus carrying 31 passengers crashes into an overhead traffic sign in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, killing at least 17 people.

<a id="event-2019-06-07-3-2"></a>

Context: 2018–19 European windstorm season.

**Archived source account.** Three people on a rescue mission are killed when Storm Miguel, with max winds of 129 km/h (80 mph), overturned their National Society of Sea Rescue boat off the west coast of France in the Atlantic Ocean. The storm, unusual at the start of the summer tourist season, hit Spain, the Netherlands and southern England and Wales yesterday and is heading north toward England, Wales and Scotland.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48553351>); [AccuWeather](<https://www.accuweather.com/en/weather-news/storm-miguel-to-bring-wet-windy-weather-to-uk-on-friday-and-saturday/70008466>).

<a id="event-2019-06-07-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the United Kingdom, three hospital patients die from listeria linked to prepacked sandwiches from North Country Cooked Meats distributed via The Good Food Chain, which supplies 43 National Health Service trusts across the country. Three other patients are seriously ill. North Country Cooked Meats, and its distributor, North Country Quality Foods, voluntarily cease production while the investigation is ongoing.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-48557421>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/06/07/health/three-dead-listeria-contaminated-sandwiches-intl-scli-gbr/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-06-07-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. cruiser USS Chancellorsville and the Russian destroyer Admiral Vinogradov almost collide in the western Pacific Ocean. Each side blames the other, and their reports disagree as to the location of the incident: Russia claims it happened in the East China Sea, while the U.S. says it was in the nearby Philippine Sea.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-48553568>).

<a id="event-2019-06-07-5-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Gulf of Oman incident.

**Archived source account.** The United Arab Emirates tells the UN Security Council that a "state actor" was most likely behind the May 12 attacks on four tankers off its coast, including ones from Saudi Arabia and Norway. UAE did not say who it suspected; the United States blamed Iran which denied the accusation.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-48551125>).

<a id="event-2019-06-07-5-4"></a>

Context: Turkey–United States relations.

Context: Mexico–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Mexico and the United States reach a deal on migration, suspending tariffs on Mexican imports into the U.S. which were to take effect on June 10. Mexico agreed to increase its enforcement efforts along their southern border with Guatemala, including deploying troops from their upcoming National Guard.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/trump-tariff-mexico-president-says-cancels-plan-after-deal-reached-on-immigration-today-2019-06-08/>); [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2019/06/07/read-the-us-mexico-statement-on-immigration-that-averted-trumps-tariffs.html>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-06-10-4-1"></a>

Context: Phase-out of lightweight plastic bags.

**Archived source account.** Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau announces that Canada will ban all single-use plastics as early as 2021 in a bid to significantly reduce plastic pollution.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-48477087>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-06-10-5-1"></a>

Context: McStay family murder.

**Archived source account.** In San Bernardino, California, Charles "Chase" Merritt is found guilty of four counts of murder in the 2013 deaths of the McStay family.

Source citations (as archived): [The Los Angeles Times](<https://www.latimes.com/local/lanow/la-me-ln-mcstay-family-murders-verdict-20190610-story.html>).

<a id="event-2019-06-10-5-3"></a>

Context: Rape in India.

**Archived source account.** An Indian court convicts six men in the 2018 rape and murder of an eight-year-old girl near Kathua in the state of Jammu and Kashmir. Three of the men are given life sentences while the other three, found guilty of destroying evidence, receive five-year prison terms.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/06/10/731323696/indian-court-convicts-6-men-in-rape-and-murder-of-8-year-old-girl>).

<a id="event-2019-06-10-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Boston Red Sox star David Ortiz returns to Boston to recover from a shooting in the Dominican Republic.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/david-ortiz-shot-dominican-republic-nightclub-returns-boston-hospital-today-2019-06-10/>).

<a id="event-2019-06-10-5-6"></a>

Context: Internal conflict in Myanmar.

**Archived source account.** Two hundred Myanmar Army troops surround Pauktawbyin monastery in Rakhine State, demanding that they be allowed entry to search for Arakan Army insurgents possibly hiding in an IDP camp within the monastery. The head monk initially refused, saying that they would only allow inspections by people in civilian clothes, but later permitted their entry.

Source citations (as archived): [RFA](<https://www.rfa.org/english/news/myanmar/surround-06102019153007.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-06-10-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nechirvan Barzani is sworn in as the new President of Iraqi Kurdistan. In his first speech as President, Barzani says he will seek to improve ties with Baghdad, and create a joint-security plan to prevent ISIL from re-emerging in the region.

Source citations (as archived): [Rudaw](<http://www.rudaw.net/english/kurdistan/100620191>).

<a id="event-2019-06-10-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Congressman Justin Amash announces that he will leave the Freedom Caucus, weeks after calling for the impeachment of President Donald Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.com/amp/story/2019/06/10/justin-amash-house-freedom-caucus-1359614>).

### 2019-06-11

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1340585908](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20June%2011&oldid=1340585908>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-06-11-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The E3 2019 trailer for Pokémon Sword and Shield, scheduled to be released in November, causes controversy and unprecedented unanimous outrage among fans following the announcement that Pokémon absent from the Galar Pokédex cannot be transferred into the games, giving rise to the "Bring Back National Dex" hashtag among fans on Twitter.

Source citations (as archived): [Polygon](<https://www.polygon.com/e3/2019/6/13/18677717/pokemon-sword-shield-national-dex-pokedex-galar-e3-2019>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-06-11-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A committee of the US House of Representatives announces that it will hold a hearing next Thursday (June 20) to examine fuel efficiency standards, as the Trump administration presses for a rollback of an Obama-era schedule of 5% reductions in emissions per year.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-autos-emissions/u-s-house-committee-to-hold-hearing-on-proposed-fuel-efficiency-freeze-idUSKCN1TC2T0>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-06-11-2-1"></a>

Context: Sinking of Hableány.

**Archived source account.** Four bodies are recovered by salvage crews during the raising of the wreck of the Hableány, which sank on the Danube in Budapest last month. Four other people are still missing.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48591791>).

<a id="event-2019-06-11-2-3"></a>

Context: 2019 North Indian Ocean cyclone season.

**Archived source account.** Very Severe Cyclonic Storm Vayu is in the Arabian Sea less than 600 miles south-southeast of Karachi, Pakistan, and is strengthening as it heads north. Vayu is expected to be a Category 2 or 3 storm when it approaches the Indian state of Gujarat early Thursday (local time), then should weaken as it approaches southeastern Pakistan over the weekend.

Source citations (as archived): [The Weather Channel](<https://weather.com/storms/hurricane/news/2019-06-10-arabian-sea-tropical-cyclone-vayu-forecast-india-pakistan>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/06/cyclone-vayu-threatens-india-pakistan-190611090703282.html>).

<a id="event-2019-06-11-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A group of 65 Rohingya Muslims are left stranded on Rawi Island in southern Thailand after their boat shipwrecked during a journey to flee genocide in their native Rakhine State in Myanmar.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://ca.reuters.com/article/topNews/idCAKCN1TC1GX-OCATP>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/65-rohingya-muslims-found-shipwrecked-in-southern-thailand/2019/06/11/dbce3794-8c4e-11e9-b6f4-033356502dce_story.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-06-11-3-1"></a>

Context: Asbestos and the law.

**Archived source account.** The Congress of Colombia unanimously approves a resolution to ban the production, commercialization, and distribution of asbestos.

Source citations (as archived): [El Tiempo](<https://www.eltiempo.com/politica/congreso/prohiben-uso-del-asbesto-en-colombia-proyecto-paso-ultimo-debate-en-el-congreso-374088>).

<a id="event-2019-06-11-3-3"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Botswana.

**Archived source account.** Botswana decriminalizes homosexuality.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-48594162>).

<a id="event-2019-06-11-3-5"></a>

Context: Media freedom in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Following a public outcry, authorities in Russia drop drug charges against a journalist, Ivan Golunov, who has earned a reputation for exposing the corruption of Moscow city officials.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-journalist-free/russia-in-rare-u-turn-after-public-anger-drops-case-against-journalist-idUSKCN1TC1QW>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48600233>).

<a id="event-2019-06-11-3-7"></a>

Context: Censorship in Samoa.

**Archived source account.** Samoa bans the film Rocketman for its depictions of gay sex.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-48593691>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-06-11-4-1"></a>

Context: North Korea–United States relations, List of North Korean missile tests.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump says he received a "beautiful", "very warm and very nice" letter from North Korean leader Kim Jong-un. He added that Kim is "keeping his word" and not testing any kind of missiles. Earlier at a speaking event in Washington, National Security Adviser John Bolton said North Korea is not complying with the terms agreed upon during Trump's first summit with Kim in Singapore last year.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-06-11/trump-says-he-got-beautiful-letter-from-kim-but-no-meeting>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/trump-praises-kim-jong-un-saying-he-received-a-beautiful-letter-from-him/2019/06/11/4359f4d6-8c70-11e9-b08e-cfd89bd36d4e_story.html>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/06/11/politics/trump-north-korea-kim-jong-un-letter-john-bolton/index.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-06-11-5-1"></a>

Context: 2019 FIFA Women's World Cup.

**Archived source account.** The USA's 13–0 defeat of Thailand sets a World Cup record for margin of victory for either men or women, and Alex Morgan's five goals ties a tournament record.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! Sports](<https://sports.yahoo.com/usa-womens-world-cup-uswnt-thailand-score-205248875.html>).

### 2019-06-12

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087895488](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20June%2012&oldid=1087895488>).

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2019-06-12-0-1"></a>

Context: Abha International Airport attack.

**Archived source account.** A ballistic missile fired by Houthi forces strikes the arrivals hall at Abha International Airport in Saudi Arabia, injuring 26 people.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/06/12/middleeast/saudi-airport-houthi-missile-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-06-12-0-3"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir.

**Archived source account.** Militants kill five Indian paramilitary police in Anantnag district. Three paramilitaries, a local policeman and a woman bystander are wounded, and one militant is killed.

Source citations (as archived): [NDTV](<https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/terrorists-attack-police-party-in-jammu-and-kashmirs-anantnag-2052165>).

<a id="event-2019-06-12-0-5"></a>

Context: Sudanese protests.

**Archived source account.** Sudanese military and opposition leaders agree to resume talks that broke down after a violent crackdown on protesters earlier in June. The military also agrees to release political prisoners, while the opposition agrees to end its campaign of strikes and civil disobedience.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-48602868>).

<a id="event-2019-06-12-0-7"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Australia.

**Archived source account.** Clavell brothers rammed a police car and then lunged at police with a knife and a tomahawk before they were shot on Wednesday afternoon by Victorian police.

Source citations (as archived): [9News](<https://www.9news.com.au/national/barnawartha-albury-police-shooting-two-men-suspected-terror-links-nsw-victoria-police-news-australia/f2b85b9a-d91b-4a67-91b5-062d4ad83d7d>).

#### Business and finance

<a id="event-2019-06-12-1-1"></a>

Context: China–United States trade war.

**Archived source account.** Chinese telecommunications and electronics company Huawei cancels its new laptop launch. A Huawei executive said the company has been "unable to supply the PC" because of the U.S. trade blacklist and may have to scrap the project.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-48609747>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2019/may/19/google-huawei-trump-blacklist-report>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-06-12-2-1"></a>

Context: Bolivarian diaspora.

**Archived source account.** A speedboat carrying migrants reportedly sinks off the coast of Venezuela en route to Curaçao, making it the third migrant boat leaving Venezuela to sink in as many months, with over 50 people missing.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-48607330>).

<a id="event-2019-06-12-2-3"></a>

Context: Indian Air Force An-32 crash.

**Archived source account.** The wreckage of An-32 aircraft was found in Arunachal Pradesh with all 13 people on board killed.

Source citations (as archived): [India Today](<https://www.indiatoday.in/india/story/an32-crash-site-arunachal-iaf-black-box-recorder-1548103-2019-06-13>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-06-12-3-1"></a>

Context: Kivu Ebola epidemic.

**Archived source account.** Wellcome Trust director Dr. Jeremy Farrar says the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, which has killed 1,400 people since August 2018, is the worst since the 2013–2016 outbreak in West Africa and shows "no sign of stopping". Uganda reported its first two deaths.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-48615667>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-06-12-4-1"></a>

Context: Japan–United States relations, Iran–Japan relations, Iran–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Japan offers to mediate between Iran and the U.S.; officials say the Japanese government hopes to rescue the landmark 2015 international nuclear deal.

Source citations (as archived): [Financial Tribune](<https://financialtribune.com/articles/national/97908/japan-offers-to-mediate-between-iran-us>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-japan-usa/iran-to-ask-japans-abe-to-mediate-over-us-oil-sanctions-officials-idUSKCN1TD0RJ>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-06-12-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Reuters reports, on the basis of an unnamed "senior administration" source, that the administration of U.S. President Donald Trump is pressuring the government of Saudi Arabia to show some progress in its investigation of the murder of Jamal Khashoggi before the one-year anniversary in October.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-khashoggi-usa/u-s-pushes-for-saudi-progress-on-khashoggi-probe-before-anniversary-of-killing-idUSKCN1TC2RY>).

<a id="event-2019-06-12-5-2"></a>

Context: Trial of Catalonia independence leaders.

**Archived source account.** The trial of the leaders involved in the Catalan declaration of independence ends and is remitted to decision. A verdict is not expected until after August.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/2019/06/12/last-day-of-trial-for-catalan-leaders>).

<a id="event-2019-06-12-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two Canadian women who were abducted in Ghana are rescued by Ghanaian police.

Source citations (as archived): [CTV News](<https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/ottawa-very-relieved-after-2-canadian-women-abducted-in-ghana-rescued-1.4462634>).

<a id="event-2019-06-12-5-5"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2019 college admissions bribery scandal.

**Archived source account.** Former Stanford University sailing coach John Vandemoer is sentenced to two-years probation, with the first six months to be served under house arrest. Vandemoer is the first person to be sentenced among the 50 individuals indicted on federal charges related to the U.S. college admissions bribery scheme.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<https://www.latimes.com/local/lanow/la-me-college-admissions-scandal-stanford-john-vandemoer-sentenced-20190612-story.html>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2019/06/12/no-prison-first-defendant-bribery-scandal-college/1429812001/>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/06/12/us/college-admissions-scandal-stanford.html>).

<a id="event-2019-06-12-5-7"></a>

Context: Same-sex marriage in Ecuador.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of Ecuador legalizes same-sex marriage.

Source citations (as archived): [France24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20190613-ecuador-highest-court-approves-same-sex-marriage>).

<a id="event-2019-06-12-5-9"></a>

Context: Abortion in the United States by state.

**Archived source account.** Illinois Governor J. B. Pritzker signs abortion rights law making the procedure a "fundamental right" for pregnant individuals in the state.

Source citations (as archived): [Chicago Tribune](<https://www.chicagotribune.com/politics/ct-met-illinois-abortion-rights-law-governor-jb-pritzker-20190612-story.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-06-12-6-1"></a>

Context: Hong Kong extradition law controversy.

**Archived source account.** The Legislative Council delays "to a later time" the second reading of the new legislation on extradition as thousands of protesters, who blocked key roads around government buildings, were confronted by police in riot gear using pepper spray. Despite widespread opposition, the government had said it will continue to push for passage.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-48591001>).

<a id="event-2019-06-12-6-3"></a>

Context: Media freedom in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russian authorities detain hundreds of protesters, including Novaya Gazeta journalist and protest organizer Ilya Azar and other reporters, at an "unauthorized march" in Moscow demanding punishment for police who detained anti-corruption journalist Ivan Golunov. Golunov's charges were dropped and he was released yesterday at which time Interior Minister Vladimir Kolokoltsev said some officers who had taken part in his detention were suspended pending an investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48607317>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-journalist-free/russia-in-rare-u-turn-after-public-anger-drops-case-against-journalist-idUSKCN1TC1QW>).

<a id="event-2019-06-12-6-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The House Oversight Committee votes to hold Attorney General William Barr and Commerce Secretary Wilbur Ross in contempt after U.S. President Donald Trump asserted executive privilege over materials related to the committee's census investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/ag-barr-trump-invoke-privilege-census-materials-dems/story?id=63639998>).

<a id="event-2019-06-12-6-6"></a>

Context: Operation Car Wash.

**Archived source account.** More text messages between judge Sérgio Moro and prosecutor Deltan Dallagnol are leaked, implicating Vice-President of the Supreme Federal Court Luiz Fux in illicit collaboration between Brazilian judges and Car Wash's team of prosecutors.

Source citations (as archived): [Veja](<https://veja.abril.com.br/politica/in-fux-we-trust-disse-moro-a-deltan-em-mensagem-vazada/>).

<a id="event-2019-06-12-6-8"></a>

Context: Bolivarian diaspora.

**Archived source account.** The Peruvian Catholic Church urges the government of that country to continue receiving Venezuelan immigrants. He also expressed concern about the "increase in the negative perception of migrants." This, after the president Martín Vizcarra decided to demand visa and passport for Venezuelan citizens who wish to enter Peru.

Source citations (as archived): [Gestión](<https://gestion.pe/mundo/iglesia-pide-peru-siga-acogiendo-venezolanos-visa-269969>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-06-12-7-1"></a>

Context: List of nearest exoplanets, Doppler Spectroscopy.

**Archived source account.** A study on exoplanet populations combining decades of data from several different observatories detects 118 possible exoplanets orbiting nearby red dwarfs, including new discoveries around nearby stars Wolf 359, Lacaille 9352, Struve 2398 B, and Luyten's Star.

Source citations (as archived): [Arxiv](<https://arxiv.org/abs/1906.04644>).

<a id="event-2019-06-12-7-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Despite dense fog, SpaceX successfully launches the Canadian Space Agency's RADARSAT Constellation satellites on a Falcon 9 rocket from Vandenberg Air Force Base.

Source citations (as archived): [CNET](<https://www.cnet.com/news/spacex-pulls-off-dazzling-falcon-9-launch-in-thick-fog/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-06-12-8-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Stanley Cup Finals.

**Archived source account.** In ice hockey, the St. Louis Blues defeat the Boston Bruins four games to three to win their first Stanley Cup.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS Sports](<https://www.cbssports.com/nhl/news/stanley-cup-final-2019-blues-stifle-bruins-4-1-in-game-7-to-win-first-title-in-team-history/>).

### 2019-06-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256158730](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20June%2013&oldid=1256158730>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-06-13-0-1"></a>

Context: June 2019 Gulf of Oman incident, Iran–United States relations, Iran–Saudi Arabia relations.

**Archived source account.** Two oil tankers, one Norwegian and one Japanese, are damaged and abandoned after being attacked in the Gulf of Oman, with all crew members aboard both ships safely rescued.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-48619771>).

<a id="event-2019-06-13-0-2"></a>

Context: June 2019 Gulf of Oman incident, Iran–United States relations, Iran–Saudi Arabia relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States Secretary of State Mike Pompeo and Saudi Arabia Foreign Minister Adel al-Jubeir directly blame Iran for being behind the attacks on both ships. Iranian officials deny the U.S. claims.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-48630374>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-tankers-saudi/saudi-arabia-agrees-iran-was-behind-tanker-attacks-saudi-minister-idUSKCN1TE36X>).

<a id="event-2019-06-13-0-3"></a>

Context: June 2019 Gulf of Oman incident, Iran–United States relations, Iran–Saudi Arabia relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States Central Command (CENTCOM) releases a video showing what CENTCOM spokesperson says, is an Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps' patrol boat approaching the Kokuka Courageous "and was observed and recorded removing an unexploded limpet mine from the M/T Kokuka Courageous." Iran denies involvement.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<https://www.apnews.com/6a48842e263541a5b3451f0d41dee01a>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-tanker/u-s-blames-iran-for-tanker-attacks-in-gulf-of-oman-iran-rejects-assertion-idUSKCN1TE0OI>).

<a id="event-2019-06-13-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A suicide bomber kills eleven and injures thirteen in an attack in Jalalabad, Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://reut.rs/2MMsrTF>); [News18](<https://www.news18.com/news/world/11-killed-13-injured-in-suicide-bombing-in-afghanistan-isis-afghan-arm-claims-responsibility-2186029.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-06-13-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** One of the towers of the centuries-old Citadel of Ghazni, Afghanistan, collapses amid heavy rainfall.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-48629680>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-06-13-2-1"></a>

Context: Flint water crisis.

**Archived source account.** Michigan Attorney General Dana Nessel announces that charges will be dropped against eight people in the Flint water crisis and investigations will be restarted in the scandal, which has plagued the city since 2014.

Source citations (as archived): [Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/michigan-drops-charges-in-flint-water-case-as-it-restarts-investigation-11560452731>); [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/policy/healthcare/state-issues/448419-prosecutors-drop-flint-water-charges-restart-investigation>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-06-13-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Office of Special Counsel (OSC) recommends that the Trump administration remove Kellyanne Conway from her office as senior aide to President Trump because of her repeated violations of the Hatch Act of 1939. The Trump administration rejects the OSC's recommendations, saying they "are deeply flawed and violate \[Conway's\] constitutional rights to free speech and due process."

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2019/06/13/watchdog-kellyanne-conway-should-removed-political-statements/1444402001/>).

<a id="event-2019-06-13-3-2"></a>

Context: List of Trump administration dismissals and resignations.

**Archived source account.** White House Press Secretary Sarah Huckabee Sanders announces she will resign at the end of June.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/sarah-sanders-leaving-white-house-1.5174520>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-06-13-4-1"></a>

Context: Twitter suspensions.

**Archived source account.** Twitter says it has removed thousands of accounts that were being run by the Iranian government, to spread propaganda and fake news on the social media platform. It has also removed over a hundred accounts linked to the Catalan independence movement, and dozens of accounts related to Venezuela.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-twitter-iran/twitter-deletes-thousands-of-accounts-tied-to-iran-seeks-to-end-false-info-campaigns-idUSKCN1TE2I9>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-06-13-5-1"></a>

Context: 2019 NBA Finals.

**Archived source account.** In basketball, the Toronto Raptors defeat the Golden State Warriors four games to two to win their first NBA championship. The Toronto Raptors are also the first NBA team outside of the United States and the first from Canada to win the NBA Finals.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<https://www.latimes.com/sports/nba/la-sp-raptors-warriors-game-6-20190613-story.html>); [Business Insider](<https://www.businessinsider.com/raptors-win-nba-championship-over-warriors-2019-6>).

### 2019-06-14

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087895878](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20June%2014&oldid=1087895878>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-06-14-0-1"></a>

Context: June 2019 Gulf of Oman incident.

**Archived source account.** An unnamed United States official claims that, just prior to the attack on two merchant vessels, an Iranian vessel launched a surface to air missile at a MQ-9 Reaper drone in the vicinity of the attack. An additional MQ-9 Reaper is reported to have been shot down by Houthi rebels several days prior in the Red Sea.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/06/14/politics/us-drone-tracked-iranian-boats/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-06-14-0-2"></a>

Context: June 2019 Gulf of Oman incident.

**Archived source account.** The president of the Japanese shipping company offers a different account of the attack than that provided by the United States. Yutaka Katada says the Filipino crew of the Kokuka Courageous oil tanker said their vessel was apparently first hit by an artillery shell rather than a mine. The United States said the tanker was attacked by limpet mines and released a video it says shows Iranian special forces removing an unexploded mine from the oil tanker's side.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/japanese-ship-owner-contradicts-us-account-of-how-tanker-was-attacked/2019/06/14/7ea347d0-8eba-11e9-b6f4-033356502dce_story.html?utm_term=.df5f200cba2a>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-48633016>).

<a id="event-2019-06-14-0-3"></a>

Context: June 2019 Gulf of Oman incident.

**Archived source account.** A U.S. official says Iranian Navy gunboats are preventing the damaged Norwegian-owned Front Altair oil tanker from being towed away by two private tugboats in the Gulf of Oman.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-attacks-usa-tugboats/iran-fast-boats-preventing-towing-of-damaged-altair-tanker-source-idUSKCN1TF2AP>).

<a id="event-2019-06-14-0-4"></a>

Context: June 2019 Gulf of Oman incident.

**Archived source account.** United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres calls for an independent investigation to establish the facts and responsibility for the oil tankers attacks in the Gulf of Oman.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-attacks-un/u-n-chief-calls-for-independent-probe-into-gulf-tanker-attacks-idUSKCN1TF24W?il=0>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-06-14-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 61 people have been killed and 356,000 evacuated from their homes as heavy rain and floods swept through large parts of southern and central China this week.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-06-14-2-1"></a>

Context: Iran–Japan relations, Iran–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Kyodo News Agency reports that during his visit to mediate between the U.S. and Iran, Japanese PM Shinzō Abe asked Iran to release American prisoners held by Iran, though the response is "unclear" to the press. But Iran says it will not negotiate with the United States, rejecting Abe's bid to broker dialogue between the two countries amid escalating tensions in the Middle East. Iranian Foreign Minister Javad Zarif accuses the "B-Team" (Mohammed bin Salman, John Bolton and Benjamin Netanyahu) of sabotaging diplomacy, including Abe's meeting, to hide its "economic terrorism" by accusing Iran of attacking oil tankers.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/japans-abe-asked-iran-to-release-us-hostages-report-says-but-the-response-is-unclear/2019/06/13/43e501e0-8e4e-11e9-b162-8f6f41ec3c04_story.html?noredirect=on&amp;utm_term=.2abd005bad62>); [Kyodo News](<https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2019/06/ad9943adea62-japan-scrambles-for-information-on-ship-attacks-near-strait-of-hormuz.html>).

<a id="event-2019-06-14-2-3"></a>

Context: Cyprus—Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** European Union Mediterranean state leaders offer full support to fellow EU member Cyprus in its dispute with Turkey over offshore natural gas deposit ownership. French President Emmanuel Macron, speaking for the EU, urges Turkey to stop “illegal activities” in Cyprus’s exclusive economic zone.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-eu-summit-mediterranean/southern-eu-leaders-back-cyprus-in-gas-dispute-with-turkey-idUSKCN1TF2JG?il=0>); [Reuters²](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-eu-france-macron/frances-macron-sides-with-cyprus-on-dispute-with-turkey-idUSKCN1TF2FO?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-06-14-3-1"></a>

Context: Transgender personnel in the United States military.

**Archived source account.** The Ninth U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals, without ruling on the merits, orders U.S. District Judge Marsha Pechman (Seattle) to reconsider her ruling against the ban of most transgender people from the military, stating she did not give the military’s judgment enough deference.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-transgender/trump-wins-u-s-court-victory-in-quest-for-transgender-military-ban-idUSKCN1TF1ZM>).

Context: Presidency of Jair Bolsonaro.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-06-15-0-1"></a>

Context: Yemeni Crisis (2011–present).

**Archived source account.** Yemen-based Houthi forces launch drone strikes on Jizan Regional Airport and Abha International Airport in Saudi Arabia. A Saudi Arabian-led coalition spokesperson says a Houthi drone has been shot down near the Saudi city of Abha.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-saudi-drone/yemens-houthis-target-two-saudi-airports-with-multiple-drone-attacks-idUSKCN1TG0M3>).

<a id="event-2019-06-15-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** 12 Kenyan police officers are killed when their vehicle hits a roadside bomb in east Wajir County, near the Somali border. No one has claimed responsibility, though the police had been pursuing suspected al-Shabab militants fighting Somalia's government and its backers.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-48648777>); [Region week](<https://regionweek.com/kenya-12-police-officers-killed-in-attack-in-wajir-county-along-the-border-with-somalia/>).

<a id="event-2019-06-15-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Twin explosions rock Mogadishu killing 11 and injuring over 25. The first bomb went off near a checkpoint for the presidential palace killing nine and the other bomb killed the two occupants in the vehicle. Al Shabbab claimed responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<https://time.com/5607825/11-killed-explosions-somalia-mogadishu/>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/06/somalia-killed-al-shabab-attacks-mogadishu-190615165754730.html>).

It also clarified that in the five cases in which patients died, death was caused by complications with other serious diseases.

Do I believe it? Not particularly". The U.S. Navy recently updated its guidelines for how its pilots can report "unidentified aircraft".

Context: Colombia–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** Colombian authorities deport Venezuelan refugees in the border town of Cúcuta; in response, the Venezuelan government restricts movement of Colombians into the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/06/colombia-deports-undocumented-venezuelans-entering-cucuta-190618123624569.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-06-18-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** It is reported that Roberto Marrero, aide to Venezuela's partially-recognized interim President Juan Guaidó, who was arrested several months ago, has his preliminary hearing completed, with Judge Carol Padilla denying his right to defense and ordering his incarceration.

Source citations (as archived): [El Universal](<http://www.eluniversal.com/politica/43195/joel-garcia-roberto-marrero-sigue-en-privativa-de-libertad>).

<a id="event-2019-06-18-3-2"></a>

Context: Immigration policy of Donald Trump, Immigration to the United States.

**Archived source account.** A three-judge panel of federal appeal court judges from the ninth circuit hears arguments concerning a 2017 ruling that U.S. authorities breached the Flores Settlement Agreement's order on holding undocumented immigrant children in "safe and sanitary" conditions. The Department of Justice is seeking relief because the order imposes “new substantive requirements” for the detention of immigrant children that aren’t laid out in the settlement. The panel will issue a ruling at a later date.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/panel-hears-case-on-conditions-for-young-migrants-on-border/2019/06/18/0f472394-921f-11e9-956a-88c291ab5c38_story.html?utm_term=.cf6806f03c76>); [Bay City News](<https://www.nbcbayarea.com/news/local/SF-Court-Hears-Arguments-on-Conditions-for-Undocumented--511500272.html>); [Newsweek](<https://www.newsweek.com/migrant-children-border-trump-administration-1445090>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-06-18-4-2"></a>

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump / Donald Trump 2020 presidential campaign.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump's speech at a rally in Orlando, Florida is billed as the official launch of his re-election campaign for the 2020 United States presidential election. He previously filed on January 20, 2017 paperwork with the Federal Election Commission (FEC) officially announcing his bid for the 2020 presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live/2019/jun/18/trump-2020-campaign-election-launch-speech-live-news-today-latest-updates-orlando-florida>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/06/trump-officially-kick-2020-election-campaign-190618220218310.html>); [The Atlantic](<https://www.theatlantic.com/ideas/archive/2019/06/trump-cant-relaunch-a-campaign-that-never-stopped/591949/>).

<a id="event-2019-06-18-4-4"></a>

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump / Political appointments by Donald Trump, Cabinet of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** Patrick Shanahan, who has been acting Secretary of Defense since January 1, has withdrawn his name from consideration as Secretary "... to devote more time to his family", President Trump said. Secretary of the Army Mark Esper will be the acting Secretary of Defense. There are allegations of domestic violence against Mr. Shanahan.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-48665798>).

<a id="event-2019-06-18-4-6"></a>

Context: Corruption in Venezuela.

**Archived source account.** Partially-recognized Interim President of Venezuela Juan Guaidó and Venezuelan Ambassador to Colombia Humberto Calderón Berti request that the Colombian government investigate two administrators of their own alliance on suspicion of embezzling US$100,000.

Source citations (as archived): [WSJ](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/venezuela-opposition-threatened-by-embezzlement-allegations-11560904989>).

<a id="event-2019-06-18-4-8"></a>

Context: 2019 Conservative Party leadership election.

**Archived source account.** Boris Johnson leads the second Tory MP leadership ballot. Dominic Raab is eliminated after coming in last. Jeremy Hunt, Michael Gove, Sajid Javid, and Rory Stewart all advance to tomorrow's third round.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-48680189>).

<a id="event-2019-06-18-4-10"></a>

Context: Operation Car Wash.

**Archived source account.** Another batch of text messages between Brazilian judge Sérgio Moro and Operation Car Wash's prosecutors are leaked. The messages state that Moro advised lead prosecutor Deltan Dallagnol and the other prosecutors to halt any investigations on Fernando Henrique Cardoso, former President of Brazil and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's political rival. Moro is quoted as saying the investigations would "offend someone whose support is important".

Source citations (as archived): [The Intercept](<https://theintercept.com/2019/06/18/lava-jato-fingiu-investigar-fhc-apenas-para-criar-percepcao-publica-de-imparcialidade-mas-moro-repreendeu-melindra-alguem-cujo-apoio-e-importante/>); [Brasil Wire](<http://www.brasilwire.com/podemos-tirar-lava-jatos-protection-of-fernando-henrique-cardoso/>).

### 2019-06-19

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087928376](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20June%2019&oldid=1087928376>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-06-19-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Li Ka-shing, "Hong Kong's richest man", pledges to pay, via his charitable foundation, the tuition fees of the Shantou University's 2019 incoming class for up to five years.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-48686629>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-06-19-1-1"></a>

Context: Venezuelan refugee crisis.

**Archived source account.** The UN predicts that over five million Venezuelans, over 15% of the nation's population, will have left the country by the end of 2019 since the start of the crisis in Venezuela—the total at the end of 2018 was 3.3 million. One million have left the country since November, with a daily average of 5,000 departures. Additionally, over 20% of all worldwide UN asylum requests are from Venezuelans; 350,000 applied in 2018 alone.

Source citations (as archived): [Financial Times](<https://www.ft.com/content/ff6053e4-92b2-11e9-aea1-2b1d33ac3271>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-06-19-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Millions of people in southeast India face water shortages due to drought and depleted groundwater.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/india-water-shortage-drought-chennai-1.5181641>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-06-19-3-1"></a>

Context: Japan–North Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** The Japanese coast guard says its patrol boats have been pushing back hundreds of North Korean boats trying to poach in fishing grounds rich with squid off Japan's northern coast.

Source citations (as archived): [Japan Today](<https://japantoday.com/category/national/japan-pushes-300-north-korean-boats-out-of-fishing-grounds>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-06-19-4-1"></a>

Context: Malaysia Airlines Flight 17.

**Archived source account.** Four people, three Russians and a Ukrainian, will be charged with murder for the crash that killed 298 people on July 17, 2014. The trial is to be held on March 9, 2020 and take place in Badhoevedorp, Netherlands.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/06/19/europe/malaysia-airlines-flight-17-suspects-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-06-19-4-2"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/06/19/734116183/nxivm-leader-keith-raniere-found-guilty-of-all-charges-in-sex-cult-case>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-06-19-5-1"></a>

Context: Assassination of Jamal Khashoggi.

**Archived source account.** Saudi Minister of State for Foreign Affairs Adel al-Jubeir says that the UN's report on the killing of journalist Jamal Khashoggi is unfounded, saying it has "clear contradictions and baseless allegations."

Source citations (as archived): [Gulf News](<https://gulfnews.com/world/gulf/saudi/al-jubeir-uns-khashoggi-report-unfounded-1.64710430>).

<a id="event-2019-06-19-5-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Conservative Party leadership election.

**Archived source account.** Rory Stewart is eliminated after coming in fifth place in today's third round voting. The front runner remains Boris Johnson. Jeremy Hunt, Michael Gove, and Sajid Javid came in second, third, and fourth respectively. A fourth round will be taken tomorrow.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-48696619>).

<a id="event-2019-06-19-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The House Democrats vote to repeal the Authorization for Use of Military Force Against Terrorists, which is used to authorize war.

Source citations (as archived): [Vox](<https://www.vox.com/policy-and-politics/2019/6/19/18691936/house-democrats-vote-repeal-9-11-aumf-war-iran>); [HuffPost](<https://www.huffpost.com/entry/2001-aumf-house-repeal_n_5d0aa028e4b0f7b7442b6c40>).

Context: Persecution of homosexuals in Nazi Germany.

**Archived source account.** A ceremony is held at the former site of Germany’s Buchenwald concentration camp to remember people imprisoned there because they were thought to be gay.

Source citations (as archived): [Japan Times](<https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2019/06/24/world/social-issues-world/nazi-branded-gay-prisoners-remembered-buchenwald-camp-site/#.XRAUbuhKjcc>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-06-23-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** Chilean President Sebastián Piñera says he agrees with Argentine President Mauricio Macri that the "corrupt dictatorship of Maduro has its days numbered".

Source citations (as archived): [ABC ES](<https://www.abc.es/internacional/abci-sebastian-pinera-dictadura-corrupta-maduro-tiene-dias-contados-201906222104_noticia.html>).

<a id="event-2019-06-23-2-3"></a>

Context: Venezuelan refugee crisis.

**Archived source account.** Chile is extending its offer of "democratic responsibility" visas, allowing Venezuelans to live in the country for up to two years, so that they may be applied for from any Chilean embassy or consulate in the world instead of just in Venezuela. However, Chile border control now also demands visas upon entry for Venezuelans, a tightening of the previous 90-day free period. The move should aid Venezuelans trying to travel through other Latin American nations that have changing restrictions.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-chile-venezuela-immigration/chile-offers-democratic-responsibility-visa-to-venezuelan-migrants-idUSKCN1TN0MN>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-06-23-3-1"></a>

Context: June 2019 Istanbul mayoral election.

**Archived source account.** The re-run Istanbul mayoral election concludes with a victory for opposition leader Ekrem İmamoğlu and defeat for the ruling AK Party.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-48739256>).

<a id="event-2019-06-23-3-3"></a>

Context: 2019 in the Czech Republic.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of thousands take to the streets of Prague to demand the resignation of Czech Prime Minister Andrej Babiš in the country's biggest protest since the Velvet Revolution in 1989.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-48737467>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/06/23/europe/czech-republic-babis-protest-intl/index.html>).

### 2019-06-24

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1328665392](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20June%2024&oldid=1328665392>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-06-24-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Amhara Region coup d'état attempt.

**Archived source account.** The Attorney General of Ethiopia's Amhara Region, Migbaru Kebede, dies after having been wounded during the coup attempt two days earlier. Asaminew Tsige, the general suspected to be behind the coup attempt, had been reportedly killed by security forces.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/ethiopia-amhara-attorney-general-dies-after-coup-effort/a-49329224>).

<a id="event-2019-06-24-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Men in camouflage kill 50 in Bahir Dar, Ethiopia

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ethiopia-security-violence/more-than-50-killed-in-attacks-in-western-ethiopia-regional-official-idUSKCN1TR2FI>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-06-24-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two German Air Force Eurofighter Typhoon fighter jets collide in mid-air and crash near Lake Müritz in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern. Both pilots are able to eject before the crash, but only one survives.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/two-eurofighters-collide-over-northern-germany/a-49332147>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-06-24-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights Michelle Bachelet says the tens of thousands of Islamic State fighters and family members being held in Iraq and Syria must be tried or released, and calls on countries to take responsibility for their citizens and take them back if not charged.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-48742972>).

<a id="event-2019-06-24-2-2"></a>

Context: Iran and state-sponsored terrorism, Terrorism in Europe.

**Archived source account.** The British newspaper Independent in Arabic quotes an intelligence source as saying that in 2018 Iran had delivered half a ton of TATP explosives in diplomatic packages to a civilian plane that was supposed to be transferred to Paris to carry out an attack in the city.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/Middle-East/Iran-attempted-attack-in-Paris-half-a-ton-of-explosives-found-report-593523>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-06-24-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Diane Madison, the mother of American serial killer Michael Madison, is stabbed to death in her home. Three children are also injured. Her grandson Jalen Plummer is arrested and charged with aggravated murder and felonious assault.

Source citations (as archived): [Cleveland.com](<https://www.cleveland.com/metro/2019/06/man-charged-in-slaying-of-serial-killer-michael-madisons-mother-stabbing-of-three-sleeping-kids-in-cleveland.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-06-24-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Defense Minister of Peru, José Huerta, suddenly dies of cardiac arrest while worked.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN en Español](<https://cnnespanol.cnn.com/2019/06/24/muere-el-ministro-de-defensa-de-peru-jose-huerta-torres/>); [Perú.21](<https://peru21.pe/politica/murio-jose-huerta-ministro-defensa-fallecio-infarto-486285>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-06-24-5-1"></a>

Context: Methane on Mars.

**Archived source account.** NASA announces that its Curiosity rover has detected the largest ever measurement of methane on Mars.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-48743551>).

<a id="event-2019-06-24-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Soyuz MS-11 returned to Earth, landing in Kazakhstan, from the International Space Station carrying Canadian David Saint-Jacques, American Anne McClain and Russian Oleg Kononenko. The astronauts and cosmonaut spent 204 days aboard the ISS, a record for Canada.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/technology/david-saint-jacques-1.5187999>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-06-24-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The 2026 Winter Olympics are selected to be held in Milan and Cortina d'Ampezzo, Italy.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/winter-olympics/48748380>).

### 2019-06-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087929511](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20June%2025&oldid=1087929511>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-06-25-0-2"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War / Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabia announces that Abu Usama al-Muhajir, the leader of ISIL's Yemeni branch, has been captured by special forces.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2019/06/25/world/middleeast/25reuters-yemen-security-isis.html>).

<a id="event-2019-06-25-0-4"></a>

Context: Sinai insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Suspected ISIL militants attack checkpoints and an assembly center in the Egyptian city of Arish. Seven police officers are killed, along with a civilian. Four militants also died, including one that blew himself up.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/06/egypt-7-policemen-killed-sinai-attack-190626094845949.html>).

<a id="event-2019-06-25-0-6"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Boko Haram militants open fire on farmers in Borno State, killing 22.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-06/27/c_138176314.htm>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-06-25-1-1"></a>

Context: Safety of electronic cigarettes.

**Archived source account.** San Francisco becomes the first U.S. city to ban the sale of electronic cigarettes (vapes) until the health effects of using them are better understood. Juul, the largest producer of e-cigarettes in the United States, which is based in the city, condemns the ban saying the move will drive people back to tobacco smoking and will create a black market.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-48752929>).

<a id="event-2019-06-25-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** AbbVie, the Illinois-based pharmaceutical company best known for Humira, announces its plan to purchase Allergan, the maker of Botox, for about $63 billion.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-allergan-m-a-abbvie/abbvie-looks-beyond-humira-with-63-billion-deal-for-botox-maker-allergan-idUSKCN1TQ15X>).

<a id="event-2019-06-25-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe announces that, effective immediately, foreign currencies such as the United States dollar or South African rand will no longer be legal tender in the country, and that any use of foreign currency within Zimbabwe will be a punishable offense.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/zimbabwe-shuts-out-foreign-currency-to-tighten-economy/a-49347739>).

<a id="event-2019-06-25-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Chamber of Commerce of Lima warns that just under a million Peruvians are at risk of returning to poverty.

Source citations (as archived): [La República](<https://larepublica.pe/economia/2019/06/24/ccl-mas-de-957-mil-peruanos-en-riesgo-de-regresar-a-la-pobreza/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-06-25-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** One woman dies and 21 people are affected after eating lunch in a Seventh-day Adventist church in the district of Sorochuco, department of Cajamarca, in Peru. The causes of the poisoning are not yet clear.

Source citations (as archived): [El Comercio](<https://elcomercio.pe/peru/cajamarca/cajamarca-muerto-intoxicacion-21-afectados-almuerzo-noticia-nndc-649112>).

<a id="event-2019-06-25-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A brush fire burns at least 32,000 acres of land in the Florida Everglades amid near record-breaking temperatures.

Source citations (as archived): [Accuweather](<https://www.accuweather.com/en/weather-news/big-brush-fire-burning-in-florida-everglades-explodes-overnight-doubles-in-size/70008650>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-06-25-3-1"></a>

Context: Iran–Saudi Arabia relations, Iran–United Arab Emirates relations, Bahrain–Iran relations.

**Archived source account.** Iran's special advisor to the parliament speaker, Hossein Amir Abdollahian, says Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Bahrain are "toying with regional security by giving territories to a foreign power".

Source citations (as archived): [Middle East Monitor](<https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20190625-iran-warns-saudi-arabia-uae-bahrain-of-toying-with-regional-security/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-06-25-4-1"></a>

Context: Cannabis in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Illinois becomes the 11th U.S. state to legalize the recreational use of cannabis. The bill, signed into law by Governor of Illinois J. B. Pritzker, will also remove criminal records for purchasing or possessing 30 grams or less of cannabis.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.apnews.com/7b793d88f3c84417b83db0f770854960>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-06-25-5-1"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Japan.

**Archived source account.** Ibaraki Prefecture says it will start issuing partnership certificates for lesbian, gay and transgender couples starting July 1. It would be the first such prefectural policy in the history of Japan.

Source citations (as archived): [Japan Today](<https://japantoday.com/category/politics/japan-prefecture-to-recognize-partnerships-for-lgbt-couples-from-july>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-06-25-6-1"></a>

Context: Space Test Program, 2019 in spaceflight.

**Archived source account.** SpaceX successfully launches and deploys 24 satellites, including LightSail 2, Green Propellant Infusion Mission, and the Deep Space Atomic Clock, into orbit via its Falcon Heavy rocket. Falcon Heavy's sideboosters both returned safely to their landing pads at Cape Canaveral Air Force Station, while the rocket's center booster failed to land on a droneship in the Atlantic Ocean, exploding in the sea.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/06/25/science/falcon-heavy-spacex-launch.html>).

### 2019-06-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1360684532](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20June%2026&oldid=1360684532>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-06-26-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Pakistan three suicide bombers attempted to storm a police housing complex in the southern Balochistan province. One of them was killed by guards, while the two others entered and blew themselves up, killing a senior constable and wounding five others. The Pakistani Taliban has claimed responsibility

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pakistan-attack/one-killed-as-militants-attack-pakistan-police-housing-complex-idUSKCN1TR0ML>).

<a id="event-2019-06-26-0-3"></a>

Context: International military intervention against ISIL / Canada and the Iraq War.

**Archived source account.** Defence Minister Harjit Sajjan announces that Canada will continue to command a NATO mission in Iraq for a second year until November 2020.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/middle-east/2019/06/26/Canada-s-command-of-NATO-mission-in-Iraq-extended-to-late-2020-.html>).

<a id="event-2019-06-26-0-5"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** Two U.S. Troops are killed in an ambush by the Taliban in Wardak Province, Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2019/06/26/aghan-war-2-u-s-service-members-killed-possible-taliban-ambush/1569137001/>).

<a id="event-2019-06-26-0-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four men with ties to ISIL are arrested in Nicaragua.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-48773780>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-06-26-1-1"></a>

Context: LGBT in the United States.

**Archived source account.** New York City begins the 50th Annual World Pride festival, expecting to draw four million people over six days.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20190625-50-years-after-stonewall-new-york-stages-huge-gay-pride-rally>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-06-26-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least ten illegal migrants are killed after a vehicle lost control in Edirne, Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-06/26/c_138175635.htm>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-06-26-3-1"></a>

Context: Germany–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump states that Germany is "delinquent" on NATO defense, saying, "So they are giving Russia billions of dollars yet we are supposed to protect Germany and Germany is delinquent\! Okay?"

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/world/2019/06/26/Trump-says-Germany-is-delinquent-on-NATO-defense.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-06-26-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An unnamed Brazilian Air Force sergeant is arrested in Seville for smuggling 39 kilograms of cocaine inside an Embraer E190 airliner. The aircraft, now grounded, was being used as a backup plane during President Bolsonaro's official visit to Japan, connecting in the Spanish city.

Source citations (as archived): [The Olive Press](<https://www.theolivepress.es/spain-news/2019/06/26/brazilian-soldier-from-convoy-of-president-bolsonaro-arrested-for-smuggling-cocaine-into-spains-sevilla-after-controversial-leader-vowed-to-crack-down-on-drugs/>).

<a id="event-2019-06-26-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** In a unanimous decision, the Supreme Court of Japan rejects retrial for a 92-year-old woman, Ayako Haraguchi, who had already served 10 years in prison for the 1979 murder of her former brother-in-law.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2019/06/26/national/crime-legal/supreme-court-rejects-retrial-92-yr-old-woman-1979-murder/#.XRPDcuhKjcc>).

<a id="event-2019-06-26-4-3"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Canada.

**Archived source account.** Canada's government adds Neo-Nazi groups Blood &amp; Honour and Combat 18 to its list of designated terrorist organizations. It is the first time that extreme far-right groups have been designated as terrorist in Canada. Three Shia militant groups, including the Iranian-backed Al-Ashtar Brigades are also banned.

Source citations (as archived): [Global News](<https://globalnews.ca/news/5432851/canada-adds-neo-nazi-groups-blood-honour-and-combat-18-to-list-of-terror-organizations/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-06-26-5-1"></a>

Context: 2020 United States presidential election, 2020 Democratic Party presidential debates and forums.

**Archived source account.** The first of two Democratic Party debates for the nomination of the party's nominee in the 2020 United States presidential election is held in Miami, Florida.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-election-debate/democrats-clash-on-healthcare-border-in-scrappy-first-u-s-presidential-debate-idUSKCN1TR168>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-06-26-6-1"></a>

Context: 2019 European heat wave.

**Archived source account.** Germany, Poland and the Czech Republic record their highest ever recorded temperatures for June amid a heat wave in Western and Central Europe.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-48780685>); [Weather Underground](<https://www.wunderground.com/cat6/Dangerous-June-Heat-Wave-Envelops-Western-Europe>).

### 2019-06-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1129620595](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20June%2027&oldid=1129620595>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-06-27-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Tunis bombings.

**Archived source account.** Twin blasts from suicide bombers, kill one police officer and wound nine others in Tunis.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/06/27/africa/tunis-explosion-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-06-27-0-3"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War, Saudi-led intervention in Yemen.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/2019/06/27/Arab-Coalition-intercepts-Houthi-drone-in-Yemeni-airspace-targeting-Saudi-Arabia.html>).

<a id="event-2019-06-27-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Angara Airlines Flight 200 crashes on landing at Nizhneangarsk Airport, Far East Russia, killing two of the 47 people on board.

Source citations (as archived): [Aviation Safety Network](<https://aviation-safety.net/database/record.php?id=20190627-0>).

<a id="event-2019-06-27-2-1"></a>

Context: Argentina–Cuba relations.

**Archived source account.** Argentina Education Minister Alejandro Finocchiaro strongly condemns a school in Chaco Province for displaying a Cuban flag on Argentina's Flag Day, asking, "What differences are there between the Cuban regime and the Nazis?" He also describes Che Guevara as a "criminal and genocider".

Context: 2020 United States presidential election, 2020 Democratic Party presidential debates and forums.
