Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/06/27/us/politics/democratic-debate-recap.html>).

<a id="event-2019-06-27-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The social democrat Frederiksen Cabinet is formed in Denmark.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-06-26/danish-social-democrats-form-new-government-after-election-win>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-06-27-3-1"></a>

Context: List of fast radio bursts.

**Archived source account.** Scientists announce, through the Science journal, that they discover the source of a fast radio burst for the first time. FRB 180924, a non-repeating FRB which was detected in September 2018 using the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder, originates from a large galaxy known as DES J214425.25−405400.81 located 3.6 billion light-years from Earth.

Source citations (as archived): [Newsweek](<https://www.newsweek.com/frb-mystery-radio-signal-deep-space-1446252>); [9news](<https://www.9news.com.au/national/csiro-scientists-radio-waves-bursts-located-galaxy-billions-light-years-science-technology-space-news-australia/bfa8dccb-7094-4943-8bad-65f621bfdc4c>).

<a id="event-2019-06-27-3-3"></a>

Context: Dragonfly (spacecraft).

**Archived source account.** NASA awards $1 billion to the Dragonfly mission, which will use a dual-quadcopter drone to explore Titan for signs of life.

Source citations (as archived): [Nature](<https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-019-02027-3>); [Science](<https://www.sciencemag.org/news/2019/06/nasa-will-fly-billion-dollar-quadcopter-titan-saturn-s-methane-rich-moon>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/06/27/science/nasa-titan-dragonfly-caesar.html>); [The Atlantic](<https://www.theatlantic.com/science/archive/2019/06/titan-saturn-nasa-dragonfly/592882/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-06-27-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 FIFA Women's World Cup.

**Archived source account.** Ellen White becomes England's all-time leading FIFA Women's World Cup Final goalscorer with the team's second goal against Norway in the 2019 Women's World Cup quarterfinal win.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-cup/2019/06/27/norway-vs-england-womens-world-cup-2019-quarter-final-live-score/>).

### 2019-06-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087982699](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20June%2028&oldid=1087982699>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-06-28-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Indanan bombings.

**Archived source account.** Two suicide bombers detonate their devices in Sulu, Philippines, killing four soldiers and two civilians. ISIL claims responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/explosion-southern-philippines-military-base-1.5194239>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-philippines-security/philippine-army-camp-blast-kills-five-islamic-state-claims-responsibility-idUSKCN1TT1T6>); [CNN Philippines](<https://www.cnnphilippines.com/regional/2019/6/29/sulu-twin-blasts-death-toll.html>).

<a id="event-2019-06-28-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Northwestern Syria offensive (April 2019–present).

**Archived source account.** Nearly 100 people are killed in clashes between the Syrian Army, rebels and jihadists in northwestern Syria. 51 government troops and allied militiamen, and 45 rebel fighters and jihadists are among the dead.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20190628-nearly-100-dead-northwest-syria-fighting-monitor>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-06-28-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Demolition experts implode the Ponte Morandi viaduct in Genoa, Italy, ten months after a partial collapse that killed 43 people.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/av/world-europe-48797883/morandi-bridge-towers-demolished-in-genoa>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-06-28-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A train hauling 40 cars derails in the St. Clair Tunnel between Port Huron, Michigan and Sarnia, Ontario, spilling 13,700 gallons of sulfuric acid and closing the tunnel for several days.

Source citations (as archived): [WDIV-TV](<https://www.clickondetroit.com/news/train-derails-inside-st-clair-river-international-tunnel-in-port-huron>); [WXYZ-TV](<https://www.wxyz.com/news/19-rail-cars-remain-inside-international-st-clair-river-tunnel-after-derailment-last-week>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-06-28-3-1"></a>

Context: China–Holy See relations.

**Archived source account.** The Vatican asks China's communist government to stop intimidating Catholic clergy who want to remain unequivocally loyal to the pope and refuse to sign ambiguous official registration forms.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pope-china/vatican-says-china-intimidating-catholics-loyal-to-pope-idUSKCN1TT1MY>).

<a id="event-2019-06-28-3-3"></a>

Context: Bahrain–Iraq relations.

**Archived source account.** More than 200 demonstrators break into the courtyard of Bahrain's embassy in Baghdad and take down the kingdom's flag to protest a U.S.-led meeting in Bahrain on the Israeli–Palestinian peace process.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians-plan-iraq/baghdad-protesters-take-down-bahrain-flag-over-trump-peace-conference-idUSKCN1TS359>).

<a id="event-2019-06-28-3-5"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Argentina.

**Archived source account.** Argentine Foreign Minister Jorge Faurie announces that the European Union and Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay and Uruguay achieved a breakthrough in free-trade talks after 20 years.

Source citations (as archived): [Gulf News](<https://gulfnews.com/business/historic-eu-and-south-america-achieve-breakthrough-in-free-trade-talks-after-20-years-1.1561745528904>).

<a id="event-2019-06-28-3-7"></a>

Context: United States–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States announces sanctions on Nicolás Maduro Guerra, the son of disputed Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro, accusing him of engaging in propaganda on behalf of the government.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-48805421>).

<a id="event-2019-06-28-3-9"></a>

Context: 2019 Argentine general election, Argentina–Brazil relations, Argentina–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump and Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro officially endorse the re-election campaign of Mauricio Macri.

Source citations (as archived): [La Nación](<https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/fuerte-respaldo-trump-bolsonaro-macri-que-no-nid2262755>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-06-28-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Salt Lake City police arrest a man for murder in connection to the search for missing University of Utah student Mackenzie Lueck.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/missing-university-utah-student-one-man-custody-salt-lake-city-n1024631>).

<a id="event-2019-06-28-4-2"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Charlottesville car attack.

**Archived source account.** James A. Fields Jr. is sentenced to life in prison after pleading guilty to 29 hate crimes for driving his car into a crowd of protestors, killing one and injuring 28, at the 2017 Unite the Right rally in Charlottesville, Virginia.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/06/28/us/charlottesville-car-attacker-sentencing/index.html>); [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/james-alex-fields-driver-deadly-car-attack-charlottesville-rally-sentenced-n1024436>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/local/public-safety/james-fields-jr-avowed-neo-nazi-in-charlottesville-car-attack-set-to-be-sentenced-for-federal-hate-crimes/2019/06/27/fcead458-9849-11e9-830a-21b9b36b64ad_story.html>).

<a id="event-2019-06-28-4-4"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in Sri Lanka.

**Archived source account.** For the first time in 43 years, Sri Lanka hires executioners to reinstate the death penalty.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/jun/28/sri-lanka-appoints-executioners-for-return-of-death-penalty-after-40-years>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-06-28-5-1"></a>

Context: Immigration to Japan.

**Archived source account.** A Nigerian man dies in a Japanese immigration detention center this week, an official says. It ends a hunger strike that an activist group said was intended to protest against him being held for more than three years.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-japan-immigration-hunger-strike/nigerian-man-dies-after-hunger-strike-in-japan-detention-center-idUSKCN1TT0R4>).

<a id="event-2019-06-28-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The House of Representatives of the Netherlands passes the final bill of the climate agreement. The goal of the accord is to have the level of greenhouse gasses in the atmosphere in 2030 the same as the level of greenhouse gasses in the atmosphere in 1990.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/Technology/wireStory/dutch-government-presents-measures-cut-carbon-emissions-64015905>).

<a id="event-2019-06-28-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** According to the first report presented by the Nicaraguan Foundation for Economic and Social Development, Nicaragua has become one of the world's least democratic countries, qualifying it as an "authoritarian regime". Among the reasons that this center of thought mentions to explain this situation are "the retrocess of civil liberties by the repression against the anti-government protests in progress since 2018" and "the loss of independence of the State institutions in favor of the Executive Power".

Source citations (as archived): [La Prensa](<https://www.laprensa.com.ni/2019/06/28/politica/2564900-nicaragua-esta-entre-los-paises-menos-democraticos-del-mundo-segun-funides>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-06-28-6-1"></a>

Context: 2019 European heat wave.

**Archived source account.** Amid a continental heat wave, France records its highest ever temperature of 45.9 C in Gallargues-le-Montueux.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/europe-heatwave-france-raises-danger-alert-to-highest-level-11750609>).

<a id="event-2019-06-28-6-2"></a>

Context: 2019 European heat wave.

**Archived source account.** In Spain, authorities report two deaths connected to the extreme heat. The worst wildfire in 20 years burns more than 5,000 hectares at the south of Province of Tarragona, in Catalonia.

Source citations (as archived): [Express](<https://www.express.co.uk/news/world/1146431/spain-heatwave-weather-forecast-madrid-Cordoba>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/06/27/world/europe-heat-wave-spain-wildfire-intl/index.html>).

### 2019-06-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087982806](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20June%2029&oldid=1087982806>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-06-29-0-2"></a>

Context: 2019 G20 Osaka summit / China–United States trade war, China–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping meet at the G20 summit and reach a deal that will allow American companies to sell non-sensitive technology to Huawei while China will buy food and agricultural products from the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/economy/trade-war-hangs-in-balance-as-trump-and-xi-finally-meet/2019/06/28/bb065eb2-9a02-11e9-830a-21b9b36b64ad_story.html>).

<a id="event-2019-06-29-0-4"></a>

Context: 2019 G20 Osaka summit / Foreign relations of Venezuela.

**Archived source account.** In Osaka, Argentina, Brazil, Chile and Canada jointly issue a statement condemning the Venezuelan government. The statement's author, Argentine President Mauricio Macri, indicated that it was meant to "show that beyond good faith and dialogue, Maduro takes advantage of that to create more poverty, famine and corruption in Venezuela".

Source citations (as archived): [Clarín](<https://www.clarin.com/mundo/argentina-brasil-chile-canada-condenaron-regimen-ilegitimo-nicolas-maduro-venezuela_0_-2pwFfl9e.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-06-29-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Carola Rackete, the captain of a migrant rescue ship, is arrested in Italy for docking without authorization after Italy closed its ports to rescue organizations.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48809134>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-06-29-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** German Chancellor Angela Merkel says she's "fine" following two bouts of shaking in public that have sparked concerns about her health.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48812127>).

### 2019-06-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087982980](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20June%2030&oldid=1087982980>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-06-30-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Four humvees packed with explosives controlled by suicide bombers kill 23, including eight election workers, in the province of Kandahar. The Taliban claimed 57 were killed.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-taliban/fighting-rages-across-afghanistan-as-peace-talks-continue-idUSKCN1TV0AD>).

<a id="event-2019-06-30-0-3"></a>

Context: 2018–19 Sudanese protests.

**Archived source account.** Ten people are killed in Sudan during clashes between the Sudanese military and civilian protesters.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-sudan-politics/tens-of-thousands-demand-civilian-rule-in-sudan-at-least-seven-killed-idUSKCN1TV0IY>).

<a id="event-2019-06-30-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Gunmen open fire, killing two guards and wounding another for Lebanese Refugee Affairs Minister, Saleh al-Gharib. This attack happened in a mountain village near Beirut, Lebanon.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/06/gunmen-open-fire-lebanese-minister-convoy-killing-190630164714839.html>); [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/lebanese-officials-shot-dead-in-attack-on-ministers-convoy/a-49422757>).

<a id="event-2019-06-30-0-6"></a>

Context: Northern Mali conflict.

**Archived source account.** At least 23 people are dead and 300 missing after attacks on three Fulani villages in central Mali.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mali-security/attack-on-mali-fulani-village-kills-23-local-mayor-idUSKCN1TW2YT>).

<a id="event-2019-06-30-0-7"></a>

Context: Northern Mali conflict.

**Archived source account.** 12 civilians including a baby were killed when the vehicle they were traveling in hit a landmine.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/07/attack-fulani-village-central-mali-kills-23-local-mayor-190701183633647.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-06-30-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ten people are killed when a Beechcraft BE-350 King Air crashes into a hangar at Addison Airport in Addison, Texas.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/10-dead-plane-crash-texas-n1025126>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-06-30-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Koreas–United States DMZ Summit, North Korea–United States relations, South Korea–United States relations, North Korea–South Korea relations, 2018–19 Korean peace process.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump, together with South Korean President Moon Jae-in, meets North Korean leader Kim Jong-un at the Joint Security Area, becoming the first sitting U.S. president to set foot in North Korea. Trump also invites Kim to the White House to resume talks about denuclearizing the Korean Peninsula.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/donald-trump/trump-kim-jong-un-meet-dmz-n1025041>); [Business Insider](<https://www.businessinsider.com/trump-shakes-hands-with-kim-jong-un-and-invites-him-to-the-white-house-2019-6>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/politics/live-news/trump-dmz-kim-live-intl-hnk/h_7c89c85737f16f7da758bcc1319c8b87>).

<a id="event-2019-06-30-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Princess Haya bint Hussein of Jordan fled her husband Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, the Vice President and Prime Minister of the UAE and Ruler of Dubai, with their two children in fear for her life. The family fled to London via Germany seeking asylum, and a high profile court battle over non-repatriation and custody of the children is anticipated.

Source citations (as archived): [Times](<https://www.thetimes.co.uk/article/sheikh-s-wife-flees-to-london-home-wpd8g906p>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-06-30-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the second similar case within a week, police in Toyonaka, Japan, arrest Ryotaro Taniguchi for keeping the body of his deceased mother a year after her death. He is quoted as saying he didn't want to pay for the funeral. Police are investigating whether or not Taniguchi continued to receive his mother's pension.

Source citations (as archived): [Japan Today](<https://japantoday.com/category/crime/man-arrested-for-keeping-mother%E2%80%99s-body-in-apartment-for-a-year>); [The Japan Times](<https://japantoday.com/category/crime/man-admits-not-reporting-father%E2%80%99s-death-for-months-in-order-to-keep-collecting-pension>).


## July

### 2019-07-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087983435](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20July%201&oldid=1087983435>).

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2019-07-01-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan; 1 July 2019 Kabul attack.

**Archived source account.** 40 people are killed and over 100 injured by a car bombing and shooting in Kabul, Afghanistan. The Taliban claims responsibility and loses five gunmen.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/07/01/world/asia/afghanistan-bombing-war-museum.html>).

<a id="event-2019-07-01-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan; 1 July 2019 Kabul attack.

**Archived source account.** Taliban militants overran the Qush Tepa district of Jowzjan Province, resulting in the deaths of over 50 Afghan soldiers. Many others were captured.

Source citations (as archived): [ATNNews](<https://ariananews.af/taliban-captured-qushtepa-district-killing-dozens/>).

<a id="event-2019-07-01-0-4"></a>

Context: Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Israel strikes multiple Iranian and Syrian military targets outside Damascus and Homs, killing 16 people and wounding 21.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/israel-strikes-iran-hezbollah-targets-in-syria-four-killed-21-wounded-1.7425013>).

<a id="event-2019-07-01-0-5"></a>

Context: Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A stray Syrian S-200 missile fired in response to the Israeli strikes crashes and explodes on a mountain near Vouno in Northern Cyprus, located 20 km (12 miles) northeast of Nicosia, causing no injuries but starting a fire.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-cyprus-crash/unidentified-flying-object-crashes-in-cyprus-no-casualties-minister-idUSKCN1TW15V>).

<a id="event-2019-07-01-0-7"></a>

Context: Iranian intervention in Iraq (2014–present), Iran–Iraq relations.

**Archived source account.** Iraqi Prime Minister Adil Abdul-Mahdi signs a decree ordering all Iranian-backed Shia militias to integrate into the Iraqi Armed Forces by the end of July. The decree will change the names of the militias such as the Popular Mobilization Forces to new divisions and brigades within the military.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://reuters.com/article/uk-usa-iran-iraq/iraq-pm-orders-iran-allied-militias-to-be-reined-in-idUKKCN1TW3EQ>); [Rudaw](<http://www.rudaw.net/english/middleeast/iraq/01072019>).

<a id="event-2019-07-01-0-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nine people were injured in a Houthi drone attack on Saudi Abha International Airport.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/report-houthi-drone-attack-on-saudi-airport-leaves-nine-injured-1.7428906>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-07-01-1-1"></a>

Context: Whaling in Japan.

**Archived source account.** Japan resumes commercial whaling after 30 years following the country's withdrawal from the International Whaling Commission. At least 227 whales are expected to be killed through to December.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/jul/01/japan-resumes-commercial-whaling-for-first-time-in-30-years>).

<a id="event-2019-07-01-1-3"></a>

Context: Phase-out of lightweight plastic bags.

**Archived source account.** A ban on single-use plastic shopping bags comes into force in New Zealand. Businesses that break the ban will face fines of up to $100,000NZD.

Source citations (as archived): [Gulf Today](<https://www.gulftoday.ae/news/2019/07/01/new-zealand-bans-single-use-plastic-bags>).

<a id="event-2019-07-01-1-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Japan–South Korea trade dispute.

**Archived source account.** Japan announced tightening of chemical exports to South Korea that are crucial for semiconductor industry.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-southkorea-japan-laborers/japan-to-tighten-export-rules-for-high-tech-materials-to-south-korea-media-idUSKCN1TV089>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-07-01-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 16 people are killed and 45 injured when a bus rolls over on a road in Tucumán Province, Argentina.

Source citations (as archived): [Clarín](<https://www.clarin.com/sociedad/10-muertos-tucuman-vuelco-micro-viajaban-jubilados_0_v3kpdzI3o.html>).

<a id="event-2019-07-01-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Lower Saxony, Germany, a Bundeswehr helicopter crashes, killing one of the pilots.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/germany-military-helicopter-crashes-near-hanover/a-49430938>).

<a id="event-2019-07-01-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Mexico, a storm drops over a metre of hail over parts of Guadalajara, damaging hundreds of houses.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/guadalajara-mexico-hail-1.5196344>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-07-01-3-1"></a>

Context: Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action, Nuclear program of Iran.

**Archived source account.** Iran announces that it has enriched more than 300 kg of uranium to 3.67%, contrary to previous agreement. This is still highly insufficient to produce one nuclear weapon.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/iran-reported-to-pass-300-kg-limit-on-low-enriched-uranium/a-49428832>).

<a id="event-2019-07-01-3-3"></a>

Context: Japan–United States relations, Japan–North Korea relations, 2018–19 Korean peace process.

**Archived source account.** After speaking by phone with U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo, Japanese Foreign Minister Tarō Kōno says "he hopes the meeting adds momentum to efforts toward the denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula". Kōno also says that Japanese Prime Minister Shinzō Abe "wants to meet Kim Jong-un to solve the issue of North Korean abductions of Japanese citizens".

Source citations (as archived): [Japan Today](<https://japantoday.com/category/politics/update1-japan-hopes-trump-kim-meeting-spurs-nuclear-abduction-talks>).

<a id="event-2019-07-01-3-5"></a>

Context: Libya–Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** After political pressure from Turkey, six Turkish sailors are released from detention by the Libyan National Army under general Khalifa Haftar.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/jul/01/six-turkish-sailors-freed-by-libya-warlord-khalifa-haftar>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-07-01-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** France's interior minister, Christophe Castaner, has asked the Paris police chief to provide explanations about a video that went viral on social media, where law enforcement officers are seen spraying with pepper spray and dragging protesters from the Extinction Rebellion anti-climate change movement. Although the police needed to evict the protesters, who obstructed a transit route, the mechanisms that they used generated negative reactions.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2019/jul/01/french-police-criticised-over-removal-of-paris-climate-protesters>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-07-01-5-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong anti-extradition bill protests.

**Archived source account.** Hong Kong anti-extradition bill protesters briefly break into the Legislative Council Complex, which houses the local parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/jul/01/hong-kong-protests-group-tries-to-storm-government-building>).

<a id="event-2019-07-01-5-3"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Japan.

**Archived source account.** Ibaraki Prefecture becomes the first in Japan to recognize same-sex partnerships.

Source citations (as archived): [Japan Today](<https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2019/07/01/national/ibaraki-becomes-japans-first-prefecture-recognize-sex-couples/#.XRsgeXHgqUk>).

<a id="event-2019-07-01-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** David Hurley is sworn is as the 27th Governor-General of Australia, succeeding Peter Cosgrove.

Source citations (as archived): [SBS News](<https://www.sbs.com.au/news/david-hurley-sworn-in-as-australia-s-governor-general>).

### 2019-07-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1356284640](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20July%202&oldid=1356284640>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-07-02-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Islamist militants attack a Niger Armed Forces base in the village of Inates, near the border with Mali, with two car bombs and gunmen, killing 18 soldiers. They also kidnapped four Nigerien soldiers and stole dozens of vehicles.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-48843070>).

<a id="event-2019-07-02-0-2"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A Libyan National Army airstrike on a suburb of Tripoli hits a detention centre for illegal migrants, killing at least 53 people and injuring 80 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/uk-libya-security-casualties/air-strike-on-migrant-detention-centre-in-libyan-capital-kills-40-official-idUKKCN1TX31P?il=0>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/07/03/africa/libya-airstrike-migrant-center-intl-hnk/index.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-07-02-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 50 people are killed after a fuel tanker overturned and then exploded in Benue State, Nigeria.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/07/02/africa/nigeria-benue-oil-tanker-explosion-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-07-02-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A fire on the Russian Navy's Losharik submarine kills 14 crew members while the vessel conducts tests in Russian territorial waters.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/fourteen-dead-in-russian-submarine-fire-11755295>); [RFERL](<https://www.rferl.org/a/at-least-14-killed-in-russian-submarine-fire/30033324.html>).

<a id="event-2019-07-02-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 18 people have died and more than a dozen are still missing in devastating floods that swept southeastern Siberia, Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2019/07/03/world/death-toll-reaches-18-siberian-floods-13-missing/#.XRzwyR7OM0M>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-07-02-2-1"></a>

Context: Iran–Saudi Arabia relations, Japan–Saudi Arabia relations.

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabia's minister of state for foreign affairs Adel al-Jubeir says his country will work with Japan and other nations to come up with a plan to ensure that ships can safely transit the Persian Gulf region. Jubeir also calls for "action" on Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [NHK](<https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20190702_14/>).

<a id="event-2019-07-02-2-3"></a>

Context: China–United Kingdom relations, Hong Kong–United Kingdom relations, 2019 Hong Kong anti-extradition bill protests, Aftermath of the Handover of Hong Kong.

**Archived source account.** China warns the United Kingdom that "no country has the right to intervene on the issue of mass protests in Hong Kong", as it considers the problems of this self-governed city an "internal problem". For China, the agreement by which the United Kingdom returned Hong Kong is nothing more than "a historical document of no practical importance" and "that European country no longer has any responsibility over Hong Kong". The British chancellery, for its part, dismissed the Chinese opinion, and has said that "it is the right and obligation of the United Kingdom to work to enforce the agreement", which, in theory, guarantees a high degree of autonomy for Hong Kong for 50 years until 2047 without Chinese interference.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/chinas-warning-to-uk-over-hong-kong-no-country-has-the-right-to-intervene-11755383>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-07-02-3-1"></a>

Context: 2020 United States presidential election.

**Archived source account.** There has been a shake-up within the campaign organization of former Colorado Governor John Hickenlooper, which includes the departure of the manager of Hickenlooper's presidential campaign, Bradley Komar. Komar and other departing staffers reportedly believe that Hickenlooper should quit the race as he has no realistic prospect of victory.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-election-hickenlooper/departing-advisers-urged-john-hickenlooper-to-quit-white-house-race-source-idUSKCN1TX2NF?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-07-02-3-3"></a>

Context: Education in Argentina, Argentina–Cuba relations.

**Archived source account.** Argentine Education Minister Alejandro Finocchiaro, who strongly condemned a school in Chaco Province for displaying a Cuban flag and displaying pictures of Che Guevara, says the school "has no supervision" and that they are "indoctrinating children with communism and totalitarian and populist governments". He also added in an interview on state TV that the school will be reviewed.

Source citations (as archived): [La Nación](<https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/como-es-escuela-tiene-escudo-al-che-nid2263397>); [Clarín](<https://www.clarin.com/opinion/che-guevara-va-escuela_0_AweVQLNQx.html>).

<a id="event-2019-07-02-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Fidesz supermajority of Hungary's National Assembly passes a bill, which takes the entire research network away from the Hungarian Academy of Sciences and hands them to a new government-backed organisation.

Source citations (as archived): [Index](<https://index.hu/english/2019/07/02/hungarian_academy_of_sciences_research_network_taken_away_academic_freedom_ministry_of_innovation_and_technology/>).

<a id="event-2019-07-02-3-6"></a>

Context: 2019 European Parliament election.

**Archived source account.** The Ninth European Parliament starts its term.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-48838498>).

<a id="event-2019-07-02-3-7"></a>

Context: 2019 European Parliament election.

**Archived source account.** Fugitive Catalan independence leaders Carles Puigdemont and Toni Comín, together with imprisoned Oriol Junqueras, are not allowed to take office as MEPs by the Supreme Court of Spain and Court of Justice of the European Union, while a pro-independence demonstration takes place in Strasbourg.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-spain-politics-catalonia-eu/european-parliament-kicks-off-new-term-with-protests-more-women-idUSKCN1TX1W4>).

<a id="event-2019-07-02-3-8"></a>

Context: 2019 European Parliament election.

**Archived source account.** The European Council nominates German Defence Minister Ursula von der Leyen to replace Jean-Claude Juncker as President of the European Commission. If confirmed by the European Parliament, she will be the first woman to hold the position. The Council also nominates Charles Michel of Belgium as President of the European Council, Josep Borrell of Spain as High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy, and Christine Lagarde of France as President of the European Central Bank.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-48847200>).

<a id="event-2019-07-02-3-10"></a>

Context: 2020 United States census.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Departments of Justice and Commerce announce that the Trump administration will not implement a proposed citizenship question in the 2020 census, and will perform the census without the question. This follows the U.S. Supreme Court rejecting the administration's rationale for the question in the case Department of Commerce v. New York.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/local/social-issues/2020-census-will-not-include-citizenship-question-doj-confirms/2019/07/02/0067be4a-9c44-11e9-9ed4-c9089972ad5a_story.html>).

<a id="event-2019-07-02-3-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** Following the fatal shooting of a young Ethiopian–Israeli man on June 30, countrywide riots in Israel result in more than 80 injuries.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/Israel-News/Amid-calls-for-further-protests-Erdan-says-there-wont-be-any-594454>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-07-02-4-1"></a>

Context: Tax returns of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. House Committee on Ways and Means sues U.S. Secretary of the Treasury Steven Mnuchin and Commissioner of Internal Revenue Charles Rettig to obtain six years of U.S. President Donald Trump's tax returns.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/07/02/738030272/house-democrats-sue-for-trumps-tax-returns>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-07-02-5-1"></a>

Context: Solar eclipse of July 2, 2019.

**Archived source account.** A total solar eclipse is visible from parts of Chile and Argentina, and a large remote stretch of the southern Pacific.

Source citations (as archived): [time and date](<https://www.timeanddate.com/eclipse/solar/2019-july-2>); [NASA](<https://www.nasa.gov/image-article/total-solar-eclipse-darkens-south-pacific/>).

<a id="event-2019-07-02-5-3"></a>

Context: Ascent Abort-2.

**Archived source account.** NASA carries out a successful in-flight test of the launch abort system of its new Orion spacecraft, a milestone in the development of the Artemis program to resume human exploration beyond low Earth orbit.

Source citations (as archived): [Space.com](<https://www.space.com/nasa-orion-capsule-abort-test-flight.html>).

<a id="event-2019-07-03-1-0"></a>

<a id="event-2019-07-03-1-1"></a>

<a id="event-2019-07-03-2-1"></a>

Context: Death of Otto Warmbier, North Korea–United States relations.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<https://www.wnem.com/seized-north-korean-ship-sought-for-american-student-otto-warmbier/article_7cc6d4c8-b313-5326-b1f1-e53fc132cdc9.html>).

### 2019-07-04

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1118623031](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20July%204&oldid=1118623031>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-07-04-0-1"></a>

Context: Sanctions against Iran.

**Archived source account.** Royal Marines seize control of an oil tanker off the coast of Gibraltar that was en route to Baniyas in Syria, suspected of breaching EU sanctions against Syria, carrying Iranian crude oil. The United Kingdom's Ambassador to Iran, Robert Macaire, is summoned in Tehran over the incident, which Iran describes as an "illegal seizure".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-48865030>).

#### Art and culture

<a id="event-2019-07-04-1-1"></a>

Context: Salute to America.

**Archived source account.** A major holiday celebration and military parade is held in Washington, D.C., United States, by President Donald Trump to commemorate the Fourth of July/Independence Day.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/07/04/politics/salute-to-america-july-4th-event/index.html>); [NBC](<https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/donald-trump/trump-delivers-remarks-military-style-salute-america-event-n1026656>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2019-07-04-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Lightsource BP, a solar energy developer headquartered in London, has announced that it will acquire utility-scale solar projects in Brazil, 1.9 gigawatts of projects, for an undisclosed sum. This is a major expansion for Lightsource, which is 43% owned by the energy giant BP.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lightsourcebp-m-a-brazil/lightsource-bp-makes-major-brazil-solar-acquisition-idUSKCN1TZ1A3>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-07-04-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Ridgecrest earthquakes.

**Archived source account.** An earthquake with a magnitude of 6.4 with scores of foreshocks and aftershocks hits Southern California, 150 miles (240 km) north of Los Angeles near the city of Ridgecrest. No injuries are reported. The earthquake is the largest in Southern California since the 1999 Hector Mine earthquake.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/07/04/us/southern-california-earthquake/index.html>); [USGS](<https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/eventpage/ci38443183/executive>); [USGS](<https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/eventpage/ci38443191/executive>).

<a id="event-2019-07-04-3-3"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** More than 80 people are missing after a migrant boat capsizes off the coast of Tunisia, according to the International Organization for Migration (IOM).

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/jul/04/boat-with-dozens-of-migrants-capsizes-off-tunisia-coast>).

<a id="event-2019-07-04-4-1"></a>

Context: Australia–North Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** An Australian student who had been detained in North Korea on June 25 is freed thanks to diplomatic talks between Australia and North Korea via Swedish officials.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-australia-northkorea-student/australian-student-released-from-north-korea-says-hes-very-good-idUSKCN1TZ09L>).

<a id="event-2019-07-04-4-3"></a>

Context: Kosovo–Serbia relations.

**Archived source account.** Amid a deterioration in relations, Kosovo bans all Serbian officials from entering the country, in response to "constant propaganda and false news about the country and our citizens" from Belgrade.

Source citations (as archived): [RFERL](<https://www.rferl.org/a/kosovo-bans-serbian-officials-in-new-diplomatic-dispute/30037050.html>).

Context: Crime in Virginia.

**Archived source account.** A 20-year-old man is charged with stabbing three in a machete attack in a plasma center in Petersburg, Virginia.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News](<https://news.yahoo.com/20-old-man-charged-stabbing-213227565.html>).

<a id="event-2019-07-05-3-1"></a>

Context: Operation Car Wash.

**Archived source account.** New text messages between Brazilian judge Sérgio Moro and Operation Car Wash's prosecutors are leaked by The Intercept Brasil and Veja. In the messages, Judge Moro illegally advises the prosecutors in including pieces of evidence against defendants of cases presided by him and suggests dates for Federal Police operations. The messages also suggest that Moro withheld evidence to prevent cases being transferred out of his jurisdiction to the Supreme Federal Court.

Source citations (as archived): [Veja](<https://veja.abril.com.br/politica/dialogos-veja-capa-intercept-moro-dallagnol/>).

### 2019-07-08

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088017328](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20July%208&oldid=1088017328>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-07-08-0-1"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** The United Arab Emirates announces a partial withdrawal of its forces from Yemen as part of a "strategic redeployment".

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/07/08/middleeast/uae-partial-withdrawal-yemen-intl/index.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-07-08-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Deutsche Bank announces lay-offs – roughly 18,000 job cuts – around the globe as part of a "reinvention", scrapping its global equities and cutting its fixed income operations.

<a id="event-2019-07-08-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Flash flooding in Washington, D.C. delivers a month's worth of rain on the local area in the span of an hour. The torrential rain leaves commuters stranded on car rooftops, floods several metro stations and causes flooding in the White House.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-07-10-0-1"></a>

<a id="event-2019-07-10-1-0"></a>

<a id="event-2019-07-10-3-1"></a>

Context: United Kingdom–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Sir Kim Darroch, the United Kingdom's ambassador to the United States, resigns his appointment amid public disagreements with U.S. President Donald Trump initiated by a series of leaked diplomatic cables in which the ambassador criticized the president, and will leave the post upon the appointment of his successor.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-48937120>).

<a id="event-2019-07-10-3-3"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2019/07/10/trump-wins-dismissal-of-emoluments-suit.html>); [Politico](<https://www.politico.com/story/2019/07/10/donald-trump-emoluments-lawsuit-1405767>).

Context: 2019 in archaeology.

**Archived source account.** Paleoanthropologists announce, through the Nature journal, that a human skull (Apidima 1) discovered inside a cave in Greece, is dated to 210,000 years ago, making it the oldest known Homo sapiens individual found outside of Africa.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-48913307>); [Nature](<https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-019-1376-z>).

The United States women's national soccer team wins the Outstanding Team Award for their 2019 FIFA Women's World Cup victory, Giannis Antetokounmpo wins the Best Male Athlete Award, Alex Morgan wins the Best Female Athlete Award, and Saquon Barkley wins the Breakthrough Athlete of the Year Award.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<https://www.espn.com/espn/story/_/id/27164007/uswnt-morgan-take-home-top-honors-espys>).

<a id="event-2019-07-13-1-4"></a>

**Editorial account; source review partial.** The National Weather Service Lake Charles account records Barry’s July 13 upgrade to a hurricane and landfall with maximum sustained winds of 75 mph. This scoped source check does not establish its exact ordinal position in the season or the archive’s separately rounded metric value.

Editorial date: 2019-07-13. Checked: 2026-10-21. Partial: hurricane classification, date and 75 mph figure are supported. The remaining ordinal/rounding wording is preserved without full-event approval.

Evidence: [National Weather Service Lake Charles](<https://www.weather.gov/lch/2019Barry>).

Original source account: Tropical Storm Barry increases to 121 kilometers per hour (75 miles per hour), becoming the first hurricane of the 2019 Atlantic hurricane season.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

Context: AMIA bombing.

Source citations (as archived): [Clarín](<https://www.clarin.com/politica/gobierno-oficializa-decreto-hezbollah-considerado-grupo-terrorista-argentina_0_eWTtCRypT.html>); [Perfil](<https://www.perfil.com/noticias/politica/amia-aumentan-indemnizaciones-declaran-terroristas-hezbollah-habra-duelo-nacional-2019.phtml>); [TN](<https://tn.com.ar/politica/el-gobierno-incluye-hezbollah-en-la-lista-de-organizaciones-terroristas_979023>).

<a id="event-2019-07-17-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mexican drug lord Joaquín "El Chapo" Guzmán is sentenced to life in prison plus thirty years, and is ordered to forfeit US$12.6 billion. He accused the U.S. government of "torture and corruption" during his sentencing hearing in the U.S. District Court in Brooklyn, New York. He will likely be sent to ADX Florence in Colorado to serve his sentence.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2019/07/17/drug-kingpin-el-chapo-sentenced-to-life-in-prison.html>).

<a id="event-2019-07-17-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pakistan arrests Hafiz Saeed, the founder of Lashkar-e-Taiba, which has been blamed by the United States and India for the 2008 Mumbai terror attacks that left more than 160 people dead.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/pakistan-arrest-hafiz-saeed-terror-suspect-lashkar-e-taiba-imran-khan-meeting-donald-trump-washington-2019-07-17/>).

<a id="event-2019-07-17-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A shooting in Erbil, Iraqi Kurdistan, leaves two dead, including a Turkish diplomat.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/turkish-diplomat-killed-in-iraqs-kurdish-capital-irbil/a-49619981>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-07-17-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** President-elect of the European Commission Ursula von der Leyen resigns from her position as Federal Minister of Defence of Germany. Chancellor Angela Merkel appoints Annegret Kramp-Karrenbauer, the leader of the ruling CDU, as her successor.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/leader-of-merkels-cdu-annegret-kramp-karrenbauer-to-become-german-defense-ministah/a-49613916-0>).

<a id="event-2019-07-17-4-2"></a>

Context: 2018–19 Sudanese protests.

**Archived source account.** Representatives of Sudan's military and the civil opposition sign the first of two parts of a power-sharing deal which is supposed to last until free elections in 2022.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/sudans-military-and-opposition-sign-first-part-of-power-sharing-deal/a-49615502>).

<a id="event-2019-07-17-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. House of Representatives votes 332–95 to table an impeachment-related measure against U.S. President Donald Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/07/17/politics/trump-impeachment-house-vote/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-07-17-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** During a campaign rally, U.S. President Donald Trump says "Squad" members "hate our country". In light of recent statements made by Trump deemed as racist, the crowd of Trump supporters started chanting "send her back" in regards to Representative Ilhan Omar.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2019/07/18/ilhan-omar-send-her-back-chant-reactions/1764651001/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-07-17-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Astronomers rule out the chances of ~30-meter asteroid 2006 QV89's impacting Earth in September 2019 by eliminating the possibility of its passing through an area where it would have to be if it were on an impacting orbit. Prior to this, the asteroid had been given a one-in-7,000 chance of impacting Earth.

Source citations (as archived): [phys.org](<https://phys.org/news/2019-07-esa-asteroid-earth.html>).

### 2019-07-18

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-07-18-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** Twelve people are killed and over 80 injured by two car bombs at a gate outside police headquarters in Kandahar, Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-blast/12-killed-scores-wounded-in-afghanistan-taliban-car-bombing-idUSKCN1UD1TZ?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-07-18-0-3"></a>

Context: Sinai insurgency.

**Archived source account.** A suicide bombing kills two people in northern Sinai a day after four bodies were found decapitated.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/07/killed-suicide-bombing-egypt-north-sinai-190718140314692.html>).

<a id="event-2019-07-18-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump reports the United States Navy's USS Boxer "destroys" an Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) drone in a "defensive action", in the Strait of Hormuz. The Iranian drone reportedly came within \{\{convert\|1000\|yards\|ft\}\} of the U.S. vessel and ignored multiple calls to stand down.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2019/07/18/trump-says-us-navy-shot-down-iranian-drone.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-07-18-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iran confirms its seizure of a Panamanian-flagged oil tanker traveling from the United Arab Emirates, and its 12 crewmembers, in the Persian Gulf last week. The tanker is being held at Qeshm Island, and is accused by Iran of smuggling oil. The United Arab Emirates denies owning or operating the tanker.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://eu.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2019/07/18/iran-seizes-oil-tanker-near-strait-hormuz-12-board/1764681001/>).

<a id="event-2019-07-18-1-2"></a>

Context: Argentina–Iran relations.

**Archived source account.** Argentine Justice and Human Rights Minister Germán Garavano says that all countries are responsible to extradite the Iranian accused of the AMIA bombing to Argentina in case they ever set foot on their soil.

Source citations (as archived): [Perspectiva Sur](<http://www.perspectivasur.com/3/82683-garavano-por-atentado-a-la-amia-la-deuda-de-la-justicia-todava-est-pendiente>).

<a id="event-2019-07-18-1-4"></a>

Context: Holy See–Iran relations.

**Archived source account.** Cardinal Louis Raphael Sako, the head of the Iraq’s Chaldean Catholic Church, voices his concerns about rising tensions between the US and Iran could endanger plans for Pope Francis visit to Iraq.

Source citations (as archived): [Asia News](<http://www.asianews.it/news-en/For-Card-Sako,-US-Iran-tensions-threaten-papal-visit-to-Iraq-47558.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-07-18-2-1"></a>

Context: Kyoto Animation arson attack.

**Archived source account.** A 41-year-old man sets fire to the main offices of Kyoto Animation, an animation studio based in Kyoto, Japan. At least 34 people are confirmed dead and 35 injured. Many of the victims are in their 20s and 30s.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/jul/18/dead-suspected-arson-attack-kyoto-animation-japan>).

### 2019-07-20

### 2019-07-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088021073](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20July%2021&oldid=1088021073>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-07-21-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** German airline Lufthansa resumes flights between Cairo and Frankfurt and Munich, while British Airways flights to Cairo remain cancelled for six more days. The UK Foreign Office warns against "all travel" to certain parts of Egypt, but its standard advice for Cairo is for passengers to check for changes.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-49062050>); [UK Foreign Office](<https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/egypt>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-07-21-1-1"></a>

Context: United States–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** The Venezuelan military reports that on Friday, an American Naval reconnaissance plane entered its national airspace, threatening flights to Maiquetia Airport; the United States asserts that their aircraft was over international waters in the Caribbean on an approved mission. The US plane was followed for a prolonged time by a Venezuelan fighter.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-07-20/venezuela-claims-u-s-military-aircraft-violated-its-airspace>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/jul/21/us-military-venezuelan-plane-aggressively-shadowed-navy-aircraft>).

<a id="event-2019-07-21-1-3"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Argentina.

**Archived source account.** President Mauricio Macri and Justice and Human Rights Minister of Argentina Germán Garavano say that Argentina will start to receive reports of human rights abuses and criminal accusations against the Venezuelan government. Macri also reiterates his support for Juan Guaidó.

Source citations (as archived): [TN](<https://tn.com.ar/politica/el-gobierno-redobla-la-presion-sobre-maduro-y-tomara-denuncias-por-violaciones-de-derechos-humanos_980032>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-07-21-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Taiwan Customs officers discover 9800 cartons of cigarettes worth more than 200,000 USD smuggled in five trucks of presidential motorade when President Tsai Ing-wen has returned from an official trip to the Caribbean and leaves the airport via a VIP lane. A security agent of National Security Bureau within Tsai's entourage allegedly pre-ordered the cigarettes duty-free from China Airlines and stored them at a warehouse of the airline's catering company at Taoyuan International Airport. National Security Bureau Director-General Peng Sheng-chu resigns over the scandal on the following day.

Source citations (as archived): [Taiwan News](<https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/en/news/3750072>); [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/taiwan-s-intelligence-chief-resigns-over-smuggled-cigarettes-11746742>); [Taipei Times](<http://www.taipeitimes.com/News/front/archives/2019/07/24/2003719210>).

<a id="event-2019-07-21-2-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong anti-extradition bill protests.

**Archived source account.** A mob of suspected masked triad members dressed in white and armed with batons attack commuters indiscriminately at Yuen Long station, injuring 45, including a pro-democracy legislator and a pregnant woman. Hong Kong police have been accused of allowing the violence to happen due to their delayed response and decision to limit emergency services in the area.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/jul/22/where-were-the-police-hong-kong-outcry-after-masked-thugs-launch-attack>); [SCMP](<https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/law-and-crime/article/3019524/least-10-injured-baton-wielding-mob-suspected-triad>).

<a id="event-2019-07-21-2-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong anti-extradition bill protests.

**Archived source account.** Pro-Beijing legislator Junius Ho applauds the assailants for their actions, saying they should be "pardoned for defending their homes" and calling them his "heroes".

Source citations (as archived): [HKFP](<https://www.hongkongfp.com/2019/07/22/just-chaos-bloodshed-hong-kong-district-hundreds-masked-men-assault-protesters-journalists-residents/>); [SCMP](<https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/politics/article/3019621/pro-beijing-lawmaker-junius-ho-defends-white-clad-mob>).

<a id="event-2019-07-21-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A former Venezuelan state oil executive at PDVSA, Juan Carlos Márquez, is found hanged in an apartment in Madrid. He had been taken into custody in connection with an investigation into corruption and money laundering.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-49082596>).

Context: 2019 Japanese House of Councillors election.

**Archived source account.** Japanese citizens head to the polls to elect one half of the members of the country's House of Councillors.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-japan-election-takeaways/takeaways-from-japan-poll-diplomatic-challenges-and-diversity-idUKKCN1UH0CE>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/07/north-korea-fires-unidentified-projectiles-south-korean-military-190724222529433.html>); [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/north-korea-fires-missiles-into-sea-south-korea-military/a-49735180>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-07-25-1-1"></a>

Context: July 2019 European heat wave.

**Archived source account.** A number of national maximum temperature records are broken, several surpassing records set the previous day: Germany sees 42.6 C at Lingen, Belgium 41.8 C at Begijnendijk and The Netherlands 40.7 C at Gilze en Rijen.

Source citations (as archived): [Accuweather](<https://www.accuweather.com/en/weather-news/scorching-heat-produces-all-time-record-highs-in-belgium-netherlands-as-western-europe-swelters-under-heat-wave/70008886>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/live/2019/jul/25/heatwave-uk-weather-set-to-break-records-as-europes-cities-await-hottest-day-live>).

<a id="event-2019-07-25-1-2"></a>

Context: July 2019 European heat wave.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom reports a temperature reading of 38.1 C in Cambridge, the second highest UK temperature yet recorded. It is subsequently confirmed that a reading of 38.7 C is verified, also in Cambridge, beating the previous record of 38.5 C set in Faversham, Kent on 10 August 2003 to become the new national record.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2019/jul/29/met-office-confirms-new-uk-record-temperature-of-387c>).

<a id="event-2019-07-25-1-3"></a>

Context: July 2019 European heat wave.

**Editorial account; source review partial.** The City of Paris climate report identifies July 25, 2019 as the date Paris reached a record 42.6°C. This review establishes the specifically named city’s record, rather than every unnamed Western European locality covered by the original generalization.

Editorial date: 2019-07-25. Checked: 2026-10-21. Partial: Paris’s temperature and date are supported; the full multi-city generalization remains outside this scoped check.

Evidence: [City of Paris](<https://cdn.paris.fr/paris/2020/01/09/1253320023851dec2f8506f83cfe5289.pdf>).

Original source account: All-time records for various cities and towns in Western Europe are broken, most notably Paris, reaching a temperature of 42.6 C.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

He also welcomes other FARC rebels to Venezuela, calling them "leaders of peace".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics/maduro-says-missing-farc-leaders-are-welcome-in-venezuela-idUSKCN1UO028>).

Hong Kong legislators and journalists reject the statement from Beijing, expressing concern that this will worsen tensions.

## August

### 2019-08-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088208805](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20August%201&oldid=1088208805>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: RENAMO insurgency (2013–2019).

**Archived source account.** A peace deal is signed between the leaders of Renamo and the ruling party Frelimo in Mozambique, officially ending a conflict that plagued the country for years.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/mozambique-political-leaders-sign-peace-pact/a-49856229>).

<a id="event-2019-08-01-0-3"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War.

**Archived source account.** 51 security forces, including Southern Movement commander Munir Al Yafi, are killed and scores wounded in a rocket attack on a military camp near the city of Aden, Yemen. The rocket attack was claimed by Houthi movement.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/death-toll-rises-to-49-in-attacks-in-yemen-s-aden/1547314>).

<a id="event-2019-08-01-0-4"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War.

**Archived source account.** 13 people are killed by a suicide bomber in Sheikh Othman. The bombing was claimed by Islamic State.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/08/01/world/middleeast/yemen-houthi-military-parade.html>).

<a id="event-2019-08-01-0-6"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Mayor of Mogadishu Abdirahman Abdi Osman dies from injuries he sustained during the 24 July 2019 Mogadishu bombing.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/08/01/world/africa/mogadishu-mayor-dead.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-08-01-1-1"></a>

Context: China–United States trade war.

**Archived source account.** President of the United States Donald Trump announces in a tweet that the United States will impose import tariffs of 10% on US$300 billion worth of Chinese exports starting September 1.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/amp/2019/08/01/trump-says-us-will-impose-10percent-tariffs-on-300-billion-of-chinese-goods-starting-september-1.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-08-01-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The town of Whaley Bridge in Derbyshire, England, is evacuated after heavy rain and flooding causes structural damage to the nearby dam at the Toddbrook Reservoir amid fears the dam could collapse. A severe flood warning has been issued for communities situated along the River Goyt.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-derbyshire-49189955>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-08-01-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Commerce Secretary Wilbur Ross says that the United States has "a blueprint" to recover Venezuela's economy if Nicolás Maduro leaves office as the nation's disputed President.

Source citations (as archived): [Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/u-s-details-plan-to-rebuild-venezuela-under-democratic-rule-11564667567>).

<a id="event-2019-08-01-3-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** U.S President Donald Trump says that he is considering a blockade of Venezuela as the U.S increases pressure on President Maduro to step down.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-venezuela-politics-trump-idUKKCN1UR5Q9>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-08-01-4-1"></a>

Context: List of nearest exoplanets.

**Archived source account.** Astronomers from the Max Planck Institute for Astronomy announce the discovery of red dwarf star GJ 357 and its three confirmed exoplanets in the Hydra constellation, one of which (GJ 357 d) is highly likely to be a super-Earth planet located in the system's circumstellar habitable zone where life can exist. The discovery was made using NASA's Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS).

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/life-style/gadgets-and-tech/news/nasa-exoplanet-alien-life-tess-discovery-planet-world-a9034736.html>).

**Archived source account.** Japan carries out the first executions this year, hanging Koichi Shoji, 64, who killed two women in 2001, and serial killer Yasunori Suzuki, 50, who killed three women between 2004 and 2005 in Fukuoka Prefecture.

**Archived source account.** The Liberal Democrats gain the Brecon and Radnorshire seat from the Conservatives. This marks the first time a seat has changed hands in a by-election triggered by a successful recall petition. The working majority of the Conservative government is reduced to one.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2019/aug/02/brecon-radnorshire-byelection-lib-dems-jane-dodds-win-cuts-johnson-commons-majority-to-one>).

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/08/02/us/politics/trump-ratcliffe-dni.html>); [The New York Times²](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/08/02/us/politics/john-ratcliffe-sue-gordon.html>).

**Archived source account.** Romanian Prime Minister Viorica Dăncilă sacks Minister of Education Ecaterina Andronescu for her controversial comments in a television interview about murdered 15-year-old girl Alexandra Măceșanu, saying she was "taught not to get in cars with strangers". A 65-year-old man has since admitted killing Alexandra Măceșanu and another teenage girl who has been missing since April.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-49210168>).

<a id="event-2019-08-02-4-7"></a>

Context: Deforestation in Brazil.

**Archived source account.** Brazil's National Space Research Institute Director-General Ricardo Galvão is dismissed from office as a result of the release of data showing a rise in Amazon deforestation. President Jair Bolsonaro has called the release of the data "irresponsible and sensationalist".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-49212115>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/aug/02/brazil-space-institute-director-sacked-in-amazon-deforestation-row>).

### 2019-08-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088209088](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20August%203&oldid=1088209088>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-08-03-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019 El Paso shooting.

**Archived source account.** At least 22 people are killed and 24 others injured in a mass shooting at a Walmart in El Paso, Texas. A suspect Patrick Crusius of Allen, Texas was captured alive. The case is being investigated as domestic terrorism given that Patrick Crusius had posted a 4-page white nationalist manifesto titled The Inconvenient Truth on 8chan where he cited a supposed "Hispanic invasion of Texas" and "Simply trying to defend my country from cultural and ethnic replacement" as motivation for the shooting. The suspect was also inspired by Brenton Tarrant, the perpetrator of the Christchurch mosque shooting in New Zealand.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/08/05/us/el-paso-shooting-monday/index.html>).

Also, the pilgrimage to Machel Mata for yatra, which also began on 1 July, has been suspended.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-49222571>); [CNN-News18](<https://www.news18.com/news/india/dont-panic-jammu-kashmir-governor-tells-political-parties-as-tourists-and-pilgrims-leave-valley-2256657.html>).

<a id="event-2019-08-05-3-2"></a>

Context: Venezuelan refugee crisis, Colombia–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** Colombia grants national citizenship to all children born in the country to Venezuelan parents since August 2015. The measure will be in force for two years.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-venezuela-politics-colombia/colombia-to-give-citizenship-to-babies-of-venezuelan-migrants-idUKKCN1UV1ZG>).

<a id="event-2019-08-05-4-1"></a>

Context: October 2018 United States mail bombing attempts.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/08/05/us/cesar-sayoc-sentencing-monday/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-08-05-4-2"></a>

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-08-05-5-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong anti-extradition bill protests.

**Archived source account.** Hong Kong citizens call for a city-wide general strike with various sit-ins in seven districts. With around 2 million residents participated in the strikes, thousands of workers announcing their participation, over 200 flights were cancelled, MTR lines halted and the Hang Seng Index dropped sharply. Chief Executive Carrie Lam blamed protesters for "destroying Hong Kong" and rejected their demands.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-08-04/hong-kong-s-protests-to-extend-into-monday-testing-new-ground>); [Hong Kong Free Press](<https://www.hongkongfp.com/2019/08/05/protesters-trying-destroy-hong-kong-foment-revolution-says-chief-exec-carrie-lam/>).

<a id="event-2019-08-05-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** India revokes Jammu and Kashmir's special status amidst increased regional tensions. The Indian government moved additional troops into the sensitive area before banning assemblies, closing schools, restricting tourism and announcing a plan to split the state into two union territories.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/08/05/world/asia/india-pakistan-kashmir-jammu.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-08-05-6-1"></a>

Context: 2019 El Paso shooting.

**Archived source account.** 8chan is taken offline after San Francisco-based Cloudflare cuts support for the site in response to the perpetrator Patrick Crusius posting his white nationalist manifesto The Inconvenient Truth on the site shortly before killing 22 people and injuring 24 others at a Walmart in El Paso, Texas which was an anti-Hispanic terrorist attack.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-49232333>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-08-05-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** German association football club Chemnitzer FC sacks club captain Daniel Frahn for "openly displaying sympathy for Neo-Nazi groups". Frahn, who is currently unable to play due to injury, watched the club's recent match in the stands with far-right hooligan fans.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/football/2019/aug/05/chemnitzer-fc-sack-captain-for-openly-displaying-sympathy-for-neo-nazi-groups>).

### 2019-08-06

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1104626598](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20August%206&oldid=1104626598>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-08-06-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Donbass.

**Archived source account.** Four Ukrainian Ground Forces soldiers are killed in an attack by pro-Russian separatists, near the village of Pavlopil in the war-torn eastern Donetsk Oblast.

Source citations (as archived): [RFE/RL](<https://www.rferl.org/a/four-ukrainian-soldiers-killed-in-clashes-with-russia-backed-separatists/30095022.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-08-06-1-1"></a>

Context: United States–Venezuela relations, International sanctions during the Venezuelan crisis.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump signs an executive order freezing all assets and interests of the Venezuelan government as contained within the United States, a severe escalation from recent industry sanctions and verbal rhetoric. Twenty-one exceptions are issued, for companies providing services including oil, aid, and telecommunications. The expanded sanctions are widely criticized as likely to worsen the conditions for people in Venezuela.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://ca.reuters.com/article/topNews/idCAKCN1UW1MP-OCATP>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-49287899>).

<a id="event-2019-08-06-1-3"></a>

Context: India–Pakistan relations, Kashmir conflict.

**Archived source account.** Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan vows to fight India's unilateral decision to revoke Indian-administered Kashmir's autonomy, including in the United Nations General Assembly and Security Council. Mr. Khan stated this move is a breach of international law, adding he feared the possibility of ethnic cleansing in the Muslim-majority region.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-49258923>).

<a id="event-2019-08-06-1-4"></a>

Context: India–Pakistan relations, Kashmir conflict.

**Archived source account.** China, which administers the Kashmir territories of Aksai Chin and the Trans-Karakoram Tract, voices opposition to this "unacceptable" Indian move and, along with Turkey, reaffirms their support for a peaceful resolution.

Source citations (as archived): [EurAsian Times](<https://eurasiantimes.com/china-turkey-support-pakistans-stance-on-resolution-kashmir-dispute/>); [Newsweek](<https://www.newsweek.com/china-pakistan-warn-india-border-1452896>).

<a id="event-2019-08-06-1-5"></a>

Context: India–Pakistan relations, Kashmir conflict.

**Archived source account.** Kashmir remains on lockdown, with the internet out and nearly all phone lines severed.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/08/06/world/asia/jammu-kashmir-india.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-08-06-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Florida Governor Ron DeSantis orders law enforcement to handle a criminal probe of Jeffrey Epstein's jail release in the late 2000s.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2019/08/06/florida-governor-orders-criminal-probe-over-prior-jeffrey-epstein-case.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-08-06-3-1"></a>

Context: Crisis in Venezuela.

**Archived source account.** The Argentine government says it has already received "hundreds" of reports of human rights abuses and criminal accusations against the Venezuelan government, days after Argentina invited Venezuelans in the country to file reports against the Venezuelan government.

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-08-06-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Scientists at the Spring, Texas, Arch Mission Foundation confirm that tardigrades in a cryptobiotic state were added to the payload of the failed SpaceIL Beresheet lander that crashed on the Moon on 11 April 2019, and may have survived the crash.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/science/2019/aug/06/tardigrades-may-have-survived-spacecraft-crashing-on-moon>); [CNET](<https://www.cnet.com/news/tardigrades-are-now-on-moon-thanks-to-crashed-israeli-spacecraft-water-bears/>).

<a id="event-2019-08-06-4-2"></a>

Context: 2019 in spaceflight.

**Archived source account.** The European Space Agency successfully launches the German Aerospace Center-operated EDRS-C laser communication satellite on an Ariane 5 from the Guiana Space Centre in French Guiana.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-49240745>).

<a id="event-2019-08-06-4-3"></a>

Context: 2019 in spaceflight.

**Archived source account.** SpaceX successfully launches Israeli communications satellite Amos-17 on a Falcon 9 rocket from Cape Canaveral Air Force Station. The launch was provided by SpaceX for free following the destruction of Spacecom's Amos-6 satellite in 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [Space.com](<https://www.space.com/spacex-launches-amos17-communications-satellite.html>).

**Archived source account.** Israeli riot police clash with Palestinians at the Al-Aqsa Mosque and Temple Mount site in East Jerusalem. With holidays coincidentally falling on the same day (11 August) this year for both Judaism and Islam, some Palestinians began protesting the admittance of Jewish visitors to the site, despite a longstanding agreement barring Jewish visitors. The Jews were then admitted, which caused further tensions on both sides of the dispute.

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-08-12-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 24 people die after floods strike across Vietnam. In the south, nearly 3,900 houses and more than 22,000 hectares of crops are submerged, mostly in Lam Dong Province. Floods also damage more than 30km of national roads, including the road leading to the tourist city of Dalat and destroy 142 hectares of aquarium farming and 4,300 cages of river-raised fish.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/08/dozens-dead-missing-typhoon-wipha-aftermath-vietnam-190807030033772.html>).

Russian nuclear agency Rosatom says the failed test involved a "nuclear isotope power source" for a liquid-propelled rocket engine.

Protestors chanted against the government's recent attempts at municipalization and privatization of the Indigenous health subsystem, and called for stricter environmental regulations.
