**Archived source account.** Suspected Islamist militants launch an attack on a Burkina Faso Armed Forces unit, killing 24 Burkinabé soldiers and wounding 7 others, the heaviest loss for the army in its fight to contain Islamist terrorism. The army said it had launched a land and air operation in response to the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-burkina-security/death-toll-from-burkina-faso-militant-attack-rises-to-24-idUSKCN1VA17S>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-08-19-1-1"></a>

Context: Deforestation in Brazil, 2019 Brazil wildfires.

**Archived source account.** After fifteen days of raging fires in the Amazon Forest in Rondônia, thick smoke clouds cover the Brazilian city of São Paulo in darkness. Street lamps had to be lit in the city around 2PM. The fires, suspected to be intentional, are still burning the forest.

Source citations (as archived): [G1](<https://g1.globo.com/sp/sao-paulo/noticia/2019/08/19/dia-vira-noite-em-sao-paulo-com-chegada-de-frente-fria-nesta-segunda.ghtml>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-08-19-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong anti-extradition bill protests; Cross-Strait relations.

**Archived source account.** China condemns Taiwan after President Tsai Ing-wen offered support and asylum to Hong Kong protesters facing prosecution in Hong Kong courts.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/world/2019/08/19/China-lashes-Taiwan-over-offer-to-Hong-Kong-protesters-.html#>).

<a id="event-2019-08-19-2-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong anti-extradition bill protests; Cross-Strait relations.

**Archived source account.** Twitter says it has suspended more than 200,000 automated accounts on the social media site that it believes were part of a Chinese government-run campaign to spread misinformation about the protests in Hong Kong.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/Technology/wireStory/twitter-shuts-chinese-accounts-targeting-hong-kong-protests-65060958>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-08-19-3-1"></a>

Context: 2016–present purges in Turkey.

**Archived source account.** Turkey's Ministry of the Interior tweets that 418 people in 29 provinces are detained by police, for suspected links with the Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK). The authorities have also announced that they "replaced" the mayors of three major southeastern cities.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/amp/idUSKCN1V90EX>).

<a id="event-2019-08-19-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former President of Sudan Omar al-Bashir appears in court for the first time at a Khartoum court to face corruption charges.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/middle-east/2019/08/19/Sudan-s-Bashir-in-court-for-graft-trial.html>).

<a id="event-2019-08-19-3-4"></a>

Context: Women's rights in El Salvador.

**Archived source account.** Evelyn Hernández is acquitted of murder after her newly-born child was found deceased in a toilet. The ruling is being held as a landmark case decision for women's rights in El Salvador, which has one of the strongest anti-abortion laws in Central America.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-49368632>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-08-19-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Palestinian Authority bans LGBT activities in the West Bank in anticipation of an upcoming Al Qaws event.

Source citations (as archived): [Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/Middle-East/PA-bans-LGBT-activities-in-West-Bank-598980>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-08-19-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Astronomers led by a team from McGill University in Montreal announce the detection of eight new repeating fast radio bursts (FRBs) using the Canadian Hydrogen Intensity Mapping Experiment (CHIME) radio telescope. The astronomers report they also found complex morphologies and downward-drifting sub-bursts in some of the eight new FRBs.

Source citations (as archived): [Phys.org](<https://phys.org/news/2019-08-fast-radio.html>).

### 2019-08-20

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256032013](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20August%2020&oldid=1256032013>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-08-20-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, 2019 Northwestern Syria offensive.

**Archived source account.** The Al-Qaeda-linked faction Hayat Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) acknowledges "a redeployment" south of the strategic town of Khan Shaykhun.

Source citations (as archived): [AP News](<https://apnews.com/7385d040867247ddbf7bbfae99847e04>).

<a id="event-2019-08-20-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, 2019 Northwestern Syria offensive.

**Archived source account.** Media close to the government reports that the Syrian Army enters the northern sector of the town of Khan Shaykhun, following the reported HTS withdrawal.

Source citations (as archived): [Al-Masdar News](<https://www.almasdarnews.com/article/breaking-syrian-army-enters-khan-sheikhoun-to-secure-city/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-08-20-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Spanish Ministry of Health declares an outbreak of listeriosis in Andalusia as a national health alert after cases are reported in Asturias, Madrid, Catalonia and Extremadura, including one death.

Source citations (as archived): [RTVE](<http://www.rtve.es/noticias/20190820/sanidad-decreta-alerta-sanitaria-nacional-brote-listeriosis-detectado-andalucia/1977367.shtml>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-08-20-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** Nicolás Maduro confirms United States reports that top Venezuelan officials are having secret meetings with members of the Trump administration. Maduro claims that the talks encourage Trump to listen to him; United States sources claim that the talks encourage Maduro supporters to defect.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/aug/21/venezuelan-leader-nicolas-maduro-confirms-months-of-secret-us-talks>).

<a id="event-2019-08-20-2-3"></a>

Context: Proposed United States purchase of Greenland.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump cancels his September state visit to Denmark because Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen says that she has no interest in discussing the purchase of Greenland.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-49416740>).

<a id="event-2019-08-20-2-5"></a>

Context: Holy See–Vietnam relations.

**Archived source account.** The two sides meet in the Vatican and discuss bilateral relations, ecclesial life and the future visit of Vatican Secretary of State, Cardinal Pietro Parolin. The Vietnam — Holy See Joint Working Group first met in 2009. Vietnam, a Communist nation of 97 million, is 7% Catholic.

Source citations (as archived): [Vatican News](<https://www.vaticannews.va/en/vatican-city/news/2019-08/holy-see-vietnam-joint-working-group-vatican.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-08-20-3-1"></a>

Context: Crime in Brazil.

**Archived source account.** Thirty-seven passengers on a bus over Rio–Niterói Bridge, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, are held hostage before police fatally shoot the armed hijacker. After closer inspection, police discover that the hijacker used a fake plastic gun.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-49406032>); [Extra](<https://extra.globo.com/casos-de-policia/sequestrador-de-onibus-na-ponte-rio-niteroi-usava-arma-de-brinquedo-afirma-porta-voz-da-policia-militar-23889013.html>).

<a id="event-2019-08-20-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former professional basketball player Mateen Cleaves is acquitted of several sex crimes in a court in his hometown of Flint, Michigan.

Source citations (as archived): [MLive](<https://www.mlive.com/news/flint/2019/08/mateen-cleaves-found-not-guilty-in-sex-assault-trial.html>); [WJRT-TV](<https://www.abc12.com/content/news/Mateen-Cleaves-found-not-guilty-of-sexual-assault-charges-557032331.html>).

<a id="event-2019-08-20-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A modification of the Volcker rule is approved by the OCC and the FDIC. The new version eases rules on proprietary trading by Wall Street banks. Consumer groups criticize the rule change, claiming that it removes protections from taxpayers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-banks-volcker/u-s-regulators-hand-wall-street-a-major-win-with-stripped-down-volcker-rule-idUSKCN1VA1B8>).

<a id="event-2019-08-20-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Texas Department of Information Resources reports that the computer systems of 23 towns in the state were hit by a ransomware attack on August 16. "One single threat actor" is suspected.

Source citations (as archived): [Insider](<https://www.insider.com/texas-ransomware-attack-affects-23-towns-single-attacker-2019-8>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-08-20-4-1"></a>

Context: Politics of Italy, Conte Cabinet.

**Archived source account.** Italian Prime Minister Giuseppe Conte resigns. He criticizes Deputy Prime Minister Matteo Salvini, accusing him of sinking the ruling coalition for personal and political gain. The President of Italy, Sergio Mattarella, accepts Conte's resignation and announces that he will start consultations with party leaders.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-italy-politics/italian-pm-resigns-denounces-salvini-for-sinking-government-idUSKCN1VA0TE>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-italy-politics-president-decision/italys-president-accepts-contes-resignation-calls-for-consultations-idUSKCN1VA22L>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-08-20-5-1"></a>

Context: List of unmanned aerial vehicles.

**Archived source account.** The Russian Ministry of Defence announces that the six-tonne satellite-controlled reconnaissance drone Altius-U has performed its maiden flight.

Source citations (as archived): [TASS](<https://tass.com/defense/1074237>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-08-20-6-1"></a>

Context: Expansion of Major League Soccer.

**Archived source account.** Major League Soccer, the top level of the men's sport in the U.S., announces that a team in St. Louis, Missouri will become the league's 28th team, most likely in 2022. The ownership group, led by several female members of the Taylor family that controls the Enterprise Holdings car rental company, is the first in MLS in which women hold a majority interest.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<https://www.espn.com/soccer/major-league-soccer/story/3925142/mls-expands-to-st-louis-team-to-start-in-2022>).

### 2019-08-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1352775987](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20August%2021&oldid=1352775987>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-08-21-0-1"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** A United States MQ-9 military drone is reportedly shot down in Yemen's Dhamar Governorate. A Houthi spokesperson claims responsibility and adds that they used a locally-developed missile.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-usa-drone/u-s-drone-shot-down-over-yemen-officials-idUSKCN1VB180>).

<a id="event-2019-08-21-0-4"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021) / 17 August 2019 Kabul bombing.

**Archived source account.** The death toll of a suicide bombing during a wedding in Kabul, Afghanistan, four days ago, increases to 80.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/08/death-toll-afghanistan-wedding-blast-rises-80-190821070634770.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-08-21-1-1"></a>

Context: United States federal budget.

**Archived source account.** The Congressional Budget Office forecasts a deficit of US$1 trillion next year, up from the previous estimate of $892 billion.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/08/21/us/politics/deficit-will-reach-1-trillion-next-year-budget-office-predicts.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-08-21-2-1"></a>

Context: Australia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Australia announces its agreement to join the United States' coalition, along with the United Kingdom and Bahrain, to prevent Iran from targeting ships travelling through the Strait of Hormuz. Australia will deploy a Boeing P-8 Poseidon and a frigate.

Source citations (as archived): [The Sydney Morning Herald](<https://www.smh.com.au/politics/federal/australia-to-join-united-states-led-coalition-to-protect-ships-near-iran-20190821-p52j85.html>).

<a id="event-2019-08-21-2-3"></a>

Context: Denmark–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Queen Margrethe II of Denmark expresses surprise at U.S. President Donald Trump's abrupt cancellation of his planned visit to her country. Experts on the royal house call the move an act of "disrespect" as illness is not the apparent cause.

Source citations (as archived): [TV2](<https://nyheder.tv2.dk/samfund/2019-08-21-ekspert-kalder-afvisning-af-kongehuset-en-fornaermelse-i-den-tunge-vaegtklasse>).

<a id="event-2019-08-21-2-5"></a>

Context: Iceland–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The office of the Prime Minister of Iceland Katrín Jakobsdóttir confirms that she will not meet the Vice President of the United States Mike Pence on his visit in September, citing "prior commitments."

Source citations (as archived): [AP News](<https://apnews.com/1124209b56fe4551a0383c71068a2cd4>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-08-21-3-1"></a>

Context: Catholic Church sexual abuse cases in Australia.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of Victoria rejects an appeal made by Cardinal George Pell against a six-year jail sentence for child sexual abuse.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2019/aug/21/cardinal-george-pells-conviction-for-child-sexual-abuse-upheld>).

<a id="event-2019-08-21-3-3"></a>

Context: China–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** The Foreign Ministry of China confirms that United Kingdom consulate in Hong Kong employee Simon Cheng, who was reported missing, is administratively detained for 15 days by Shenzhen police.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://amp.cnn.com/cnn/2019/08/21/asia/hong-kong-simon-cheng-intl-hnk/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-08-21-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Indian senior opposition Rajya Sabha MP and former Cabinet Minister Palaniappan Chidambaram is arrested by the Central Bureau of Investigation on charges of corruption and money laundering during his term as Minister of Finance. Chidambaram says to the Supreme Court that the government is practicing a "politically-motivated vendetta" against him and his son Karti, who is also an opposition MP.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-49421255>).

### 2019-08-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088369126](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20August%2022&oldid=1088369126>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Papua conflict.

**Archived source account.** Indonesia cuts off Internet in the provinces of Papua and West Papua amid pro-independence unrest.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://amp.theguardian.com/world/2019/aug/22/west-papua-protests-indonesia-deploys-1000-soldiers-to-quell-unrest>); [RTÉ](<https://www.rte.ie/amp/1070242/>).

<a id="event-2019-08-22-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A ninth round of peace talks between the United States and the Taliban starts in Doha, Qatar.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/amp/news/2019/08/crucial-talks-taliban-doha-190822134721796.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-08-22-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least four people are dead and more than 100 injured after lightning strikes the summit of Giewont in the Tatra Mountains, Poland. Another person is killed in Slovakia.

Source citations (as archived): [tvn24.pl](<https://www.tvn24.pl/tvn24-news-in-english,157,m/poland-several-dead-and-injured-after-heavy-thunderstorm-in-tatras,963176.html>); [gazeta.pl](<http://wiadomosci.gazeta.pl/wiadomosci/7,114883,25111090,tatry-piorun-uderzyl-w-turystow-na-giewoncie-trwa-akcja-ratunkowa.html>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-49439619>).

<a id="event-2019-08-22-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least five people are killed and 21 others injured in a stampede at a rap concert in Algiers, Algeria.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-08-22-2-1"></a>

Context: Japan–South Korea relations, GSOMIA.

**Archived source account.** South Korea decides against extending the General Security of Military Information Agreement (GSOMIA). South Korean officials express that the exclusion from Japan's preferred trade list on 12 August eliminated any benefit to maintaining the agreement.

Source citations (as archived): [NHK](<https://www3.nhk.or.jp/news/html/20190822/k10012044721000.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-08-22-3-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Chemnitz protests.

**Archived source account.** A Syrian man is jailed for manslaughter in relation to a stabbing in Chemnitz, Saxony, Germany last year. The killing sparked far-right protests and riots in the city.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-49438847>).

<a id="event-2019-08-22-3-3"></a>

Context: Eileen Sarmenta and Allan Gomez murder.

**Archived source account.** Philippine Department of Justice Secretary Menardo Guevarra and Bureau of Corrections (BuCor) Director-General Nicanor Faeldon says that former Calauan Mayor Antonio Sanchez is ineligible under a 2013 law that credits good conduct time allowance (GCTA) for an early release from prison.

<a id="event-2019-08-22-4-1"></a>

Context: 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries.

**Archived source account.** Washington governor Jay Inslee drops out of the presidential primaries to focus on his re-election bid.

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-08-22-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The second GPS IIIA satellite is successfully launched by a Delta IV Medium rocket from Cape Canaveral Air Force Station. It is the last launch of the Delta IV Medium vehicle.

Source citations (as archived): [Orlando Sentinel](<https://www.orlandosentinel.com/space/os-bz-delta-gps-advance-20190821-ohgyewv2f5d2jivurkiexqznje-story.html>).

<a id="event-2019-08-22-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The uncrewed Soyuz MS-14 mission to resupply the International Space Station commences. Its launch is a successful test of a Soyuz spacecraft atop a Soyuz-2 launch vehicle, which will replace the Soyuz-FG as the carrier rocket for Soyuz spacecraft starting next year.

Source citations (as archived): [NASASpaceFlight.com](<https://www.nasaspaceflight.com/2019/08/soyuz-ms-14-upgrades-ferry-skybot-robot-station/>); [Space.com](<https://www.space.com/russia-launches-humanoid-robot-on-soyuz-spacecraft.html>).

### 2019-08-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088369753](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20August%2023&oldid=1088369753>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-08-23-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, 2019 Northwestern Syria offensive.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Army captures the entire northern Hama-southern Idlib rebel pocket, asserting control over the strategic towns of Kafr Zita, Al-Lataminah and Murak, as well as numerous villages and an archaeological site, following the withdrawal of rebel forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-northwest/syrian-army-captures-hama-rebel-pocket-in-northwest-state-media-idUSKCN1VD0P1>); [Al Masdar News](<https://www.almasdarnews.com/article/breaking-syrian-army-captures-entire-northern-hama-pocket/>).

<a id="event-2019-08-23-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, 2019 Northwestern Syria offensive.

**Archived source account.** The Turkish observation post near Murak is encircled by government forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Asharq Al-Awsat](<https://aawsat.com/english/home/article/1869021/syrian-regime-forces-surround-turkish-army-post>); [Ansamed](<http://www.ansamed.info/ansamed/en/news/sections/generalnews/2019/08/23/syrian-govt-forces-advance-south-of-idlib_93fb60b4-4fb7-44c8-99be-bb94e06a3223.html>).

<a id="event-2019-08-23-0-4"></a>

Context: Iran–Israel proxy conflict.

**Archived source account.** U.S. officials confirm that an airstrike on an Iranian weapons depot in Amirli, Iraq on July 19 that killed two Iranian military commanders was conducted by Israel. The strike is the first known Israeli attack inside Iraq since Operation Opera in 1981.

<a id="event-2019-08-23-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Al-Qaeda accuses "treacherous Pakistani forces" of detaining the wife and two other relatives of the group's leader Ayman al Zawahiri for over a year.

<a id="event-2019-08-23-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Brazil wildfires.

**Archived source account.** Finland, current chair of the European Union, asks the bloc to contemplate a ban on beef from Brazil in response to the ongoing disaster.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-politics-eu-beef/finland-urges-eu-to-consider-banning-brazilian-beef-over-amazon-fires-idUKKCN1VD17R>).

<a id="event-2019-08-23-2-1"></a>

Context: China–United States trade war.

**Archived source account.** China retaliates on the United States' latest tariff decisions by imposing tariffs of up to 25% on some American goods.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/amp/2019/08/23/china-to-retaliate-with-new-tariffs-on-another-75-billion-worth-of-us-goods.html>).

<a id="event-2019-08-23-2-2"></a>

Context: China–United States trade war.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump states on Twitter that he has "hereby ordered" that U.S. companies find an alternative for manufacturing in China and relocate "HOME."

Context: China–United States trade war.

The Office of the United States Trade Representative says it will "begin the process of increasing the tariff rate to 30% effective October 1 following a notice and comment period".

### 2019-08-24

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-08-24-0-1"></a>

Context: Papuan conflict.

**Archived source account.** Crowds gather in Port Moresby, Papua New Guinea, to show solidarity and to campaign for the freedom of West Papua, which is under Indonesian control. Meanwhile, churches push the government of Papua New Guinea to take a firm stand on the situation.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/397395/papuan-students-in-java-urged-to-return-home-if-not-safe>).

<a id="event-2019-08-24-0-3"></a>

Context: Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Israel Defense Forces say their Air Force strikes multiple Iranian Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps targets in Aqraba near the Syrian capital Damascus. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu claims an Iranian attack on Israel using armed drones to be imminent. Syria says it repels the attack and shoots down most of the attackers' rockets.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/Breaking-News/Explosions-heard-above-Damascus-599587>); [SANA](<https://sana.sy/en/?p=171819>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-08-24-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Brazil wildfires.

**Archived source account.** Brazil readies its military to fight wildfires in the Amazon rainforest, but does not deploy troops.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/amp/2019/08/24/as-eu-threatens-trade-retaliation-brazil-fights-amazon-fires.html>); [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/amazon-fires-troops-ready-1.5258906>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-08-24-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Nauruan parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Nauru go to the polls to elect new members of parliament. President Baron Waqa loses his parliamentary seat so he is not able to be re-elected in the office he has been holding since 2013.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2019-08-24/nauru-election-plagued-by-allegations-of-misconduct-opposition/11438708>); [ABC News](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2019-08-25/naurus-president-loses-bid-for-re-election/11446064>).

### 2019-08-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1174592363](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20August%2025&oldid=1174592363>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-08-25-0-2"></a>

Context: Israeli–Lebanese conflict / 2019 Beirut drone crash.

**Archived source account.** Hezbollah says two Israeli drones went down in the Moawwad neighborhood of Dahieh (South Beirut), Lebanon, and they did not shoot them. A small reconnaissance drone fell on the roof of the Hezbollah media building, then another drone exploded nearby, causing damage to the building. Residents report a loud blast. The Israeli Army says it does not comment on "foreign reports". The Lebanese Army confirms the drones as Israeli.

Source citations (as archived): [AP News](<https://apnews.com/f6838eab9e9f4bb6b587013f26fad961>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/08/israeli-drones-beirut-hezbollah-190825052725185.html>); [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-lebanon-security-israel/lebanese-army-says-one-israeli-drone-fell-another-exploded-in-beirut-overnight-idUKKCN1VF075>).

<a id="event-2019-08-25-0-4"></a>

Context: Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Iran denies attacks in southern Syria by Israel hit their installations. The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights, an opposition-aligned medium, claims the missiles killed one Iranian and two people from Hezbollah.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/iran-denies-its-posts-were-hit-in-syria-strike-2-hezbollah-fighters-said-killed/>).

<a id="event-2019-08-25-0-6"></a>

Context: 2019 Israeli airstrikes in Iraq.

**Archived source account.** Alleged Israeli airstrikes hit a Iran backed Popular Mobilization Forces convoy near Al-Qa'im, Iraq.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/08/iraq-paramilitary-israel-drone-attack-syria-border-190825184711737.html>).

<a id="event-2019-08-25-0-8"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** In an escalation of the ongoing protests, a police officer fires a gun whilst clearing protesters; this is the first time a gun has been fired by a police officer in Hong Kong since 1967.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/aug/30/hong-kongs-be-water-protests-leaves-china-casting-about-for-an-enemy>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-08-25-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A helicopter and an ultralight airplane plane collide near the town of Inca, on the island of Mallorca, Spain, killing seven people including two children, according to regional government officials.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/five-dead-after-helicopter-and-small-plane-collide-in-majorca-11793978>).

<a id="event-2019-08-25-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Lightning strikes on at least two Alaska Airlines planes force them to make emergency landings in Southeast Alaska. Lightning also knocked out electrical service to the state capital, Juneau.

Source citations (as archived): [Kfsk](<https://www.kfsk.org/2019/08/26/lightning-strikes-reported-on-two-alaska-airlines-flights-sunday-near-juneau/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-08-25-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed and four others injured in a mass shooting at a house party in Hobbs, New Mexico, U.S.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/08/25/us/three-dead-new-mexico-shooting/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-08-25-3-1"></a>

Context: Rohingya crisis.

**Archived source account.** At Kutupalong, the world's largest refugee camp, in Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh, 200,000 people gather peacefully to remember the day, in 2017, when a violent crackdown by Myanmarese security forces compelled 740,000 Rohingya to flee over the border.

Source citations (as archived): [France24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20190825-200-000-rohingya-rally-to-mark-genocide-day-in-bangladesh-camps>).

<a id="event-2019-08-25-3-3"></a>

Context: 2020 Republican Party presidential primaries.

**Archived source account.** Conservative radio host and former Illinois congressman Joe Walsh announces his run for president, becoming only the second Republican to challenge incumbent President Donald Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/08/25/politics/joe-walsh-take-on-trump-in-2020-republican-primary/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-08-25-3-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Abkhazian presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Partially recognized Republic of Abkhazia holds the first round of the presidential election. Incumbent President Raul Khajimba and oppositor Alkhas Kvitsinia heads to second round on 8th September.

Source citations (as archived): [Eurasianet](<https://eurasianet.org/abkhazia-presidential-election-heads-to-runoff>).

### 2019-08-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 912802986](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20August%2026&oldid=912802986>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-08-26-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Qousaya attack, Israel–Lebanon relations.

**Editorial account; source review partial.** Reuters reported claims by a Palestinian faction and Lebanese media of Israeli strikes on a position near Qusaya. It also recorded an Israeli military spokesperson declining to comment. This supports an attributed report, rather than independent confirmation of the attack’s perpetrator or the source’s exact post-2006 ordinal claim.

Editorial date: 2019-08-26. Checked: 2026-10-21. Partial: location, reported target and attribution are supported; the “second attack since 2006” formulation is not established by this review.

Evidence: [Reuters via Geo News](<https://www.geo.tv/latest/245859-israeli-strikes-hit-palestinian-military-position-in-lebanon-group>).

Original source account: Lebanese media claims Israeli aircraft targeted a PFLP-GC military site in Qousaya town, making it the second attack in Lebanon since the 2006 war after the alleged attack in Beirut yesterday.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2019-08-26-0-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Qousaya attack, Israel–Lebanon relations.

**Archived source account.** Lebanese President Michel Aoun accuses Israel of a "declaration of war", and asserts the right of the country to defend itself from aggression in response to Israeli strikes in the Beqaa Valley.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/middle-east/2019/08/26/Lebanese-president-Aoun-Israeli-strikes-amount-to-declaration-of-war-.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-08-26-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Federal Cartel Office in Germany announced that it will appeal a decision by a regional court that suspended its restrictions on Facebook's activities. The appeal will bring the dispute, over underlying privacy issues, to the attention of the country's highest court.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-facebook-germany/german-cartel-office-to-take-facebook-case-to-high-court-idUSKCN1VG1AJ>).

<a id="event-2019-08-26-1-2"></a>

Context: Opioid epidemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** An Oklahoma district court finds Johnson &amp; Johnson liable for exacerbating opioid addiction in the state, and fines them US$572 million. The company announces it will appeal.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-opioids-litigation-oklahoma/jj-liable-for-572-million-in-oklahoma-opioid-epidemic-trial-but-shares-surge-idUSKCN1VG0V2>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-08-26-2-1"></a>

Context: 45th G7 summit.

**Archived source account.** Group of Seven leaders hold their yearly meeting in Biarritz, France.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/politics/live-news/g7-summit-monday-dle-intl/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-08-26-3-1"></a>

Context: Politics of Indonesia.

**Archived source account.** Indonesian President Joko Widodo announces North Penajam Paser and Kutai Kartanegara regencies as location of the future capital of Indonesia. He says government will prepare a bill to submit in the House of Representatives as soon as possible.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jakarta Post](<https://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2019/08/26/breaking-jokowi-announces-east-kalimantan-as-site-of-new-capital.html>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/welcome-to-the-jungle-indonesia-picks-site-for-new-capital-city/2019/08/26/809cb0a2-c7b4-11e9-9615-8f1a32962e04_story.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-08-27-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Kurdish–Turkish conflict.

**Archived source account.** YPG units withdraw from Tell Abyad and Ras al-Ayn as the first stage of the Northern Syria Buffer Zone agreement enters into effect.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-syria-security-sdf-idUKKCN1VH1BJ>); [Kurdistan 24](<https://www.kurdistan24.net/en/news/6ea0b2eb-5b51-4583-93c8-2f717f655350>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-08-27-1-1"></a>

Context: Tropical Storm Dorian.

**Archived source account.** Tropical Storm Dorian is expected to grow stronger as it reaches Puerto Rico, the National Hurricane Center says.

Source citations (as archived): [Sun-Sentinel](<https://www.sun-sentinel.com/news/weather/hurricane/fl-ne-tropical-storm-dorian-update-florida-path-20190827-75d3b5rfnfbmxhvhqkywipabpa-story.html?fbclid=IwAR3sgLrvQoMtcwEHksBXmMzbs07WO9DypYbX1cjOSF-hfQncADVBJKw5uD0>).

<a id="event-2019-08-27-1-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Amazon rainforest wildfires.

**Archived source account.** The Brazilian government through President Jair Messias Bolsonaro is open to accepting financial aid from organizations and foreign countries to help fight fires in the Amazon rainforest on the condition that the funds must be under the country's control.

<a id="event-2019-08-27-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Air China Airbus A330 preparing to takeoff as Flight 183 catches fire during boarding at Beijing International Airport. Passengers and crew successfully evacuate, but the aircraft is severely damaged.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-08-27-2-1"></a>

Context: Abortion in Missouri.

**Archived source account.** A U.S. federal judge blocks a Missouri law banning abortions eight weeks after conception from going into effect.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Beast](<https://www.thedailybeast.com/missouris-8-week-abortion-ban-blocked-by-federal-judge?fbclid=IwAR16KRp_iyAfMTIaqRTPAg6i65vhBteg7-_NY5l4f1MXy7lO9REBaFS0-vk>).

<a id="event-2019-08-27-2-3"></a>

Context: Illegal immigration to the United States.

**Archived source account.** The Donald Trump administration is in the process of shifting at least $155 million from the Federal Emergency Management Agency to the Department of Homeland Security, in order to fund the return of some migrants to Mexico. The move comes as Tropical Storm Dorian nears hurricane status as it approaches Puerto Rico.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/08/27/politics/fema-immigration-enforcement-dorian/index.html?utm_source=CNN-News-Alerts&amp;utm_medium=email&amp;utm_campaign=ICE+to+get+FEMA+fundsf6deda37-364a-4dca-b3d4-8cc1e690b369&amp;utm_term=1c1a3674-f347-0441-0baa-8ee61c704e63&amp;m=d6b08d327e4dcaf19c8d7624ea3f3e1e&amp;p=2019-08-2720%3A06&amp;fbclid=IwAR053QTycMJMaIKsvD-0tRVo0E9C9mH71qw0ViqKNjETx0cMrzyUgIvo5rg>).

<a id="event-2019-08-27-2-5"></a>

Context: Boeing 737 MAX groundings.

**Archived source account.** Russian aircraft leasing firm Avia Capital Services, which has ordered 35 Boeing 737 MAX aircraft, sues Boeing in an Illinois court in the first legal action taken by a 737 MAX customer in the wake of the groundings. Avia seek damages and a cancellation of the order, claiming Boeing were fraudulent, breached their contract with Avia, and negligently introduced design flaws to the aircraft and made negligent representations to the Federal Aviation Authority seeking the plane's certification. With nearly 400 jets grounded worldwide since March, lawyers representing Avia say they are discussing the possibility of joining the litigation with other companies.

Source citations (as archived): [CityNews Vancouver](<https://www.citynews1130.com/2019/08/27/russian-firm-sues-boeing-over-max-jet-says-defects-hidden/>).

<a id="event-2019-08-27-2-7"></a>

Context: 2013 Via Rail Canada terrorism plot.

**Archived source account.** An appeals court in Ontario, Canada overturns the terror convictions of Raed Jaser and Chiheb Esseghaier, citing an error by the trial judge regarding jury selection. A new trial is expected to take place.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-49490394>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-08-27-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Nauruan parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** Lionel Aingimea is sworn in as the President of Nauru, replacing Baron Waqa.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/397576/aingimea-chosen-as-waqa-s-successor-in-nauru>).

<a id="event-2019-08-27-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Poland announces a planned national budget with zero deficit for the first time in 30 years.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! Finance](<https://finance.yahoo.com/news/poland-plans-no-budget-deficit-131625295.html?guccounter=1&amp;guce_referrer=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZ29vZ2xlLmNvbS8&amp;guce_referrer_sig=AQAAAEBVO-Fr5NO4Tp7o5oGIvbKMt9rjU5ZJfMj8iPVXJAn3RnHOkF4hE5AKjD7QStKSwSa6rlLeixDR_KQkNUE9f0T_ZDBl_J8aLoNINZL-ydDXU5KD2C13qoyWv3jhMa3EXedxXiF4aG2ZcziFb5DFIyN3H0EFJio8et8TCRj73VA6>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-08-27-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The uncrewed Soyuz MS-14 spacecraft successfully docks with the International Space Station on its second attempt, with the Zvezda module. The docking follows the failure of the automated systems aboard the Poisk module with which the spacecraft was originally intended to dock on 24 August. MS-14 carries supplies for the ISS, along with a humanoid robot named Fedor.

Source citations (as archived): [SpaceNews](<https://spacenews.com/soyuz-docks-with-iss-on-second-attempt/>); [Space.com](<https://www.space.com/unpiloted-soyuz-ms14-docks-at-space-station.html>).

<a id="event-2019-08-27-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** SpaceX executes a successful test of its Starhopper vehicle at Boca Chica. The vehicle was raised 150 metres (490 feet) into the air by its methane-fueled Raptor engine. The engine is planned for use on SpaceX's Starship vehicle – a crewed spacecraft capable of interplanetary flight.

Source citations (as archived): [Forbes](<https://www.forbes.com/sites/jonathanocallaghan/2019/08/27/spacex-launches-starhopper-on-stunning-final-flight-and-takes-a-major-step-towards-mars/#77e238493529>); [Los Angeles Times](<https://www.latimes.com/business/story/2019-08-27/spacex-starhopper-mars-prototype-test>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-08-27-5-1"></a>

Context: 2019–20 in English football.

**Archived source account.** English association football club Bury F.C., who were in EFL League One, are expelled from the English Football League (EFL) after a takeover bid to save the club collapses. Fellow EFL League One club and local rivals Bolton Wanderers F.C. are given an extra 14 days to avoid being expelled due to financial difficulty. EFL executive chair Debbie Jevans calls the expulsion of Bury F.C. "one of the darkest days in the league's recent history".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/49451896>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

**Archived source account.** Hamas says that on Tuesday night, three Palestinian police officers were killed and several wounded in two separate suicide attacks on police checkpoints. ISIL's affiliate in Gaza, the Sheikh Omar Hadid Brigade, are the suspected perpetrators.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-49491516>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-08-28-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed amidst heavy rains in southwestern Japan. Authorities ask almost one million people to evacuate, warning "unprecedented" levels of rainfall could cause the flooding of rivers, trigger landslides, and submerge houses.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-49492706>).

<a id="event-2019-08-28-1-2"></a>

Context: 2018 Pretoria Convair 340 crash.

**Archived source account.** The Civil Aviation Authority of South Africa concludes its investigation with a final report indicating the accident was caused by poor maintenance and errors by unqualified pilots.

Source citations (as archived): [The Aviation Herald](<http://avherald.com/h?article=4bafa778/0005&amp;opt=0>).

<a id="event-2019-08-28-1-4"></a>

Context: 2019 Amazon rainforest wildfires.

**Archived source account.** Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro announces all Amazon-region nations except Venezuela will meet to discuss a coordinated response to the disaster. He also reiterates rejection of G7 money to assist the efforts unless French President Emmanuel Macron issues him an apology, but after meeting with Chilean President Sebastián Piñera accepts an offer of four firefighting aircraft from Chile.

<a id="event-2019-08-28-1-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Amazon rainforest wildfires.

**Archived source account.** Finland, current chair of the European Union, writes to the body's High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy, Federica Mogherini, urging the use of the EU's "full toolkit" including foreign and trade policy to counter the use of deliberate fires as a means of deforestation in Brazil.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-08-28/eu-must-use-full-toolkit-to-counter-amazon-fires-finland-says>).

<a id="event-2019-08-28-1-7"></a>

Context: Hurricane Dorian.

**Archived source account.** Florida Governor Ron DeSantis declares a state of emergency in anticipation of Hurricane Dorian, which is expected to make landfall in the state within days.

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-08-28-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** New Zealand bans tourists from swimming with bottlenose dolphins, saying dwindling numbers are linked to excessive interaction with tourists, as the animals choose socialising with people over necessary biological functions. Authorities say the species risks "being loved into extinction".

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/australasia/new-zealand-bottlenose-dolphin-swimming-ban-endangered-species-boats-a9081571.html>).

<a id="event-2019-08-28-3-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Tonga.

**Archived source account.** Through a spokesman, Lopeti Senituli, for the government, Tonga blames the World Bank over the situation of their schools in Tongatapu, which are still in tents 17 months after Cyclone Gita.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/397652/tonga-govt-say-world-bank-responsible-for-gita-delays>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-08-28-4-2"></a>

Context: Mexican Drug War / Coatzacoalcos nightclub fire.

**Archived source account.** 28 people are killed in a bar fire in Coatzacoalcos, Veracruz, Mexico, that police believe was caused by an attack by drug cartels. Mexican media reports that Molotov cocktails were thrown inside.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-49494019>).

<a id="event-2019-08-28-4-4"></a>

Context: Crime in South Africa.

**Archived source account.** Pretoria, the administrative capital of South Africa, experiences widespread looting and violent attacks by rioters focused on foreigners. Police are currently outnumbered and many businesses have been set on fire. The riots follow the death of a taxi driver reportedly shot by Nigerian drug dealers after they realized he had seen them complete a drug deal and had also seen their supplier. Bus services are suspended and authorities say the capital is currently unsafe.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio 702](<http://www.702.co.za/articles/359104/tshwane-cbd-a-war-zone-as-protesters-clash-with-police-bus-services-suspended?fbclid=IwAR10sbs38KIdpplr2aj-NbVg1xdzIFJ9SiRM8a-0FaL5ogQogmx4fFQXOD8>); [ZimEye](<https://www.zimeye.net/2019/08/28/south-africa-capital-pretoria-on-fire-as-locals-clash-heavily-with-foreigners-police-overpowered/>).

<a id="event-2019-08-28-4-6"></a>

Context: LGBTQ rights in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Forty-eight members of the US Congress from the Republican Party\{\{spaced ndash\}\}eight from the Senate and 40 from the House of Representatives\{\{spaced ndash\}\}file a joint amicus brief with the Supreme Court arguing that the Civil Rights Act does not protect LGBTQ people from discrimination. They argue the law "does not prohibit discrimination because of an individual's actions, behaviours, or inclinations".

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/supreme-court-civil-rights-act-lgbt-republicans-gop-amicus-briefs-a9082361.html>).

Context: 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries.

**Archived source account.** New York Senator Kirsten Gillibrand drops out of the presidential race.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/08/28/us/politics/kirsten-gillibrand-2020-drop-out.html>).

<a id="event-2019-08-28-5-5"></a>

Context: Politics of Italy.

**Archived source account.** The Five Star Movement and Democratic Party agree to form a new coalition. The move comes weeks after Deputy Prime Minister and Northern League secretary Matteo Salvini unsuccessfully pushed for a no-confidence vote against Prime Minister Giuseppe Conte. Therefore, Conte remains Prime Minister.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-49502232>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-08-28-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Archaeologists in Huanchaco, Peru, unearth 227 sets of human remains aged between five and fourteen, and believed to be sacrificed over 500 years prior. The discovery is the largest known child sacrifice in history.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-49495167>).

### 2019-08-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088371446](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20August%2029&oldid=1088371446>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-08-29-0-1"></a>

Context: Papua conflict.

**Archived source account.** Tensions escalate between Indonesia and Pacific Island nations as the situation in the province of West Papua worsens after an Indonesian soldier and a West Papuan are killed in clashes. Vanuatuan Foreign Minister Ralph Regenvanu said "something must be done", amid calls to invite United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights Michelle Bachelet to investigate murders and torture in the area.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/397733/surge-in-papua-violence-prompts-stronger-stand-from-pacific-leaders>).

<a id="event-2019-08-29-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hamas says it has captured an ISIL cell responsible for Tuesday's suicide bombings that killed three policemen. Hamas says ten are in custody.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/hamas-says-it-captured-cell-behind-gaza-suicide-bombings-that-killed-cops/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-08-29-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Amazon rainforest wildfires.

**Archived source account.** Brazil bans land clearance fires for 60 days in response to the ongoing disaster.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-49507405>).

<a id="event-2019-08-29-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least seven spectators have died after a flash flood swept across the pitch at a local match in the village of Tizert, Morocco.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/seven-die-as-floodwater-hits-local-football-match-in-morocco-11797224>).

<a id="event-2019-08-29-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The number of people killed in the collapse of an apartment building yesterday in western Ukraine rose to eight, including one child.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ukraine-incident/death-toll-in-ukraine-building-collapse-rises-to-eight-emergency-services-idUSKCN1VJ0CQ>).

<a id="event-2019-08-29-1-5"></a>

Context: USS Fitzgerald and MV ACX Crystal collision.

**Archived source account.** The Japan Transport Safety Board concludes its investigation into a fatal collision between USS Fitzgerald and Filipino container ship ACX Crystal. The board's final report concludes distraction and incomplete radar information aboard the US Navy vessel caused the accident.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2019/08/29/national/japan-report-us-destroyer-collision>).

<a id="event-2019-08-29-1-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** The volcano on the Italian island of Stromboli erupts, an event described as "high intensity" by the National Institute of Geophysics and Volcanology.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/stromboli-volcano-eruption-italy-island-tourist-a9083161.html>).

<a id="event-2019-08-29-1-8"></a>

Context: 2019 Atlantic hurricane season.

**Archived source account.** Georgia Governor Brian Kemp declares a state of emergency for several counties in anticipation of Hurricane Dorian, which is expected to make landfall in the upcoming days.

Source citations (as archived): [WJXT](<https://www.news4jax.com/news/georgia/help-available-for-disabled-georgians-in-case-of-a-hurricane>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-08-29-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ethiopia plants 350 million trees in 12 hours, breaking the previous world record held by India since 2016 of 50 million trees planted in the same time.

Source citations (as archived): [United Nations Environment Programme](<https://www.unenvironment.org/news-and-stories/story/ethiopia-plants-over-350-million-trees-day-setting-new-world-record>); [Office of the Prime Minister of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia](<https://pmo.gov.et/greenlegacy/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-08-29-3-1"></a>

Context: China–United States trade war, China–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** China announces that it will not immediately retaliate on the latest U.S. import tariffs, but is instead "lodging solemn representations".

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-08-29/china-indicates-it-won-t-retaliate-against-newest-u-s-tariffs>).

<a id="event-2019-08-29-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. officially reestablishes Space Command.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC](<https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/president-donald-trump-reestablishes-us-space-command/story?id=65271426>).

<a id="event-2019-08-29-3-4"></a>

Context: Status of Jerusalem, Status of East Jerusalem.

**Archived source account.** Israel announces that, on 16 August, Nauru officially recognized Jerusalem as the capital of Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [Jewish News Syndicate](<https://www.jns.org/republic-of-nauru-recognizes-jerusalem-as-israels-capital/>).

<a id="event-2019-08-29-3-5"></a>

Context: Status of Jerusalem, Status of East Jerusalem.

**Archived source account.** The Foreign Affairs Minister of the Palestinian National Authority announces that it will file a complaint to the United Nations after Honduras' recognition of the disputed city of Jerusalem as the capital of Israel. Palestinians see East Jerusalem as the capital of the future State of Palestine.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/Middle-East/2019/Aug-29/490665-palestinians-to-file-complaint-over-honduras-jerusalem-move.ashx>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-08-29-4-1"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in Thailand.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of Thailand upholds death sentences against two migrant workers convicted of murdering two UK tourists and raping one. Rights groups say that the men are scapegoats and tortured into false confessions by police under pressure to solve the crimes, which attracted international attention.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/aug/29/death-sentences-upheld-in-thai-backpacker-case-zaw-lin-wai-phyo-hannah-witheridge-david-miller>).

<a id="event-2019-08-29-4-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong anti-extradition bill protests.

**Archived source account.** Hong Kong police ban a planned Saturday march by the Civil Human Rights Front, saying there is "a high chance that certain violent protesters will hijack this event". The CHRF plans to appeal.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-08-29/hong-kong-police-will-ban-mass-weekend-protest-march-scmp-says>).

<a id="event-2019-08-29-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Office of Inspector General of the Federal Bureau of Investigation releases its final report in which former director James Comey is criticised for his leaking of documents regarding U.S. President Donald Trump. However, it does not recommend he be prosecuted.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-49513403>).

<a id="event-2019-08-29-4-6"></a>

Context: Rotherham child sexual exploitation scandal.

**Archived source account.** Six Pakistani men are found guilty of abusing and raping teenage girls between 1998 and 2002 in Rotherham, England. The National Crime Agency believes as many as 1,510 teenagers were sexually exploited in the town during the same period.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-south-yorkshire-49500387>).

<a id="event-2019-08-29-4-8"></a>

Context: Identitarian movement.

**Archived source account.** A French court jails several members of Generation Identity and fines the organisation over an anti-immigration operation in the Alps. They were found guilty of "exercising activities in conditions that could create confusion with a public function". The case was that the operation could be mistaken for a government action.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/far-right-generation-identity-members-jailed-alps-france-asylum-seekers-a9084976.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-08-29-5-1"></a>

Context: Politics of Italy.

**Archived source account.** President of Italy Sergio Mattarella tasks demissionary Prime Minister Giuseppe Conte with the formation of a new cabinet, a coalition of Five Star Movement and Democratic Party. The premier-designate reserves the right to accept the mandate, pending further talks with both parties.

Source citations (as archived): [ANSA](<http://www.ansa.it/english/news/politics/2019/08/29/mattarella-gives-conte-mandate_de5c7f54-978c-4ac7-88e8-bae156d12cba.html>).

<a id="event-2019-08-29-5-3"></a>

Context: Politics of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Oleksiy Honcharuk becomes the new Prime Minister of Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/08/oleksiy-honcharuk-ukraine-prime-minister-190829160052863.html>).

<a id="event-2019-08-29-5-5"></a>

Context: Politics of the United Kingdom, Brexit.

**Archived source account.** The Court of Session in Edinburgh begins hearing arguments in a case challenging UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson's decision to suspend the UK Parliament. The challenge, seeking an interdict, the Scottish equivalent to an injunction, to prevent the move, is being brought by Members of the Scottish Parliament. The judge announces he will consider his position overnight and give his judgement tomorrow at 10:00 local time.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-scotland-politics-49509712>).

<a id="event-2019-08-29-5-6"></a>

Context: Politics of the United Kingdom, Brexit.

**Archived source account.** Ruth Davidson steps down as leader of the Scottish Conservatives. She has been a critic of Johnson, himself a Conservative, especially his approach to Brexit.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-scotland-politics-49509275>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-08-29-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Iranian Space Agency Simorgh carrier rocket explodes on the launch pad at Imam Khomeini Spaceport in southeastern Iran. This is Iran's third failed attempt to reach orbit this year following launches in January and February.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/08/29/755406765/iranian-rocket-launch-ends-in-failure-images-show>).

### 2019-08-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1219693496](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20August%2030&oldid=1219693496>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-08-30-0-1"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen, Yemeni Civil War (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** The Yemeni Ministry of Defense says 300 people were killed and wounded in United Arab Emirates air raids in southern Yemen over the two previous days. The UAE Foreign Ministry has said the "preemptive operation" targeted "terrorist militias".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/08/uae-targets-terrorist-militias-fractures-saudi-grow-190830080042582.html>).

<a id="event-2019-08-30-0-3"></a>

Context: Israel–Lebanon conflict.

**Archived source account.** Israeli Defense Forces name three senior Iranian officers and point out that the leader of the Quds Force is in Lebanon "with his family". Amid the campaign for the 17 September legislative election, Israel says Iran is moving to convert Hezbollah's arsenal of what Israel says is more than 100,000 rockets into precision-guided missiles.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://amp.cnn.com/cnn/2019/08/30/middleeast/israel-lebanon-tensions-intl/index.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-08-30-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis sends a video message to the people of Mozambique before his visit to the African country next week. He stresses reconciliation after years of conflict. The Pontiff says that “although I will be unable to travel beyond the capital, my heart reaches out and embraces you all, with a special place for those who live in difficulty.”

Source citations (as archived): [Holy See Press Office](<https://press.vatican.va/content/salastampa/en/bollettino/pubblico/2019/08/30/190830a.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-08-30-2-1"></a>

Context: Brexit.

**Archived source account.** A Court of Session judge refuses to grant an interdict, the Scottish equivalent to an injunction, preventing the upcoming suspension of the UK Parliament. The judge rules there is "no cogent need" for such an emergency measure as the suspension is not scheduled until September 9. However, a full hearing on the lawfulness of the suspension is brought forward to Tuesday. The case against the UK government is being brought by Members of the Scottish Parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-scotland-politics-49521132>).

<a id="event-2019-08-30-2-2"></a>

Context: Brexit.

**Archived source account.** Former Prime Minister Sir John Major announces he will join a case brought by anti-Brexit campaigner Gina Miller seeking judicial review of Parliament's suspension in the High Court under English law. The case challenges the lawfulness of current UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson's advice to Queen Elizabeth II in asking her to suspend the UK Parliament. The case is due for a preliminary hearing next Thursday with a full hearing the following day if the High Court approves one.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-49523055>).

<a id="event-2019-08-30-2-3"></a>

Context: Brexit.

**Archived source account.** The High Court in Belfast hears a claim under Northern Irish law brought by Raymond McCord, a campaigner for Troubles victims, challenging the constitutionality of suspending the UK Parliament. Sir Declan Morgan, The Lord Chief Justice of Northern Ireland, adjourns proceedings until next week.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-northern-ireland-49522042>).

<a id="event-2019-08-30-2-4"></a>

Context: Brexit.

**Archived source account.** A cross-party group of over fifty members of the suspended Parliament pledge to carry on meeting in the absence of Parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2019/aug/30/more-than-50-rebel-mps-pledge-to-convene-alternative-parliament>).

<a id="event-2019-08-30-2-6"></a>

Context: Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** Prominent Hong Kong pro-democracy activists Joshua Wong and Agnes Chow are arrested, charged and released on bail.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-china-49520025>).

<a id="event-2019-08-30-2-8"></a>

Context: September 11 attacks.

**Archived source account.** A military judge sets 11 January 2021 as the starting date for the selection of a military jury in the trial of five suspects, among which is Khalid Sheikh Mohammed, held in Guantanamo Bay.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2019/aug/30/khalid-shaikh-mohammad-9-11-trial-start-date>).

<a id="event-2019-08-30-2-10"></a>

Context: List of mass shootings in the United States in 2019.

**Archived source account.** At least 10 teenagers (age 15 to 18) are injured in a mass shooting at a high school football game at Ladd–Peebles Stadium in Mobile, Alabama.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/08/31/us/mobile-ladd-peebles-stadium-shooting/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-08-30-3-1"></a>

Context: Politics of the United States.

**Archived source account.** Madeleine Westerhout is forced to resign as Director of Oval Office Operations at the White House after leaking private information about the Trump family and White House operations to reporters at a private dinner. Westerhout had allegedly bragged about her personal access to U.S. President Donald Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-49527707>).

<a id="event-2019-08-30-3-2"></a>

Context: Politics of the United States.

**Archived source account.** White House aides admit that President Trump made up a phone call from China last weekend.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-china-phone-call-lie-fact-check-g7-summit-trade-war-a9085786.html>).

### 2019-08-31

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1140253068](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20August%2031&oldid=1140253068>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-08-31-0-1"></a>

Context: American-led intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Around 40 people are killed by an American cruise missile strike targeting al-Qaeda-linked militants at a Huras al-Din base in Syria's rebel-held Idlib Governorate, where the Syrian government earlier began a unilateral ceasefire.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-49538528>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-syria/u-s-forces-strike-syrian-al-qaeda-facility-defense-department-idUSKCN1VL0LA>).

<a id="event-2019-08-31-0-3"></a>

Context: 2018–19 Gaza border protests.

**Archived source account.** The Hamas-run Health Ministry of Gaza says a 25-year-old man died in hospital there today after being struck by an Israeli bullet during protests at the Gazan-Israeli border yesterday. It further says Israeli soldiers wounded 42 protesters. Israel says Palestinians threw grenades at the fence, damaging a vehicle and injuring a soldier.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\!](<https://news.yahoo.com/officials-gaza-man-dies-wounds-102211746.html>).

<a id="event-2019-08-31-0-5"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** Taliban fighters storm Kunduz city, apparently killing three civilians and dozens of soldiers. A suicide bomber kills ten municipal police.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-49536374>); [Tolo News](<https://www.tolonews.com/afghanistan/blast-kunduz-city-leaves-10-dead-several-wounded>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-08-31-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Amazon rainforest wildfires.

**Archived source account.** Brazil's Foreign Minister Ernesto Araújo states that the fires have mostly been extinguished.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2019/08/31/world/fires-amazon-extinguished-brazil-says/>).

<a id="event-2019-08-31-1-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Alta helicopter crash.

**Archived source account.** An Airbus AS350 helicopter crashes in northern Norway, killing all five Norwegian passengers and the Swedish pilot.

Source citations (as archived): [Standard](<https://www.standardmedia.co.ke/article/2001340326/six-die-in-helicopter-crash-in-norway>).

<a id="event-2019-08-31-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** An explosion followed by a fire at a chemical factory in Dhule, India kills at least 12 and injures at least 58.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/08/31/india/india-dhule-chemical-factory-explosion-intl/index.html>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-08-31-2-1"></a>

Context: Eastern equine encephalitis.

**Archived source account.** The Maine health department confirms a horse in York County has tested positive for the rare, deadly, potentially transferable to humans, mosquito-borne viral disease Eastern equine encephalitis. Earlier this week, an infected 14-year-old Michigan girl was hospitalized in serious condition, and Ohio officials confirmed an Ashtabula County horse also tested positive. Neither of the horses were vaccinated against EEE.

Source citations (as archived): [Newsweek](<https://www.newsweek.com/eee-virus-identified-maine-1457097>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2019/08/28/eastern-equine-encephalitis-rare-virus-hospitalizes-michigan-teen/2147508001/>); [The Horse](<https://thehorse.com/178245/eastern-equine-encephalomyelitis-confirmed-in-ohio-horse/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-08-31-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** India releases the final version of the National Register of Citizens for the state of Assam. Up to 1.9 million residents risk losing their citizenship if they are not on the list and can not prove their residency. The move is criticized for disproportionately affecting the local Bengali community.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-49520593>).

<a id="event-2019-08-31-3-2"></a>

Context: Brexit.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people join protests across the United Kingdom against the suspension of the UK Parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/live/2019/aug/31/brexit-stopthecoup-protests-uk-proroguing>).

<a id="event-2019-08-31-3-4"></a>

Context: Amazon rainforest wildfires.

**Archived source account.** The Brazilian Institute of Environment and Renewable Natural Resources (IBAMA) raids an illegal wildcat miners' site in the state of Pará as the country resumes environmental policing of the rainforest. The suspects escape following a firefight.

Source citations (as archived): [(New York Post](<https://nypost.com/2019/08/31/brazil-ramps-up-environmental-policing-amid-outrage-over-amazon-fires/>).

<a id="event-2019-08-31-3-6"></a>

Context: Midland–Odessa shootings.

**Archived source account.** At least seven people are killed and 21 others wounded in a mass shooting in West Texas, between the cities of Midland and Odessa. The shooter is shot and killed in Odessa. Police continue to investigate for other possible suspects.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-49540160>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/08/31/us/odessa-texas-active-shooter/index.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-texas-shooting/five-killed-including-shooter-around-21-injured-in-texas-shooting-police-media-idUSKCN1VL0SP>); [MST](<https://www.massshootingtracker.org/data>).

<a id="event-2019-08-31-3-8"></a>

Context: 2016 Interstate 10 tour bus crash.

**Archived source account.** A truck driver involved in the accident, which killed thirteen when two vehicles collided in California, pleads guilty to 42 crimes including vehicular manslaughter. The sleep-deprived driver fell asleep during a temporary halt to traffic; when traffic moved off again he remained stationary and the bus ran into the rear of his vehicle.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/trucker-pleads-guilty-california-crash-killed-13-65320848>).

<a id="event-2019-08-31-3-10"></a>

Context: 2019 Lyon stabbings.

**Archived source account.** An Afghan citizen stabs nine in Lyon, France, killing a 19-year-old.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/08/31/europe/france-villeurbanne-knife-attack/index.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-08-31-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Spa-Francorchamps FIA Formula 2 round.

**Archived source account.** Formula 2 racing driver Anthoine Hubert dies in a collision during a race at the Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps in Belgium.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2019/aug/31/spa-f2-race-abandoned-antoine-hubert-juan-manuel-correa-crash>).


## September

### 2019-09-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1236312307](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20September%201&oldid=1236312307>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-09-01-0-1"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen, Iran–Saudi Arabia proxy conflict.

**Archived source account.** More than 100 people are killed in a Saudi airstrike on a detention centre in Dhamar, Yemen, according to the International Committee of the Red Cross. Saudi Arabia says it hit a Houthi military facility used to store drones and missiles, "in accordance with international humanitarian law". Iran labels the airstrike as a "war crime".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-49544559>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/09/01/world/middleeast/yemen-houthi-saudi-arabia.html>); [Iran Press](<http://iranpress.com/en/iran-i138063-iran_condemns_saudi_airstrike_on_a_prison_in_yemen&#x27;s_western_dhamar_province>).

<a id="event-2019-09-01-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** A vehicle triggers a roadside bomb in Balkh, Afghanistan; all eight civilians on board are killed.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-09/01/c_138355675.htm>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-09-01-1-1"></a>

Context: Economic history of Argentina, Presidency of Mauricio Macri.

**Archived source account.** A Necessity and Urgency Decree reinstates currency controls in Argentina.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-argentina-economy/argentina-returns-to-currency-controls-as-debt-crisis-spirals-idUSKCN1VM1IH>); [Buenos Aires Económico](<https://www.baenegocios.com/economia-finanzas/Cepo-a-la-compra-y-giro-de-divisas-y-exigencia-de-liquidacion-a-exportadores-20190901-0004.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-09-01-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Amazon rainforest wildfires.

**Archived source account.** Troops join volunteers battling wildfires in Bolivia.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/09/amazon-fires-soldiers-join-volunteers-battle-fire-190901101353462.html>).

The storm is heading west at 7 mph toward Grand Bahama and the southeast American coast. Storm surges from Dorian, which ties as the second strongest Atlantic hurricane on record, are predicted to be as high as 23 feet (7 meters) in places.
