<a id="event-2019-09-05-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A United States Department of State spokesperson confirms as accurate a story reported yesterday by the Financial Times, saying that Akhilesh Kumar, the captain of a tanker carrying Iranian oil that was captured in Gibraltar in July and since then released, was offered millions of dollars by U.S. official Brian Hook to change its course, so that it could be impounded on U.S. charges of "terrorism".

Source citations (as archived): [Hindustan Times](<https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-offered-money-to-indian-ship-captain-iran-calls-it-blackmail/story-mvVz2awHrVYWU1dGgf537K.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-09-05-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The San Francisco Board of Supervisors passes an official resolution declaring the National Rifle Association to be a domestic terrorist organization. NRA chief executive Wayne LaPierre criticizes the decision online.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2019-09-05/san-francisco-declares-nra-a-terrorist-organisation/11483440>).

<a id="event-2019-09-05-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Court of Appeal in Kyiv, Ukraine, rules to release Volodymyr Tsemakh, a person of interest in the case of the downed Malaysia Airlines Flight 17. President of Russia Vladimir Putin says both countries are finalizing negotiations on a "rather large-scale" prisoner exchange.

Source citations (as archived): [RFE/RL](<https://www.rferl.org/a/mh17-suspect-to-be-released/30147814.html>).

<a id="event-2019-09-05-4-3"></a>

Context: Ghost Ship warehouse fire.

**Archived source account.** A jury finds Max Harris, the creative director of the Ghost Ship warehouse in Oakland, California, not guilty on involuntary manslaughter charges in relation to a fire at the location in 2016, which killed 36 people. The jury fails to reach a verdict on similar charges for its leaseholder, Derick Almena, due to a hung jury.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/09/05/us/ghost-ship-fire-oakland-verdict/index.html?utm_source=CNN-News-Alerts&amp;utm_medium=email&amp;utm_campaign=verdict+in+Ghost+Ship+fire+deaths057346f4-7cdc-4be7-9889-3e43be6d702a&amp;utm_term=1c1a3674-f347-0441-0baa-8ee61c704e63&amp;m=d6b08d327e4dcaf19c8d7624ea3f3e1e&amp;p=2019-09-0522:31>).

<a id="event-2019-09-05-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former First Lady of Honduras Rosa Elena Bonilla is sentenced to 58 years in prison after buying jewels with public funds.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-49593150>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-09-05-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Jo Johnson, British Prime Minister Boris Johnson's younger brother, resigns from his joint position as the minister of state for universities, science, research and innovation with the Department of Education and the Department for Business, Energy and Industrial Strategy. He says he has experienced "an unresolvable tension" in recent weeks in being "torn between family loyalty and the national interest".

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/brexit-referendum/u-k-prime-minister-boris-johnson-s-brother-quits-government-n1049886>).

<a id="event-2019-09-05-5-2"></a>

Context: Conte II Cabinet, 2019 Italian government crisis.

**Archived source account.** Italian Prime Minister Giuseppe Conte's new cabinet is sworn in after the coalition agreement between the Five Star Movement and the Democratic Party. Lega Nord ministers, led by Matteo Salvini, are ousted from the government.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/sep/05/italys-coalition-enemies-open-way-matteo-salvini-return>).

<a id="event-2019-09-05-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan threatens to "open the gates" and allow over three million Syrian refugees to freely emigrate into Europe, unless the Northern Syria Buffer Zone, agreed between Turkey and the United States, is set up according to Turkey's plans. He further claims that the "international community, namely the European Union" fails to provide support with respect to the refugees.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/sep/05/erdogan-ill-let-syrian-refugees-leave-turkey-for-west-unless-safe-zone-set-up>).

<a id="event-2019-09-05-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Special Representative for International Negotiations Jason Greenblatt, in charge of crafting the as yet unreleased Trump peace plan intended to resolve the Israeli–Palestinian conflict, announces his resignation.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/09/05/politics/jason-greenblatt-mideast-peace-trump/index.html>).

### 2019-09-06

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1241005442](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20September%206&oldid=1241005442>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-09-06-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Amazon is criticized for the trailer and synopses of its new season of Jack Ryan, which are interpreted to promote a US-led invasion of Venezuela.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\!](<https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment/amazons-jack-ryan-tv-series-212547937.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-09-06-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 43 people are now confirmed to have been killed by Hurricane Dorian in the Bahamas. The death toll is expected to rise further.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-49616990>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-09-06-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Niuean MP Terry Coe says there is "growing concern" over the absence of Premier Toke Talagi, who is reportedly undergoing medical treatment in New Zealand and has not been seen in public since July and, prior to that, early April. Coe says Niue's citizens are concerned that the state affairs are seemingly being conducted from New Zealand, and the island nation's acting premier has held power for an unusually long period of time due to Talagi's absence.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/398214/growing-concern-in-niue-over-premier-s-absence-opposition-mp>).

<a id="event-2019-09-06-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Robert Mugabe, the second president of Zimbabwe, dies at the age of 95.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2019/09/06/former-president-of-zimbabwe-robert-mugabe-has-died.html>).

<a id="event-2019-09-06-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom's House of Lords approves a bill forcing Prime Minister Boris Johnson to ask the European Union for a Brexit deadline extension. The bill will now become law once receiving royal assent from Queen Elizabeth II.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-49612757>).

<a id="event-2019-09-06-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The first government of Sudan after the Omar Al-Bashir era is formed, headed by Abdalla Hamdok.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/09/sudan-forms-cabinet-removal-al-bashir-190906083613765.html>).

<a id="event-2019-09-06-2-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** Venezuelan political parties waive the multi-party agreement to rotate leadership of the National Assembly annually in favor of allowing Juan Guaidó to continue in the position for another term.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics/venezuela-opposition-parties-back-guaido-as-congress-chief-in-2020-idUSKCN1VR2FS>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-09-06-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A denial-of-service attack takes down Wikipedia, with users unable to access the encyclopedia in Europe and parts of the Middle East. The Wikimedia Foundation blames a "massive and very broad" distributed denial of service attack.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/life-style/gadgets-and-tech/wikipedia-down-not-working-google-stopped-page-loading-encyclopedia-a9095236.html>); [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/malicious-attack-takes-wikipedia-offline-in-germany/a-50335521>); [TechCrunch](<https://techcrunch.com/2019/09/07/wikipedia-blames-malicious-ddos-attack-after-site-goes-down-across-europe-middle-east/>).

<a id="event-2019-09-06-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Indian Space Research Organization loses contact with Vikram moments before its planned soft landing on the Moon. India would have been the fourth nation to have explored the lunar surface, had Vikram successfully landed, and it would have deployed the Pragyan rover onto the surface.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/09/06/758419791/indias-attempt-to-land-rover-at-moon-s-south-pole-fails>).

### 2019-09-07

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088396431](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20September%207&oldid=1088396431>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-09-07-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021), Afghan peace process.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump says he has "called off" peace negotiations with the Taliban over the latest Taliban attack in Kabul. It is not clear if the talks are paused or altogether cancelled.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/09/trump-called-peace-talks-taliban-attack-190908014028311.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-afghanistan-mckenzie/spike-in-taliban-attacks-unhelpful-to-afghan-peace-push-u-s-general-idUSKCN1VS0MX>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-09-07-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Joichi Ito steps down as the director of the MIT Media Lab and as a member of the board of directors of The New York Times Company. Yesterday, The New Yorker wrote that the lab hid its financial links with Jeffrey Epstein after Epstein had pleaded guilty of procuring a minor for prostitution in 2008.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/09/07/758670699/m-i-t-media-lab-director-steps-down-over-financial-ties-to-jeffrey-epstein>).

<a id="event-2019-09-07-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mastercard cuts access to two Venezuelan banks.

Source citations (as archived): [Venezuelanalysis](<https://venezuelanalysis.com/news/14649>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-09-07-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Pacific typhoon season.

**Archived source account.** Typhoon Lingling impacts South Korea, killing at least three people and knocking out power to over 50,000 homes, according to the Ministry of the Interior and Safety.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/09/person-killed-powerful-typhoon-slams-south-korea-190907085411587.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-09-07-3-1"></a>

Context: Russia–Ukraine relations, Ukrainian crisis.

**Archived source account.** Russia and Ukraine swap prisoners on a "35-to-35" basis, including Oleg Sentsov, Mykola Karpyuk, Olexandr Kolchenko, Roman Sushchenko, and 24 Ukrainian Navy sailors detained by Russia during the 2018 Kerch Strait incident. The exchange includes Kirill Vyshinsky. The Dutch government says it "seriously regrets" that Volodymyr Tsemakh is included in the swap. U.S. President Donald Trump lauds the move as "perhaps a first giant step to peace."

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ukraine-russia-prisoners/russia-and-ukraine-swap-prisoners-in-first-sign-of-thawing-relations-idUSKCN1VS04X>); [Ukrayinska Pravda](<https://www.pravda.com.ua/rus/news/2019/09/7/7225601/>); [Ukrayinska Pravda](<https://www.pravda.com.ua/rus/news/2019/09/7/7225603/>); [TASS](<https://tass.com/politics/1077066>).

<a id="event-2019-09-07-3-3"></a>

Context: Nuclear program of Iran.

**Archived source account.** The Atomic Energy Organization of Iran announces it has activated the research and development of new uranium enrichment centrifuges. It is the third breach of the 2015 Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action agreement from which the United States withdrew last year, reimposing U.S. sanctions on Iran. Iranian President Hassan Rouhani has recently stated his country will reimplement the agreement only if the remaining parties also do so, giving them two extra months.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/iran-ramps-up-uranium-enrichment-in-latest-nuclear-breach/a-50336501>).

<a id="event-2019-09-07-3-5"></a>

Context: Colombia–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** Venezuelan president Nicolás Maduro has the Venezuelan military deploy air defense missiles to its border with Colombia after declaring an "orange alert" signifying potential or likely incoming threat.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Masdar News](<https://www.almasdarnews.com/article/venezuela-deploys-air-defense-missiles-colombian-border-to-ward-off-potential-attack/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-09-07-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Venezuelan de facto Attorney General Tarek William Saab announces a charge of high treason against acting president Juan Guaidó. This comes as part of an investigation where the Maduro government alleges Guaidó does not support the Venezuelan claim to the Guayana Esequiba region, despite Guaidó having been a vocal supporter of the claim since he entered politics in 2007.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<https://www.scmp.com/news/world/americas/article/3026156/venezuelan-prosecutors-charge-opposition-leader-juan-guaido>); [Yahoo\!](<https://news.yahoo.com/venezuela-prosecutors-charge-guaido-high-treason-185544663.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-09-07-5-1"></a>

Context: Brexit.

**Archived source account.** British Secretary of State for Work and Pensions Amber Rudd resigns from Boris Johnson's cabinet and the Conservative whip in protest of both his handling of Brexit and his expulsion of 21 MPs from the party. Rudd will now sit as an independent MP in the House of Commons.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/09/07/uk/uk-amber-rudd-resigns-parliament-gbr-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-09-07-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** King Salman of Saudi Arabia replaces Minister of Energy Khalid al-Falih with his son Abdulaziz bin Salman by royal order. Earlier this month, al-Falih was replaced with Yasir Al-Rumayyan, head of the kingdom’s sovereign wealth fund and a close adviser to the crown prince, as chairman of Saudi Aramco.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-09-07/saudi-replaces-energy-minister-al-falih-with-an-mbs-brother>).

<a id="event-2019-09-07-5-4"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** Juan Guaidó appoints Leopoldo Lopez to form a shadow cabinet in preparation for taking control of the Venezuelan government. Lopez is currently in refuge in the Spanish embassy of Venezuelan capital Caracas after being freed from house arrest by dissident military during the 30 April uprising, which may have removed a bar placed on him from engaging in political activity.

Source citations (as archived): [VOA](<https://www.voanews.com/americas/guaido-ally-under-spanish-protection-forming-shadow-venezuelan-cabinet>).

**Archived source account.** The Syrian government condemns the operation as a "flagrant violation of international law."

<a id="event-2019-09-08-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Northern Syria Buffer Zone.

**Archived source account.** Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan says the U.S. seems to be interested in a safe zone for "the terrorist organization", rather than for Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-turkey-erdogan/turkey-cites-disagreements-with-u-s-even-as-joint-syria-patrols-begin-idUSKCN1VT0JI>).

<a id="event-2019-09-08-1-1"></a>

Context: China–United States trade war.

**Archived source account.** Imports of U.S. goods into China decreased by 22% in August, while exports of Chinese goods into the U.S. fell 16% over the same year-to-year period, according to customs data.

<a id="event-2019-09-08-1-2"></a>

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-09-08-2-1"></a>

Context: 2018–19 Australian bushfire season.

**Archived source account.** A wildfire destroys much of the Queensland Heritage Register-listed Binna Burra Cultural Landscape holiday resort, including its famous lodge, in Binna Burra, Queensland, Australia.

Context: Brexit negotiations.

**Archived source account.** French Minister of Europe and Foreign Affairs Jean-Yves Le Drian says that, under current conditions, the European Union would not grant the United Kingdom an extension beyond October 31 to negotiate its exit from the Union.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-eu-france/france-says-eu-wont-approve-brexit-delay-as-things-stand-idUSKCN1VT094>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-09-08/french-minister-le-drian-sees-no-brexit-delay-as-things-stand>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2019/sep/08/france-threatens-to-veto-further-brexit-extension>).

<a id="event-2019-09-08-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iran's Adrian Darya 1 oil tanker, which was temporarily detained in Gibraltar and sanctioned by the United States Department of Justice, has sold its cargo after supposedly docking at the Syrian port of Tartus, according to the Iranian Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-iran-tanker/iranian-tanker-reaches-destination-oil-sold-ministry-tells-tv-idUSKCN1VT0H0>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/sep/08/british-iranian-relations-strained-as-oil-tanker-is-seen-off-syria>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-09-08-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Russian elections.

**Archived source account.** Russian citizens head to polls to cast their votes in elections for heads and council members of federal subjects, among which an election for the Moscow City Duma, members and heads of local legislatures, and in by-elections to the State Duma.

Source citations (as archived): [TASS](<https://tass.com/politics/1077127>).

<a id="event-2019-09-08-4-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Russian elections.

**Archived source account.** Roskomnadzor, the state communications watchdog, states Google and Facebook published political advertising the day before and during the election, even though it requested them to ban such publication "in line with Russian law". The watchdog labels the tech giants' actions as "interference in Russia’s sovereign affairs".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-election-internet/russia-says-facebook-google-distributed-political-ads-on-election-day-idUSKCN1VT0K0>).

**Archived source account.** The Parliament of Georgia appoints the previous Interior Minister Giorgi Gakharia as Prime Minister.

Source citations (as archived): [DPA](<https://www.gulf-times.com/story/641078/Georgia-names-new-prime-minister-who-condemns-Russian-occupation>).

<a id="event-2019-09-08-4-5"></a>

Context: 2020 U.S. Republican Party presidential primaries.

**Archived source account.** Former South Carolina congressman and governor Mark Sanford announces a primary challenge against incumbent President Donald Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [Axios](<https://www.axios.com/mark-sanford-primary-trump-bfa7c69c-d91a-4093-a39d-6cfcff496cb6.html>).

<a id="event-2019-09-08-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Neo-Nazi National Democratic Party of Germany (NPD) politician Stefan Jagsch is elected as the mayor of Altenstadt-Waldsiedlung in Altenstadt, Hesse, after running unopposed, prompting condemnations from Germany's political leaders, including SPD General Secretary Lars Klingbeil. ### 2019-09-10

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088498518](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20September%2010&oldid=1088498518>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-09-10-0-1"></a>

Context: American-led intervention in Iraq (2014–2021).

**Archived source account.** The United States Air Force launches a small shock and awe bombing raid using F-35 and F-15 Eagle warplanes on the ISIL-occupied Qanus Island in Iraq's Saladin Governorate, dropping 36,000 kg of explosives. The small island was being used by ISIL as a "major transit hub", according to the U.S.-led coalition.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/isis-iraq-us-air-force-bombing-qanus-island-video-a9100526.html>); [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/is-infested-island-wiped-out-by-40-tonnes-of-explosives-11806797>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-09-10-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Jack Ma retires and Daniel Zhang succeeds him as executive chairman of Alibaba Group.

Source citations (as archived): [International Business Times](<https://www.ibtimes.com/jack-ma-retires-alibaba-everything-know-about-new-chairman-daniel-zhang-2824593>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-09-10-2-1"></a>

Context: Karbala stampede.

**Archived source account.** Thirty-one pilgrims are killed and 100 others are injured in a stampede in the city of Karbala, Iraq, while marking Ashura.

Source citations (as archived): [Gulf News](<https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/karbala-stampede-results-in-many-deaths-1.1568123543822>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-09-10-3-1"></a>

Context: Fukushima disaster cleanup.

**Archived source account.** As Tepco says that, by 2022, it will run out of storage room for what is now more than 1 million tonnes of radioactively contaminated reactor core cooling water, Japanese Minister of the Environment Yoshiaki Harada opines that "the only option will be to drain it into the sea and dilute it".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-japan-fukushima-water-idUSKCN1VV0CC>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-09-10-4-1"></a>

Context: Colombia–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** 150,000 Venezuelan troops begin exercises along the Colombian border. Nicolás Maduro's Venezuelan government says it is to intercept an attack from the other country, despite no indications there will be one.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics/venezuelan-military-conducts-drills-on-colombian-border-to-intercept-invasion-idUSKCN1VV2HY>).

<a id="event-2019-09-10-4-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong protests, Hong Kong Human Rights and Democracy Act.

**Archived source account.** Chief Executive of Hong Kong Carrie Lam urges "foreign parliaments" not to interfere in Hong Kong's internal affairs and says continued violence "cannot solve the issues".

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/09/10/asia/carrie-lam-hong-kong-us-intl-hnk/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-09-10-5-1"></a>

Context: List of Trump administration dismissals and resignations.

**Archived source account.** United States National Security Advisor John R. Bolton is dismissed by President Donald Trump, citing strong disagreements. Bolton insists he resigned. The interim replacement is to be Deputy Charles Kupperman, says the White House.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-49655279>).

<a id="event-2019-09-10-5-3"></a>

Context: September 2019 Israeli legislative election, Proposed Israeli annexation of the Jordan Valley.

**Archived source account.** With next week's election in sight, Prime Minister of Israel Benjamin Netanyahu proposes to annex parts of the West Bank and the Jordan Valley. Prime Minister of the State of Palestine Mohammad Shtayyeh replies that "Netanyahu is the chief destroyer of the peace process".

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/Israel-News/Prime-Minister-Netanyahu-expected-to-announce-annexation-of-Jordan-Valley-601207>); [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/netanyahu-seeks-annex-jordan-valley-coordination-u-s-n1051901>).

<a id="event-2019-09-10-5-5"></a>

Context: 2019 North Carolina's 9th congressional district special election.

**Archived source account.** In a special election viewed as prescient to the 2020 elections, Republican Dan Bishop beats Democrat Dan McCready by two percentage points.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/09/10/us/politics/north-carolina-special-election.html>).

<a id="event-2019-09-10-5-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** The California State Senate approves Assembly Bill 5, a bill to regulate gig economy work, introducing a formal test to classify workers as independent contractors or employees.

Source citations (as archived): [TechCrunch](<https://techcrunch.com/2019/09/10/gig-worker-bill-ab-5-passes-in-california/>); [The Week](<https://theweek.com/speedreads/864127/california-legislators-pass-bill-that-reclassifies-contractors-employees>).

### 2019-09-11

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088498733](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20September%2011&oldid=1088498733>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-09-11-0-1"></a>

Context: China–United States trade war.

**Archived source account.** China publishes a list of 16 U.S. goods that will be temporarily exempted from its retaliatory import tariffs.

<a id="event-2019-09-11-0-2"></a>

Context: China–United States trade war.

**Archived source account.** China announces that it will allow the import of soybean meal from Argentina, to ensure livestock feed under the impact of the trade war with the U.S. Apart from Argentina, China has been increasing imports of soybeans and soymeal from other channels, such as allowing soybean meal, rapeseed meal and sunflower meal from Russia since September 6.

Source citations (as archived): [Global Times](<http://www.globaltimes.cn/content/1164329.shtml>).

<a id="event-2019-09-11-0-4"></a>

Context: 2019 Japan–South Korea trade dispute.

**Archived source account.** South Korea announces it will file a complaint with the World Trade Organization over Japanese government export controls.

Source citations (as archived): [Marketwatch](<https://www.marketwatch.com/story/south-korea-will-complain-to-wto-about-japans-trade-curbs-2019-09-10?link=MW_latest_news>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-09-11-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A crash of a twin-engine Convair 440 cargo plane near Toledo, Ohio, kills the two people on board.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/09/11/us/ohio-toledo-plane-crash/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-09-11-1-2"></a>

Context: Effects of Hurricane Dorian in The Bahamas.

**Archived source account.** The Bahamian National Emergency Management Agency lists approximately 2,500 people as missing after Hurricane Dorian devastated the islands last week.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-49666942>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-09-11-2-1"></a>

Context: Pastoral visit of Pope Francis to Africa.

**Archived source account.** At St. Peter's Square Pope Francis reviews highlights from his African visit to Mozambique, Madagascar and Mauritius on September 4-10.

Source citations (as archived): [Crux](<https://cruxnow.com/vatican/2019/09/11/africa-trip-planted-new-seeds-of-hope-pope-says-at-audience/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-09-11-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Suffering from pneumonia, Tongan Prime Minister ʻAkilisi Pōhiva is rushed from hospital in Nukuʻalofa to one in Auckland, New Zealand, where he was treated for a liver condition earlier this year. According to a government spokesperson, Pōhiva is in a "very serious" condition.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/398579/tongan-pm-akilisi-pohiva-medevaced-to-auckland>).

<a id="event-2019-09-11-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** B.J. Habibie, reformist Indonesian president, dies at 83, after spending more than a week in intensive care.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://beta.washingtonpost.com/local/obituaries/bj-habibie-reformist-indonesian-president-dies-at-83/2019/09/11/aef7ea16-d493-11e9-9610-fb56c5522e1c_story.html?noredirect=on>).

<a id="event-2019-09-11-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Japanese Prime Minister Shinzō Abe rearranges his government cabinet, naming replacements at the Defense, Foreign Affairs, Environment and Olympics ministries, among others.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/09/japan-pm-picks-foreign-defence-ministers-reshuffle-190911043258966.html>).

<a id="event-2019-09-11-3-4"></a>

Context: Politics of the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Scotland's Court of Session rules that UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson violated the law by his suspension of Parliament from 9 September to 14 October, encouraging calls for MPs to get back to work immediately.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-eu-watson/brexit-in-chaos-after-court-rules-pms-suspension-of-parliament-was-unlawful-idUSKCN1VV2S6>).

<a id="event-2019-09-11-3-5"></a>

Context: Politics of the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** The Johnson ministry releases the Operation Yellowhammer contingency plans in the event of a no-deal Brexit to the public.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-49670123>).

<a id="event-2019-09-11-3-7"></a>

Context: 2019 Canadian federal election.

**Archived source account.** Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau calls a general election on 21 October. Governor General Julie Payette, the acting head of state, formally dissolves Parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/canada-election-federal-general-justin-trudeau-news-latest-a9101286.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-09-11-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Scientists from Denmark and the United Kingdom report they have identified genetic information from a 1.7-million-year-old Stephanorhinus tooth enamel from Dmanisi, Georgia, making it the oldest genetic data ever recorded.

Source citations (as archived): [Cosmos](<https://cosmosmagazine.com/palaeontology/the-oldest-genetic-data-ever-recorded>).

<a id="event-2019-09-11-4-2"></a>

Context: Discoveries of exoplanets.

**Archived source account.** Water vapor is detected on exoplanet K2-18b, a super-Earth which is located about 111 light-years away from Earth. It is the first time water has been confirmed on an exoplanet within the circumstellar habitable zone of a star.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-49648746>); [Business Insider](<https://www.businessinsider.com/water-vapor-on-potentially-habitable-super-earth-exoplanet-2019-9>).

<a id="event-2019-09-11-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Scientists report, in the journal Gondwana Research, the discovery of an eighth— still hidden—continent (Greater Adria) from the break-up of supercontinent Pangaea which slid underneath what is now Southern Europe about 120 million years ago.

Source citations (as archived): [National Geographic](<https://www.nationalgeographic.com/science/2019/09/lost-continent-revealed-by-plate-tectonics-model-greater-adria-mediterranean/#close>); [Business Insider](<https://www.businessinsider.com/hidden-continent-greater-adria-buried-under-europe-2019-9>).

### 2019-09-12

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1286306774](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20September%2012&oldid=1286306774>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-09-12-0-1"></a>

Context: Kulp bombing.

**Archived source account.** Seven civilians are killed and ten are injured in a roadside attack by the PKK in Kulp, Diyarbakir Province, Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/turkey/pkk-terrorist-attack-in-se-turkey-kills-7-civilians-/1580369>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-09-12-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The European Central Bank announces new monetary stimulus, with a second round of quantitative easing "for as long as it deems necessary" and lowering its already-negative main deposit rate.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2019/09/12/european-central-bank-launches-new-bond-buying-program.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-09-12-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A train derails in the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Tanganyika Province, killing about 15 people and injuring many others.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-09-12-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The French National Assembly says its president, Richard Ferrand, is put under formal investigation in a "financial impropriety" case. Ferrand stepped down as a minister in President Emmanuel Macron's government in 2017 over the case related to property deals, eight years ago, by a health insurance fund he managed in Brittany. Prosecutors in Lille say he is charged with a conflict of interest.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.france24.com/en/20190912-frances-national-assembly-leader-macron-ally-investigated-graft-probe>); [AFP](<https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/french-assembly-chief-and-macron-ally-probed-over-property-deals>).

<a id="event-2019-09-12-3-2"></a>

Context: Death of Sahar Khodayari.

**Archived source account.** Iran's judiciary issues a warrant to arrest actress Saba Kamali after she posted a text in her Instagram sympathizing with Sahar Khodayari, which was reported to be found "insulting" to the third Shiite Imam, Hussain ibn Ali.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Farda](<https://en.radiofarda.com/a/iran-to-arrest-superstar-for-sympathizing-with-dead-female-football-fan/30160647.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-09-12-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tongan Prime Minister ʻAkilisi Pōhiva, age 78, dies one day after being taken to a New Zealand hospital from his native country.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/pacific/398621/tongan-pm-akilisi-pohiva-dies-aged-78>).

<a id="event-2019-09-12-4-2"></a>

Context: 2020 U.S. Democratic Party presidential debates and forums.

**Archived source account.** The third major Democratic Party televised debate takes place at the Health and Physical Education Arena in Houston, Texas, with a focus on health care in the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-49684419>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-09-12-5-1"></a>

Context: Interstellar objects.

**Archived source account.** C/2019 Q4 (Borisov), a second interstellar comet after ʻOumuamua in 2017, is discovered by an amateur astronomer.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-49676757>).

<a id="event-2019-09-12-5-3"></a>

Context: Social media use in politics.

**Archived source account.** Twitter suspends several Cuban government and state media accounts, including First Secretary of the Communist Party of Cuba Raúl Castro and his daughter Mariela Castro. The pro-government Union of Journalists of Cuba denounces the suspensions as "massive censorship".

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/sep/12/twitter-raul-castro-state-media-outlets-blocked>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-49683029>).

<a id="event-2019-09-12-5-4"></a>

Context: Social media use in politics.

**Archived source account.** Facebook suspends a chatbot on Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's official page for violating its hate speech policy. Netanyahu says the mistake was made by a volunteer employee.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2019/sep/12/facebook-disables-netanyahu-page-bot-over-hate-speech-violation>).

### 2019-09-13

#### Business and economy

Context: Transport in Paris.

**Archived source account.** Parisian metro workers launch a general strike, the largest of its kind since 2007, in protest at Emmanuel Macron’s pension reforms. Ten of the sixteen metro lines and two major regional train lines are shut down during morning rush hour.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-france-protests-subway/paris-commuter-chaos-as-metro-workers-strike-over-pension-reform-idUSKCN1VY0GD?il=0>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-09-13-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A fire in a hospital kills eleven people in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

<a id="event-2019-09-13-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two students are killed when a bus rolls over east of Bamfield, British Columbia.

Context: 2019 Abqaiq–Khurais attack, Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

Context: 2019 Abqaiq–Khurais attack, Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://twitter.com/AJABreaking/status/1172859916437950464>); [Al Jazeera](<https://twitter.com/AJABreaking/status/117286054028220006>).

<a id="event-2019-09-14-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A charity ship, carrying 82 migrants rescued off the coast of Libya, is offered docking at the Italian island of Lampedusa. The migrants can be brought ashore after "several E.U. countries" agreed to take them in, Italian Prime Minister Giuseppe Conte said on Thursday.

### 2019-09-15

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1225505181](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20September%2015&oldid=1225505181>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-09-15-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Abqaiq–Khurais attack, Saudi Arabia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** During a phone call, U.S. President Donald Trump reportedly tells Saudi Crown Prince Mohammad bin Salman that the "U.S. supports Saudi Arabia in its efforts to fight terrorism" and that the U.S. will cooperate in the aftermath of the oil facilities attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya English](<https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/gulf/2019/09/14/Saudi-Arabia-s-Crown-Prince-receives-a-phone-call-from-US-President-.html>).

<a id="event-2019-09-15-0-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Abqaiq–Khurais attack, Saudi Arabia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** After accusations by U.S. and Saudi officials, Iran denies involvement in the attack and says it's "ready for war" against both the U.S. and Saudi Arabia after the Kingdom blamed Iran for backing the Houthis.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-aramco-attacks/iran-dismisses-u-s-claim-it-was-behind-saudi-oil-attacks-says-ready-for-war-idUSKBN1W009P>).

<a id="event-2019-09-15-0-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Abqaiq–Khurais attack, Saudi Arabia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** An anonymous senior Iraqi intelligence officer says the drones that attacked Saudi Arabia were launched from Popular Mobilization Forces bases in southern Iraq. The drones on that flight path reportedly would have crossed Kuwait's airspace to carry out the strikes. Kuwait's government says it is investigating the sighting of a drone, reportedly flying low and hovering over Kuwait City on the day of the attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [Middle East Eye](<https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/exclusive-iranian-drones-launched-iraq-carried-out-attacks-saudi-oil-plants>).

<a id="event-2019-09-15-0-4"></a>

Context: 2019 Abqaiq–Khurais attack, Saudi Arabia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** An unnamed United States official says evidence suggests the drones approached Saudi Arabia from the northwest from Iraq or Iran, contrary to the Houthi militants' claim that the drones were launched from Yemeni territory. Three experts cited by CNN say the official's evidence is not conclusive.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-aramco-attacks/evidence-from-saudi-oil-attack-points-to-iran-not-yemen-u-s-official-idUSKBN1W00SA>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/09/15/politics/iran-satellite-images-saudi-arabia-oil-attack/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-09-15-0-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Abqaiq–Khurais attack, Saudi Arabia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Donald Trump says the U.S. military is "locked and loaded" after the attacks on its ally Saudi Arabia, but is awaiting confirmation from Riyadh on who launched the strikes before taking action.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2019/09/15/trump-says-us-is-locked-and-loaded-after-attack-on-saudi-oil-supply.html>).

<a id="event-2019-09-15-0-8"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / 2019 al-Rai bombing.

**Archived source account.** A car bomb in the Syrian town of al-Rai, close to the Turkish border, kills at least ten people after it explodes near a hospital.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-syria-security-blast/car-bomb-kills-10-in-syrian-town-near-turkish-border-local-council-medic-idUKKBN1W00O6>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-09-15-1-1"></a>

Context: Price of oil.

**Archived source account.** Following the drone attacks on Saudi Aramco facilities, the price of benchmark Brent Crude oil futures contracts surges as high as 19.5% at market opening, the biggest increase in percentage terms since the 1990 oil price shock in response to Ba'athist Iraq invading Kuwait.

<a id="event-2019-09-15-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. company Purdue Pharma files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy. Agreeing to contribute more than US$3 billion from the sale of a daughter company, the owners propose to settle thousands of lawsuits related to the risk of addiction to their narcotic painkiller Oxycontin.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-09-16-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Abqaiq–Khurais attack, Iran–Saudi Arabia proxy conflict, Iran–United States relations.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya English](<https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/gulf/2019/09/16/Iran-says-accusations-about-Saudi-Aramco-attacks-are-unacceptable-baseless-.html>).

<a id="event-2019-09-16-0-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Abqaiq–Khurais attack, Iran–Saudi Arabia proxy conflict, Iran–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Iraq says the United States has told them that the information the U.S. has "confirms the Iraqi government's statement that its territory was not used to carry out this attack".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-aramco-attacks-iraq/iraq-says-u-s-does-not-believe-iraqi-territory-used-to-launch-attack-on-saudi-idUSKBN1W10Q1>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-09-16-1-1"></a>

Context: Economy of China.

**Archived source account.** Figures released by the National Bureau of Statistics of China show that industrial production growth in August was at a 17-year low.

Source citations (as archived): [SCMP](<https://www.scmp.com/economy/china-economy/article/3027374/chinas-industrial-engine-slowed-new-17-year-low-august-even>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-09-16-2-1"></a>

Context: Grenfell Tower fire.

**Archived source account.** Officers with the Metropolitan Police interview members of the London Fire Brigade under caution in connection with the disaster. The fire brigade is being treated as a corporation suspected of breaching health and safety legislation.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2019/sep/16/met-interviews-london-fire-brigade-over-grenfell-tower-disaster>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-09-16-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** One firefighter is killed and six others are injured after a propane gas leak leads to a large explosion at a non-profit organization in Farmington, Maine.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/us/live-news/farmington-maine-explosion/index.html>); [WGME](<https://wgme.com/news/local/gov-janet-mills-reacts-to-deadly-farmington-explosion>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-09-16-4-1"></a>

Context: Iran–United Arab Emirates relations.

**Archived source account.** The Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps of Iran says it has seized a vessel in the Persian Gulf which it claims was smuggling diesel fuel to the United Arab Emirates.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<https://www.rferl.org/a/iran-claims-seized-ship-smuggling-diesel-fuel-to-u-a-e-/30167003.html>).

<a id="event-2019-09-16-4-3"></a>

Context: Political status of Taiwan, Foreign relations of China, Foreign relations of the Solomon Islands.

**Archived source account.** The Cabinet of the Solomon Islands votes to shift diplomatic ties from Taiwan to China. Taiwanese Minister of Foreign Affairs Joseph Wu says that, since the Solomon Islands decided to establish diplomatic relations with China, this prompts Taiwan to cut ties with the Solomon Islands".

Source citations (as archived): [Hong Kong Free Press](<https://www.hongkongfp.com/2019/09/16/breaking-solomon-islands-officially-switches-diplomatic-ties-taiwan-china/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-taiwan-diplomacy/taiwan-says-china-meddling-with-elections-after-solomon-islands-cuts-ties-idUSKBN1W112U>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-09-16-5-1"></a>

Context: Brexit.

**Archived source account.** UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson abruptly pulls out of a press conference in Luxembourg to avoid an anti-Brexit protest organised and attended by British citizens living in Luxembourg. Luxembourg Prime Minister Xavier Bettel attends the press conference, where, during a short speech followed by questions from journalists, he contradicts Johnson's prior public statements and exposes that the UK government has not submitted any concrete proposals for amendments to the UK's Withdrawal Agreement from the European Union, or delivered any alternative to the "Irish backstop" which Johnson wishes to replace. Bettel warns that Johnson "holds the future of all UK citizens in his hands" and that he shouldn't "hold the future hostage for party political gain".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-49715705>).

<a id="event-2019-09-16-5-2"></a>

Context: Brexit.

**Archived source account.** At the Liberal Democrats conference, party leader Jo Swinson reaffirms that if elected any future Liberal Democrat led government, would halt Brexit by revoking Article 50, adding that in the case of a hung parliament she would not enter a coalition with either the Conservatives or Labour.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-49717388>).

### 2019-09-17

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1336206233](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20September%2017&oldid=1336206233>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-09-17-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021) / 17 September 2019 Afghanistan bombings.

**Archived source account.** Suicide bombings in Afghanistan kill 48 people including civilians and soldiers. The first is in Charikar at a rally for Ashraf Ghani, the President of Afghanistan. The second is in Kabul near the U.S. embassy.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/09/17/world/asia/afghanistan-bombing-ghani.html>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-49726088>).

<a id="event-2019-09-17-0-4"></a>

Context: Islamic terrorism in Europe.

**Archived source account.** An Italian soldier in Milan was stabbed in the neck and in the back with a pair of scissors by a man. He was arrested after the stabbing, which was described as a terrorist attack linked to Islamic extremism. The soldier survived the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [TGCOM24](<https://www.tgcom24.mediaset.it/cronaca/lombardia/milano-ferisce-un-militare-e-poi-urla-allah-akbar-arrestato-per-attentato-terroristico_3232392-201902a.shtml>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-09-17-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ecumenical Patriarch Bartholomew meets with Pope Francis at the Vatican. In his brief remarks, Patriarch Bartholomew talks about the value of synodality in the Eastern Orthodox Church.

Source citations (as archived): [Vatican News](<https://www.vaticannews.va/en/pope/news/2019-09/pope-francis-meets-orthodox-patriarch-bartholomew.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-09-17-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Atlantic hurricane season.

**Archived source account.** Tropical Storm Imelda makes landfall in Texas, threatening severe flash flooding throughout Eastern Texas and the Houston area.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/weather/2019/09/17/houston-braces-up-foot-rain-unnamed-tropical-weather-system/>).

<a id="event-2019-09-17-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Italian champion speedboat designer and racer Fabio Buzzi and two other racers are killed when their boat, attempting to set a new Monte Carlo-to-Venice record in the Assonautica Italiana race, crashes into a sunken, flood-barrier dam near the finish line. A fourth racer is in hospital with serious injuries.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-49738385>); [Il Globo](<https://ilglobo.com.au/news/45141/motorboat-racer-fabio-buzzi-one-of-three-killed-in-boat-crash-in-venice/#>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-09-17-3-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Taiwan, Foreign relations of China, Foreign relations of the Solomon Islands.

**Archived source account.** Taiwanese President Tsai Ing-wen regrets and strongly condemns the move by the Solomon Islands to cut ties with Taiwan and establish relations with China.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/398932/taiwan-condemns-solomons-china-switch>).

<a id="event-2019-09-17-3-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Abqaiq–Khurais attack.

**Archived source account.** An anonymous U.S. official says the United States is certain that the attack was launched from Iranian territory and that it involved cruise missiles.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Star](<http://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/Middle-East/2019/Sep-17/491769-kingdom-is-capable-of-responding-to-attacks-king-salman.ashx>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-09-17-4-1"></a>

Context: Donald Trump impeachment hearings.

**Archived source account.** Amid a gag order from the White House, impeachment hearings begin at the United States House Committee on the Judiciary.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-news-live-impeachment-hearing-la-today-california-twitter-bay-area-tax-returns-a9108946.html>).

<a id="event-2019-09-17-4-3"></a>

Context: Brexit, 2019 British prorogation controversy.

**Archived source account.** The UK Supreme Court begins considering the lawfulness of Prime Minister Boris Johnson's prorogation of Parliament. It is jointly considering two appeals. One is against a ruling by the High Court under English law that the issue is solely a matter for the Prime Minister and one the courts do not have jurisdiction over. The other is against a ruling by the Court of Session under Scots law declaring the suspension unlawful and a nullity, and requiring Johnson to recall Parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-49722087>).

<a id="event-2019-09-17-4-5"></a>

Context: April 2019 Spanish general election, Politics of Spain.

**Archived source account.** Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez, after failing to achieve support from the Unidas Podemos alliance, announces the calling for a snap election on 10 November, which would be the fourth general election in 4 years.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-spain-politics/spain-to-hold-snap-election-on-november-10-after-party-talks-fail-idUSKBN1W20VG>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-49736118?intlink_from_url=https://www.bbc.com/news/topics/c5wdv20l9zzt/pedro-sanchez&amp;link_location=live-reporting-story>).

<a id="event-2019-09-17-4-7"></a>

Context: September 2019 Israeli legislative election.

**Archived source account.** Israeli voters head to the polls after the last election failed to form a government. Exit polls show the incumbent right-wing Likud barely losing to the centrist Blue and White alliance.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-election/israeli-election-too-close-to-call-netanyahu-weakened-exit-polls-idUSKBN1W12UY>).

<a id="event-2019-09-17-4-8"></a>

Context: September 2019 Israeli legislative election.

**Archived source account.** The Arab-dominated Joint List is projected to win between 13 and 15 seats, its highest showing ever. Yisrael Beiteinu, led by former Defense Minister Avigdor Lieberman, is expected to play kingmaker.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-election/israels-netanyahu-teetering-in-close-election-race-polls-idUSKBN1W300B?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-09-17-4-10"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Venezuelan secret service releases National Assembly Vice President Edgar Zambrano. The Nicolás Maduro government says his release comes after a partial compromise with members of Juan Guaidó's opposition government to live peacefully; Guaidó says the Maduro government has been forced to release him under international human rights pressure.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-49736985>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-09-17-5-1"></a>

Context: Christchurch mosque shootings.

**Archived source account.** Following the attack, which was livestreamed on Facebook, the social network teams up with the Metropolitan Police of London. Facebook is providing bodycams to the force's firearms officers to help train its artificial intelligence systems, enabling it to automatically detect and remove live first-person footage of violent incidents. The company says it previously had insufficient footage for its software to suitably match fresh footage with, and has been criticised for its role in the shooting. Instagram say they will also participate.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2019/sep/17/facebook-teams-up-with-police-to-stop-live-streaming-of-terror-attacks>).

### 2019-09-19

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088500246](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20September%2019&oldid=1088500246>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-09-19-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** According to Afghan officials, a US drone strike kills more than 30 pine nut farm workers in Nangarhar Province. The US military say they targeted ISIL terrorists.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-attack-drones/u-s-drone-strike-kills-30-pine-nut-farm-workers-in-afghanistan-idUSKBN1W40NW>).

<a id="event-2019-09-19-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021) / 2019 Qalat bombing.

**Archived source account.** According to Afghan officials, a Taliban truck bomb outside a hospital in Qalat, Zabul Province, kills 39 people. The Taliban say they targeted a National Directorate of Security building nearby.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/amp/news/2019/09/killed-car-bomb-attack-afghan-province-zabul-190919042138106.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-09-19-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A German magazine reports that the chief financial officer of automobile manufacturer BMW, Nicolas Peter, plans to cut between 5,000 and 6,000 jobs at that company, mostly at the Munich headquarters, before 2022.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bmw-jobs/bmw-cfo-wants-to-cut-5000-6000-jobs-by-2022-manager-magazin-idUSKBN1W41XG>).

<a id="event-2019-09-19-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** UK-based travel agent Thomas Cook is reported to be attempting to sell assets as it seeks to prevent its collapse. The group employs 20,000 people and, were it to collapse, approximately 150,000 British customers currently abroad could require repatriation assistance from the Civil Aviation Authority in the largest peacetime operation of its kind.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/thomas-cook-seeks-last-ditch-fire-sale-in-bid-to-avert-collapse-11814043>).

<a id="event-2019-09-19-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Over the last three days, the Federal Reserve Bank of New York adds more than US$200 billion liquidity to the money market, countering a spike in the repo rate on Tuesday.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Day](<https://www.businesslive.co.za/bd/world/americas/2019-09-19-federal-reserve-adds-third-dose-of-liquidity-to-money-market/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-09-19-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An F-16 fighter jet of the Belgian Air Component strikes a house before crashing into a field near Pluvigner, north-west France. Both pilots eject and escape with minor injuries, but one gets his parachute entangled in high-voltage power lines, requiring two hours to rescue.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-49751536>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-09-19-3-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** France and Italy call for a new system to redistribute immigrants to the European Union amid an ongoing increase in the numbers arriving, complaining of unfair demands being placed upon nations where immigrants make landfall.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-49752380>).

<a id="event-2019-09-19-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Austrian MPs vote to demand a government veto on a proposed trade deal between the European Union and South American trade group Mercosur. The deal is the result of 20 years of negotiations. France and Ireland have previously threatened to also veto the deal unless Mercosur member Brazil increases efforts to fight ongoing Amazon rainforest wildfires.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-49753210>).

<a id="event-2019-09-19-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Department of State withholds US$160 million in direct aid to Afghanistan, citing "Afghan Government corruption and financial mismanagement."

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/policy/international/462194-us-to-withdraw-and-withhold-160-million-from-afghanistan-over-corruption>).

<a id="event-2019-09-19-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Citing "influence operations against the United States," the US expels two Cuban diplomats at the United Nations. Cuban Minister of Foreign Affairs Bruno Rodríguez Parrilla dismisses the accusations as "vulgar slander."

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/09/19/politics/us-cuba-un-diplomats/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-09-19-4-1"></a>

Context: Fukushima nuclear disaster.

**Archived source account.** The only prosecution concerning the 2011 nuclear catastrophe ends with the acquittal of three former Tepco executives. The decision means nobody has been held criminally responsible for the meltdown. Greenpeace says the verdict is not very surprising, since the case was "hugely political".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/09/japan-court-set-rule-fukushima-disaster-trial-190919000654856.html>).

<a id="event-2019-09-19-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Interpol reports that in six weeks it has detected more than a dozen people wanted for terrorism offences crossing the Mediterranean Sea using tourist routes. The joint operation involved Algeria, France, Italy, Morocco, Spain, and Tunisia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-49758650>).

<a id="event-2019-09-19-4-4"></a>

Context: Brexit.

**Archived source account.** The UK Supreme Court finishes hearing arguments on the lawfulness of Prime Minister Boris Johnson's prorogation of Parliament. The court states it expects to rule next week. It is jointly considering appeals against two rulings. One, made by the High Court in London under English law, ruled prorogation was an entirely political decision over which courts had no jurisdiction. The other, made by the Court of Session in Edinburgh under Scots law, ruled Johnson acted unlawfully and the prorogation was a nullity that must be reversed.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/uk-politics-49751323>).

<a id="event-2019-09-19-4-6"></a>

Context: Hwaseong serial murders.

**Archived source account.** Police in South Korea link convicted murderer Lee Chun-jae to the serial rapes and murders, which occurred between 1986 and 1991 and left ten dead. The investigations inspired the movie Memories of Murder and saw 21,000 people investigated. Lee, who is serving life for the 1994 rape and murder of his sister in law, cannot be prosecuted despite a DNA link to three victims because the statute of limitations has expired.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-49750184>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-09-19-5-1"></a>

Context: Havana syndrome.

**Archived source account.** A study ordered by the Canadian government finds that exposure to anti-mosquito fumigation, which contains cholinesterase-inhibiting neurotoxins, coincides with brain damage causing the same symptoms as those associated with the syndrome.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-cuba-diplomats-canada/neurotoxin-may-have-caused-diplomats-illness-in-cuba-study-idUSKBN1W42QU>).

### 2019-09-20

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256032052](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20September%2020&oldid=1256032052>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-09-20-0-1"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Nigeria bans international humanitarian organization Action Against Hunger for allegedly providing food and medicine for Boko Haram militants in the north-east of the country. Action Against Hunger denies the Nigerian military's accusations.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-49767289>); [Africanews](<https://www.africanews.com/2019/09/20/nigeria-bans-ngo-for-aiding-boko-haram-islamic-state/>).

<a id="event-2019-09-20-0-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Karbala bombing.

**Archived source account.** A bomb explodes onboard a minibus at a security checkpoint near Karbala, Iraq, killing 12 civilians.

Source citations (as archived): [SFGate](<https://www.sfgate.com/news/article/Iraq-Minibus-explosion-outside-Karbala-kills-8-14455903.php>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-09-20-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Under pressure from owner Hasbro, the next Brussels edition of the Monopoly board game censors Manneken Pis, the 17th-century bronze statue of a naked boy urinating, with swimming trunks.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2019/09/20/monopoly-censor-belgiums-manneken-pis-brussels-edition-box/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-09-20-2-1"></a>

Context: China–United States trade war.

**Archived source account.** The Trump administration lifts tariffs on 437 goods, amid talks. Chinese officials cancel a planned farm visit to return to China earlier.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trade-china/u-s-lifts-tariffs-on-400-chinese-products-trump-cites-trade-progress-idUSKBN1W51Z9>).

<a id="event-2019-09-20-2-3"></a>

Context: Nicotine marketing.

**Archived source account.** American retailer Walmart announces it will stop selling electronic cigarettes, which have recently caused at least eight deaths and 530 cases of a new extreme form of respiratory disease.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/09/20/business/walmart-e-cigarettes-vaping/index.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-09-20-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bus carrying Chinese tourists overturns near Bryce Canyon national park in Utah, United States. At least four passengers are killed and another five wounded. The National Transportation Safety Board launches an investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2019/sep/21/chinese-tourists-killed-in-utah-bus-crash>); [NTSB](<https://twitter.com/NTSB_Newsroom/status/1175165832395182094>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-09-20-4-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Taiwan.

**Archived source account.** Taiwan severs diplomatic relations with Kiribati, according to Taiwanese Foreign Minister Joseph Wu. Only the Marshall Islands, Nauru, Palau and Tuvalu maintain formal relations with Taiwan in the Pacific.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/399237/taiwan-cuts-ties-with-kiribati>).

<a id="event-2019-09-20-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump demands that European allies, in particular Germany and France, take back captured ISIL fighters, or else, he says, "we're going to let them go at your border". Trump also made the same threat in August.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/trump-threatens-to-release-is-captives-at-european-borders/ar-AAHB5fW>).

<a id="event-2019-09-20-4-4"></a>

Context: United States sanctions against Iran, 2019 Abqaiq–Khurais attack.

**Archived source account.** The United States unveils the "highest sanctions ever imposed on a country", targeting Iran's Central Bank and its National Development Fund.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.com/story/2019/09/20/trump-sanctions-irans-central-bank-1506558>).

<a id="event-2019-09-20-4-5"></a>

Context: United States sanctions against Iran, 2019 Abqaiq–Khurais attack.

**Archived source account.** The head of the Iranian Central Bank says the "re-boycotting" of the already-blacklisted institution shows the U.S.' failure to find new ways to pressure Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-aramco-usa-iran-governor/iran-central-bank-head-says-new-sanctions-show-u-s-failure-idUSKBN1W52BI>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-09-20-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A woman who previously accused late United States financier Jeffrey Epstein of sexually abusing her when she was a teenager says she was "trafficked" to Prince Andrew of the United Kingdom and was abused by him at a house in London. She calls him "an abuser" and "a participant". Prince Andrew denies the allegations.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-49774539>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-09-20-6-1"></a>

Context: September 2019 climate strikes.

**Archived source account.** Millions of young people take to the streets and numerous businesses worldwide go on strike days before the UN Climate Summit, demanding that further action be taken to confront climate change.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-climate-change-strike/students-begin-global-climate-strike-with-message-for-governments-do-your-job-idUSKBN1W507I>); [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/globyal-climate-strike-which-companies-are-closing-their-doors-n1055621>).

<a id="event-2019-09-20-6-3"></a>

Context: 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries.

**Archived source account.** The Mayor of New York City Bill de Blasio announces he is ending his presidential campaign, saying "I feel like I have contributed all I can to this primary election, and it's clearly not my time".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-49766266>).

<a id="event-2019-09-20-6-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Egyptian protests.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of protestors march across Egypt, including at Tahrir Square, demanding the resignation of President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi.

Source citations (as archived): [Al-Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/09/egypt-thousands-streets-demanding-sisi-resignation-190920205701643.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-09-20-7-1"></a>

Context: Twitter suspensions.

**Archived source account.** Twitter suspends a network of 4,258 accounts using fake names being operated from the United Arab Emirates that were spreading fake news and propaganda, mostly about Qatar and the war in Yemen. Twitter also suspends the account of Saud al-Qahtani for violating the company's "platform manipulation" policies.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/09/twitter-suspends-thousands-fake-accounts-uae-190920083258996.html>).

### 2019-09-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1320892564](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20September%2021&oldid=1320892564>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-09-21-0-2"></a>

Context: Iran–Saudi Arabia proxy conflict / 2019 Abqaiq–Khurais attack.

**Archived source account.** Saudi Foreign Minister Adel al-Jubeir says the international community must take a firm stand on Tehran and that if confirmed Iran is behind the attacks against the oil facilities, Saudi Arabia will "take the necessary steps" to "respond appropriately".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/saudi-aramco-jubeir/saudi-says-it-will-respond-appropriately-if-probe-confirms-irans-role-in-attacks-idUSB2N24901D>).

<a id="event-2019-09-21-0-4"></a>

Context: 2019 Karbala bombing.

**Archived source account.** ISIL claims responsibility for yesterday's bombing in Iraq, in which 12 were killed.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/09/21/world/middleeast/islamic-state-bus-bomb-iraq.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-09-21-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Search and rescue operations begin for a baby who is missing after a migrant boat carrying fourteen people sinks near Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Sabah](<https://www.dailysabah.com/turkey/2019/09/21/baby-missing-after-boat-carrying-14-migrants-sinks>).

<a id="event-2019-09-21-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Authorities in Texas report a fifth death from Tropical Storm Imelda.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<https://www.latimes.com/world-nation/story/2019-09-21/florida-mans-death-is-5th-linked-to-imeldas-aftermath>).

<a id="event-2019-09-21-1-3"></a>

Context: Venezuelan migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** As the number of refugees from the crisis in Venezuela is projected to surpass the 6 million figure in 2020, matching that of the Syrian Civil War now, Brookings Institution calculates that aid for Venezuelan emigration is yet only 1.5% that for Syrian emigrants after five years of crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-09-20/venezuela-exodus-as-big-as-syria-s-got-1-5-of-the-aid-chart>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-09-21-2-1"></a>

Context: Individual and political action on climate change.

**Archived source account.** Global warming protesters glue themselves to a road near the Port of Dover in England, blocking it. Police arrest ten people, believed to be members of Extinction Rebellion. Further scheduled protests take place in a dedicated area set up by police.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-kent-49780966>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-09-21-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iran's Revolutionary Guards leader, Hossein Salami, warns that "any country that attacks the Islamic Republic will have their mainland turned into the main battlefield". He further added that "any attack will not stop until the full destruction of the aggressor".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya English](<https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/middle-east/2019/09/21/IRGC-chief-warns-any-country-that-attacks-Iran-will-be-main-battlefield-.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-09-21-4-1"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Turkey.

**Archived source account.** Turkish authorities declare a forest wildfire near Istanbul to be the result of terrorism. They say a suspect is in custody.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Sabah](<https://www.dailysabah.com/war-on-terror/2019/09/21/forest-fire-in-istanbul-district-terror-related-minister-says>).

<a id="event-2019-09-21-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A mass shooting in Lancaster, South Carolina, leaves 2 men dead and 9 other people injured.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2019/09/21/south-carolina-shooting-leaves-2-dead-9-injured-lancaster-bar/2400844001/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-09-21-5-1"></a>

Context: Brexit.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of protestors march in Edinburgh, Scotland, against the upcoming departure of the United Kingdom from the European Union. The crowd is addressed by Members of the UK Parliament, and Members of the Scottish Parliament. Amongst the attendees is MSP Joanna Cherry QC, who is taking legal action against UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson's recent prorogation of the UK Parliament. Cherry's action succeeded at Scotland's Court of Session, and is currently being reviewed by the UK Supreme Court.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-scotland-politics-49781535>).

### 2019-09-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088527508](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20September%2022&oldid=1088527508>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-09-22-0-1"></a>

Context: 71st Primetime Emmy Awards.

**Archived source account.** Fleabag wins Outstanding Comedy Series and Game of Thrones wins Outstanding Drama Series at the 71st Primetime Emmy Awards.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2019/09/22/emmys-2019-the-complete-list-of-winners-and-nominees.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-09-22-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 22 people are killed and 15 others injured after a bus rams into a hill en route from Skardu to Rawalpindi, Pakistan, following a brake failure.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/at-least-22-killed-after-bus-rams-into-hill-following-brake-failure-11816591>).

<a id="event-2019-09-22-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two minibuses collide head-on near Limpopo, South Africa. All eleven on board the vehicles die.

Source citations (as archived): [ENCA](<https://www.enca.com/news/11-killed-horror-head-collision-limpopo>).

<a id="event-2019-09-22-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Search and rescue aircraft locate wreckage near Ilaga, Indonesia. It is thought to be a missing Twin Otter cargo plane carrying rice and four people, but this remains to be confirmed.

Source citations (as archived): [The Aviation Herald](<http://avherald.com/h?article=4ccf9902&amp;opt=0>).

<a id="event-2019-09-22-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A classroom collapses in Dagoretti, Kenya, killing at least seven children.

Source citations (as archived): [The Standard](<https://www.standardmedia.co.ke/article/2001342979/two-pupils-killed-several-injured-as-classroom-wall-collapses-in-dagoretti>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-09-22-2-1"></a>

Context: World Car-Free Day.

**Archived source account.** Cities around the world celebrate World Car-Free Day.

Source citations (as archived): [UrduPoint](<https://www.urdupoint.com/en/world/factbox-world-carfree-day-717540.html>).

<a id="event-2019-09-22-2-2"></a>

Context: World Car-Free Day.

**Archived source account.** Brussels reports up to 70% lower levels of nitrogen dioxide and black carbon in the atmosphere, compared to other Sundays.

Source citations (as archived): [Belga](<https://www.hln.be/in-de-buurt/brussel/-tot-70-minder-stikstof-en-dieselroet-bij-autovrije-zondag-brussel~a1a501aa/>).

<a id="event-2019-09-22-2-3"></a>

Context: World Car-Free Day.

**Archived source account.** Over 12 miles of roads are closed for traffic in central London.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/cities/gallery/2019/sep/22/world-car-free-day-2019-in-pictures>).

<a id="event-2019-09-22-2-5"></a>

Context: Climate change mitigation.

**Archived source account.** German Environment Minister Svenja Schulze says the €54 billion climate plan approved by the German cabinet on Friday enables her country to join the Powering Past Coal Alliance. Germany expects to transition away from coal by 2038.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/germany-to-join-alliance-to-phase-out-coal/a-50532921>).

<a id="event-2019-09-22-2-7"></a>

Context: Effects of global warming.

**Archived source account.** The World Meteorological Organization publishes a report stating that 2015–2019 was the hottest five-year period since measurements began. The increase in the global carbon dioxide level, the rise of the sea level and the melting of ice caps is accelerating.

Source citations (as archived): [PA](<https://www.breakingnews.ie/world/climate-change-causes-and-impacts-are-accelerating-experts-warn-952345.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-09-22-3-1"></a>

Context: Crisis in Venezuela.

**Archived source account.** Argentina accuses Venezuela of committing "crimes against humanity", "torture and murder" after receiving reports from Venezuelan refugees in the country.
