The Argentine Government will file a formal accusation against Venezuela before the International Court of Justice.

Source citations (as archived): [Clarín](<https://www.clarin.com/mundo/torturas-ejecuciones-desapariciones-forzadas-crudo-informe-gobierno-argentino-abusos-regimen-venezuela_0_rpFqgDFJ.html>).

<a id="event-2019-09-22-3-3"></a>

Context: Brexit.

**Archived source account.** Dominic Raab says the UK Government will abide by the upcoming Supreme Court's ruling on the lawfulness of Prime Minister Boris Johnson's prorogation of Parliament. When asked if the Government would prorogue Parliament again if it wins, he answers that he's "keen not to take levers off the table that weaken the position of the UK in Brussels".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-49786644>).

<a id="event-2019-09-22-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sudanese Prime Minister Abdalla Hamdok launches an investigation into the deaths of dozens of protestors during a July crackdown orchestrated under the regime of now-ousted President Omar al-Bashir.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20190922-sudan-hamdock-investigation-protest-deaths-violence>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-09-22-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Joint List recommends Benny Gantz as the next Prime Minister of Israel. This is the first time an Arab-led political party recommends a candidate for prime minister since they recommended Yitzhak Rabin in 1992.

Source citations (as archived): [Axios](<https://www.axios.com/israel-netanyahu-gantz-arab-joint-list-odeh-efce1338-2aaf-4c61-97a3-05d08477b506.html>).

### 2019-09-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088527638](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20September%2023&oldid=1088527638>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-09-23-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** Afghan officials say a government strike Sunday night on a militant facility in Musa Qala District, Helmand Province, killed 35 or more civilians at a wedding party nearby. The Afghan Defence Ministry says the operation targeted a training facility for suicide bombers and it killed 22 members of the Taliban. The Taliban say 18 members of the Afghan forces were killed.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-attack/at-least-35-people-at-wedding-party-killed-during-nearby-afghan-army-raid-idUSKBN1W80MI>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-09-23-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In a rare joint press release, European car makers warn that a no-deal Brexit, introducing administrative hassle and tariffs, would have a "seismic" impact on frictionless trading conditions and that it would deal a "severe" blow to the industry's just-in-time manufacturing supply chains, also potentially affecting "consumer choice and affordability on both sides of the Channel".

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.theguardian.com/business/2019/sep/23/no-deal-brexit-will-have-seismic-impact-says-european-car-industry>).

<a id="event-2019-09-23-1-2"></a>

Context: Collapse of Thomas Cook.

**Archived source account.** British travel company Thomas Cook enters compulsory liquidation, leaving 150,000 British holidaymakers stranded abroad and endangering 22,000 jobs worldwide. In response, the UK government and the Civil Aviation Authority launches Operation Matterhorn, the largest repatriation in the UK's peacetime history.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-49791249>); [Gov.uk](<https://www.gov.uk/government/news/government-and-uk-caa-launches-largest-repatriation-in-peacetime-history-after-collapse-of-thomas-cook>).

<a id="event-2019-09-23-1-3"></a>

Context: Collapse of Thomas Cook.

**Archived source account.** Tunisian tourism minister René Trabelsi says Thomas Cook owes Tunisian hotels €60 million for stays in July and August, with 4,500 customers still in the country. Tourism is a major component of the national economy.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-thomas-cook-grp-investment-tunisia-ho/thomas-cook-owes-tunisian-hotels-60-million-euros-minister-idUSKBN1W810R>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-09-23-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Southeast Asian haze.

**Archived source account.** Raging wildfires in Indonesia cause the sky to turn red over much of Sumatra. The phenomenon is a result of Rayleigh scattering.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-49793047>).

<a id="event-2019-09-23-2-3"></a>

Context: Boeing 737 MAX groundings.

**Archived source account.** Boeing announces each relative of victims of two air disasters will be paid US$144,500 by the aircraft manufacturer, and will not have to waive their right to litigate to receive the money.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ethiopia-airplane-victims/boeing-to-pay-737-max-crash-victims-families-144500-each-idUSKBN1W8288>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-09-23-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Doctors Without Borders alleges the World Health Organisation is rationing vaccines for Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo despite adequate resources.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20190923-dr-congo-msf-doctors-without-borders-accuses-who-rationing-ebola-vaccine>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-09-23-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iran says a UK-flagged ship seized several months ago is free to depart. MV Stena Impero, an oil tanker, was captured in response to the seizure of an Iranian oil tanker in Gibraltar over allegations it was carrying fuel to Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/british-ship-iran-seized-us-tanker-latest-a9116561.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-09-23-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** After "seriously considering feedback from different parties who feel objections on some substantial content", Indonesian President Joko Widodo postpones the vote on a new criminal code, intended to replace the century-old Dutch colonial-era penal code. The proposed code would criminalise extramarital sex, insults to the president and "obscene acts".

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/09/23/asia/indonesia-sex-code-intl-hnk/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-09-23-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Spanish Civil Guard arrests nine members of the Committees for the Defence of the Catalan Republic for planning violent acts and creating homemade explosives. Expressions of support come from politicians including the Government and President of Catalonia claiming the charges represent repression against Catalonia.

Source citations (as archived): [La Vanguardia](<https://www.lavanguardia.com/politica/20190923/47570882252/guardia-civil-operacion-independentistas-cdr-detenidos-video-seo-ext.html>).

<a id="event-2019-09-23-5-3"></a>

Context: 2016 Notre-Dame de Paris bombing attempt.

**Archived source account.** A group of alleged ISIL sympathisers go on trial in France, including two women accused of an attempted car bombing at Notre-Dame Cathedral in 2016. Defendants also include a man being tried in absentia whom the United States claims to have killed via drone strike in 2017; the court ruled no evidence had been provided to confirm his death.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20190923-paris-notre-dame-female-suspected-jihadists-women-trial-botched-terror-attack-group>).

<a id="event-2019-09-23-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Port-au-Prince, an Associated Press photojournalist and a security guard are wounded when Senator Jean Marie Ralph Féthière (PHTK) opens fire, reportedly trying to pass through a demonstration outside the Haitian Parliament. The Senate tries to convene and appoint Fritz-William Michel as Prime Minister.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/sep/23/haiti-shooting-senator-gun-parliament-photojournalist>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-09-23-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The World Anti-Doping Agency launches a probe into "inconsistencies" with laboratory results from Russia, promising "the most stringent sanctions" if violations are found. Russia was previously banned from the 2018 Winter Olympics following a similar probe.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20190923-world-sport-anti-doping-body-says-to-probe-russia-inconsistencies>).

### 2019-09-24

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1284625225](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20September%2024&oldid=1284625225>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-09-24-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Papua protests.

**Archived source account.** Violent protests in Papua, Indonesia, kill at least 30 people. Most casualties are in Wamena, with deaths also reported in Jayapura. Victims reportedly receive stab and arrow wounds, and others die in fires as protestors torch government buildings.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<http://telegraph.co.uk/news/2019/09/24/fresh-wave-west-papua-violence-leaves-27-dead/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-09-24-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** WeWork co-founder Adam Neumann agrees to resign as chief executive officer of the office rental firm amid investors increasing concern about the firm's true market value which has led to the company postponing its initial public offering.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-49803064>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/09/24/business/dealbook/wework-ceo-adam-neumann.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-09-24-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A fire in the maternity ward of a hospital in El Oued, Algeria, kills eight newborn babies.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa/algeria-hospital-fire-newborn-baby-death-toll-latest-algiers-el-oued-a9117756.html>).

<a id="event-2019-09-24-2-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Kashmir earthquake.

**Archived source account.** An earthquake in Azad Kashmir kills at least 37 people and wounds more than 300 others in Pakistan. The tremor hits cities including Mirpur and Islamabad. The military commences search and rescue operations.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-quake-pakistan/death-toll-mounts-in-pakikashmirstan-earthquake-but-panic-subsides-idUSKBN1WA0BZ>).

<a id="event-2019-09-24-2-4"></a>

Context: Merrimack Valley gas explosions.

**Archived source account.** The National Transportation Safety Board of the United States meets to discuss a final report on the accident, including findings of cause. The explosions killed one, injured dozens, and destroyed or damaged around 100 structures.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS Boston](<https://boston.cbslocal.com/2019/09/24/ntsb-merrimack-valley-gas-explosions-report-columbia-gas/>).

<a id="event-2019-09-24-2-6"></a>

Context: Effects of global warming.

**Archived source account.** Italian authorities close roads in the Val Ferret valleys on Mont Blanc de Courmayeur and order evacuation of the population in the risk area beneath the Planpincieux Glacier following warnings by experts that the glacier, whose movement has accelerated to 50-60cm (16-23in) a day, could collapse.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-49820542>); [Agenzia Nazionale Stampa Associata](<http://www.ansa.it/english/news/world/2019/09/24/mont-blanc-glacier-risks-collapsing_2141b1f7-5742-4282-b8ce-e442d6744f08.html>).

<a id="event-2019-09-24-2-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** A tanker truck carrying fuel overturns after swerving to avoid a motorcycle in Bamako, Mali. A subsequent explosion kills six and seriously injures 46 more. Dozens of vehicles burn.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mali-blast/tanker-truck-explosion-in-mali-capital-kills-six-wounds-46-idUSKBN1W92NX>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-09-24-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sudanese Finance Minister Ibrahim el-Badawi says Prime Minister Abdalla Hamdok is to ask the World Bank for US$2 billion. Sudan has been unable to do business with either the World Bank or the International Monetary Fund because it is featured on the United States' State Sponsors of Terrorism list. The US Congress is unlikely to remove Sudan before next year, el-Badawi further announces, saying he has been told the process is complicated.

Source citations (as archived): [Asharq al-Awsat](<https://aawsat.com/english/home/article/1916641/us-says-removing-sudan-terror-list-could-take-year>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-09-24-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Luxury automaker Daimler, owner of the Mercedes-Benz brand, is fined €870 million by prosecutors in Stuttgart, Germany for its role in the diesel emissions scandal.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-daimler-emissions-fine/daimler-to-pay-870-million-euros-fine-in-relation-to-diesel-investigation-idUSKBN1W91KW>).

<a id="event-2019-09-24-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of Spain rules that the body of former Caudillo Francisco Franco can be exhumed from the country's Valle de los Caídos tomb, where his body has been kept since his death in 1975. The Spanish Socialist Workers' Party-led Sánchez government says it will go ahead with the exhumation following the court ruling.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/sep/24/franco-body-moved-burial-site-spain-court>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-09-24-5-1"></a>

Context: Brexit, 2019 British prorogation controversy.

**Archived source account.** The UK Supreme Court rules that Prime Minister Boris Johnson's prorogation of Parliament was an unlawful nullity.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC Newsq](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-49810261>).

<a id="event-2019-09-24-5-3"></a>

Context: U.N. General Assembly 74th session.

**Archived source account.** General Debate opens at the UN Headquarters in New York City, with US President Donald Trump denouncing globalism and calling Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro "a Cuban puppet".

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/politics/live-news/trump-un-speech-09-24-2019/index.html>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2019/sep/24/trump-bolsonaro-and-johnson-to-open-un-general-assembly-live-news>).

<a id="event-2019-09-24-5-5"></a>

Context: Efforts to impeach Donald Trump, 2019 Trump–Ukraine scandal.

**Archived source account.** Speaker of the House Nancy Pelosi announces that a formal impeachment inquiry has been launched into US President Donald Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/09/24/us/politics/democrats-impeachment-trump.html?smid=fb-nytimes&amp;smtyp=cur>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/powerpost/pelosi-top-democrats-privately-discuss-creation-of-select-committee-for-impeachment/2019/09/24/af6f735a-dedf-11e9-b199-f638bf2c340f_story.html?wpisrc=al_news__alert-politics--alert-national&amp;wpmk=1>).

<a id="event-2019-09-24-5-7"></a>

Context: September 2019 Indonesian protests and riots.

**Archived source account.** Tens of thousands of students rally against graft laws and new criminal codes across Indonesia. Some of the protesters violently clash with the riot police, leading to the injury of more than 300 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/indonesia-police-tear-gas-students-protesting-sex-graft-laws/a-50565478>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/09/indonesia-protests-80-students-hurt-police-clashes-190925044211780.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-09-24-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Microsoft issues an emergency patch for its Internet Explorer browser to close a vulnerability that allowed cybercriminals to install malware via boobytrapped websites.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-49809453>).

<a id="event-2019-09-24-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The European Court of Justice rules in favour of United States search engine Google in a landmark right to be forgotten case, rejecting a French privacy regulator's argument that Google should apply the rules to its results and domains globally and not only within the European Union.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-49808208>).

### 2019-09-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1218716477](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20September%2025&oldid=1218716477>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-09-25-0-1"></a>

Context: Collapse of Thomas Cook.

**Archived source account.** German airline Condor, a subsidiary of the now insolvent Thomas Cook Group, files for bankruptcy.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-49824427>).

<a id="event-2019-09-25-0-2"></a>

Context: Collapse of Thomas Cook.

**Archived source account.** Secretary of State for Transport Grant Shapps announces that the UK government is planning to introduce new legislation in the aftermath of Thomas Cook's collapse in order to allow "more orderly" bankruptcies by travel agencies and airlines.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/thomas-cook-calls-for-new-laws-in-light-of-ridiculous-situation-11819254>).

<a id="event-2019-09-25-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Northern Irish bus manufacturer Wrightbus collapses into administration after buyout talks fail, with 1,200 jobs lost. Local politicians urge action from UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson, who commissioned the so-called "Boris Bus" from the company when he was Mayor of London and previously promised to "do everything we can to ensure the future of" Wrightbus.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/routemaster-maker-wrightbus-collapse-places-1-400-jobs-at-risk-11819140>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-09-25-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Rescuers reach the wreckage of a Twin Otter cargo plane that crashed last week between Timika and Ilaga in Papua, Indonesia. All four persons on board are found dead, and their bodies are recovered.

Source citations (as archived): [The Malaysian Insight](<https://www.themalaysianinsight.com/s/185725>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-09-25-2-1"></a>

Context: Climate change mitigation.

**Archived source account.** An advisory board to the Dutch government recommends reducing speed limits on roads and using public money to purchase outdated cattle farms as part of a raft of measures to tackle global warming-linked nitrogen emissions in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<https://www.apnews.com/c4865d774bf745fe8d74b236917cff17>).

<a id="event-2019-09-25-2-3"></a>

Context: Economy of Poland.

**Archived source account.** Polish Energy Minister Krzysztof Tchórzewski announces the ruling Law and Justice party plans to pass new laws to enable more coal mines to be built.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://euronews.com/2019/09/25/poland-plans-new-coal-mines-despite-eus-call-for-carbon-neutrality>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-09-25-3-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Kiribati.

**Archived source account.** Kiribatian President Taneti Mamau condemns Australia for the alleged apathy the Australian government shows toward small island nations in the Pacific facing the threat of global warming.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/399535/kiribati-president-pans-australia-for-climate-apathy>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-09-25-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bomb explodes as a police riot bus passes by in Yüreğir, Adana Province, Turkey. At least five officers are injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Bianet](<http://bianet.org/english/human-rights/213509-explosion-while-riot-police-service-vehicle-passing-in-adana-5-people-wounded>).

<a id="event-2019-09-25-4-2"></a>

Context: Cannabis in Australia.

**Archived source account.** The Australian Capital Territory (ACT) becomes the first jurisdiction in Australia to legalize the recreational use of cannabis. From January 31, 2020, adults within ACT will be allowed to have 50 grams of the drug and can grow up to four cannabis plants at home.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-australia-49820735>).

<a id="event-2019-09-25-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Millionaire Italian yacht businessman Giulio Lolli is convicted of terrorism in Libya and sentenced to life imprisonment by a court in Tripoli. Lolli is wanted for fraud in Italy, and his Italian lawyer says the Libyan legal case appears to be based on Lolli using a yacht to evacuate fighters from Tripoli.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times](<https://www.thetimes.co.uk/article/italian-playboy-giulio-lolli-jailed-for-terror-in-libya-f3mg7fzs2>).

<a id="event-2019-09-25-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A jury in New York convicts Dilkhayot Kasimov, a citizen of Uzbekistan, of terrorism offences for attempting to raise funds to assist a friend in travelling to join ISIL. Five others pleaded guilty in 2015.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<https://www.apnews.com/b00f266984454143a90bee7f2d479878>).

<a id="event-2019-09-25-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Suspected serial killer Gracious David-West confesses to fifteen murders at a hotel in Port Harcourt, Nigeria.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2019/09/25/man-confesses-killing-15-women-port-harcourt-hotel-murders-rocked/>).

<a id="event-2019-09-25-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** The military court in Blida sentences Mohamed Mediène, Said Bouteflika, Bachir Tartag and Louisa Hanoune, four persons from the ruling elite around former Algerian President Abdelaziz Bouteflika, to 15-year jail terms for conspiracy against the army and the authority of the Algerian state.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-algeria-trial/algeria-jails-top-figures-of-bouteflika-era-idUSKBN1WA07P>).

<a id="event-2019-09-25-4-8"></a>

Context: Impeachment inquiry into Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The United States House of Representatives issues an impeachment inquiry into President Donald Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/politics/live-news/trump-impeachment-inquiry-09-25-2019/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-09-25-4-10"></a>

Context: Danske Bank money laundering scandal.

**Archived source account.** Authorities raid the German bank Deutsche Bank as part of a money laundering probe into €200 billion of suspicious payments identified into the accounts of Danske Bank's branch in Estonia. Danske Bank's Estonian boss from 2007 to 2015 is found dead near Tallinn at his home in circumstances police describe as neither suspicious nor accidental.

Source citations (as archived): [City A.M.](<https://www.cityam.com/dutch-bank-abn-amro-probed-under-terror-financing-rules/>).

<a id="event-2019-09-25-4-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** A federal grand jury indicts a US Army soldier on charges of distributing explosives information as part of an alleged far-right terror plot.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/09/25/politics/army-soldier-indicted-alleged-bombing-news-network/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-09-25-5-1"></a>

Context: September 2019 Israeli legislative election.

**Archived source account.** Israeli President Reuven Rivlin formally gives Benjamin Netanyahu the mandate to form the next Israeli government by October 24, after 55 members of the Knesset recommended the latter, compared with 54 recommendations for Benny Gantz. If Netanyahu fails, the mandate could be transferred to Gantz.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/Israel-Elections/Rivlin-meeting-with-Netanyahu-Gantz-602868>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-09-25-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Soyuz-MS spacecraft Sarmat, carrying Hazza Al Mansouri, the first United Arab Emirates astronaut, and Expedition 61 crew members Jessica Meir and Oleg Skripochka, is launched to the International Space Station. It was the final flight of the Soyuz-FG launch vehicle – all future Soyuz MS spacecraft launches will be conducted with the Soyuz-2.

Source citations (as archived): [Spaceflight Now](<https://spaceflightnow.com/2019/09/25/soyuz-ms-15-launch-mission-status-center/>); [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/soyuz-rocket-launch-today-watch-live-stream-soyuz-flight-international-space-station-uae-guest-cosmonaut-2019-09-25/>).

### 2019-09-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088528361](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20September%2026&oldid=1088528361>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-09-26-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The world's largest airport, Beijing Daxing International Airport, formally opens to commercial flights.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/travel/article/daxing-international-airport-beijing-opens/index.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-09-26-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Ambon earthquake.

**Archived source account.** A 6.5-magnitude earthquake strikes the Maluku Islands in eastern Indonesia. 30 people are killed and 156 others injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<https://www.rappler.com/world/regions/asia-pacific/241324-indonesia-earthquake-death-toll-september-29-2019>).

<a id="event-2019-09-26-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Around 100 people are evacuated from Breivika port in Tromsø, Norway, after Russian trawler FV Bukhta Naezdnik catches fire and develops a heavy list. The burning ship has a tank of ammonia and 200,000 litres of diesel oil on board. The ship is purposely capsized to reduce the risk of the ammonia tank exploding.

Source citations (as archived): [BreakingNews.ie](<https://www.breakingnews.ie/world/explosion-risk-as-russian-trawler-catches-fire-in-norwegian-harbour-953159.html>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/russia-ship-fire-trawler-tromso-breivika-explosion-evacuation-a9121606.html>).

<a id="event-2019-09-26-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 30 miners are killed after a gold mine collapses due to a landslide in the Tibesti Region, Chad.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-49839574>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-09-26-2-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Sudan, Aftermath of the Sudanese Revolution.

**Archived source account.** Sudan closes its borders with Libya and the Central African Republic citing the "threat they pose to the security and economy of Sudan".

Source citations (as archived): [Africanews](<https://www.africanews.com/2019/09/26/sudan-will-close-its-borders-with-libya-and-central-africa-official/>).

<a id="event-2019-09-26-2-3"></a>

Context: Japan–South Korea relations, 2019 Japan–South Korea trade dispute.

**Archived source account.** Japan and South Korea fail to make progress toward resolution, but agree to continue dialogue.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2019/09/27/national/politics-diplomacy/although-pressing-disputes-remain-unresolved-japan-south-korea-agree-continue-dialogue/#.XY5JZ3GyTMx>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-09-27/south-korea-s-kang-says-big-disagreements-with-japan-persist>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-09-26-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Major Criminal Court in Bahrain sentences four people to jail terms for setting up a terror group with the aim of launching attacks on police, and related crimes. Two are fugitives tried in absentia

Source citations (as archived): [Gulf News](<https://gulfnews.com/world/gulf/bahrain/bahrain-convicts-four-on-terror-charges-1.66693197>).

<a id="event-2019-09-26-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Authorities in the Netherlands launch a probe into bank ABN Amro. The bank is suspected of breaching rules on money laundering and terrorism financing.

Source citations (as archived): [City A.M.](<https://www.cityam.com/dutch-bank-abn-amro-probed-under-terror-financing-rules/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-09-26-4-1"></a>

Context: National Emergency Concerning the Southern Border of the United States.

**Archived source account.** The United States Senate votes to end President Donald Trump's emergency declaration along the U.S.-Mexico border.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/senate-votes-to-kill-national-emergency-declaration-along-southern-border>).

<a id="event-2019-09-26-4-3"></a>

Context: September 2019 Indonesian protests and riots.

**Archived source account.** A student dies after allegedly being shot during a violent clash between the protesters and police force in front of the provincial parliament building in Kendari, Indonesia.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jakarta Post](<https://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2019/09/26/one-student-dies-one-in-critical-condition-after-protest-turns-violent-in-kendari.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-09-26-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Soyuz-MS spacecraft Sarmat successfully docks with the International Space Station, with the first Emirati astronaut, Hazza Al Mansouri, and Expedition 61 astronauts Jessica Meir and Oleg Skripochka joining the crew of Expedition 60 aboard the station.

Source citations (as archived): [Gulf News](<https://gulfnews.com/uae/science/uae-in-space-what-did-hazzaa-almansoori-carry-with-him-to-space-1.1569476103518>).

### 2019-09-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1284625272](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20September%2027&oldid=1284625272>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-09-27-0-1"></a>

Context: American intervention in Libya (2015–2019).

**Archived source account.** The United States Africa Command says the US has carried out an airstrike against ISIL in southwest Libya, killing at least 17 militants.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<https://www.straitstimes.com/world/africa/the-us-says-it-has-carried-out-an-airstrike-against-the-islamic-state-group-in-libya>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-09-27-1-1"></a>

Context: Collapse of Thomas Cook.

**Archived source account.** Portugal announces it has set aside 150 million euros to lend to the companies that have been hurt by the collapse of tour guide company Thomas Cook.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-portugal-tourism-thomascook/portugal-sets-aside-150-million-euros-to-offer-credit-to-firms-hit-by-thomas-cook-collapse-idUSKBN1WC1DY?il=0>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-09-27-2-1"></a>

Context: September 2019 climate strikes, Individual and political action on climate change.

**Archived source account.** An estimated two million people across the world participate in strikes to encourage action on climate change, with a total of 6 million during the week, including up to 500,000 protesters in Montreal, Quebec, Canada.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2019/sep/27/climate-crisis-6-million-people-join-latest-wave-of-worldwide-protests>); [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/montreal/get-a-unique-view-inside-and-above-montreal-s-half-million-climate-march-1.5301122>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-09-27-3-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of China, Foreign relations of Taiwan, Foreign relations of Kiribati, Cross-Strait relations.

**Archived source account.** Anti-China protests are held by the opposition in Kiribati's capital of Tarawa after the government severed ties with Taiwan and established relations with China.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/399747/opposition-organises-anti-china-protest-march-in-kiribati>).

<a id="event-2019-09-27-3-3"></a>

Context: Turkey–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan says that it is "impossible" for his country to stop buying oil from Iran, despite United States sanctions against Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-iran-trade-usa/erdogan-says-turkey-will-continue-oil-natural-gas-trade-with-iran-ntv-idUSKBN1WB33D>).

<a id="event-2019-09-27-3-5"></a>

Context: U.N. General Assembly 74th session, Foreign relations of North Macedonia.

**Archived source account.** North Macedonia establishes diplomatic relations with Armenia, Monaco, San Marino and Tunisia at the 74th session of the United Nations General Assembly.

Source citations (as archived): [Ministry of Foreign Affairs of North Macedonia](<http://mfa.gov.mk/index.php?option=com_content&amp;view=article&amp;id=3229:74-5&amp;catid=52:press-releases&amp;lang=en&amp;Itemid=684>); [News.am](<https://news.am/eng/news/535883.html>); [Foreign Minister of North Macedonia](<https://twitter.com/Dimitrov_Nikola/status/1177679851697901568>).

<a id="event-2019-09-27-3-7"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** Diplomats of several Western-aligned countries walk out of the UN General Assembly as Venezuelan Vice-President Delcy Rodríguez begins a speech.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<https://www.foxnews.com/politics/diplomats-walk-out-in-protest-as-venezuela-attempts-to-fill-un-general-assembly-with-supporters>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-09-27-4-1"></a>

Context: Honour killing in Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** The brother of Pakistani social media star Qandeel Baloch is sentenced to life in prison for her honour murder, while six others are acquitted. The case sparked international headlines and discussion of women's rights in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-49848384>).

<a id="event-2019-09-27-4-3"></a>

Context: Crisis in Venezuela.

**Archived source account.** A resolution is adopted by the United Nations Human Rights Council with 19 votes in favour, 7 against and 21 abstentions, accusing Venezuela's Nicolás Maduro government of thousands of extrajudicial murders, forced disappearances, and torture, after being proposed by the Lima Group and backed by many European countries. The UN resolves to send an investigative mission to the country. Maduro says the motion was "produced by the United States to run a hate campaign". Another Venezuelan representative calls the UN a "small group" that they "will not cooperate with".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-49855018>).

<a id="event-2019-09-27-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police in Kaduna, Nigeria, raid an Islamic learning centre, and free around 500 men and male children held captive there. The freed detainees allege torture, slavery, and sexual abuse, and some display evidence of injury and malnutrition. Two children self-identify as being from Burkina Faso, with the remaining captives thought by police to be mostly Nigerian. Eight suspects are arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-49850408>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-09-27-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson is formally referred to the Independent Office for Police Conduct (IOPC) amid allegations of corruption during his tenure as Mayor of London. Johnson is alleged to have awarded a close friend, American technology entrepreneur Jennifer Arcuri, "thousands of pounds" in public business funding, according to the The Sunday Times.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2019/sep/27/boris-johnson-referred-to-police-watchdog-over-potential-misconduct>).

<a id="event-2019-09-27-5-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Trump–Ukraine scandal, Impeachment inquiry into Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** Kurt Volker, United States special envoy to Ukraine, resigns one day after the release of a whistleblower report concerning a phone call between U.S. President Donald Trump and Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelensky.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/09/27/politics/kurt-volker-resigns/index.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-whistleblower-ukraine-volke/trump-envoy-to-ukraine-volker-resigns-sources-idUSKBN1WC2L6>).

<a id="event-2019-09-27-5-4"></a>

Context: 2020 United States federal budget.

**Archived source account.** President of the United States Donald Trump signs a short-term spending bill that temporarily extends government funding through November 21, thereby avoiding a federal government shutdown when the 2019 budget funding ends on September 30.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/homenews/administration/463464-trump-signs-stopgap-measure-funding-government-through-november>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/09/27/politics/trump-signs-short-term-spending-bill/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-09-27-5-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Fale Alea elects Pohiva Tuʻiʻonetoa as Prime Minister of Tonga succeeding the interim premiership of Semisi Sika.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/399761/tonga-mps-choose-tu-i-onetoa-as-new-prime-minister>).

### 2019-09-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088528614](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20September%2028&oldid=1088528614>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-09-28-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bomb targeting the office of Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam in Chaman, Balochistan, Pakistan, kills three people, including leader Maulana Mohammad Hanif, with nine more people injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Arab News](<https://www.arabnews.com/node/1561086/world>).

<a id="event-2019-09-28-0-2"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** Houthi rebels claim that they have captured "thousands" of enemy troops near the Saudi town of Najran following a major, deadly attack near the two countries' border. Saudi officials have not confirmed the claim.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-49866677>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/09/houthis-claim-capture-thousands-saudi-troops-attack-190928144722091.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-09-28-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Flooding in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh kills at least 93 people and displaces thousands of others. Another 29 people were killed in Bihar..

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-49875027>).

<a id="event-2019-09-28-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** An oil tanker ship explodes in Ulsan, South Korea, with flames subsequently spreading to an adjacent second tanker. At least ten people are injured.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/south-korea-ship-fire-1.5301463>).

<a id="event-2019-09-28-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A coach with a flat tyre swerves into oncoming traffic and strikes a lorry head-on in Jiangsu, China. The collision kills at least 36 and injures another 36.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/sep/29/china-road-crash-at-least-36-killed-as-coach-hits-truck>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-09-28-2-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, U.N. General Assembly 74th session, Rojava conflict.

**Archived source account.** Syrian Foreign Minister Walid al-Moualem demands the immediate withdrawal of all U.S. and Turkish troops from his country and warns that Syrian government forces have the right to take countermeasures if they refuse.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-un-assembly-syria/syria-demands-withdrawal-of-u-s-turkish-forces-warns-of-countermeasures-idUSKBN1WD0JL>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-09-28-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Afghan presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Afghanistan head to the polls to elect a new president. The process is overshadowed by "insurgent" attacks, which led to dozens of civilian casualties.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/afghanistan-election-day-violence-leaves-multiple-casualties/a-50618466>).

<a id="event-2019-09-28-3-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Afghan presidential election.

**Archived source account.** The Independent Election Commission says it has reports that there is no contact with 901 of the 4,942 polling centers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-election-vote/afghanistan-election-commission-has-no-contact-with-some-polling-centers-idUSKBN1WD086>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-09-28-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Richmond Football Club defeats the Greater Western Sydney Giants in the 2019 AFL Grand Final by 114 points to 25, marking the club's twelfth premiership and second in three years. The match, attended by 100,014 spectators, is the lowest single-match score by the Giants in their history, and the most lopsided Grand Final result in Richmond's history (89 points).

Source citations (as archived): [The Age](<https://www.theage.com.au/sport/afl/supreme-tigers-deliver-roar-lesson-to-giants-20190928-p52vtu.html>).

<a id="event-2019-09-28-4-2"></a>

Context: 2019 UCI Road World Championships.

**Archived source account.** Annemiek van Vleuten wins the women's road race after a 105 km solo attack, with a lead of 2 min 15 s over second-placed defending champion Anna van der Breggen.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2019/sep/28/annemiek-van-vleuten-womens-road-race-world-championship>).

### 2019-09-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088528762](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20September%2029&oldid=1088528762>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-09-29-0-1"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian and Yemeni border conflict, Yemeni Crisis, Najran attack.

**Archived source account.** Yemen's Houthi movement releases footage appearing to show captured Saudi Arabian Army soldiers and burning armoured personnel carriers, after claiming to have conducted an "all-out" cross-border offensive inside Saudi Arabia's Najran Region that defeated three "enemy military brigades".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/09/yemen-houthi-rebels-release-saudi-attack-video-190929130644121.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-09-29-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A fire at an overcrowded refugee camp on the Greek island of Lesbos kills an Afghan woman living in a shipping container. A local official claims "aggressive" residents at the camp prevented firefighters from accessing the blaze, and that thrown stones and other missiles injured first responders and damaged their vehicles.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/sep/30/riots-at-greek-refugee-camp-on-lesbos-after-fatal-fire>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-09-29-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Austrian legislative election.

**Archived source account.** The Federal Electoral Authority, based on preliminary results, reports the People's Party, headed by the prior chancellor Sebastian Kurz, wins the snap election with 38.4 percent of the vote. Second place Social Democratic Party got 21.5%.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-49867930>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/09/29/world/europe/austria-elections-kurz.html>); [National Election Authority](<https://www.bmi.gv.at/412/Nationalratswahlen/Nationalratswahl_2019/start.aspx>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-austria-election/austria-votes-in-snap-parliamentary-poll-conservatives-seen-heading-new-coalition-idUSKBN1WD0PV>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-09-29-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 UCI Road World Championships.

**Archived source account.** Mads Pedersen wins the men's Road race World Championship as the first rider from Denmark ever.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC Sport](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/cycling/49872621>).

### 2019-09-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088528945](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20September%2030&oldid=1088528945>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-09-30-0-1"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Islamist militants launch two attacks against foreign forces in Somalia. A U.S. military base in Baledogle, Lower Shabelle, is stormed by attackers using two car bombs and guns, and an Italian peacekeeping convoy is targeted by additional bombs in Mogadishu. United States and Italian authorities both state no injuries occurred, although the suicide bombing against the Italian convoy destroyed a military vehicle and heavily damaged nearby buildings. Al-Shabaab claims responsibility for both attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [Newsweek](<https://www.newsweek.com/jihadists-storm-us-air-base-bomb-military-convoy-1462056>).

<a id="event-2019-09-30-0-3"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War, Yemeni peace process.

**Archived source account.** The International Committee of the Red Cross says that the Houthis have unilaterally released 290 prisoners. The move is part of a peace agreement brokered in Stockholm by the United Nations in December. The Houthis call on their opponents to take a comparable step.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-49880517>).

<a id="event-2019-09-30-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Swedish Navy formally relocates its headquarters back to the underground Muskö naval base on the island of Muskö after a 25-year absence. The move from Karlskrona naval base to Muskö is based on the calculation that only Muskö could withstand a Russian attack, according to the Swedish Defence Research Agency.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/sep/30/swedish-navy-returns-to-vast-underground-hq-amid-russia-fears>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-09-30-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The American clothing retailer Forever 21 files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy and announces it will close up to 178 stores.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/09/30/765699885/nothing-lasts-forever-21-discovers-another-clothing-chain-files-for-bankruptcy>).

<a id="event-2019-09-30-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** French airline XL Airways grounds all flights amid financial difficulties ahead of a bankruptcy hearing scheduled for Wednesday.

Source citations (as archived): [The Local](<https://www.thelocal.fr/20190930/second-french-airline-faces-collapse-as-all-flights-grounded>).

<a id="event-2019-09-30-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Slovenian airline Adria Airways cancels all flights and files for bankruptcy.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/us-slovenia-adria/slovenias-adria-airways-files-for-bankruptcy-idUKKBN1WF1OL>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-09-30-2-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Vanuatu, 2019 Papua protests.

**Archived source account.** At the United Nations, the Prime Minister of Vanuatu, Charlot Salwai, calls for "action on West Papua". He was rebuffed by Indonesian diplomats.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/399952/vanuatu-pm-calls-for-un-action-on-west-papua>).

<a id="event-2019-09-30-2-3"></a>

Context: Iraq–Syria relations.

**Archived source account.** The main border crossing between Al-Qa'im, Iraq, and Albukamal, Syria, reopens.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/Middle-East/2019/Sep-30/492562-iraq-syria-reopen-major-border-crossing-retaken-from-daesh.ashx>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-09-30-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eight alleged members of a far right terror cell go on trial in Germany. The defendants, from Chemnitz, are accused of plotting attacks against immigrants and "the economic establishment". The city saw far-right protests last year following the stabbing homicide of a German man.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-49877578>).

<a id="event-2019-09-30-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Moroccan journalist Hajar Raissouni and her husband Rifaat al-Amin are each jailed for a year by a Rabat court for premarital sex and unlawful abortion, with doctor Mohammed Jamal Belkeziz receiving two years for carrying an abortion out. Her lawyer claims the evidence was fabricated to dissuade Raissouni and others from criticising the government. Observers including Amnesty International criticise the verdicts.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/sep/30/moroccan-journalist-hajar-raissouni-jailed-abortion>).

<a id="event-2019-09-30-3-3"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Riots erupt following a fire yesterday which killed an Afghan woman at an overcrowded refugee camp on the Greek island of Lesbos. The camp in Moria houses 13,000 in tents and shipping containers but has facilities for only 3,000 residents. The Greek government declares it will step up transfers to the mainland in response.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/sep/30/riots-at-greek-refugee-camp-on-lesbos-after-fatal-fire>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-09-30-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Peruvian constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** President of Peru Martín Vizcarra dissolves the Congress and calls for snap elections. Lawmakers reject the proposal, suspend him from office and name Vice President Mercedes Aráoz as acting president. The Peruvian Armed Forces continued to recognize Vizcarra as President of Peru and head of the armed forces. Popular protests backing the President takes place in the streets of Lima.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-49888117>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/01/perus-president-dissolves-congress-to-push-through-anti-corruption-reforms>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/09/30/world/americas/peru-vizcarra-congress.html>).

<a id="event-2019-09-30-4-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Peruvian constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Vicente Zeballos is named new Prime Minister, replacing Salvador del Solar.

Source citations (as archived): [Andina](<https://andina.pe/ingles/noticia-vicente-zeballos-sworn-in-as-new-prime-minister-of-peru-768287.aspx>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-09-30-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Scientists say the largest iceberg in 50 years has broken away from Antarctica's Amery Ice Shelf. The 1,636 sq km iceberg, known as D28, will continue to be monitored as it could pose a risk to shipping.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-49885450>).

<a id="event-2019-09-30-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A near-record snowstorm drops large amounts of snow in some parts of Alberta, from September 27-30. 95 cm fell in Waterton, 50-60 cm fell in Lethbridge, and over 27-32 cm fell in Calgary. Impacts were relatively mild, with power outages, and businesses closing.

Source citations (as archived): [The Globe and Mail](<https://www.theglobeandmail.com/canada/alberta/article-southern-alberta-blanketed-with-snow-after-three-day-storm-shuts-down/>).


## October

### 2019-10-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1358599322](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20October%201&oldid=1358599322>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-10-01-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Donbass, Minsk Protocol.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine agrees to the "Steinmeier formula", aimed at granting a special self-governing status to the Donbass and organising OSCE-validated elections according to Ukrainian law.

Source citations (as archived): [Kyiv Post](<https://www.kyivpost.com/ukraine-politics/ukraine-agrees-to-steinmeier-formula-green-lights-elections-in-occupied-donbas.html>); [TASS](<https://tass.com/world/1080822>).

<a id="event-2019-10-01-0-3"></a>

Context: 2015–19 Iraqi protests, New Arab Spring.

**Archived source account.** At least two people are killed and 200 are injured at protests against unemployment and government corruption in Iraq. Protestors also try to enter the fortified Green Zone in Baghdad.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-protests/iraqi-police-open-fire-use-tear-gas-and-water-cannon-to-disperse-baghdad-protests-idUSKBN1WG44U>).

<a id="event-2019-10-01-0-5"></a>

Context: Northern Mali conflict.

**Archived source account.** Mali's government says jihadist militant attacks on military (FAMA) posts in Mondoro and Boulkessi, in the central Mopti Region, killed 41 troops and left 60 others missing, possibly captured, while also inflicting heavy equipment losses.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mali-security/mali-says-25-soldiers-killed-in-attacks-by-suspected-jihadists-idUSKBN1WG4U4>); [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/mali-dozens-killed-and-missing-in-attack-on-army-camps/a-50670119>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-10-12/worst-jihadist-attack-in-years-stokes-anger-over-mali-s-response>).

<a id="event-2019-10-01-0-7"></a>

Context: 2019–2020 Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** An 18-year-old protestor is shot in the chest by police and taken to hospital for surgery during clashes between pro-democracy protesters and the police in Hong Kong on National Day of the People's Republic of China. Video footage shows the police officer shooting the protester as the protester tries to hit his arm with a metal pipe. This is the first reported injury from a live round.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-49891403>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-10-01-1-1"></a>

Context: 70th anniversary of the People's Republic of China.

**Archived source account.** China celebrates its National Day with parades across the country, including a large military parade in the capital Beijing.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/asia/live-news/china-hong-kong-oct-1-live-intl-hnk/index.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-10-01-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Belfast shipyard Harland and Wolff owner Dolphin Drilling announces it has found a buyer for the shipyard, infrastructure-based InfraStrata, saving it from closure.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-harlandandwolff-m-a-infrastrata/belfasts-harland-and-wolff-shipyard-saved-in-6-million-pound-infrastrata-deal-idUSKBN1WG31O>).

<a id="event-2019-10-01-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** United Parcel Service announces that it has been designated as the first official, commercial, drone airline service by the Federal Aviation Administration.

Source citations (as archived): [Wired](<https://www.wired.com/story/ups-drone-airline-faa-certification-delivery/?itm_campaign=TechinTwo>).

<a id="event-2019-10-01-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** In leaked audio from a meeting with employees in July, Facebook CEO Mark Zuckerberg threatens to sue Senator Elizabeth Warren, who is running in the 2020 U.S. presidential election, if she is elected president and tries to "break up" large tech companies.

Source citations (as archived): [The Verge](<https://www.theverge.com/2019/10/1/20756701/mark-zuckerberg-facebook-leak-audio-ftc-antitrust-elizabeth-warren-tiktok-comments>).

<a id="event-2019-10-01-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Kristalina Georgieva succeeds Christine Lagarde as the Managing Director of the International Monetary Fund.

Source citations (as archived): [The Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/imfs-new-chief-vows-to-fix-the-roof-before-the-storm-hits-11570096800>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-10-01-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Nanfang'ao Bridge, the only steel single-arch bridge in Taiwan, collapses on fishing boats in Su'ao. Ten people are injured and six are believed to have been trapped.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-taiwan-bridge/taiwan-bridge-collapse-crushes-fishing-boats-six-crew-feared-trapped-idUSKBN1WG2P3>).

<a id="event-2019-10-01-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Severe flooding affects Laxey, Isle of Man, with some residents evacuated from their homes.

Source citations (as archived): [Isle of Man Government](<http://www.isleofman.com/news/video/87780/floods-old-laxey>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-10-01-4-1"></a>

Context: Climate change mitigation.

**Archived source account.** Dutch farmers stage a protest in The Hague against proposals to halve livestock numbers in a bid to cut nitrogen emissions. Motoring group ANWB claims tractors on highways caused a total of 1,136km (700 miles) of traffic jams during morning rush hour, with tractors on one highway swerving back and forth to prevent traffic passing.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-49891449>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-10-01-5-1"></a>

Context: North Korea–United States relations, North Korean missile tests, Japan–North Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** North Korea says it will resume working-level nuclear talks with the United States, reviving a denuclearization process that has remained stalled since a February summit in Vietnam ended without a deal.

Source citations (as archived): [The Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/u-s-and-north-korea-to-resume-nuclear-talks-pyongyang-says-11569927143?fbclid=IwAR2RG7m2WrWVARmUxIDfNMPD1yUpO-WVew_Pfz7HIiBwhidd0jnARsA-EBA>).

<a id="event-2019-10-01-5-2"></a>

Context: North Korea–United States relations, North Korean missile tests, Japan–North Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** North Korea fires a missile which lands in the exclusive economic zone of Japan, according to Japanese Chief Cabinet Secretary Yoshihide Suga.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-missiles-japan-suga/one-north-korea-missile-fell-into-japans-eez-japan-government-idUSKBN1WG4ZP>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-10-01-6-1"></a>

Context: Kuopio school stabbing.

**Archived source account.** A woman is killed and ten other people injured when a student attacks a teacher and students with a sword at a vocational school inside a shopping mall in Kuopio, Northern Savonia, Finland. Police disarm and arrest the suspect, who is one of the injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Evening Standard](<https://www.standard.co.uk/news/world/finland-shooting-one-dead-and-nine-injured-at-school-in-kuopio-shopping-centre-a4251016.html>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/01/europe/violent-incident-finland-dead-intl/index.html>); [NewsNow](<https://newsnowfinland.fi/crime/developing-1-dead-10-injured-in-kuopio-college-sword-attack>).

<a id="event-2019-10-01-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A jury finds Amber Guyger, a former Dallas police officer, guilty of murder. Guyger was indicted last year after fatally shooting her unarmed neighbor, Botham Jean, in his own apartment, which she claims to have mistaken for her own.

Source citations (as archived): [The Sacramento Bee](<https://amp.sacbee.com/news/nation-world/national/article235659352.html?fbclid=IwAR0NmUNEbg68IBJU_aY5rPIvbueaRJpDmlWtmCGP16IRR1_THj803gFnbvI>).

<a id="event-2019-10-01-6-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A U.S. district judge in Boston, Massachusetts, upholds Harvard University's admissions process following a challenge from a group of Asian American applicants who believe the school discriminated against them.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/01/politics/harvard-affirmative-action/index.html?utm_source=CNN-News-Alerts&amp;utm_medium=email&amp;utm_campaign=Federal+judge+upholds+Harvard>).

<a id="event-2019-10-01-6-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the United Kingdom, Prince Harry and Meghan Markle announce they are suing The Mail on Sunday, as well as its parent company DMG Media, claiming the publisher's newspapers have been publishing "false and deliberately derogatory stories" about their lives.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News](<https://www.yahoo.com/lifestyle/meghan-markle-prince-harry-legal-action-mail-on-sunday-dad-letter-193755627.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-01-6-6"></a>

Context: Opioid epidemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Johnson &amp; Johnson announces it has reached a $20.4 million settlement with two Ohio counties over its role in the opioid epidemic in the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/investigations/johnson-and-johnson-reaches-tentative-204-million-settlement-in-massive-opioid-case/2019/10/01/6a8a9670-e48e-11e9-b403-f738899982d2_story.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-01-6-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Aida Merlano, a former Congresswoman who is serving a fifteen-year sentence for buying votes and for firearms offences, escapes from prison in Bogotá, Colombia.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/colombia-politician-prison-break-rope-motorbike-dentist-aida-merlano-bogota-a9136916.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-01-6-9"></a>

Context: 2019 Trump–Ukraine scandal.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump's personal lawyer Rudy Giuliani hires Watergate scandal prosecutor Jon Sale to represent him in the impeachment inquiry investigating the president.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2019/10/01/trump-lawyer-rudy-giuliani-hires-attorney-jon-sale-to-represent-him.html?fbclid=IwAR037r76qHk_OcD1gdm-UAJABKkhGTE3pj1MFCb8JrKZtv08nIdsIfMQTLM>).

<a id="event-2019-10-01-6-10"></a>

Context: 2019 Trump–Ukraine scandal.

**Archived source account.** Steve Linick, the inspector general of the U.S. State Department, requests an "urgent" briefing with senior congressional staff members regarding Ukraine. The private meeting will be held tomorrow.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/01/politics/deposition-delayed-impeachment-investigation/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-01-6-12"></a>

Context: Immigration policy of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The New York Times reports that U.S. President Donald Trump suggested shooting migrants in the legs in order to slow them down after they crossed the Mexico–United States border during a meeting in March. He also reportedly suggested digging a moat to fortify a border wall and filling it with "snakes or alligators", and wanted the wall "electrified, with spikes on top that could pierce human flesh".

Source citations (as archived): [Business Insider](<https://www.businessinsider.com/trump-suggested-shooting-migrants-in-legs-border-moat-2019-10?fbclid=IwAR0ppcLU0wSHa9UpSmq_7_REJyE-RfU1_QJLbNyA4VdWd7dyZsyURfefSBs>).

<a id="event-2019-10-01-6-14"></a>

Context: Tax returns of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** A U.S. federal judge in California blocks a state law requiring presidential candidates to disclose income tax returns before their names can appear on the state's primary ballot. The ruling is considered a win for President Donald Trump, who has resisted releasing his tax returns.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/01/politics/california-law-trump-tax-returns-blocked/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-10-01-7-1"></a>

Context: Impeachment inquiry into Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo accuses House Democrats of attempting to "intimidate" and "bully" five State Department officials whom key congressional committees have asked to interview as part of an impeachment inquiry into President Donald Trump. The House Democrats in turn issue a warning to Pompeo to stop "intimidating" witnesses, telling Pompeo that it "is illegal and will constitute evidence of obstruction of the impeachment inquiry" into President Trump.,

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/pompeo-accuses-house-democrats-intimidate-bully-state-department/story>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/01/politics/pompeo-accuses-democrats-intimidation/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-01-7-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Peruvian constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Vice President of Peru Mercedes Aráoz, who was named by the Congress as the acting president, resigns from both offices to facilitate the snap general election.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-49901872>).

<a id="event-2019-10-01-7-5"></a>

Context: Donald Trump 2020 presidential campaign.

**Archived source account.** The Republican National Committee and the 2020 U.S. presidential election campaign to reelect President Donald Trump raised $125 million between July and September, setting a new presidential fundraising record, the Associated Press reports.

Source citations (as archived): [Axios](<https://www.axios.com/trumps-reelection-effort-raised-125-million-d65fbdbb-6e0d-43ca-a7ba-bc04792c992e.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-01-7-7"></a>

Context: Politics of San Marino.

**Archived source account.** Luca Boschi and Mariella Mularoni begins the term as Captain Regents.

Source citations (as archived): [San Marino TV](<https://sanmarinortv.sm/news/politica-c2/san-marino-saluta-i-nuovi-capitani-reggenti-per-il-semestre-10-ottobre-2019-10-aprile-2020-a177695>).

### 2019-10-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1284625421](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20October%202&oldid=1284625421>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-10-02-0-1"></a>

Context: 2018–19 Arab protests.

**Archived source account.** At least five people are killed in a second day of spontaneous protests against unemployment, government corruption and lack of basic services in Iraq. Police say they have "lost control" of the city of Nassiriya after exchanging gunfire with protesters. Curfews are imposed on the Iraqi cities of Baghdad, Nassiriya, Amarah and Hillah.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.apnews.com/90e9ce3ac90a4a7294eb233da7fd6b1d>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-protests/gunfights-rage-in-southern-iraq-protests-spread-nationwide-idUSKBN1WH0YF>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-10-02-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The World Trade Organization authorizes the United States to impose about US$7.5 billion in tariffs on goods from the European Union every year. The WTO started the probe in 2005 after the United States complained that European subsidies to Airbus damage Boeing airplane sales.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/10/02/766404561/wto-says-u-s-can-hit-eu-with-7-5-billion-in-tariffs-over-airbus-subsidies>).

<a id="event-2019-10-02-1-1"></a>

Context: The World Trade Organization authorizes the United States to impose about US$7.5 billion in tariffs on goods from the European Union every year. The WTO started the probe in 2005 after the United States complained that European subsidies to Airbus damage Boeing airplane sales..

**Archived source account.** The United States announces a tariff of 10% on European-made Airbus planes and 25% on a range of goods, set to take effect on 18 October.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-wto-aircraft/u-s-widens-trade-war-with-tariffs-on-european-planes-cheese-whisky-to-punish-subsidies-idUSKBN1WH0SI>).

<a id="event-2019-10-02-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** American retailer Bed Bath &amp; Beyond announces it will close 60 stores by the end of the year due to declining profits.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/money/2019/10/02/bed-bath-beyond-closing-60-stores-coming-months/3847126002/>).

<a id="event-2019-10-02-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A foreign exchange trader, Rohan Ramchandani, has filed a lawsuit against Citigroup. Ramchandani won acquittal last year after criminal charges of market manipulation. He claims that the charges were instigated by his former employer in order to mitigate the regulatory consequences for its own misbehavior.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-citigroup-forex-ramchandani/london-forex-trader-sues-citigroup-over-malicious-forex-prosecution-idUSKBN1WH1Y2>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-10-02-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Following yesterday's collapse of Nanfang'ao Bridge in Su'ao, Taiwan, onto fishing boats, rescuers recover four bodies. Three are identified as foreign fishermen, with a fourth corpse unidentified. Two people remain missing.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/death-toll-rises-in-taiwan-bridge-collapse/a-50652949>).

<a id="event-2019-10-02-2-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Boeing B-17 Flying Fortress crash.

**Archived source account.** A World War II-era B-17 crashes near Bradley International Airport in the U.S. state of Connecticut, killing at least seven of the 13 people on board.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/vintage-b-17-plane-crashes-erupts-flames-bradley-international-airport-n1061161>).

<a id="event-2019-10-02-2-4"></a>

Context: Schoharie limousine crash.

**Archived source account.** The National Transportation Safety Board of the United States, as part of its investigation, issues a series of recommendations to the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration asking it to mandate improved seatbelt and construction standard for stretch limousines.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-limos-safety/u-s-agency-should-require-limo-safety-standards-after-deadly-crash-ntsb-idUSKBN1WH1ZI>).

<a id="event-2019-10-02-2-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 14 people are killed after an illegal gold mine collapses in the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Maniema province. Search efforts are underway for others who could be trapped.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-49912811>).

<a id="event-2019-10-02-2-7"></a>

Context: Star City fire.

**Archived source account.** A fire razed Star City, an amusement park in Pasay, Philippines in a suspected arson attack early morning.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News UK](<https://uk.news.yahoo.com/fire-destroys-theme-park-philippines-020000317.html?guccounter=1&amp;guce_referrer=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZ29vZ2xlLmNvbS8&amp;guce_referrer_sig=AQAAAIyKONHM6DJEuI5AbMIXnewjq2NB5OfNqC8M_IpPUk70zBftcKpINjrIYacgoJHzovc9TapRtxEG9zyMSsMcR1gmf2oW27k-LHaf5Fr2svRnxmVanam28O9QzO60sU7XvW7092lZf4vbmZSnmm5Dwt92ZrRKlcWLTOr4d_lIOyzQ>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-10-02-3-1"></a>

Context: Japan–North Korea relations, North Korean missile tests.

**Archived source account.** Japanese Prime Minister Shinzō Abe condemns in the strongest terms the latest North Korean missile tests and says they clearly violate United Nations Security Council resolutions.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-49902182>).

<a id="event-2019-10-02-3-2"></a>

Context: Japan–North Korea relations, North Korean missile tests.

**Archived source account.** North Korean state media says the country has successfully tested a new type of submarine-launched ballistic missile (SLBM) off the coast of Wonsan.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/north-korea-fires-submarine-launched-missile-state-media/a-50685521>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-missiles/north-korea-says-successfully-tested-new-submarine-launched-ballistic-missile-kcna-idUSKBN1WH2GS>).

<a id="event-2019-10-02-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo speaks out about China's religious freedom violations during a visit to the Vatican.

Source citations (as archived): [Catholic News Agency](<https://www.catholicnewsagency.com/news/at-vatican-secretary-mike-pompeo-highlights-chinese-religious-freedom-violations-62073>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-10-02-4-1"></a>

Context: Corruption in Israel.

**Archived source account.** Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu faces a pretrial hearing regarding the charges against him in Case 4000, one of the three corruption cases in which the Israeli Attorney General Avichai Mandelblit decided to indict him, pending a hearing.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/02/israel-pm-benjamin-netanyahu-faces-pre-trial-corruption-hearing>).

<a id="event-2019-10-02-4-3"></a>

Context: Internet censorship in Singapore.

**Archived source account.** The Protection from Online Falsehoods and Manipulation Act (POFMA), a law giving the Singaporean government more powers to stop the spread of designated falsehoods and fake news, goes into effect. Rights groups like Human Rights Watch and journalists worry the law could be used to stifle dissent and free expression.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/10/02/766399689/fake-news-law-goes-into-effect-in-singapore-worrying-free-speech-advocates>).

<a id="event-2019-10-02-4-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Trump–Ukraine scandal, Impeachment inquiry into Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** A whistleblower who filed a complaint against U.S. President Donald Trump over a phone conversation with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky sought guidance from the House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence prior to the filing, Representative Adam Schiff's office says, but denies seeing the complaint in advance.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/10/02/politics/whistleblower-intelligence-committee-complaint/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-02-4-7"></a>

Context: Immigration policy of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The Donald Trump administration says it is preparing to broadly expand DNA collection from migrants in U.S. detention.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/trump-admin-broadly-expand-dna-collection-migrants-custody-n1061471>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-10-02-5-1"></a>

Context: 2020 United States presidential election, Bernie Sanders 2020 presidential campaign.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Senator Bernie Sanders suspends campaigning for the 2020 U.S. presidential election "until further notice" after the discovery of artery blockage during a medical evaluation for chest discomfort results in surgery.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/02/politics/bernie-sanders-artery-blockage-2020/index.html>).

### 2019-10-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1284625493](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20October%203&oldid=1284625493>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-10-03-0-1"></a>

Context: Paris police headquarters stabbing.

**Archived source account.** A man stabs five people at the central police headquarters in the French capital of Paris, killing three officers and an administrative worker. The attacker, who was shot dead by other officers, was an admin worker at the station.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/49921145>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-10-03-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Marine Accident Investigation Branch of the UK Department for Transport issues a report on the grounding of cargo vessel MV Priscilla on the Pentland Skerries off the coast of Shetland, Scotland. The investigation concludes the lone crewmember on the bridge was distracted by watching music videos during the nighttime accident. The grounding triggered changes in procedures by the Maritime and Coastguard Agency.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-highlands-islands-49911746>).

<a id="event-2019-10-03-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed and three others injured in a plane crash at Capital Region International Airport in Lansing, Michigan.

Source citations (as archived): [WNEM-TV](<https://www.wnem.com/news/dead-injured-from-small-plane-crash-at-capital-region-airport/article_da2f87ca-e5e1-11e9-8442-7bef85ce3a72.html>); [WLNS-TV](<https://www.wlns.com/news/local-news/breaking-small-plane-crashes-at-capital-region-airport/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-10-03-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 United States outbreak of lung illness linked to vaping products.

**Archived source account.** The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention announces that the number of deaths caused by vaping-associated pulmonary injury ("vaping illness") linked to electronic cigarettes has risen to 18, with an additional 1,080 injuries reported. The CDC says the cause is still under investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2019/10/03/mayo-clinic-vaping-study-chemical-fumes-blame-lung-illnesses/3850859002/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-10-03-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A shooting in Vancouver, Washington, United States leaves at least one dead, and several more injured.
