Source citations (as archived): [The Columbian](<https://www.columbian.com/news/2019/oct/03/shots-fired-at-smith-tower-in-vancouver/>).

<a id="event-2019-10-03-3-2"></a>

Context: Foreign interference in the 2020 United States elections.

**Archived source account.** Amid an impeachment inquiry against him, U.S. President Donald Trump says "China should start an investigation" into presidential candidate Joe Biden. Chair of the Federal Election Commission Ellen Weintraub again explains that "it is illegal for any person to solicit, accept, or receive anything of value from a foreign national in connection with a U.S. election".

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2020-election/trump-publicly-urges-china-ukraine-investigate-bidens-amid-impeachment-inquiry-n1061956>).

<a id="event-2019-10-03-3-4"></a>

Context: 2019 Trump–Ukraine scandal.

**Archived source account.** Sources for The New York Times allege that two American diplomats presented a statement for Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky to sign wherein Ukraine would commit to investigate Joe Biden and his son Hunter Biden.

Source citations (as archived): [ANP](<https://www.hln.be/nieuws/buitenland/nyt-vs-wilden-oekraine-onderzoek-naar-biden-opdringen~a936917d/>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/10/03/us/politics/trump-ukraine.html>).

### 2019-10-04

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088533886](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20October%204&oldid=1088533886>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-10-04-0-1"></a>

Context: 2018–19 Arab protests.

**Archived source account.** On the third day of protests in Iraq, the death toll reaches 100. The government imposes near-total internet blackout.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-49946325>).

<a id="event-2019-10-04-0-2"></a>

Context: 2018–19 Arab protests.

**Archived source account.** The Iraqi military says "unidentified snipers" have shot four people dead on the streets of Baghdad amid protests, including two police officers, with dozens of others wounded by sniper fire. Reuters reporters witness at least one protester being shot in the head by a sniper, killing him.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-protests/death-toll-surges-to-46-as-iraq-unrest-accelerates-cleric-blames-politicians-idUSKBN1WJ0NW>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-49937451>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-10-04-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Antonov An-12 cargo plane operated by Ukraine Air Alliance runs out of fuel and crashes as it approaches Lviv International Airport in Ukraine. Five of the seven occupants are killed, and the airport closes.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-49931753>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-10-04-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** Hong Kong Chief Executive Carrie Lam invokes the colonial-era Emergency Regulations Ordinance and bans the use of face masks in public gatherings.

Source citations (as archived): [RTHK Hong Kong English](<https://news.rthk.hk/rthk/en/component/k2/1484217-20191004.htm>).

<a id="event-2019-10-04-2-3"></a>

Context: Crime in Italy.

**Archived source account.** Two police officers are killed and another is wounded after a Dominican suspect opens fire on them at a police station in Trieste, Italy.

Source citations (as archived): [La Repubblica](<https://www.repubblica.it/cronaca/2019/10/04/news/trieste_sparatoria_questura-237691554/>).

<a id="event-2019-10-04-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A woman in Florida is arrested and charged with explosives offences after a police raid on her home finds 24 pipe bombs and bomb-making material and several other weapons. She admits constructing the devices to harm people. Police were notified of the problem by the 27-year-old's parents.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/10/04/us/florida-woman-pipe-bombs/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-04-2-6"></a>

Context: 2019 college admissions bribery scandal.

**Archived source account.** A parent is sentenced to five months in prison, a fine of $100,000 and 500 hours of community service for his involvement in the college admissions scandal.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/10/04/us/college-admissions-scam-agustin-huneeus/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-04-2-8"></a>

Context: Hwaseong serial murders.

**Archived source account.** Police in South Korea receive confessions from convicted murderer Lee Chun-jae to the serial rapes and murders, which occurred between 1986 and 1991 and left at least nine dead. He denies a tenth murder, now believed to be perpetrated by a copycat. The investigations inspired the movie Memories of Murder and saw 21,000 people investigated. Lee, who is serving life for the 1994 rape and murder of his sister in law, cannot be prosecuted because the statute of limitations has expired. He had been linked to three victims earlier this month by DNA.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/10/04/asia/south-korean-serial-murder-confessed-intl-hnk-scli/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-10-04-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Argentine general election.

**Archived source account.** At a conference in Washington, D.C., Sergio Massa, candidate for the Argentine Chamber of Deputies for Frente de Todos, the coalition of candidate Alberto Fernández, says Fernández's position on Venezuela is clear and that keeping silent about the situation in Venezuela is to "become an accomplice of the government \[of Maduro\]". He also is the first member of Fernández's party to describe Venezuela as a "dictatorship".

Source citations (as archived): [Infobae in Spanish](<https://www.infobae.com/politica/2019/10/04/sergio-massa-en-washington-negar-lo-que-sucede-en-venezuela-es-ser-complice/>).

<a id="event-2019-10-04-3-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Ecuadorian protests.

**Archived source account.** Ecuadorian President Lenín Moreno declares a state of emergency amid nationwide protests against a hike in fuel prices. The protests have crippled the country's transport network with all major roads and bridges blocked in the capital Quito.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-49929272>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-10-04-4-1"></a>

Context: Foreign interference in the 2020 United States elections, Cyberwarfare and Iran.

**Archived source account.** Microsoft says a network of hackers linked to the Iranian government has attempted to access the email accounts of people associated with a 2020 presidential election campaign, as well as prominent Iranian expatriates in the United States. Microsoft has not named the specific campaign which was targeted by Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/tech/security/iran-linked-hackers-tried-compromise-presidential-campaign-microsoft-says-n1062541>).

### 2019-10-05

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-turkey-usa-idUSKCN1WK053>); [Daily Sabah](<https://www.dailysabah.com/war-on-terror/2019/10/05/turkey-ready-for-operation-east-of-euphrates-in-syria-erdogan-says>).

<a id="event-2019-10-05-0-3"></a>

Context: Paris police headquarters stabbing.

**Archived source account.** Counter-terror investigators confirm the man who killed four people at Paris police headquarters two days ago was a convert who adhered to Islamist extremism and had contact with Salafists.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-49945640>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-10-05-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Totnes bus crash.

**Archived source account.** A major incident has been declared in Devon, England, after a double-decker bus overturned near the town of Totnes while operating a busy passenger service between the English Riviera coast and the city of Plymouth.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-devon-49944705>).

<a id="event-2019-10-05-1-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Totnes bus crash.

**Archived source account.** More than fifty people, including the bus driver, have been injured; eight people have serious injuries. Local hospitals have been overwhelmed with patients attending from the bus crash and forced to close to non-emergency care.

Source citations (as archived): [ITV](<https://www.itv.com/news/westcountry/2019-10-05/up-to-eight-people-seriously-injured-after-double-decker-overturns-in-devon-road>).

<a id="event-2019-10-05-1-4"></a>

Context: Ukraine–European Union relations.

**Archived source account.** The European Aviation Safety Agency revokes its authorisation of Ukraine Air Alliance, effectively banning the airline from all airspace in the European Union. The move results from yesterday's crash of an Antonov An-12 owned by the airline, after it ran out of fuel near Lviv, Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [The Aviation Herald](<http://avherald.com/h?article=4cd99477&amp;opt=0>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-10-05-2-1"></a>

Context: Russia–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** Russian Deputy Prime Minister Yuri Borisov visits ally Venezuela, reiterating Russia's support of disputed president Nicolás Maduro and announcing new trade deals with the economically crippled country.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-venezuela/russian-deputy-prime-minister-in-venezuela-to-support-maduro-idUSKCN1WK0CF>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-10-05-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Lower Manhattan, New York City, four homeless men are beaten to death and a fifth severely injured while sleeping. A 24-year-old man, also believed homeless, is in custody.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/10/05/us/new-york-homeless-men-killed/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-05-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** After acquitting five Muslim men of murder, Thai judge Kanakorn Pianchana gives a speech complaining of corrupt pressure upon the judiciary, including in this case, to convict without sufficient evidence. He then shoots himself in the chest in court in Yala, but survives. Criticism from judges of the Thai legal system is rare, but rights groups claim Muslims often face trumped-up charges in the region, which is Muslim-majority and suffers from insurgency.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-49945636>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-10-05-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Emirati parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** A pool of citizens of the United Arab Emirates heads to the polls in the country's fourth parliamentary election.

Source citations (as archived): [Gulf News](<https://gulfnews.com/uae/government/emiratis-head-to-the-polls-in-fnc-elections-1.66903098>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-10-05-5-1"></a>

Context: 2019 World Artistic Gymnastics Championships.

**Archived source account.** In the floor exercise, Simone Biles lands a triple-twisting double backflip in a tucked position. The new skill will be named "Biles 2", the third element named after her, and will have an FIG difficulty value of J.

Source citations (as archived): [PopSugar](<https://www.yahoo.com/lifestyle/simone-biles-starts-off-worlds-185211838.html>).

### 2019-10-06

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1210073471](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20October%206&oldid=1210073471>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-10-06-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Kurdish–Turkish conflict (2015–present), Northern Syria Buffer Zone.

**Archived source account.** Following a phone call between U.S. President Donald Trump and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, the White House says that Turkish Armed Forces will launch an incursion into Syrian Democratic Forces-held northern Syria, and that United States Armed Forces will be withdrawing from the region to avoid clashing with its NATO ally.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/07/us-to-let-turkish-forces-move-into-syria-abandoning-kurdish-allies>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-10-06-1-1"></a>

Context: List of mass shootings in the United States in 2019.

**Archived source account.** Police in Kansas City, Kansas, are seeking two unnamed suspects after two men opened fire at a bar, killing four people and wounding another five.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-49951720>).

<a id="event-2019-10-06-1-3"></a>

Context: Crime in Austria.

**Archived source account.** An Austrian man kills five people in the town of Kitzbühel, Tyrol: his ex-girlfriend, her brother and parents, as well as her new boyfriend. He gives himself up at the police station.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-austria-crime/five-murdered-in-austrian-ski-town-of-kitzbuehel-police-idUSKCN1WL07L>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-10-06-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Jordanian government announces it has struck a deal with the teachers' union to end a month-long strike that affected at least 1.5 million students. The strike was instigated over pay in light of new austerity measures.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-jordan-strike-teachers/jordan-reaches-deal-with-teachers-union-to-end-one-month-strike-idUSKCN1WK0KQ?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-10-06-2-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Kosovan parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** Following the resignation of Prime Minister Ramush Haradinaj in July, voters in Kosovo cast their ballots to elect the new members of the Assembly of the Republic of Kosovo. Opposition party, Vetëvendosje, led by Albin Kurti wins in an unprecedented victory.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/kosovo-votes-for-parliament-amid-calls-for-talks-with-serbia/a-50713649>).

<a id="event-2019-10-06-2-4"></a>

Context: 2019 Portuguese legislative election.

**Archived source account.** Portuguese voters head to the polls to elect a new session to the Assembly of the Republic. In line with opinion polls, exit polls show the incumbent Socialist Party winning the most seats, but likely not quite enough to form a majority.

Source citations (as archived): [euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/2019/10/05/portugal-elections-who-are-the-main-parties>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-portugal-election-socialist/portugals-socialists-claim-election-victory-idUSKBN1WL0I6>).

<a id="event-2019-10-06-2-6"></a>

Context: 2019 Tunisian parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** Tunisian citizens gather to vote in the country's latest parliamentary election.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/tunisia-election-a-chance-for-political-newcomers/a-50711837>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-10-06-3-1"></a>

Context: Fermi bubbles.

**Archived source account.** Scientists say that, using data from the Hubble Space Telescope, they have found evidence of a 300,000-year-long burst of radiation originating 3.5 million years ago from or near the center of our galaxy, erupting through both galactic poles, with effects on the Magellanic Stream, 200,000 light-years away.

Source citations (as archived): [EarthSky](<https://earthsky.org/space/explosion-milky-way-center-seyfert-flare-magellanic-stream>).

### 2019-10-07

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1263824788](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20October%207&oldid=1263824788>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-10-07-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 32-year-old Syrian man rams a stolen truck into eight cars in Limburg an der Lahn, Hesse, causing eight injuries. German police believe it was intentional, but the motive is yet to be determined.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/08/eight-hurt-as-stolen-truck-crashes-into-cars-in-germany>).

<a id="event-2019-10-07-0-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Jalalabad suicide bombing.

**Archived source account.** A bomb on a rickshaw detonates as a minibus carrying new army recruits passes in Jalalabad, Nangarhar Province, Afghanistan. A military spokesperson says ten, including a child, were killed and a further 27 wounded.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/afghan-official-says-bomb-kills-at-least-10-in-eastern-city/2019/10/07/7d54ccb0-e904-11e9-a329-7378fbfa1b63_story.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-07-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Kurdish–Turkish conflict (2015–present), International military intervention against ISIL, Northern Syria Buffer Zone.

**Archived source account.** U.S. forces begin to withdraw from northern Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Foreign Policy](<https://foreignpolicy.com/2019/10/07/erdogan-defying-pentagon-trump-endorses-turkish-operation-in-syria/>).

<a id="event-2019-10-07-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Kurdish–Turkish conflict (2015–present), International military intervention against ISIL, Northern Syria Buffer Zone.

**Archived source account.** The Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces calls the U.S. withdrawal a "stab in the back".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-49956698>).

<a id="event-2019-10-07-0-6"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Kurdish–Turkish conflict (2015–present), International military intervention against ISIL, Northern Syria Buffer Zone.

**Archived source account.** A U.S. Department of Defense spokesperson says Turkey has been pulled off the Combined Air Operations Centre's air tasking order and that the U.S. has halted sharing aerial surveillance information with Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [Middle East Monitor](<https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20191008-us-cuts-turkeys-access-to-north-east-syria-airspace-ahead-of-military-campaign/>); [Military Times](<https://www.militarytimes.com/flashpoints/2019/10/07/how-the-us-troop-withdrawal-from-northern-syria-could-create-an-isis-resurgence/>).

<a id="event-2019-10-07-0-7"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Kurdish–Turkish conflict (2015–present), International military intervention against ISIL, Northern Syria Buffer Zone.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Senator Lindsey Graham strongly criticizes President Trump's decision, describing the event as "a big win for Iran and Assad \[and\] a big win for ISIL". Former American envoy Brett McGurk mentions the 60,000 SDF-held ISIL detainees, saying that the State Department and inspectors general at the Department of Defense warn they are the "nucleus for a resurgent ISIL".

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/07/us-to-let-turkish-forces-move-into-syria-abandoning-kurdish-allies>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-10-07-1-1"></a>

Context: Censorship in China.

**Archived source account.** China bans American animated sitcom South Park in response to the episode "Band in China" which parodied censorship in China and Chinese influence on Hollywood.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Post](<https://nypost.com/2019/10/07/south-park-banned-from-chinese-internet-after-band-in-china-episode/>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/10/07/us/south-park-apology-chinese-internet-trnd/index.html>); [Global News](<https://globalnews.ca/news/6001579/south-park-banned-in-china/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-10-07-2-1"></a>

Context: Economic effects of Brexit.

**Archived source account.** Holger Bingmann, head of the Federation of German Wholesale, Foreign Trade and Services, tells journalists German businesses have lost €3.5 billion so far this year due to Brexit.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/german-businesses-already-incurring-brexit-losses-says-industry-boss/a-50725851>).

<a id="event-2019-10-07-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pizza Express, a UK-based chain with 470 restaurants, including 150 overseas, reportedly hires financial advisors ahead of talks with its creditors. The business is £1.1 billion in debt and has made a loss for two consecutive years. It employs around 14,000 people.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-49957551>).

<a id="event-2019-10-07-2-4"></a>

Context: China–United States trade war.

**Archived source account.** Citing human rights issues, the United States Department of Commerce puts 20 Chinese public security bureaus and eight high tech companies, such as HikVision, SenseTime and Megvii, on the Export Administration Regulations entities blacklist. Like Huawei, which was sanctioned on an identical blueprint for national security reasons, the entities will need U.S. government approval before they can purchase components from U.S. companies.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trade-china-exclusive/u-s-expands-blacklist-to-include-chinas-top-ai-startups-ahead-of-trade-talks-idUSKBN1WM25M>); [American Shipper](<https://www.freightwaves.com/news/commerce-adds-28-chinese-firms-to-entity-list>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-10-07-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Ukrainian Ministry of Transport announces it has revoked the air operator's certificate of Ukraine Air Alliance, effective from October 5. The move results from the October 4 crash of an Antonov An-12 owned by the airline, after it ran out of fuel near Lviv, Ukraine. The decision was taken the same day.

Source citations (as archived): [The Aviation Herald](<http://avherald.com/h?article=4cd99477>).

<a id="event-2019-10-07-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A North Korean fishing boat collides with a Japanese Fisheries Agency vessel and sinks off Japan. At least 20 North Koreans are pulled from the water. The Japanese ship had been attempting to warn the North Korean vessel away from Japanese territory.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-10-07/20-north-korean-fishermen-overboard-after-collision-nhk-says>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/10/06/world/asia/japan-north-korea-ship.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-07-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** An overloaded ship carrying migrants capsizes and sinks off the island of Lampedusa, Italy, in rough conditions in the Mediterranean Sea. Search and rescue is underway; of at least 50 on board, 22 survivors have been saved and 13 bodies found. The deceased and missing both include pregnant women. The International Organization for Migration states the boat had departed from Tunisia.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/italy-death-toll-continues-to-rise-after-migrant-ship-sinks-in-mediterranean/a-50720302>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-10-07-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** King Carl XVI Gustaf of Sweden decides that the children of Prince Carl Philip and Princess Sofia, and the children of Princess Madeleine and Christopher O'Neill will no longer be members of the Royal House of Sweden. The purpose of the decision is to establish which members of the Royal House may be expected to perform official duties incumbent on the Head of State or related to the function of the Head of State.

Source citations (as archived): [Swedish Royal Court](<https://www.kungahuset.se/royalcourt/latestnews/latestnews/communiqueonchangestotheroyalhouse.5.18cc416116d61fe304a87a9.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-07-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Lower Manhattan, New York City, a 24-year-old homeless man is charged with murdering four other homeless men and attempting to murder a fifth in random attacks. Authorities identify one of the deceased as an 83-year-old man, but release no further details about the victims.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/new-york-homeless-murder-beaten-death-sleep-manhattan-chinatown-randy-santos-a9145641.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-07-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two protestors who were arrested in Rostov-on-Don in 2017 while holding signs seeking resignations from the Russian government, and have been in custody since, are sentenced to over six years each in high-security prisons. They were charged with planning violent mass disturbances, and said that they confessed during torture.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times](<https://www.thetimes.co.uk/article/anti-putin-protesters-jailed-for-six-years-rbzttnhqv#>).

<a id="event-2019-10-07-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of the United States opens its 2019–2020 nine-month term with eight of its nine justices present. Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg, who underwent a number of medical procedures for cancer throughout the past year, was present, but Justice Clarence Thomas was absent "due to an unspecified illness."

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/us-supreme-court-kicks-off-new-term-with-justice-thomas-absent/ar-AAIp97d?ocid=spartandhp>).

<a id="event-2019-10-07-4-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** The first people are charged with breaking the ban on wearing face masks in Hong Kong. The government of Hong Kong says the prohibition of face masks is needed to end months of violent protests.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/07/hong-kong-protests-charges-anti-face-mask-laws>).

<a id="event-2019-10-07-4-7"></a>

Context: Tax returns of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** A judge rules against U.S. President Donald Trump, ordering him to release eight years of state tax returns to New York officials. The defense makes an immediate appeal to the Second Circuit Court of Appeals, and is granted a temporary stay "pending expedited review."

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-49963910>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-10-07-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine is awarded to Peter J. Ratcliffe, William Kaelin Jr. and Gregg L. Semenza for their discoveries of how cells sense and adapt to oxygen availability.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/10/07/health/nobel-prize-medicine.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-07-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Astronomers announce the discovery of 20 new moons around Saturn, adding to the 62 previously known. The new moons comprise 17 retrograde moons in the Norse group and three prograde moons, two of which belong to the Inuit group.

Source citations (as archived): [Phys.org](<https://phys.org/news/2019-10-saturn-surpasses-kupiter-discovery-moonsand.html>).

### 2019-10-08

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088539764](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20October%208&oldid=1088539764>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-10-08-0-1"></a>

Context: Turkish involvement in the Syrian Civil War, Northern Syria Buffer Zone.

**Archived source account.** Turkish officials say that Turkish Air Force jets have begun bombing the Syrian-Iraqi border on Monday night, ahead of an imminent invasion of northern Syria. That region is controlled by Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces, whom Turkey regards as terrorists.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/policy/international/464841-turkey-confirms-strikes-on-syrian-border-ahead-of-offensive-report>).

<a id="event-2019-10-08-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** A bomb explodes in a classroom at Ghazni University in Afghanistan, wounding at least nineteen students. The same university was targeted last month with a bomb attached to a university minibus. That bomb killed one person and injured five others.

Source citations (as archived): [Gulf News](<https://gulfnews.com/world/asia/afghanistan-bomb-goes-off-inside-classroom-wounds-19-1.66988845>).

<a id="event-2019-10-08-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two sappers die and four more are wounded trying to defuse World War II shells in Poland. The last such casualties occurred in 1982.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-10/09/c_138456810.htm>); [TVN24](<https://www.tvn24.pl/gen-boguslaw-bebenek-to-pierwszy-od-1982-r-smiertelny-wypadek-zolnierzy-podczas-rozminowania,975760,s.html>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-10-08-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pacific Gas and Electric shuts off power to 800,000 customers in Northern California, citing safety concerns over an elevated fire risk caused by weather conditions.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS 13 Sacramento](<https://sacramento.cbslocal.com/2019/10/08/pge-power-shutoffs-norcal/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-10-08-2-1"></a>

Context: Brexit negotiations in 2019.

**Archived source account.** President of the European Council Donald Tusk tells Prime Minister of the United Kingdom Boris Johnson that "what's at stake is not a stupid blame game," after a UK source said that talks were "close to breaking down" following a reported argument in a phone call between Johnson and German chancellor Angela Merkel about the post-Brexit status of Northern Ireland.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/10/08/uk/donald-tusk-brexit-boris-johnson-gbr-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-08-2-3"></a>

Context: China–United States relations, China–United States trade war.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. State Department imposes visa restrictions on numerous Chinese government officials whom it believes responsible for the detention or abuse of Muslim Uighurs and other ethnic minorities in Xinjiang province. On Monday the Department of Commerce added twenty-eight Chinese firms and bureaus to its "trade blacklist" for similar reasons.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-china-muslims/u-s-imposes-visa-restrictions-on-chinese-officials-over-muslim-treatment-idUSKBN1WN29H>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-10-08-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thirteen men are arrested in the United Kingdom for drug smuggling. The authorities believe that over several years, the suspects imported approximately 50 tonnes of illegal drugs from the Netherlands, valued at several tens of millions of pounds. The National Crime Agency called it “the biggest ever \[drug\] conspiracy that we've seen in the UK”.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-49973186>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-10-08-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Ecuadorian protests.

**Archived source account.** The Government of Ecuador, headed by President Lenín Moreno, moves to Guayaquil as the Carondelet Palace in Quito is taken over by protesters and chaos persists in the capital.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/08/ecuador-moves-government-out-of-capital-as-violent-protests-rage>).

<a id="event-2019-10-08-4-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Ecuadorian protests.

**Archived source account.** As the situation in the country worsens, Moreno denounces a "coup attempt" by incumbent President Nicolás Maduro of Venezuela and former Ecuadorian President Rafael Correa.

Source citations (as archived): [Chicago Tribune](<https://www.chicagotribune.com/sns-bc-lt--ecuador-political-crisis-20191008-story.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-08-4-4"></a>

Context: Politics of Italy.

**Archived source account.** Italian lawmakers vote to reduce the number of seats in the Chamber of Deputies from 630 to 400, and the number of seats in the Senate of the Republic from 315 to 200, at the next Italian general election.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-italy-politics-parliament/italian-parliament-votes-to-scrap-hundreds-of-seats-at-next-election-idUSKBN1WN1VK>).

<a id="event-2019-10-08-4-6"></a>

Context: Politics of Azerbaijan.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Novruz Mammadov presents his resignation as President appoints Ali Asadov to the office.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/azerbaijan-pm-resigns-president-replaces-loyalist-191008092046855.html>); [Eurasianet](<https://eurasianet.org/azerbaijan-replaces-prime-minister>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-10-08-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Nobel Prize in Physics is awarded to Jim Peebles for theoretical discoveries in physical cosmology, and to Michel Mayor and Didier Queloz for the discovery of 51 Pegasi b, an exoplanet orbiting a solar-type star.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-49960497>).

### 2019-10-09

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1263824798](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20October%209&oldid=1263824798>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-10-09-0-1"></a>

Context: Halle synagogue shooting.

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed and two others are injured in attacks by a man wearing military camouflage near a synagogue and at a kebab shop in Halle, Saxony-Anhalt, Germany. Shots are also reported in nearby Landsberg. A suspect, 27-year-old Stephan Billiet, is arrested. The attack had been livestreamed on Twitch for 35 minutes citing anti-Semitic and racist motivations.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-49988482>); [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/germany-deadly-shooting-near-synagogue-in-halle/a-50751722>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/09/two-people-killed-in-shooting-in-german-city-of-halle>).

<a id="event-2019-10-09-0-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria, Turkish involvement in the Syrian Civil War, Kurdish–Turkish conflict (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan says his country has launched a military invasion of northern and eastern Syria. The Kurdish YPG-led Syrian Democratic Forces say that Turkish fighter aircraft strike targets and "civilian areas". Syrian state television says the Turkish artillery shelling of Ras al-Ayn, al-Hasakah Governorate, is "random", and Ayn Issa, Raqqa Governorate, is also being shelled.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/erdogan-turkey-launches-offensive-in-northern-syria/a-50758501>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/turkey-syria-border-latest-updates-191008131745495.html>); [Xinhuanet](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-10/09/c_138458986.htm>).

<a id="event-2019-10-09-0-4"></a>

Context: 2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria, Turkish involvement in the Syrian Civil War, Kurdish–Turkish conflict (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** The Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces requests urgent air support from the United States, and a no-fly zone over northern Syria to protect it from Turkish air raids. U.S. President Donald Trump has ordered U.S. forces to not intervene in the conflict.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/uk-syria-security-turkey-zone/sdf-urges-no-fly-zone-to-stop-turkish-attacks-in-northeast-syria-idUKKBN1WO1OQ>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-49983357>).

<a id="event-2019-10-09-0-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria, Turkish involvement in the Syrian Civil War, Kurdish–Turkish conflict (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** Women at the SDF-controlled Al-Hawl refugee camp, which holds around 74,000 refugees, mostly the wives and children of ISIL fighters, riot and burn their tents according to a Kurdish security official.

Source citations (as archived): [Kurdistan24](<https://www.kurdistan24.net/en/news/0d97f37e-b24f-4b1b-b816-2293f03931e7>).

<a id="event-2019-10-09-0-6"></a>

Context: 2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria, Turkish involvement in the Syrian Civil War, Kurdish–Turkish conflict (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** The U.S. military takes two militants of the Beatles ISIL cell previously held by Kurdish forces to face trial in the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-usa-beatles/u-s-military-takes-custody-of-two-high-profile-islamic-state-militants-idUSKBN1WO2XG?il=0>); [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/isis-beatles-transferred-syrian-prison-us-military-custody/story?id=66172473>).

<a id="event-2019-10-09-0-7"></a>

Context: 2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria, Turkish involvement in the Syrian Civil War, Kurdish–Turkish conflict (2015–present).

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<https://time.com/5695812/islamic-state-militants-hit-kurdish-fighters-syria/>).

<a id="event-2019-10-09-0-9"></a>

Context: Military activity of ISIL.

**Archived source account.** President of Niger Mahamadou Issoufou claims that American hostage Jeffery Ray Woodke is still alive and being held by a jihadist group affiliated with ISIL. Woodke was kidnapped in October 2016.

### 2019-10-10

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1296293885](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20October%2010&oldid=1296293885>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-10-10-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria, Kurdish–Turkish conflict.

**Archived source account.** Heavy fighting between the Turkish Land Forces and the Syrian Democratic Forces along the Syria–Turkey border reportedly leaves hundreds dead. The International Rescue Committee says 64,000 people in northern Syria have fled since the Turkish offensive began, leaving the border towns of Ras al-Ayn and al-Darbasiyah largely deserted.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://reuters.com/article/uk-syria-security-turkey-usa/thousands-flee-hundreds-reported-dead-in-turkish-attack-on-u-s-allied-kurds-in-syria-idUKKBN1WP0V8>).

<a id="event-2019-10-10-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Deputy Foreign Minister, Faisal Mekdad, blames the Turkish offensive on the Kurdish forces, saying Syria will not be negotiating with them "on the terms of separatism".

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-10/11/c_138462068.htm>).

<a id="event-2019-10-10-0-5"></a>

Context: Yemeni Crisis (2011–present).

**Archived source account.** The White House confirms that Ibrahim al-Asiri, suspected chief bomb maker for terrorist group Al-Qaeda in the Arabian Peninsula, was killed in an American counter-terrorism operation in Yemen in 2017.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/10/10/world/middleeast/qaeda-bomber-death-trump.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-10-0-7"></a>

Context: 2019 Ecuadorian protests.

**Archived source account.** Anti-government protesters parade captured police officers in the Ecuadorian capital Quito, which is de facto under the control of protesters and the Confederation of Indigenous Nationalities of Ecuador. The officers were not harmed, though they were forced to address a large crowd calling on President Lenín Moreno to step down, which was broadcast live by several private broadcasters after being ordered to do so by indigenous leaders.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/10/ecuador-indigenous-protesters-parade-captured-officers>).

<a id="event-2019-10-10-0-8"></a>

Context: 2019 Ecuadorian protests.

**Archived source account.** Protest groups issue a statement demanding that the International Monetary Fund (IMF) leave Ecuador, saying that civil unrest won't stop until they leave.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-10-10/protesters-in-quito-seize-ecuadorian-police-shouting-murderer>); [Pastebin](<https://pastebin.com/63bNTAtd>).

<a id="event-2019-10-10-0-10"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Indonesia.

**Archived source account.** An ISIL radical stabs multiple people, including Indonesia's security minister Wiranto. Two suspects were later arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-49997210>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-10-10-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Swedish Academy awards the 2018 Nobel Prize in Literature to Olga Tokarczuk, "for a narrative imagination that with encyclopedic passion represents the crossing of boundaries as a form of life", and the 2019 prize to Peter Handke, "for an influential work that with linguistic ingenuity has explored the periphery and the specificity of human experience". The 2018 prize is awarded only now because last year it was postponed due to a scandal.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/books/2019/oct/10/nobel-prizes-in-literature-olga-tokarczuk-peter-handke-2019-2018>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-10-10-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A highway bridge collapses onto cars in Wuxi, China, trapping multiple vehicles. Search and rescue operations commence.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/road-bridge-collapses-in-wuxi-china-trapping-cars-underneath>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-10-10-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 United States outbreak of lung illness linked to vaping products.

**Archived source account.** The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reports the number of deaths caused by vaping-associated pulmonary injury has risen to 27, with an additional 1,299 cases of non-fatal injuries.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/10/10/health/vaping-illnesses-cdc.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-10-10-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria, European Union–Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan threatens to send 3.6 million Syrian refugees into Europe if the European Union labels the country's recent offensive in northeastern Syria an "occupation".

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/10/turkish-president-threatens-send-refugees-europe-recep-tayyip-erdogan-syria>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-10-10-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Michael Drejka, a 47-year-old white Florida man who shot and killed Markeis McGlockton, an unarmed 28-year-old African American man, in a parking space dispute, is sentenced to 20 years in prison. Drejka had cited Florida's stand-your-ground law in his defense and was not initially charged until the case was handed over to State Attorney Bernie McCabe, who charged Drejka with one count of manslaughter.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/US/stand-ground-killer-michael-dreka-sentenced-20-years/story?id=66182264>).

<a id="event-2019-10-10-5-2"></a>

Context: Crime in Alaska.

**Archived source account.** A murder case from Anchorage, Alaska makes national news, after it is revealed that the killer recorded the killing in both video and still photographs on an SD card, which was later found by a local woman on a street and turned over to police. Local police arrested Brian Steven Smith and charged him with the murder, after identifying him from the content of the memory card.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/10/09/us/anchorage-murder-sd-card-video.html>); [Yahoo News](<https://news.yahoo.com/police-solved-alaskan-murder-memory-154404961.html>); [KTUU-TV](<https://www.ktuu.com/video/?vid=562751552>).

<a id="event-2019-10-10-5-4"></a>

Context: 2019 Trump–Ukraine scandal.

**Archived source account.** Two associates of Rudy Giuliani have been arrested for campaign finance violations in connected to efforts to discredit presidential candidate Joe Biden, according to a spokesman for the District Court for the SDNY.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/10/politics/guliani-client-arrested-campaign-finance/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-10-10-6-1"></a>

Context: Politics of Romania.

**Archived source account.** Romanian Prime Minister Viorica Dăncilă and her government is ousted after the approval of a vote of no-confidence. She will hold the office acting until new Prime Minister is elected.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-49998670>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-10-10-7-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** A source for CNN confirms that a note posted anonymously on Pastebin.com is by Apple CEO Tim Cook. In the note, Cook defends Apple's decision today to bin the HKmap.live iOS app because, he says, its use endangers "law enforcement and residents in Hong Kong."

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/10/11/tech/apple-tim-cook-letter-hkmap-live/index.html>).

Context: Women's rights in Iran, 2022 FIFA World Cup qualification – AFC Second Round.

**Archived source account.** In a men's football match attended by women supporters for the first time in decades, Iran beats Cambodia 14–0.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/iranian-women-attend-football-match-40-years-191010160637819.html>).

### 2019-10-11

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-10-11-0-1"></a>

Context: Iran–Saudi Arabia proxy conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Pentagon announces the deployment of 1,000 to 3,000 U.S. troops to Saudi Arabia to deter Iranian aggression.

<a id="event-2019-10-11-0-2"></a>

Context: Iran–Saudi Arabia proxy conflict.

**Archived source account.** Iran claims one of its oil tankers was hit in the Red Sea, likely by missiles. The Saudi Ports Authority confirms an incident with a tanker near the port of Jeddah overnight.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-iran-tanker/iran-oil-tanker-hit-by-two-missiles-off-saudi-coast-iranian-state-media-idUSKBN1WQ0G0>).

<a id="event-2019-10-11-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, 2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-blast/car-bomb-hits-syrian-kurdish-held-city-of-qamishli-sdf-official-idUSKBN1WQ1QK>).

<a id="event-2019-10-11-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, 2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria.

<a id="event-2019-10-11-0-6"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, 2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria.

**Archived source account.** Turkish artillery mistakenly hits a contingent of United States special operations forces on Mashtenour hill in the Kurdish-majority city of Kobanî, according to a senior Department of Defense official.

<a id="event-2019-10-11-0-7"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, 2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria.

**Archived source account.** A YPG mortar and rocket attack on the Turkish town of Nusaybin kills eight civilians and injures 35 others, according to the governor of Mardin Province.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen kill 16 people during prayers in a northern Burkina Faso mosque.

**Archived source account.** Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed wins the 2019 Nobel Peace Prize for his efforts to make peace between Ethiopia and neighbouring Eritrea.

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-10-11-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thierry Bolloré is fired with immediate effect as the number two of the Renault group, reportedly after a power struggle with its president Jean-Dominique Senard.

<a id="event-2019-10-11-2-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Japan–South Korea trade dispute.

<a id="event-2019-10-11-2-4"></a>

Context: China–United States trade war.

**Archived source account.** China and the United States announced a tentative agreement for the "first phase" of a trade deal, with China agreeing to buy up to $50 billion in American farm products with the United States agreeing to suspend new tariffs scheduled for October 15.

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-10-11-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A cargo plane carrying presidential staff crashes in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, killing all eight passengers and crew onboard. The Russian embassy in Kinshasa says "preliminary information" indicates Russians were on the aircraft.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-congo-crash/cargo-plane-crashes-in-congo-with-presidential-staff-on-board-idUSKBN1WQ1IV>).

<a id="event-2019-10-11-3-2"></a>

Context: Saddleridge Fire.

**Archived source account.** A wildfire destroys 25 homes, displaces 100,000 people and burns over 7,500 acres of forest in and around Los Angeles.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/10/11/769352277/25-homes-more-than-4-700-acres-burn-in-saddleridge-fire-near-los-angeles>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-10-11-4-1"></a>

Context: Manchester Arndale stabbing.

**Archived source account.** Four people are stabbed and injured, one critically, in a mass stabbing at the Manchester Arndale shopping centre in the Northern Quarter, Manchester, United Kingdom. Another person was injured but not stabbed. A man in his early 40s is arrested. He was arrested under the Mental Health Act.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-manchester-50025301>).

<a id="event-2019-10-11-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** One Dutch person and two Afghans are remanded in custody for manslaughter and assistance to illegal immigrants staying in France, after they sold places in inflatable boats for them to reach Great Britain, causing the death of an Iranian woman on 9 August.

Source citations (as archived): [La Voix du Nord](<https://www.lavoixdunord.fr/650487/article/2019-10-12/trois-passeurs-presumes-devant-la-justice-apres-la-mort-d-une-migrante-dans-la>).

<a id="event-2019-10-11-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Uganda announces the plan to pass a bill within weeks which potentially broadens the criminalisation of same-sex relations to include the death penalty.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa/uganda-death-penalty-kill-the-gays-homosexuals-lgbt-a9151411.html>); [Fox News](<https://www.foxnews.com/world/uganda-kill-the-gays-bill-death-penalty>).

<a id="event-2019-10-11-4-5"></a>

Context: Censorship in Turkey, Erdoğanism.

**Archived source account.** Turkey's Minister of the Interior Süleyman Soylu says almost 500 people were investigated and 121 have been detained for "insulting" the Turkish offensive in Syria on social media and characterizing Turkey as an "invading" force.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/middle-east/2019/10/11/Turkey-says-121-detained-for-social-media-posts.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-10-11-5-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Argentina, 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** Argentina announces it has severed diplomatic ties with the disputed Nicolás Maduro-led Government of Venezuela in favour of explicit recognition of opposition leader Juan Guaidó as interim president of Venezuela in the context of the 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [Clarín](<https://www.clarin.com/politica/gobierno-formaliza-ruptura-venezuela-maduro-da-representacion-plena-embajadora-guaido_0_7aU46_JN.html>).
