#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-10-12-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eliud Kipchoge finishes a marathon in Vienna in 1 hour, 59 minutes and 40 seconds, assisted by a car and using a fleet of pacemakers.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/10/12/sport/eliud-kipchoge-marathon-vienna-intl/index.html>).

### 2019-10-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1218716483](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20October%2013&oldid=1218716483>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-10-13-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria, NES–Syria relations.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Democratic Forces agree to allow the Syrian Army to enter the SDF-held cities of Manbij and Kobani in an attempt to deter Turkey from attacking the towns.

Source citations (as archived): [Defence Post](<https://thedefensepost.com/2019/10/13/syria-government-russia-kobani-manbij-sdf/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-towns-report/report-syrian-army-to-enter-sdf-held-kobani-manbij-idUSKBN1WS0K0?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=worldNews&amp;&amp;rpc=401>); [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/middle-east/2019/10/13/Syrian-army-to-enter-SDF-held-Kobani-Manbij-Monitor.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-13-0-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria, NES–Syria relations.

**Archived source account.** As many as 700 ISIL family members escape an Ayn Issa camp.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/13/middleeast/turkish-forces-cut-main-road-syria-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-13-0-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria, NES–Syria relations.

**Archived source account.** A thousand U.S. soldiers are to be pulled out of Syria because of the Turkish offensive.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-50034802>).

<a id="event-2019-10-13-0-4"></a>

Context: 2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria, NES–Syria relations.

**Archived source account.** Fourteen people are killed and ten are injured by Turkish airstrikes targeting a convoy in the Syrian town of Ras al Ain. Five are identified as civilians.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-turkey-strike/fourteen-killed-after-turkish-strike-in-ras-al-ain-idUSKBN1WS0HL?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-10-13-0-6"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War (2009–present).

**Archived source account.** Multiple mortars hit Mogadishu Airport, wounding at least six people. Al-Shabaab claims responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [VOA News](<https://www.voanews.com/africa/al-shabab-mortar-attacks-hits-area-around-mogadishu-airport>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-somalia-security/mortar-bombs-strike-somalias-mogadishu-airport-six-injured-source-idUSKBN1WS0ED>).

<a id="event-2019-10-13-0-8"></a>

Context: Russian–Syrian hospital bombing campaign, Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The New York Times claims it can prove Russian aircraft bombed four Syrian hospitals in a matter of hours in May, using a combination of logbooks from planespotters, recorded radio transmissions, and eyewitnesses.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/russia-syria-bomb-hospitals-war-kurds-putin-assad-idlib-a9153786.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-10-13-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Forty-eight people are confirmed dead, about 100 others are injured and 17 are missing after Typhoon Hagibis makes landfall in Japan.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/typhoon-hagibis-elderly-woman-falls-to-her-death-from-rescue-helicopter-11834366>).

<a id="event-2019-10-13-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The 90-metre cargo ship MV Rhodanus, with a crew of seven, runs aground in the Mouths of Bonifacio nature reserve in the Strait of Bonifacio off Corsica. French maritime police say the vessel did not respond to calls for around an hour before grounding, and that fuel was not thought to be leaking.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20191013-cargo-ship-runs-aground-in-corsican-nature-reserve>).

<a id="event-2019-10-13-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A gas explosion kills nine people in a restaurant in Wuxi, China.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/asia/gas-explosion-restaurant-china-death-toll-dead-wuxi-jiangsu-a9154121.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-10-13-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At Saint Peter's Square, Vatican City, Pope Francis canonizes the 19th-century Anglican convert John Henry Newman, who was a unifying figure in both the Anglican and Catholic churches.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/pope-canonizes-john-henry-newman-unifier-divided-world-66241676>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-10-13-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** California becomes the first U.S. state to ban the sale of fur products. The law goes into effect on January 1, 2023.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/10/13/us/california-bans-fur-products-trnd/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-10-13-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Tunisian presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Tunisia go to the polls to elect a new president. Conservative academic Kais Saied wins more than 70% of the votes.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/karoui-saied-face-tunisia-presidential-election-191012203427620.html>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/14/tunisia-election-exit-polls-point-to-landslide-win-for-robocop-kais-saied>).

<a id="event-2019-10-13-4-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Polish parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Poland go to the polls to elect a new government. The incumbent right-wing Law and Justice is expected to slightly increase its plurality.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-poland-election/second-term-awaits-nationalist-pis-as-divided-poles-vote-idUSKBN1WR0O4>).

### 2019-10-14

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1357885547](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20October%2014&oldid=1357885547>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-10-14-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, 2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria, NES–Syria relations.

**Archived source account.** In the early hours of the morning, the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces hands over control of Tabqa, and the nearby Tabqa Airbase in the Raqqa Governorate to the Syrian Army.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-tabqa/syrian-army-deploys-to-town-near-raqqa-state-media-idUSKBN1WT11G>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/turkey-military-operation-syria-latest-updates-191014053832727.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-14-0-3"></a>

Context: Insurgency in the Maghreb.

**Archived source account.** A French tourist is stabbed to death while a Tunisian soldier is wounded by an Islamist in Bizerte, Tunisia.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-10/14/c_138471373.htm>).

<a id="event-2019-10-14-0-5"></a>

Context: Mexican Drug War.

**Archived source account.** Fourteen state police officers are killed in an ambush in Aguililla, Michoacán; crime-scene evidence points to the involvement of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-50049142>); [El Universal](<https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/estados/atacan-convoy-de-la-policia-estatal-en-michoacan-reportan-tres-muertos>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-10-14-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A stone statue is discovered in the walls of a church in England. Officials believe the statue had been hidden inside those walls for about 400 years since the Restoration period.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/video/science/statue-hidden-in-churchs-wall-for-400-years-discovered/vi-AAILGKF>); [Daily Mail](<https://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-7571223/Statue-hidden-stone-mason-ordered-destroy-Restoration-uncovered.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-10-14-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences selects Abhijit Banerjee, Esther Duflo and Michael Kremer as laureates for this year's Nobel Prize in Economics, "for their experimental approach to alleviating global poverty".

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/10/14/770004647/3-win-nobel-prize-in-economic-sciences-for-work-in-reducing-poverty>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-10-14-3-1"></a>

Context: Trial of Catalonia independence leaders, 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of Spain sentences the twelve Catalan independence leaders between 9 and 13 years in prison and disqualification from holding public office for sedition and misuse of public funds. While it proves the existence of violent outbreaks, it judges they are not sufficient to convict for rebellion.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-49974289>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/10/14/world/europe/catalonia-separatists-verdict-spain.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-14-3-2"></a>

Context: Trial of Catalonia independence leaders, 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Former Catalan Vice President Oriol Junqueras receives the highest penalty with 13 years in prison and disqualification, while former councilors Meritxell Borràs, Santi Vila and Carles Mundó are sentenced to one year and eight months disqualification for disobedience.

Source citations (as archived): [El País](<https://elpais.com/politica/2019/10/14/actualidad/1571033446_440448.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-14-3-3"></a>

Context: Trial of Catalonia independence leaders, 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Demonstrations and cut roads take place throughout Catalonia, with the largest taking place in Barcelona. The Committees for the Defense of the Republic calls for disobedience and popular revolt.

Source citations (as archived): [El Periódico](<https://www.elperiodico.com/es/politica/20191014/mapa-carreteras-cortadas-manifestaciones-sentencia-proces-7677209>); [El Mundo](<https://www.elmundo.es/cataluna/2019/10/14/5da407d321efa0a1248b468a.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-14-3-4"></a>

Context: Trial of Catalonia independence leaders, 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** President of Catalonia Quim Torra requests a meeting with King Felipe VI of Spain and Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez and calls the sentence as an act of "revenge". Sánchez, in a special press conference, guarantees compliance with the sentence and calls for dialogue and coexistence, as well as ensures that Spain is a democratic state.

Source citations (as archived): [El Confidencial](<https://www.elconfidencial.com/multimedia/video/espana/cataluna/2019-10-14/quim-torra-sentencia-proces-tribunal-supremo_2281643/>); [El Mundo](<https://www.elmundo.es/espana/2019/10/14/5da4340121efa0a21a8b45a1.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-14-3-5"></a>

Context: Trial of Catalonia independence leaders, 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Judge Pablo Llarena issues a European Arrest Warrant against former Catalan President Carles Puigdemont.

Source citations (as archived): [El Confidencial](<https://www.elmundo.es/espana/2019/10/14/5da4623221efa0752d8b468a.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-14-3-6"></a>

Context: Trial of Catalonia independence leaders, 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Clashes erupts between Mossos d'Esquadra and the protesters that occupied the Barcelona–El Prat Josep Tarradellas Airport. Several flights are cancelled.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC.es](<https://www.abc.es/espana/catalunya/abci-tsunami-democratic-convoca-independentismo-ocupar-aeropuerto-barcelona-201910141305_noticia.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-14-3-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Convicted British serial sex offender and paedophile Richard Huckle, who sexually abused dozens of children in Malaysia, is found stabbed to death in his cell at HM Prison Full Sutton.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-50042406>).

<a id="event-2019-10-14-3-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** The IRGC say they captured Ruhollah Zam, an Iranian journalist-activist exiled in Europe, accusing him of having stoked anti-government unrest in early 2018 using social media.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-opposition-arrest/iran-says-it-captures-exiled-journalist-who-supported-2018-unrest-idUSKBN1WT1JT>).

<a id="event-2019-10-14-3-10"></a>

Context: 2018 Westminster car attack.

**Archived source account.** At the Old Bailey in London, Salih Khater is sentenced to life imprisonment with a minimum term of fifteen years.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-london-50044250>).

<a id="event-2019-10-14-3-12"></a>

Context: Shooting of Atatiana Jefferson.

**Archived source account.** Aaron Dean, the Fort Worth, Texas police officer who shot a woman to death in her bedroom during what was intended to be a welfare check, resigns his position, and later that day is arrested and formally charged with murder in the case.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<https://www.foxnews.com/us/fort-worth-police-officer-in-shooting-investigation>).

### 2019-10-15

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088541642](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20October%2015&oldid=1088541642>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-10-15-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, 2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria.

**Archived source account.** The Russian Ministry of Defence says the Syrian Army has gained control over Manbij and the surrounding area, adding, "Cooperation with the Turkish side has been arranged". The U.S. military spokesperson for Operation Inherent Resolve announces the United States has withdrawn their forces from Manbij.

Source citations (as archived): [TASS](<https://tass.com/defense/1083224>); [Military Times](<https://www.militarytimes.com/flashpoints/2019/10/15/russian-and-syrian-troops-fill-void-as-us-pulls-troops-out-of-manbij-syria/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-10-15-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Turkish lira rises after U.S. President Donald Trump threatened 50% steel tariffs and a halt to trade negotiations in retaliation for the Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria. Analysts describe the sanctions as "relatively light" and "window dressing".

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2019/10/15/turkish-lira-up-as-trump-tariff-threats-are-less-serious-than-expected.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-15-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Wells Fargo, the fourth-largest bank in the United States, misses its third quarter profit estimates due to interest rate declines and the shrinkage of its mortgage lending business.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-wells-fargo-results/wells-fargo-disappoints-wall-street-as-legal-costs-mount-idUSKBN1WU1NI>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-10-15-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The number of people confirmed killed in central and eastern Japan by Typhoon Hagibis rises to 66, with 15 people still missing and more than 200 injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-asia-storm-japan/japan-typhoon-death-toll-rises-to-58-as-hopes-for-missing-fade-idUSKBN1WT2KK>).

<a id="event-2019-10-15-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A chemical plant used to manufacture Bakelite explodes in Guangxi, China; at least four are killed and six more are injured.

Source citations (as archived): [The News and Observer](<https://www.newsobserver.com/news/business/article236227358.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-15-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A seven-storey apartment block collapses in Fortaleza, Brazil. One person is confirmed dead with seven more rescued; a further ten people are believed to be trapped in the wreckage.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-50055727>).

<a id="event-2019-10-15-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** An irregular gas company explodes and kills four people in Boa Vista, Brazil.

Source citations (as archived): [MBS](<https://www.mbs.news/2019/10/four-people-die-in-northern-brazil-in-a-gas-factory-explosion.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-15-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 4.5 magnitude earthquake, with a preliminary depth of 14.0 kilometers (8.7 miles), shakes the San Francisco Bay area. Residents reported minor damage.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2019/10/15/earthquake-shakes-san-francisco-bay-area/3983253002/>); [U.S. Geological Survey](<https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/eventpage/nc73291880/executive>).

<a id="event-2019-10-15-2-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least one person is killed and 70 people hospitalized as more than 100 wildfires break out across Lebanon for the second day. The Chouf and Matn regions are especially hit hard. The Lebanese Civil Defense labels it the worst firestorm in decades.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/hellish-scenes-wildfires-engulf-lebanon-191015191252866.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-10-15-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Climate activists continue Extinction Rebellion protests at the transport ministry in central London after the Metropolitan Police Service yesterday banned Extinction Rebellion protests in London, United Kingdom. Following the ban, police cleared a protester camp occupying Trafalgar Square. Almost 1,500 arrests have been made since last week.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-50051279>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-climate-change-britain-transport/climate-change-activists-protest-against-british-high-speed-train-line-idUSKBN1WU0OC>).

<a id="event-2019-10-15-3-2"></a>

Context: Notre-Dame de Paris bombing attempt.

**Archived source account.** A court in France sentences five women to prison terms for their roles in the failed bombing. A Syrian man, thought to have been killed in Iraq in 2017, is sentenced to life in absentia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-50053555>).

<a id="event-2019-10-15-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Papua New Guinea police issue an arrest warrant for former Prime Minister Peter O'Neill for corruption.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/401047/png-police-issue-arrest-warrant-for-former-pm-o-neill>).

<a id="event-2019-10-15-3-5"></a>

Context: Trial of Catalonia independence leaders, 2019 Catalan Protests.

**Archived source account.** After a second day of mobilizations in Catalonia after the sentence of the independence leaders with cutroads and railways cuts, violent clashes take place in Tarragona, Barcelona, Girona, Sabadell and Lleida.

Source citations (as archived): [RTVE](<http://www.rtve.es/noticias/20191015/sentencia-proces-directo-ultimas-noticias/1980652.shtml>).

<a id="event-2019-10-15-3-6"></a>

Context: Trial of Catalonia independence leaders, 2019 Catalan Protests.

**Archived source account.** The Government of Spain issues a statement acknowledging that there is "widespread and coordinated violence in Catalonia" and that its objective is "to guarantee security and coexistence \[...\] following its commitment of firmness, proportionality and unity".

Source citations (as archived): [la Sexta](<https://www.lasexta.com/noticias/nacional/comunicado-moncloa-valora-forma-muy-positiva-labor-policia-guardia-civil-mossos-protestas-cataluna_201910155da63c8a0cf2d85aaa02f97e.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-15-3-8"></a>

Context: 2019 Río Piedras shooting.

**Archived source account.** Five men and a woman are killed in a mass shooting Monday night at the Río Piedras housing project in San Juan, Puerto Rico. A group of people with large guns showed up before the shooting, according to the police commissioner. Sunday, two people were killed in Guaynabo in the northern section of the San Juan metropolitan area. Governor Wanda Vázquez Garced convened an emergency meeting of her security team Tuesday.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/six-people-are-dead-after-a-mass-shooting-in-puerto-rico/ar-AAIP311?ocid=spartandhp>); [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/the_americas/shooting-kills-6-in-puerto-rico-leads-to-emergency-meeting/2019/10/15/8577e37e-ef89-11e9-bb7e-d2026ee0c199_story.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-10-15-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Mozambican general election.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Mozambique go to the polls to elect both their president and the members of the legislature.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/mozambique-votes-in-key-test-for-peace-deal/a-50834183>).

<a id="event-2019-10-15-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Migrant rescue ship MV Ocean Viking is granted permission to dock by Italy and heads to Taranto, carrying 176 migrants rescued at sea off the Libyan coast on Sunday.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-europe-migrants-italy/italy-lets-french-migrant-ship-dock-to-anger-of-far-right-idUKKBN1WU1VQ>).

### 2019-10-16

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1185136815](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20October%2016&oldid=1185136815>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-10-16-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** A Taliban truck bomb in eastern Afghanistan kills three police officers and injures 36 other people, including twenty children.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/car-bomb-kills-police-wounds-children-eastern-afghanistan-191016053735525.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-16-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, 2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria.

**Archived source account.** Following the withdrawal of troops, U.S. F-15s bomb a CJTF–OIR ammunition depot bunker at the Lafarge cement factory in Aleppo Governorate, Syria, to prevent the munitions and other equipment from being used by Turkish-led forces or Syrian government forces.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/10/16/politics/us-airstrike-storage-site-syria/index.html>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/syria-war-trump-turkey-invasion-us-base-bomb-lafarge-cement-factory-manbij-russia-video-a9159851.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-10-16-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** General Motors and the United Auto Workers announce that they have reached a tentative deal to end a month-long strike that cost the company US$2 billion. It will be sent to union members tomorrow for final approval. If approved, workers will receive a pay raise and temporary workers will be granted a more simplified path to full-time employment.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-autos-labor/uaw-gm-leaders-have-a-deal-now-workers-will-decide-idUSKBN1WV241>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-10-16-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Mindanao earthquake.

**Archived source account.** A magnitude 6.3 earthquake strikes the province of Cotabato, Philippines, at 19:37 local time (11:37 UTC), killing at least 5 people and injuring 53 others.

Source citations (as archived): [GMA News](<https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/news/regions/712001/2-dead-after-strong-mindanao-quake/story/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-10-16-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** Jimmy Sham, a leader of the Hong Kong protests, is attacked by a group of hammer-wielding men in the Mong Kok District of the Kowloon Peninsula, and is taken to hospital with severe head injuries.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-50073583>).

<a id="event-2019-10-16-3-3"></a>

Context: Trial of Catalonia independence leaders, 2019–2020 Catalan protests.

**Archived source account.** The nine pro-Catalonia independence politicians jailed earlier this week issue a joint plea for an end to violent protests across the region. Meanwhile, the Spanish government says it will meet protestors with a "firm, proportional and united" response.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/16/police-clash-with-catalonia-protesters-in-second-night-of-violence>).

<a id="event-2019-10-16-3-4"></a>

Context: Trial of Catalonia independence leaders, 2019–2020 Catalan protests.

**Archived source account.** The violence of the protests in Tarragona, Girona, Lleida and Barcelona increases, while there are clashes with Mossos d'Esquadra in Reus. Four protesters and one policeman are injured in a pro-independence protest in Madrid.

Source citations (as archived): [El Mundo](<https://www.elmundo.es/cataluna/2019/10/16/5da6aa66fdddff61428b45b0.html>); [El País](<https://elpais.com/politica/2019/10/16/actualidad/1571207756_038911.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-16-3-5"></a>

Context: Trial of Catalonia independence leaders, 2019–2020 Catalan protests.

**Archived source account.** The Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez advises in a press conference that the Government will act with moderation but not concrete exceptional measures yet.

Source citations (as archived): [El País](<https://elpais.com/politica/2019/10/16/actualidad/1571210620_205746.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-16-3-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Around 337 people in a dozen countries are arrested for participating in a child pornography network that hosted up to 250,000 videos depicting child sexual abuse. Officials in the United States, United Kingdom, and South Korea called it one of the largest child pornography operations to date.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-crime-exploitation/hundreds-arrested-worldwide-in-sweeping-child-porn-investigation-idUSKBN1WV1WW>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-10-16-4-1"></a>

Context: Japan–South Korea relations, 2019 Japan–South Korea trade dispute.

**Archived source account.** Foreign ministry officials from Japan and South Korea meet in Seoul to discuss wartime forced labor and trade dispute

Source citations (as archived): [NHK World](<https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20191016_46/>).

### 2019-10-17

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088682018](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20October%2017&oldid=1088682018>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-10-17-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria.

**Archived source account.** After meeting with Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, U.S. Vice President Mike Pence says Turkey has agreed to a five-day ceasefire in Syria while the United States helps facilitate the withdrawal of Kurdish fighters.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/pence-arrives-in-turkey-as-us-seeks-to-halt-erdogans-syria-offensive/2019/10/17/55b806aa-f04c-11e9-bb7e-d2026ee0c199_story.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-10-17-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The number of people confirmed killed in central and eastern Japan by Typhoon Hagibis rises to 77, while nine other people are still missing.

Source citations (as archived): [NHK World](<https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/special/01/1919/>).

<a id="event-2019-10-17-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Peninsula Air passenger plane carrying 42 people crashes at an airport in Unalaska, Alaska. One passenger on the Saab SB20 is killed, and at least one more is seriously injured.

Source citations (as archived): [KTUU](<https://www.ktuu.com/content/news/Plane-off-runway-at-Unalaska-Airport-563346322.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-17-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A double-decker bus carrying pilgrims crashes and catches fire near Medina, Saudi Arabia. The disaster kills at least 35 foreigners.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-50081706>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-10-17-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 outbreak of lung illness linked to vaping products.

**Archived source account.** Electronic cigarette maker Juul announces it will stop producing most of its flavored cartridges, excluding mint and menthol.

Source citations (as archived): [Arstechnica](<https://arstechnica.com/science/2019/10/juul-halts-sales-of-some-flavors-but-not-the-ones-teens-use-most/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-10-17-3-1"></a>

Context: Brexit negotiations, Brexit.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom and the European Union agree on a new Brexit withdrawal agreement deal following talks in Brussels. Current coalition partner the Democratic Unionist Party subsequently announces they will oppose the deal.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-50079385>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-10-17-4-1"></a>

Context: Murder of Kathleen Jo Henry.

**Archived source account.** Police in Anchorage, Alaska charge Brian Steven Smith, who was arrested on October 8 for the murder of Kathleen Jo Henry, with a second murder, that of Veronica Abouchuk. Smith reportedly confessed to killing Abouchuk and told authorities where her body could be found.

Source citations (as archived): [KTLA Los Angeles](<https://ktla.com/2019/10/17/man-seen-in-strangling-video-charged-in-killing-of-2nd-woman-in-alaska/>).

<a id="event-2019-10-17-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The New York City Council votes to close Rikers Island, the city's main prison, by 2026. The complex's infrastructural deterioration and excessive abuses were the cited reasons.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-new-york-rikers/new-york-city-council-votes-to-close-infamous-rikers-island-jails-idUSKBN1WW2ZW>).

<a id="event-2019-10-17-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The fourth night of violence in the streets of Catalonia in protest of the sentence of the Catalan independence leaders leaves 33 arrested and 80 injures. In Tarragona, the main door of the city hall is burnt.

Source citations (as archived): [El País](<https://elpais.com/ccaa/2019/10/17/catalunya/1571348005_655263.html>); [La Vanguardia](<https://www.lavanguardia.com/vida/20191018/47104590938>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-10-17-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Representative Elijah Cummings, Maryland Democratic Congressman and House Oversight Committee Chair, dies at age 68.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/rep-elijah-cummings-house-oversight-committee-chair-dead/story?id=66338264>).

<a id="event-2019-10-17-5-2"></a>

Context: List of Trump administration dismissals and resignations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Secretary of Energy Rick Perry announces he will resign by the end of the year.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/10/17/593950148/energy-secretary-rick-perry-resigns>).

<a id="event-2019-10-17-5-4"></a>

Context: Trial of Catalonia independence leaders, 2019 Catalan Protests.

**Archived source account.** The Catalan president Quim Torra, in a special plenary session at the Parliament of Catalonia, announces that he will convene a third independence referendum and a Constitution throughout the legislature.

Source citations (as archived): [El Periódico](<https://www.elperiodico.com/es/politica/20191017/torra-autodeterminacion-govern-erc-jxcat-7686835>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-10-17-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** NASA announces that the InSight Mars lander's heat probe had successfully dug 3 cm into the ground after becoming stuck 35 cm in the ground in February 2019, confirming that the probe had not hit a rock and instead simply didn't have enough friction in the soil to dig much deeper. The vehicle landed near the Martian equator in November 2018.

Source citations (as archived): [Space.com](<https://www.space.com/mars-insight-lander-burrowing-probe-hope.html>).

### 2019-10-18

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1111706711](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20October%2018&oldid=1111706711>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-10-18-0-1"></a>

Context: Mexican Drug War.

**Archived source account.** The Mexican National Guard arrests Ovidio Guzmán López, one of former cartel leader Joaquín "El Chapo" Guzmán's sons, in Culiacán. He is later released after government forces come under intense attack and are overpowered by Sinaloa Cartel gunmen, according to Security Minister Alfonso Durazo.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-50092641>); [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2019/10/18/gun-battles-rock-mexican-city-culiacan-after-el-chapos-son-detained.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-18-0-2"></a>

Context: Mexican Drug War.

**Archived source account.** According to a later statement, Mexican President Andrés Manuel López Obrador and government authorities ordered officers to let Guzmán López go free to avoid a "bloodbath" and "preserve the lives of our officers and bring calm back to the city".

Source citations (as archived): [Clarín](<https://www.clarin.com/mundo/mexico-panico-tiros-detonaciones-hijo-chapo-guzman-libre_0_qRlCz8Hp.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-18-0-3"></a>

Context: Mexican Drug War.

**Archived source account.** Eight people are confirmed killed in the failed raid. More than twenty others were injured.

Source citations (as archived): [AP News](<https://apnews.com/e0228a1114fd44f5aff1ace1479ce0f1>).

<a id="event-2019-10-18-0-5"></a>

Context: Haska Meyna mosque bombing.

**Archived source account.** Multiple explosions inside a mosque in Haska Meyna District of Afghanistan's Nangarhar Province kill at least 62 people and severely damage the building.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-blast/blasts-in-afghanistan-mosque-kill-at-least-62-wound-more-than-100-idUSKBN1WX1AP>).

<a id="event-2019-10-18-0-7"></a>

Context: 2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria.

**Archived source account.** The Kurds say that Turkey is already violating the ceasefire agreement by shelling the border town of Ras al-Ain.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/18/middleeast/syria-turkey-ceasefire-violations-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-18-0-8"></a>

Context: 2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria.

**Archived source account.** Turkish airstrikes kill five civilians in the village of Bab al-Kheir.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/deadly-turkish-airstrikes-shatter-deal-to-pause-syria-offensive/>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-10-18-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The wreck of Japanese warship Kaga, sunk in the Battle of Midway during World War II, is discovered on the seabed in the Pacific Ocean. It is only the second vessel sunk during the battle to have been found.

Source citations (as archived): [Live Science](<https://www.livescience.com/explorers-find-wwii-warship.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-10-18-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** UK clothing retailer Bonmarché collapses into administration. The chain employs 2,900 people and operates 318 stores.

Source citations (as archived): [iNews](<https://inews.co.uk/news/business/bonmarche-collapses-into-administration-putting-2900-jobs-at-risk-816818>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-10-18-3-1"></a>

Context: Seattle crane collapse.

**Archived source account.** Washington State authorities find a crane collapse earlier this year in Seattle was caused when workers removed securing pins too early during the crane's dismantling. Four people were killed in the accident. Three firms are issued fines.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/totally-avoidable-3-firms-fined-deadly-seattle-crane-collapse-n1068466>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-10-18-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Japan says it will not join the U.S.-led International Maritime Security Construct to protect international shipping in the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz amid Iranian aggression, but will instead deploy its own Maritime Self-Defense Force to the region to guard merchant vessels "related to Japan".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://reuters.com/article/uk-mideast-iran-japan/japan-wont-join-u-s-coalition-to-protect-middle-east-shipping-will-send-own-force-idUKKBN1WX0Y4?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-10-18-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Financial Action Task Force, an international counter-terrorism finance taskforce, tells Pakistan to improve its counter-terror funding operations by next February or face being added to the group's blacklist.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hindustan Times](<https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/global-anti-terror-body-fatf-gives-pakistan-till-february-to-curb-terror-funding/story-LkMQFwvnhv5OCgszqnOomO.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-10-18-5-1"></a>

Context: Trial of Catalan independence leaders; 2019 Catalan protests.

**Archived source account.** Catalonia goes to a general strike in protest of the prison sentence of the Catalan independentists leaders. Thousands of demonstrators arrive walking to Barcelona from the whole region.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/18/catalonia-general-strike-protests-independence>).

<a id="event-2019-10-18-5-2"></a>

Context: Trial of Catalan independence leaders; 2019 Catalan protests.

**Archived source account.** After a peaceful demonstration involving more than 500,000 people in Barcelona, violent clashes erupt, with more clashes in Tarragona and Girona.

Source citations (as archived): [El Periódico](<https://www.elperiodico.com/es/videos/politica/disturbios-en-via-laietana/4701189.shtml>); [Tarragona Digital](<https://tarragonadigital.com/tarragona/carregues-policials-tarragona-manifestacio-18-octubre>).

<a id="event-2019-10-18-5-3"></a>

Context: Trial of Catalan independence leaders; 2019 Catalan protests.

**Archived source account.** In Barcelona, a water cannon is used for the first time against protesters in Spain.

Source citations (as archived): [La Vanguardia](<https://www.lavanguardia.com/politica/20191018/471051109292/mossos-tanqueta-agua-disturbios-barcelona-manifestantes.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-18-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former President of Catalonia Carles Puigdemont is released with charges by the Brussels prosecutor's office after surrendering on Thursday to the Belgian authorities following the issuing of the European Arrest Warrant on Monday.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/18/ex-catalan-leader-carles-puigdemont-belgian-authorities-arrest-warrant>); [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/2019/10/18/former-catalan-leader-carles-puigdemont-walks-free-after-handing-himself-to-brussels-polic>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-10-18-6-1"></a>

Context: 2019–20 Lebanese protests.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of protestors march across Lebanon over the government's proposal to tax numerous goods, such as tobacco and WhatsApp calls. Police respond by firing tear gas on those in Beirut.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/protests-erupt-lebanon-plans-impose-taxes-191017194856354.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lebanon-economy-protests-teargas/lebanon-security-forces-use-tear-gas-in-beirut-protests-idUSKBN1WX01Z?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-10-18-6-2"></a>

Context: 2019–20 Lebanese protests.

**Archived source account.** The government withdraws the controversial tax plan. Despite this, protests continue, with participants swelling to tens of thousands and them now calling for the downfall of the government. Prime Minister Saad Hariri gives his government 72 hours to resolve the country's worsening economic crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/lebanon-protests-economic-crisis-corruption-continue-191018132945814.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-18-6-4"></a>

Context: 2019 Santiago protests.

**Archived source account.** After a week of fare-dodging protests in the Santiago Metro, thousands of protestors clash with police in different places across Santiago, Chile. Subway service is suspended in the entire city. Protests started after a price hike in the most expensive subway system in Latin America.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/18/chile-students-mass-fare-dodging-expands-into-city-wide-protest>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-10-18-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the International Space Station, the crew members Expedition 61, Christina Koch and Jessica Meir took the first all female spacewalk in history.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC news](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-50085930>).

### 2019-10-19

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088683746](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20October%2019&oldid=1088683746>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-10-19-0-1"></a>

Context: SIEV X.

**Archived source account.** An Iraqi man is arrested at Brisbane Airport for his membership in a human trafficking syndicate responsible for chartering a boat carrying 421 Afghan and Iraqi refugees to Australia. More than 350 of those aboard perished when the boat sank off the coast of Indonesia in October 2001.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2019/oct/19/siev-x-tragedy-iraqi-man-charged-in-australia-in-connection-with-deaths-of-350-people>).

<a id="event-2019-10-19-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A dam on the Seiba river in Krasnoyarsk, Siberia, collapses, flooding a nearby gold mine and cabins used to house miners. At least 15 people have been killed, with 13 more missing and 14 hospitalised.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-50108413>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-10-19-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Santiago protests.

**Archived source account.** The Chilean government declares a state of emergency in the capital Santiago, following riots in response to a price hike in Santiago Metro fares. Overnight, the high-rise headquarters of Enel Generación Chile is set on fire by rioters.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-50106743>).

<a id="event-2019-10-19-1-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Santiago protests.

**Archived source account.** 19 stations of the Santiago Metro are set on fire during the night.

Source citations (as archived): [La Tercera](<https://www.latercera.com/nacional/noticia/incendios-estaciones-del-metro/868259/>).

<a id="event-2019-10-19-1-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Santiago protests.

**Archived source account.** Police and military officers clash with protestors in Plaza Baquedano, Maipú Main Square and other places, while several cacerolazos are heard in the city.

Source citations (as archived): [ADN Radio](<https://www.adnradio.cl/noticias/deportes/cacerolazo-convocado-por-vecinos-finalizo-con-incidentes-en-la-plaza-de-maipu/20191019/nota/3968118.aspx>).

<a id="event-2019-10-19-1-4"></a>

Context: 2019 Santiago protests.

**Archived source account.** Curfew is announced for the Greater Santiago area, the first time it is used since the end of the Pinochet dictatorship.

Source citations (as archived): [El Desconcierto](<https://www.eldesconcierto.cl/2019/10/19/decretan-inedito-toque-de-queda-en-santiago-tras-fracaso-del-gobierno-en-contener-ola-de-protestas/>).

<a id="event-2019-10-19-1-6"></a>

Context: Brexit.

**Archived source account.** The British Parliament votes 322 to 306 to pass the so-called "Letwin amendment" to the Withdrawal Agreement Bill, which states it will not approve any withdrawal agreement unless all relevant formal legislation is passed. In effect any subsequent vote on a deal is not considered final, and Prime Minister Boris Johnson will be forced to ask for an extension.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-eu-letwin-vote/uk-lawmakers-vote-for-letwin-proposals-forcing-johnson-toward-brexit-delay-idUSKBN1WY0D0>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/10/19/uk/brexit-letwin-amendment-scli-intl-gbr/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-19-1-8"></a>

Context: 2019–20 Lebanese protests.

**Archived source account.** Four ministers resign from the current cabinet, stating that the government is incapable of addressing any of the issues under current circumstances. Conversely, Hassan Nasrallah of Hezbollah announces that his group will continue to support the government, saying, "All of us have to shoulder the responsibility of the current situation that we arrived at."

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/tens-thousands-protest-day-lebanon-191019180840017.html>).

Context: American-led intervention in Iraq (2014–2021).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-10-20-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Bolivian general election.

**Archived source account.** People in Bolivia head to the polls for the latest general election.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20191020-bolivia-goes-to-polls-as-left-wing-icon-evo-morales-seeks-unprecedented-fourth-term-1?fbclid=IwAR09Q5hONdZkcFocQS5ZqRW6phvH4v0ZzuGGj94bVFGwXXPnwk28QTOPNEU>).

Before the results were halted, incumbent President Evo Morales held 45 percent of the vote and former President Carlos Mesa held 38 percent.

<a id="event-2019-10-20-3-4"></a>

Context: 2019 Chilean protests.

**Archived source account.** Curfew is extended to Concepción and Valparaíso Region. Including Santiago, nine million people are under a state of emergency, equal to 52 percent of the country's population.

Source citations (as archived): [La Tercera](<https://www.latercera.com/nacional/noticia/ministro-chadwick-anuncia-se-decretara-toque-queda-tambien-concepcion/869631/>); [Sputnik](<https://sputniknews.com/latam/201910201077097640-chilean-authorities-impose-curfews-in-several-provinces-amid-mass-protests---reports/?fbclid=IwAR37oLxFTAlx_v8QRPWXyQrD5ylmTWy_M6TsM3zsDmUJonFIWhfUngB8Pdg>).

Context: 2019 Chilean protests.
