<a id="event-2019-10-20-3-7"></a>

Context: 2019 Swiss federal election.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Switzerland elect the members of the country's Federal Assembly and Council. Provisional results show the Swiss People's Party retaining their plurality, and that the Green Party has become the fourth-largest party.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/green-gains-expected-as-swiss-voters-head-to-the-polls/a-50903915>); [Le News](<https://lenews.ch/2019/10/20/swiss-federal-election-results-2019-winners-and-losers/>); [The Local](<https://www.thelocal.ch/20191020/swiss-vote-in-possible-green-wave-election?fbclid=IwAR0tmVDR17mhGYz0hiWJ7VGp1d9wi2TLrkmA4u5n8M42KA6SW1t_SNj9oT4>).

<a id="event-2019-10-20-3-9"></a>

Context: Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh.

**Archived source account.** The government of Bangladesh announces it will begin moving thousands of Rohingya refugees from crowded camps to the flood-prone island of Thengar Char, starting early November. The government hopes to relocate 100,000 refugees by the end of the operation, which has been criticised by rights groups as an "inevitable" humanitarian crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/bangladesh-thousands-rohingya-agree-relocation-island-191020074723514.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-rohingya-bangladesh/bangladesh-to-move-rohingya-to-flood-prone-island-next-month-idUSKBN1WZ0DR>).

### 2019-10-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 940490682](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20October%2021&oldid=940490682>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-10-21-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria, Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov says his country is ready to mediate between the Syrian government and Kurdish forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Kurdistan 24](<https://www.kurdistan24.net/en/news/5b221b1e-93ae-4ccd-952a-a530520f360e?fbclid=IwAR1DAsqP0Dul7qAvR40vR7fDaHrf_0XGxBWxOJwUYEBEJb05sjIUNK0EOKY>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-10-21-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A team of ocean explorers announce the discovery of Imperial Japanese aircraft carrier Akagi on the Pacific seafloor. The vessel was sunk in 1942 during the World War II Battle of Midway.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/21/humbling-wreckage-of-japanese-ships-from-battle-of-midway-found-in-pacific>); [TVNZ](<https://www.tvnz.co.nz/one-news/world/deep-sea-explorers-find-lost-warship-wwii-battle-midway?fbclid=IwAR2Av2T5JPkkeoNBdUOxGHNXMizfUYuoMva29tRMZr1Saj-cIYbBJIqAlCU>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-10-21-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A fiery bus crash near Kinshasa in the Democratic Republic of Congo kills at least 31 people, with another 18 injured.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/10/21/africa/congo-bus-fire-intl/index.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-10-21-3-1"></a>

Context: New Zealand–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** The Foreign Minister of New Zealand Winston Peters accuses the United Kingdom of "walking out" on Pacific aid to small island nations. The accusation surprised British officials.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/401460/uk-walked-out-on-pacific-nz-s-foreign-minister>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-10-21-4-1"></a>

Context: Murder of Ján Kuciak.

**Archived source account.** Authorities in Slovakia charge four people with murdering investigative journalist Ján Kuciak and his fiancée. The killings sparked widespread anti-corruption protests and forced the resignation of Prime Minister Robert Fico.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/21/slovakia-four-people-charged-murder-investigative-journalist-jan-kuciak>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-slovakia-crime/four-charged-in-slovak-journalist-murder-that-brought-down-prime-minister-idUSKBN1X011E?fbclid=IwAR2GsTW39FVTcE0vLf1xn8Sw78S3JuXFZ7OhfsAE1qOSVnvtIi7H8E7a7-Y>).

<a id="event-2019-10-21-4-3"></a>

Context: Opioid epidemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Teva Pharmaceuticals, McKesson, and AmerisourceBergen reach a US$260 million settlement hours before a civil trial in U.S. federal court in Cleveland, Ohio, brought as a class-action lawsuit representing communities affected by opioid addiction.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2019/oct/21/opioid-makers-drug-industry-trial-cleveland-ohio>); [The Week](<https://theweek.com/speedreads/873162/drug-companies-reach-settlement-ohio-counties-avoid-federal-opioid-trial>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-10-21-5-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Canadian federal election.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Canada go to the polls to elect members of the 43rd Canadian Parliament. Polls show Justin Trudeau's Liberals and Andrew Scheer's Conservatives deadlocked with equal numbers of support after a divisive campaign.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC News](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/grenier-polls-election-end-1.5327737>); [CTV News](<https://election.ctvnews.ca/frantic-final-push-for-votes-marks-final-day-of-divisive-campaign-1.4646693>); [HuffPost](<https://www.huffpost.com/entry/canada-votes-in-election-that-could-see-justin-trudeau-lose-power_n_5dadc3d0e4b0422422c91c62?fbclid=IwAR1Z_uGBww69lD5wGK8UEjC4SfgrXohTIvMgoiJ_58wNxGyh2R7bWdKqZMU>).

<a id="event-2019-10-21-5-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Canadian federal election.

**Archived source account.** The Liberal Party win a pluralty of seats, and will remain in government, albeit as a minority and having lost the popular vote to the Conservative Party. The Bloc Québécois resurge from a 10-seat rump at dissolution to take third place and regain official party status.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC News](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/federal-election-results-2019-cbc-leaders-1.5329485>); [CTV News](<https://election.ctvnews.ca/trudeau-nabs-minority-government-loses-the-popular-vote-in-tumultuous-campaign-1.4649117>); [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2019/10/22/canadian-pm-justin-trudeaus-liberals-to-form-minority-government-cbc.html?fbclid=IwAR2PWNKinwA28zkBnZMZ0WVPVPlNCjTtvB8halERy_1AXme5HLfo4GR5bV8>).

<a id="event-2019-10-21-5-4"></a>

Context: 2019 Chilean protests.

**Archived source account.** Chilean President Sebastián Piñera says that Chile is "at war" and calls on citizens to take sides in the matter as violence continues in the capital and other cities.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/dead-santiago-supermarket-set-fire-191020052021604.html>); [Pensions and Investments](<https://www.pionline.com/economy/chilean-president-says-country-war-calls-people-choose-sides?fbclid=IwAR0d4qlQP4MWHmgWTLOgLeWSPJSNHEv9MofKRuaFN6uIdEj1lowObz8pfDk>).

<a id="event-2019-10-21-5-6"></a>

Context: 2019 Bolivian protests, 2019 Bolivian general election.

**Archived source account.** Protests break out across Bolivia in rejection of what are seen as fraudulent Presidential vote results.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-50134451>); [MSN](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/bolivian-protesters-flood-capital-as-morales-whisker-away-from-outright-victory/ar-AAJblIH?fbclid=IwAR1be3LJ1PY5ZZYBuUnFG2RUG4Z3SHPfbiM8sMMC3cLfUPuZH-HOdCnrw90>).

<a id="event-2019-10-21-5-8"></a>

Context: 2019–20 Lebanese protests.

**Archived source account.** The Lebanese government passes a series of economic measures, such as slashing government wages and extending financial aid to poor families, in an attempt to placate protestors.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-50118300>).

### 2019-10-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1284625687](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20October%2022&oldid=1284625687>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-10-22-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria, Second Northern Syria Buffer Zone.

**Archived source account.** Vladimir Putin and Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, presidents of Russia and Turkey respectively, reach an agreement in Sochi, which would end Turkey's offensive into Northern Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/22/middleeast/putin-erdogan-syria-deal-hodge-analysis-intl/index.html>); [CNN2](<https://www.cnn.com/middleeast/live-news/turkey-syria-10-22-2019/index.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-10-22-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Japanese imperial transition.

**Archived source account.** Japanese Emperor Naruhito officially proclaims his enthronement as the Emperor of Japan in an ancient enthronement ceremony held in the Imperial Palace in Tokyo, after ascending to the throne on 1 May. It was attended by about 2,000 guests with 420 foreign dignitaries.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/21/asia/japan-enthronement-emperor-intl-hnk/index.html>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-50120563>).

<a id="event-2019-10-22-1-3"></a>

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** An anonymous senior Donald Trump administration official, who in 2018 wrote a controversial New York Times op-ed called treasonous by President Trump, has written a book about the administration titled "A Warning," its publisher says. It will be released next month.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/anonymous-author-of-trump-resistance-op-ed-to-publish-a-tell-all-book/2019/10/22/b9ea2f42-f45a-11e9-ad8b-85e2aa00b5ce_story.html?fbclid=IwAR13nxOeNL47UJ0LeDCytXhsEm6Gq9kgbWkAgf4OKthDx_BdqtpGpMhxIrA>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-10-22-2-1"></a>

Context: Florida International University pedestrian bridge collapse.

**Archived source account.** The National Transportation Safety Board of the United States concludes its investigation into the accident, which killed six and injured ten. It states design errors were the immediate cause, exacerbated by failures to take appropriate remedial action when cracks were discovered.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://eu.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2019/10/22/design-error-blamed-florida-international-university-pedestrian-bridge-collapse/2449316001/>).

<a id="event-2019-10-22-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A convention centre catches fire in Auckland while still under construction, causing significant disruption in the CBD.

Source citations (as archived): [Stuff](<https://www.stuff.co.nz/national/116480357/fire-at-sky-city-convention-centre>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-10-22-3-1"></a>

Context: Crime in Norway.

**Archived source account.** Police officers in Oslo wound an armed 32-year-old man, who injured three people when he rammed a stolen ambulance into them. The police then arrest him and a 25-year-old woman, both of whom have connections to the Nordic Resistance Movement.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/22/injured-man-ambulance-oslo>); [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2019/10/22/armed-man-steals-ambulance-drives-crowds-oslo/>).

<a id="event-2019-10-22-3-3"></a>

Context: Manchester Arena bombing.

**Archived source account.** UK Home Secretary Priti Patel announces the inquests into the deaths of the victims will be converted into a public inquiry at the request of the coroner. This enables the hearing of evidence in secret by members of the intelligence community, which would otherwise not be available as the coroner had previously granted public interest immunity to the witnesses on the grounds of possible assistance to future terrorists were the evidence to be heard. Inquests cannot hear secret evidence.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2019/10/22/public-inquiry-held-manchester-terror-attack-allow-security/>).

<a id="event-2019-10-22-3-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Trump–Ukraine scandal, Impeachment inquiry into Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** Acting U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine William B. Taylor Jr. testifies before Congress that he had been told President Donald Trump would, to help his reelection chances, withhold military aid to Ukraine until that country publicly declared investigations would be launched into Burisma Holdings, a company that hired former Vice President Joe Biden's son Hunter, as well as Ukraine's alleged involvement in the 2016 U.S. presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [Salon](<https://www.salon.com/2019/10/22/trumps-ukraine-envoy-gives-congress-most-damning-evidence-yet-in-impeachment-probe/?fbclid=IwAR2x241HcpidjYTOLbyhc9lcj7EuiBo7koy5qKCIYefN2NGiUzP8ZxdzUjI>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-10-22-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Chilean protests.

**Archived source account.** According to candidate for Vice President of Argentina for the Together for Change alliance, Miguel Ángel Pichetto, there is a "destabilization plan in Latin America directly linked to Venezuela's and Cuba's governments' activities". Argentine Foreign Minister Jorge Faurie also expressed his concerns and said there were "calculated and identical methods of destabilization in the region". He blames Nicolás Maduro's government after Constituent Assembly President Diosdado Cabello says there is a "Bolivarian breeze" in the region.

Source citations (as archived): [Clarín](<https://www.clarin.com/politica/jorge-faurie-cree-protestas-region-accionar-coordinado-metodos-calcados-_0_YyR6TF-k.html>); [Buenos Aires Times](<https://www.batimes.com.ar/news/argentina/jorge-faurie-latin-america-threatened-by-bolivarian-hurricane.phtml?fbclid=IwAR2GmCyI2rZp0gcB0Yqe0Arn-KORFN1oJy2rCHS9FZZmlhWC0Ghm5yhnUAA>).

<a id="event-2019-10-22-4-3"></a>

Context: Abortion in Northern Ireland, Same-sex marriage in Northern Ireland.

**Archived source account.** As a result of the local government failing to reconvene in time, the Northern Ireland (Executive Formation etc) Act 2019 comes into effect. This means abortion is decriminalized in Northern Ireland, and same-sex marriage is scheduled to commence in February 2020.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-northern-ireland-50128860>).

<a id="event-2019-10-22-4-5"></a>

Context: Brexit.

**Archived source account.** The British Parliament votes 329 to 299 to pass the Withdrawal Agreement Bill, but then rejects the proposed timetable in a separate 322 to 308 vote. Speaker of the House of Commons John Bercow says the bill is now "in limbo", and Prime Minister Boris Johnson plans to consult with European Union leaders for the time being.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-50146182>).

### 2019-10-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1284625742](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20October%2023&oldid=1284625742>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-10-23-0-1"></a>

Context: Lion Air Flight 610, Boeing 737 MAX groundings.

**Archived source account.** Indonesian investigators meet with families of the deceased ahead of the release of their final report, scheduled for Friday. They state the crash was caused by design flaws with software on the aircraft, and inaccurate assessments by Boeing as to how pilots would respond to them.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/lion-air-boeing-737-max-design-flaws-tied-indonesia-crash-191023064944012.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-23-0-3"></a>

Context: Yirol Let L-410 Turbolet crash.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine releases the final report into the disaster, which was prepared by South Sudan. The report concludes mistakes by both crew and maintenance, as well as poor weather, combined to cause the crash.

Source citations (as archived): [The Aviation Herald](<http://avherald.com/h?article=4bd74c51&amp;opt=0>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-10-23-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pacific Gas and Electric is set to shut off power to 179,000 customers in Northern California due to an elevated wildfire risk, while Southern California Edison does so for 308,000 in Southern California.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/10/23/business/energy-environment/california-power.html>); [KTLA](<https://ktla.com/2019/10/23/socal-edison-could-cut-power-to-over-300000-customers-due-to-wildfire-risk/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-10-23-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria, Turkey–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The Trump administration lifts the sanctions it placed on Turkey, in response to the latter's ceasefire. While U.S. President Donald Trump states the ceasefire is permanent, he threatens to reinstate the sanctions if "something happens that we are not happy with".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-trump/trump-says-turkeys-ceasefire-in-northern-syria-now-permanent-sanctions-lifted-idUSKBN1X223P?il=0>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-10-23-3-1"></a>

Context: Essex lorry deaths.

**Archived source account.** Police discover 39 bodies inside a lorry container in Grays, Essex, UK. They had been transported from Zeebrugge, across the English Channel to Purfleet. The driver, a man from Northern Ireland, is arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2019/oct/23/driver-arrested-after-39-bodies-found-in-lorry-container-in-essex>).

<a id="event-2019-10-23-3-3"></a>

Context: Right-wing terrorism in the United Kingdom, Christchurch mosque shootings.

**Archived source account.** Two men are given prison sentences in the United Kingdom after they incited copycat attacks following mosque shootings in New Zealand. They were convicted of a series of terror offences.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-tyne-50161137>).

<a id="event-2019-10-23-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police in Albania say they have identified a terrorist cell in the country operated by the Revolutionary Guards of Iran and seeking to attack members of exiled Iranian anti-government group Mujahedin-e Khalq.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/23/albanian-police-say-iranian-terror-cell-planned-to-attack-exiles>).

<a id="event-2019-10-23-3-6"></a>

Context: Murder of Nusrat Jahan Rafi.

**Archived source account.** A court in Bangladesh sentences sixteen people to death after they burned a student alive when she reported sexual harassment by a teacher.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-50138990>).

<a id="event-2019-10-23-3-8"></a>

Context: 2019 Trump–Ukraine scandal.

**Archived source account.** At a hearing in New York City, Lev Parnas and Igor Fruman, two associates of U.S. President Donald Trump's personal lawyer Rudy Giuliani, who aided him with a search in Ukraine for detrimental information on President Trump's political opponents, plead not guilty to charges that they funneled $350,000 in illegal donations to a pro-Trump political committee and another $20,000 to former Republican Congressman Pete Sessions while acting on behalf of at least one Ukrainian government official.

Source citations (as archived): [AOL](<https://www.aol.com/article/news/2019/10/23/2-giuliani-associates-plead-not-guilty-in-campaign-finance-scheme/23845872/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-10-23-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Botswana general election.

**Archived source account.** Citizens of Botswana cast their vote to elect the members of the National Assembly and local government councils.

Source citations (as archived): [Eyewitness News](<https://ewn.co.za/2019/10/23/all-systems-go-for-botswana-elections>).

<a id="event-2019-10-23-4-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Chilean protests.

**Archived source account.** Chilean President Sebastián Piñera in a nationally televised address apologizes for the failures of the government and pledges economic reforms as violent protests continue in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [WJCT](<https://news.wjct.org/post/chile-president-apologizes-governments-failings-violent-protests-continue>).

<a id="event-2019-10-23-4-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Bolivian protests.

**Archived source account.** Evo Morales accuses opposition politicians of plotting a coup d'etat with foreign powers.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/23/bolivia-evo-morales-coup-accusation-opposition-foreign-powers>).

<a id="event-2019-10-23-4-7"></a>

Context: Stoneman Douglas High School shooting, Fort Lauderdale airport shooting.

**Archived source account.** In a special session of the Florida Senate, the chamber voted 25–15 to uphold the suspension of former Broward Sheriff Scott Israel for his agency's response to the mass shootings at both Ft. Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport and Parkland.

Source citations (as archived): [WPLG](<https://www.local10.com/news/politics/florida-senate-votes-to-uphold-decision-to-remove-sheriff-scott-israel-from-office>).

<a id="event-2019-10-23-4-9"></a>

Context: September 2019 Israeli legislative election.

**Archived source account.** President of Israel Reuven Rivlin tasks Leader of the Opposition Benny Gantz to try to form government after the failing of current Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/23/israeli-opposition-leader-benny-gantz-to-be-asked-to-form-government>).

### 2019-10-24

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1127423817](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20October%2024&oldid=1127423817>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-10-24-0-1"></a>

Context: Japan–South Korea relations, 2019 Japan–South Korea trade dispute.

**Archived source account.** Japan and South Korea hold a high-level bilateral meeting for the first time since the trade dispute, with Japanese Prime Minister Shinzō Abe meeting with his counterpart Lee Nak-yeon.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2019/10/24/national/politics-diplomacy/abe-meets-south-korean-prime-minister/#.XbFdXnPZHqA>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-10-24-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Grays incident.

**Archived source account.** The people found deceased in a lorry in Essex yesterday are suspected to be Chinese nationals.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-essex-50162617>).

<a id="event-2019-10-24-1-3"></a>

Context: Persecution of homosexuals in Uganda.

**Archived source account.** Ugandan authorities announce that they have arrested 16 LGBT activists on suspicion of gay sex.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/24/sixteen-lgbt-activists-arrested-in-uganda-as-hate-crimes-soar>).

<a id="event-2019-10-24-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** At the Old Bailey a UK jury convicts a British man who traveled to fight against the Islamic State of a terror offence for visiting a training camp used by the PKK. He is the first UK man found guilty of such a crime, and is remanded in custody to await his November 7 sentencing hearing.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-merseyside-50167158>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-10-24-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The remains of former Spanish dictator Francisco Franco are exhumed from Valle de los Caídos and are moved to a private mausoleum with his wife Carmen Polo, 44 years after his death. Some pro-Franco protestors gather outside the national mausoleum.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/10/24/europe/franco-exhumation-spain-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-24-2-2"></a>

Context: 2019–20 Lebanese protests.

**Archived source account.** As protests enter its eighth day, President Michel Aoun in a televised address states he is willing to meet with protestors and offers support for various reforms, such as increasing transparency for banks and lifting immunity for government officials. He however states that changes “can only happen through state institutions" in response to calls to bring down the government.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/waiting-lebanon-aoun-invites-protesters-talk-191024112324367.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-24-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Chicago Teachers Union's strike enters its sixth school day as it is unable to reach an agreement with Chicago Public Schools.

Source citations (as archived): [WMAQ-TV](<https://www.nbcchicago.com/news/local/cps-classes-canceled-for-sixth-day-thursday-chicago-teachers-strike-563728431.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-24-2-5"></a>

Context: Mueller special counsel investigation, Russia investigation origins counter-narrative.

**Archived source account.** U.S. federal prosecutor John Durham's ongoing probe into potential FBI and Justice Department misconduct in the time leading up to the 2016 presidential election through the spring of 2017 is upgraded to a formal criminal investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Post](<https://nypost.com/2019/10/24/justice-department-review-of-russia-probe-is-now-a-criminal-probe/?fbclid=IwAR0mmeqqYw9n-1vR6lZJFwmpZ9vEP9CM3ga6Kx4j90uOklSiEu5YY4XIeYU>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-10-24-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Brandon Taubman, the assistant general manager for the Houston Astros, is fired from his position for making "inappropriate comments" toward female journalists.

Source citations (as archived): [Forbes](<https://www.forbes.com/sites/barrymbloom/2019/10/24/brandon-taubman-fired-by-houston-astros-for-inappropriate-conduct/?fbclid=IwAR3s7kXzh1WPBjA2Hb54LCeTfKrE-cIg4IkeMFCyxhgE8Tq_u-eNeUyLyyI#6d40c3586d80>).

### 2019-10-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1263824809](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20October%2025&oldid=1263824809>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-10-25-0-1"></a>

Context: American-led intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Following the U.S. military withdrawal from northern Syria, the United States is to deploy more troops to Syria's eastern Deir ez-Zor Governorate to secure the country's petroleum gas and oilfields, according to a senior Department of Defense official.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/deploy-troops-eastern-syrian-secure-oil-fields-191025022517393.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-25-0-3"></a>

Context: 2018–19 Iraqi protests.

**Archived source account.** At least 40 people are killed and over 1,700 wounded when security forces violently clamp down on anti-government protestors in Iraq.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/iraqi-police-open-fire-disperse-protesters-baghdad-streets-191025075732647.html>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-50181212>).

<a id="event-2019-10-25-0-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Ethiopian riots.

**Archived source account.** Ethiopian police report on Friday that the death toll from violent protests in Oromia Region was 67, including five officers. The protests started on Wednesday when protestors accused Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed of acting dictatorial, but they quickly degenerated into ethnic clashes.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/25/ethiopia-protests-violence-nobel-peace-prize-prime-minister>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-10-25-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of tourists flock to Uluru in Australia's Northern Territory to climb it for the last time before the park's ban on climbing goes into effect. The ban is being implemented to respect the wishes of the indigenous Aṉangu people, who find Uluru sacred.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-australia-uluru/australias-uluru-closes-to-climbers-for-good-after-decades-long-fight-idUSKBN1X32S6>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-10-25-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Automobile Workers ends their 40-day strike against General Motors after a new contract is ratified.

Source citations (as archived): [MLive](<https://www.mlive.com/news/2019/10/uaw-ratifies-contract-ending-weeks-long-strike-against-gm.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-25-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** In a move that surprised insiders, Microsoft beats Amazon Web Services to win a $10 billion cloud computing contract with the United States Department of Defense.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-pentagon-jedi/microsoft-beats-amazon-for-pentagons-10-billion-cloud-computing-contract-idUKKBN1X42IS?il=0>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-10-25-3-1"></a>

Context: Lion Air Flight 610.

**Archived source account.** Indonesian investigators conclude their probe of the disaster with the release of a 353-page final report. The report states the crash was caused by a combination of flawed software design by Boeing, a failure of Lion Air to ground the jet over issues it had previously experienced, and inappropriate pilot responses to the developing emergency.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-50177788>).

<a id="event-2019-10-25-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A car collides with pedestrians and other vehicles after running two red lights while accelerating in central Shanghai. At least five are killed and nine more injured.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<https://www.scmp.com/news/china/society/article/3034535/rush-hour-smash-shanghai-kills-five-injures-nine>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-10-25-4-1"></a>

Context: Brexit negotiations.

**Archived source account.** The European Commission announces that the European Union has agreed to a further extension of the Brexit deadline. The length of the extension is yet to be decided.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-50175914>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-10-25-5-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Grays incident.

**Archived source account.** Liu Xiaoming, Chinese ambassador to the United Kingdom, announces he has sent a team to Essex to verify the identities of the 39 bodies found in a lorry this week, who are thought by UK authorities to be Chinese nationals. Post-mortems are due to begin today. The Northern Irish driver remains in police custody, suspected of murder.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-essex-50177820>).

<a id="event-2019-10-25-5-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Grays incident.

**Archived source account.** It is suspected that six of the victims are Vietnamese nationals. The family of one of them, a 19-year-old woman, made public her last text message to her parents which she sent while dying.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-50185788>).

<a id="event-2019-10-25-5-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Grays incident.

**Archived source account.** Two further people are arrested on suspicion of manslaughter and conspiracy to traffic people in connection to the case.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-essex-50179092>).

<a id="event-2019-10-25-5-5"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Turkey.

**Archived source account.** Turkish police arrest nine people on terrorism charges in Adana, including one foreign national. The men are suspected of Islamic State membership, recruiting for the group, and planning terrorist attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/turkey/turkey-arrests-9-daesh-linked-terror-suspects/1625951>).

<a id="event-2019-10-25-5-7"></a>

Context: Gorny shooting.

**Archived source account.** A Russian soldier shoots and kills eight fellow soldiers and wounds two others at a Russian Armed Forces base in the village of Gorny, Zabaykalsky Krai. Officials say the soldier is suspected of having a "nervous breakdown", according to Russian media.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-50184909>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-10-25-6-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Bolivian general election.

**Archived source account.** Official results announce that incumbent Bolivian president Evo Morales has achieved a great enough margin to win re-election, though the legitimacy of the electoral process has been questioned by protestors and international observers.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-50178188>).

<a id="event-2019-10-25-6-3"></a>

Context: 2019–20 Lebanese protests.

**Archived source account.** Hezbollah's Hassan Nasrallah calls on his supporters to leave the protests, warning the government's resignation will lead to "chaos" and "civil war". It comes the day after Hezbollah supporters violently clashed with protestors in central Beirut.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/hezbollah-head-gov-fall-push-lebanon-chaos-191025131157587.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-25-6-5"></a>

Context: Mueller report, Mueller special counsel investigation.

**Archived source account.** A federal judge rules the U.S. Justice Department must provide Congress with grand jury information redacted from special counsel Robert Mueller's investigation into Russian interference in the 2016 presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [The Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/mueller-grand-jury-materials-must-be-transmitted-to-congress-judge-rules-11572034351?fbclid=IwAR0kjSMfYOkLUf7QdrojapSz3L6rporE7XC1PuQ4jATB-dNzuS_mT6L8eYU>).

<a id="event-2019-10-25-6-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Chicago Teachers Union 2019 strike extends into its seventh schoolday, on-par with its 2012 strike. A Cook County judge is expected to hear an emergency injunction filed against the Illinois High School Association for not allowing student athletes within Chicago Public Schools participate in state playoffs, despite the IHSA's long-standing ban against teams from striking districts.

Source citations (as archived): [WGN-TV](<https://wgntv.com/2019/10/25/emergency-injunction-filed-to-allow-cps-student-athletes-to-compete-in-state-playoffs/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-10-25-7-1"></a>

Context: 2019–20 in English football.

**Archived source account.** Leicester City F.C. equals the 24-year record for the biggest ever Premier League win and the biggest ever victory by an away side in an English football top-flight game after beating Southampton F.C. 9–0 at St Mary's Stadium. It was also Southampton's worst ever defeat in all competitions in their history.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC Sport](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/50092694>).

### 2019-10-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 924283107](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20October%2026&oldid=924283107>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-10-26-0-1"></a>

Context: 2018–19 Iraqi protests, October 2019 Iraqi protests.

**Archived source account.** Fifteen more people are killed in clashes between security forces and protestors in Iraq, raising the overall death toll to 222 since protests began this month.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/killed-iraq-anti-government-protests-continue-191026155414026.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-protests/fifteen-killed-dozens-wounded-as-iraq-protests-flare-for-second-day-idUSKBN1X507K>).

<a id="event-2019-10-26-0-2"></a>

Context: 2018–19 Iraqi protests, October 2019 Iraqi protests.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Adil Abdul-Mahdi orders the elite Counter-Terrorism Service to quell the protests in the capital Baghdad and the southern city of Nasiriya.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://www.voanews.com/middle-east/nearly-50-dead-iraq-protests-take-new-violent-turn>).

<a id="event-2019-10-26-0-4"></a>

Context: 2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria, Second Northern Syria Buffer Zone.

**Archived source account.** Turkish Foreign Minister Mevlüt Çavuşoğlu rejects a proposal by German Defence Minister Annegret Kramp-Karrenbauer to establish a United Nations-mandated security zone in northeastern Syria, calling the plan "not very realistic".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/turkey-rejects-german-security-zone-plan-unrealistic-191026141506342.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-26-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sea-Eye, a charity which performs migrant rescue operations in the Mediterranean Sea, claims the Libyan coastguard circled their ship MV Alan Kurdi and fired warning shots into the air, with weapons pointed at crew and the migrants they were rescuing.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/libya-authorities-fire-warning-shots-at-migrant-rescue-ship/a-51001668>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-10-26-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Flooding in Japan kills nine people in Chiba and one more in Fukushima, with a further person missing in the latter.

Source citations (as archived): [Gulf News](<https://gulfnews.com/world/asia/flood-mudslides-from-heavy-rain-in-japan-kill-at-least-10-1.67408304>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-10-26-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Times reports that the Barclay family is looking to sell The Daily Telegraph and The Sunday Telegraph, citing conflicting viewpoints within the family and low circulation. The Daily Mail, Amazon CEO Jeff Bezos, and Evening Standard owner Evgeny Lebedev are rumored to be potential buyers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-britain-divestiture-telegraph/barclay-family-puts-telegraph-newspapers-up-for-sale-the-times-idUKKBN1X42IE>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-50192912>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-10-26-3-1"></a>

Context: Trial of Catalonia independence leaders; 2019 Catalan protests.

**Archived source account.** In a demonstration in Barcelona, 350,000 people protest prison sentences given to Catalan leaders. The protest turns violent with clashes with National Police Corps and Mossos d'Esquadra.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/2019/10/26/catalonia-braces-for-more-protests-as-separatists-set-to-rally-in-barcelona>); [La Vanguardia](<https://www.lavanguardia.com/politica/20191026/471203818849/manifestacion-independentista-barcelona-26-octubre-contra-sentencia-juicio-proces-via-laietana-calle-marina-en-directo.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-26-3-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Grays incident.

**Archived source account.** The driver of the lorry in which 39 bodies were found is charged with 39 counts of manslaughter, as well as immigration offences, money laundering, and people trafficking. Three other people remain in police custody suspected of manslaughter and people trafficking after 39 bodies were found in a lorry earlier this week.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-essex-50196265>).

### 2019-10-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1249281086](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20October%2027&oldid=1249281086>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-10-27-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, American-led intervention in the Syrian Civil War, International military intervention against ISIL, Barisha raid.

**Archived source account.** Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi, leader of the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant, is believed to have died in a suicide bombing after U.S.-led coalition special forces raid targeted positions belonging to Huras al-Din in Syria's rebel-held Idlib Governorate. U.S. President Donald Trump makes a statement at 9:00 AM EDT (1300 UTC) asserting his death.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://www.voanews.com/usa/leader-targeted-us-forces-believed-dead-trump-make-statement>); [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-mideast-crisis-baghdadi-group-factbox/baghdadis-death-a-major-blow-to-islamic-state-idUKKBN1X60F3?r>).

<a id="event-2019-10-27-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, American-led intervention in the Syrian Civil War, International military intervention against ISIL, Barisha raid.

**Archived source account.** Abul-Hasan al-Muhajir, the official spokesman of ISIL, is killed in a second operation near Jarabulus in northwest Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [BNO News](<https://bnonews.com/index.php/2019/10/u-s-targets-senior-isis-leader-in-northwest-syria/>).

<a id="event-2019-10-27-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, American-led intervention in the Syrian Civil War, International military intervention against ISIL, Barisha raid.

**Archived source account.** France is put on high alert due to concerns of ISIL revenge attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-baghdadi-france-vigila/france-on-high-alert-for-revenge-attacks-following-death-of-baghdadi-idUSKBN1X60OD?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-10-27-0-5"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** Over 80 Taliban members are killed in Afghan and U.S. airstrikes.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/afghan-forces-kill-80-taliban-fighters-officials-191027103220070.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-27-0-6"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** A bomb planted on a foreign tank wounds a soldier at Kandahar International Airport. The nationality of the military concerned is unknown.

Source citations (as archived): [Gulf News](<https://gulfnews.com/world/asia/explosion-near-kandahar-airport-in-afghanistan-1.1572165677865>).

<a id="event-2019-10-27-0-7"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** An improvised explosive device planted by the Taliban detonates when a child steps on a pressure plate in Pashtun Kot. The explosion kills five, all children. A sixth child survives but is injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua News Agency](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-10/27/c_138507298.htm>).

<a id="event-2019-10-27-0-9"></a>

Context: 2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria, Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Clashes take place between Turkish forces and the Syrian Army in the town of Ras al-Ain, with an undetermined number of casualties.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-syria-security-turkey-clashes/clashes-between-turkish-forces-and-syrian-army-in-north-syria-sana-idUKKBN1X60BA>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-10-27-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Hong Kong economy enters into a recession, as a result of continuous protests from the past five months.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-hongkong-protests/hong-kong-enters-recession-as-protests-show-no-sign-of-relenting-idUKKBN1X706B?il=0>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-10-27-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 California wildfires.

**Archived source account.** Further evacuations are ordered, with 180,000 people now affected. Power companies are scheduled to cut supplies for a million people today, doubling the size of what is already the biggest blackout in California history in a bid to prevent further fires igniting from damaged electric cables.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-50196185>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-10-27-3-1"></a>

Context: North Korea–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The government of North Korea says that it is "running out of patience with the U.S." due to "unilateral hostile disarmament demands" and warns that the cordial relationship between Kim Jong-un and Donald Trump would not prevent the talks from derailing.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/north-korea-running-patience-us-66555929>).

<a id="event-2019-10-27-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Since convening on 6 October, the synod of Catholic bishops from Bolivia, Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, French Guiana, Guyana, Peru, Venezuela, and Suriname gather with Pope Francis in Rome. According to the bishops, "a deep personal, social and structural conversion" is needed in response to the "unprecedented" environmental and social crisis in the Amazon.

Source citations (as archived): [Catholic News Service](<https://www.catholicnews.com/services/englishnews/2019/caring-for-common-home-requires-deep-ecological-conversion-synod-says.cfm>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-10-27-4-1"></a>

Context: Essex lorry deaths.

**Archived source account.** Three people arrested on suspicion of manslaughter and conspiracy to traffic people after 39 deaths in a lorry earlier this week are released on police bail as Essex Police continue their investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-essex-50197691>).

<a id="event-2019-10-27-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two men die and ten others are injured in a mass shooting at a Halloween party in Greenville, Texas.

Source citations (as archived): [KXAS-TV](<https://www.nbcdfw.com/news/local/Mass-Shooting-Reported-at-Homecoming-Party-in-Greenville-Outside-of-Dallas-563934821.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-10-27-5-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Chilean protests.

**Archived source account.** Chilean President Sebastián Piñera fires all sitting ministers of his government.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-50197673>).

<a id="event-2019-10-27-5-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Argentine general election.

**Archived source account.** Argentinian voters go to the polls to elect a new president. Though the margin is lower than what opinion polls predicted, Alberto Fernández of the left-wing Justicialist Party beats incumbent Mauricio Macri of the center-right Republican Proposal. Macri becomes the first president in Argentinian history to lose his reelection bid.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/argentina-rejects-austerity-elect-alberto-fernandez-president-191028004353278.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-27-5-5"></a>

Context: 2018–19 Iraqi protests, October 2019 Iraqi protests.

**Archived source account.** Several universities and schools shut down as many students join the protests across Iraq. Thousands continue to participate in spite of the violent crackdowns from the previous days.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/iraqi-students-join-thousands-ongoing-anti-gov-protests-191027201126667.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-27-5-7"></a>

Context: 2019–20 Lebanese protests.

**Archived source account.** Nearly 170,000 protestors form a 105 mile (170 km) human chain running from Tyre to Tripoli to symbolize their solidarity.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/lebanon-protesters-form-human-chain-country-191027113442407.html>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/27/middleeast/lebanon-human-chain-trnd/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-27-5-9"></a>

Context: 2019 Omani general election.

**Archived source account.** Citizens of Oman vote for the members of the country's Consultative Assembly.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Oman](<https://timesofoman.com/article/2131951/Oman/Government/We-voted-for-our-country>).

<a id="event-2019-10-27-5-11"></a>

Context: 2019 Uruguayan general election.

**Archived source account.** People in Uruguay vote for their next president and the members of the country's senate and Chamber of Representatives.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-uruguay-election/uruguay-heads-to-the-polls-with-tight-race-expected-idUSKBN1X60JI>).

<a id="event-2019-10-27-5-13"></a>

Context: 2019 Catalan protests.

**Archived source account.** In Barcelona, 80,000 demonstrators take to the streets in protest of the Independent politics of the Catalan government and the violence of the last weeks' pro-independence protests, and for the unity and democracy of Spain.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-spain-politics-catalonia/catalonia-divided-barcelona-hosts-unionist-rally-a-day-after-separatist-march-idUSKBN1X60K0>).

<a id="event-2019-10-27-5-15"></a>

Context: Politics of Belgium.

**Archived source account.** Sophie Wilmès becomes the first female Prime Minister of Belgium, succeeding Charles Michel.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/28/belgium-first-female-pm-sophie-wilmes>).

<a id="event-2019-10-27-5-16"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. Democratic Congresswoman Katie Hill of California announces her resignation days after admitting to having a relationship with a campaign staffer before coming into office.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/27/politics/katie-hill-announces-resignation/index.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-10-27-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The uncrewed Boeing X-37B spacecraft returns to Earth after spending a record 780 days in orbit. The nature of the X-37B's mission remains classified information.

Source citations (as archived): [United States Air Force](<https://www.af.mil/News/Article-Display/Article/1999734/x-37b-breaks-record-lands-after-780-days-in-orbit/>); [Space](<https://www.space.com/x-37b-space-plane-otv5-lands-after-780-days.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-10-27-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In golf, Tiger Woods wins the inaugural Zozo Championship in Japan by three shots over Hideki Matsuyama for his 82nd career PGA Tour title, tying him with Sam Snead atop the all-time list.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<https://www.espn.com/golf/story/_/id/27945812/tiger-woods-takes-82nd-pga-tour-title-tying-sam-snead-atop-list>).

### 2019-10-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1200602424](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20October%2028&oldid=1200602424>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-10-28-0-1"></a>

Context: Afghanistan–Pakistan barrier.

**Archived source account.** Three women are killed after Afghan and Pakistani forces clash in Kunar Province.

Source citations (as archived): [CityNews Vancouver](<https://www.citynews1130.com/2019/10/28/afghan-official-pakistani-forces-open-fire-killing-3-women/>).

<a id="event-2019-10-28-0-3"></a>

Context: Kashmir conflict.

**Archived source account.** Twenty people are injured in a grenade attack in Sopore.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-india-kashmir-eu/india-allows-eu-lawmakers-into-kashmir-in-first-foreign-visit-since-clampdown-idUSKBN1X716L>).

<a id="event-2019-10-28-0-6"></a>

Context: Maghreb insurgency / Pobé Mengao shooting.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen kill 16 people after they refused to help buy them ammunition. The attack happened in the village of Pobé Mengao in Burkina Faso.

Source citations (as archived): [Jeune Afrique](<https://www.jeuneafrique.com/848805/politique/burkina-faso-au-moins-15-civils-tues-dans-le-nord-du-pays/>).

<a id="event-2019-10-28-0-8"></a>

Context: Bayonne mosque shooting.

**Archived source account.** A gunman opens fire on a mosque in Bayonne, Nouvelle-Aquitaine, France, wounding two before being detained. The perpetrator is an 84-year-old man who ran for the National Front in the 2015 regional elections.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2019/10/28/france-mosque-shooting-man-arrested-two-shot-bayonne/>).

<a id="event-2019-10-28-0-10"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** An improvised explosive device detonates in a partially constructed building in Bati Kot, Afghanistan. The bomb kills two labourers and injures five more, three seriously.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua News Agency](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-10/28/c_138509726.htm>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-10-28-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis officially renames the Vatican Secret Archive to the Vatican Apostolic Archive.

Source citations (as archived): [Detroit News](<https://www.detroitnews.com/story/news/world/2019/10/28/pope-declares-vaticans-secret-archive-secret-anymore/40451171/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-10-28-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An explosion kills five people at a petroleum plant in Shaanxi, China. A further three are missing.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<https://www.scmp.com/news/china/society/article/3035190/china-oil-plant-explosion-leaves-five-dead>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-10-28-3-1"></a>

Context: Impeachment inquiry into Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** Charles Kupperman, U.S. President Donald Trump's former deputy national security adviser, defies a congressional subpoena to testify before the House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence regarding the impeachment inquiry into President Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/28/politics/charles-kupperman-no-show-deposition/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-10-28-4-1"></a>

Context: Brexit negotiations.

**Archived source account.** The European Union agrees to delay the deadline again for a Brexit deal until January 31, 2020.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-50205603>).

<a id="event-2019-10-28-4-3"></a>

Context: October 2019 Iraqi protests.

**Archived source account.** The Iraqi government enacts a curfew in Baghdad as renewed protests enters its fourth day.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/iraq-declares-curfew-ongoing-mass-anti-government-poritests-191028134431588.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-28-4-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Chilean protests.

**Archived source account.** President Sebastián Piñera changes eight ministries of his cabinet, notably with Interior Minister Andrés Chadwick and Financial Minister Felipe Larraín Bascuñán being replaced with Gonzalo Blumel and Ignacio Briones respectively. New rounds of protests and riots erupt in Santiago and other cities after the announcement.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-50207883>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/28/chile-president-sebastian-pinera-replaces-cabinet-protests>).

<a id="event-2019-10-28-4-7"></a>

Context: 2019–20 Lebanese protests.

**Archived source account.** Central Bank Governor Riad Salame says the economy of Lebanon is "days" away from collapsing.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/10/28/middleeast/lebanon-salame-economy-collapse-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-28-4-9"></a>

Context: Impeachment inquiry into Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. House of Representatives announces it will vote this week to formalize the impeachment inquiry into President Donald Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/28/politics/house-impeachment-procedure-vote/index.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-10-28-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A study by Garvan Institute of Medical Research in Sydney, and headed by geneticist Vanessa Hayes, pinpoints the Okavango region in northern Botswana as the origin of modern humans. Other scientists express skepticism at this, particularly at the study's primary evidence coming from mitochondrial DNA.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-50210701>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/science/2019/oct/28/ancestral-home-of-modern-humans-is-in-botswana-study-finds>); [Nature](<https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-019-1714-1>).

### 2019-10-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1258538610](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20October%2029&oldid=1258538610>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2019-10-29-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** WhatsApp sues Israeli cyber intelligence firm NSO Group for allegedly spying on 1,400 users on four continents. Among those affected were diplomats, journalists, and government officials. If moved forward, it could set a major legal precedent for cybersecurity.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-facebook-cyber-whatsapp-nsogroup/whatsapp-sues-israels-nso-for-allegedly-helping-spies-hack-phones-around-the-world-idUSKBN1X82BE?il=0>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-10-29-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Cotabato earthquakes.

**Archived source account.** A magnitude 6.6 earthquake strikes the southern part of the island of Mindanao, killing at least eight.

Source citations (as archived): [GMA News and Public Affairs](<https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/news/regions/713664/magnitude-6-5-earthquake-rocks-southern-phl/story/>).

<a id="event-2019-10-29-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 42 people were killed during a landslide caused by torrential rainfall in the city of Bafoussam, Cameroon. Twenty-six of the victims are children.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/dozens-dead-cameroon-landslide-torrential-rain-191029180802994.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-29-1-4"></a>

Context: South Airlines Flight 8971.

**Archived source account.** The National Bureau of Air Accidents Investigation of Ukraine concludes its investigation, stating the accident was caused by the pilot's excessive speed reductions as he attempted to land in weather conditions beyond his qualifications.

Source citations (as archived): [The Aviation Herald](<http://avherald.com/h?article=45db0756&amp;opt=0>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-10-29-2-1"></a>

Context: Turkey–United States relations, Armenia–United States relations, Armenian Genocide recognition.

**Archived source account.** The United States House of Representatives votes 405 to 11 to officially recognize the Armenian Genocide as a genocide for the first time. Turkey condemns the resolution, describing it as "a meaningless political step", and that "its sole addressees are the Armenian lobby and anti-Turkey groups".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-turkey-armenia/u-s-house-backs-measure-recognizing-armenian-genocide-idUSKBN1X82LY>).

<a id="event-2019-10-29-2-3"></a>

Context: Israel–Jordan relations.

**Archived source account.** Jordan recalls its ambassador to Israel when the latter refuses to release two Jordanian citizens whom Foreign Affairs Minister Ayman Safadi says have been held illegally for months without charges. They were arrested in August for crossing into the West Bank to attend a family wedding.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-jordan-israel-envoy/jordan-recalls-envoy-to-israel-to-protest-detention-of-two-citizens-idUSKBN1X82JI>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-10-29-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019–20 Lebanese protests.

**Archived source account.** Lebanese Prime Minister Saad Hariri submits his resignation to President Michel Aoun.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/lebanon-pm-saad-hariri-offers-resignation-mass-protests-191029123235727.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-29-3-3"></a>

Context: October 2019 Iraqi protests.

**Archived source account.** Shia cleric Muqtada al-Sadr, who heads the current ruling bloc, calls on the opposition to help him introduce a motion of no confidence against Prime Minister Adil Abdul-Mahdi.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-protests-sadr/iraqs-sadr-calls-on-rival-to-join-him-in-ousting-pm-idUSKBN1X825R?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-10-29-3-5"></a>

Context: 2019 United Kingdom general election.

**Archived source account.** The House of Commons votes 438 to 20 to approve Prime Minister Boris Johnson’s call to hold a general election on December 12.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-britain-eu/britain-set-for-december-12-election-to-break-the-brexit-deadlock-idUKKBN1X80QT>).

### 2019-10-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1293474893](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20October%2030&oldid=1293474893>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-10-30-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A motorcycle bomb explodes in front of a hotel in Spin Boldak, Kandahar Province, Afghanistan. Seven are wounded.

Source citations (as archived): [Hindustan Times](<https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/7-injured-after-bomb-laden-motorbike-explodes-in-afghanistan/story-awtrPHlufmoUfOjg2YoS7J.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-30-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Afghan army, together with its international partners, launch a series of counterterrorism airstrikes in Kandahar, Uruzgan and Zabul, killing 58, including a Taliban governor. Ten mines are also destroyed.

Source citations (as archived): [Hindustan Times](<https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/airstrikes-in-southeast-afghanistan-kill-47-terrorists-afghan-military-spokesperson/story-ScvIHdN8oHwqkV8eHvaUQL.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-30-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian peace process.

**Archived source account.** The first meeting of the Syrian Constitutional Committee takes place in Geneva in a bid to end the country's eight-year-long civil war.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-un/syria-constitutional-panel-launched-amid-scepticism-idUSKBN1X919S?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=worldNews&amp;&amp;rpc=401>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2019-10-30-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Twitter announces it will ban all political ads on its platform starting November 22.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-50243306>).

<a id="event-2019-10-30-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A man, 66-year-old Coy Featherson, homeless for 20 years, finds a permanent home, with the help of friends who had known him since middle school.

Source citations (as archived): [People](<https://people.com/human-interest/friends-locate-homeless-childhood-pal/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-10-30-2-1"></a>

Context: 2013 Glasgow helicopter crash.

**Archived source account.** The fatal accident inquiry into the crash concludes with the issuing of a report by Sheriff Principal Craig Turnbull. Turnbull criticises the helicopter's pilot, prompting concerns by some victims over excessive blame being placed upon pilot error. The aircraft crashed into a bar after running out of fuel.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-glasgow-west-50220838>).

<a id="event-2019-10-30-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A fire destroys much of the 500-year-old Shuri Castle in Shuri, Okinawa, Japan, which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

Source citations (as archived): [NHK World-Japan](<https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20191031_09/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-10-30-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Samoa assassination plot.

**Archived source account.** After months of delay, the Supreme Court of Samoa accepts a closed court bail hearing for two defendants accused of attempting to assassinate Prime Minister of Samoa Tuilaepa Sailele Malielegaoi. A third defendant who pleaded guilty is due to be sentenced on November 1.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/402127/samoa-s-highest-court-approves-closed-bail-hearing>).

<a id="event-2019-10-30-3-3"></a>

Context: Murder of Aya Maasarwe.

**Archived source account.** A court in Australia sentences Maasarwe's confessed killer, Codey Herrmann, to 36 years in prison with parole eligibility after 30 for rape and murder. The case prompted widespread debate about violence against women in Australia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-australia-50216172>).

<a id="event-2019-10-30-3-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Chilean protests.

**Archived source account.** Due to the escalation in the protests, President Sebastián Piñera announces the cancellation of the 2019 APEC Summit and the United Nations Climate Change Conference, due to be hosted in Santiago in the following weeks.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-10-30/chile-cancels-apec-summit-in-santiago-amid-wave-of-protests>).

<a id="event-2019-10-30-3-7"></a>

Context: Death of Jeffrey Epstein.

**Archived source account.** Dr. Michael Baden, a medical examiner who observed the autopsy of Jeffrey Epstein, says that it shows signs consistent with homicide.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News](<https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment/famed-forensic-pathologist-dr-michael-151656473.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-30-3-9"></a>

Context: Crime in California.

**Archived source account.** A mass shooting at a Halloween party at a residence in Long Beach, California, by at least one gunman, who is believed to have targeted the party but to have fired at random, kills three and injures at least nine, with some having significant injuries.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/3-dead-9-hurt-in-long-beach-shooting/ar-AAJz2jC?ocid=spartanntp>).

<a id="event-2019-10-30-3-11"></a>

Context: Censorship in Myanmar.

**Archived source account.** A court in Yangon convicts five members of satirical thangyat troupe Peacock Generation over an April performance in which they lampoon the nation's military. They each are jailed for one year.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<http://bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-50238031>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-10-30-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 World Series.

**Archived source account.** The Washington Nationals beat the Houston Astros 6–2 in Game 7 to win the World Series. It is the franchise's first World Series championship and the first World Series victory for an MLB team based in the district since the Washington Senators (now known as the Minnesota Twins) won in 1924. This World Series is also notable as the first in which all games were won by the visiting team.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/mlb/playoffs/2019/10/31/washington-nationals-world-series-houston-astros/4105149002/>).

### 2019-10-31

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1200602580](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20October%2031&oldid=1200602580>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-10-31-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** ISIL confirms the deaths of its leader Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi and its spokesman Abul-Hasan al-Muhajir, and names Abu Ibrahim al-Hashimi al-Qurayshi as its new leader.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/isil-confirms-death-leader-al-baghdadi-names-chief-191031151709004.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-31-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A car bomb in Afrin kills nine people and wounds over 14 others. No one has claimed responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://www.voanews.com/middle-east/car-bomb-turkish-held-part-syria-kills-least-8>).

<a id="event-2019-10-31-0-4"></a>

Context: Islamist insurgency in Mozambique.

**Archived source account.** Seven Russian defense contractors from the Wagner Group and 20 Mozambican soldiers are reportedly killed in attacks by Salafi jihadists in northern Mozambique.

Source citations (as archived): [The Moscow Times](<https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2019/10/31/7-kremlin-linked-mercenaries-killed-in-mozambique-in-october-sources-a67996>).

<a id="event-2019-10-31-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A rocket is fired from the Gaza Strip, exploding in an open field in southern Israel. The IDF retaliates by launching strikes against two Hamas military posts.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jewish Press](<https://www.jewishpress.com/news/israel/idf/idf-attacks-hamas-military-posts-in-gaza/2019/10/31/>); [Xinhua News Agency](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-11/01/c_138519266.htm>).

<a id="event-2019-10-31-0-7"></a>

Context: Allied Democratic Forces insurgency.

**Archived source account.** The Armed Forces of DR Congo (FARDC) began a new large scale offensive against the Allied Democratic Forces rebel group in the Congo's North Kivu province.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/dr-congo-launches-large-scale-operation-rebels-191101163242390.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-31-0-9"></a>

Context: Ansar al-Islam.

**Archived source account.** Ansar al-Islam claims responsibility for an IED explosion that killed three soldiers in Iraq's Diyala Province. This was their first attack since 2013.

Source citations (as archived): [Long War Journal](<https://www.longwarjournal.org/archives/2019/10/ansar-al-islam-claims-first-attack-in-iraq-since-2014.php>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-10-31-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An archaeologist discovers a 25 m-wide ring cairn dating back to the Bronze Age near Tidenham, Gloucestershire.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-gloucestershire-50208092>).

<a id="event-2019-10-31-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** American rock band My Chemical Romance announces their reunion and first show in seven years.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/31/entertainment/my-chemical-romance/index.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-10-31-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ana Botín, the chairwoman of Spain's Santander bank, which has suffered a major stock price fall since reporting its disappointing third quarter earnings, buys €3.61 million worth of shares as a display of confidence.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-banco-santander-stocks-chairman/santander-chairman-buys-3-61-million-euros-of-bank-shares-as-price-falls-idUSKBN1XA2DT>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-10-31-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Tezgam train fire.

**Archived source account.** A train catches fire in Liaquatpur Tehsil, Rahim Yar Khan District, Punjab, Pakistan. The blaze, apparently sparked by gas stoves used by passengers illegally cooking on board, kills at least 74 people.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-50245090>).

<a id="event-2019-10-31-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Firefighters in Hungary save 20,000 baby birds in the wake of a barn fire that broke out earlier this week.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/video/animals/make-way-for-ducklings-firefighters-save-20000-baby-birds/vi-AAJDtx9?ocid=spartanntp>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-10-31-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police in Papua New Guinea withdraw the arrest warrant issued against former Prime Minister Peter O'Neill, who was accused of corruption.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/402205/png-police-withdraw-former-pm-s-arrest-warrant>).

<a id="event-2019-10-31-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mongolian police arrest 800 Chinese citizens and confiscate hundreds of computers and SIM cards in Ulaanbaatar. Authorities believe they were part of a cybercrime ring involved in illegal gambling, hacking and identity theft, among other activities.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mongolia-crime-china/mongolia-arrests-800-chinese-citizens-in-cybercrime-probe-idUSKBN1XA0NW?utm_source=reddit.com>).

<a id="event-2019-10-31-4-3"></a>

Context: Orinda shooting.

**Archived source account.** Police say five people were shot dead and another four injured at a Halloween party in Orinda, California. An investigation is currently underway.

Source citations (as archived): [San Francisco Chronicle](<https://www.sfchronicle.com/crime/article/4-people-killed-at-Orinda-house-party-reports-say-14767586.php>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-10-31-5-1"></a>

Context: Presidency of Jair Bolsonaro.

**Archived source account.** Brazilian Congressman Eduardo Bolsonaro threatens to introduce a "new AI-5" in response to opposition to the government headed by his father, Jair Bolsonaro.

Source citations (as archived): [GloboNews](<https://oglobo.globo.com/brasil/eduardo-bolsonaro-se-esquerda-radicalizar-resposta-pode-ser-via-um-novo-ai-5-2-24053268?versao=amp>).

<a id="event-2019-10-31-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** India formally splits Jammu and Kashmir into two union territories, dubbed Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh. Both entities will be directly governed from New Delhi.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-50233281>).

<a id="event-2019-10-31-5-4"></a>

Context: 2019–20 Lebanese protests.

**Archived source account.** Days after Prime Minister Saad Hariri resigned, both France and Hezbollah call for quick formation of a new government, saying that reforms are needed to deal with Lebanon's economic crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lebanon-protests/lebanons-hezbollah-france-call-for-new-government-idUSKBN1XA19D?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-10-31-5-5"></a>

Context: 2019–20 Lebanese protests.

**Archived source account.** President Michel Aoun pledges that the new government will consist of technocrats.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lebanon-protests-aoun/lebanons-president-aoun-pledges-cabinet-of-technocrats-in-new-government-idUSKBN1XA2I6?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-10-31-5-7"></a>

Context: Impeachment inquiry into Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. House of Representatives votes 232 to 196 to approve a resolution formalizing the procedures of the impeachment inquiry into President Donald Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/31/politics/house-impeachment-inquiry-resolution-floor-vote/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-10-31-5-9"></a>

Context: 2019 Bolivian protests, 2019 Bolivian general election.

**Archived source account.** Two men are killed in a town in Santa Cruz, Bolivia, during protests and riots over the disputed general election on 20 October.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-10-31/two-killed-in-bolivia-s-post-election-riots-as-violence-spreads>).

<a id="event-2019-10-31-5-10"></a>

Context: 2019 Bolivian protests, 2019 Bolivian general election.

**Archived source account.** The Organization of American States, with Spain, Mexico and Paraguay as observers, begins its audit of the election results.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-50248739>).

<a id="event-2019-10-31-5-12"></a>

Context: 2019 Iraqi protests.

**Archived source account.** In Iraq, Prime Minister Adil Abdul Mahdi agrees to resign after weeks of anti-government protests.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/31/middleeast/iraq-prime-minister-resigns-intl/index.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-10-31-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Researchers discover a shipwreck at a depth of \{\{convert\|20,400\|feet\|m\}\} under the Philippine Sea. The shipwreck is believed to be the remains of USS Johnston, a World War II-era destroyer.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/video/science/us-wwii-vessel-is-deepest-shipwreck-ever-found/vi-AAJE4Vn?ocid=spartanntp>).


## November

### 2019-11-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1048555392](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20November%201&oldid=1048555392>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-11-01-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Ménaka attack.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen kill 53 soldiers and a civilian in a mass shooting in Ménaka Region, Mali.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence, the House Committee on Oversight and Reform and the House Committee on Foreign Affairs release the transcripts of the first two closed-door depositions in the impeachment inquiry into President Donald Trump. The testimonies are that of former Ambassador to Ukraine Marie Yovanovitch and former Ambassador to Brazil Michael McKinley. Yovanovitch said she felt threatened by President Trump, while McKinley said that he resigned from his position because he was concerned about "the engagement of our missions to procure negative political information for domestic purposes," something he says he had never observed the State Department try to take part in throughout his career, with the exception of the Trump administration.
