#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-11-05-1-1"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in the Cook Islands.

**Archived source account.** The Cook Islands announces it will retain its ban on homosexual practices by men and that it will be extended to women as well. Homosexuals face up to seven years of imprisonment on the islands.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/402530/cook-islands-retains-ban-on-homosexuality>).

<a id="event-2019-11-05-1-3"></a>

Context: Crime in Italy.

**Archived source account.** Three firefighters are killed while two others and a policeman are injured after an explosion at an abandoned farm building in Quargnento, Piedmont, Italy. The explosion was caused by two bombs placed in the building.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<https://www.foxnews.com/world/italy-firefighters-killed-explosion>).

<a id="event-2019-11-05-1-5"></a>

Context: Murder of Ana Kriégel.

**Archived source account.** An Irish judge sentences two 15-year-old boys to jail for the 2018 murder of 14-year-old Ana Kriégel in suburban Dublin. The boys were 13-years-old at the time they murdered her and are the youngest people convicted of murder in Ireland. They have not been named due to their age. One boy was sentenced to life in detention to be reviewed after twelve years—he was also sentenced to eight years for sexual assault to run concurrently with the murder sentence. The other boy was sentenced to 15 years in prison, but his sentence will be reviewed after eight years instead of twelve. Her parents said that "justice has been served for Ana", but about the sentences that "forever is not long enough".

Source citations (as archived): [RTE News and Current Affairs](<https://www.rte.ie/news/ireland/2019/1105/1088699-kriegel-sentencing/>); [RTE News and Current Affairs2](<https://www.rte.ie/news/courts/2019/1105/1088828-ana-kriegel/>).

<a id="event-2019-11-05-1-7"></a>

Context: Impeachment inquiry into Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** Gordon Sondland, the United States Ambassador to the European Union, reverses his previous testimony, admitting to a quid pro quo in the withholding of military aid for Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/11/05/us/politics/impeachment-trump.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-11-05-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Virginia elections, 2019 Kentucky gubernatorial election.

**Archived source account.** Democrats win majorities in both houses of the Virginia General Assembly (Senate and House), resulting in Democratic trifecta control of the governorship and General Assembly for the first time since 1993. Democratic Kentucky Attorney General Andy Beshear defeats Republican incumbent Matt Bevin to win the governorship of Kentucky.

Source citations (as archived): [Vox](<https://www.vox.com/policy-and-politics/2019/11/5/20944109/virginia-elections-legislature-results-democrats>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/polls-open-in-virginia-balance-of-power-in-state-government-is-at-stake/2019/11/05/bdb57972-ff5b-11e9-8501-2a7123a38c58_story.html>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/11/05/politics/virginia-election-democrats-control/index.html>).

### 2019-11-06

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1057714916](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20November%206&oldid=1057714916>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-11-06-0-1"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Tajikistan.

**Archived source account.** Twenty gunmen open fire around a border checkpoint between Tajikistan and Uzbekistan, killing a border guard and a policeman. Fifteen assailants are killed and five others captured.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/isil-blamed-deadly-attack-tajik-border-outpost-191106084341568.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-06-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A knife-wielding man launched a random assault wounding eight people, including four foreign tourists and four locals, before being arrested in Jerash, Jordan. A Mexican tourist and a Jordanian tour guide are seriously injured. Among the injured there is a bus driver stabbed while trying to stop the assailant from entering a cafeteria full of tourists.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-50316093>).

<a id="event-2019-11-06-0-4"></a>

Context: Allied Democratic Forces insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Ten civilians are killed by ADF militiamen who crossed the border from Uganda into the Beni Territory, North Kivu, DR Congo.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20191106-10-civilians-killed-in-militia-attack-in-eastern-drcongo>).

<a id="event-2019-11-06-0-6"></a>

Context: Insurgency in the Maghreb.

**Archived source account.** Thirty-seven people are dead and 60 others are injured after gunmen attack a Canadian gold mining company convoy on a road in Burkina Faso.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-50326743>).

<a id="event-2019-11-06-0-7"></a>

Context: Insurgency in the Maghreb.

**Archived source account.** France announces it will send ground troops to three border areas in Burkina Faso.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/france-announces-troop-deployment-burkina-faso-191106133819577.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-06-0-9"></a>

Context: 2019 Yala attack.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen kill 15 people and injure five at a security checkpoint in Yala Province, Thailand. The attack is the most deadly in years.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-thailand-insurgency/gunmen-kill-15-in-southern-thailands-worst-attack-in-years-idUSKBN1XG03N>); [Bangkok Post](<https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/1788474/insurgents-attack-security-checkpoint-in-yala-15-killed>).

<a id="event-2019-11-06-0-11"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** Hong Kong pro-government politician Junius Ho and his assistant are hospitalized after being stabbed by a man pretending to be a supporter. The perpetrator is arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-50312310>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/11/05/asia/hong-kong-junius-ho-attack-intl-hnk/index.html>); [South China Morning Post](<https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/politics/article/3036492/hong-kong-lawmaker-junius-ho-injured-along-two-others-knife>).

<a id="event-2019-11-06-0-13"></a>

Context: LeBarón family massacre.

**Archived source account.** A suspect has been arrested for the mass shooting in Sonora, Mexico.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2019/11/06/family-ambushed-way-wedding-mexico-these-survivors/4175532002/>).

<a id="event-2019-11-06-0-15"></a>

Context: 2019 Iraqi protests.

**Archived source account.** At least three people are killed, and a further 17 wounded, when security forces fire at protestors trying to block a bridge in Baghdad. This is in spite of the government announcing the military was banned from using live rounds.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/killed-baghdad-protests-military-bans-live-ammunition-191106140913317.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-11-06-1-1"></a>

Context: Facebook–Cambridge Analytica data scandal.

**Archived source account.** A court filing by California Attorney General Xavier Becerra reveals for the first time that the state launched an 18-month investigation into Facebook’s privacy issues in response to the Cambridge Analytica scandal. The filing accuses the company of refusing to cooperate with investigators, and asks the court to require them to turn over information regarding third-party access to data and changes in privacy settings.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-facebook-privacy/california-reveals-facebook-probe-says-social-media-company-stonewalling-investigation-idUSKBN1XG2NP>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-11-06-2-1"></a>

Context: Israel–Jordan relations.

**Archived source account.** Israel releases two Jordanian citizens it held in detention since August, after the Jordanian government successfully negotiated for their release on Monday.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/israel-frees-jordanians-held-charge-191106144638912.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-06-2-3"></a>

Context: Nuclear program of Iran.

**Archived source account.** French media reports that Iranian nuclear scientists began injecting uranium into centrifuges in the presence of International Atomic Energy Agency inspectors at the Fordow Fuel Enrichment Plant. Effectively it turns the plant from a research site into an active nuclear site, in further violation of the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/iran-pumps-centrifuges-uranium-gas-nuclear-deal-dies-191106195355234.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-11-06-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Dutch police evacuate passengers and crew onboard an Air Europa flight at Amsterdam's Schiphol Airport to investigate reports of a "suspicious situation". The airline later tweets it was a false alarm.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-50325887?ns_linkname=news_central&amp;ns_mchannel=social&amp;ns_campaign=bbc_breaking&amp;ns_source=twitter>); [NL Times](<https://nltimes.nl/2019/11/06/schiphol-emergency-false-alarm-says-airline>).

<a id="event-2019-11-06-3-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Chilean protests.

**Archived source account.** Regional prosecutor for East Santiago Manuel Guerra announces his intentions to investigate 14 police officers for allegedly torturing protestors.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-chile-protests/chile-prosecutor-seeks-to-investigate-14-police-officers-for-alleged-torture-of-protesters-idUSKBN1XG2A9>).

<a id="event-2019-11-06-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two former Twitter employees are charged for spying on at least 6,000 users on behalf of Saudi Arabia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-50324977>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-11-06-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019–20 Lebanese protests.

**Archived source account.** Protestors sit-in at numerous government ministries, offices of major utility company Électricité du Liban, and property development sites at Zaitunay Bay in Beirut as protests enter their fourth week.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/lebanon-protesters-seek-shut-state-institutions-191106071921890.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-06-4-2"></a>

Context: 2019–20 Lebanese protests.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of students at schools and universities join the protests.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/lebanon-students-skip-school-protesters-eye-state-institutions-191106131406319.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

**Archived source account.** Five Malaysian men are sentenced to six months in jail, fined, and caned for "attempting gay sex".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-malaysia-lgbt/malaysia-sentences-five-men-to-jail-caning-and-fines-for-gay-sex-idUSKBN1XH197>).

<a id="event-2019-11-07-1-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Mauritian general election.

**Archived source account.** Citizens of Mauritius cast their vote in the country's latest parliamentary election. Militant Socialist Movement, led by incumbent Prime Minister Pravind Jugnauth wins a huge majority securing the re-election.

Source citations (as archived): [Foreign Brief](<https://www.foreignbrief.com/daily-news/indian-ocean-island-nation-of-mauritius-heads-to-the-polls-for-parliamentary-election/>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2019/11/08/world/africa/08reuters-mauritius-election.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mauritius-election/mauritius-starts-counting-votes-after-parliamentary-election-idUSKBN1XI177>).

### 2019-11-08

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1200603280](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20November%208&oldid=1200603280>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-11-08-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 5.9-magnitude earthquake strikes 60 km (35 miles) from Hashtrud, East Azerbaijan Province, in northwestern Iran, killing at least six and injuring more than 300. The United States Geological Survey warns that "significant casualties are likely and the disaster is potentially widespread".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/deadly-magnitude-59-earthquake-hits-northwestern-iran-191108011507464.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-08-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** An explosion in a mine in Teutschenthal, Saxony-Anhalt, Germany, injures two workers and traps around 30 underground in a secure area. All are rescued several hours later.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/germany-workers-trapped-underground-after-mine-explosion/a-51165862>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-11-08-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Takuma Sakuragi, a 76-year-old former Japanese assemblyman from Inazawa, Aichi, is sentenced to life in prison by the Guangzhou City First Intermediate Court in southern China for smuggling drugs hidden in his suitcase at Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport in October 2013. He had been detained by Chinese authorities since then.

Source citations (as archived): [Kyodo News Plus](<https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2019/11/cce447c54b0f-breaking-news-japanese-ex-councilor-gets-life-in-prison-in-china-for-drug-crime.html>); [Los Angeles Times](<https://www.latimes.com/world-nation/story/2019-11-07/china-sentences-former-politician-life>).

<a id="event-2019-11-08-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A federal judge orders the immediate release of former Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-brazil-corruption-court-lula/brazil-judge-orders-ex-president-lula-released-from-prison-idUKKBN1XI2AE>).

<a id="event-2019-11-08-1-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** A student from Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, named Chow Tsz-lok, died after suffering brain damage following a fall during anti-government protests.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/nov/08/hong-kong-protests-student-who-fell-from-parking-lot-during-demonstrations-dies>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/11/07/world/asia/hong-kong-protest-student-dies.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-08-1-5"></a>

Context: Impeachment inquiry into Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** During her testimony before U.S. House investigators last month in the impeachment inquiry against President Donald Trump, Fiona Hill, Trump's former top adviser on Russia and Europe, said that she received death threats and "hateful calls" and was the subject of false "conspiracy theories" as part of a targeted harassment campaign she claims was implemented after she agreed to cooperate with the inquiry, according to a deposition transcript.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/trump-impeachment-inquiry/former-trump-adviser-who-testified-ukraine-pressure-campaign-said-she-n1078726>).

<a id="event-2019-11-08-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Turkey's Interior Minister Süleyman Soylu announces that his country will begin repatriating ISIL prisoners on Monday.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-turkey-islamic-state/turkey-says-will-begin-repatriation-of-islamic-state-prisoners-on-monday-anadolu-idUSKBN1XI1G3>).

**Archived source account.** Under pressure of sanctions by ECOWAS, newly appointed Prime Minister of Guinea-Bissau Faustino Imbali resigns.

<a id="event-2019-11-08-2-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Bolivian protests.

**Archived source account.** Several dozen policemen were seen joining the protests against Evo Morales' government in at least three cities. Bolivia's defence minister stated that no "military measures" would be taken against the policemen, but added that he would "get" the disobedient officers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bolivia-election/bolivian-police-seen-joining-scattered-anti-morales-protests-idUSKBN1XI20M>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/nov/09/bolivian-police-mutiny-in-opposition-to-evo-morales>).

Context: Bushfires in Australia.

**Archived source account.** The bodies of three people killed by bushfires in Australia are found – two near Glen Innes, and one at Johns River – as fires that have destroyed at least 150 houses continue to burn in eastern New South Wales and Queensland.

Context: November 2019 Spanish general election.

**Archived source account.** Citizens of Spain head to the polls for the second general election within a year.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/spain-returns-to-the-polls-to-break-political-deadlock/a-51155618>).

<a id="event-2019-11-10-2-11"></a>

Context: November 2019 Spanish general election.

**Archived source account.** The PSOE, headed by incumbent Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez, wins the election but loses 3 seats and its absolute majority in the Senate. Political deadlock remains.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/ng-interactive/2019/nov/10/spanish-general-election-2019-live-results>).

<a id="event-2019-11-10-2-12"></a>

Context: November 2019 Spanish general election.

**Archived source account.** Far-right Vox gains 28 seats and raises from fifth to the third national force.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-50367870>).

<a id="event-2019-11-10-2-13"></a>

Context: November 2019 Spanish general election.

**Archived source account.** The center-right Citizens, the third national force going into the elections, goes from 57 seats in Congress to just 10, the biggest seat loss in the election. Albert Rivera quits as Citizens' leader as a result.

Source citations (as archived): [El País](<https://elpais.com/elpais/2019/11/11/inenglish/1573467972_489207.html>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2019/11/10/world/europe/ap-eu-spain-election-the-latest.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-10-2-15"></a>

Context: 2019 Chilean protests.

**Archived source account.** An American white supremacist shoots a protester in Reñaca. Before being detained by the police, he uploads a video to YouTube confessing the attack, claiming to have fired in self-defense.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/nation/2019/11/11/john-cobin-chile-shooting-protesters-video/>).

<a id="event-2019-11-10-2-16"></a>

Context: 2019 Chilean protests.

**Archived source account.** Interior Minister Gonzalo Blumel announces the government will propose the creation of a new constitution through the existing Congress instead of a constituent assembly as requested by the protesters.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg News](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-11-11/chile-s-government-to-propose-mechanism-for-a-new-constitution>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-11-10-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 MLS Cup Playoffs.

**Archived source account.** The Seattle Sounders FC defeat Toronto FC 3–1 at CenturyLink Field to win their second MLS Cup.

Source citations (as archived): [Major League Soccer](<https://www.mlssoccer.com/post/2019/11/10/seattle-sounders-are-2019-mls-cup-champions-rave-green-win-second-mls-title>).

### 2019-11-11

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1198483026](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20November%2011&oldid=1198483026>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-11-11-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Bolivian protests, Evo Morales government resignation.

**Archived source account.** Buildings are set alight in La Paz overnight in apparent retaliatory attacks after Evo Morales resigned under pressure from anger over his disputed re-election.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bolivia-election/morales-exit-in-bolivia-sparks-night-of-violence-political-vacuum-idUSKBN1XL1DT>).

<a id="event-2019-11-11-0-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Bolivian protests, Evo Morales government resignation.

**Archived source account.** Armed gangs attack people in Cochabamba who appear to be celebrating Evo Morales's resignation.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/11/11/world/americas/bolivia-evo-morales.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-11-0-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Bolivian protests, Evo Morales government resignation.

**Archived source account.** Drinking water supplies to La Paz and El Alto, Bolivia's top two largest cities, are cut off.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/11/11/world/americas/bolivia-evo-morales.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-11-0-4"></a>

Context: 2019 Bolivian protests, Evo Morales government resignation.

**Archived source account.** Former Bolivian President Evo Morales says he has accepted an offer of political asylum in Mexico and boards a Mexican government plane as Bolivian Army troops are deployed in the capital.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-50383608>).

<a id="event-2019-11-11-0-6"></a>

Context: Gaza–Israel conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Israel Defense Forces say they've killed Baha Abu al-Ata, leader of the Islamic Jihad Movement in Palestine's armed wing known as the Al-Quds Brigades, in an airstrike on a building in the Gaza Strip. PIJ confirms the death of Baha Abu al-Ata and his wife, vowing to "shake the Zionist entity to its core" in response.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/.premium-israeli-operation-targets-leader-of-islamic-jihad-overnight-in-gaza-1.8118328>); [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/Breaking-News/Explosions-at-house-of-Islamic-Jihads-Abu-al-Ata-Palestinian-report-607579>).

<a id="event-2019-11-11-0-8"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Israeli involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Israeli Air Force jets target a downtown Damascus house belonging to Islamic Jihad Movement in Palestine. The strike killed one of the militant's son.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/syria/israel-targets-damascus-home-of-islamic-jihad-official-group-says-1.8118575>).

<a id="event-2019-11-11-0-9"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Israeli involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Three blasts targeting the town of Qamishli in Syria kill 6 and wound dozens of others. All the blasts were claimed by ISIL.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/blasts-kill-6-syrian-town-turkey-191111154834074.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-11-0-10"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Israeli involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** ISIL also claims responsibility for the killing of an Armenian priest and his father.

Source citations (as archived): [Vatican News](<https://www.vaticannews.va/en/church/news/2019-11/priest-killed-syria-islamic-state-militants.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-11-0-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** Gunmen kill nine in twin attacks in Punjab a Pakistan province. The ambushes killed two police officers, two intelligence officers and an informant in the first attack. The second attack happened at a checkpoint when unknown gunmen killed an officer and three others.

Source citations (as archived): [TOLOnews](<https://tolonews.com/world/pakistani-police-say-gunmen-attacked-security-vehicle-5-killed>); [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<https://www.rferl.org/a/eparate-attacks-in-pakistan-s-punjab-province-kill-9-people-police-say/30263014.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-11-0-12"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 33-year-old Yemeni man stabbed and wounded three Spanish theatre actors in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Is not known if the attack is in protest against the war in Yemen or for the attacker's opposition to Saudi Arabia’s growing entertainment industry.

Source citations (as archived): [The Arab Weekly](<https://thearabweekly.com/kingdoms-reform-drive-irks-hard-line-conservatives>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-11-11-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The wreckage of United States Navy submarine USS Grayback (SS-208), which disappeared with its 80 crew members in the East China Sea on February 27, 1944 during World War II, is discovered on the sea floor using new drone technology.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-50380521>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/videos/world/2019/11/11/uss-grayback-missing-75-years-discovered-japan-orig.cnn>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-11-11-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** James Le Mesurier, the British co-founder of the White Helmets, a volunteer civil defence organisation in Syria, is found dead near his home in Istanbul, Turkey. The cause of death is not known.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-50375869>).

<a id="event-2019-11-11-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Cristian Sabou pleads guilty to the murder of Valerie Graves. He is convicted and sentenced to life imprisonment with a minimum of 23 years 272 days.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2019/nov/11/man-pleads-guilty-murder-valerie-graves>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-11-11-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** Protesters in Hong Kong call for a city-wide strike amidst an escalation in violence. Police shot a man with a live round at point-blank range in Sai Wan Ho district, besieged the Chinese University of Hong Kong and the Hong Kong Polytechnic University, and fired tear gas inside the campuses.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hongkong-protests/hong-kong-protester-shot-by-police-as-chaos-erupts-across-city-media-idUSKBN1XL00W>).

<a id="event-2019-11-11-3-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** Embattled Hong Kong leader Carrie Lam says on Monday that violence has exceeded protesters' demands for democracy and labels the demonstrators as the "people's enemy".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hongkong-protests-lam/hong-kong-leader-says-violence-has-far-exceeded-calls-for-democracy-idUSKBN1XL170>).

<a id="event-2019-11-11-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Kiribati High Court clears the way for the opposition to file a motion of no confidence against President Taneti Mamau amid reported discontent with the government's decision to switch its diplomatic recognition of Taiwan to recognition of the People's Republic of China.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/403038/kiribati-high-court-clears-way-for-attempt-at-no-confidence-vote>).

<a id="event-2019-11-11-3-5"></a>

Context: International reactions to the persecution of Rohingyas in Myanmar.

**Archived source account.** Fifty-seven countries file a lawsuit in the International Court of Justice against Myanmar, formally accusing their government of committing a genocide against the country's Rohingya population.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/57-countries-sue-myanmar-reported-genocide-rohingya-historic/story?id=66893262>).

<a id="event-2019-11-11-3-7"></a>

Context: 2019 United Kingdom general election.

**Archived source account.** Major parties put forward veterans' platforms for Remembrance Day, the first in a campaign season since the 1923 election, with the Conservatives proposing an amendment to the Human Rights Act so that it will no longer apply to The Troubles or other 20th-century actions and the Labour Party promising extra childcare for military families and a new railcard for veterans. This is the 100th anniversary of the two-minute silence and other Armistice Day commemorations worldwide.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/election-2019-50369104>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-11-11-4-1"></a>

Context: Transit of Mercury.

**Archived source account.** In a rare celestial event, Mercury passes directly between Earth and the Sun for five and a half hours. Mercury's next transit will be in 2032.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/mercury-retrograde-planet-passing-directly-between-earth-and-the-sun-today-2019-11-11/>).

### 2019-11-12

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1357885215](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20November%2012&oldid=1357885215>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-11-12-0-1"></a>

Context: Gaza–Israel conflict.

**Archived source account.** Israel conducts airstrikes on Islamic Jihad Movement in Palestine (PIJ) targets in Gaza Strip.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/11/12/778506421/rockets-rain-on-gaza-and-israel-after-airstrike-kills-militant-leader>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-11-12-1-1"></a>

Context: Mondobhag train collision.

**Archived source account.** Two passenger trains collide head-on in Kasba, Bangladesh, killing at least 16 people and injuring over 100.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News](<https://news.yahoo.com/express-trains-collide-bangladesh-killing-030719401.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-12-1-3"></a>

Context: Sea level rise driven by effects of global warming on oceans, Acqua alta.

**Archived source account.** An exceptional high tide of 187 cm hits flooded Venice, Italy. It is the second highest acqua alta in Venetian history, after the 1966 Venice flood. Two deaths are reported.

Source citations (as archived): [NDTV](<https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/exceptionally-high-tide-hits-flooded-venice-officials-2131559>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-50401308>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2019/nov/13/waves-in-st-marks-square-as-venice-flooded-highest-tide-in-50-years>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-11-12-2-1"></a>

Context: Cuba–Spain relations.

**Archived source account.** Felipe VI becomes the first ever Spanish Monarch to visit Cuba.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/spanish-king-and-queen-arrive-in-cuba-for-first-royal-visit/2019/11/11/6cfe5368-04f2-11ea-9118-25d6bd37dfb1_story.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-11-12-3-1"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Uganda.

**Archived source account.** Police in Uganda raid a gay-friendly bar in Kampala and charge 67 people with "common nuisance" in what is described as the "latest attack on Uganda's LGBT community".

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2019/11/12/world/africa/ap-af-uganda-lgbt-arrests.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-12-3-3"></a>

Context: Crime in China.

**Archived source account.** A man attacks a kindergarten class in Kaiyuan, China, with chemical spray, injuring 51 children and three teachers.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/11/12/asia/china-corrosive-liquid-kindergarten-intl-hnk/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-12-3-5"></a>

Context: Crime in Thailand.

**Archived source account.** In Chanthaburi Province, Thailand, an ex-policeman shoots and kills two people, including a former prime minister's lawyer and a plaintiff, before being killed by return fire.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2019-11-13/lawyer-plaintiff-and-gunman-killed-in-thai-courtroom-shooting/11698762>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-11-12-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** As the situation worsens with clashes in the central financial district, police say violence is bringing the city to the "brink of total breakdown". Large-scale protests continue near the City University of Hong Kong, Chinese University of Hong Kong, and other districts including Central and Tai Po.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hongkong-protests/violence-brings-hong-kong-to-brink-of-total-breakdown-police-idUSKBN1XM00X>).

<a id="event-2019-11-12-4-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** After police shoot a protester with live ammunition, Hong Kong leader Carrie Lam speaks out and labels the protesters as "selfish" for "paralyzing" the city and urges all students not to take part in protests.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hongkong-protests-lam/hong-kong-leader-says-protesters-paralyzing-the-city-are-selfish-idUSKBN1XM05I>).

<a id="event-2019-11-12-4-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** Police investigate protesters for attempted murder after they are filmed setting a 57-year-old man on fire during an argument.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/hong-kong-man-set-on-fire-protests-police-attempted-murder-12085506>).

<a id="event-2019-11-12-4-5"></a>

Context: November 2019 Spanish general election.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez from the PSOE and Pablo Iglesias, leader of the left-wing Podemos, announce a first government agreement that will constitute the first coalition government in Spain's democratic history. This follows the failure to reach an agreement last summer and the rise of the far-right party Vox.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2019/11/12/world/europe/12reuters-spain-election.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-12-4-7"></a>

Context: 2019 Catalan protests, Catalan independence movement.

**Archived source account.** Protesters block the two main passages between Spain and France. In La Jonquera, on the border between Catalonia and France, French National Police try to expel rioters.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/nov/12/french-police-clear-catalan-independence-protesters-from-road>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-50387514>).

<a id="event-2019-11-12-4-8"></a>

Context: 2019 Catalan protests, Catalan independence movement.

**Archived source account.** The Parliament of Catalonia approves a resolution expressing willingness to exercise the right to self-determination concretely, mocking the warnings of the Constitutional Court, which suspends its effects shortly thereafter.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2019/11/12/world/europe/12reuters-spain-politics-catalonia-parliament.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-12-4-9"></a>

Context: 2019 Catalan protests, Catalan independence movement.

**Archived source account.** During the night, some major throughways of Barcelona and Tarragona and national roads in Basque Country are blocked for a few minutes.

Source citations (as archived): [The Local](<https://www.thelocal.fr/20191113/500-cars-trapped-overnight-as-protesters-continue-to-block>).

<a id="event-2019-11-12-4-11"></a>

Context: 2019 Bolivian protests, Evo Morales government resignation.

**Archived source account.** Despite lacking a quorum in a session of the National Congress, Senator Jeanine Áñez immediately declares herself President of Bolivia due to the vacancy arising from the resignation and exile of Evo Morales.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/11/12/world/americas/evo-morales-mexico-bolivia.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-12-4-13"></a>

Context: 2019 United Kingdom general election.

**Archived source account.** Nigel Farage announces that his Brexit Party will withdraw its candidates in the 317 seats that the ruling Conservative Party won in the last general election. The move is expected to increase the chances of a Conservative majority in parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Times](<https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2019/nov/12/nigel-farages-brexit-party-will-withdraw-candidate/>).

<a id="event-2019-11-12-4-15"></a>

Context: Politics of Moldova.

**Archived source account.** A vote of no-confidence ousts the government of Prime Minister Maia Sandu after breaking the coalition government with Socialist Party.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-moldova-politics/moldovas-fledgling-government-brought-down-by-no-confidence-vote-idUSKBN1XM1G4>).

### 2019-11-13

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-11-13-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / November 2019 Kabul bombing.

**Archived source account.** A suicide car bomb kills 12 people and injures 20 others near the Interior Ministry in Kabul, Afghanistan.

<a id="event-2019-11-13-0-4"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Indonesia.

**Archived source account.** A suicide bomber kills himself and injures six other people when he detonates near police headquarters in Medan, Indonesia.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/indonesia-one-dead-six-injured-in-suspected-suicide-bombing-at-medan-police-station/a-51219836>).

<a id="event-2019-11-13-0-6"></a>

Context: Gaza–Israel conflict; Gaza–Israel clashes (November 2019).

**Archived source account.** Israeli airstrikes leave 22 Palestinians (20 militants and 2 civilians) dead and dozens injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/gaza-israel-rockets-day-2-islamic-jihad-tel-aviv-hamas-syria-1.8122258>).

<a id="event-2019-11-13-0-7"></a>

Context: Gaza–Israel conflict; Gaza–Israel clashes (November 2019).

**Archived source account.** More than 200 rockets are fired into Israel from Gaza.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Post](<https://nypost.com/2019/11/12/nearly-200-rockets-launched-at-israel-from-gaza-strip-since-killing-of-islamic-jihad-leader/>).

<a id="event-2019-11-13-0-8"></a>

Context: Gaza–Israel conflict; Gaza–Israel clashes (November 2019).

<a id="event-2019-11-13-0-10"></a>

Context: Islamist insurgency in Mozambique, Mozambique–Tanzania relations.

**Archived source account.** Jihadists kill six civilians and injure seven in a village near the Mozambique–Tanzania border. All the victims are Tanzanian nationals, while the terrorists are identified as Mozambicans.

<a id="event-2019-11-13-0-12"></a>

Context: Crime in Poland.

**Archived source account.** Two people are arrested in Poland for planning to kill Muslims in an attack inspired by the 2011 Utoya/Oslo attacks by Norwegian mass murderer Anders Behring Breivik, and the Christchurch, New Zealand mosque shootings.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-poland-arrests/poland-seizes-two-for-plotting-breivik-style-attacks-on-muslims-idUSKBN1XN23L?il=0>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-11-13-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bus collision with a truck near Nitra kills 13 people and leaves at least 17 wounded. The disaster is the deadliest in Slovakia in a decade.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/slovakia-crash/bus-crash-in-slovakia-kills-at-least-13-many-more-injured-idUSL8N27T5DN>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-11-13-2-1"></a>

Context: Japan–North Korea relations, Japan–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** South Korean media reports that between May and September, Japanese Prime Minister Shinzō Abe sent personal letters to North Korea's Kim Jong-un to hold bilateral meetings to ease tensions between the two countries. A Japanese government spokesman denies the report.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2019/11/13/national/politics-diplomacy/abe-sent-personal-letters-holding-summit-kim-jong-un-south-korean-paper/#.XcwkDtIzZ6o>).

<a id="event-2019-11-13-2-3"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Bolivia, Foreign relations of Venezuela, 2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** Interim President of Bolivia Jeanine Áñez officially establishes relations with Juan Guaido's government after he recognizes her as President of Bolivia on Twitter.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-11-13-3-1"></a>

Context: Catholic Church sexual abuse cases.

**Archived source account.** The Australian High Court agrees to hear a final appeal from ex-Vatican treasurer and convicted child sex offender George Pell, who was found guilty of sexually assaulting three teenage choirboys.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-australia-abuse-pell/australian-high-court-agrees-to-hear-ex-vatican-treasurers-sex-offences-appeal-idUSKBN1XM2V6>).

<a id="event-2019-11-13-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** After the South Korean government launches an investigation into comfort women, a survivor tells the press that Japan "lacked honor" for failing to attend the South Korean court's proceedings.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-southkorea-japan-comfortwomen/korean-survivor-says-japans-no-show-at-comfort-women-case-in-seoul-lacks-honor-idUSKBN1XN18Y>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-11-13-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** Hong Kong leader Carrie Lam vows not to give in to protesters as chaos continues into Wednesday morning.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/hong-kong-faces-more-transit-disruptions-after-chaotic-night>).

<a id="event-2019-11-13-4-2"></a>

<a id="event-2019-11-17-1-1"></a>

**Editorial account; source review partial.** The archive’s November 17 first-case assertion remains unverified. The 2021 WHO-convened joint report described December 8 as the earliest illness onset among cases in the reviewed national reporting system, while acknowledging that its retrospective evidence could not exclude low-level earlier circulation. Neither finding identifies a definitive first human infection.

Editorial date: 2019-11-17. Checked: 2026-10-21. Partial: the source’s November 17 date, 55-year-old identity and market visit are not established by the opened report. The report’s own scope and uncertainty prevent treating its earliest recorded onset as proof that earlier infection was impossible.

Evidence: [WHO-convened joint international study](<https://www.who.int/docs/default-source/coronaviruse/final-joint-report_origins-studies-6-april-201.pdf?sfvrsn=4f5e5196_1>).

Original source account: The first known case of COVID-19 is traced to a 55-year-old man who had visited a market in Wuhan, Hubei Province, China.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.
