<a id="event-2019-11-18-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Japan opens its first military arms show, as it tries to improve its military technology to combat external threats from China and North Korea.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-japan-defence-exhibition/japan-hosts-first-fully-fledged-arms-show-looking-for-an-edge-in-tech-idUSKBN1XS128?il=0>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-11-18-2-1"></a>

Context: Fukushima nuclear disaster.

**Archived source account.** The Japanese government authorizes a release of contaminated water from the plant into the Pacific Ocean. Officials say that the release represents a "significantly small" risk to human health.

Source citations (as archived): [Kyodo News Plus](<https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2019/11/69b8ea68fa78-govt-says-safe-to-release-contaminated-fukushima-water-into-ocean.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-11-18-3-1"></a>

Context: Russia–Ukraine relations, Ukrainian crisis.

**Archived source account.** Russia returns three Ukrainian Navy vessels it seized during an incident in the Kerch Strait last year.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/russia-returns-navy-vessels-seized-from-ukraine/a-51286196>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/ukraine-crisis-russia/ukraine-confirms-russia-returning-three-captured-naval-ships-idUSL8N27Y0HU>).

<a id="event-2019-11-18-3-3"></a>

Context: Israel–United States relations, Israeli occupation of the West Bank.

**Archived source account.** The Trump administration announces that the United States no longer considers Israeli settlement of the West Bank as illegal per se under international law. The announcement is praised by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, and condemned by the European Union, the Palestinian National Authority, and Jordanian Foreign Affairs Minister Ayman Safadi.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/nov/18/us-israeli-settlements-no-longer-considered-illegal-palestinian-land-mike-pompeo>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-11-18-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** The Hong Kong High Court rules that the government's mask ban violates the Basic Law.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/politics/article/3038184/anti-mask-law-quell-hong-kong-protests-ruled>).

<a id="event-2019-11-18-4-3"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Saudi Arabia.

**Archived source account.** Two Saudi journalists, one of whom worked for CNN and the BBC, are outed as gay, which prompts them to flee and seek asylum in Australia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-australia-saudi-asylum/saudi-journalists-who-say-they-were-outed-as-gay-held-in-australian-asylum-center-idUSKBN1XS251>).

<a id="event-2019-11-18-4-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Bolivian protests.

**Archived source account.** Interim interior minister Arturo Murillo threatens to arrest MAS legislators, who refuse to recognize Jeanine Áñez's legitimacy, for "subversion".

Source citations (as archived): [The Globe Post](<https://theglobepost.com/2019/11/18/bolivian-government-arrest-mas-lawmakers/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-11-18-5-1"></a>

Context: Marshall Islands general election.

**Archived source account.** Citizens cast their votes for the 33 members of the country's legislature.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-marshallislands-election/marshall-islands-heads-to-polls-in-election-closely-watched-by-washington-idUSKBN1XS0F9>).

<a id="event-2019-11-18-5-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Bolivian protests.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of Bolivian coca farmers came out in protest in favour of Evo Morales and called for the resignation of Añez as Acting President.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-bolivia-election-idUKKBN1XS29A>).

### 2019-11-19

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1364700883](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20November%2019&oldid=1364700883>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-11-19-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan, Afghan peace process.

**Archived source account.** In Zabul Province, the Taliban releases two foreign hostages, American professor Kevin King and Australian professor Timothy Weeks, who had been held captive since being kidnapped outside the American University of Afghanistan in 2016. Three high-ranking Taliban militants are released in exchange for the hostages.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-50471186>).

<a id="event-2019-11-19-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan, Afghan peace process.

**Archived source account.** Afghan President Ashraf Ghani claims victory over ISIL, citing the surrender of over 600 of their fighters in the past weeks as an example that the group has given up.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-islamicstate/afghanistans-president-claims-victory-over-islamic-state-idUSKBN1XT1UQ>).

<a id="event-2019-11-19-0-4"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Libyan National Army (LNA) warplanes carry out airstrikes on the port city of Misrata. The LNA say they were targeting munitions and armored vehicles that had been delivered from Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-libya-security/east-libyan-forces-target-munitions-in-misrata-with-air-strikes-idUSKBN1XT16D>).

<a id="event-2019-11-19-0-6"></a>

Context: 2019–2020 Iranian protests.

**Archived source account.** Rioters armed with knives kill three members of Iran's security forces, bringing the death toll up to 11.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/urges-iran-restraint-reports-rioters-kill-3-soldiers-191119073050682.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-19-0-7"></a>

Context: 2019–2020 Iranian protests.

**Archived source account.** Amnesty International reports that 106 protesters have been killed during the protest. Some reports indicate a much higher death toll.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-50474405>); [National Post](<https://nationalpost.com/pmn/news-pmn/politics-news-pmn/at-least-106-protestors-killed-in-iran-during-unrest-amnesty-international>).

<a id="event-2019-11-19-0-9"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** After the attack on pro-democracy activist Jimmy Sham the month prior, another pro-democracy activist, Albert Ho, is attacked by masked men at a minibus stop.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/politics/article/3038480/police-investigate-alleged-attack-hong-kong-pro-democracy>).

<a id="event-2019-11-19-0-11"></a>

Context: 2019 Bolivian protests.

**Archived source account.** At least three people are killed and 22 injured after Bolivian police and military forces use armored vehicles and helicopters to unblock access to a major fuel plant that had been blockaded by supporters of former president Evo Morales.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/nov/19/bolivia-clashes-police-army-break-fuel-blockade>).

<a id="event-2019-11-19-0-12"></a>

Context: 2019 Bolivian protests.

**Archived source account.** Bolivia's congress, controlled by lawmakers from Morales' Movement for Socialism (MAS) party, said it would cancel a contentious vote in the legislature that had been expected to reject Morales' resignation.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bolivia-election/bolivian-lawmakers-seeking-to-calm-tensions-cancel-vote-on-morales-idUSKBN1XT228>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-11-19-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Japan–South Korea trade dispute.

**Archived source account.** Officials from Japan and South Korea hold their second round of trade talks as part of the World Trade Organization's dispute settlement process.

Source citations (as archived): [NHK World-Japan](<https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20191119_10/amp.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-19-1-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Japan–South Korea trade dispute.

**Archived source account.** Japan and South Korea have failed to narrow their differences over Japan's export controls in the second round of bilateral talks.

Source citations (as archived): [NHK World-Japan](<https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20191120_07/>).

<a id="event-2019-11-19-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Amid continuing fallout over rape allegations against Prince Andrew, Duke of York, and controversy over his close friendship with convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, several businesses—including British banking group Standard Chartered, KPMG, Aon and drug giant AstraZeneca—cut ties with the Prince. Pitch@Palace, an initiative founded by Prince Andrew to support entrepreneurs, removes its entire web page listing its supporters.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News](<https://uk.sports.yahoo.com/news/prince-andrew-jeffrey-epstein-pitchpalace-kpmg-aon-095904255.html>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/11/18/business/prince-andrew-pitch-at-palace/index.html>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-11-19-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Fifteen children are confirmed (and three more suspected) dead from measles in Samoa as the illness epidemic continues within the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/403586/samoa-measles-outbreak-claims-lives-of-15-children-report>).

#### International Relations

<a id="event-2019-11-19-3-1"></a>

Context: Hong Kong–United States relations, China–United States relations, 2019 Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Senate unanimously passes the Hong Kong Human Rights and Democracy Act, which mandates that the State Department at least annually checks to see if Hong Kong retains enough autonomy to retain its special trade status with the United States. The Senate also unanimously passes another bill banning the sale of certain crowd-control munitions to the Hong Kong police. The former's passage is condemned by China.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hongkong-protests-usa/u-s-senate-passes-hk-rights-bill-backing-protesters-angers-beijing-idUSKBN1XT2VR?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-11-19-3-3"></a>

Context: Iran–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln transits through the Strait of Hormuz amidst ongoing tensions between the United States and Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [Navy Times](<https://www.navytimes.com/news/your-navy/2019/11/20/carrier-abraham-lincoln-transits-strait-of-hormuz-for-the-first-time-since-deployment/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/world/us-aircraft-carrier-strike-group-sails-through-strait-of-hormuz-idUSKBN1XT2EF/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-11-19-4-1"></a>

Context: Assange v Swedish Prosecution Authority.

**Archived source account.** A Swedish prosecutor says she will drop charges of rape against Julian Assange after a review of the evidence.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-assange-sweden/sweden-says-it-is-dropping-assange-rape-investigation-idUSKBN1XT1QO>).

<a id="event-2019-11-19-4-3"></a>

Context: Death of Jeffrey Epstein.

**Archived source account.** Two prison guards who worked at the Metropolitan Correctional Center in New York City are arrested in connection with the death of American financier and convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. The guards are accused of falsifying the records of their watch the night Epstein was found dead.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Examiner](<https://www.washingtonexaminer.com/news/two-prison-employees-arrested-in-connection-to-epsteins-death>); [New York Post](<https://nypost.com/2019/11/19/two-jail-guards-arrested-over-jeffrey-epstein-suicide/>).

<a id="event-2019-11-19-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Northern Mariana Islands House of Representatives calls for the impeachment of Governor Ralph Torres amid an ongoing Federal Bureau of Investigation investigation into his businesses.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/403640/call-for-impeachment-of-cnmi-governor>).

<a id="event-2019-11-19-4-6"></a>

Context: Crime in Germany.

**Archived source account.** Son of former German president Richard von Weizsäcker, a physician, is stabbed to death during a lecture. The attacker is reported as 57 years old.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/son-of-former-german-president-stabbed-to-death-in-berlin-hospital/a-51325419>); [The Berlin Spectator](<https://berlinspectator.com/2019/11/20/berlin-prominent-physician-murdered-during-lecture/>).

<a id="event-2019-11-19-4-8"></a>

Context: Operation Car Wash.

**Archived source account.** A Rio de Janeiro judge issues an arrest warrant against former President of Paraguay Horacio Cartes, accusing him of operating a money laundering scheme with a friend, Dario Messer, who is prosecuted as part of Operation Car Wash.

Source citations (as archived): [EFE](<https://www.efe.com/efe/america/politica/la-lava-jato-golpea-a-paraguay-con-pedido-de-prision-del-expresidente-cartes/20000035-4114531>); [Clarín](<https://www.clarin.com/mundo/juez-brasil-ordeno-detencion-ex-presidente-paraguay-horacio-cartes-corrupcion_0_QzVTXSgu.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-11-19-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Shinzō Abe becomes the longest-serving Prime Minister of Japan.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/japans-shinzo-abe-ties-record-for-longest-serving-pm-even-as-allegations-of-misdeeds>).

<a id="event-2019-11-19-5-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Chilean protests.

**Archived source account.** An impeachment inquiry is launched against Chilean President Sebastián Piñera due to his alleged role in the violation of human rights in the ongoing protests.

Source citations (as archived): [World Socialist Web Site](<https://www.wsws.org/en/articles/2019/11/19/chil-n19.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-19-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sabah Al-Khalid Al-Sabah is named by the Emir as the new Prime Minister of Kuwait, replacing Jaber Al-Mubarak Al-Hamad Al-Sabah.

Source citations (as archived): [Gulf News](<https://gulfnews.com/world/gulf/kuwait/kuwait-emir-appoints-foreign-minister-as-new-pm-1.67932916>).

<a id="event-2019-11-19-5-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Montserratian general election.

**Archived source account.** After his victory in the general election, Easton Taylor-Farrell is sworn in as Premier of Montserrat.

Source citations (as archived): [RJR News](<http://rjrnewsonline.com/local/new-monsterrat-premier-easton-taylor-farrell-sworn-in>).

<a id="event-2019-11-19-5-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Silveria Jacobs is appointed as the new Prime Minister of Sint Maarten.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Herald](<https://www.thedailyherald.sx/islands/92592-st-maarten-has-new-government>).

### 2019-11-20

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1364701587](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20November%2020&oldid=1364701587>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-11-20-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli military launches airstrikes on dozens of Quds Force targets in Damascus and surrounding towns in response to a missile intercepted the previous day over the Golan Heights. The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights reports 23 are killed, including several Iranian fighters.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<https://apnews.com/ea7d21d0cbe24e899351b3ad56839fa2?fbclid=IwAR3EfZ-D5kgirXyhrD6Jiq392n6-LQHnRYjP4sNhkCSkJV5I2f0FbwuMBpQ>).

<a id="event-2019-11-20-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Missiles and airstrikes strike a crowded facility in Qah and Idlib, killing approximately over 20 including women and children. Activists claim that Syrian Armed Forces were behind the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-50503857>).

<a id="event-2019-11-20-0-4"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. military says two American service members have been killed in a helicopter crash in Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2019/11/20/statement-says-wednesday-cause-crash-under-investigation-however-preliminary-reports-do-not-indicate/4246844002/?fbclid=IwAR0NlyMetzCk2PVAIspSxKD2_-1aZZxbgJElQgzeTSNBOXPI4CkBAN4ci2Q>).

<a id="event-2019-11-20-0-6"></a>

Context: 2019 Bolivian protests.

**Archived source account.** The death toll in the protests rises to 30.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bolivia-politics/bolivian-lawmakers-seek-election-breakthrough-as-death-toll-hits-30-idUSKBN1XU1YJ>).

<a id="event-2019-11-20-0-8"></a>

Context: 2019 Iranian fuel protests.

**Archived source account.** According to the human rights organization Amnesty International, casualties are estimated to be around 106 protestors and rising.

Source citations (as archived): [Radiofarda](<https://en.radiofarda.com/a/death-toll-in-iran-protests-rises-as-u-s-europe-condemn-use-of-force-/30280481.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-20-0-10"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** Houthi militants release the South Korean ship they captured two days prior.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/yemen-houthis-release-captured-south-korean-saudi-vessels-191120080140333.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-20-0-12"></a>

Context: Allied Democratic Forces insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Militants target civilians in the DR Congo near the border with Uganda, killing 19 and kidnapping others. Churches were also burned down in two separate attacks. It is believed that the Allied Democratic Forces is behind the attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-congo-security/suspected-islamist-militants-kill-19-burn-church-in-eastern-dr-congo-idUSKBN1XU2K6>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-11-20-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Prince Andrew, Duke of York, halts all public duties in light of allegations of rape, saying his "ill-judged" association with American convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein had caused major disruption to the royal family's work.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-royals-andrew-duties/britains-prince-andrew-halts-public-duties-over-sex-scandal-idUSKBN1XU2CW>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-11-20-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Japan–South Korea trade dispute.

**Archived source account.** South Korea's finance minister Hong Nam-ki presses Japan to take steps to lift its export restrictions.

Source citations (as archived): [Yonhap](<https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20191120006000320>).

<a id="event-2019-11-20-2-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** Joshua Wong calls on HSBC to re-open an account used to support the pro-democracy movement in the city.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/business/2019/11/20/hong-kong-protest-leader-urges-hsbc-reopen-account-linked-pro/>).

<a id="event-2019-11-20-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Google announces it will ban targeted ads that use voter data, effective within a week.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-alphabet-google-advertising/google-bars-elections-ads-from-using-political-leanings-voter-data-idUSKBN1XU2WT>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-11-20-3-1"></a>

Context: Iran–Saudi Arabia relations.

**Archived source account.** King Salman of Saudi Arabia blames Iran for the "chaos and destruction" their multiple missiles and drone attacks have caused in the country, and reiterates that his country will not hesitate to defend itself.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-king/saudi-king-blames-iran-for-chaos-says-strikes-failed-to-hurt-kingdoms-development-idUSKBN1XU1J5>).

<a id="event-2019-11-20-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis arrives in Bangkok for a three-day visit to Thailand. The Catholic Church in Thailand is celebrating 350 years of Holy See recognition of the Church in Thailand. Bishop Arpondratana of Chiang Mai diocese states that the pope's visit is important for the Church in all of Asia.

Source citations (as archived): [Catholic News Agency](<https://www.catholicnewsagency.com/news/thai-bishop-popes-visit-a-significant-moment-for-small-catholic-community-79770>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-11-20-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tongan authorities contact their New Zealand counterparts to warn them of death threats against Tongan Prime Minister Pohiva Tuʻiʻonetoa on social media.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/403737/nz-police-called-in-after-death-threat-to-tongan-pm>).

<a id="event-2019-11-20-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ali al-Haj, secretary of the Islamist Popular Congress Party, is arrested after Sudanese authorities summon him for questioning over his role in the coup d’état that put former President Omar al-Bashir in power.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-sudan-politics/sudans-top-islamist-politician-sent-to-prison-holding-bashir-idUSKBN1XU292?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-11-20-4-3"></a>

Context: International reactions to the Rohingya genocide.

**Archived source account.** The office of Myanmar's civilian leader, Aung San Suu Kyi, releases a statement announcing that she will personally lead the legal team defending the Burmese military's actions against the Rohingya minority in the International Criminal Court. Nine days earlier, fifty-seven countries led by The Gambia filed a lawsuit in the International Criminal Court, formally accusing Myanmar of committing genocide against the Rohingya.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/11/20/asia/aung-san-suu-kyi-rohingya-icj-intl/index.html>); [TIME](<https://time.com/5735203/myanmar-suu-kyi-genocide-rohingya-icj/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-11-20-5-1"></a>

Context: 2019 referendum on the creation of a Sidama region.

**Archived source account.** The Sidama people of Ethiopia go to the polls for a referendum on further autonomy for the Sidama Zone. If autonomy is approved, then local taxes, education, security and laws will be decided by the Sidama instead of the government of Ethiopia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://reuters.com/article/uk-ethiopia-politics/ethiopias-sidama-vote-on-autonomy-in-latest-test-for-restive-regions-idUKKBN1XU020>).

<a id="event-2019-11-20-5-3"></a>

Context: 2020 Israeli legislative election.

**Archived source account.** Blue and White Alliance leader Benny Gantz's mandate to form a new government expires. As both he and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu failed to form one, Israel will likely face a third election in two years.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/israel-election-looms-deadline-form-govt-expire-191120145722129.html>).

### 2019-11-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1364701607](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20November%2021&oldid=1364701607>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-11-21-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Bolivian protests.

**Archived source account.** Bolivian riot police fire tear gas to break up a funeral procession that had turned into massive anti-government protest.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20191121-police-break-up-bolivia-funeral-protest-as-congress-meets-on-elections>); [International Business Times](<https://www.ibtimes.com/police-break-bolivia-funeral-protest-congress-meets-elections-2871174>); [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-bolivia-politics/supporters-of-bolivias-morales-march-with-coffins-of-dead-protesters-idUKKBN1XV1P5>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-11-21-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two USAF airmen are killed when two planes collide at Vance Air Force Base in Enid, Oklahoma, United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<https://www.abc12.com/content/news/Vance-Air-Force-Base-Okla-says-2-aircraft-involved-in-mishap-565283912.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-21-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** An explosion at a fireworks factory in the town of Barcellona Pozzo di Gotto, Sicily, Italy, kills five people and injures two others.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/five-people-killed-in-explosion-at-fireworks-factory-in-sicily-11866146>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-11-21-2-1"></a>

Context: Cross-Strait relations.

**Archived source account.** After the running mate for the presidency of Taiwan for Tsai Ing-wen, William Lai, says he supports Taiwanese independence, China condemns the move as a "disaster" which crosses a red line China is not willing to accept.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-taiwan-election/china-says-taiwan-courting-disaster-after-pre-election-comment-on-independence-idUSKBN1XV0LU>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-11-21-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** The Hong Kong High Court denies the lift of a travel ban imposed on pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong, who was scheduled to travel to the United Kingdom to receive a human rights award from the two houses of the British Parliament. The judge cites the risk of absconding and says he can remain in the city to help restore peace.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<http://theindependent.sg/hk-court-forbids-joshua-wong-from-traveling-to-london-to-receive-human-rights-award-from-british-parliament/>).

<a id="event-2019-11-21-3-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Chilean protests.

**Archived source account.** Amnesty International releases a report regarding human rights violations committed by the Carabineros and the Armed Forces against peaceful protesters.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-chile-protests-amnesty-idUSKBN1XV1J1?taid=5dd6b27cbd53880001eb7034>).

<a id="event-2019-11-21-3-5"></a>

Context: Investigations involving Benjamin Netanyahu.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister of Israel Benjamin Netanyahu is officially indicted by Attorney General Avichai Mandelblit for bribery, fraud, and breach of trust. Netanyahu protests the allegations as being part of a political "witch-hunt" against him.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/nov/21/israeli-prime-minister-benjamin-netanyahu-indicted-for-bribery-and>).

<a id="event-2019-11-21-3-7"></a>

Context: 2019 Iranian fuel protests.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme National Security Council gradually restores the internet to some provinces and parts of Tehran, after shutting it off nationwide five days ago to counteract protests.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/iran-loosens-internet-restrictions-protest-shutdown-191121195539005.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-21-3-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nine Extinction Rebellion protesters are arrested for storming U.S. House of Representatives Speaker Nancy Pelosi’s office.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/climate-environment/2019/11/21/nine-climate-activists-arrested-after-storming-nancy-pelosis-office/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-11-21-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Vanuatu backtracks on a controversial law that would have allowed immigration authorities to racially profile and closely follow people from the Middle East.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/403853/vanuatu-backtracks-on-special-profiling-immigration-policy>).

<a id="event-2019-11-21-4-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Colombian protests.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of protestors take to the streets in Colombia demanding the resignation of President Iván Duque Márquez. The protests were instigated over controversial tax and labor reforms proposed by Congress, murders of indigenous leaders, and the government’s failure to implement the FARC peace deal.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/the_americas/with-nationwide-strike-colombia-joins-south-americas-season-of-protest/2019/11/21/2d3adf0e-0bef-11ea-8054-289aef6e38a3_story.html>).

### 2019-11-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088701021](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20November%2022&oldid=1088701021>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-11-22-0-1"></a>

Context: China–United States trade war.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Federal Communications Commission (FCC) unanimously votes to label Chinese telecommunications giants Huawei and ZTE as national security risks, thereby disqualifying them from the Universal Service Fund. In a separate vote, the FCC mandates that national wireless carriers remove both companies' products from their existing networks. The companies have 30 days to appeal.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-china-huawei-tech/fcc-votes-5-0-to-bar-chinas-huawei-zte-from-government-subsidy-program-idUSKBN1XW1TC>).

<a id="event-2019-11-22-0-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Japan–South Korea trade dispute.

**Archived source account.** South Korea halts its World Trade Organization complaint concerning Japan's tightened export controls of key chemicals South Korea uses for computer chips and displays.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://www.voanews.com/east-asia-pacific/south-korea-reverses-course-will-still-share-intel-japan>).

<a id="event-2019-11-22-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Amazon files a lawsuit against the United States Department of Defense for awarding a US$10 billion cloud computing contract to Microsoft. The company had previously accused the Department of bias in their decision, given CEO Jeff Bezos has been a vocal critic of U.S. President Donald Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-amazon-com-pentagon-microsoft/amazon-files-lawsuit-contesting-pentagons-10-billion-cloud-contract-to-microsoft-idUSKBN1XX00M?il=0>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-11-22-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Samoa measles outbreak.

**Archived source account.** Samoa confirms that 20 persons, all but one under the age of four, have died of measles, and 11 more are in critical condition. Authorities recorded 1,644 cases since the outbreak began last month.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/403902/samoa-measles-death-toll-hits-20-eleven-children-critical>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-11-22-2-1"></a>

Context: Chagos Archipelago sovereignty dispute.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom misses a United Nations deadline to return control of the disputed Chagos Archipelago to Mauritius, prompting the government of Mauritius to call the UK an "illegal colonial occupier".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-50511847>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-11-22-3-1"></a>

Context: Murder of Grace Millane.

**Archived source account.** After a three-week trial, a 27-year-old New Zealand man is found guilty of murdering 22-year-old British tourist Grace Millane in Auckland in December 2018.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-essex-50512163>).

<a id="event-2019-11-22-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Paraguayan Congresswoman Cynthia Tarragó is arrested alongside her husband at Newark Liberty International Airport in Newark, New Jersey and charged with money laundering, following an undercover operation from FBI agents who purported to be drug traffickers. According to court documents, in addition to money laudering, Tarragó offered to traffic drugs herself from Paraguay.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC Color](<https://www.abc.com.py/tv/abc-noticias/2019/11/22/detienen-a-cynthia-tarrago-en-eeuu/>); [Última Hora](<https://www.ultimahora.com/detienen-cynthia-tarrago-eeuu-blanqueo-dinero-n2856211.html>); [The Philadelphia Inquirer](<https://www.inquirer.com/business/money-laundering-cocaine-marijuana-paraguay-newark-cynthia-tarrago-diaz-raimundo-va-fbu-20191122.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-11-22-4-1"></a>

Context: 2021 German federal election.

**Archived source account.** Annegret Kramp-Karrenbauer, who replaced German Chancellor Angela Merkel as leader of the Christian Democratic Union, threatens to stand down as a chancellor candidate if her centre-right party continues to disagree over support.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-50520902>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/nov/22/merkel-successor-annegret-kramp-karrenbauer-back-her-or-sack-her>); [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2019/11/22/mini-merkel-faces-critics-back-sack-challenge/>).

<a id="event-2019-11-22-4-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Bolivian protests, 2019 Bolivian political crisis.

**Archived source account.** Bolivia's new interior minister, Arturo Murillo, files a criminal complaint against former President Evo Morales for alleged sedition and terrorism.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/nov/22/bolivia-evo-morales-terrorism-sedition-interim-government>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bolivia-politics/bolivias-interim-government-charges-morales-with-sedition-and-terrorism-idUSKBN1XW26Y>).

### 2019-11-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1364701714](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20November%2023&oldid=1364701714>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-11-23-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, November 2019 Syria bombings.

**Archived source account.** A car bomb detonates in Tell Abyad, Raqqa Governorate, killing ten people and wounding 25 others.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security/car-bomb-kills-at-least-10-people-near-syrias-border-with-turkey-idUSKBN1XX0BS?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-11-23-0-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Colombian protests.

**Archived source account.** Three Colombian police are killed and seven wounded by a car bomb in Santander de Quilichao, Cauca province.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/nov/23/colombian-protests-flare-again-as-looting-erupts-in-bogota>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-11-23-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Samoa measles outbreak.

**Archived source account.** Tonga and Fiji declare a state of emergency as part of an ongoing measles outbreak. Conditions worsen in Samoa where the death toll continues to rise and schools remain closed. There are 1,797 confirmed cases as of Saturday, with 153 detected on Friday alone.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-50528834>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-11-23-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Iranian fuel protests.

**Archived source account.** Iranian Vice President Eshaq Jahangiri warns regional states of dire consequences, claiming the protests are "directly linked to the United States, Saudi Arabia, and Israel."

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-gasoline-protests/iran-warns-regional-states-of-consequences-if-they-stoked-unrest-idUSKBN1XX07O>).

<a id="event-2019-11-23-2-3"></a>

Context: Iran–Iraq relations.

**Archived source account.** The border between Iran and Iraq reopens, after being closed for a week due to mass protests in their respective countries.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-iran-border/iraq-iran-border-crossing-reopens-after-week-long-closure-statement-idUSKBN1XX0BB?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-11-23-2-5"></a>

Context: China–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Chinese Foreign Affairs Minister Wang Yi accuses the United States of being the "world's biggest destabilizing factor" and of "smearing China everywhere" at the G20 meeting in Nagoya.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-usa-trade/china-attacks-u-s-at-g20-as-the-worlds-biggest-source-of-instability-idUSKBN1XX09P?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-11-23-2-7"></a>

Context: Australia–China relations, Chinese intelligence activity abroad.

**Archived source account.** Australian network newspapers, Nine’s The Age and Sydney Morning Herald newspapers, report that a Chinese spy, Wang ‘William’ Liqiang - who defected to Australia, gives counter-espionage agency the names of senior military intelligence officers he says funded and conducted operations in Hong Kong, Taiwan and Australia.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3039046/chinese-spy-who-infiltrated-hong-kong-taiwan-defects-australia>).

<a id="event-2019-11-23-2-8"></a>

Context: Australia–China relations, Chinese intelligence activity abroad.

**Archived source account.** Wang says he was personally involved in infiltration and disruption operations in all three territories, and “revealed in granular detail” how Beijing covertly controls listed companies to fund intelligence operations, including the surveillance and profiling of dissidents and the co-opting of media organizations.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-50528831>).

<a id="event-2019-11-23-2-9"></a>

Context: Australia–China relations, Chinese intelligence activity abroad.

**Archived source account.** Wang is now seeking asylum in Australia, saying he ‘will be dead’ if he returns home.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2019-11-23/chinese-spy-wang-liqiang-seeks-political-asylum-australia-report/11732174>).

<a id="event-2019-11-23-2-10"></a>

Context: Australia–China relations, Chinese intelligence activity abroad.

**Archived source account.** The Shanghai police department says that Wang is a conman who was convicted for fraud in 2016 and is being investigated for another case of fraud since April 2019.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<https://amp.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3039101/self-proclaimed-chinese-spy-william-wang-who-defected>).

<a id="event-2019-11-23-2-12"></a>

Context: Pope Francis travels to Japan.

**Archived source account.** During his 23 to 26 November journey to Japan, Pope Francis visits Tokyo, Nagasaki and Hiroshima. The only pope to previously visit Japan was Pope John Paul II from 23–26 February 1981.

Source citations (as archived): [Holy See Press Office](<https://press.vatican.va/content/salastampa/en/bollettino/pubblico/2019/10/28/191028a.html>); [Vatican News](<https://www.vaticannews.va/en/vatican-city/news/2019-11/pope-john-paul-ii-visit-japan-1981.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-11-23-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Bougainvillean independence referendum.

**Archived source account.** People in the Autonomous Region of Bougainville vote to choose between more autonomy within Papua New Guinea or outright independence. However, the Papua New Guinea central government will have the final say on accepting independence.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/403929/expectations-high-as-bougainville-referendum-gets-underway>).

<a id="event-2019-11-23-3-3"></a>

Context: 2019 referendum on the creation of a Sidama region.

**Archived source account.** The Ethiopian electoral board announces that the referendum to grant autonomy to the Sidama Zone passed with 98.5% of the vote.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ethiopia-politics/ethiopias-sidama-vote-overwhelmingly-to-form-autonomous-region-idUSKBN1XX0GR?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-11-23-3-5"></a>

Context: Climate change policy, Harvard-Yale football game.

**Archived source account.** A non-violent protest was held at the Yale Bowl during the annual Harvard-Yale football game at halftime. The apparently scheduled protest included both Yale and Harvard students. The students were protesting the colleges' usage of endowments from fossil fuel companies. The game was delayed for about an hour. There were some arrests.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/11/23/us/harvard-yale-climate-protest-trnd/index.html>); [(The New York Times\}](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/11/23/us/harvard-yale-game-protest.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-11-23-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Copa Libertadores.

**Archived source account.** The premier association football club competition of South America concludes with Brazilian club Flamengo beating titleholders River Plate 2-1 in Lima's Monumental Stadium. It is their first title since 1981 and second overall.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC Sport](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/50532892>).

### 2019-11-24

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088701355](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20November%2024&oldid=1088701355>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-11-24-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Taliban insurgents storm a checkpoint in Daykundi Province, killing eight Afghan Army personnel. After reinforcements were sent to the area, Afghan soldiers drive off the attackers, killing at least 20 of them.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/afghan-official-taliban-storm-army-checkpoint-killing-8/2019/11/24/838196c0-0eb3-11ea-924c-b34d09bbc948_story.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-24-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** A grenade attack in Kabul hit a United Nations car killing one foreigner and injuring five others.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-blast/grenade-thrown-at-u-n-vehicle-in-kabul-one-foreigner-killed-idUSKBN1XY0I2>).

<a id="event-2019-11-24-0-4"></a>

Context: 2019 Iraqi protests.

**Archived source account.** Security forces opened fire on protesters, killing nine and wounding dozens.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-protests/security-forces-kill-nine-in-iraq-protests-idUSKBN1XY04Z>).

<a id="event-2019-11-24-0-6"></a>

Context: 2019–20 Lebanese protests.

**Archived source account.** Clashes between anti-government protestors, and Hezbollah and Amal Movement supporters break out when the former group blocked a main bridge in downtown Beirut. At least five people are injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lebanon-protests/lebanese-protesters-clash-with-supporters-of-hezbollah-amal-in-downtown-beirut-idUSKBN1XZ013?il=0>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-11-24-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Busy Bee crash.

**Archived source account.** A plane crashes shortly after takeoff in a densely populated neighborhood of the city of Goma, Democratic Republic of the Congo, killing all the 19 people on board. About ten other people are killed on the ground.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-congo-crash/plane-crash-kills-at-least-18-in-eastern-congo-idUSKBN1XY06H>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-50536220>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-11-24-2-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Tuvalu.

**Archived source account.** Tuvaluan Foreign Minister Simon Kofe says Tuvalu rejects Chinese offers to build artificial islands for his country, which deals with rising sea levels because Tuvalu sees the offers as an "attempt to reduce Taiwanese influence in the Pacific region". Tuvalu is one of four Pacific nations to recognize Taiwan in the One-China policy dispute.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/403936/tuvalu-s-artificial-islands-won-t-be-made-in-china>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-11-24-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Bolivian political crisis.

**Archived source account.** Bolivia's legislative assembly approves the annulment of the October general election and the holding of new elections. Ex-president Evo Morales is barred from participating.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/bolivia-approves-new-elections-excluding-evo-morales/a-51387746>).

<a id="event-2019-11-24-3-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Guinea-Bissau presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Citizens of Guinea-Bissau head to the polls to vote for a new president amidst political turmoil.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/2019/11/24/guinea-bissau-votes-for-president-after-weeks-of-political-upset>).

<a id="event-2019-11-24-3-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong protests, 2019 Hong Kong local elections.

**Archived source account.** Local elections are held in Hong Kong. Barring military intervention from Beijing, the outcome is seen as a major indicator for the political future of the protest-ridden region.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/hong-kong-record-turnout-for-district-elections/a-51387049>).

<a id="event-2019-11-24-3-6"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong protests, 2019 Hong Kong local elections.

**Archived source account.** With a record 71% turnout, the pro-democracy camp wins 333 of 452 seats up for election. Jimmy Sham, one of the leaders of the protest, won in his electorate while major pro-Beijing leader Junius Ho lost in his.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hongkong-protests/hong-kong-democrats-romp-to-local-election-landslide-after-months-of-protests-idUSKBN1XY0MZ>).

<a id="event-2019-11-24-3-8"></a>

Context: 2019 Romanian presidential election.

**Archived source account.** People of Romania cast their vote in the second round of the latest presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/romania-seeking-a-return-to-normality/a-51380802>).

<a id="event-2019-11-24-3-10"></a>

Context: 2019 Uruguayan general election.

**Archived source account.** Uruguay holds the second round of the 2019 presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/ruling-party-faces-exit-uruguay-votes-president-191124081851651.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-24-3-12"></a>

Context: 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries, Michael Bloomberg 2020 presidential campaign.

**Archived source account.** Former Mayor of New York City Michael Bloomberg announces he's running for the presidency as part of the Democratic ticket.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/11/24/782096579/former-new-york-mayor-michael-bloomberg-is-running-for-president>).

<a id="event-2019-11-24-3-13"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. Secretary of Defense Mark Esper forces Navy Secretary Richard V. Spencer to resign over his handling of the court martial of Navy SEAL Eddie Gallagher.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-military-seals/u-s-defense-secretary-fires-navy-chief-over-handling-of-seal-saga-idUSKBN1XY0M5>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-11-24-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Campeonato Brasileiro Série A.

**Archived source account.** With four rounds to go, Flamengo wins the Brazilian league for the sixth time. They are the first team since 1963's Santos FC to win the national league and the Copa Libertadores on the same weekend.

Source citations (as archived): [Globo Esporte](<https://globoesporte.globo.com/futebol/times/flamengo/noticia/flamengo-e-campeao-brasileiro-e-se-torna-primeiro-time-desde-1963-a-ganhar-nacional-e-libertadores-no-mesmo-ano.ghtml>).

<a id="event-2019-11-24-4-3"></a>

Context: 2019 CFL season.

**Archived source account.** The Winnipeg Blue Bombers win the 107th Grey Cup, defeating the Hamilton Tiger-Cats 33-12, in Winnipeg's first Grey Cup win since 1990. Winnipeg running back Andrew Harris becomes the first player in Grey Cup history to be named both Most Valuable Player and Most Valuable Canadian.

Source citations (as archived): [Sportsnet](<https://www.sportsnet.ca/football/cfl/blue-bombers-andrew-harris-becomes-first-win-grey-cup-mop-moc/>).

### 2019-11-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1353996455](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20November%2025&oldid=1353996455>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-11-25-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Protestors storm the MONUSCO headquarters in Beni, Democratic Republic of the Congo, and set UN vehicles on fire in anger at the peacekeepers' failure to stop the Allied Democratic Forces insurgency. Congolese security forces fire at the crowd to disperse them, killing at least two.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/killed-rebel-attack-dr-congo-city-beni-191125105346272.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-11-25-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Transport for London announces it will not grant a new license to operate to Uber, citing safety failures. The company will appeal.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-50544283>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-11-25-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Ménaka helicopter crash.

**Archived source account.** Thirteen French soldiers are killed in a helicopter crash during an operation against jihadists in Mali.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-50557511?ns_linkname=news_central&amp;ns_mchannel=social&amp;ns_campaign=bbc_breaking&amp;ns_source=twitter>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-11-25-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Samoa measles outbreak.

**Archived source account.** Fijian Health Minister Ifereimi Waqainabete warns that police will be deployed to areas under quarantine if people continue not to respect the order to stay at home if they have measles, amid an ongoing outbreak of the illness in various Pacific island nations.

Source citations (as archived): [Fiji Times](<https://www.fijitimes.com/ministry-sounds-warning-as-measles-cases-rise/>); [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/404072/authorities-in-fiji-urge-public-to-respect-quarantine>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-11-25-4-1"></a>

Context: Iran–Israel relations, Iran–Saudi Arabia relations, Iran–United States relations, 2019 Iranian protests.

**Archived source account.** Hossein Salami, commander-in-chief of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps delivers a televised speech toward Israel, Saudi Arabia, the United States and those who are protesting against the government in which he says "We will destroy you" if they cross Iran's red line.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/iran/iran-warns-israel-u-s-saudi-arabia-cross-red-lines-and-we-will-destroy-you-1.8176159>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/irans-guard-threatens-us-allies-over-protests/2019/11/25/87ebdb90-0f89-11ea-924c-b34d09bbc948_story.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-11-25-5-1"></a>

Context: Essex lorry deaths.

**Archived source account.** The driver of the lorry in which 39 Vietnamese migrants were found dead in Grays, Essex, England, pleads guilty to conspiring to assist unlawful immigration.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://independent.co.uk/news/uk/crime/essex-lorry-deaths-maurice-robinson-mo-guilty-trafficking-immigration-latest-a9216561.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-25-5-3"></a>

Context: Catholic Church sexual abuse cases in Argentina.

**Archived source account.** Two Roman Catholic priests are sentenced to more than 40 years in prison for sexually assaulting deaf children at a church school in Mendoza Province, Argentina; the school's gardener also receives an 18-year sentence.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-50549918>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/nov/25/roman-catholic-priests-argentina-sentenced-45-years-child-abuse-school-deaf>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-11-25-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tim Berners-Lee, creator of the World Wide Web, launches a World Wide Web Foundation scheme Contract for the Web.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2019/11/25/tim-berners-lee-launches-contract-for-the-web-to-fix-the-internet.html>).

### 2019-11-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088701956](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20November%2026&oldid=1088701956>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-11-26-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, November 2019 Syria bombings.

**Archived source account.** A car bomb kills 17 civilians and injures 20 others in an attack in Ras al-Ayn, Al-Hasakah Governorate, Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-turkey/turkey-says-car-bomb-kills-17-near-syrias-ras-al-ain-idUSKBN1Y01ZB?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-11-26-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** An American is identified as the victim killed in a Kabul grenade attack on a United Nations convoy.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/Breaking-News/Pompeo-An-American-was-killed-in-attack-on-UN-vehicle-in-Kabul-609108>).

<a id="event-2019-11-26-0-5"></a>

Context: Terrorism in the Netherlands.

**Archived source account.** Two men are arrested in the Netherlands after plans were uncovered to commit a jihadist attack with explosive belts and car bombs.

Source citations (as archived): [NL Times](<https://nltimes.nl/2019/11/26/dutch-forces-arrest-two-plotting-terrorist-car-bomb-attack-years-end>).

<a id="event-2019-11-26-0-7"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir.

**Archived source account.** A grenade attack kills two including a government official and wounds four others. Two militants were also killed in another incident.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/india-killed-wounded-kashmir-grenade-attacks-191126140031755.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-26-0-9"></a>

Context: Iraqi insurgency (2017–present).

**Archived source account.** Multiple bombings in Baghdad kill six people and injure 15 others. Most are motorcycle bombs.

Source citations (as archived): [U.S. News and World Report](<https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2019-11-26/baghdad-bombings-kill-5-as-iraqis-protest-government>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-11-26-1-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Israel.

**Archived source account.** It is announced that in a United States-backed peace plan, Israeli citizens will be allowed to visit the Gulf States for "business and political purposes", starting next year.

Source citations (as archived): [Middle East Monitor](<https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20191126-israelis-will-be-able-to-visit-gulf-states-next-year-says-former-minister/>).

<a id="event-2019-11-26-1-3"></a>

Context: China–United States trade war.

**Archived source account.** Discount retailer Dollar Tree reports that it will miss its analysts' profit expectations for this quarter, blaming the shortfall on the tariff costs imposed by the United States government on products it imports from China.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-dollar-tree-results/dollar-tree-forecast-misses-as-tariffs-bite-shares-slump-17-idUSKBN1Y01I1?il=0>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-11-26-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Albania earthquake.

**Archived source account.** A 6.4 magnitude earthquake hits coastal Albania, bringing down many buildings and leaving people trapped under rubble. The Defense Ministry confirms 30 people killed and 650 others injured, mostly in Durrës County.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-50562552>).

<a id="event-2019-11-26-2-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Albania earthquake.

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis prays for victims of the earthquake in Albania and sends “heartfelt condolences” to Albanian President Ilir Meta. The quake's epicenter is less than 20 miles from Tirana, the country’s capital city, which has a population of 900,000. Additional earthquakes occurred in southern Bosnia and the Greek island of Crete.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.catholicnewsagency.com/news/pope-francis-prays-for-victims-of-deadly-earthquake-in-albania-39805>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-11-26-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Samoa measles outbreak.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the measles outbreak in Samoa has reached 32 with over 2,400 cases recorded.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC Australia](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2019-11-26/samoa-measles-emergency-claims-32-lives-as-death-toll-rises/11738138>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-11-26-4-1"></a>

Context: Censorship in Vietnam.

**Archived source account.** A court in Vietnam sentences a Facebook user to six years in prison for anti-state posts on the social media. It is the latest case seen as a crackdown on government dissidents.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-vietnam-security-trials/vietnam-jails-another-facebook-user-as-dissent-crackdown-intensifies-idUSKBN1Y014L>).

<a id="event-2019-11-26-4-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Chilean protests.

**Archived source account.** Human Rights Watch releases a report about "serious" human rights violations committed by Carabineros, confirming the findings of Amnesty International published last week.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20191126-serious-rights-violations-during-chile-protests-human-rights-watch>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-11-26-5-1"></a>

Context: Politics of Mauritius.

**Archived source account.** Acting President Barlen Vyapoory resigns from office. Eddy Balancy, the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of Mauritius, becomes the country's new acting president.

Source citations (as archived): [L'Express](<https://www.lexpress.mu/article/366014/qui-sera-prochain-ou-prochaine-presidente-republique-selon-vous>).

<a id="event-2019-11-26-5-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Australian Parliament infiltration plot, Chinese intelligence activity abroad.

**Archived source account.** ASIO is investigating an alleged plot by the Communist Party of China to install an agent into the Parliament of Australia.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC Australia](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2019-11-26/pressure-is-on-to-reign-in-chinese-spying-in-australia/11736530>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-11-26-6-1"></a>

Context: 2019 in spaceflight.

**Archived source account.** Egypt's first ever communications satellite TIBA 1 is launched by Arianespace on an Ariane 5 rocket from the Guiana Space Centre.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/us-egypt-space-satellite/egypt-launches-first-communication-satellite-cabinet-idUKKBN1Y02LT>).

### 2019-11-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1260792119](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20November%2027&oldid=1260792119>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-11-27-0-1"></a>

Context: Allied Democratic Forces insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Islamist militants of the Allied Democratic Forces kill nineteen people near the city of Oicha in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, following a week's worth of protests against the mass killings from rebels that killed four others near a United Nations base.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-congo-security/suspected-islamists-kill-15-in-latest-east-congo-attack-idUSKBN1Y124B?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-11-27-0-3"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The eastern-based Libyan National Army loyal to Field Marshal Khalifa Haftar recaptures the strategic Elephant Field oil field in southwestern Libya after driving out GNA forces with airstrikes.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-libya-oil/eastern-libyan-forces-regain-control-of-el-feel-oilfield-lna-idUSKBN1Y11SM?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-11-27-0-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Iraqi protests.

**Archived source account.** Iraqi protesters storm and set fire to the Iranian Consulate General in Najaf.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-protests-iran/iraqi-protesters-set-fire-to-iran-consulate-in-najaf-police-first-responders-idUSKBN1Y12FF>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/iraqi-protesters-torch-iranian-consulate-najaf-191127200729292.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-27-0-7"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** A roadside bomb in Kunduz Province kills 15 civilians and injures two others.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/roadside-bomb-kills-15-civilians-northern-afghanistan-191127181943637.html>); [VOA](<https://www.voanews.com/south-central-asia/bomb-blast-kills-15-afghan-civilians>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-11-27-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A chemical plant producing butadiene in Port Neches, Texas, United States, explodes and burns. It damages thousands of buildings over several square miles and sending three workers to the hospital.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News](<https://news.google.com/articles/CBMiRGh0dHBzOi8vbmV3cy55YWhvby5jb20vdHBjLXBsYW50LWV4cGxvc2lvbi1ibGFzdC1wb3J0LTE1NTYwNDYyOS5odG1s0gFMaHR0cHM6Ly9uZXdzLnlhaG9vLmNvbS9hbXBodG1sL3RwYy1wbGFudC1leHBsb3Npb24tYmxhc3QtcG9ydC0xNTU2MDQ2MjkuaHRtbA?hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen>).

<a id="event-2019-11-27-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A fire at a Minneapolis apartment building leaves five dead and three injured.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/11/27/us/minneapolis-apartment-fire.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-11-27-2-1"></a>

Context: China–United States relations, Hong Kong–United States relations, 2019 Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump signs the Hong Kong Human Rights and Democracy Act into law despite strong opposition from China. The bill means the U.S. will only trade with Hong Kong if it retains enough autonomy and bans the export of crowd-control munitions to Hong Kong Police Force.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hongkong-protests-trump/trump-approves-legislation-backing-hong-kong-protesters-idUSKBN1Y12NB>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-11-27-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Guinea-Bissau presidential election.

**Archived source account.** The latest presidential election in Guinea-Bissau has to go into a second round on December 29 as no candidate managed to win more than 50% of the votes during the first round. The second round will be a run-off between Domingos Simões Pereira and Umaro Sissoco Embaló while incumbent president José Mário Vaz was eliminated from the race.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/guinea-bissau-presidential-election-ex-pms-advance-to-runoff-as-incumbent-eliminated-from-race/a-51440879>).

<a id="event-2019-11-27-3-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Namibian general election.

**Archived source account.** Citizens of Namibia head to the polls to elect both the country's president and National Assembly members.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/africa/namibia-votes-as-ruling-party-faces-unprecedented-challenge/2019/11/27/2c40812c-10d5-11ea-924c-b34d09bbc948_story.html>).

<a id="event-2019-11-27-3-5"></a>

Context: Ninth European Parliament.

**Archived source account.** The European Parliament confirms the Von der Leyen Commission, which will begin acting on December 1.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/european-commission-von-der-leyens-new-team-confirmed-by-european-parliament/a-51434588>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-11-27-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Following a public outcry, Twitter apologises and backtracks one day after saying that it would begin deleting inactive accounts outside the United States on December 11, after users were upset that the measure would cause the removal of accounts belonging to users who had died. It now says that it will first implement a process for "memorialising" dead users. It would have been the first large scale cull of inactive accounts on the social media platform.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-50581287>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-11-27-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Arena Football League announces that it has filed for Chapter 7 bankruptcy and will immediately cease operations. This marks the effective end of the 32-year-old league, and the second liquidation bankruptcy in its history.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/nfl/2019/11/27/arena-football-league-declares-bankruptcy-shuts-down/4322126002/>).

<a id="event-2019-11-27-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** City Football Group (CFG) owner Khaldoon Al Mubarak, who is also chairman of Premier League club Manchester City F.C., the fifth most valuable association football club in the world, agrees to sell a $500 million stake to American private equity firm Silver Lake Partners, making CFG the most valuable association football group in the world.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-soccer-england-mci-silver-lake-deals/manchester-city-owner-scores-4-8-billion-price-tag-with-stake-sale-idUKKBN1Y10FH>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-50570117>).

### 2019-11-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1344020027](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20November%2028&oldid=1344020027>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-11-28-0-1"></a>

Context: Allied Democratic Forces insurgency.

**Archived source account.** An attack on a United Nations center in the Congo by Mai-Mai militants kills three Ebola response workers and a police officer.

Source citations (as archived): [LA Times](<https://www.latimes.com/world-nation/story/2019-11-28/ebola-responders-congo-world-health-organization>).

<a id="event-2019-11-28-0-2"></a>

Context: Allied Democratic Forces insurgency.

**Archived source account.** The death toll in November attacks by Islamist militants in the Democratic Republic of the Congo increases to 107 from violence in and around Beni since November 5.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/dr-congo-brink-191127120254060.html>); [TRT World](<https://www.trtworld.com/africa/democratic-republic-of-congo-massacre-death-toll-rises-to-27-31773>).

<a id="event-2019-11-28-0-4"></a>

Context: 2019 Iraqi protests.

**Archived source account.** In one of the deadliest days of the protests so far, Iraqi security forces open fire and kill 25 people who were blocking a bridge in Nasiriyah, while 10 people are killed in Najaf, and four people are shot dead in the capital Baghdad. The Iraqi Armed Forces says an emergency unit had been created to "impose security and restore order" in response to the violence. 45 people have been killed by security forces in total.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-50584123>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/nov/29/iraq-in-turmoil-as-45-shot-dead-by-security-forces-in-protests>).

<a id="event-2019-11-28-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two Turkish troops are killed by mortar fire in the Akçakale district of Turkey, near the Syrian border.

Source citations (as archived): [AA](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/turkey/mortar-attack-martyrs-2-soldiers-in-turkeys-southeast/1657859>).

<a id="event-2019-11-28-0-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** South Korean army officials claim that North Korea launched two projectiles "from a super-large caliber multiple rocket launcher."

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/11/28/asia/north-korea-launch-intl-hnk/index.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-11-28-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Albania earthquake.

**Archived source account.** Twenty more bodies are found under destroyed buildings after the earthquake in Albania two days ago, bringing the death toll to 50 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Shqiptarja.com](<https://shqiptarja.com/lajm/40-viktima-nga-termeti-nxirren-te-gjithe-personat-nga-rrenojat-ne-thumane-vijojne-kerkimet-ne-durres-per-6-persona>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-11-28-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Samoa measles outbreak.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations blames anti-vaccination messages for the current outbreak of measles in the Pacific island nation, where the death toll has risen to 39 and is expected to rise as 200 are reported hospitalised, according to the World Health Organization. Total cases now soar to near 3,000.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/nov/28/samoa-measles-outbreak-who-blames-anti-vaccine-scare-death-toll>); [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/404352/samoa-measles-epidemic-death-toll-reaches-39>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-11-28-3-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Benin.

**Archived source account.** The government of Benin orders EU ambassador Oliver Nette to leave the country after accusing him of "meddling in their internal affairs".

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/benin-orders-eu-ambassador-to-leave-reports/a-51441422>).

<a id="event-2019-11-28-3-3"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Bolivia, Foreign relations of Israel.

**Archived source account.** Bolivia and Israel reestablish diplomatic relations after Bolivia suspended ties over a decade ago as a consequence of Operation Cast Lead. The foreign minister of the Bolivian transitional government says President Evo Morales took the decision in 2009 "without thinking about the economic and commercial consequences".

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/Israel-News/Bolivia-renews-ties-with-Israel-609316>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-11-28-4-1"></a>

Context: Censorship in Vietnam.

**Archived source account.** In the third case this month, and the second this week, a court in Vietnam convicts and sentences a Facebook user to nine years in prison for defaming the ruling Communist Party and government.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-vietnam-security-trials/vietnam-jails-third-activist-this-month-in-crackdown-on-facebook-posts-idUSKBN1Y20J3>).

<a id="event-2019-11-28-4-3"></a>

Context: Hillsborough disaster.

**Archived source account.** David Duckenfield, the former South Yorkshire Police chief superintendent who was in charge of the 1988–89 FA Cup semi-final match between Liverpool F.C. and Nottingham Forest F.C. at Hillsborough Stadium, is cleared of manslaughter by gross negligence relating to the deaths of 96 Liverpool fans who were crushed to death during the match. The verdict sparks outrage from the families of victims.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-50592077>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2019/nov/28/hillsborough-families-outraged-david-duckenfield-not-guilty-verdict>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-11-28-5-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong protests, Hong Kong–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** Following the U.S. legislation regarding Hong Kong, pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong urges Western nations, especially the United Kingdom, to "stand with Hong Kong" and calls for the penalization of leader Carrie Lam.

Source citations (as archived): [Federal News Network](<https://federalnewsnetwork.com/world-news/2019/11/protester-warns-against-police-moving-into-hong-kong-campus/>).

<a id="event-2019-11-28-5-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021), Afghanistan–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump and First Lady Melania Trump make an unannounced Thanksgiving visit to troops at the Bagram Airfield in Afghanistan, their second visit to a combat zone since taking office. While there he also claims he has re-started talks with the Taliban.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/11/28/us/politics/trump-afghanistan.html>).

### 2019-11-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088702611](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20November%2029&oldid=1088702611>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-11-29-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019 London Bridge stabbing.

**Archived source account.** A terrorist mass stabbing at London Bridge kills two civilians and injures three others. The attacker, Usman Khan, wearing a fake explosive belt, is shot dead by police on the bridge. Khan was a former prisoner convicted of terrorism offences, and had links to Islamist terrorist groups.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-50610215>).

<a id="event-2019-11-29-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–present).

**Archived source account.** After a surprise visit by U.S. President Donald Trump, the Taliban say they are ready to restart peace talks and reach a ceasefire.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-afghanistan-taliban/after-trumps-kabul-visit-taliban-says-ready-to-resume-peace-talks-idUSKBN1Y30GR>).

<a id="event-2019-11-29-0-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Iraqi protests.

**Archived source account.** Protests continue across Iraq with a death toll of seven protesters by unsourced reports. Other reports by hospital sources state the death toll is over 20 due to Iraqi forces opening fire in Nasiriya.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/protesters-shot-dead-violence-continues-iraq-191129193729541.html>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-50600495>).

<a id="event-2019-11-29-0-7"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Houthi militants say that they shot down a Saudi Arabian helicopter, killing both pilots. Saudi Arabia has not confirmed the incident.

Source citations (as archived): [Sputnik](<https://sputniknews.com/middleeast/201911291077435287-houthi-forces-claim-theyve-shot-down-a-saudi-helicopter/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-11-29-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Samoa measles outbreak.

**Archived source account.** It is expected that there will be 70 deaths from the illness, and at least 6,500 people will be infected by the highly infectious disease.

Source citations (as archived): [NZ Herald](<https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/news/article.cfm?c_id=1&amp;objectid=12289525>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-11-29-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The government of Sudan repeals all laws restricting women's freedom of dress, movement, association, work and study, and dissolves the former ruling party. Sudanese Prime Minister Abdalla Hamdok praises women on social media and says that the laws were “an instrument of exploitation, humiliation, violation, aggression on the rights of citizens”.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/nov/29/sudan-dissolves-ex-ruling-party-and-repeals-morality-law>).

<a id="event-2019-11-29-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A national court rules President of Suriname Dési Bouterse guilty of murder. The case addresses the execution of 15 government critics in 1982, following the 1980 Sergeants' Coup led by Bouterse. Six other former military officers are also declared guilty.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/nov/30/suriname-president-guilty-of-over-1982-executions>).

<a id="event-2019-11-29-2-2"></a>

Context: A national court rules President of Suriname Dési Bouterse guilty of murder. The case addresses the execution of 15 government critics in 1982, following the 1980 Sergeants' Coup led by Bouterse. Six other former military officers are also declared guilty..

**Archived source account.** Police report that three young people have been wounded in a stabbing on a shopping street in The Hague, Netherlands.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-netherlands-stabbing/dutch-police-several-wounded-in-stabbing-in-the-hague-idUSKBN1Y329Y>).

<a id="event-2019-11-29-2-4"></a>

Context: Burning Sun scandal.

**Archived source account.** K-pop singer-songwriter Jung Joon-young receives a six-year prison term and former boy band member Choi Jong-hoon is sentenced to a five-year term for having sex with a woman who was unable to consent, as well as other sex crimes including filming women without consent.
