<a id="event-2019-12-04-1-2"></a>

**Editorial account; source review complete.** The companies’ SEC filing records completion of the merger on December 4: Viacom merged into CBS, with CBS continuing as the surviving company. This was a corporate combination, rather than a shutdown of the CBS and Viacom businesses.

Editorial date: 2019-12-04. Checked: 2026-10-21. Complete wording review: qualify “cease operations” using the documented legal transaction and continuing company; preserve the original assertion unchanged.

Evidence: [ViacomCBS filing via US Securities and Exchange Commission](<https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/813828/000119312519306334/d842322d8k.htm>).

Original source account: CBS and Viacom cease operations and become ViacomCBS.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2019-12-05-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Miramar, Florida, police pursuing jewel thieves through traffic engage in a shootout leaving both perpetrators dead alongside two bystanders (one of whom was a UPS driver who had been taken hostage).

Source citations (as archived): [Miami New Times](<https://www.miaminewtimes.com/news/miramar-shooting-updates-everything-we-know-about-police-the-ups-driver-and-bystander-11325800>).

<a id="event-2019-12-05-3-5"></a>

Context: Impeachment inquiry into Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** U.S. House Speaker Nancy Pelosi announces the U.S. House of Representatives will begin to draft articles of impeachment against U.S. President Donald Trump before the Christmas recess.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/12/05/us/politics/pelosi-impeachment.html>).

<a id="event-2019-12-05-3-7"></a>

Context: 2019 French pension reform strike.

**Archived source account.** A national strike begins in France over President Emmanuel Macron's pension reform plan.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/12/05/785018695/national-strike-in-france-shuts-down-cities-over-macrons-pension-reform-plans>).

### 2019-12-06

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1354000832](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20December%206&oldid=1354000832>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-12-06-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019–2021 Iraqi protests.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen in vehicles open fire on protesters in Baghdad, killing over 19 and injuring around 70 others. Three of the dead were Iraqi police. The victims were either stabbed or shot.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/2d15fae86ea3e86dcf417f1d26a3461b>); [Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2019/12/06/gunmen-cars-kill-least-15-injure-scores-baghdad-protests/>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/middleeast/2019/12/killed-central-baghdad-assailants-fire-live-rounds-191206190824237.html>).

<a id="event-2019-12-06-0-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Kenya bus shooting.

**Archived source account.** At least ten people – including seven police officers – are killed when gunmen ambush a bus in Kotulo, Kenya. Al-Shabaab claimed responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-kenya-attack/at-least-eight-killed-in-kenya-in-suspected-islamist-militant-attack-idUSKBN1YA27Z>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/10-killed-kenya-bus-attack-claimed-al-shabab-191207082718077.html>).

<a id="event-2019-12-06-0-5"></a>

Context: Naval Air Station Pensacola shooting.

**Archived source account.** A shooter kills three people and injures eight more at Naval Air Station Pensacola, Florida, United States, before being shot and killed by police.

Source citations (as archived): [Pensacola News Journal](<https://www.pnj.com/story/news/2019/12/06/breaking-active-shooter-reported-base-nas-pensacola/4351773002/>).

<a id="event-2019-12-06-0-6"></a>

Context: Naval Air Station Pensacola shooting.

**Archived source account.** The shooter was a Saudi national who was being trained at the Naval station. His name was later released to be Mohammed Saeed Alshamrani.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/12/06/us/pensacola-naval-station-lockdown/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-12-06-0-8"></a>

Context: Allied Democratic Forces insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Islamists kill 17 civilians in two attacks in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-congo-security/islamist-rebels-kill-at-least-17-in-eastern-congo-local-official-idUSKBN1YA1YJ>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-12-06-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A collision between a U.S. Navy boat and a U.S. Coast Guard boat in Kodiak, Alaska's Womens Bay injures nine, one critically.

Source citations (as archived): [Stars &amp; Stripes](<https://www.stripes.com/news/coast-guard/coast-guard-navy-boats-collide-in-alaska-nine-injured-1.610036>).

<a id="event-2019-12-06-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A gas explosion and consecutive fire in an apartment building in Prešov, Slovakia killed at least seven people and injured dozens.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/slovakia-7-die-in-gas-explosion-dozens-injured/a-51559162>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2019/12/07/world/europe/ap-eu-slovakia-gas-explosion.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-12-06-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Samoa measles outbreak.

**Archived source account.** Samoan police arrest Edwin Tamasese, an anti-vaccination campaigner, for incitement against a government order.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC Australia](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2019-12-06/anti-vaxxer-charged-samoa-amid-nationwide-immunisation-drive/11772714>).

<a id="event-2019-12-06-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States District Court for the Central District of California rejects a US$190 million defamation suit against entrepreneur Elon Musk by Tham Luang cave rescuer Vernon Unsworth. The lawsuit, considered to be the first major suit by a private individual over comments made on Twitter, was filed over Musk's insulting Tweets after Unsworth criticized his role in the rescue.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-musk-lawsuit/tesla-boss-elon-musk-wins-defamation-trial-over-his-pedo-guy-tweet-idUSKBN1YA13U>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-12-06-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Dominican general election.

**Archived source account.** People in Dominica head to the polls to elect the members of the House of Assembly of Dominica. The governing Dominica Labour Party gathers the most votes and stays in power for another legislation.

Source citations (as archived): [Dominica News Online](<https://dominicanewsonline.com/news/homepage/homepage-carousel/breaking-news-dlp-wins-again-according-to-unofficial-reports/>).

### 2019-12-07

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1354000880](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20December%207&oldid=1354000880>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-12-07-0-1"></a>

Context: 2019–2021 Iraqi protests.

**Archived source account.** A drone attacks the home of prominent Shia cleric Muqtada al-Sadr, leaving no casualties and causing minimal damage. The attack follows yesterday's incident in Baghdad when multiple protesters were fired upon and killed.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-protests-baghdad/rocket-hits-iraqi-clerics-home-following-deadly-baghdad-attack-idUSKBN1YB09W>).

<a id="event-2019-12-07-0-3"></a>

Context: Afghan peace process.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban announce that the peace talks with the United States resumed "from where they stopped" in September.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/12/07/politics/us-taliban-peace-talks-resume-doha-qatar/index.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-12-07-1-1"></a>

Context: 2018–19 Southern Africa drought.

**Archived source account.** An unprecedented drought in Zimbabwe, considered the worst in a century, causes the Victoria Falls waterfall on the Zambezi river to nearly stop flowing.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/dec/07/victoria-falls-dries-to-a-trickle-after-worst-drought-in-a-century>).

<a id="event-2019-12-07-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A woman is killed and 18 other people injured when a bus crashes with a truck in Milan, Italy.

Source citations (as archived): [Ansa](<http://www.ansa.it/lombardia/notizie/2019/12/07/scontro-bus-camion-rifiuti-feriti_b566a1a7-0fe6-4eeb-b062-052f928302e6.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-12-07-2-1"></a>

Context: Iran–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** In an act of cooperation that is rare in recent years, Iran releases Princeton PhD candidate Wang Xiyue while the United States releases stem cell researcher Massoud Soleimani in a prisoner exchange. Both U.S. President Donald Trump and Iranian Foreign Minister Mohammad Javad Zarif thank the Swiss government for facilitating the swap.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-usa-prisoners/united-states-and-iran-swap-prisoners-in-rare-act-of-cooperation-idUSKBN1YB08X>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-12-07-3-1"></a>

Context: Rohingya genocide.

**Archived source account.** Myanmar's Aung San Suu Kyi travels to The Hague where she is expected to face genocide charges against her government for the alleged crimes committed against the Rohingya Muslim minority, in what is described as one of the most-high profile international legal cases in a generation.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2019/12/07/aung-san-suu-kyi-fight-genocide-charges-hague/>).

<a id="event-2019-12-07-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two indigenous leaders from the Guajajara tribe are shot dead in a drive-by shooting on a federal highway in Brazil's Maranhão state.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/dec/08/amazon-indigenous-leaders-killed-in-brazil-drive-by-shooting>).

### 2019-12-08

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1272890566](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20December%208&oldid=1272890566>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-12-08-0-1"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen, Yemeni Crisis (2011–present).

**Archived source account.** Sudanese Prime Minister Abdalla Hamdok says the government has reduced the number of Sudanese Armed Forces troops in Yemen from 15,000 to 5,000, saying the conflict "can no longer be solved militarily".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-sudan-politics/sudan-says-it-has-reduced-troops-in-yemen-to-5000-idUKKBN1YC0HX?il=0>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-12-08-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Delhi factory fire.

**Archived source account.** Forty-three workers are killed in a fire in a factory in Delhi, India.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-india-50703659>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-12-08-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis appoints Cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle, the Archbishop of Manila, Philippines, to head the Congregation for the Evangelization of Peoples. It is a congregation of the Roman Curia, responsible for world-wide missionary work and related activities.

Source citations (as archived): [Catholic News Agency](<https://www.catholicnewsagency.com/news/cardinal-tagle-named-head-of-vatican-evangelization-office-83714>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-12-08-3-1"></a>

Context: Women's rights in Saudi Arabia.

**Archived source account.** The Ministry of Municipal and Rural Affairs of Saudi Arabia announces that gender-segregated entrances are no longer mandatory for restaurants. This change is not considered compulsory however, and there are no announcements for similar changes to other public institutions.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/saudi-arabia-ends-gender-segregated-entrances-restaurants-191208171725619.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-12-08-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** After a massive march in the city, Civil Human Rights Front leader and Rainbow of Hong Kong activist Jimmy Sham says "it is the last chance for Carrie Lam to listen to the people".

Source citations (as archived): [Economic Times India](<https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/international/world-news/hong-kong-protesters-mark-half-a-year-of-protest-with-mammoth-rally/articleshow/72430246.cms>).

<a id="event-2019-12-08-4-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Sammarinese general election.

**Archived source account.** Citizens of San Marino are called to the polls in the first round to elect the 60 members of the Grand and General Council.

Source citations (as archived): [Il Resto del Carlino](<https://www.ilrestodelcarlino.it/rimini/politica/elezioni-san-marino-2019-1.4927174>).

<a id="event-2019-12-08-4-5"></a>

Context: Politics of Finland.

**Archived source account.** The Social Democratic Party of Finland selects Minister of Transport and Communications Sanna Marin for Prime Minister, following the resignation of Antti Rinne. If confirmed, she will become Finland's youngest ever Prime Minister and the world's youngest serving Prime Minister at age 34.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-finland-government-pm/finlands-social-democrats-name-marin-to-be-youngest-ever-prime-minister-idUKKBN1YC0JQ>).

<a id="event-2019-12-08-4-7"></a>

Context: 2019–20 Lebanese protests.

**Archived source account.** Businessman Samir Khatib withdraws his candidacy for the Prime Minister position after failing to secure enough votes from the Sunni Muslim bloc last week. This leaves the ousted Saad Hariri as the only potential candidate. Massive protests are formed outside the Parliament building in response to Hariri’s possible return.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/lebanon-hariri-emerges-pm-candidate-khatib-withdraws-191208192459108.html>).

### 2019-12-09

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1259092956](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20December%209&oldid=1259092956>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-12-09-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Russian Ministry of Defence says the Russian Armed Forces have entered Raqqa.

Source citations (as archived): [Asharq Al-Awsat](<https://aawsat.com/english/home/article/2027826/russian-forces-enter-syria%E2%80%99s-raqqa-after-us-pullback>).

<a id="event-2019-12-09-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** The Washington Post publishes raw interviews and notes taken for the Special Inspector General for Afghanistan Reconstruction's "lessons learned" initiative. The difference with the previously published reports reveals that senior U.S. administration officials misled the public by painting "a rosier picture of the state of the war than they knew to be true".

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/policy/defense/473635-documents-show-us-leaders-misled-public-on-progress-in-afghanistan-war-report>).

<a id="event-2019-12-09-0-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Venezuelan uprising attempt.

**Archived source account.** Sixteen Venezuelan National Guardsmen who took part in a failed attempt to overthrow President Nicolás Maduro on 30 April 2019 successfully flee Venezuela in a clandestine "military operation". The guards, accused of treason, were granted asylum in the Panamanian embassy in Caracas following the failed uprising.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/779a723625d58303b7beff55ed85c4f5>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-12-09-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Whakaari/White Island eruption.

**Archived source account.** New Zealand's Whakaari / White Island stratovolcano erupts with reports of at least five fatalities and a number of people injured or missing. Around 50 people, mostly tourists, were believed to be on the island at the time of eruption, according to Prime Minister Jacinda Ardern.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/12/08/asia/new-zealand-white-island-eruption-intl-hnk/>).

<a id="event-2019-12-09-1-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Chilean Air Force C-130 disappearance.

**Archived source account.** A Chilean Air Force C-130 Hercules with 38 passengers and crew onboard is reported missing while en route to Base Presidente Eduardo Frei Montalva in Antarctica.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-50723907>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-12-09-2-1"></a>

Context: War in Donbass, Normandy Format, Russia–Ukraine relations.

**Archived source account.** Volodymyr Zelensky, Vladimir Putin, Emmanuel Macron and Angela Merkel meet in Paris for Ukraine peace talks. It is the first time Putin and Zelensky meet and the first such four-way leaders' meeting since 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ukraine-crisis-summit/putin-meets-ukraine-leader-for-first-time-at-paris-peace-summit-idUSKBN1YD1TP>).

<a id="event-2019-12-09-2-2"></a>

Context: War in Donbass, Normandy Format, Russia–Ukraine relations.

**Archived source account.** Following a breakthrough in talks, Russia and Ukraine agree to implement a ceasefire in the Donbass by the end of 2019.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-50713647>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-12-09-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** British serial rapist Joseph McCann receives 33 life sentences, having been convicted on Friday at London's Old Bailey of 37 charges of rape, sexual assault, kidnapping and false imprisonment, his victims ranging from 11 to 71 years old.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky](<https://news.sky.com/story/joseph-mccann-serial-rapist-gets-33-life-sentences-after-campaign-of-sex-attacks-11882129>).

<a id="event-2019-12-09-3-2"></a>

Context: Crossfire Hurricane.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Inspector General Michael E. Horowitz releases a redacted version of his investigation into the origins of the FBI's investigation of members of Donald Trump's 2016 presidential campaign believed to be linked to Russian operations.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-russia/no-political-bias-but-fbi-made-mistakes-in-probe-of-trump-2016-campaign-watchdog-idUSKBN1YD11L>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-12-09-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The European Space Agency awards the first contract to clean up space debris, in a plan to remove a single piece of debris from orbit in 2025.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/science/2019/dec/09/european-space-agency-to-launch-clearspace-1-space-debris-collector-in-2025>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-12-09-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The 2019 Lou Marsh Award for best Canadian athlete is granted by unanimous vote to tennis player Bianca Andreescu.

Source citations (as archived): [The Star](<https://www.thestar.com/sports/2019/12/09/bianca-andreescu-named-unanimous-winner-of-lou-marsh-award.html>).

<a id="event-2019-12-09-5-2"></a>

Context: Doping in Russia.

**Archived source account.** The World Anti-Doping Agency bans Russia from competing in all major international sporting events, such as the 2020 Summer Olympics, 2022 Winter Olympics, the 2022 FIFA World Cup and possibly the 2024 Summer Olympics, for the next four years. Russian athletes that want to compete can only do so as part of a "neutral team". Russia has three weeks to appeal the decision at the Court of Arbitration for Sport.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/12/09/sport/wada-ban-russia-decision-rusada-doping-spt-intl/index.html>); [United News India](<http://www.uniindia.com/wada-ban-on-russia-may-not-cover-2020-olympics-but-will-then-cover-2024-olympics--crc/sports/news/1816082.html>).

### 2019-12-10

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1200603736](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20December%2010&oldid=1200603736>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-12-10-0-1"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Near the Villa Somalia presidential palace in Mogadishu, five al-Shabaab gunmen attack a SYL hotel. The attack and subsequent shootout kills three civilians, two soldiers and all the attackers.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS17](<https://www.cbs17.com/news/armed-men-attack-presidential-residence-in-somalias-capital/>).

<a id="event-2019-12-10-0-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Jersey City shooting.

**Archived source account.** Heavy gunfire is exchanged between police and two shooters in Jersey City, New Jersey. Six people are killed: a police officer, the shooters, and three people inside a kosher supermarket, which the shooters barricaded themselves in. Police describe the shooting as an "ambush".

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/jersey-city-shooting-today-active-shooter-police-officer-nj-mlk-drive-new-york-a9241241.html>); [NBC New York](<https://www.nbcnewyork.com/news/local/active-shooter-situation-in-jersey-city-sources-say/2238983/>).

<a id="event-2019-12-10-0-5"></a>

Context: Iranian involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Satellite images spot a tunnel system being dug at Imam Ali military base in eastern Syria, which is controlled by the Iranian military; Western intelligence believe the tunnels are being constructed to house their missiles.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<https://www.foxnews.com/world/iran-underground-tunnel-missile-storage>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-12-10-1-1"></a>

Context: Myanmar–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States Department of the Treasury blacklists four top Burmese military leaders, including Commander-in-Chief Min Aung Hlaing, for their role in the persecution of Rohingya Muslims and other minorities.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-myanmar-sanctions/u-s-blacklists-head-of-myanmar-military-for-alleged-rights-abuses-against-rohingya-idUSKBN1YE1XU?il=0>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-12-10-2-1"></a>

Context: Ostrava hospital attack.

**Archived source account.** In Ostrava, Czech Republic, a man opens fire in a hospital's waiting room, killing seven people before fleeing, then shooting himself dead.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-czech-shooting/gunman-kills-six-in-czech-hospital-before-shooting-himself-idUSKBN1YE0P4>).

<a id="event-2019-12-10-2-3"></a>

Context: Rohingya genocide case.

**Archived source account.** At the International Court of Justice, The Gambia presents charges against the government of Myanmar and its leader Aung San Suu Kyi, who traveled to appear in the court. According to the prosecution, the Burmese government is responsible for mass rapes, widespread arson and killings of Rohingya children, among other crimes.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-rohingya-world-court/as-suu-kyi-looks-on-gambia-details-mass-rapes-killings-in-myanmar-idUSKBN1YE0HL?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-12-10-2-5"></a>

Context: 2017 Saint Petersburg Metro bombing.

**Archived source account.** A military court sentences 10 people to jail terms ranging between 19 and 28 years. The person who is said to have trained the suicide bomber gets prison for life.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-50729108>).

<a id="event-2019-12-10-2-7"></a>

Context: Impeachment inquiry into Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** Democrats in the United States House of Representatives unveil two articles of impeachment against President Donald Trump: abuse of power and obstruction of Congress.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/politics/live-news/impeachment-inquiry-12-10-2019/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-12-10-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Alberto Fernández takes the oath of office as President of Argentina while Cristina Fernández de Kirchner is sworn in as Vice President.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.tv/l/P3X2/2019/12/10/argentina-s-president-elect-alberto-fernandez-is-sworn-in>).

### 2019-12-11

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088854066](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20December%2011&oldid=1088854066>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-12-11-0-1"></a>

Context: Islamic terrorism in Europe.

**Archived source account.** Across Denmark, police arrest twenty Islamists who were planning attacks. Bomb materials were found in some of the houses during the raids.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/dec/11/islamist-terrorism-suspects-arrested-in-raids-across-denmark>).

<a id="event-2019-12-11-0-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Bagram Airfield attack.

**Archived source account.** Taliban forces assaulted a United States air base in Afghanistan amidst peace talks between the two parties. The attackers killed two civilians and injured another 80 people using two car bombs and guns. The attackers were successfully repelled by a NATO mission present at the base along with support from US fighter aircraft.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/12/11/world/asia/Afghanistan-bagram-airfield-attack.html>); [Military Times](<https://www.militarytimes.com/flashpoints/2019/12/11/airstrikes-called-in-as-taliban-attempt-to-breach-bagram-air-base/>).

<a id="event-2019-12-11-0-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Inates attack.

**Archived source account.** At least 71 people were killed after terrorists stormed a military base in Inates, Niger. The attack was carried out by suspected Islamic State in the Greater Sahara militants.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-50744649>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-niger-security/jihadists-kill-71-soldiers-in-mass-attack-niger-military-idUSKBN1YF2DF?il=0>).

The Young Doctors Association of Pakistan reports death of 12 patients.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-aramco-ipo-markets/vindication-saudi-arabia-hails-10-debut-jump-in-aramco-shares-idUSKBN1YF0LC>).

<a id="event-2019-12-17-0-0"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [CGTN](<https://news.cgtn.com/news/2019-12-17/Xi-attends-commissioning-of-first-Chinese-built-aircraft-carrier-Mv4uyZPVUk/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-12-17-1-1"></a>

Context: Musharraf high treason case.

**Archived source account.** Former President of Pakistan Pervez Musharraf is sentenced to death in absentia for high treason, by a 2-1 majority. He is described as a dictator who seized power in a 1999 coup, imposed a 2007 state of emergency and resigned in 2008 to avoid impeachment.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/12/17/asia/pervez-musharraf-death-sentence-pakistan-intl-hnk/index.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pakistan-law-musharraf/pakistan-sentences-former-dictator-musharraf-to-death-in-absentia-idUSKBN1YL0MJ>).

<a id="event-2019-12-17-1-3"></a>

Context: 2016–present purges in Turkey.

**Archived source account.** Turkish police arrest 191 people, including a mayor, accused of links with the Gülen movement (named by Turkey as FETÖ, a terrorist group) and of using ByLock, an encrypted messaging application.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Sabah](<https://www.dailysabah.com/investigations/2019/12/17/mayor-190-others-arrested-in-new-wave-of-operations-against-feto>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-12-17-2-1"></a>

Context: Climate change in Australia.

**Archived source account.** A temperature of 47°C (116.6F) is recorded in the remote outback town of Oodnadatta, South Australia, marking Australia's hottest day on record with average temperatures of 40.9°C, according to the Bureau of Meteorology.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/australia-has-hottest-day-on-record-as-heatwave-grips-the-country-11889511>).

### 2019-12-18

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088862042](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20December%2018&oldid=1088862042>).

#### Armed conflict and attack

<a id="event-2019-12-18-0-1"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Boko Haram militants open fire on civilians, killing 15 and wounding five others in a fishing village in Chad. 13 others were missing after the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/chad-dozen-killed-boko-haram-attack-191218140312791.html>).

<a id="event-2019-12-18-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Gunmen kill two police officers escorting a polio vaccination team in Lower Dir District, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [National Post](<https://nationalpost.com/pmn/health-pmn/gunmen-in-pakistan-kill-two-police-escorting-polio-vaccinators>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-12-18-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ilham Tohti, an Uyghur economist serving a life sentence for his criticisms of China’s policies in Xinjiang, is awarded this year’s Sakharov Prize.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/jailed-uighur-economist-ilham-tohti-receive-sakharov-prize-191216064925850.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-12-18-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pakistan pulls out of an international summit of Muslim nations in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, scheduled to start this Thursday. Foreign Minister Shah Mahmood Qureshi said it was done after Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates expressed concern that the summit was to establish a rival bloc to the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/pakistan-pulls-malaysia-summit-muslim-nations-191218082917256.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-12-18-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Cabinet of Germany proposes to ban conversion therapy for both transgender and gay people. The proposal was expanded to include people between the ages of 16 and 18.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/germanys-cabinet-approves-ban-on-gay-transgender-conversion-therapy/a-51717750>).

<a id="event-2019-12-18-3-2"></a>

Context: Impeachment of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The United States House of Representatives votes largely along party lines to impeach President Donald Trump for abuse of power and obstruction of Congress. Trump becomes the third American president to be impeached by the House, after Andrew Johnson and Bill Clinton. His impeachment proceedings continue on to the Senate, which will give them a final verdict and decide whether or not he should be removed from office.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2019/12/18/us/politics/impeachment-vote.html?action=click&amp;module=Spotlight&amp;pgtype=Homepage>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-12-18-4-1"></a>

Context: Cosmic Vision.

**Archived source account.** Arianespace successfully launches the European Space Agency's CHEOPS space telescope from Guiana Space Centre. The European observatory will search for new exoplanets and will be able to study an exoplanet's composition and internal structure. The launch also included OPS-SAT, an ESA CubeSat.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-50804258>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2019-12-18-5-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Catalan protests.

**Archived source account.** Despite the boycott attempt by Democratic Tsunami, El Clásico is played in Camp Nou, Barcelona, with important security measures.

Source citations (as archived): [Ruptly](<https://ruptly.tv/en/events/201912182042-LIVE2242>).

<a id="event-2019-12-18-5-2"></a>

Context: 2019 Catalan protests.

**Archived source account.** The first clashes between Mossos d'Esquadra, Boixos Nois and protestors occur outside the stadium, leaving 9 arrested and 70 injured.

Source citations (as archived): [El País](<https://elpais.com/ccaa/2019/12/18/catalunya/1576691270_224054.html>); [Marca](<https://www.marca.com/en/football/barcelona/2019/12/18/5dfa844022601de4518b45bf.html>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-50845732>); [El Mundo](<https://www.elmundo.es/deportes/futbol/primera-division/2019/12/18/5dfaaa6021efa0892f8b4643.html>).

### 2019-12-19

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256032124](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20December%2019&oldid=1256032124>).

#### International Relations

<a id="event-2019-12-19-0-1"></a>

Context: Pakistan–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. State Department reinstates Pakistan into International Military Education and Training program. It was suspended in August 2018 as part of the Trump administration's pressure to have it crack down on Islamist militants.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-pakistan/u-s-to-resume-military-training-program-for-pakistan-state-department-idUSKBN1YO03S?il=0>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-12-19-1-1"></a>

Context: Maguindanao massacre.

**Archived source account.** A court in the Philippines finds 28 people, including former Mayor Andal Ampatuan Jr. and his brother, former Governor Zaldy Ampatuan, guilty of murder for their roles in the Maguindanao massacre, and sentences them to life imprisonment (40 years).

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<https://www.rappler.com/nation/247380-ampatuan-brothers-guilty-ampatuan-maguindanao-massacre-case>).

<a id="event-2019-12-19-1-2"></a>

Context: Maguindanao massacre.

**Archived source account.** Mayor Sajid Ampatuan, also a brother of Mayor Andal Ampatuan Jr., and 55 others are acquitted.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<https://www.rappler.com/nation/247380-ampatuan-brothers-guilty-ampatuan-maguindanao-massacre-case>).

<a id="event-2019-12-19-1-4"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis, April 2019 Spanish general election.

**Archived source account.** President of Catalonia Quim Torra is sentenced by the High Court of Justice of Catalonia to a year and a half of disqualification (inhabilitación) from exercising the powers of elected office, in addition to a fine of 30,000€ for disobeying the Central Electoral Board by not withdrawing partisan symbols in the Palau de la Generalitat and not guaranteeing the institution's neutrality during the April election campaign. Torra can appeal the ruling.

Source citations (as archived): [El País](<https://elpais.com/ccaa/2019/12/19/catalunya/1576750819_163784.html>).

<a id="event-2019-12-19-1-6"></a>

Context: Trial of Catalonia independence leaders, 2019 European Parliament election.

**Archived source account.** The European Court of Justice determines that jailed former Vice President of Catalonia Oriol Junqueras had immunity as an elected MEP, despite being unable to take up his seat, as the Spanish Supreme Court had ruled due to his then-provisional prison situation.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/dec/19/jailed-catalan-leader-oriol-junqueras-had-immunity-as-mep-court-rules>).

<a id="event-2019-12-19-1-8"></a>

Context: Moscow FSB headquarters shooting.

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed and four injured in a mass shooting outside Russia's Federal Security Service headquarters on Moscow's Lubyanka Square. The shooter is also killed.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-russia-shooting/russia-names-gunman-behind-moscow-shooting-death-toll-rises-to-two-idUKKBN1YO0V0?il=0>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-12-19-2-1"></a>

Context: Citizenship Amendment Act protests.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of demonstrators take to the streets in various parts of India to protest the Citizenship (Amendment) Act, 2019. Some are arrested, and internet service is shut down in many parts of the country.

Source citations (as archived): [ndtv](<https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/hundreds-protest-against-citizenship-act-citizens-list-in-mumbais-august-kranti-maidan-2151411?trendingnow>).

<a id="event-2019-12-19-2-2"></a>

Context: Citizenship Amendment Act protests.

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed in violent clashes between protesters and police in Mangalore and Lucknow.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-50833361>).

<a id="event-2019-12-19-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Venezuelan Supreme Court overturns a rule pertaining to the opposition-led National Assembly, which allowed members of the Assembly to vote in absentia due to large numbers of exiled opposition politicians.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\!](<https://news.yahoo.com/venezuelan-court-overturns-congress-decision-201022764.html>).

<a id="event-2019-12-19-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Parliament of Lebanon nominates former Education Minister Hassan Diab as Prime Minister. President Michel Aoun tasks him with forming a new government.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/hezbollah-backed-hassan-diab-lebanon-pm-191219155153401.html>).

<a id="event-2019-12-19-2-6"></a>

Context: 2020 Labour Party leadership election.

**Archived source account.** Shadow Treasury Minister Clive Lewis announces his candidacy to succeed Jeremy Corbyn as Leader of the Labour Party. He is the second person to make this announcement, after Shadow Foreign Secretary Emily Thornberry.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-50861140>).

<a id="event-2019-12-19-2-8"></a>

Context: 2019 Algerian presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Abdelmadjid Tebboune is sworn in as President of Algeria, the first after 20 years of Abdelaziz Bouteflika regime.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/algeria-swears-president-opposition-debates-response-191219110029526.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-12-19-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Scientists discover a 386 million-year-old fossil forest at a sandstone quarry in Cairo, New York, making it the oldest known fossil forest in the world.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2019/dec/19/worlds-oldest-known-fossil-forest-found-in-new-york-quarry>).

### 2019-12-20

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1107961828](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20December%2020&oldid=1107961828>).

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2019-12-20-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Fighting resumes in rebel-held northwestern Syria, as government forces capture four villages by making their first large-scale push against rebel groups since the ceasefire that ended the 2019 northwestern Syria offensive earlier this year.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/syrian-troops-make-push-rebel-held-northwest-idlib-67856263>).

<a id="event-2019-12-20-0-3"></a>

Context: Citizenship Amendment Act protests.

**Archived source account.** Further clashes between protesters and police in the northern state of Uttar Pradesh leaves six people dead.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/killed-india-anti-citizenship-law-protests-rumble-191220171811195.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-12-20-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Japan announces it will raise military spending (1.1%) for an eighth consecutive year to a record high as it invests in ballistic missile and air defence to counter a perceived threat from North Korea and China.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-japan-economy-budget-defence/japan-government-approves-eighth-straight-defense-spending-hike-to-record-high-idUSKBN1YO05N>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-12-20-2-1"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Chief Prosecutor of the International Criminal Court Fatou Bensouda announces she will launch a full investigation into allegations of war crimes in the Palestinian territories.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/icc-investigate-alleged-war-crimes-palestinian-territories-191220143949348.html>).

<a id="event-2019-12-20-2-3"></a>

Context: Iran–Japan relations.

**Archived source account.** Iranian President Hassan Rouhani meets with Prime Minister Shinzō Abe in Tokyo to discuss renewing the Iranian nuclear deal. Rouhani is the first Iranian president to visit Japan in over 19 years.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/iran-rouhani-visits-japan-nuclear-deal-impasse-191220153826601.html>).

<a id="event-2019-12-20-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Two Popes film is released on Netflix just before the holiday season. It has a limited theatrical release during November in the United States and United Kingdom. Jonathan Pryce as Pope Francis gives a dramatic interpretation of a series of conversations that took place between the liberal cardinal and the conservative incumbent Pope Benedict (played by Anthony Hopkins).

Source citations (as archived): [Screen Daily](<https://www.screendaily.com/features/jonathan-pryce-on-playing-pope-francis-in-the-two-popes-hes-a-flawed-character/5145379.article>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-12-20-3-1"></a>

Context: Climate justice, Climate change mitigation.

**Archived source account.** In Urgenda Foundation v. State of the Netherlands, the Supreme Court of the Netherlands upholds a 2015 ruling that "protection from the potentially devastating effects of climate change" is a human right, ordering the Dutch government to cut greenhouse gas emissions by at least 25% by the end of 2020 compared to 1990 levels.

Source citations (as archived): [climatecasechart.com](<http://climatecasechart.com/non-us-case/urgenda-foundation-v-kingdom-of-the-netherlands/>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/5534fe18ac5352ba43c74c9a64d6a20a>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-12-20-4-1"></a>

Context: Brexit.

**Archived source account.** The House of Commons of the United Kingdom votes 358–234 to pass the government's Brexit withdrawal agreement for the United Kingdom to leave the European Union on 31 January 2020. The bill will now head to the House of Lords for final approval. The bill also rules out extending trade talks with the EU beyond 31 December 2020, known as the "transition period".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-50870939>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-12-20-5-1"></a>

Context: Boeing Orbital Flight Test.

**Archived source account.** An Atlas V N22 rocket successfully launches the first space-faring Boeing Starliner spacecraft during the Boe-OFT mission. However, an issue with the spacecraft's mission elapsed time clock immediately after launch causes the premature depletion of the spacecraft's attitude control fuel, precluding the spacecraft's planned rendezvous with the International Space Station. An early reentry and landing of the spacecraft at the White Sands Missile Range is planned for 22 December.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2019/12/20/790098677/in-uncrewed-test-boeings-starliner-capsule-fails-to-reach-space-station>).

<a id="event-2019-12-20-5-3"></a>

Context: Twitter suspensions.

**Archived source account.** Twitter bans almost 6,000 accounts, alleging that they were "amplifying messages favourable to Saudi authorities" in a Saudi state-backed coordination.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-50872118>).

### 2019-12-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1363908094](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20December%2021&oldid=1363908094>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-12-21-0-1"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War (2009–present).

**Archived source account.** A suicide attack by car bomb in Galkayo, Somalia, kills at least seven civilians, though the death toll is expected to rise according to military officials. According to a military spokesman, the suicide bomber tried to enter a hotel compound but failed and hit a military pickup. No group has claimed responsibility yet.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-somalia-attack-galkayo/suicide-bomb-outside-somali-hotel-kills-at-least-seven-military-idUSKBN1YP0KT>).

<a id="event-2019-12-21-0-3"></a>

Context: Islamic insurgency in the Maghreb (2002–present), Operation Barkhane.

**Archived source account.** During his visit to West Africa, French President Emmanuel Macron says that French forces killed 33 Islamist militants in central Mali earlier that day.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/dec/21/french-forces-kill-33-islamic-extremists-in-mali-says-macron>).

<a id="event-2019-12-21-0-5"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War, Libya–Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** The Libyan Coast Guard loyal to Field marshal Khalifa Haftar seizes a Grenada-flagged ship with a Turkish crew off the coast of Derna, Libya, according to a spokesman for the Libyan National Army.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-libya-security-turkey/eastern-libyan-forces-seize-ship-with-a-turkish-crew-spokesman-idUSKBN1YP0LW>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-12-21-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nord Stream 2 says it will finish construction "as soon as possible" after a contractor suspends pipe-laying work due to U.S. sanctions on the Russian gas pipeline to Europe.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-russia-nord-stream-completion/nord-stream-2-to-press-on-with-europe-gas-pipe-despite-u-s-sanctions-idUSKBN1YP061>).

<a id="event-2019-12-21-1-2"></a>

Context: Russia–Ukraine relations.

**Archived source account.** Russia and Ukraine reach a new five-year agreement on gas transit.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/5025492604b2378ef41e5e040351814c>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-12-21-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A fire at an apartment building in Las Vegas, Nevada, United States, kills six people and injures thirteen others.

Source citations (as archived): [Las Vegas Review-Journal](<https://www.reviewjournal.com/local/local-las-vegas/6-dead-in-downtown-las-vegas-apartment-fire-1919071/amp/>).

<a id="event-2019-12-21-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bus collides with a truck near Gualán, Guatemala, killing at least 21 people including seven children, according to the Guatemalan Public Ministry.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/12/21/americas/guatemala-bus-crash/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-12-21-3-1"></a>

Context: Censorship in Pakistan, Blasphemy in Pakistan, Capital punishment in Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** A court in Multan, Punjab, Pakistan, sentences university professor Junaid Hafeez to death for blasphemy – verbal and on Facebook.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/pakistani-academic-junaid-hafeez-sentenced-death-blasphemy-191221091139428.html>).

<a id="event-2019-12-21-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Royal Canadian Mounted Police arrest two suspects after they allegedly made online death threats to Prime Minister Justin Trudeau. Trudeau had to wear a bulletproof vest during a visit to Mississauga, Ontario, due to the threats made during his electoral campaign.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News Canada](<https://ca.news.yahoo.com/rcmp-arrests-2-alleged-online-184209881.html>).

### 2019-12-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088864161](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20December%2022&oldid=1088864161>).

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2019-12-22-0-1"></a>

Context: Crisis in Venezuela.

**Archived source account.** Attackers raid a military facility in the southern state of Bolívar, killing one soldier and stealing weapons. Authorities say the weapons are recovered and opposition-linked suspects are arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-military/southern-venezuela-military-facility-raided-one-soldier-dead-officials-idUSKBN1YQ0M9>).

<a id="event-2019-12-22-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Suspected Boko Haram militants have killed at least 50 people on an island on Lake Chad, bordering Cameroon and Chad.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-50987123>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-12-22-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** British retailer Tesco suspends operations at a factory in China after the Sunday Times newspaper reports that a six-year-old in London found a message from Shanghai prisoners calling for help and urging whoever finds the message to alert a human rights organisation, with a link to the author of the story, hidden inside a pack of charity Christmas cards. Tesco says that it has a policy against using prison labour.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-50883161>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-12-22-2-1"></a>

Context: 2019–20 Australian bushfire season.

**Archived source account.** Fire and Rescue NSW firefighters gain access to previously cut-off towns and settlements by bushfires in New South Wales, taking advantage of cooler weather. The small town of Balmoral is reported as being destroyed with NSW Premier Gladys Berejiklian saying there's "not much left" of the town.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Telegraph](<https://www.dailytelegraph.com.au/news/nsw/black-christmas-record-number-of-fireys-battle-terrifying-blazes/news-story/a8c4f2e3fbc15b85b9dc98f237b3605f>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-australia-bushfires/australian-firefighters-access-badly-burned-towns-pm-defends-climate-policies-idUSKBN1YP0MG>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-12-22-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A riot at a maximum security prison in El Porvenir, Atlántida, Honduras leaves at least 16 inmates dead, according to Honduran authorities. The riot comes just two days after another riot killed 18 inmates at a prison in the town of Tela.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/796606438edfbd2d5a79a7e200aa18f1>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-12-22-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Afghan presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Afghanistan's incumbent President Ashraf Ghani wins a slim majority of the votes in a September 28 election, delayed preliminary results showed after a poll that plunged the country into political crisis and was marred by allegations of fraud.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-election/afghanistans-ghani-wins-slim-majority-of-presidential-vote-in-preliminary-results-idUSKBN1YQ054>).

Context: 2019 Croatian presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Citizens of Croatia cast their votes in the latest presidential election.

<a id="event-2019-12-22-4-5"></a>

Context: 2019 Hong Kong protests.

**Archived source account.** Over a thousand protestors march in the financial district of Hong Kong to show solidarity with Uyghur Muslims in Xinjiang. A dozen police officers clash with the crowd to disperse them.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hongkong-protests/clashes-as-police-try-to-clear-hong-kong-protesters-after-uighur-support-rally-idUSKBN1YQ076>).
