#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-12-22-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Boeing's unmanned CST-100 Starliner crew capsule successfully reenters the atmosphere and lands at White Sands Missile Range in New Mexico, United States, after a failed rendezvous with the International Space Station.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/science/2019/dec/22/nasa-boeing-starliner-capsule-lands-safely-new-mexico>).

### 2019-12-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1110216917](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20December%2023&oldid=1110216917>).

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2019-12-23-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A car bomb in Turkish-controlled Suluk, Tell Abyad District, Raqqa Governorate, kills five people and wounds others. Turkey's defense ministry says the attack killed eight civilians and was by the PKK/YPG group.

Source citations (as archived): [TRTWorld](<https://www.trtworld.com/middle-east/car-bomb-kills-eight-civilians-in-northern-syria-turkey-32421>).

<a id="event-2019-12-23-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The UK-based SOHR says an Israeli missile attack near Damascus killed three foreigners, believed to be Iranians.

Source citations (as archived): [Ynetnews](<https://www.ynetnews.com/article/B1r5AAaCH>).

<a id="event-2019-12-23-0-4"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** The Pentagon says a U.S. soldier has been killed in combat. The Taliban claim a roadside bomb in Char Dara District, Kunduz Province was responsible.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/afghanistan-american-service-member-killed-us-military-says-today-2019-12-23/>).

<a id="event-2019-12-23-0-6"></a>

Context: Insurgency in the Maghreb (2002–present), Operation Barkhane.

**Archived source account.** France's defense ministry reports its first armed drone strike. On Saturday, a Reaper drone strike killed seven in central Mali.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/World/2019/Dec-23/498009-france-says-it-carries-out-1st-armed-drone-strike-in-mali.ashx>).

<a id="event-2019-12-23-0-8"></a>

Context: 2019 Iranian protests.

**Archived source account.** Unknown Iranian officials claimed the death toll is 1,500 in recent crackdowns by security forces. The United States confirmed the report, including the deaths of 400 women and a dozen teenagers.

Source citations (as archived): [VOA](<https://www.voanews.com/middle-east/voa-news-iran/us-confirms-report-citing-iran-officials-saying-1500-killed-protests>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-12-23-1-1"></a>

Context: Crimean Bridge.

**Archived source account.** A railway bridge over the Kerch Strait connecting Russia and Crimea, the longest in Europe, is inaugurated.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/6123f7874d16f3819965dbc00f20e850>).

<a id="event-2019-12-23-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Democratic Republic of the Congo launches an investigation into allegations of money laundering at the state-owned mining company Gécamines, relating to a €200 million loan by the sanctioned Fleurette Group.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-congo-mining/congo-prosecutors-probe-israeli-billionaires-loan-to-state-mining-company-idUSKBN1YR1JK?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-12-23-1-4"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Boeing 737 MAX groundings.

**Archived source account.** Boeing announces the resignation of its CEO, Dennis Muilenburg, amidst ongoing controversy over the crashes and subsequent groundings of the Boeing 737 MAX fleet.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/12/23/business/boeing-dennis-muilenburg/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-12-23-1-6"></a>

Context: Economy of China.

**Archived source account.** China announces the reduction of tariffs on 850 products and measures to open markets in several industries.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/a3c6388217bfc1a48267fbb763608316>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-12-23-2-1"></a>

Context: Fukushima disaster cleanup.

**Archived source account.** Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry proposes gradually releasing or allowing to evaporate massive amounts of radioactive water at the tsunami-hit Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant.

Source citations (as archived): [TIME](<https://time.com/5754524/fukushima-nuclear-water-release-environment/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-12-23-3-1"></a>

Context: North Korea–United States relations, Korean peace process.

**Archived source account.** North Korea warns of a "Christmas gift" if the United States does not come up with an agreement by the end of the year.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/dec/12/us-warns-north-korea-of-consequences-of-missile-test-christmas-gift>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-12-23-4-1"></a>

Context: Assassination of Jamal Khashoggi.

**Archived source account.** A court in Saudi Arabia sentences five people to death for the 2018 killing of journalist Jamal Khashoggi. Three other defendants are given prison sentences totalling a combined 24 years, and another three are acquitted.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-50890633>).

<a id="event-2019-12-23-4-2"></a>

Context: Assassination of Jamal Khashoggi.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations rapporteur on summary executions, Agnès Callamard, describes the sentence as a "mockery" of justice, since, according to her, it was an "extrajudicial execution for which the state of Saudi Arabia is responsible" and its masterminds walk free.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/turkey-rights-groups-decry-saudi-verdict-khashoggi-murder-191223171239748.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-12-23-5-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Algerian protests.

**Archived source account.** The Chief of Staff of the People's National Army of Algeria, Ahmed Gaid Salah, dies unexpectedly of a heart attack. Saïd Chengriha is appointed to the post ad interim.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.arabnews.com/node/1602921/middle-east>).

<a id="event-2019-12-23-5-3"></a>

Context: 2019 Jharkhand Legislative Assembly election.

**Archived source account.** In an election occurring in the midst of massive protests against the central government, the incumbent right-wing Bharatiya Janata Party is projected to lose its majority to the United Progressive Alliance parties in the eastern Indian state of Jharkhand.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/india-bjp-concedes-defeat-jharkhand-state-assembly-election-191223121238135.html>).

<a id="event-2019-12-23-5-5"></a>

Context: 2019 French pension reform strike.

**Archived source account.** Around 30 protestors clash with riot police at the Gare de Lyon in Paris.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-france-protests-pensions/protesters-clash-with-police-at-key-paris-rail-terminal-idUSKBN1YR123?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-12-23-5-7"></a>

Context: Politics of Bosnia and Herzegovina.

**Archived source account.** The Bosnian parliament approves Prime Minister Zoran Tegeltija's cabinet after a 14-month deadlock, caused by disagreements over proceeding with NATO integration, with Tegeltija stating his main priority is pursuing membership with the European Union.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bosnia-government/bosnian-lawmakers-approve-new-government-after-14-month-deadlock-idUSKBN1YR1JE?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-12-23-5-9"></a>

Context: Politics of Romania.

**Archived source account.** Centrist Florin Cîțu is approved by the Parliament as the new Prime Minister, succeeding acting Nicolae Ciucă.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News](<https://news.yahoo.com/romanias-parliament-approves-government-171428082.html>).

### 2019-12-24

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1131735515](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20December%2024&oldid=1131735515>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-12-24-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Taliban insurgents ambush an Afghan National Army checkpoint, killing 15 members of the security forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-attack/taliban-kill-15-in-attack-on-afghan-security-checkpoint-local-officials-idUSKBN1YS0K2>).

<a id="event-2019-12-24-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Northwestern Syria offensive (December 2019–March 2020).

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Army continues its offensive in southern Idlib Governorate towards the key rebel-held city of Ma'arrat al-Nu'man, capturing several towns and villages, including Jarjnaz and Sarman. Around 30,000 civilians have fled the area in recent days, according to the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights.

Source citations (as archived): [Channel News Asia](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/syria-regime-forces-surround-turkish-army-post-in-idlib--12207822>).

<a id="event-2019-12-24-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Northwestern Syria offensive (December 2019–March 2020).

**Archived source account.** A war monitor reports that eight people—including five children—were killed after a missile struck a school in Jobas, Idlib District, used as a shelter for displaced civilians. Opposition activists blame Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/children-killed-syria-missile-hits-school-191224115623082.html>).

<a id="event-2019-12-24-0-6"></a>

Context: Arbinda attack, Maghreb insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Thirty-five civilians are dead and six others are injured after jihadists stormed the town of Arbinda, Soum Province, Burkina Faso, and its military base, killing seven soldiers. Eighty militants were also killed.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-50908880>).

<a id="event-2019-12-24-0-8"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen attack the Christian village of Chibok in Borno State, Nigeria, killing seven Christians. It is believed the attack was targeted for Christmas.

Source citations (as archived): [VOA News](<https://www.voanews.com/africa/7-killed-nigeria-jihadist-attack-christmas-eve>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-12-24-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bus plunges into a ravine in South Sumatra, Indonesia, killing at least 25 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/sumatra-bus-crash-25-killed-after-262ft-ravine-plunge-11894592>).

<a id="event-2019-12-24-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 28 people are killed after the Typhoon Phanfone battered the Philippines. It led to the evacuation of more than 58,000 people.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-50921944>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-12-24-2-1"></a>

Context: United States–Zambia relations, LGBT rights in Zambia.

**Archived source account.** Sources report that the U.S. has recalled its ambassador to Zambia after a row over a conviction of men who were sentenced to prison in Zambia for consensual homosexual acts. President of Zambia Edgar Lungu declared ambassador Daniel Lewis Foote persona non grata because he had criticized the verdict while accusing Zambia of not actively prosecuting misappropriation of donor aid.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-50901537>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-12-24-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Iraqi protests.

**Archived source account.** The Council of Representatives passes a series of electoral laws to placate protestors. The laws will allow voters to select individuals rather than use party lists, and the candidates will represent electoral districts rather than provinces.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-protests/iraq-passes-electoral-reforms-but-deadlock-remains-idUSKBN1YS157?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-12-24-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thousands of Ethiopian Muslims march across the country in response to attacks last Friday that saw four mosques and multiple Muslim-owned businesses burned in the Amhara Region.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/ethiopian-muslims-protest-mosques-burned-191224141944689.html>).

### 2019-12-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1354000398](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20December%2025&oldid=1354000398>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-12-25-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Taliban militants say they have kidnapped 27 local peace activists in Farah Province as they were traveling from Herat Province.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanitan-kidnapping/27-local-peace-activists-abducted-in-western-afghanistan-idUSKBN1YT0FB>).

<a id="event-2019-12-25-0-3"></a>

Context: Arbinda attack.

**Archived source account.** In Burkina Faso, the government orders 48 hours of mourning after the jihadist attack yesterday in Soum Province.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/mourning-burkina-faso-attack-kills-dozens-191225001927810.html>).

<a id="event-2019-12-25-0-4"></a>

Context: Arbinda attack.

**Archived source account.** A dozen Burkina Faso soldiers are killed in an armed attack in the night by militants responsible for the previous attack.

Source citations (as archived): [DW News](<https://www.dw.com/en/burkina-faso-tense-in-mourning-amid-jihadist-attacks/a-51795594>).

<a id="event-2019-12-25-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two "wanted terrorists" are killed in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, after exchanging gunfire with security forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-security/saudi-security-forces-kill-two-terrorists-after-dammam-city-shooting-tv-idUSKBN1YT0KU>).

<a id="event-2019-12-25-0-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is briefly brought to a bomb shelter during an election rally in Ashkelon, Israel, after a rocket is fired from the Gaza Strip. The rocket is intercepted with no casualties reported.

Source citations (as archived): [NBCWashington](<https://www.nbcwashington.com/news/national-international/israel-gaza-rocket-intercepted-as-pm-held-election-rally/2192244/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians-violence/gaza-rocket-sends-netanyahu-to-shelter-during-campaign-rally-tv-idUSKBN1YT0P6?>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-12-25-1-1"></a>

Context: Notre-Dame de Paris fire.

**Archived source account.** Notre-Dame rector Patrick Chauvet states there is "maybe a 50 percent chance that \[the building\] will be saved" due to deterioration of scaffolding near the vaults, and that renovations will not start until 2021 at the soonest.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/notre-dame-rector-fragile-cathedral-saved-191225163613989.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-12-25-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Japanese National Diet member Tsukasa Akimoto of the ruling Liberal Democratic Party is arrested for allegedly receiving up to ¥3 million in bribes from a Chinese company interested in setting up a casino in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-japan-casino-corruption/japan-ruling-party-lawmaker-arrested-on-casino-bribery-suspicion-prosecutors-idUSKBN1YT03N?il=0>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-12-25-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019–2021 Iraqi protests.

**Archived source account.** The largest parliamentary bloc, Binaa Bloc, including Fatah Alliance and State of Law Coalition, nominates Basra governor Asaad Al Eidani to succeed Adil Abdul-Mahdi as Prime Minister of Iraq. Protesters reject the nomination, seeing him as part of the establishment.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/iraq-iran-backed-bloc-nominates-basra-governor-pm-191225124512897.html>).

### 2019-12-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1131735575](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20December%2026&oldid=1131735575>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-12-26-0-1"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War, Libya–Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan announces he will send troops to Libya to help the internationally-recognized Tripoli-based Government of National Accord after they requested support. He plans to submit his motion to the Grand National Assembly on January 7 for approval.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/erdogan-announces-plan-send-troops-libya-191226090214331.html>).

<a id="event-2019-12-26-0-3"></a>

Context: Insurgency in the Maghreb.

**Archived source account.** Fourteen Nigerien soldiers are killed by heavily armed militant gunmen who ambushed the convoy in the Tillabéri Region of Niger.

Source citations (as archived): [France24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20191226-niger-authorities-say-14-troops-killed-during-ambush-g5-sahel-force-west-africa>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-12-26-1-1"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in Japan.

**Archived source account.** Japan executes a foreigner for the first time since the disclosure of details of its sentences began in 2007. He was a Chinese man convicted of killing a family of four.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-japan-deathpenalty/japan-executes-first-foreigner-in-years-a-chinese-man-who-killed-a-family-idUSKBN1YU07N>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-50916494>).

<a id="event-2019-12-26-1-3"></a>

Context: Censorship in Turkey.

**Archived source account.** The Constitutional Court of Turkey orders the immediate lifting of the block of Wikipedia in Turkey, ruling it a violation of the freedom of expression. In response to the news, Wikipedia co-founder Jimmy Wales says, "Welcome back, Turkey\!"

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/dec/26/turkish-court-wikipedia-block-lifted>).

<a id="event-2019-12-26-1-5"></a>

Context: 2020 Ivorian general election.

**Archived source account.** In Ivory Coast, former rebel leader, prime minister and presidential candidate for next year's general election, Guillaume Soro, could face prison for life over an alleged coup plot that involved amassing weapons, says the country's public prosecutor.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ivorycoast-politics/ivory-coast-says-presidential-candidate-soro-plotted-a-coup-idUSKBN1YU14A?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-12-26-1-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court in Morocco sentences a man to four years in prison for insulting the king. Authorities also arrest a Twitter user for criticizing the long prison terms given to those who protest.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-morocco-trial/morocco-jails-one-man-detains-another-over-criticism-of-authorities-on-social-media-idUSKBN1YU16M>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-12-26-2-1"></a>

Context: Citizenship Amendment Act protests.

**Archived source account.** Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh Yogi Adityanath threatens to confiscate property from more than 200 people, mostly Muslims, allegedly to pay for damages caused by protesters. The northern Indian state has seen the most violence from the protests, with 18 out of the 25 killings happening there.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/indian-state-warns-law-protesters-confiscate-property-191226111207708.html>).

<a id="event-2019-12-26-2-3"></a>

Context: Freedom of religion in Montenegro.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of protesters, mostly consisting of supporters of the pro-Serbia opposition bloc, march in Podgorica, Montenegro, to protest a proposed law that would require religious communities to provide proof of property ownership from before the creation of Yugoslavia in 1918. Protesters claim the law unfairly targets the predominant Serbian Orthodox Church.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-montenegro-protest/serbs-protest-in-montenegro-ahead-of-vote-on-religious-law-idUSKBN1YU0WC?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-12-26-2-5"></a>

Context: 2020 Israeli legislative election.

**Archived source account.** Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu survives a primary challenge from former Education Minister Gideon Sa'ar with 72% of the vote.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/dec/26/israel-voting-under-way-in-likud-primary-seen-as-threat-to-netanyahu>).

<a id="event-2019-12-26-2-7"></a>

Context: 2019 Iraqi protests.

**Archived source account.** Iraqi President Barham Salih rejects the nomination of Basra governor Asaad Al Eidani for Prime Minister of Iraq, stating that protesters will also oppose him due to his connections with Iranian-backed parties. As the constitution doesn't give him the power to officially veto candidates, Salih threatens to resign instead.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/iraq-president-threatens-quit-pm-nominee-191226132315483.html>).

### 2019-12-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088864782](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20December%2027&oldid=1088864782>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-12-27-0-1"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** Pakistani authorities announce they have arrested five suspected members of al-Qaeda in the eastern province of Punjab, as they are reported to have been planning an attack on security personnel.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pakistan-arrests/pakistan-seizes-five-suspected-al-qaeda-militants-idUSKBN1YV10I?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-12-27-0-3"></a>

Context: Iraqi insurgency (2017–present).

**Archived source account.** A rocket attack on K-1 Air Base in Iraq's Kirkuk Governorate, kills an American civilian contractor and injures several U.S. and Iraqi troops. No group has claimed responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/us-civilian-contractor-killed-troops-injured-rocket-attack/story?id=67949811>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-12-27-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Dutch government announces it will officially stop using the moniker "Holland" from January 2020, so the country will only be referred to by its official name, the Netherlands. The change comes ahead of the 2020 Summer Olympics and Eurovision Song Contest 2020, which the country is due to participate in.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/travel/news-and-advice/netherlands-holland-dutch-tourism-board-logo-a9261266.html>).

<a id="event-2019-12-27-1-2"></a>

Context: 2018 Moscow–Constantinople schism.

**Archived source account.** The Russian Orthodox Church cuts ties with the Greek Orthodox Church of Alexandria over the former's recognition of the Orthodox Church of Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2019/12/27/world/europe/ap-eu-russia-orthodox-church-africa.html>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2019-12-27-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Spotify announces it will suspend all political ads on its platform starting early 2020. It follows similar moves from Twitter and Google.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-spotify-political-ads/spotify-to-suspend-political-advertising-in-2020-idUSKBN1YV1GI>).

<a id="event-2019-12-27-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sudanese Finance Minister Ibrahim Elbadawi states that, as part of the government budget for 2020, subsidies for gasoline will be gradually lifted while the minimum wage and pay for civil servants will increase in an effort to combat both inflation and poverty. The budget, which will be finalized in two days, will also increase spending on education, social services, and aid to refugees.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-sudan-economy/sudan-to-lift-fuel-subsidies-gradually-in-2020-minister-idUSKBN1YV1LY?il=0>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-12-27-3-1"></a>

Context: Bek Air Flight 2100.

**Archived source account.** A Fokker 100 plane with 98 people on board crashes while taking off from Almaty International Airport, Kazakhstan, killing 12 and injuring about 60 others.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-50922219>).

<a id="event-2019-12-27-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A sightseeing helicopter crashes on the Hawaiian island of Kauai, killing seven people on board.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-50927645>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-12-27-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Food and Drug Administration announces that President Donald Trump signed legislation last week to amend the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act which will raise the legal age to buy tobacco in the U.S. from 18 to 21 in the next three to six months.

Source citations (as archived): [Gray News](<https://www.abc12.com/content/news/566498521.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-12-27-5-1"></a>

Context: Iran–Japan relations.

**Archived source account.** After briefing the Iranian government, the Cabinet of Japan approves the deployment of a destroyer and patrol planes to the Middle East (independent from similar U.S.-led and European missions) to protect Japanese vessels, as the situation in the region remains volatile.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-iran-japan/japan-to-send-warship-aircraft-to-middle-east-to-protect-vessels-idUSKBN1YV00W>).

<a id="event-2019-12-27-5-3"></a>

Context: Chagos Archipelago sovereignty dispute.

**Archived source account.** Mauritian Prime Minister Pravind Jugnauth says he is considering bringing charges of crimes against humanity against British officials in the International Criminal Court (ICC) over the UK's refusal to allow evicted Chagossians to return to their former homes on the Chagos Archipelago.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-50924704>).

<a id="event-2019-12-27-5-5"></a>

Context: Philippines–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte bans U.S. Senators Dick Durbin and Patrick Leahy from entering the country, as both are seeking to enforce sanctions on politicians involved in the prosecution of Philippine Senator and Duterte administration critic Leila de Lima. Duterte also threatens to tighten visa requirements for American citizens should the sanctions go through.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-philippines-usa-duterte/philippines-bans-two-u-s-senators-mulls-new-visa-rules-for-americans-idUSKBN1YV0GX>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2019-12-27-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Russia's Ministry of Defence announces the first deployment of the Avangard hypersonic glide vehicle (HGV), calling it a "landmark event". According to President Vladimir Putin, the top speed is over Mach 20 and it puts Russia's military "ahead of all other nations".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-50927648>).

### 2019-12-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088865127](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20December%2028&oldid=1088865127>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-12-28-0-2"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War (2009–present) / December 2019 Mogadishu bombing.

**Archived source account.** A suicide truck bombing at a security checkpoint in Mogadishu kills at least 79 people and injures 149 others. No group has claimed responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/12/28/africa/somalia-unrest-bombing-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-12-28-0-4"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** A Taliban attack on an Afghan military base in Sangin District, Helmand Province, kills at least 10 Afghan soldiers and injures 4 others.

Source citations (as archived): [VOA](<https://www.voanews.com/south-central-asia/taliban-assault-army-base-kills-10-afghan-soldiers>).

<a id="event-2019-12-28-0-6"></a>

Context: Monsey Hanukkah stabbing.

**Archived source account.** Five people are injured in a mass stabbing at the home of a Hasidic rabbi, during Hanukkah celebrations, in Monsey, New York. The suspect was later apprehended by the police. New York governor Andrew Cuomo calls it an "act of domestic terrorism".

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/nypd-adl-monitoring-reports-of-stabbing-at-synagogue/2019/12/28/4eb05460-29f5-11ea-9cc9-e19cfbc87e51_story.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-12-28-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A North Korean ghost ship washes up on the shore of Japan's Sado Island, containing the corpses of five people onboard, suspected to be fishermen. The bodies are described by Japanese police as "partially skeletonised", suggesting the boat has been adrift at sea for a long time.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-50934145>).

<a id="event-2019-12-28-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Five people are killed when a plane crashes near a Walmart supermarket in Lafayette, Louisiana. One occupant survives, while three others on the ground are injured.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-50935208>).

<a id="event-2019-12-28-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Indonesian palm oil tanker ship MV Namse Bangdzod vanishes in the Java Sea. The ship, with a crew of twelve, is theorised by rescuers to be the victim of piracy, a notion dismissed by the Navy.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jakarta Post](<https://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2019/01/10/the-curious-case-of-the-namse-bangdzod-mystery-shrouds-vessels-disappearance.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-12-28-2-1"></a>

Context: Corruption in Vietnam.

**Archived source account.** A court in Vietnam sentences former information minister Nguyen Bac Son to life in prison after finding him guilty of accepting $3 million in kickbacks via an overpriced purchase of Audio Visual Global JSC for nearly 8.9 trillion dong ($383.7 million) in late 2015 by government-owned company MobiFone.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-vietnam-corruption/vietnam-court-sentences-ex-minister-to-life-in-mobifone-corruption-scandal-idUSKBN1YW02M?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-12-28-2-3"></a>

Context: Prostitution in China.

**Archived source account.** The National People's Congress abolishes the use of forced labor to punish sex workers, but states that prostitution will remain illegal.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-lawmaking-prostitution/china-scraps-extra-judicial-forced-labor-for-sex-workers-idUSKBN1YW08M?il=0>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-12-28-3-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Algerian protests.

**Archived source account.** Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune appoints former University of Algiers professor Abdelaziz Djerrad to be the new Prime Minister.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-algeria-politics/algeria-names-new-prime-minister-idUSKBN1YW08G?il=0>).

### 2019-12-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1279494465](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20December%2029&oldid=1279494465>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-12-29-0-1"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** Security Belt forces say a missile fired by the Houthis hit a military parade in the southern separatist-held town of al-Dhalea, killing at least five people and injuring others. There are no claims of responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-blast/blast-hits-military-parade-in-yemen-at-least-five-dead-idUSKBN1YX047>).

<a id="event-2019-12-29-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Donbass.

**Archived source account.** The Ukrainian government and separatist rebels exchange prisoners according to the "all identified for all identified" formula agreed upon during peace talks in Paris earlier this month.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/ukraine-russia-backed-rebels-swap-prisoners-latest-sign-peace-efforts-n1108281>).

<a id="event-2019-12-29-0-5"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Local officials say Taliban have killed 17 local militiamen in an attack on their base in Khwaja Bahauddin District, Takhar Province. A Taliban spokesman says they killed 21 gunmen. The Taliban propose a 7 to 10-day nationwide ceasefire, after which a peace deal with the United States would be signed.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/taliban-attack-kills-17-local-fighters-northern-afghanistan-191229100215464.html>).

<a id="event-2019-12-29-0-7"></a>

Context: 2019 United States bombing of Kata'ib Hizbollah.

**Archived source account.** The United States Air Force carries out strikes using F-15E Strike Eagle jets and drones in Iraq and Syria in retaliation for the death of an American civil contractor in a rocket attack on K-1 Air Base in Kirkuk Governorate. The strikes were targeted at the Iranian-backed Kata'ib Hezbollah militia group. A spokesman for Kata'ib Hezbollah, says 19 of its fighters were killed and 35 injured in the American strikes, while vowing to respond.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-security-usa/u-s-strikes-in-iraq-syria-target-iranian-backed-shiite-muslim-militia-group-idUSKBN1YX0GR?il=0>); [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20191229-us-bombs-militant-group-in-iraq-syria-in-retaliation-for-contractor-s-killing>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-security/us-launches-strikes-in-iraq-and-syria-targeting-iran-backed-militia-pentagon-says/2019/12/29/28c12e22-2a64-11ea-be79-83e793dbcaef_story.html>).

<a id="event-2019-12-29-0-8"></a>

Context: 2019 United States bombing of Kata'ib Hizbollah.

**Archived source account.** Iraqi Prime Minister Adil Abdul-Mahdi condemns the unilateral American bombings inside Iraq, saying the U.S. strikes are a "violation of Iraqi sovereignty", and a "dangerous escalation that threatens the security of Iraq and the region."

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://eu.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2019/12/29/us-strikes-iran-backed-militia-behind-attack-killed-american/2770555001/>).

<a id="event-2019-12-29-0-9"></a>

Context: 2019 United States bombing of Kata'ib Hizbollah.

**Archived source account.** Iran warns of consequences after the airstrikes. The Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Abbas Mousavi stated it was "illegal" and "the United States must accept responsibility of the attack."

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2019/12/30/middleeast/iraq-us-airstrikes-reaction-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-12-29-0-11"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Following a tip-off from the United States, Russia arrests two men planning a New Year's Eve attack in the city of Saint Petersburg.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/vladimir-putin-thanks-donald-trump-for-helping-to-prevent-new-year-terror-attacks-in-st-petersburg-11897814>).

<a id="event-2019-12-29-0-13"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War (2009–present).

**Archived source account.** The death toll of the attack in Mogadishu the previous day rises to 84 with over 25 others remaining missing.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-12/30/c_138667291.htm>).

<a id="event-2019-12-29-0-14"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War (2009–present).

**Archived source account.** The United States target Al-Shabaab in a series of airstrikes that killed four. The strikes were in coordination with the government of Somalia.

Source citations (as archived): [DW News](<https://www.dw.com/en/us-targets-al-shabab-militants-after-deadly-mogadishu-bombing/a-51830689>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2019-12-29-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The world's oldest rhinoceros, Fausta, dies in Tanzania at the age of 57.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-50937820>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2019-12-29-2-1"></a>

Context: Citizenship Amendment Act protests.

**Archived source account.** The Indian tourism industry reports that, as a result of protests, December visits to the Taj Mahal and the state of Assam declined by 60% and 90% respectively compared to the same period last year. These declines are also occurring in the midst of general economic slowdown in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-india-citizenship-protests-tourism/tourists-stay-away-from-taj-mahal-other-indian-attractions-as-protests-flare-idUSKBN1YX03C?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-12-29-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Over 19 flights are cancelled as a three-day strike at Lisbon Airport comes to an end. The strike was instigated when airport owner Vinci refused to unfreeze wages for the employees.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-portugal-airport-strike/airport-strike-prompts-cancellation-of-flights-to-and-from-portugals-capital-idUSKBN1YX0BV?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-12-29-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ghanaian President Nana Akufo-Addo announces his country will adopt the eco as its new currency, but insists to fellow members of the currency union that it should not be pegged to the euro.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-westafrica-economy/ghana-wants-to-join-new-west-african-currency-but-ditch-euro-peg-idUSKBN1YX0EH?il=0>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-12-29-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An official at Bangladesh's health directorate says at least 50 people have died of cold-related illnesses in December. A cold wave sweeps through the country, with a lowest recorded temperature of \{\{convert\|4.5\|°C\|°F\}\}.

Source citations (as archived): [Thomson Reuters](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/bangladesh-cold-wave-1.5410074>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2019-12-29-4-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Samoa measles outbreak.

**Archived source account.** The Samoan government lifts its six-week state of emergency after a mass immunization campaign against measles reduced the death and infection rates.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/samoa-ends-measles-state-emergency-infection-rate-slows-191229021559134.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-12-29-5-1"></a>

Context: West Freeway Church of Christ shooting.

**Archived source account.** A man kills two people and injures another at a church in White Settlement, Texas, United States before being killed by a security guard and a civilian.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/US/injuries-reported-shooting-texas-church/story?id=67969564>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-50942664>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2019-12-29-6-1"></a>

Context: 2019 Guinea-Bissau presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Citizens of Guinea-Bissau head to the polls in the second round of the country's latest presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bissau-election/guinea-bissau-votes-in-presidential-run-off-between-two-former-premiers-idUSKBN1YX00V>).

### 2019-12-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088865545](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20December%2030&oldid=1088865545>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-12-30-0-1"></a>

Context: December 2019 Mogadishu bombing.

**Archived source account.** Al-Shabaab, an ally of Al-Qaeda, claims responsibility for the suicide bombing in Mogadishu, Somalia, that killed nearly 90 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-somalia-blast/al-qaeda-ally-claims-responsibility-for-somalia-blast-that-killed-90-people-idUSKBN1YY16C>).

<a id="event-2019-12-30-0-3"></a>

Context: Allied Democratic Forces insurgency.

**Archived source account.** ADF militants kill 22 people in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. They were all hacked with machetes and many also went missing in the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/rebels-hack-civilians-death-eastern-drc-attack-191230182423732.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-12-30-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019–20 Australian bushfire season.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people are reported stranded on a local beach awaiting evacuation near Mallacoota, Victoria, Australia, as bushfires enter the coastal town. Four people are reported missing. Elsewhere, a volunteer Fire and Rescue NSW firefighter died battling a bushfire near the town of Jingellic.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2019/dec/31/mallacoota-fire-mayhem-armageddon-bushfires-rage-victoria-east-gippsland>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2019-12-30-2-1"></a>

Context: Bolivia–Spain relations, Bolivia–Mexico relations.

**Archived source account.** In a tit-for-tat move, Spain expels three Bolivian diplomatic staff from Madrid after interim Bolivian President Jeanine Áñez forced two Spanish diplomats and the Mexican ambassador to leave. Their expulsions are related to the Mexican embassy in La Paz's decision to shelter at least nine officials connected to the government of deposed President Evo Morales.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/bolivia-spat-spain-mexico-deepens-morales-allies-191230153945637.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-12-30-3-1"></a>

Context: Lulu and Nana controversy.

**Archived source account.** Chinese state news agency Xinhua reports that He Jiankui, who last year announced the birth of babies with modified DNA, was sentenced to three years imprisonment and a fine of 3 million yuan, for "illegal medical practice". Two other defendants are given lesser sentences.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2019/12/30/china/gene-scientist-china-intl-hnk/index.html>).

<a id="event-2019-12-30-3-2"></a>

Context: Lulu and Nana controversy.

**Archived source account.** The court in Shenzhen confirms his claim that a second woman was impregnated, and reveals that three gene-edited babies were born instead of the previously believed two.

Source citations (as archived): [New Scientist](<https://www.newscientist.com/article/2228710-scientist-behind-worlds-first-gene-edited-babies-sentenced-to-prison/>).

<a id="event-2019-12-30-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Sudanese court sentences 29 people to be hanged for the killing of a teacher in detention in February during protests that led to the overthrow of former president Omar al-Bashir.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-50945224>).

<a id="event-2019-12-30-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Yemeni man, suspected to be an Al-Qaeda militant, is sentenced to death in Saudi Arabia for a November 11 terror attack against a group of Spanish theatre actors in Riyadh, wounding three of them. An accomplice is sentenced to 12 years of jail.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-50947324>).

<a id="event-2019-12-30-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former CEO of the Renault–Nissan–Mitsubishi Alliance Carlos Ghosn escapes house arrest in Tokyo and flees to Lebanon. He was under arrest for money laundering and underreporting his income, though he denies the charges.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-renault-nissan-ghosn-lebanon/ousted-renault-nissan-boss-ghosn-leaves-japan-for-lebanon-idUSKBN1YY1FM>).

### 2019-12-31

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1359815766](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2019%20December%2031&oldid=1359815766>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2019-12-31-0-1"></a>

Context: American-led intervention in Iraq (2014–2021).

**Archived source account.** Angry supporters storm the United States embassy in Baghdad, Iraq, in response to the U.S. airstrike on Sunday against Kata'ib Hezbollah militants. Iraqi officials say the U.S. ambassador and staff have been evacuated, but the U.S. Army denies this. The U.S. ambassador is reportedly on holiday. U.S. President Donald Trump blames Iran for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/iraq-protests-american-embassy-attack-violence-police-a9265131.html>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/dec/31/iraq-riots-embassy-expose-america-weaker-fewer-options>).

<a id="event-2019-12-31-0-2"></a>

Context: American-led intervention in Iraq (2014–2021).

**Archived source account.** According to an Iraqi official, demonstrators have prepared a sit-in protest in front of the embassy.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-12/31/c_138669405.htm>).

<a id="event-2019-12-31-0-3"></a>

Context: American-led intervention in Iraq (2014–2021).

**Archived source account.** Protesters in Tahrir Square distance themselves from the events around the U.S. embassy.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/protesters-embassy-baghdad-gear-sit-191231130210231.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2019-12-31-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tencent, along with Singaporean sovereign wealth fund GIC Private Limited and the Qatar Investment Authority, purchase a 10% stake in the Universal Music Group. The former purchased it to build up its own music streaming service.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-vivendi-universal/tencent-gets-into-global-groove-with-stake-in-vivendis-universal-idUSKBN1YZ0HF>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2019-12-31-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An \{\{convert\|8\|meter\|feet\|adj=on\}\} high fire ignites accidentally next to Adelaide Oval after the 9pm New Year's Eve fireworks in Adelaide, South Australia. This comes following major controversy over the New Year's firework displays across Australia in response to ongoing bushfires.

Source citations (as archived): [News.com.au](<https://www.news.com.au/sport/cricket/big-bash/bbl09-adelaide-strikers-vs-sydney-thunder-live-blog/live-coverage/7f0d7331e1d59f06c536323f5cf6d254>).

<a id="event-2019-12-31-2-2"></a>

Context: 2018–19 Southern Africa drought.

**Archived source account.** Severe drought conditions continue in Zimbabwe where close to 7 million people are facing food shortages, according to a Catholic aid agency. Because of repeated droughts over the past five years, many of Zimbabwe’s small farmers are unable to feed their families. Catholic Relief Services is working with farmers teaching soil and water conservation methods. The agency offers drought-resistant crops to farmers and is cooperating on a notification system warning farmers about threats to their harvest.

Source citations (as archived): [Catholic News Agency](<https://www.catholicnewsagency.com/news/farmers-in-zimbabwe-facing-severe-droughts-hunger-crisis-crs-says-56240>); [Bloomberg News](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-12-27/zimbabwe-drought-hunger-likely-to-run-into-2020-fewsnet-says>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2019-12-31-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court in Abidjan sentences Charles Blé Goudé to 20 years in prison in absentia for his role in the Second Ivorian Civil War that followed the 2010 presidential election, his lawyers say.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ivorycoast-justice/ivory-coast-street-militia-leader-sentenced-to-20-years-for-role-in-civil-war-idUSKBN1YZ0S7>).

<a id="event-2019-12-31-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Bosnian Serb Army general Milomir Savčić is indicted for his role in planning the Srebrenica massacre.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bosnia-warcrimes/bosnia-indicts-serb-army-general-over-srebrenica-genocide-idUSKBN1YZ11X?il=0>).

<a id="event-2019-12-31-3-3"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2019 Fresno shooting.

**Archived source account.** Police arrest six people in connection with a mass shooting last month in Fresno, California, that left four people dead and another six injured.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2019/12/31/fresno-mass-shooting-arrests-deadly-backyard-shooting/2783554001/>).

#### Health

<a id="event-2019-12-31-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** COVID-19 pandemic: The Wuhan Municipal Health Commission reports an outbreak of pneumonia of insatiable origin. The cause would be later identified as a previously unknown coronavirus.

Source citations (as archived): [Straits Times](<https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/china-probes-pneumonia-outbreak-for-sars-links-state-media>).
